product_title: Stiga High Speed Table Top Hockey Game by Stiga USA
review_headline: Fragile, cheaply made and poorly shipped
review_body: I bought this game as a Christmas gift for my grandchildren. It was delivered to me in an oversized box with no packing material.  The game was dinged, but OK upon inspection.  The first day the boys used the game a wingman rod broke.  Stiga does offer replacement parts, but this one was not in stock and is relativey expensive.  Overall, this game looks like a great toy, but it is cheaply made and certainly not worth the $90 +.  AMAZON should drop this item and manufacturer.

product_title: 1/1 Scale Realistic Looking Toy AK-47 Machine Gun
review_body: Bought this as a Christmas present to my son, and I have been very disappointed with the quality.  It is four days since Christmas and I have tried to keep the toy together with electrical tape (which detracts from the visual appeal).  The butt of the gun is already broken, the handle, scope, and side light are placed on the gun by sliding them on to some tracks, but they easily fall off.  I would not recommend this toy to anybody, and am disappointed I bought it.

product_title: Tattoo Artist Tote
review_headline: Less is more...More in price I guess
review_body: For the price, I expected more than one sheet of tattoos.  It all comes in a tickler file type case, for what? That makes for alot of empty pockets.  Maybe the holder is what I paid for.  I was disappointed when the receipient opened this as their Christmas present.  Maybe there would've been more tattoos if there was less of a case was lefor the price.

product_title: Color Stix
review_headline: Quick, Fun and Teaches Problem Solving Skills
review_body: This is a must have game.  It can be played as quickly as five minutes or less for one round, or it can be expanded to include several rounds.  It is a back to basics toy.  Just a bunch of wooden sticks.  The object is to line up as many of the same color in a row.  Strategies are tried out and success is built upon.  (Or if a strategy fails, no big deal- lesson learned and you move on.)  I gave the game a 4 star rating for durability.  Nothing has happened yet, but it would not surprise me if down the road, the paint starts to peel off of the sticks.   HINT: I am a huge fan of things made by Mindware and this is no exception.  I typically find the items in their catalog and unless I am able to find a coupon code, Amazon's prices are usually better.

product_title: Disney Advanced Talking Buzz Lightyear Action Figure 12" (Official Disney Product)
review_body: Santa left this for my 4 year old who is a toy story fanatic.  It's a cute toy, he has really enjoyed playing with it.  Though I'm a little disappointed in the quality.  There were a few flaws in the painting of the toy.  The door for the controls on Buzz's arm wont stay on and the stickers are already peeling off :(  I'm writing this review on January 1, he only received the toy on 12/25.  For the price I am not pleased with the quality.  However, my son is still in heaven, so it only matters to me.

product_title: DeNight Special 50 ARF
review_body: Solid construction and extremely well built ! Looks great and very robust landing gear. Havent had the opportunity to fly her as yet but should be lots of fun.

product_title: 8011 Mp5 Asault Team Ty Rifle Gun
review_body: I ordered 2 machine guns for Christmas from the seller directly because the shipping is cheaper.  On Christmas morning, my 7yo son and I were playing with the guns and the M16 broke within 5 minutes.  First, the sound stopped, despite changing batteries.  Then, the tip of the gun fell apart.  When it was working, my son loved it--for all of 5 minutes.    The other gun, a submachine gun, still works, but the shoulder handle broke as well.  These guns are fun, if they work.  Unfortunately, I cannot recommend them at all.  Very disappointed.

product_title: Chantilly Lane Singing Santa On Plane
review_body: This is a toy everyone is fascinated by: the propeller lights up with 3 different phrases as it rotates.  Merry Christmas, Happy Holidays, and Ho Ho Ho (I think).  It seems to go in one direction, then the other, which is done by the way the propeller lights up.  We absolutely love it.  A friend bought one in Fort Worth and I came back to Hawaii and couldn't stop thinking about it, so I found it at Giftbarntexas and got great and quick service from them.  Highly recommend.

product_title: Dogobie Dog Disc
review_headline: flimsy, dog won't pick it up
review_body: I bought this frisbee thinking it would be a good light weight toy for travel/camping...but the dog thought otherwise.  My GSD won't touch it.  It appears to be hard to pick up unless he grabs it from the top and bends it in half.  It is so flimsy it doesn't fly straight unless you throw it perfectly right.  Not fun for either one of us.

product_title: Fisher-Price Little People Animal Sounds Farm
review_body:
My nephew has a previous version of the Fisher-Price farm, and it has much more going on than the new one my son just received as a gift. My nephew's farm has a room for the farmer to sleep and a room with a work bench, both of which have sound effects, the chicken has a nest to sit in that clucks, the pig has a muddy patch that oinks, etc, and there's even a roundabout that plays a song. The new version has way fewer sounds and areas for play. The silo was added for the new version, which is nice since it can store the smaller parts, but I wish Fisher-Price had made the farm more interesting instead of less interesting. I also feel this set is overpriced for what you get.
Update: Well last month at 15 months old my son suddenly finds the farm to be more interesting than ever. He is always playing with the animals and putting them in the barn and everywhere else. He doesn't really care about the sounds, seeing as how there are hardly any sound effects it's not a surprise. So, yes, it's overpriced and could be better, but looks like he's going to get a lot of play out of it after all.

product_title: Non-trivial Quest
review_body:
I purchased this game a few weeks ago after someone brought it to a game night that I was hosting at my house for friends. We all had a blast playing the game! The questions covered all levels, so regardless of their general level of knowledge,
everyone had fun! And we learned relevant information (NOT useless trivia) while having a great time! :)

product_title: MobiGo Software Cartidge -- Cars 2
review_body: excellent product for the price . this product sell for over a hundred dollars in my country. so it was good to find it at such a reasonable cost

product_title: Mega Bloks Caterpillar Large Dump Truck
review_headline: Great truck, but back wheels keep coming off.
review_body: My daughter love this dump truck, but I am not as impressed. It lasted 10 minutes before the back tires popped off. Now every time she pushes it around the back tires come off. Like I said she loves it but I am very disappointed!

product_title: Fastrack Game
review_body: Unfortunately, my FastTrack game arrived without the wooden pieces enclosed, so I returned it unused.  I heard about this game on the Today Show and was looking forward to trying it out.  Too bad!

product_title: Hot Wheels Wall Tracks Starter Set
review_body: The wall track is a lot of fun but the starter set has to be carefully put up if you wish to add additional track.  Original mounting took three hours and then when the additional track was to be added well, everything is on a different wall now.  BUT A LOT OF FUN, oh one other thing the additional tracks have to be VERY carefully added to the starter because the cars do not like any bumps.

product_title: Game Zone Monkeying Around Balancing Game
review_headline: a few design flaws but still fun & easy!
review_body: I bought this for me and my 2 year old to play together.  She loves games but there aren't many for her age.    The spinner is horrible!  It doesn't spin properly at all!  The magnet needs to be a little stronger.  It is pretty predictable when it is going to fall when you get to a certain number of monkeys.    Overall, she likes to play it!  Great for hand/eye coordination and learning to take turns!

product_title: Plan Toy Victorian Doll House
review_body: I love the look of this dollhouse, like the natural wood and little touches like working windows... but the assembly instructions are a real problem. There are a number of parts that need to be put together with a specific orientation, but the instructions don't tell you that anywhere. I had to take the entire thing apart because a hinged wall segment wasn't closing properly, and even after that it didn't fit perfectly. Some of the components felt slightly warped, and there was a small split that needed glueing. The staircase also has a tendency to collapse, but the parts can be held in place with a bit of putty.  Overall, I'm still glad we bought it, but we'll have to see how it holds up over time.

product_title: Disney Princess Exclusive Princess Magical Castle Play Set
review_body: First, I will say that I did not purchase this toy online, but at the Disney store in the mall. However, do not waste your money! It is a piece of junk. The plastic is extremely thin and flimsy, the decorations are cheap stickers you apply yourself, and the stairs will not stay attached. I cannot believe that Disney would sell anything of such poor quality. Extremely disappointed, not only in the toy but in Disney.

product_title: John Deere Sit-N-Scoot Tractor
review_headline: Son loves it, parents not so much.
review_body:
I ordered this ride-on tractor for my son (7 months old). He loves the tractor, he enjoys sitting on it, playing on and around it, and I know in a few months he will love to ride on it as well.

The product seems well made, and I don't believe there will ever be an issue with durability. However, I just do not understand the axles. There is not locking mechanism to hold the axles in place from moving left to right. On one side of each axle is a raised rim, that keeps it from going all the way through, but through normal pushing and pulling the axle eventually works it way out in the opposite direction. Then mom or I have to push the axle back in and it will happen again soon.

Other than the axle issue, we're pleased.

product_title: Fisher-Price Little People Zoo Talkers Animal Sounds Zoo
review_headline: Birthday Hit for a 2 year old!
review_body: My Daughter recieved this for her second Bday, and she loves it.  We had bought all of the additional animals at Target in their stocking stuffer section at Christmas time and decided that we should get the zoo to go along with it.  She loves all of the animals, but does not use the identifying button very often.    I have seen a lot of complaints about the lack of a monkey, and must say that the monkey is no longer on the packaging, though it is still on the picture on amazon.  My one big complaint about it is that my tree swing and water slide break off very easily, though my daughter thinks that it is hilarious when it happens.    I would recommend this toy, in fact we are going to another bday soon, and we will have one of these wrapped and in tow!

product_title: Lalaloopsy Fashion Pack -  Party Dress
review_body: This outfit is adorable! The little dress fits well on the doll and it is made out of good fabric. My DD loves to dress her Lalaloopsy up and this dress is perfect and easy for her little hands to handle.

product_title: Ty Beanie Baby Hello Kitty - Aqua Plaid
review_body: Got this for two of my kids for Christmas. Very cute plush that is well made! They like to snuggle Kitty in bed and I just admit it's very cute!

product_title: Calico Critters: Baby Playhouse Windmill
review_body: Well, we ordered this item for Christmas, and when we assembled it we noticed that the windmill appeared broken. We contacted the seller who very graciously sent us another one since Calico Critters doesn't offer replacement parts. Crazy on Callico Critters part! Anyway, we received the \\"new\\" playhouse today only to find that the windmill is broken in it as well! Obviously, there is a packing problem where the windmill gets damaged during transport or the windmill is just poorly assembled/created by the manufacturer. We have many many Calico items, and this has been a dissapointment as far as quality and durability! At this point we have two houses with defective windmills! I wouldn't recommend this toy because of the poor durability. I will note, however, that my daughter still enjoys playing with it, but she gets frustrated when the windmill falls off as it does with play.

product_title: THE MERCEDES-BENZ 500K ROADSTER Model Scale 1:10 #CBC-203
review_body:
Of course this kit is made of cardboard paper, it is a WREBBIT product after all!
They are KNOWN for making puzzles and kits out of paper, so it should not come as a surprise (like the other reviewer stated).

The details, the overall design of this kit, including the many moving parts, the working drivetrain with rubber 'engine' within the motor block, 'real' threaded wire wheels - this must be the king of all paper kits of cars, period. Only to be matched by the \\"Working paper clock\\" book.
It is VERY difficult to build if you want the threaded wire wheels, hence they offer an optional print version of the wheels instead in this kit.
Not for beginners or kids - this is SERIOUS stuff for carton paper specialists.
A must for any car enthusiast - too bad, that the company has stopped making these wonderful kits many years ago.

product_title: Lauri Foam Magnets - Pattern Blocks
review_headline: My kids love these magnet pattern blocks
review_body: I bought this along with a white board/ magnetic board for my elementary aged children. It has gotten A TON of use! When they're bored and not sure what to do - we get this out and start making shapes. I love the creativity that comes with this and how my 5 yr old really is able to create something fun. She has made \\"castles\\" \\"homes\\" \\"trees\\" to name a few. She's also done \\"patterns\\" with them just like she has learned at school.  What I love most about this -- they have no idea that it's a learning toy. Ha!  This is a great rainy day \\"I'm Bored\\" kind of toys. Highly recommend to have it around the house.  I'd give it 5 stars but the jar is so tight that sometimes it's a problem getting them all back in there. Next time make the jar a bit bigger so that storing them is not so difficult.

product_title: Kids Authority Toy Microphone and Amplifier with Built In Speaker - Adjustalbe Height - Unisex Toy by Generic
review_body: I highly recommend not buying ANY products from the thief who runs \\"Dinev Deals, Inc.\\"  This price went from 40.00 up to 60.00 for an item that costs about 3.00 to manufacture.  This person should be arrested for fraud.  If we had paid 5 dollars I'd still be very upset. It's about the cheapest  piece of garbage you could fashion into a microphone/stand looking item. The sound  is barely audible, distorted even though low in volume. Horrible in every sense.  Show me the person who made and/or designed this thing and I'll show you a person  with cheap Hong Kong plastic shoved up his rear end. Avoid at all costs. Buyer beware.

product_title: Hard to Find Disney The Princess and the Frog 8" Raymond Ray Firefly Doll Mint
review_body: Cute character but way too expensive.  Just because it is hard to find it should not be so pricey.  It is very cute and my granddaughter enjoys having it to hold as she watches the movie.

product_title: Power Wheels Kawasaki KFX with Monster Traction
review_body: Excellent value. Tough, durable and clear instructions on assembly. My grandson grasped the concept of the accelerator peddal with no problem...ah, the turning thing needs some work. It was a great size and the adult \\"lockout\\" on the speed control was a good feature. I would recommend the product to anyone looking for something to excite and entertain a youngster.

product_title: Ty Beanie Babies Yo Gabba Gabba - Set of 5
review_body: I BOUGHT 2 SETS OF THESE FOR MY TWO GRANDSONS AND THEY ARE DELIGHTED WITH THEM. THEY GOT SEVERAL OTHER TOYS BUT THEY ARE CRAZY OVER THESE.

product_title: Peg Perego Polaris Outlaw - Red
review_headline: Lots of power - Use a helmet!
review_body: I weigh 125 lbs. Got on this unit to make sure it worked okay and was nearly dumped off.  Make sure kids wear a helmet!! I had ordered a different product for my grandsons for Christmas but had to send it back due to broken pieces, battery wouldn't charge, flimsiness, etc.  I'm very happy with the Polaris Outlaw 4-wheeler.  It's sturdy and should last for quite a while. ALSO, I ordered it on January 2nd with 3 other items. This was delivered on January 6th, less than 4 days. Amazing!

product_title: Redcat Racing 80142A Nitro R/C Starter Kit
review_body: The glow plug igniter was DOA out of this kit, but even considering that fact it still wasn't a bad value. To Amazon's credit, they were more than willing to take it back in their usual graceful fashion. But considering the value of the rest of the kit, I just kept it. I got another glow plug igniter that uses interchangeable batteries with a discharge meter. Which, if you are running a nitro engine, I would highly recommend doing the same thing. Aside from that, even with the broken part, I would get this kit again. For the price, you can't beat it...

product_title: TY Classic -Shadow - Black Cat
review_headline: Very handsome, very real looking cat
review_body: Shadow is great; he looks so real. I ordered him because I didn't seem able to order \\"Tux\\" cat at the time, but now of course I've discovered I could have got Ruth to order him for me. Never mind, I might order him and \\"Crystal\\" or \\"Spice\\" cat to be his girlfriend. All in all, very soft and handsome and mine at least DID come with a ribbon

product_title: Littlest Pet Shop Carry Case
review_body: This case was a necessity for my 6 year old daughter because of the sheer amount of LPS she owns now. All of the LPS cases available now are tiny, and we needed something large and durable. I like the small storage areas on the top. They are perfect for accessories and such. And the case itself holds all of her LPS, which is great. However, the latch is a HUGE disappointment for me. It completely falls off when unlatched. Or sometimes she will think it is latched all the way, and pick it up only to have it fall open and spill the contents. It is not broken or defective. It was clearly made so that the latch lifts up and flips down, but can be removed easily. It's weird. Not appropriate for a 6 year old. Too much work for kids always on the move. And for the $40.00 I paid for it, I wish I had bought a nice tackle box and some LPS stickers. She could have decorated her carrying case herself. I guess that is my recommendation for anyone looking to buy this case. Make your own.

product_title: Daydream Toy Flash Flyer (color may vary)
review_headline: WAY Fun, and a step above the rest
review_body:
I'm sorry, but I admit it, I purchased this toy as much for me as I did my 2 sons. It just looked like fun. Well it is! The light up factor is hugely appealing and opens up a whole new way and time frame you can play with the toy. I love that it is flexible and doesn't mark walls inside the house. There is a multitude of ways to work w/ the toy and it comes w/ a pamphlet to show you them all.

We've only had it a couple of days & I worry it may not last over time. The disk IS flexible, and the lights seem as though they may be fragile. But as of now, we are loving it. I'll try to remember to come back and update the review after some time has passed.

1/8/13 Update - well, the lights DO last. The disk lasts as well. The only thing that has had issues is the pull string. One of ours did break. It is very possible it is due to the roughness of the child playing with it, as our more gentle son did not break his. They did enjoy them for awhile, played with them both inside & outdoors at night, but they have lost their appeal after about 6 month. They only get picked up from time to time now. I guess that's true for alot of toys though.

product_title: Fisher-Price GeoTrax Disney/Pixar Cars 2 Dirt Race Track Pack
review_body: We have lots of GeoTracks. This set is a lot of fun. My boys use the Cars vehicles and their trains on it.

product_title: Wits & Wagers
review_body: Every time I come home my parents jump at the chance to play this game.  Its a family game and teaches you a lot in a fun way! Great game and lots of fun!

product_title: DC Direct Ame-Comi Heroine Series: Jesse Quick as The Flash PVC Figure
review_body: My boyfriend got me the Jesse Quick Figure as a Holiday gift to add to my growing collection of DC figures. There was a list of defects with the figure. Fist off the packaging was damaged, second her visor would not stay on and there was no no way to determine how to better attach it. Third her Flash Bolt fell off her chest and did not snap back on. Lastly He lightning bolt over he left ear had a crack. I was really upset that the gift someone got me was so damaged. It becomes a greater concern because my boyfriend bought this product directly from Amazon.com.

product_title: Venis Radio Remote Control Superior Championship Electric RTR RC Boat Remote Control Boat Full Function (colors May Vary)
review_body: I got this boat for Christmas and i loved it. But when i got it in the water it was going less than 5 mph. When i got tis boat out of the water and put it back in the box, and got it in the house it wouldn't run. This boat is a piece of JUNK.

product_title: Big Bad Booming Bugs Electronic Observation Station
review_body: 8 Year old and 4 Year old like this item.  One likes it because it keeps the bugs contained and the other because she can see the bugs.  The pincher cup shaped gripper that comes with this is useless.  We just trap the bugs with the container itself.  Using the ear plugs and hearing the bug is fun.  The downside as with many child magnifiers is that they don't magnify to the degree I would like them to.  And the magnifier is only on top.  It would be nice to have it on two sides as well.  I didn't know the clear plastic can twist away from the base.  We almost had a bug disaster (at least for the 8 year old.  I have no complaints about the legs.  We don't use them.

product_title: Green Trim - Black Smart Aero Protection Design Slim Soft Neoprene Cover Carrying Sleeve Case with Extra Accessory Back Pocket For WiFi HotSpot GPS 5MP 16GB Android OS AD2P 7 Inch Tablet Device + Includes a eBigValue (TM) Determination Hand Strap + Includes a Universal Graphic Designer Stylus Pen usedfor navigating your eReader + Includes a Anti Glare Screen Protector
review_body: Thiscasefits the7 inch tablet I got my kids okay. The elastic bands slip from the corner every once in a while. It does well to protect the tablet though. Great product for the price! The little accessories are trash.

product_title: LEGO - Minifigures Series 2 - KARATE MASTER
review_headline: Great service and my son loves it!
review_body: Thank you for this toy!  My son loves legos and enjoyed receiving this gift! It was a Christmas gift so it was important to get this in time too!

product_title: NECA Nightmare on Elm Street Head Knocker
review_body: Love this Freddie it really stands out in my collection I keep in my office. It's a must for all you fans out there.

product_title: Guess Who
review_body: This new and \\"improved\\" Guess Who is cheaply made.  If you so much as bump into the board, all the doors shut and the game is ruined and you have to start over.  The characters are too small to see differences.  It is made of cheap flimsy plastic.  Stick with the original flat game or you will be disappointed too!

product_title: LeapFrog Digital Download Card
review_body: This is a must have for the Leap Pad! I would recommend getting at least 2 of these if not more. If you see one for less than $20 grab it and save money. At the stores they can go for over $24. You can pick any downloadable program you would like and make it as educational or fun as you want. Very easy to use!

product_title: Corolle Fashions 14-Inch Pink Layette Set
review_body: I got this for my daughter for Christmas for her JC Toys La Newborn First Yawn doll that we got for her.  And the clothing just fit perfectly.  It's very durable material and almost seems like a real baby's clothing.  It's very easy to use for my 4 year old and it can go in the wash so it was just perfect.

product_title: Disney Pixar Wall E Stickers - 2 Pack (4 Sheets) Adhesive Autocollants
review_body: These are great little stickers.  They are very cute.  I got them as a stocking-stuffer for my wife.  She loves them and put them on a few things, as well as used them to play games with or reward her 5 year-old cousin.

product_title: My Pillow Pets Book Engardia And 17" Lavender Unicorn Pillow Pet
review_body: Bought it for my little niece. Her mom said that was her favorite toy she received for Christmas. She just hopped on her little horse & wouldn't get off of it.

product_title: Original Sifteo Cubes Game System(Older Model)
review_body: My 4 year old son received the Sifteo as a Christmas gift from his aunt. He has never seen it before. The moment he saw it, he said it's like an mini ipad. My son is a  \\"heavy\\" ipad user, he plays apps on the ipad all the time. At first I was skeptical that he would be interested at the little cubes. To my surprise, he fell in love with it immediately, and it is easy to learn how to use. He followed the \\"Getting Started\\" game and he was off to play all the games, even those that are for older children. I find that the sifteo differs from the ipad games in allowing the user to, not only practice their tactile skills, but also enforce their spatial reasoning and logic by having to switch around or rotating the cubes. Even more surprising is that my 11 years old and my 15 years old all have fun playing the sifteo with the games they choose, and found them to be of age-relevant difficulty. Something that challenges them to think. Now my dilemma is that when one starts to play the sifteo, the other 2 start to fight over playing them!

product_title: Little Tikes Super Chef Kitchen
review_body: Got this for my grandson and he just loves it has played with all day since Christmas. Very easy  to put to together. and very sturdy. Would recommend this to anyone.

product_title: Peppa Pig 12 & 24 Piece Jigsaw Puzzles
review_headline: Cute but too small and some probs
review_body: This is a cute set of puzzles, nice color, and nice box with handle. They are quite small so you don't get a whole lot for your money, but my biggest problem with it is that some of the pieces actually fit in the wrong slots. My daughter said she was done and sure enough all the pieces she put down fit without being forced, however, some of them where in the wrong spots...so the workmanship does leave a bit to be desired. If you can get them cheap (including the shipping which for us it wasn't since we are in the US) then they are worth the money, but I would not pay a premium price for these.

product_title: Real Construction Tool Belt Set Accessories
review_body: This toolbelt is cute and adjusts but it still slid down over my grandson's butt. He liked that the flashlight fit in the holder. It may be better as he gets older.

product_title: VTech Sit-to-Stand Learning Walker
review_body: Just the sound of it and my 14m old daughter wants to play with it! It is a great toy. She is never tired of playing with it.

product_title: Pressman Toy Retro Mastermind Game
review_body:
For what it is, this is a fine version of this game. Two problems, both with the pegs.

Firstly, the side slot meant for storing all the pegs is not large enough to accommodate all the pegs provided.

Second, there are two shades of yellow. The pegs are all weird Easter-y pastel colors. Would have preferred red, green, blue, yellow, et cetera.

product_title: Blip Toys Squinkies Barbie Dream House Playset
review_headline: My 4yo loves her barbie dream house!!
review_body: Out of all the squinkie dispensers i think this one offers the most play and best design. You throw the squinkies in through the chimney and there is extra storage on the right front, where you slide the roof piece over and you can store 6 or 7 more. It has a chute at the bottom that lifts to get them out. There is an 'elevator' on the left where you can place a squinkie and they ride up, places for them to sit on the balconies and roof. My daughter was so excited over this she ran around giving everyone hugs and kisses while squealing so i would have to say this was money well spent. If you lose the coins they give you to dispense the balls the instructions say dimes or pennies will work which i thought was excellent on the makers behalf. My daughter has about 20 squinkies and they all fit inside this dream house with room to spare, i'd say it could hold another 10 or so which i felt was a gracious amount. Love love love it!!

product_title: VTech Pop and Count Vacuum Push Toy
review_body:
My son is a curious child and loves to push things around. We were at a friends house and he found a vacuum in their kids room and spent hours with it. Knowing that many Vtech products are good I purchased this one for my son.

The pros: This was easy to put together. I spent more time taking it out of the box.

The Cons: This is impossible to play with as a vacuum. You can't push it on carpet, pick up blocks or do anything else a real vacuum would do. I expect toys to work as designed, but this was not quality controlled at all. My little one falls down a lot because there is no way to lock the base and it gets caught on everything.

This has become an outside toy since it pretty much only works on smooth surfaces.

The learning portion of this toy is pretty basic. If you have any other VTech toys it's pretty much the same.

Skip this and go with another brand. Even a small real vacuum would cost you a few dollars more and be worth the money over this.

product_title: Beyblades #BB113 JAPANESE Metal Fusion Starter Set Scythe Khronos T125EDS 4D
review_body: it is strong as it is but to make it better also get dark libra and then change their performance tips to make scythe Khronos a little bit better.

product_title: Learning Resources Jumbo Ocean Animals
review_body: These are nice big animals. My only gripe I guess is that there isn't a card telling you even each animals name they just come in plastic bags in an unmarked box - just seems strange for a teaching toy. Got them for a good deal - I don't think they are worth the retail price.

product_title: Hexbug Crab - Indigo
review_body: Bought two of these. Although batteries were included, they were dead. Installed new batteries, but toys performed dismally. Gifts to two grandsons, one of whom said quite candidly \\"this toy is lame!\\"

product_title: InnoTab 3 Plus The Learning Tablet
review_body: We purchased the VTech for our 4yr old daughter this Christmas.  The battery cover came loose and fell off the first day, and the second day the 4 AA batteries had died.  We got about 4hrs of use out of them.  The downloadable games were not very well put together. We will be returning this toy, and waiting until the LEAP Pad becomes available again.  My daughters favorite game was the art icon.

product_title: Lazer Stunt Chaser Dragonfire RC Car
review_body: Bought this for my 7 yr old nephew..powered up took off..crazy speed and he caught on quickly on how to run the controls..set up the stunt ramp..took a few tries but we found the best way to do it..got some serious air off the ramp..he was laughing and running the car all over..thru the carpet onto the hardwood..it flies over both..worth every penny and he loved it..thats all that mattered

product_title: LEGO 8683 Minifigures Series 1 - Sea Diver
review_body: Wow! This is a teachable moment for your son that life is full of disappointments. product_title: Cat in the Hat I Can Do That! Game
review_body: Received this as a Christmas present for my 7, 5, and 3 year olds.  I love the cat in the hat shows and watch them occasionally with kids so I was curious to see what this game would be like.  My 7 year old was interested in playing it so she set it up and I played with her.  Here are my thoughts: 1)the age range seems a bit old - I would think 2-4 year olds would be more entertained by this.  If I play again with my 7 year old I'm going to make up some more challenging/entertaining activities.  It was nice she could read her own cards, whereas the younger preschool age child likely will not be able to. 2) the scoring system was odd -- count the stars on your cards to see who has more?  Every other turn my 7 year old got a 'stop' card and kept that in her scoring pile and put the rest back in the draw pile.  The 'stop' cards do have stars on them so even though i probably did twice as many activities as her she still ended up with more stars than I did. 3) If we get the game out again i'll have to take a closer look at the directions, but I couldn't find any directions on what to do if you aren't able to do the activity correctly.  We just put the cards back in the 'draw' pile.  The tv show is so educational and fun - this game is lacking in both areas.  Quick update:  my just turned 4 yr old loves this game.  Regarding no.3 above, if you don't think you can do a activity you just draw again.

product_title: Rogue Trader: Battlefleet Koronus
review_headline: Best supplement I've seen in years
review_body:
I was very excited when I first learned about this book being published, and it lived up to the hype. In short, it adds all of the final touches to starship combat rules that weren't in the corebook, such as torpedoes, attack craft squadrons, and even ridiculously awesome things like Nova Cannons. It also offers a lot of new hull types, and rules for battle cruisers and grand cruisers, and a lot of stats for xenos/Chaos ships to make a GM's life easier. There is a section on rules for mass combat as well, both fleet and ground based. Both systems are workable, though the ground based mass combat is a bit unsatisfactory. It really should have been playtested more, and will likely require some errata (to say the least) to bring it up to standards.

However, the book's main focus was on fleet and starship combat, which this book excels at. Any GM who wants to expand the starship elements of his game would profit from getting this book; any 40k game which is going to center on the Imperial Navy in particular would find it essential.

product_title: Pathfinder RPG Beginner Box
review_headline: For a brand new beginner, this is Awesome.
review_body:
I tried the recent D&D Redbox and I hated it. I tried this Pathfinder box and I felt it gave me a real understanding of the game.
Both books are very solid, I love the small cardboard figures it comes with, and it explains things in ways that even someone brand new to table-top gaming can understand.

I can't recommend this enough. And even if you've played before it comes with some great card-board figure holders, it comes with a map that is dry-erase friendly, and it comes with a set of dice!

One thing to note - Paizo's website has further support for this pack if you finish the included adventure and you get bored with the 4 included classes. They add the class Berserker to the beginner box on there and they have yet another pre-constructed adventure to run though. I absolutely love the company who made this and will be purchasing more from them in the future.

product_title: Tetris Link -(Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is a very poorly thought through game - there are not enough playing pieces of the various shapes - we have run out of tiles every time we have played it!!!  The rules also have NO provision for what you do if you run out of a particular shape ... (do you loose your turn/do you choose a different shape?)    Also there is no value if you have a group of 7 ... 7 points, as opposed to a group of 4 and 3, still 7 points.  So the player who was able to get one big group has NO advantage, other than to break a possible tie.  No one in my household enjoyed the game (6 of us).  This game is an absolute flop - don't waste your money!!!  10x better on a computer.

product_title: Munchkin Deluxe
review_body: I purchased this game for my 16 year old son on recommendation of a Swedish friend, who's played it for years.  We grabbed it Christmas night to play, at the insistence of my son, and proceeded to spend the next four hours in some very animated gameplay.  The oldest person playing was 61; the youngest 14. review_headline: Awesome for the $. Press the nose, hear a MOO!

I saw this cool animal costume line at Hammacher Schlemmer, but at $30 a pop, I wasn't willing to make the investment:   [...]  I ended up finding this cow mask and others on Amazon, and for $5 each thought they were worth a try. product_title: LEGO Games Harry Potter Hogwarts 3862
review_body: Bought this for my Grandsons, ages 9 and 7. Played only once with them but thought this was a GREAT game and they enjoyed playing it. It is fairly simple to learn if you don't start with the additional options. The strategy is good because you only have to bother with your current turn since the board will change drastically before your next turn. This is good for younger children. It certainly gave the feel of the movies with the moving staircases and the classrooms with collectible objects. I don't understand the 1 and 2 star reviews, I found the game board sturdy, the rules simple, and the gameplay inventive and would be different each time you play.  Would highly recommend this game for beginning strategy.

product_title: LeapFrog Tag Junior Book Cars Shapes All Around (works with LeapReader Junior)
review_headline: Great for Children Learning to read!
review_body: This book is great for children learning to read when used in conjunction with the leap frog tag junior device. Even without the device the book is enjoyable for young children, however, when used with the device a whole new meaning and experience is provided when the book is perused by children. My son is 4 and reads this book using his tag junior on a daily basis. All of the leap frog books that go along with the tag junior have proved enjoyable and entertaining for young children! While I do not feel that my son is going to learn to read with this system, I do believe this system is allowing him to develop a love for reading at a young age!

The game has several options for game length (and an easy first game option) and as other reviews have said, it's much like San Juan in that you are using cards to build buildings. In this game, however, there are several rules on how to build them so it adds an additional few turns to each building. This one will be a staple in our regular rotation.

product_title: SpaceX Falcon 9 and Dragon Flying Model Rocket Kit
review_body: Actually, I am 13 and I am writing this review with my dad's permission.  We saw this rocket one day at a rocket launch session. it was being launched by a Space X team, who were flying this and testing the model of the Falcon Heavy; which, I must add, is pretty cool ;). this rocket is a brilliant flier, and it's clear detachable fins make it look even more like the real thing (for details of the full size rocket, luanching February 2012 go to  [] and click on the Falcon 9 tab). Another cool feature is that the nosecone or 'Dragon Capsule' has a seperate parachute to the body tube, attached at the tip of the nosecone,to make fuction more closely to the real rocket's pattern. Overall it is a brilliant rocket, although personally I can't wait for the release of the Falcon Heavy model! (Also at [...]

product_title: Small World Toys All About Baby Dolls - Hands That Hold Lilly
review_headline: Doll was nice for the price....
review_body: The girls like the dolls but I thought they were a little cheap.  Looked different in picture.  Passy and fingers don't stay in mouth very well but the girls played with them. I would buy better dolls instead of these but if you are looking to spend less then these are your toys...

product_title: Hello Kitty Wireless Intercom Set
review_body: I LOVE THIS PRODUCT.  IT'S SO EASY TO USE AND IT IS VERY EASY. MY NIECE ENJOYS USING IT EVERY DAY.

product_title: The Elf on the Shelf: A Christmas Tradition (With Blue-eyed Elf Plus Elf on the Shelf Skirt) - Make your Elf on the Shelf a Girl
review_body: This product arrived in perfect condition. At first my 6 yr. old wanted nothing to do with it. She said she was scary looking but, by the next day she could not wait to find her. Definately wish I had bought this a few years ago.

product_title: Green Toys Dump Truck Vehicle Toy
review_body: Overall toy is great.  Well built and great for my daughter.  We were suprised at the size of the toy.  Only about 12-14\\" in overall length.  We had expected it to be larger.

product_title: Angry Birds Plush 5-Inch Blue Bird with Sound
review_headline: Fun plush toy, now how do I turn off the sound?
review_body: Actually, the angry bird sound isn't that loud (almost have to hold it up to your ear), so that isn't an issue (for which I am grateful).  Seems similar in construction to other plush animals my daughters have.  They love their angry birds.

product_title: Melissa & Doug Giant - Lifelike Stuffed Animal Dog
review_body: Kids love it, Kids want to ride it but if there over 30lbs it seems to stress the legs. My 2 boy's 7 and 11 love husky's and this one looks so real. Amazon delivery is very quick.

product_title: Melissa & Doug Jumbo Triangular Colored Pencils (Set of 24)
review_headline: Fun and Great Help in Holding Pencils Correctly
review_body: If the question is whether the 4 year old was thrilled...well, she oohed about getting all the pretty pencils but it wasn't her favorite Christmas present.  From her mother's and my perspective, it was a GREAT gift!  Having 24 colors is outstanding; the pencils being triangular will help her learn how to hold pencils properly.  They'll be used and they'll be helping her and she'll have fun.  That makes them perfect in my book!

product_title: Air Hogs Hawk Eye Helicopter
review_body: No stabilization possible. Even using the trim knob it spun in circles. There is a lag between when you hit the photo button and it takes it. Even while pointing the controller at the helicopter it would suddenly just drop from the sky. Flight time was 2 to 3 minutes. I was able get it in stable flight for only few seconds before it would drop or begin spinning.  I knew it was cheap, but I was looking for something that would not be expensive to lose. I did not expect it to fall below my expectations for the price but it did.

product_title: John Deere - Wheelbarrow
review_body: I bought this wheelbarrow for my three year old grandson for christmas along with garden tools. As soon as the wheelbarrow was assabled, he went into the yard to rake up leaves under the Florida oak trees. Wonderful item, thank you!

product_title: Andrea By Sadek 16 Piece Children's Tea Set
review_body: Bought this for my 6 year old granddaughter who just opened it this Christmas morning. She absolutely loves it; I could not be more pleased.

product_title: 12 Decorate Your Own Rubber Ducks
review_body: I wrote on these ducks with sharpies (which I do recommend doing. Other marker will probably rub off as you do this.) They are so cute and very well put together. <3 them. I used them as a present, great present! Definitely recommend.

product_title: Plan Toy Chalet Doll House with Furniture
review_body: Every piece was warped. I was able to put it together, but because of the poor design, some of the pieces fall out. The directions are horrible, and none of the pieces are labeled so you don't know what the picture is referencing as alot of the pieces are similar but different enough to cause problems. If you love your child and want them to be happy, get a different dollhouse.

product_title: Digital Blue Barbie Boombox White/Pink
review_body: bought for niece, she claims it was the best gift she got for xmas!! how fun. i now can buy music for gifts in the future and know she will use it!

product_title: Super Sports RTR RC Car Series High Powered Radio Control Race Car 1:18 Scale Toy Model for Kids (Colors Vary)
review_body: I bought this car for my 9 year old son. I was hesitant to do it because my son has gone through about 6 cars all not durable enough. The car is wonderful. The headlights light up making it really cool in low light. He has had it in the house and outside and it keeps on working! You can't beat it for the price too.  You don't get to \\"choose\\" your color which for us was not a problem.  It doesn't seem to go through batteries and continues to run on evey surface!  I couldn't be happier! If you are looking for a durable and fun remote control car aat a reasonable price than this is for you.

product_title: Bushman Kids Costume
review_body: My son loves this. Its like his own little gilli suit. Hes wanted one for a long time but they are expensive. His friends want one now too. Great price. Fast shipping.

product_title: Veggie Singalong CD Player
review_body: The other site I was able to find a review of this for had 5 stars. Other than that, I could not find any reviews of this product before buying. We LOVE Veggie Tales here, and I was SO excited to give this to my son for Christmas. It was his big gift. He was so very very excited to open it and play with it. It won't play the CD though. The laser that reads the CD is not very good and it just won't play the CD. It will play about 10 seconds of the first song on any of the CDs we put in and then it just has a fuzzy noisy that comes out of the speakers. He LOVES the idea and when we put the CD into another player he loves to sing along with it on the mircrophones (which work very well!!). The mircrophone volume is incorrectly labelled with the volume up/down on the wrong sides, but I wouldn't mind that if everything else worked.  We are very sad over here. :(  And yes, we've tried different batteries (cheap and expensive) just to make sure it wasn't a picky electronic (because I know some are), but that didn't work. It just won't play the CDs. :(

product_title: 18 Inch Doll Stackable Bunk Bed Hand-painted - 2 Sets of Quilted Bedding, Mattress & Ladder - Beds Fit 18" American Girl Dolls
review_body: I got this bed for my 6 year old daughter who inherited two American Girl Dolls.  The dolls fit perfectly and the bed is very cute.  It can be separated into two twin beds.  Nice details are including a notch in the ladder so it stays in place.  The bedding is thin, but cute pink and white -- bedding could be a fun project for later on.  She loves it!

product_title: Yugioh YAP1-EN008 Shiba-Warrior Taro Ultra Rare
review_body: i recived this item last year but never got around to reviewing it i was impressed that the company put it in a protective seleve so thats cool it now proudly sits on self

product_title: Melissa & Doug Felt Food Sandwich Play Food Set (33 pcs)
review_headline: Felt food that looks and feels real.
review_body: Close as it gets to real. Attention to detail. A lot of fun. Not your typical plastic food. My grandchildren love all of the Melissa & Doug pretend food. Great learning tool for interpersonal skills.

product_title: EZ-Fort: The Bunker
review_body: Santa gave an EZ Fort: The Bunker and EZ Fort: Fairy Tale Castle to 8 yr old boy/girl twins.  They are always building forts with the couch and cardboard boxes.  They love the EZ Forts and put them together without adult assistance.  Their neighbor friend was over and he also loved playing in the forts the twins had built.

product_title: Air Swimmers Remote Control Flying Shark
review_body: I purchased the Air Swimmer Shark as a Christmas present for my 7 yr old son. He was really looking forward to playing with this toy right after he opened it. Unfortunately, after opening the box I realized I (translate my husband) would be in for several hours of assmebly. Even after making an early attempt to get it put together we were foiled in step 1 of the instructions which called for access to helium. On Christmas morning? Really?? I think this should be in bold on the front of the box. I found this to be very frustrating, and worse my young son found it to be very dissapointing. Several days later after arriving at the party store for inflation we were back on track. We then found extreme difficulty trying to keep the small pieces of cellophane tape from sticking together while applying all of the fragile fins. One did break while attempting to place it on the shark. If you purchase this plan on having 2 people for assembly. As an adult I feel this product is a slightly overpriced glorified mylar balloon. My son on the other hand LOVES it and is now having a great time \\"swimming\\" his shark around the house! Air Swimmer Shark is definitly alot of fun however, this product could be greatly improved by having it already completely assembled leaving only the inflation for the owner. The product could also use more durable materials for the parts.

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Soothe and Glow Seahorse
review_body: Product arrived fast, and in excellent condition. The outside of the product is somewhat hard, and child didn't seem to enjoy touching it.  I would think that a toy used for sleeping would be a little more touchable. otherwise product was what was expected.

product_title: Disney Phineas and Ferb 8 Inch Action Figure Dr. Doofenshmirtz
review_headline: What kids really do with the toy after Christmas.
review_body: Product arrived on time and was as advertised.  Would buy again from reseller.  Prize was lowest around.  Later the Disney Store at the mall had it for half the price but that could not be predicted.

product_title: Make Your Own Beeswax Candle Kit - Includes 10 Assorted Colored 100% Beeswax Honeycomb Sheets and Approx. 6 Yards (18 Feet) of Cotton Wick - Each Sheet Measures Approx. 8" x 16 1/4.
review_body: This was not so useful to make \\"cookie cutter\\" candles (stacking sheets of cut designs) BUT made great, beautiful, easy rolled candles.  My 2 & 4 yr old helped make them and did well and thought it was fun.

product_title: Little Einsteins Big Hugs Plush Toy Rocket
review_body: My 3 year old grandson loves this toy. He watches little einsteins on tv and imitates the rocket. I cannot believe I paid $50. for it. It's probably worth about $15. I called to question the price and they gave me a $15. credit which was ok, but it is not even worth $35. Because my grandson loves it so much, I'm glad I bought it, but it should have never been priced that high. It's just not worth that much money.

product_title: JXD 4 Ch Indoor Infrared RC Gyroscope Helicopter "Drift King" - Colors May Vary
review_body: I've flown and recharge the bird less then ten times and the recharging takes longer each time.  It went from 45 minutes to 90 minutes to 2.5 hours and now I've had it charging all night and it is still not fully charged.  I'm charging from a USB port.  I've tried different USB ports but that doesn't improve the time.  I'm not sure if I should get a plug-in charger or change the battery or return it and try my luck with a different bird.  Besides that, it flies ok,  I'm just a beginning and was mastering up/down and forward/back.  The long times between full charge makes the learning curve a lot longer.

product_title: Fisher-Price Little People Animal Sounds Farm
review_body: Bought this for my grandson. He loves it. It was delivered promptly and well packaged. The construction and quality of the toy is good. Only drawback is that on the silo, there isn't a way to latch the door up so the child can easily pull out the animals he's dropped into the silo from the top. The horse, especially, tends to get stuck when trying to pull it out of the silo b/c he's larger than the other animals. I suppose lack of latch and horse size encourages development of dexterity?

product_title: Hot Wheels Color Shifters Dr. Bones Color Lab Playset
review_body: Although my son is enjoying this toy, it should be advertised as an outdoor toy. There is such a mess everytime he plays with it. Water is everywhere, on the floor, chair, the towel I stuck under the toy, and all over my son. I am all for him having fun, making messes, but this toy is way too messy with the water. On the plus side, it doesn't seem to be flimsy, and he does like it. If you do buy this, just be prepared for a major mess, or just set it up on a porch outside.

product_title: Build-a-Bear Workshop Red Beary Turf Shoe Teddy Bear Sports Footwear
review_body: We got these cleats for our 7-year old soccer player for her new Build a Bear (and as a companion to the soccer outfit).  They are absolutely adorable and very authentic looking.  She loved them!  Someone else even bought her a black pair (without knowing we'd already gotten them for her) which she wanted to keep as well, but we told her to pick one and swap it for another outfit.  She decided to keep the red and exchanged the black pair (for ice skates!).  [[ASIN:B002R86BKQ Build-A-Bear Workshop Red Beary Turf Shoe®]]

product_title: Pastel Smoothie Set
review_body: Great little smoothie set, it would be nice if there were lights or if it made noise, but its all wood and made of safe non toxic materials so thats all that counts.  Love this set because its teaching healthy habits!!  My daughter loves it because we make real smoothies together in the morning.

product_title: Revell 1:32 M4 Sherman Tank
review_body: I purchased this model, and one other, as a couple of projects my son and I could spend some time on over these last holidays.  There was a little coaxing of the major top and bottom halves of the tank.  Judicious removal of some plastic on the edges.  Didn't take long, and otherwise, the model went together nicely.  Took a few moments to remove some of the burrs on some parts for easier assembly.  Nothing unexpected.  Lots of moving parts (the tank I had as a kid had no moving parts).  On this one, the treads work (wheels rotate), the turret rotates, the gun elevates, and over-all I am quite satisfied.  My son liked this, and the other model.  My son's age is 7.  Son likes them; I got to spend some extra time with him; mission accomplished.

product_title: LEGO Space UFO Abduction 7052
review_body: I got this toy for my son on Christmas. He loved putting it together and playing with it afterwards. It is very to play with.

product_title: Critter Clinic Toy Vet Play Set
review_headline: The only present my granddaughter played with!
review_body: I ordered this not knowing to much about ti.  I noticed it came with a set of keys and my two year old grandchild LOVES keys.  It was a hit.  This is the only present she played with.  My older granddaughter loved it too!

product_title: Allosaurus
review_body: This is a nice looking dinosaur. My child is enjoying it very much. It is pretty small though. I guess I thought it would be bigger from the picture for some reason. It's not big like a T Rex, more like a raptor.

product_title: Kid Galaxy Robot Circuit
review_body: The Kid Galaxy Robot Circuit is an easy to use robot for use by younger children.  It has the sounds, lights and movements that appeal to younger children and has simple controls.

product_title: My Little Pony So Soft Newborn Sweetie Belle
review_headline: Perfect for my four year old
review_body:
My four year old LOVES My Little Pony, and this toy was the biggest hit this year. She's soft enough to cuddle, and makes some noises when you squeeze her foot.
The play value may turn out to be minimum, as she doesn't DO a whole lot, but so far she's a great snuggle toy and my daughter has had fun feeding her and playing with her so far...

product_title: VTech Sit-to-Stand Learning Walker
review_body: My one year old son loves this toy. It is his favourite toy. He loves to pretend talking on the phone, loves the music and the amazing thing is he identifies the 5 keystrokes and enjoys a lot.

product_title: My Pillow Pet Lady Bug - Large (Pink And Purple)
review_body: The recipient of this Pillow Pet at Christmas was absolutely overjoyed with the gift. It is taking pride of place in her bedroom and in her \\"pup tent\\" outside. Loves it!!!

product_title: Air Hogs Cars 2 RC McQueen & Francesco
review_body: Bought this as gift as one of my four year old son's Christmas presents. He absolutely loves Cars 2, so I thought it would make a nice gift. The packaging is a nightmare, however while trying to set-up Francesco after setting up Mcqueen, I noticed that the flimsy steering mechanism on Mcqueen had already broken. It lasted a total of ten minutes!!!   I certainly didn't expect the toy to last forever, but not to make it past Xmas day...! What a disappointment. We'll see how long Francesco will last.

product_title: Schleich Replica Saurus: Quezalcoatlus
review_body: My little boys love dinosaurs and this was an excellent addition to his collection. He likes realistic toys, this was a great buy.

product_title: Lionel Polar Express Train Set - G-Gauge
review_body: For $98.50, bought on Amazon 5 Dec 2011, its a great deal. Delivered in about 5 days. All plastic train set (g-gauge), 12 curved plastic track pieces about 11\\" x 3\\", and 4 straight plastic track pieces about 7\\" x 3', with remote control variable speed control, includes reverse, has buttons on r/c for whistle and also a bell, and audio \\"All Aboard, This is the Polar Express\\". My 4 year old can't stop playing with it, it came with an engine linkage not connected but it didn't take a scientist to make it work. I bought the extra batteries and a charger (~$42), thinking I'd need them and expect to need them, but batteries have been good so far, 2 days off and on. I debated on going the next step higher to the o-gauge, and am glad I didn't. My little guy can't keep his hands off the pieces, so no worry because its all plastic and remote control powered by batteries. The o-gauge would have been with electric track, transformer, etc. I didn't like giving the time required to fix the engine, but am impressed otherwise. The set is simple, looks realistic, and operates as intended so far, no complaints. Well worth it if you have a 4 year old boy that likes trains who doesn't already have one.

product_title: Melissa & Doug Swivel Bridge Wooden Train Set (47 pcs)
review_headline: Great train for a 2 year old
review_body: My grandson plays with his new train every day, according to his Mom.  He puts the train pieces together himself, which teaches him how puzzle pieces work. The track works well in any configuration. And they found \\"Thomas\\" which works with this set as well.  I am very happy I chose this gift as Ridley's Christmas present! It was within my price range and a good value.  Kathy from Atlanta

product_title: 28" Snap Together Hula Hoop for Kids
review_body: I like that this hula hoop comes apart; I thought it might be less likely to get run over or broken.  Because the plastic is so cheap, it's not that easy to snap together, so I don't see we'll be taking it apart that often.  My daughter is almost 4 and probably could use a smaller hoop to learn with, and the better quality ones are more weighted, making them easier to use.  This is really, really light.  Even adults who are good at hula hooping have trouble using this one.  I try hard not to buy plastic toys, particularly cheap plastic ones, but I fear this one will be in the landfill sooner than later.

product_title: Twins Weazel Ball Weasel Chase Jump Rolling Ball Childrens Toy
review_body: I purcased this for my kitten and after her getting used to it for several days, she is very happy with it. She chases it all over the house.

product_title: HO scale Bachmann Trains 2-8-4 Berkshire Pere Marquette 1225
review_body: This train did not run on my system. So I returned it to the company and they said it will take 6 weeks to repair it. I am still waiting for it to return.

product_title: Hot Wheels Sketch Portfolio
review_body:
It's Hot Wheels, how can that not be fun. My son had fun pointing out the cars in the book, and comparing them to the cars he has in his own collection. He did get frustrated that he couldn't make his cars look even close to the cover design.

I really didn't care for the monsters added to the cars. They didn't seem to fit. It's a book to design cars, so what are
these monsters doing? They took away from the true focus- the car. Not enough stickers, and originally we didn't even recognize that they had numbers attached to them to tell us where they went. Not very imaginative when directed where things should go. The stencils were also confusing and a lot of work. They are also specific to each car. This leaving very little room for the imagination. Searching tediously for the right stencils to fit the car, stecils that don't always work, and then looking back and forth trying to match the stickers with the car... it loses something.

product_title: Mindscope Neo Tracks Additional Car Pack Set of 2
review_body: Initially these cars were amazing however they eat batteries VERY quickly. After replacing the batteries we noticed that the cars did not move nearly as fast as they originally did. My twins have lots of fun with them but some cars are definitely much slower than others and they run into each other. We do have a double set and 6 cars so the track gets a little crowded. I was just surprised that the cars would lose power so quickly. Overall they are fun.

product_title: LEGO City Fishing Boat 4642
review_body: MININIFIGURES:  this set includes a man and (what im guessing is) his son.  The son has a white hoody, blue short legs, a life jacket,a green hat, and an eager expression with freckles.  The father has a blue and red plaid shirt on, blue legs, a life jacket, orange/light brown hair, and a smiling face  Nothing really special about the minifigs.  VEHICLE:  The bottom of the boat is just one giant piece with a few pieces on top, it has an iner sanctum for sleeping or getting out of the sun, some controls at the top and a seat near the back to fich off of.  OTHER:  the set included one generic shark which is a nice extra, a fish to catch and 2 fishing poles.  PROS:  cool boat  lots of accesories  2 minifigs  floats  CONS  62 pieces and $20  stickers  This set only has 62 pieces and cost's $20 (its should cost $6-$7)  and should have been $12 at the highest.  I would only recommend this if you like fishing, if you need more boats in your city or both.

product_title: Faber-Castell - Young Artist Texture Painting Set - Premium Art Supplies For Kids
review_body:
My daughter loved this present! My husband loved it as well. He actually laughed with excitement and told her to go paint him a picture with every brush used.
He is such a kid . haha!
It is a wonderful gift/ present idea!

product_title: LEGO 2011 City Advent Calendar 7553
review_headline: First year with the calender and surprised at the great value!
review_body: My 3 and 5 yr old sons are Lego maniacs!  We have spent a fortune over the past year on legos.  I had no idea about these Advent calenders until this year..my mom was able to get it dirt cheap using a coupon at B&N and the boys loved it.  I will say, we had to open 2 boxes every OTHER day as they fought so bad for the piece.  But every other day they were excited to see what was inside.  I was surprised with several minifigures, pieces we have never had before in our other sets like a skateboard, safe, etc.  If you can get it on sale or with a coupon, it's a great deal!  I would agree with the other posters that the theme of robbers puts a damper on the holiday.  My 3 yr old kept saying \\"oh no they are going to steal all the presents!\\" and would tear up.  Hopefully next year will be a different theme.

product_title: Aeromax Jr. Astronaut Suit with NASA patches and diaper snaps
review_body: Shipping took a reasonable amount of tiime, item is very cute and my 4 year old can put it on without assistance.  Fabric is a little thin so I'm hoping it doesn't wear out soon, but it's adorable, comfortable, and age appropriate.

product_title: Mindscope Neo Tracks Additional Car Pack Set of 2
review_body: These cars are great at first but they do not last long. The wheels came off about 15 min after we took them out of the box and power does not last long. Even with a brand new battery the cars do not go well. They are fun while they go.

product_title: Q-bitz Visual Dexterity. Cubed with FREE Storage Bag
review_body: This is a good game for exercising the brain. It is a great family game as age doesn't really help you win. Our 13 year-old nephew won probably 8 out of 10 rounds.

product_title: Awkward Family Photos
review_body: The game was fun but would have been better if we didn't play it in \\"mixed\\" company (teens, parents and grandparents). I suggest if you play this, stick to a group of people around the same age range, otherwise it is awkward for the players.

product_title: Guidecraft Center Stage Table Top Puppet Theater
review_headline: Great gift for a 5 year old...she loves it.
review_body: Bought this for my grandchild and she loves it, and her cousin loves it as well (both are 5). I got puppets at a teaching store (king, queen, dragon and wizzard) and they put plays on all the time. I did put felt on the bottom so stage would not scratch the table they use for their shows. It works great and fills a lot of hrs. with great fun.

product_title: Super Magz 130 Magnetic Construction Kit M1704 (Age 14+)
review_headline: build with magnets and steel balls
review_body: This is a fun toy.  I just let the pieces sit on the dining room table.  Both kids and adults will enjoy  playing around, designing different things.

product_title: Blank Playing Cards
review_body: I purchased these to make an aid to an existing game.  They are dry-erase but Sharpie does stay on them permenantly.  The were exactly what I needed them for and performed as advertised.

product_title: Tie - Not Water Balloon Filling Set (Tie-Knots Color May Very)
review_body: i bought one of these last year for summer. i saw the video on vat19.com. it was okay for the first day i used it. i practiced making some the day before the water war and it took maybe a good 5 attempts before i was able to get the hang of it and not get scared of swinging the balloon over the stick. it is possible to get a balloon tied in under 6 seconds, but it takes practice.   the disappointment came when we played a second time a week later at a different location. the water pressure was inconsistent, so i guess that put strain on the tienot's internal workings. the push valve on the top kept popping off, which would temporarily halt balloon production. i got wet.... a lot.. and i didn't even throw any balloons that time. after the tenth time the valve trigger popped off, i couldn't find where it flew off to anymore, thus ended the life of the tienot water balloon tying tool :'(. the valve needs a stronger hold somehow. it keeps unlatching and popping off and the device itself would expand from the water pressure.. i guess that's what cause the hold on the valve to loosen. maybe after the design flaw is fixed, it'd be okay. as a tying tool, it's cool. as a water valve, it needs some reinforcement or a harder more durable plastic.  the 100pcs if biodegradable water balloons are thin, but surprisingly elastic. you'd think they'd burst when you hold them, but they don't. unlike normal water balloons you'd get from anywhere, these don't rip or burst (at least when i was filling them) when you fill them up. even without the tool, the high elasticity makes it easier to tie.   i'd still recommend buying this, but don't turn the faucet up all the way to avoid breakage. then again maybe it was just the item i got.

product_title: AEROBIE 13 in. Pro Ring
review_body: Got this for my 33 year old brother for Christmas. He and I had various sized aerobies growing up and loved seeing how far we could throw them. This one is large, perhaps oversized, and goes and goes. We took it out the day after Christmas and were routinely throwing it 150+ yards. It can probably go farther than that in better conditions. It's still soft to catch. A real joy to play with. Gets you out of the house and running more than you'd think (errant throws). Every kid should have one of these and a big open field to let it fly. Love this toy. Brought back a lot of great memories.

product_title: X-Zylo Flying Gyroscopes
review_body: It took a few tries to get the throwing technique, but this thing really did fly after we got the hang of it. We threw it almost exactly like we were pitching a wiffle ball across home plate. The video on Vat19 shows how to throw it even farther using a sidearm or underhand technique. Perfect. Okay. Stop typing now. Come on, really, dad. Tee Heee.

product_title: BELLYLADY Navy Blue Belly Dance Hip Scarf with Gold Coins
review_body: I ordered this product from Amazon about a month ago for a belly dancing performance. First of all, I LOVE the color. The product looks just like the picture. The coins are super fun and yes, they do jingle. I am 5'4, 145lbs and the skirt fit great. Just make sure to tie a hard knot to keep the skirt from falling down if you move around a lot when you dance like me! :)

product_title: Kids Children Electric Piano Toy Karaoke Music Keyboard
review_body: You definitely get what you pay for with this product.  It's made of cheap plastic, and it wasn't long before both the microphone holder and microphone broke.  The sound quality is also quite poor.  Having said that, my daughter (2yr) does enjoy pressing the various buttons and likes that it has a stool.

product_title: Toynami Robotech Maia Shadow Alpha Fighter MPC
review_body: I just got this for Christmas, and while it's a beautiful piece, superbly engineered and such, the plastic is fragile. While trying to transform it I noticed stress points in at least two different areas. Any further pressure may warp or cause the pieces to break. It's not meant to be transformed even on a casual basis, and it's certainly not as durable as the first generation Macross Masterpiece Veritech Fighters.  So, yeah, it's fragile. I'm 34, and I'm not going to be playing with it constantly, but it does disappoint me.  One other gripe, the gun pod does not fit. The mecha can't hold it, can't place the fist into the slot, whatever. It's annoying.  But it's beautiful, too. Looks great on the shelf.

product_title: Baby Born Lil' Wagon

product_title: The Wonder Forge Dr Seuss Super Stretchy ABCs
review_headline: Great fun for my 2.5 and 5 year olds
review_body: The first thing I noticed when I opened the box was that there was nothing to assemble. All of the cards and chips were punched out, and put it their own tiny zip-top bag. The \\"toy boxes\\" used to collect the chips were also already assembled. This seems to be unheard of now-a-days. The box the game comes in is also nicely constructed, and will help keep all of the pieces inside.  As far as game play goes, my kids really enjoyed it. What works well, is that unlike twister, each player takes a turn on his/her own. This allowed us to have a bit different rules for my younger child than my older. Per the suggestion of a previous reviewer, we had my 2.5 year old son, who is still learning to read his alphabet, just find the letter, and touch it with the proper body part, instead of trying to touch all of the letters at once. This is really helping him identify his letters. However, after watching his older sister try to touch them all at once, he tried to do it that way, too. So maybe next time we'll try to have him play that way. I also tried to play with them... it just reminded me how inflexible I am :). It is really silly trying to watch everyone try to touch everything at once.  I also liked how the chips come out displaying either the letter, or a picture. This was great because it allowed for my 5 year old to think about her reading skills when determining the starting letter of the words. For my 2.5 year old, I would just flip the chips over to display the letters.   I also liked that it's easy to make your own \\"house rules\\" for this game. Play it the way that makes the most sense for your family.   Another thing I liked is that the winner of the game is random, and not based no the number of chips received. At the start of the game, a \\"Secret Letter\\" car is selected. When the game is over, the person who won the chip with that letter, wins. If no one has that letter, then it says Thing 1 and Thing 2 win :). This works well since it would be easier for my son toget the most chips since our rules are not making him stretch to get his letters. However, it would be very easy to change the rules to make the person with the most chips win.  Overall, I think this is a great game not only because it is fun to play and educational, but the game came with no assembly needed, and a quality box with quality parts.

product_title: Syma Big CH-47 Chinook 3 Channels RC Helicopter *Colors May Vary
review_headline: Great Toy! Here Are the pro's and con's
review_body: I have never written a review before, but i had to for this toy!  Here is the deal, I fly a lot of these smaller grade rc helicopters, this is the best one i have flown, i picked up being able to fly this one very fast because others i have purchased are cheep and difficult to fly, I have only been able to fly it three times because i just got it tonight, and u need to let the battery cool before u plug it right back in to charge. and then it charges around 45-60 min.  Pro's  This thing is awesome! Its bigger than it is given credit for! The body is 11 inches long and with the props, its 17 1/2 inches!   The thing has got some massive power! The props are sweet! The LED lights on it are cool and fun to have!  It is a lil sensitive but muuuch more stable than any other copter i have gotten for this price!! Someone who typically doesn't fly these things, fly it low and fly it cautiously when first starting off!  It is super durable!   Another great thing this has, is that the copter charges through an outlet, and the remote control only takes 4 AA batteries, while lots of other rc things will take 6-8, thats a big bonus!  Con's  There are always cons, these things are made in china, and mass produced, all these rc helicopters are gunna have defects, i have worked at places like meijer and walgreens and all those places that sell helicopters and we get tons of returns for defects, so if u get a defect, don't hate, just send it back, get a new one, and u should get a good working one, sometimes ur just unlucky!  The charge on the under belly of the copter is very short and hard to plug in and unplug, but id rather that then spend tons of money on batteries. It'll b harder if u have sausage link finger....Xp  If u have read a lot of these reviews, u'll pick up these things sometimes freak out! And they do, mine did the very moment i turned it on, it spazed out flying full boar, luckily i had it safe in my hands, but it was ready to shoot off like a rocket! and that thingcould do some damage! I have flown it three times, for 15 min intervals, and the first two times it did act up like it was possessed, the second time i let my dad fly it, and it flipped out and smashed into the wall, i wasn't happy considering i hadn't crashed it yet, but the third time it didn't crash, im just cautious with it, it really is an awesome toy!

product_title: TOKYO MEW MEW: Main Characters 6 figure set
review_body:
I have an authentic Ichigo that is high quality - no paint chips, sturdy, etc.
The set pictured here is bootleg aka fake. This keychain set was originally made in Japan, but then bootleged in Hong Kong with the molds, therefore fragile and poorly painted. The best way to tell is when a set of 6 is offered together; there are FIVE figures in the authentic set, the extra lettuce that is lighter in color is a bootleg of a different figure set. What does that mean? That means that these were mass-produced for a few cents and they aren't worth anything. If you sold them as authentic to another collector...Be wary of buying anything from Hong Hong and always research your buys...If the price is too low and it looks too good to be true...it probably is.

product_title: Monster High Create-a-Monster Werewolf & Dragon
review_body:

product_title: Air Hogs - Sharp Shooter - Blue
review_headline: for the price stick with the Syma or other better brands
review_body:
they are much more durable, flyable and forgiving than these... here was a multi product review i did:
So for xmas a two 107Gs, a 109G and a 111G as well as two Air Hog Sharpshooters arrived at the house for the kids. The Sharpshooters are just not worth it especially for the money - i think they were even more than at least one of the Syma's - they are cheaper made, no forward/reverse - never can really find trim and one piece blades. one broke on the second flight.

Now, the Syma's - Im absolutely impressed. I had bought two mallstore copters last year which were junk. Impossible to fly, and no where the quality or durability.

I like all three of these, and here is my take:

107G's are the most nimble of the three - quick to the air, stablest in hover and seem to move the quickest when low to the ground.they have skids so pretty decent on the land - and if rolled over on side, a quick throttle boost can right them back up on the skids.

109G - love the look (military), seems a little beefier and for the kids its great --moves nicely controlled.

111G - most sensitive of the three, but makes it interesting. Seems to be the hardest for the kids to fly. tends to pull back when trying to just hover or lift off.nice looking though and frankly i like the difference the three bring to the table.

all around, very impressed with the Syma Brand and durability - did not expect the quality and product after the Air hogs experience and mall bought mini's. Pleasantly surprised and look forward to a couple more!!
