product_title: Rory's Story Cubes Actions
review_body: The best toys are often the simplest and most elegant.  The concept here is very straightforward: roll a set of nine six-sided dice (a small compartment for rolling is integrated into the box) and tell a story using the small picture/icons what comes up on the set.  The box is slightly larger than a deck of cards, and has a magnetic closure on the top flap.  The directions suggest that one picture could be the basis or theme, and that one storyteller or alternating people could add to the narrative using the remaining images.  The rules themselves are offered only as suggestions, so players could make up other rules of play as well.  My kids play a variation that puts the cubes in a line and requires that they tell stories about one another using all nine pictures in order.  I play with them by telling a story using eight of the nine, and having them point out which I missed.    My favorite use so far is in the car (on a plane would work equally well).  We set the story in our actual travel destination and ask the kids to use a particular \\"vocabulary\\" word in the stories they tell, and then let them play whichever variation they want.  The key is that the game is intuitive, even for a 4-5 y.o., is not language-specific, does not make electronic noises or require batteries, and is portable.  I also don't see us getting tired of it anytime soon.  And at less than $10, it is a bargain.  This gets tucked away on my list of gifts for others, too.

product_title: Rush Hour Logic Game
review_body: I was a little worried about buying this for our 6 year old.  He struggled a bit at first, but, once we showed him how to play the game he quickly caught on.  Now, he looks forward to the increasing challenge levels and always announces when he has completed the next level.  This is sooo much better for him that a video game.  Rush Hour requires the player to move cars around in order to \\"free\\" the Red car.  It reminds me of the toy I had as a child where one had to move 15 tiles on a 4 x 4 plate and place them in numeric order.  However, this has 40 levels of difficulty.  So far, our 6 y.o. has solved all 10 of the beginner levels.  I have solved 20 including the intermediate levels.  Lower levels will challenge an 8 y.o. Higher levels require a serious amount of strategy and concentration.  This is a great learning toy and I'm pleased we own it.

product_title: Educational Insights Design & Drill Activity Center
review_body: I gave my 2 year old this for Christmas and he absolutely loves it.  It is more sophisticated than I thought it would be.  There are 3 different bits for the drill (which is really a screw gun) - flathead, phillips, and socket.  Any of the bits can be used to screw the bolts into the board.  There is an off position, forward, and reverse position on the screw gun.  My 2 year old figured it out in about 10 minutes which way to go to move the switch to do the different operations.  Just like a regular screw gun, it has to be in forward to screw the screws into the board and reverse to remove the screws from the board.  It also comes with a manual screw driver handle that the different bits can fit into, so you can manually insert/remove the screws (which my 2 year old can also do), and there is a manual wrench as well.  When he gets older, I'll bring out the pattern sheets, but right now he has enough fun and challenge just filling out the screw board and removing them.  This is so much better than the other toy workbenches you see out there - it actually does something!!!

It's not too small for a kid to play with once built (about three times the size of a MatchBox car) and the container drop off and pickup mechanism works flawlessly.

product_title: Minute To Win It Card Game
review_headline: My kids are playing it right now and having a good time.
review_body: All the stunts seem to be done with the cards.  They involve things like alphabetizing the cards using only your toes, throwing cards against a wall, holding cards between your knees and dropping them in a box, throwing cards across the table and into the box.  My kids are 13 and 15 and they are enjoying it.  Will they play it every day?  No, but it adds some variety to our game cabinet and we will pull it out occasionally to play.

product_title: Wooden Ark Play Set with Noah, His Wife and 10 Animals
review_body: Our 4 year old grandson told us, upon seeing the ark assembled, \\"You guys are the best! This is the best Christmas present ever!\\" and proceeded to play with it for hours. It continues to be his favorite toy. It is easy to assemble and sturdy once together. We all love it.

product_title: Fisher-Price Laugh & Learn Love to Play Puppy
review_body: A very durable and educational toy!  A must have for your little one!!  Batteries last a long time, so just keep having fun with the puppy!

product_title: The Electronic Claw Game
review_body: We bought \\"The Claw\\" for our daughter and was surprised that when we opened the box everything was pre-assembled and ready to go with the addition of a couple of batteries.  I was expecting the game to be in a hundred pieces - thankfully it wasn't.  Construction is solid and movement of parts appear to be smooth thus far.  The game does not appear to drain the batteries very quickly either.  This game/toy provides hours of fun for all of us with some good family time.  Good purchase.

product_title: Gund Peek A Boo Bear
review_body: This darling bear was wonderfully received by my little grandson.  His favorite game at 10 months is peek a boo.  This bear made him smile and laugh even after the busy Christmas day of visiting all his relatives.  He was incredibly tired but this still brought a big smile to his little face.

product_title: Step2  Flip and Doodle Easel Desk with Stool
review_body: great toy, easy to set up, small so it dose not take up too much room but big enough to work on and easy for our 3 year old boy to use.

product_title: Mega Bloks Lil Pony Ranch Building Blocks
review_headline: Great toy to help toddlers stacking/building skills
review_body: My daughter (2) got this for Christmas and she really enjoys it a lot.  She doesn't know much about building any \\"thing\\", but she loves stacking the blocks like crazy!  Her big brother has his millions of small legos, so this was the perfect toy for her to feel like she had her own legos.  Great storage bag that comes with the blocks that makes for wonderfully easy clean-up every day (and we should know - we play with these every day!).  Great item, can't wait to see her grow with them and learn to build things as she gets older!

product_title: Angry Birds: Knock On Wood Game
review_body: We love this game. Had fun playing as a group or by yourself.  Can make up your own structures as well.  Great for all ages.

product_title: LeapFrog LeapPad1 Explorer Learning Tablet, green
review_body: payed over $200 from amazon because I wanted it befor the holidays and everyone was sold out. Toysrus and target sell same item for $99. What a fool I am. What nerve amazon has.

product_title: My Pillow Pet Dolphin - Large (Light Blue)
review_body: I got this pillow pet dolphin for my granddaughter for Christmas, because she really liked it and wanted it.When she opened it at Christmas her eyes lite up and she was really excited.

product_title: Bleach Kon Run Over Plush
review_body: Kon came in excellent condition. I am glad to have this toy much like the animated Kon from Bleach (looks just like in picture). Great collectors item.  Satisfied...Delivery on time.

review_body:
I couldn't help but give in to this iconic item from my favorite Game series. I was excited when it finally came, I rigged up velcro straps to put it on and see if it really works. It functioned for about a minute before the blade stopped retracting. I took it apart and apart from having zero craftsmanship quality, I couldn't solve the problem. \\"Made in India\\", it should have stayed there.

product_title: Plush Beluga Whale 12"
review_body: My friend loves Beluga Whales and I was looking for a good priced stuffed animal! I got it for a coming home present from overseas and she loved it!

product_title: Syma S107/S107G  R/C Helicopter with Gyro
review_headline: One flight ! But has promise ... more later
review_body:
I've had a couple cheap units before, under $20, they were useless, constantly had to re-balance to fly it. So I was excited to see how well built this was, true engineering. This little thing took right off, was able to hold a steady hover right out of the box, then I drifted a little to close to the wall and boom, she came down from about 4 feet. That was the one and only flight. Now there is a grinding noise out of one (of two) drive motors/gears so it cannot get enough speed to lift off. I will try to return it and get another one. But come on ... one flight ?!?! These have to be built tough to take us beginners. One flight is 500 to few. I have the spare blades, battery and a charger too, so I'll give them another chance. I'll update this later.

Update: Turns out the yellow ones are fakes, at least this one is ... when I hooked up the yellow one to a charger, the circuits were wired differently and the rotors started turning backwards, even with the the copter switched off (not kidding). Also, my yellow one has the red and green motors, and not the black and white ones the authentic 107's have.

I am going to get another one, probably a different color.

______________________________UPDATE________________UPDATE_______________________________

Bought a new one, the 2012 model, gold color. What a blast !! Been flying it repeatedly for a couple weeks. Can't hurt this thing. Boom ...crash ..boom ... get right back up and fly it. I highly recommend this copter. Worth every penny. Getting better everyday. Can land it on a book now.

Only complaint is the slight repetitive circling ... procession I think they call it. Like a top that circles around about a one foot circle, so does this. Physics. Not fixable in a small copter like this.

product_title: Scrabble Premier Wood Edition
review_body: This is a premium edition - fairly decent craftsmanship for a production model. It arrived with broken wood corners which did not appear to be the result of shipping damage. review_body: Purchased this as a Christmas gift for my 4yr old. Prior to opening the item, got the tools that were required to put it together. As I opened the item, noticed that the tools were not needed, everything was put together. This tells me that I got a used item not a new as advertised. product_title: Ignite Radio Control Air Soft Black Justice Dealer 4 Wheel Drive Military Vehicle
review_body: I received this truck as a present for Christmas.  For 50 bucks it seemed like allot of fun for my brother and I to play around with.  However after charging the battery and taking it for a test drive I realized it was a great design but constructed by idiots.  The product worked fine for 2 or 3 minutes and then I noticed a loss of power in the drive train.  I thought that was odd for something that had only been used for a couple minutes.  The turret and gun worked great.  I stopped using it after 2 or 3 minutes not because I was tired of it but because it was smoking.  I quickly unplugged the battery and let it cool off.  Later on I reconnected the battery and tested it out, I had lost all forward and backward motion and the turret would no longer traverse back to the left.  So now I have a truck that doesn't go anywhere with a turret that only goes up and down and always faces to the right. I sent an email to the manufacturer to see what they say about their product I'll let you know how it turns out.

product_title: Angry Birds Plush 5-Inch Red Bird with Sound (Discontinued by manufacturer)
review_body: I reviewed the Black Angry birds,and this is the same.  In looking for a fun stocking stuffer for my grown kids, I was delighted to find these Angry Birds.  I don't think I realized they made sounds when I ordered them, so that was a bonus.  My kids got a kick out of them, and I think they probably really ended up going to the grandchildren!  Don't think they are educational, but they are fun.

product_title: Glow Crazy Distance Doodler
review_body:
I have a 9 year old son who wanted this for Christmas. He talked about it all summer like it was the next best thing.

So he received it for Christmas. He was very excited. When it came out of the box, the thick rubber-like papers were stuffed in there very tightly. The ends were curled in order to fit in the box and...to this day they are still curled.

I imagine people are having issues with the self-stick because the paper is coiled in such a way that the pressure from mounting it to the wall is too much and it comes off.

I'll just get to it:

PRO'S

When used in the dark, it is fun to come up with games like tic-tac-toe or drawing. You can even put multiple papers together to make a big canvas.

Pen is decent and good quality. I like that it has two light features (wide and pinpoint). It is ergonomically nice and when the child holds it, it appears comfortable.

CON's

The fun lasts about as long as the light stays on the paper. For us, it's about 10 - 15 seconds. So tell me this: Look at the package in the picture. See how that kid has drawn intricate objects on the paper? THAT IS A LIE. There is no way the paper can hold the energy from the light long enough to finish a tic-tac-toe game, let alone drawing a Moon, Stars, UFO, Fence, Cow, Cowboy, Horse, 'With Light' and a shaded hand. NO WAY! I can't stand it when product makers do this. It's shady (pun intended) and it really irritates me when I see what it is supposed to look like only to have reality hit me. It reminds me of those fast food commercials where you see the juicy burger and thick tomato and special sauce only to receive a limp half-baked version of what it is supposed to be. This toy is just like that. They mis-represent the toy many times over. Reality is the light hits the paper and fades in about 5-10 seconds.

The reason it gets 3 stars instead of 2 is that it is reusable and the kids do get SOME fun out of it. It's not quite a full-fail product and it will last many years. So perhaps if you purchase it for an older child and intend to hand it down, it is good for that. The paper is rubber like so I'm not sure how it \\"broke\\" for the other reviewers here. I think they got a dry version of it? Who knows.

Overall...I say \\"meh\\" and move along...There are way better toys. Get a light bright or view master projector. Those are more fun.s if you purchase it for an older child and intend to hand it down, it is good for that. The paper is rubber like so I'm not sure how it \\"broke\\" for the other reviewers here. I think they got a dry version of it? Who knows. Overall...I say \\"meh\\" and move along...There are way better toys. Get a light bright or view master projector. Those are more fun.

review_headline: Love It - 50's Fashion Princess Dolls for Grown Ups

review_body: I thought this was a create your own book where you draw pictures and write on each page. It is a scrapbook. I think my 5 yr old is a little young for it.

product_title: Spy Gear Ultimate Night Vision
review_body: I looked at all the night vision units available for my grandson (7) and this one was the cheapest that had any good reports.  I am often cautious when reading other peoples reviews but this time they were spot on.  I tried it myself and in a pitch black room all details could be seen clearly without the infra red beam.  It certainly lived up to expectations, (always a bonus).  My granson is highly delighted.  It is extremely bulky but has a good quality robust feel to it.  For fun use I would definitely recommend this to any one.

product_title: InStep Police Pedal Car
review_body: We bought this toy for our 4 year old son. He loves it. The car is small enough to ride in the house. It is very durable and was easy to put together.

product_title: Disney Ultimate Princess Castle
review_body: This is a gorgeous doll house!  Perfect for a little girl who loves Disney Princesses!  It's very durable and easy to put together too!

product_title: Lauren Children's Beginner Acoustic Guitar Package - Black Guitar
review_body: This was a great gift for my 8 year old nephew.  Although he never touched a guitar, he knew what to do with it, it was the right size and he is really enjoying learning how to play.

product_title: Melissa & Doug Fish Colors Mix 'n Match Wooden Peg Puzzle (10 pcs)
review_headline: Good to learn color and fine motor skills
review_body: It's a basic puzzle.... but the kids have fun matching it up and figuring out how to get the pieces to fit.  It was certainly easy enough for them to figure out what goes where so they didn't get frustrated and give up (thinking they were putting the wrong piece in) which was a problem I had with other puzzles.  This has been one of the best puzzles we've had, but admittedly, my kids don't usually love puzzles and give up relatively quickly if it gets too hard/boring.  They got this when my oldest was 3 (now almost 6) and it's still out at least once a week.

product_title: Little Tikes 3 in 1 Trike Red (Discontinued by manufacturer)
review_body: The 3-in-1 Trike has so far proven to be quite a bit of fun for my 9 month old son.  Overall the construction is very durable and has handled most urban terrain just fine.  My son likes to sit forward with his hands on the protective bars and his feet touching the foot rests.  It appears to make him more involved with the world around him.  The only reason I gave it less than five stars is because of two things.    One the sunshade is flimsy like other reviewers have written and frankly I suggest you don't bother with it.  The second item is the restraining system.  If he was held tight in the seat he would be unable to touch the handlebars.  As such I use the lap-belt only.  Overall my wife and I believe it's a great buy and we would do it again.

product_title: Spot It!
review_body: a card game for kids? Not really. It's a game that involves cards that can be played in many ways with 2 or more. Try teams if it works for you. Small, easy to pack, great to play anywhere.

product_title: Air Swimmers Remote Control Flying Clownfish
review_headline: Fun once you get it put together....
review_body: I bought this for my sister, knowing we would all have fun putting it together and playing with it on Christmas. The instructions could have been better and the items could have been put together better for a easier assembly too. It took 2, occasionally 3 people to put together. Floating, light weight fish are not easy to keep still, patience is required.. But overall once it was up and running we had a blast.. plus we had fun with the left over helium (not included) after the fish was full. One thing I will also mention. High ceilings or a large open space are needed for this item. Luckily my sister has really high ceilings so we were able see the full movement of the fish. Very fun. :)

review_headline: Great quality and protects your cards well
review_body: I had the old ultra pro card sleeves that were bigger, which didn't fit my Yugioh cards well. After buying these, I noticed that they are a near perfect size for Yugioh cards, plus they feel very sturdy. :)  They are a bit pointy and slippery (the slipperiness makes it easy to shuffle) but not too slippery to the point where your deck collapses if its stationary.  Overall very nice, reliable, and durable card sleeves for Yugioh cards.

product_title: LeapFrog SpongeBob SquarePants: The Clam Prix Learning Game (works with LeapPad Tablets, Leapster GS, and Leapster Explorer)
review_body: My child enjoy it learn a lot from it like spelling and counting, I would reccomend it. Very useful specialy when traveling.

product_title: Barbie Tim Burton's Alice In Wonderland Mad Hatter Doll
review_body: This product was amazing it was shipped very fast. That item was better than its description. I was very pleased I ordered it for a gift for my daughter,but when it arrived I thought about keeping it for myself. I ended up giving it to my daughter for christmas. I would love to get another one for myself. This doll looks so real its an amazing product. I would recommend this to anyone who likes the Alice In Wonderland movie.

product_title: LEGO Minifigure Collection Series 2 LOOSE Mini Figure Dracula Vampire
review_body: My grandson loves legos and he wanted some different types of charactors. He thinks this one is cool and is happy.

product_title: The Elf on the Shelf: A Christmas Tradition with Blue Eyed North Pole
review_body: Sure it is a pain in the butt to move every night, but kids are only kids for so long. Mine love to get up and look for him every morning. It does not have to be used a blackmail, just have some fun with kids and enjoy the time where they still believe in Christmas magic.

review_body: Sight unseen, I was a little nervous about buying this product. It offered more tracks and was less money than the one at Toys R Us, so I thought I would take a chance. I'm glad I did. These tracks are a perfect fit for my son's Misty Island Adventure Take and Play set.

review_body: The parts that were sent don't match the picture.  The top part is an obvious mismatch.  When installed, the rotor spins within the new part revealing a mismatched opening in the replacement part.

product_title: Zillionz Electronic Money Jar
review_headline: Ruined a 4 year old's Christmas day
review_body: Despite many bigger, more expensive presents on Christmas Day, this was the one my 4 yr old was most excited about- he's obsessed with coins and counting money.  First off, to actually insert a coin into the slot you have to press down really hard, not easy for me and so very difficult for a child.  Secondly, the thing just doesn't work. Within 4 coins it misread the value of a dime, adding on 15 cents and then continued to do this ever after. To top it all, when the total got to $6.01 the readout stopped there and refused to budge and is no doubt still showing that as it languishes at the bottom of the dumpster.  Save yourself some money and the crestfallen face of your child and avoid this piece of crap like the plague.

product_title: Table & Ladder for WWE Jakks Mattel Wrestling Action Figures
review_body: My son LOVES WWE right now. So of course he basically had a WWE christmas this year. The table and ladder accessories are one thing that he had on his list that he really wanted since the few wrestling ring set ups he had didn't come with them. Online seemed to be the only place I could find the serparate accessories and they aren't cheap. THought this was an OK deal being $8 .. but then I ended up paying like a total of $15 after shipping. so still wasn't cheap for what they were. But he was thrilled when he got them. Only downfall was that the table doesn't \\"break\\" like I thought it would.. He had to hit it hard enough where I was worried he would break the plastic instead of the part where its meant to break away. My husband did a little revising to it and made it easier to come apart. Realistically when my son is playing with his wrestling guys if he drops a guy on it I would expect it to break away without a ton of force. The ladder is so far holding up better but still pretty cheaply made. I guess I kind of expected a little more durable plastic knowing it would be used with the WWE guys. Overall I wasn't thrilled but I didn't have too many options for places to buy JUST the accessories.

product_title: Kidkraft Suite Elite Dollhouse
review_body: WOW!!! Purchased this item for my four year old twin granddaughters.  The twin beds on the top floor sold me.  The girls can both play with it at the same time.  They love love love it!!! Very well made but does take a little time to assemble, well worth it.

product_title: Fashion Angels Barbie Fashion Design Sketch Portfolio
review_body: Even by the low, low standards by which we judge Barbie toys, this is a failure. The stickers aren't cut all the way, so you end up tearing them all in half, and the stencils are so thin that they rip almost immediately unless you're extremely careful (hope your high-schooler is into Barbie). The sketchpad is a good idea--I wish a different company had come up with it so my daughter could actually enjoy it.

product_title: Disney Princess Royal Castle
review_body: Yes, my daughter who is three loves this. I knew it was a cheap piece of plastic, so I searched for the best deal I could get and tried not to be too critical when I opened it.  It's not too large, the furniture looks like something from the Dollar store, but my daughter has lots of fun making princess parties. There is very little room inside, so most of the playing is around the outside of it.  The turret keeps falling, so superglueing it is a good idea. It's basically a good set for letting your little one's imagination go.

product_title: Webkinz HM222 Silversoft Cat Plush Animal
review_body: What a relief not to have to scour local stores looking for the ONE specific  webkinz our child wanted. Finding the Silversoft cat on-line was a huge convenience.

review_body: THE trolley set is perfect, with the exception that it does not bump n go. It runs in a continuing circle.  I returned it for only that reason, I just wanted the trolley, however, the customer service with this company cannot be beaten, courteous, friendly and prompt action , they will definitely be in my future plans.

product_title: Manhattan Toy Baby Stella Feeding Baby Doll Accessories Set for 15" Dolls
review_body: I bought this accessory kit to go along with my 20mos old daughter's new Manhattan Toy boy & girl dolls. She loves using the magnetic bottle to \\"feed\\" her babies & gets a kick out of the spoon and food. We all know toddlers put everything in their mouth, so a big part of what drew me to these dolls and the accessories was the fact they were magnetic and made of plush material, not plastic. Instead of chewing on a plastic bottle and risking eating plastic bits (not to mention making the toy bottle/pacifiers a sad sight to see), the magnetic pacifiers and bottle tip prevent our daughter from ingesting something she's not supposed to. She thinks it's kind of funny that the babies \\"want their binky/bottle so much\\" that it jumps to their mouth from the magnetic force. Someday she'll learn it's physics, but for now I don't think I'll burst her little bubble. :o)

review_headline: A nice little remote control car
review_body:
I purchased a similar car to this one about two years ago for my son's Christmas gift, but sadly the main feature of the R/C car didn't work, the video screen. I returned it to the store quite disappointed and subsequently wrote a bad review for it on Amazon's UK site when I got home. I would have entered the review link here, but the product is no longer available for purchase (for good reason I suppose). When I first saw this Spy Gear Video car, I had my reservations, but I decided to give it a shot since it was a different company and I was just so curious to see how it worked.

Getting this car out of the box is needlessly complicated. The car itself is literally screwed in to the inside cardboard and you need medium length Philips head screwdriver to undo the screws. I am guessing because of the camera inside the car that they needed to be sure that the car stays secure, but I have purchased much more expensive and complicated equipment (XBOX 360, PS3), and they seemed to do just fine with snug fitting styrofoam in order to absorb shocks during shipping.

I got the car first, and figured I would get the batteries later so I didn't even bother (nor had time) to read the battery requirements. When I had the package in my hand, my jaw dropped when I saw the battery requirements; TEN AA batteries are required to get this thing working. (6 for the car, 4 for the remote). So because of this I highly recommend rechargeable batteries. Batteries are not cheap, and I'm figuring this thing is a battery hog so you may not want to be buying 10 AA batteries every 1 - 2 weeks. For me personally, I bought some cheap Grocery store batteries at first, to see if my son would stay interested in this long enough to warrant spending more on rechargeable batteries. If he stays interested, I will invest in rechargeables.

When I finally got the car and remote out the pack and put the 643 batteries in and powered it up for the first time, I was relieved to see the camera actually work. The quality of the camera is not that good, but I suppose what you would expect from a toy. The screen is tiny and there is very little detail in the image. Unless you have good lighting, then it will be somewhat difficult to tell what you are looking at on the screen. Night vision however works a lot better and is surprisingly good. My son seems to enjoy it and we would put the car in the kitchen with our two dogs and watch their reactions to the car through the remote control. One just looks at it curiously, while the other tries to get away from it. Looking at the camera on the remote, it's possible to drive the car without actually being in view of it, but again, unless you have adequate lighting, it will be very difficult to avoid bumping into things.

The actually movement controls on the car are ok. It seems to be a little slow and has a hard time driving over obstacles, but that could very well have to do with the cheapo batteries I bought for it. As far as it being \\"stealth\\", that term is quite the misnomer with this toy. It is not quiet enough to be stealth, and in a dark room even with other noises going on (TV, radio, talking, etc.) it's still easy to hear this car moving around even if you can't see it. Of course it doesn't record sound either so not really a \\"spy\\" car. Still it's a fun toy to play around with. The instructions tell you not to take it outside, but I may take it out in the back yard anyway at night to see if I can see any critters scurrying around and how they react to the car.

All in all a nice little toy to play around with for you or your kids, and you won't be disappointed if you do not expect too much.e camera actually work. product_title: Crayola Color Wonder Magic Light Brush with Metallic Paper
review_headline: Great painting toy but you will need paint and paper refills quickly!
review_body:
This is the same Crayola Color Wonder Magic Light Brush as the last model - this one just includes Metallic Paper. You put batteries in the small paint console and each individual paint color lights up when you put the brush in that specific color. The gel colors look clear until the child paints the color wonder paper. Then the colors appear. My boys (9,6,3) love this toy. The 9 year old loses interest quickly but says it is \\"cool\\". The younger boys use it again and again for about 30 minutes at a time.

The only drawback I find as a mom is that the paint refills are expensive and difficult to find. Do not pay the 16-18$ they charge on Amazon as they should be 4-5$. I bought our paint refills at Walmart for 5.99 but I just looked online and they are not available online. They are usually with the Crayola art section there - not with the toys. The Crayola Store online has the paint refills 2 for 8.99 (but with 6.99 for shipping the paint is the same price as the refills offered on Amazon). I guess I just have a hard time paying the same price for paint refills as the initial toy!

A technical point - Make sure you clean the gel paint off the brush after each use like any paintbrush as the brush will not work (will not read the colors) if there is too much gel paint dried on the end. If the gel paint does dry on the brush just wrap a warm dishtowel around the tip and it will come off.

All said this toy is a worthwhile purchase if you can stomach the refill prices. I would not buy this unless you are willing to order a refill set now though because your kids will go thru the paint quickly and the toy is useless without the refill. If you have last years model though just go buy metallic paper and you will have the same thing! Happy painting.....

product_title: House of Staunton Superior Elm Burl Ebony Chess Board - 2.25 inch
review_body: I fell in love with this chessboard but was leery after reading the first review.  I still had to have it so when I ordered I specifically added a note referring to the negative review and asking that my board be pre-inspected for defects.  I also stated that I would gladly choose another board if there was a problem.  Much to my horror when the board arrived it had about six nicks/scratches on one of the boarders.  Judging by the finish I suspect that the nicks occurred at the factory.  Also about three of the squares are not perfectly joined (a little rough at the edge).  If you inspect it super close you will also find other squares that are not perfectly smooth.  It also has a couple of wood knots which I guess should be expected but the problem is that it seems to be missing the proper amount of wood stain so instead of being able to appreciate a nice natural wood knot attention is caught by a couple light circles.  I'm usually not a very picky person which is why I ignored the first review but when your paying $300 for a chessboard I expected it to be perfect.  I must also state that maybe hand crafted boards aren't supposed to be perfect but the photo of this board that I had as my computer desktop background had zero defects.  My real disappointment is that I asked that the board be inspected and it apparently wasn't.  Maybe there's not enough profit to warrant special attention.  In defense of the House of Staunton the transaction was smooth, shipping was fast and the board was perfectly packaged and protected.  My only complaint with them is I feel the order taker didn't even read my request for a board inspection and certainly they never assured me that they would.  I also never contacted them about my disappointment but that is solely because the first reviewer didn't seem to get anywhere, a little passing the buck seemed to have gone on.  I'm more disappointed that the manufacture of the board let this defective board leave their shop and judging by thefirst review this is routine.  I gave it four stars because I still love this board even with all the defects and the real irony is that I would have probably still bought it had I seen it in person.  When I get an extra $300 I will probably replace this with a perfect copy, I love it that much.  I will also do business again with House of Staunton just not for this board.  If anybody loves this board as much as I do and needs to see what to expect you can contact me and I will gladly send you pictures of the defects.  cyclist12removenospam@yahoo.com

product_title: Corolle Les Chéries Camille Ballerina Fashion Doll
review_body:
This review is from: Corolle Les Cheries 13\\" Fashions (Ballerina Set Toy)

From January 2009:
My daughter has this doll and she really likes her. I don't care for Barbie and I wanted to wait on American Girl for my daughter, so this was the perfect alternative. She's lovely but not babyish, but not too mature. Her hair is lovely to style (which my 5 year old loves to do) and very durable for the brushing and combing. The only problems I see with this doll are that her one eyelid slightly sticks a little, so she sometimes looks like she has a lazy eye (nothing wrong with that! Just sayin'...) but my daughter doesn't even notice it. Also, the ballet shoes do not have ties long enough to wrap up her legs and to stay up. They are sewn up when the first arrive, but you have to remove that if your child wants to undress and dress her.

Just a note: You can also buy this doll in everyday streetwear and buy a ballet outfit separately. I did that for my other daughter, and the ballet shoes on that have ties longer than the ones on this doll.

product_title: Walthers SceneMaster - Figures - Townspeople
review_body: I ordered these thinking they would be great for my seven year old to play  with, but they are so tiny you can hardly even play with them.  They are about the size you see in the picture.  So if you want something a child can play pretend with, this is NOT the toy!

product_title: Star Wars Ultimate Anakin FX Lightsaber
review_headline: Just what my grandson wanted and he just loves it.
review_body: It is the least expensive light saber to give a 9 year old and he loves it. His daddy has the more expensive one and this one to me seems only shorter.

product_title: Angry Birds: Knock On Wood Game
review_body: I ordered this game for grandkids for Christmas. It was being offered by Amazon.com. Each time I clicked to order it at the lower price ($19 one time and $25 one time), it would be come up \\"no longer available at that price.\\" So, wanting to ensure the kids received the toy I ordered it 3 days ago at the outlandish price of $31 (offered by Amazon)Grandparents do this! Now today, 11/17/11 it is again offered at $19! What's the deal Amazon? Walmart.com offered it at $14 (no longer available) and Toys R Us has it on sale for $12. They will call me when it arrives. product_title: Fisher-Price Disney/Pixar Cars 2 Bubble Mater
review_headline: In our house it is a pretend vacuum...
review_body: I bought Tow Mater without knowing you needed a lot of space to run to get him to start  blowing bubbles. After a while of my son getting frustrated I decided to wash him and he is now an indoor toy. Every time Mama vacuums, my son runs and gets Mater and pretends to vacuum using him. It wasn't a total loss because he is happy and has played with him a lot, just not for bubbles.

product_title: LEGO Series 4 Collectible Minifigure Crazy Mad Scientist
review_body: The Lego minifigures are a favorite in our house.  We are happy to buy this specific one and not be subjected to the mystery of the unmarked bags!

review_body: This wallet is a gag gift for a family member who is constantly teased about his love of bacon and other salted meats.  This wallet makes a creative way to give a gift card or certificate - instead of the usual boring greeting card.

product_title: LEGO Exclusive Set #10218 Pet Shop
review_body: This lego set is lovely, with lots of neat special pieces, and will appeal to animal lovers as much as Lego Lovers.

review_body: O.K product but could be a little better made! Fun for kids but could be better quality!

review_body: I cannot recommend buying this item.  Materials are very cheap and the construction is very poor.  Basically, this toy is total junk.

product_title: Pente
review_body: East to learn, a lifetime to master.  This is a really wonderful game for 2, 3 or 4 players, challenging and brain stimulating even with no blinking lights or sounds.  Amazing!

product_title: Star Wars 3.75 Vintage Figure Rebel Fleet Trooper
review_body: The Rebel Fleet Trooper has always been a fan favorite, all the more so because it was never released in the original Vintage line. The first version from the POTF2 wasn't bad, but was a bit on the muscular side. Later versions were better but not perfect. This Vintage-style version is near perfect. The figure is fairly lanky and looks more like the hapless troops on the Tantive IV. The accessories are fantastic. The trooper has his standard gun, hand binoculars, a strap of grenades around his ankle, his trademark helmet - no less - and a baseball cap. All of these accessories are removable. If you see more than one of these, definitely get a few - they're ideal for troop building.

product_title: Young Heroes Special Forces Child Costume with Accessories, Medium
review_body: Costume seemed to run small but was only offered in one size. Needed some stitching for the face mask other wise with the plastic eye piece that portion stuck straight out rather than curve to the shape of the head. The mask did fog up during school time wearing too. We did not use the plastic knee pads, were afraid they would fall down. Okay costume for the price. Something different we had not seen in stores.

product_title: Child Glamorous Princess Brown Wig
review_body: This is a super fun costume wig. Teach your kids how to be creative through the use of imagination! Pretend to be a princess - Rapunzel or Sleeping Beauty... your kids will have a great time!

product_title: Transformers Animated Deluxe: Elite Bumblebee
review_body: Animated Elite Bumblebee is one cool elite guard!This version is the same mold as the original with a mostly black paint job with some gold trim.Bumblebee still has some yellow color also with the elite guard symbols on the door panels and chest plate.Bumblebee is one of the best transformers in the animated line with a cool look in robot or sports car mode.Bumblebee also comes with some sweet features like snap on rocket boosters and flip out stingers.The poseability is outstanding with great stability for creating cool battle scenes or unique display poses.The durability is excellent as well with secure joints and a solid build in either robot or sports car mode to handle whatever comes Bumblebee's way.The transformation level is advanced meaning if you have plenty of experience with transformers there is mid-level difficulty.If you are a parent buying for a child of 5-6 or younger you might have to assist some in the process.Bumblebee is very versatile though for most ages with practice.Bottom line Bumblebee is a well-made,high quality,10 out of 10 transformer all fans will enjoy.I highly recommend Elite Bumblebee to all fans and collectors out there.Bumblebee Rocks and Transformers Rule!!!

product_title: 3-in-1 Magnetic Travel Game Set by Trademark Games Black
review_headline: You get what you pay for
review_body: It is very hard to find a decent magnetic chess/checkers/backgammon set that isn't over 40.00.  This is astonishing, as they were everywhere when I was a kid.  Either way, this 3-in-1 set is a classic 'you get what you pay for' scenario.  The metal board for the chess/checkers portion was warped with a ripple in the middle when I recieved it.  I will be attempting to exchange it in hopes that the defect is not across all of them.  It does not make it unplayable, but even for the 10.00 I paid for it, it shouldn't have this defect.  It was sloppy adhesion of the board to the plastic box frame that appears to be very strong.

product_title: Buzz Bee Berserker Blaster
review_body: I hate this gun. It doesn't shoot far or fast, looks ugly, and has ugly darts. Even though it was only 20 bucks, it looks like its from the dollar store. People might think giant guns shoot far, but not this one. This one goes phoot doink in a high arc, and is not accurate. It doesn't even come in a nice box! Tomorrow, I'm returning this to the store to buy a nerf gun for a lower price. And if you look at the box, buzz bee world hq is in hong kong.

product_title: Melissa and Doug Dinosaurs - Paint By Numbers
review_body: My 5 year old got this as a gift.  He really enjoyed painting it.  The areas were large enough that he could more or less paint inside the lines.  He also liked gluing it together.

product_title: Red Ranger Classic
review_headline: My son loves this costume!!  Missing belt buckle.
review_body: I bought my 5yr old son this costume size S(4-6)..  Fits him well, but he is slender... Not sure how it would fit a larger child.  The opening to put it on looks kinda small, but it went on relatively easily.  The discription does state that it includes the BELT BUCKLE, but it was not in the package. They had to have a little help getting the moving parts to work but it works perfectly.  They have since added some pieces to make it look \\"cooler\\". product_title: Howie Hedgehog Mini Flopsie 8" by Aurora
review_body: I bought this for a friend who loves hedgehogs. I was really hoping it would be a lot softer, but it's really cute!

product_title: Memory Madness
review_headline: Great Game.  Lots of laughs in the Woods
review_body: My husband and I took this on a weekend camping trip.  Trying to recall past information lead to a lot of laughs!  The only negative thing about the game, was that there were quite a few duplicate cards.

product_title: Kid Galaxy Ratchet Racers Fire Truck/School Bus Set
review_headline: Cute, but not for the littlest kids
review_body: My 4-year-old thinks these are pretty great toys and especially likes mixing and matching them to create \\"firebus\\" or \\"schooltruck.\\" However, my almost-3-year-old can't figure out how to wind them up very well, which means he comes up to me approximately 87 times per day begging me to wind it up or him. (I realize these are really for 3 and up, though.) They do go pretty far and fast (on wood floors, at least), and they've survived numerous collisions, though, so no real complaints!

product_title: My Pillow Pets Large Horse  18 inch
review_body: These Pillow Pets are fantastic.  They can serve as a playmate and then at nap time switch over to being a pillow or something to cuddle with.  Pillow Pets are also great for sleepovers or traveling.

product_title: Alien Mask
review_body: This mask was perfect for my dead aliens in our yard.  Just the right size, and so creepy looking!!  I used a wig head to put these masks on when laying in our yard.  Looked very real.

product_title: Deluxe Chess Set Combination - Single Weighted - Forest Green - by US Chess Federation
review_body: In the world of Chess, one must put himself in a figurative medieval battle.  The lines are drawn, the stage is set, and the opening takes place!  Yes indeed hills and forts are immediately created with pawns E4 and E5.  But ALAS!  The Knight is used to threaten, NAY! To bully the E5 pawn causing sheer fright!  But when all is done, a check mate ends the battle!  All of that said, this particular chess set is durable, the pieces are heavy, and the bag is well constructed.  I would recommend this to any and all!  Now i am on my way, and let it be known....  there be wars to fight, and only the most tactical and strategic mind will overcome!

product_title: Alexander Dolls Baby Cuddles Feeding Baby 14"
review_body: The doll is nice but not as special as I expected. When it arrived, it wasn't much different than the dolls you would find on a Target or Wal-Mart shelf. Nice doll....satisfied with purchase, but probably would not go this route again.

product_title: Adora Nursery Time Baby Doll- Light Skintone/Blue Eyes
review_headline: Precious, but arm came off after 3 weeks!
review_body: This is the perfect baby doll for my almost 3 year old daughter!  It's going to be a gift from Santa this Christmas, but I've already taken her out of the box to check her out for myself.  Her little body is weighted to feel like a real baby and her facial features are so cute!  Way cuter and more realistic than most dolls out there....and we have a few since I have an older daughter as well.  Wish I'd learned about Adora dolls a few years ago before I bought other dolls that do not even compare in cuteness or quality for the same price!  She is also a perfect size for a 1 to 5 year old, but pretty sure older girls would think she's pretty cute as well. Comes in a cute bassinet and sweet little newborn sleeper gown.  Precious doll all around!   .....3 weeks since my original review above!  Loved this doll up until this morning!  My daughter came screaming and running out of our playroom with the doll's arm in her hand.  She is devastated and I am super disappointed!  She was trying to get the doll out of her doll highchair and pulled her by her arm and it popped off.  There is no way for me to get the arm back on, so I'm left with an expensive one armed baby doll.  I have contacted the seller to see what can be done since she's only had this doll for 3 weeks...since Christmas.  I plan to contact the doll manufacturer as well.  This doll is advertised for 3 year olds and up, but I have a hard time with that since it broke so easily.  Very disappointed!

product_title: Sing Along CD Player
review_body: We received this singalong CD player as a gift, and my two-year-old was immediately into it.  But while singing along to a CD, the CD would stop playing in the middle of a song, for no apparent reason.  Over and over.  My toddler would stop, \\"More music?  More music?\\"  And after 15 seconds, it would start up again, and we'd start singing, and it would pause again.  Very frustrating.  Then the latch to the player door broke, so now it won't close.  I can't believe how much this thing cost, now I have to tell Grandma and Grandpa their gift was a bust.  And those short microphone cords are a pain.  So is the feedback, which had my toddler running, crying from the room saying his head hurt.  What a disappointment.

product_title: Imaginext Disney / Pixar Toy Story 3 Figure Lotso with Sparks & Chunk
review_headline: 3 stiff figures, statues more than toys
review_body: Usually, imaginext toys are awesome.  Although they aren't as articulated or detailed as the superior \\"mega bloks\\" toys, I can count on imaginext for making very durable toys that have at least one or two points of articulation.  Unfortunately, out of the 3 toy story characters included in this set, only the huggy bear toy can move his arms.  That's it.  I got it hoping my kid could incorporate the rock guy and the little robot into his playtime with other imaginext figures, but they serve as mere fodder for the other toys that can actually move their arms, legs, heads, etc.  Every imaginext super friends, dinosaur, and ninja toy I've gotten has been a real success, but this package of three toys - only one of which (the weakest looking one, no less) can move at his shoulder joint and thats it was a let-down.  What's really frustrating is that when you look at the packaging of this toy, they show the rock guy holding his arms in different positions, like WTF!!!

product_title: Bananagrams Word Game
review_headline: Best new game in a long time
review_body: Normally I buy games for my kids and they just aren't that fun.  Too many rules, too long between reading instructions and playing the game.  Usually the gameplay is an absolute dud.  This game is so simple.  Yet so fun.  There aren't many rules.  The gameplay is simple.  Yet, it i surprising fun and addictive.  This game is great for anyone over around 8 years old.  The game does not last very long, but you will want to keep playing it over and over.  For those unfamiliar with how it's played, it is similar to scabble, except there are no \\"points\\" and each player builds his/her own \\"crossword\\" style words with their pieces (this means you DON'T have to wait on the other player before it's your turn\\".  Play continues until the community unused letters are fewer than the number of players.  At that point, the first person out of letters wins.  You will also become quickly familiar with the terms \\"dump\\" (trading in 1 letter for 3 new ones) and \\"peel\\" (when a player runs out of letters, but there are still letters to be had in the \\"bunch\\").  I can not stress enough how great a game this is.  I don't write many reviews, but I had to share how pleased I am to have found this game.

review_body:

product_title: Tonka Ricochet R/C Rampage Flip
review_headline: Great Indoor... or Smooth Surface Outdoor R/C Fun
review_body: The unit appears well-made and durable... ready for bumping and tumbling about the house. It measures 4-1/2\\" x 4\\" x 2\\" so it will not do well outside except on smooth sidewalks or driveways... those experienced with larger R/C's with the size and power to accommodate rough terrain may be disappointed. But for indoor fun this toy is fine. The infrared frequency remote control does fine while vehicle is in sight which will cover most users without problems... indoor use is this toys forte anyway. If one wants to operate the toy from a seated position in a room full of furniture... not the most common situation... the unit may lose contact with the remote as furnishings may block the signal. This unit's trick is called the Rampage Flip... the car flips over and continues as ordered... this was a trick enjoyed but loses it's appeal after a few days. You will need 5 AA batteries but the 3.6v battery is provided. Fun indoor toy.

product_title: As Seen On Tv Craft-Lite Cutter With 21 Led Lights
review_headline: useful for crafters and kids, excellent value.
review_body: We have used this cutter for scrapbooking and for my son's poster boards and school projects. I have had it for about 3 yrs and love it!! It is lightweight, easy to use, and cuts through card stock and thin cardboard easily. The perforate blade is mostly for thinner papers, but (surprisingly) the rest of the blades even worked on craft foam when I went slowly and took my time. The light doesn't shine through heavier papers, but it is really helpful for lining up the perfect cut and avoiding mistakes. I believe this is safer for my kids to use than my industrial guillotine style cutter, and I can leave it out on my craft table with no worries, because the blade is not exposed except when pressing down to cut.  My ruler arm seems to be square, so I have not experienced a problem like another reviewer did.  However, this is not a heavy duty cutter, and I can see how it could be pushed out of square with a bit of pressure or if dropped, or even in shipping in its thin cardboard box. When used appropriately, I believe the craft lite cutter is plenty durable and an excellent value because all of the blades are included. Some other brands sell the blades separately, and it can be expensive . The blades store easily along the blade arm when I am not using them, and that makes them so easy to find. As I write this I am ordering two as gifts for Christmas. One is for a student and the other is for a crafter.   My tips for best results with this cutter are common sense:  -to use it on a surface that is sturdy ( sturdy enough to knead dough on) because you will be pressing down.  -don't drop it.  -don't try to cram too many layers of paper in it at once.  -don't use on chipboard, sandpaper, or thick foils (Don't laugh; we crafters use everything)  -adjust your pressure and speed for the thickness and consisency of the material you are cutting.  -move the blade straight down the arm without pushing to either side.  -practice on scraps till you get the feel of it.

review_body: I had one of these when I was little, so I'm comparing the two.  I realize that the original was from over 30 years ago and it's not going to be the same. The plastic on the new record player isn't very sturdy.  The sound quality is very poor, also.  The original one was a toy around a music box, if you get what I'm trying to say.  You know, the little music box devices, with the metal teeth that twang as they go over the pins on the roller.  Well, the old records had those little pins that the needle would hit and play the tune.  The new one has it all internal.  The records have no little studs on them.  I don't know if there's a digital device inside, but the sound is not pretty.  Yes, it plays the tunes, but it's not the pretty music box sound.  YES, I know, it's not the original, everything is new and improved.  But, if you're looking for nostalgia, I'd go on Ebay and find one some little kid's already slobbered on but is still in good shape.  You'll be disappointed when you open this up, expecting the old one.  If you've never seen the old one, then it'll be fine.  I'm just used to a little better quality.

product_title: VTech Crazy Legs Learning Bugs
review_body: This is a cute toy designed to look like a Mommy ladybug carrying a baby ladybug on her back, and it has a TON of features. From what I've been able to figure out so far, it has 2 modes, an \\"It's Learning Time\\" mode, labled with an open book, and a \\"Let's Explore\\" mode, labled with music notes. The Learning Time mode will say things like, \\"Where is the square?\\" and then make a clapping sound when the square is pushed. When you push the baby ladybug down, it will change from shapes to nature sounds to numbers. Each shape has a number and also a correlating number of nature pictures (one sun, three leaves, etc.). When you push each button it will either tell you the shape, the number, or a sentence using the nature picture, depending on the setting. This mode also has a few short songs and music. The \\"Let's Explore\\" mode is a mix of longer songs and silly sounds. There are two colored arcs that light up on the top of the toy, one on either side of the baby ladybug. The purple one, with pictures of nature things, will produce a sound effect when pressed in this mode, and the yellow one, covered with music notes, will cycle through the different songs. (In Learning Time mode, they produce the \\"Where is the...?\\" questions.)In addition, when the baby ladybug is held down and the toy is pushed across the floor, it makes a clicking sound and it will say various phrases, including \\"It's so nice to crawl with Mommy\\". (This one is particularly nice in my opinion, because crawlers tend to push the toy in this manner as they crawl around the room.)  The shape pieces are held on to the toy by an elastic string with coils around it, which keeps them from getting lost (Thank you, VTech!) and they're only long enough to go on the shape groove they're attached to and to reach the ones next to it only if the string is pulled out to its max. They seem a little hard to get lined up at first, but it's still easier than traditional shape balls and it's not to difficult to get used to. My14-month-old twins have started being able to get the shapes in, and my two-year-old has been able to get them on ever since we got it around her birthday. When the baby ladybug is pushed down, it releases the shapes that have been latched on with a fun boingy sound. The shapes can also be pulled off, but you have to pull rather hard (though my twins can do it). The pull string is stored inside the battery compartment, so that it can be stored for crawlers and pulled out for walkers (another good idea by VTech, I believe). When the toy is pushed or pulled across the floor, the songs speed up, and when left alone they slow back down to normal speed. Also, it has an automatic shut-off feature that turns the toy off after only a couple of minutes of inactivity.   This toy is very durable and colorful, and all three of my children enjoy playing with it. I only have two real complaints, one minor and one a little more major that cost my review a star. My biggest complaint is that there is not a volume control, and its sounds and music are a little loud. The other thing is that when it is picked up off the floor by its string (something all kids will do sometimes, and mommies, too!), it is top-heavy and the whole thing turns upside-down. It's not a big problem, it doesn't hurt the toy, but toddlers have a hard time knowing how to turn it right-side-up again.  In all, I like this toy and I recommend it, but if you're looking for a toy that's not overloaded with features or is somewhat quiet, this is probably not the one for you.

product_title: Disney Tinkerbell Pom Pom Slippers
review_body: The idea of these slippers is great, the execution, however, fails on all counts. My 2 yr old wears size 7 shoes...length- wise this shoe was maybe a size bigger...I don't think it will fit anything over a size 8 (even though description says 8.5 and up and 3+ years).  I don't know how they managed to do this, but this shoe is both too narrow and too wide. The bottom of the shoe (sole) is way too narrow for a normal foot of any kind and the top of the shoe is super wide and will fall off the foot. Also, there is absolutely no padding in the sole, the bulky seams are bare on the inside and I imagine would be super uncomfortable. There is a thin layer of cloth at the bottom of the shoe (definitely not for outdoor use- i did not subtract from the score for this but I thought it might be useful info, it's not a rubber sole like other slippers). Having said all that, I still had to make do with them, since there's not enough time to return them and get something else (using for halloween costume) so I rigged it to where it will work for a few hours. If you are in the same predicament and are crafty, here's what I did: I cut the bulky seams on the inside as close as I could without risking unraveling, lined the bottom of the slippers with 2 layers of soft felt (gluing it in place with some fabric glue). I outlined, cut, and glued a piece of pleather at the bottom of the sole, to give it a bit more security for an hour of trick or treating. To fix the wideness issue, I pinched the shoe from the top to fit my toddler's foot and glued the pinched parts together with fabric glue, folded the pinched part over and glued it again to the shoe so it doesn't stick up, I cut the pom pom and glued it back on over the folded \\"seam\\" to cover it. Basically a lot of work when I was trying to avoid it (or else I would have made them myself). Now they fit, are cute (in no way thanks to the manufacturer) and are comfortable, as my daughter was jumping around in them and dancing without complaints. product_title: Fisher Price Thomas Take n Play Percy
review_headline: Percy - member #6 of Sodor's 8 member "Steam Team"!
review_body:
Here's Percy, one of the 8 members of the "Steam Team" (including Thomas, Edward, Henry, Gordon, James, Toby & Emily), and is Thomas' best friend! Accident-prone Percy is a NWR (North Western Railway) green saddletank engine with red lining and a yellow number "6" on his bunker sides, and 4 matching green wheels. If you're going to buy a Percy "single", THIS is the definitely the high quality diecast version you'll want for your youngster. We paid $6.29 for our grandson's when we started his collection back in 2010 (the year Fisher-Price took over the Thomas diecast line from Learning Curve's "Take-Along" and renamed it "Take-n-Play"), and the small engines have had a $6 MSRP all along... the difference now, is that they've come out with a very cheapened new version of Percy (model # CBL76), and want the same amount!

Before you purchase Percy as a single though, I'd like to suggest checking out your other options as well. There were a couple of 2010 buddy packs (Percy & Mavis/Thomas, Percy & Rosie), and as of March 2015, he's been included in nine playsets (Percy's Mail Delivery, Knapford Station, Sodor Engine Wash, Go Go Speedy Railway, Percy's Penguin Adventure, Percy Portable Set, Scrapyard Cleanup Team, Spiral Tower Tracks with Percy, Percy to the Rescue), a themed 2-pack (Percy's Fishery Delivery), four themed 3-packs (Percy's Sweet Special, Percy's Bumpy Delivery, Percy's Catapult Cargo, Percy's Fossil Dig), six themed 4-packs (Steamies vs Diesels, Percy Hard at Work, Percy & Kevin to the Rescue, Talking Thomas & Percy Hard at Work, Tales From the Past Engine Pack, Brendam Buddies), as well as a 10 pack called Thomas' Favorite Friends. There are three talking versions of Percy - the original (model # R8862), Talking Percy at the Dieselworks, and the one already mentioned inside the Talking Thomas & Percy Hard at Work pack. There are also two "special editions" (Jelly Bean Percy, Holiday Percy), a Pull 'n Zoom Percy and a Push & Puff Percy. We had a complete collection going for our oldest grandson (2010 through the end of 2013), and would've kept it going for our two younger grandsons if the quality of the line hadn't started declining. THIS Percy is a definitely worth 5 stars! We weren't able to afford the wooden trains, and these fit our budget. We're glad we invested, but also glad we got out when we did! If you plan to purchase Take-n-Play, we hope you're able to get some of the older, high quality models before they're all replaced. (And just so you're aware, Take-n-Play products are not compatible with wooden tracks.)

Fisher-Price includes a yearly "Collector Checklist" with some (not all) Take-n-Play items, though it was never a comprehensive list and now just uses it as a sales pitch for the most recent stuff. I'm going back through all of my train reviews to provide a complete list of train characters that have been introduced into the line since 2010 (in order), not just for "serious" collectors, but also for those who'd just like to know what their other options are as far as Thomas' "co-workers" goes (and the farther back you go, the better the quality... IF, that is, you get the ORIGINAL models!) So here ya go: Thomas, Percy, Salty, Diesel 10, James, Emily, Gordon, Henry, Hiro, Molly, Charlie, Diesel, Rosie, Edward, Hank, Victor, Spencer, Mavis, Stanley, Toby, Flora, Mighty Mac, Sir Handel, Arthur, Duke, Ferdinand, Murdoch, Whiff, Bill, Ben, Dash, Bash, Scruff, Skarloey, Donald, Douglas, D199, Belle, Rheneas, Den, Dart, Peter Sam, Rusty, Neville, Fearless Freddie, Dennis, Paxton, Norman, Sidney, Iron 'Arry, Luke, Iron Bert, Stafford, Stephen, Harvey, Millie, Connor, Duck, Caitlin, Porter, Gator, Timothy, Culdee, Big City Engine, Class 40, Stepney, Marion, Duncan, and Samson. (And that doesn't even include the NON-train characters!)

I just found out the TnP line of diecast trains/vehicles/rolling stock with magnetic connectors is being REPLACED by Fisher-Price in 2017 with a diecast line called "Thomas & Friends Adventures", which will be TnP models modified with PLASTIC HOOK & LOOP COUPLERS. Obviously, your youngster will not be able to connect the 2014-2016 TnP models (with their flat, round 1-way magnetic connectors), nor the 2010-2014 TnP models - or Learning Curve's compatible 2002-2010 Take Along models - with their protruding 2-way magnetic connectors - with the new types of couplers as of next year.

review_headline: A lot of fun!!  Unique HO Train!!

product_title: ALEX Toys My Work Bench Activity Center
review_body:
As a grandma I really wanted to like this toy work bench, but I can't give it five stars simply because the quality and materials are not sturdy enough to withstand daily hammering and use from toddlers. The work bench I received was damaged upon removing from the box although not unrepairable. The backboard arrived with broken pegs (the ones the tools hang on) but was easily fixed with some wood glue. The shipping box and the box the item was packaged in wasn't damaged so it's a quality control issue the manufacture needs to fix.
As for assembly, it doesn't get any easier than this-It only took about 15 minutes for me to completely assemble from start to finish. It's only held together by a few screws, again not enough, IMO, to withstand the daily use toddlers can dish out to toys.
The workbench itself is painted with vibrant, bright colors that easily catch the eye of toddlers both boys and girls. The \\"tools\\" and hardware (wooden pegs and screws) are perfect imitations of real items, only smaller, and work and assemble easily. I also like that all the items are made from wood, no plastic involved.
My grandson doesn't live close by so I only see him a few times a month, if that often. For my needs, a toy room that isn't visited often, I think this toy will hold up and last a few years. If I had a toddler living with me daily, I don't think the work bench would last very long.

review_body: Im going to be honest.... I was out with my son shopping and ran into this vacuum at a consignment shop. there was no price on it, so the nice lady gave it to me for $1.25. I was so excited i got this for so cheap. It is in perfect shape with no pieces missing. my son loves that it sucks up small pieces of paper with the hose, and the quiet mode is also a hit with him. but when you push it around the floor the head of it is such a bad design. it gets caught up underneath itself, which makes it impossible to pretend to vacuum. it really frustrates my son. Im not writing this review because im mad about losing my $1.25... i just dont want anyone to spend 40 bucks on this! you will regret it. go with the cheaper 20 dollar dirt devil one. its much better.

product_title: My First Colorforms - Little Miss Weather Dress Up Set - University Games
review_body: I loved Colorforms as a child, so I was excited to see them still around now that I'm a grandmother!  I bought this set as a new toy for a family road trip.  We were in the car for about 6 hours and I wanted to make sure there were new toys to help my 3 year old granddaughter pass the time.  When I pulled this out of my bag, she was really excited.  She just recently got her first raincoat and boots, so she was most interested in those pieces at first.  We talked about umbrellas and raindrops and she built a cute scene with clouds.  She has a great sense of humor, and really liked the animal accessories.  She would put strange pieces together and then laugh out loud at how silly they were.  If you've never played with Colorforms before, they are clingy vinyl pieces.  They are not stickers; they are supposed to be easily removed and re-positioned.  They cling to windows and white boards, too.  These are exactly like the ones I played with as a child.  Everything does need to be wiped down occasionally, including the play surface, to maintain the cling.  This is a fun toy we can play with together, making up funny stories and rhymes as we build new scenes.  I'm so glad I found them!

product_title: Tenergy Syma S102G Night-Hawk 3-Channels Mini Indoor Helicopter
review_body:
At first i was skeptical of a $20 remote control helicopter, but after reading the reviews I decided to take my chances.
I'll admit that I was rather surprised at how functional and durable this little machine is. It takes a bit of getting used to at first but its easy to fly and can take a fair beating. After accidentally flying into the roof and slamming into the ground, it still flies the same. Even after several encounters with walls and pillars, it keeps on working.
The main downside is the short battery life of around 6ish minutes with a 45 minute charge time, which is unfortunate but to be expected.

review_body: My son and his mom picked this up at the Chicago Toy & Game show last weekend and he pretty much hasn't stopped playing it since. He went from being inattentive and disinterested in simple math, to telling me how this many chickens plus this many chickens equals this many chickens. Oh yeah, and it's environmentally friendly if that is something important to you (which it is to our son).

product_title: Transformers Movie Deluxe Autobot Jazz
review_body: Jazz is one of the best deluxe transformers in the movie line!I actually think Jazz looks alot cooler in the pontiac solstice mode compared to the G1 version.Jazz has a simple,but sleek design that is just awesome in either mode.There is great articulation in the legs,body,and head piece.Jazz is very realistic in either mode also to match how he is in the movie.Jazz comes with some sweet weapon features like a telescoping sword/gun for shooting down any decepticon attack and the spoiler section acts as a shield in robot mode for some defensive protection.The poseability is one of the best with great stability for acting out battle scenes or displaying this gem where you please.The durability is excellent as well with secure joints and a solid build in either robot or pontiac solstice mode to handle any situation.The transformation level is intermediate meaning if you have plenty of experience with transformers there is mid-level difficulty.If you are a parent buying for a child of 5-6 or younger you might have to help some in the process.Jazz honestly though has a very versatile and managable transformation all ages should be able to handle.The process starts off with the back part rotating down and underneath the front section.The same section then swings straight down with the lower parts where the wheels are sliding out.The same sections then rotate around with the feet folding out.The hood on the front splits into two sections while the front wheels rotate upwards to end up forming the arms.The top sections of the cab and spoiler then rotate down to rest on the back while the head piece is revealed in the same motion.The spoiler section can attach to the shoulder if you prefer a more battle ready look.If you are a fan of Jazz this is a must have for fans from the beginning or just starting out.Bottom line Jazz is a well-made,high quality,10 out of 10 transformer all fans will enjoy.I highly recommend Jazz to all transformer fans and collectors alike.Jazz Rocks and Transformers Rule!!!nd Transformers Rule!!!

product_title: Star Wars Darth Vader Helmet
review_body: This is an excellent toy mask for any Star Wars fan!  This mask (not a complete helmet) looks remarkably genuine from the front and is made out of good quality, flexible plastic.  It has a top and side strap on the back, as well as a comfortable rubber piece for the nose.  The eye lenses are equivalent to dark sunglasses - you can still see out, but it is hard for anyone to see your eyes unless there is a lot of light.  This really adds to the effect!  It fits almost anyone, adjusting with the straps on the back.  It fit my 5-year-old as well as adults like myself (I usually wear an XL size helmet for recreation).  It can be worn with glasses, which is how I wore it.  With the helmet on, my glasses were pressed fairly hard on my nose, causing a fair amount of discomfort.  Another problem is that the downward visibility is fairly limited, causing the wearer to tilt the head forward while walking, which looks a little unbecoming for Darth Vader.  It has a button on the top right outside of the helmet which trigger any of 7 phrases, or several instances of a few seconds of Vader's raspy breathing, in a fixed order (so you can cycle through to make sure it says what you want the next time).  The button blends into the mask nicely, but once others notice it, they may be tempted to reach up and press it.  It also has an on/of switch inside the helmet to save on batteries.  My 14-year-old son used it today for a little skit at a costume party.  He has a medium adult size head.  It fit him fine, although it pressed a little harder than he liked on his nose.  He wore a black ski mask to make the back of his head match fairly well, although when he turned away from the audience, they could see it wasn't a full helmet.  Still, it looks quite realistic from the front!  He added a black turtleneck, a black cape, and black boots for an excellent effect.  The voice sounds very close to the movie, although the enunciation is slightly different.  I believe that it is either an excellent imitation of James Earl Jones, or separate recordings made by him.  The battery is a single replaceable AA battery (pre-installed).  My boys 6-14 enjoy wearing it around, it looks impressive, and seems quite durable.  Recommended!

review_headline: So very adorable, but very disappointed
review_body:
This is a super cute kitchen, and I gladly forked over its exorbitant price in order for my daughter to have the kitchen of her dreams. What is so incredibly disappointing is that, after assembly, when my husband tried to move it.. just a tiny little scoot so we could better position ourselves to move it to its location.. the back corner just bent, then SNAPPED right off, as if it were made of graham crackers or something! REALLY, Kidkraft??

No, it's not solid wood.. yes, its particle board... but really... there's no reason it should have snapped like that. None.

This is a Christmas gift, and it's broken before it was even given. We'll have to glue it back together... but for the going price for this kitchen... we just shouldn't be having to do this at all.

If you purchase this for your child/ren - don't be tempted at even a tiny scoot. Just pick it up completely to move it.

product_title: Nerf N-Strike Spectre Rev-5 Dart Blaster
review_body: This is a stellar addition to any Nerf arsenal for several reasons.  First, despite being packaged with Whistler Darts it can fire Streamlines (clip darts) with high velocity (in particular the Whiteout versions you find at Wal-Mart).  Second, unlike the Maverick (the oldest Nerf revolver) the barrels do not advance with a trigger pull and the slide is much easier to pull than the Maverick - this means fewer jams and pulled skin.  Third, the barrel attachment actually enhances the gun's stability while firing and is not clearly for show (it's not a real silencer, naturally, but the wide bore doesn't allow for the normal \\"bounce-around\\" in the narrower bore barrels like in the Longstrike or Longshot rifles).  Fourth, the revolving chamber pops out of the gun for easy reloads.  Fifth, it is unusually well-balanced with the barrel extension despite the added length.  Drawbacks include the stock - while it adds stability for younger Nerfers, older Nerfers won't find much use as it is not very durable and they can hold the gun with the barrel very well in one hand. The gun's relative lack of barrel interchangability is another drawback - this barrel comes with a bead to lock it in place in addition to the normal lock system and the barrel attachment does not seem to like getting other barrel extensions placed upon it.  Case in point - my Longstrike's barrel extension snapped on fine but took a lot of wrenching to get it detached; conversely, the Spectre's extension spun off the Longstrike with far greater ease.  All in all, well worth the $20 spen; it is a Wal-Mart exclusive though, the only other places to find it are on auction sites and Amazon.

product_title: Kodiak Custom Play Set Hardware Kit (wood not included)
review_body:
Don't even get me started on the people who thought they were buying a huge swing set like this for under $200!!!

Anyway, we're very pleased with this purchase. After researching like crazy I realized the swing sets in the $300-$600 range were garbage...soft wood that wouldn't hold adults.

I knew the first thing my 5 yo would say was, \\"come swing with me\\" or \\"come up in my fort\\". What a letdown it would've been to say, \\"sorry buddy, you have to play on it yourself!\\" We built the 512 model and love it. I also purchased a heavy duty swing that holds over 500 pounds so anyone can swing next to him. The 4x6x10 holds just fine and the a frame bracket at the end does it's job. REALLY love the bracket system for the 4X4's...so quick.

There were a few of us putting it together and after cutting all the lumber to size it took most of the day. Instructions were spot on 95% of the time with only a couple, \\"well that's stupid\\" or \\"wait...what???\\" moments.

We've had 4 large adults and 1 kid up in the fort without any stress. If you buy some quality lumber then this thing is heavy duty.

Tips:

Have a corded drill to go with a couple cordless drills

Mark the measurement with a grease pencil on every piece you cut an the stack them accordingly (20\\" pile, 30\\" pile, 40\\", etc.). Makes it easy to say, \\"go grab 4 58\\" 2x4's from the 50\\" pile\\" to your helper.

We only put two swing between the set and A Frame. Three would be way too close! We then installed another swing on the outside portion.

Get some quality star bit screws.
