product_title: Healing Blade
review_headline: Great teaching tool on infectious diseases
review_body:
The Healing Blade is a game about battling infectious diseases. Yes, you read that right. It is a two player game where one side plays the Lord of Pestilence (the diseases) and another plays the Apothecary Healers (the medicinal agents for countering the diseases). It was developed by two medical doctors who also happen to be gamers, Francis Kong and Arun Mathews. From what I've read, it is growing in popularity with medical students.

When I first heard about this, the first thing I thought of was an academic paper my wife had ran across and told me about by Richard Steinman and Mary Blastos called \\"A trading-card game teaching about host defence\\" from 2002. The paper concluded concluded that the game was super-effective for teaching the concepts. The two are unrelated, to my knowledge, but share the same conceptual space. Both the game in the paper and The Healing Blade are games... that teach. But on to this game.

It's a beautiful game. It has high-quality components, and great art. There are 20 green glass beads included to track the energy resource used, ATP (adenosine triphosphate). Each player has a full-color playmat. And most of the 90 cards have unique art. The art is definitely worth mentioning here... it would definitely hold its own against Magic: The Gathering art. Gorgeous illustratiuons. Altogether, a very impressive set of components.

And then... the cards. Okay, here is where the diseases come in. Each Lord of Pestilence card has the full scientific name of the disease (Streptococcus pneumoniae or Helicobacter pylori, as examples), its abbreviated common name (S. pneumoniae, H. pylori) and a fantasy-style piece of art that represents it, plus flavortext that puts a magical spin on its real-world effect. Each Apothecary Healer card has the name of a medicine (ie, Doxycyclene) and its own art and flavortext. Aside from a small font, they are very well put together.

As for gameplay... let's say that this was the funnest study session I've ever had on infectious diseases. Which is to say that as a game, the mechanics do leave a little to be desired. The rules are pretty concise and simple, but in playing we found a couple situations not covered in the rules. For instance, as the Lord of Pestilence, I found my hand of cards clogged with high-cost diseases that I was unable to play. The result was that my Apothecary Healer opponent was able to build up and have a healer combatant that could counter most diseases I could play. It could have just been a bad run, and I noticed on their site a rules revision is in progress. So... the current gameplay isn't tight, mechanics-wise... but as I see it, that's not an issue. Because mechanics are not the point.

What this game represents is a great step in the right direction for games that teach. If I were a medical student, I would absolutely love this game. This beats the heck out of a dry textbook. Granted, it doesn't replace the textbook, but it is a great supplement that presents the material in a way that activates different parts of the brain. This would be a great supplement to a class on pathogens. It slaps a fun theme on the subject of infectious diseases and how to fight them, and runs with it. I hands-down recommend this for any med student out there. For gamers? Not so much. But keep your eye out: the next rules revision may very well put this mechanically closer to the games we play just for fun. I suspect we may start seeing more hobby-quality games whose primary purpose is to help us learn. And I like that!ever had on infectious diseases. product_title: DC Direct DC Universe Online Statue: Green Arrow
review_headline: An absolutely INCREDIBLE piece of art work. Minutely detailed, gorgeously sculpted and painted. A GA statue and it's best.
review_body:
I didn't used to be a fan of Green Arrow. Not sure why really. But as I fell in love with Black Canary, he obviously was in the stories more and more. LOL Eventually when they got their own series, and after reading Kevin Smith's masterpiece ([[ASIN:1563899655 Green Arrow: Quiver (Book 1)]]), Green Arrow started to grow on me. Once I started playing Dc Universe Online, I decided to start collecting these statues. ([[ASIN:B002I0KOYC DC Universe Online Collector's Edition]]) I have a neat little thing I do in my library. Whatever collection of books I have on whichever shelf, I have statues of those characters in front of the books. So my Green Arrow collection has this Green Arrow statue in front of it. And it's gorgeous.
So okay, down to the business of the review. Once I saw that darn bow when I opened the box, I was TERRIFIED I was going to break it. It's very small and fragile, and it uses actual string for the bow. But the statue is packed so well that you'd have to drop kick it into a brick wall to get it to break. The ONLY way you're breaking that bow is if you're Mr. or Ms. Clumsy-Fingers when opening the box and removing the statue. LOL It is well wrapped, and unwraps easily once it comes out of the box. And viola, I had my statue. It really is a beautiful statue, and if you're a Green Arrow fan, then I think this item is a must have. It's also a good sized statue for the price. It is VERY limited edition, so I recommend you buy it now before the price skyrockets. To that note, these items ALWAYS skyrocket in price. They're limited edition, as I said, and are therefore a GREAT investment. I've got Wonder Woman statues that I paid 100 bucks for and are now worth 10 to 20 times that. So yeah, you're definitely getting a bang for your buck here.
Thanks for your time folks. I appreciate it. Sincerely, R.A. McDowell

product_title: Star Wars Signature Series Force FX Lightsaber w/Removable Blade
review_body:
I'll get straight to the point:

I just received this lightsaber in the mail today. It's my first lightsaber. I have been playing with it for the past 4 hours haha. A lot of other people have made some excellent comments as to the quality of this product so I will just mention two issues: (a) its durability and (b) its \\"removable\\" aspect.

Okay, first, people say to be careful with it and that's probably true but I'm of the mind that if you're going to buy a lightsaber in the first place a tiny kid inside you wants to go hit something (or someone) with it. And I think the people who make this know that which is why they make them fairly durable. For example, the very first thing I did when I got it out of the box and assembled was hit my friend over the head with it (it made a very satisfying clashing sound). It isn't made of eggshells people. On accident I hit it against the wall hard enough to chip the paint and aside from a few minor scuffs on the blade (which become invisible once it's on) nothing was damaged.

Second, I love the fact that the blade is removable. Practically speaking it's very easy to remove (you could disassemble the whole thing in less than a minute) and I love how it actually makes a releasing sound when you remove the blade. It's the little details like that which make this thing so damn cool.

So there ya go. If you're on the fence just go ahead and buy one. I was on the fence but after reading the other reviews here I decided to go buy it and I wasn't disappointed. There are very few toys (okay \\"replicas\\") out there that can make you feel like a kid again and this is one of them. Happy jedi training! =D

p.s. - the only complaint I have about this product are the stickers which were put on the handle. Seriously, these stickers are godawful. They're the ones that leave a sticky residue after you pull them off that doesn't come off. I've been rubbing it down with alcohol and some tissue and instead of coming off it just SMEARS! I don't know what the manufacturers were thinking since I've seen even my local grocery store has stickers that peel off easily and painlessly without any SMEARING residue-gunk. And the handle had about three or four of those stickers... I'm actually looking at the lightsaber right now and I notice that 1) pieces of the tissue have stuck onto the sticky gunk and 2) after rubbing the sticky-gunk it has clumped in certain areas in a darker coagulated mass (looks like boogers) around the corners of the handle.don't know what the manufacturers were thinking since I've seen even my local grocery store has stickers that peel off easily and painlessly without any SMEARING residue-gunk. product_title: Beyblade Metal Fusion Battletop Faceoff - Dragon Bite Attack
review_body: This package contains two Beyblades and two launchers:   Balance B108  105WD 26915 EARTH WOLF        (right spin Beyblade)   Blue right spin rip-cord launcher   Attack  BB43C 100HF 26915 Lightning L-Drago (left  spin Beyblade)   Clear left spin rip-cord launcher      The Earth Wolf is an awesome blade. It ALWAYS wins against my other blades: L-Drago, Evil Gemious BB-56, Meteo L Drago BB-88. It spins so well on its 1st launch, it typically defeats others on their 2nd launch attempt. It comes with an WD performance tip. WD stands for \\"Wide Defense\\". WD has significant defensive capabilities & superior stamina. It uses a form of tip (like a toy top) that permits it to spin & spin & spin...  Using this blade with a REV UP Launcher B-203 is a tough combo to beat. A good match up may be against the Basalt Horogium 145WD    The Lightning L-Drago is an ok run of the mill blade. It hasn't won too many battles for me. It comes with an HF performance tip. HF stand for \\"Hole Flat\\". The hole is supposed to provide a slight stamina improvement (less friction) over the basic flat tip, but it won't ever outlast an WD tip. This blade is an attack type. After a few attacks, it usually starts its death wobble.    This kit makes for a decent starter kit. You still need a stadium, and I recommend losing the rip-cord launchers and replacing them with string launchers and launcher handles.

product_title: Melissa & Doug
review_headline: Perfect toy for every child, including special education
review_body:
This should be one of the number one toys or educational toys on the list for children of all aptitudes. There aren't too many children who are not enraptured with doing their own freestyle drawings on an easel. Every Pre-K child I've worked with has thrived and been thrilled with painting or drawing their own artwork on an easel set up such as Melissa and Doug's Standing Easel.

If you buy this at home or for the classroom, buy plastic aprons as well. Clean up is easy, but children can get themselves stained with colors if you don't have an apron.

Also, Melissa and Doug products for early childhood are all of good quality and well thought out, from my experience in the early childhood classroom.

Recommended for special education children also of all types, including children with ADHD and autistic children. Children sometimes benefit from guided painting, e.g. draw/paint the outline of an elephant and allow them to use their imagination to fill in the details, without guiding their painting. This is a number one on the list toy for 99% of children. Buy children's water paints and brushes and you have a beginner's painting easel as well.

review_body: Flash cards can be a great way to practice math but they're boring.  Math is one of those subjects that it can be hard enough to get kids to practice at all, let alone enjoy it. I remember when I was little I loved practicing math with a computer game where you defeated an evil wizard.  This game is even better since it takes it a couple steps further.  By using realistic situations it helps kids understand the importance of math in daily life.  Earning money for completing challenges that players can then spend is another great incentive for them to practice and develop important skills.

review_body: Travel folio scrabble works well for travel. Letter pieces lock into players' letter holders. More difficult to move them around to visualize words and everything is smaller scale, but it works. Nice travel size.

product_title: Barbie Video Girl Doll
review_body: I bought this for my grand daughter and she loves it and plays with it all the time.She loves watching the movies she makes with it.This doll is very durable and dependable for kids.

product_title: Rubie's Costume Co Ak-47 Machine Gun Costume
review_body: I love this toy gun its a 1:1 scale ak47 and the one that i got even comes with a scope and laser system it is completely awesome! this is a great buy!

product_title: Neat-Oh! LEGO Ninjago Battle Arena
review_body: My four year old chose several Ninjago spinners for his birthday. He's younger than the suggested age but loves these toys. This box helps him keep his little weapons, spinners and figures in place. Much better than a plain box. Its a nice travel box as well. The battle spaces work just ok. They don't spin as well as a hard surface but works on the go.

product_title: Trademark Innovations 18 Card Bingo Set With 75 Numbered Balls, a Metal Cage to Spin, Bingo Chips and Ball Rack
review_headline: just okay-quality assurance sleeping on the job
review_body: I bought this game so that my kids could play with their grandma.   We have a good time playing but the numbers and letters are illegible on MANY of the balls.   My daughter went so far as to print them herself with a Sharpie pen.   It's dissappointing that the company felt the quality of this product was good enough to sell.  Is there no pride in a job well done anymore?

product_title: Fascinations AntWorks
review_body: Our ants arrived safe and ready to go. They started to dig tunnels with in a couple hours of being introduced to their new environment. It has been less then 7 days and they have some great tunnels completed. Even my 19 year old brother finds these insects fascinating to watch.

product_title: Little Tikes Princess  Cozy Coupe - 30th Anniversary
review_body: Product was as described. Last purchsed one from the same company 18 years ago. Yes...started over! Quality seems as good as my previous model which lasted many years. This model has a removeable floor which is a great benefit to avoid the smaller ones feet being dragged. The old models did not have this. I would definetly give it a thumbs up!!

product_title: Fisher-Price Imaginext DC Super Friends Batmobile with Bonus Figures
review_body: Kids don't play with it as much as I thought they would. Love the batcave though. I think this is pretty cool, but the kids aren't as amused by it as you would think. Plus, look elsewhere...it's cheaper other places....too bad I didn't know that sooner.

product_title: Schwinn Roadster 12-Inch Trike
review_body: We bought this roadster for our 21 month old and are very pleased! The Roadster is nice and stable, looks really cool, and the seat can be adjusted for a growing kid.    However, even with the seat in the closest position, our boy who is just under the 50th percentile for height can't quite reach the pedals well enough to get going.  We attached an old broom handle to the back via some string and a carabiner that allows us to push him when we go out for a walk.  This weekend we might try to figure out a way to make the pedals thicker so he can really rest his feet on them, but for now we're quite pleased to be able to enjoy a walk in the neighborhood with our pleased-as-punch little boy cruising along on his very first trike.    And...the shipping was free and amazingly fast!!!

product_title: Airfix A04210 1:600 Scale HMS Iron Duke Warship Classic Kit Series 4
review_headline: outstanding model of Jutland-era RN battleship
review_body: This is the only affordable, full-hull version of a Jutland-era Grand Fleet battleship (the Warspite model by the same company is presented only in its WWII configuration; and more recently another company has put out a 1915 version of the Warspite).  This is a fine, and seemingly accurate depiction of the ship.  LATER UPDATE COMMENT: Now an HMS Queen Elizabeth model is out by the same company, another full-hull Jutland-era Grand Fleet battleship!

product_title: Perplexus Epic
review_body: Well, it would be a great toy if it didn't break right away.  We are big fans of the original and preordered 2 Epics.  My kids were pretty disappointed that they both broke in the same place within two days of receipt.  I am returning.

product_title: InStep Pedal Car
review_body: The truck is nice and durable my son loved it.! The truck has nice accessories I'm sure any kid would love it.!

product_title: Melissa & Doug Knob Wooden Puzzle
review_body: My 11 month old Grand daughter use this for the first time yesterday.  The paper is already starting to come off.  Poor quality product.

product_title: Jigsaw Puzzle Collectible Tin 500 Pieces 15"X17"-Rockwell-Coming And Going
review_body: Few can resist the charm of Norman Rockwell but here, I wish I had. The box is small, cheap & the lid doesn't fit well. The photo on the box is great,   but  blown up to puzzle size, it loses its clarity. The box loses even more attraction in finding it too small to sort puzzle pieces, unlike a handy regular sized   cardboard box would provide. I was easily fooled with the charm of the metal box but it's not very useful when actually working with the puzzle.     The puzzle pieces are very small, very thin and don't hold together well. If I have 3 pieces put together, they will not stay together if I try moving them carefully to where they belong.   The pieces are not snug together, but easily fall apart.    I did not in any way enjoy this puzzle & wish I had not bought it. Even the tin is not worth it.

product_title: Action Figure Stand Pack of 25 Clear Stands by Entertainment Earth
review_body: I bought the EE action figure stands as a substitute for the increasingly difficult to find Protech stands. I couldn't be happier with them. These are a really nice matte finish, and are 2 and 1/8 inches across. The foot peg is just the right length, where the Protech ones often had to be filed down quite a bit for peg holes that are in the toe area of some figures. The previous reviewer mistakenly stated that these are supposed to come in 3 sizes, but they are not. I'd recommend these to anyone who wants a good quality stand at a really great price.

product_title: Fisher-Price TRIO DC Super Friends Batcave
review_headline: Great solo play and time with mom
review_body: My son got this from Grandma for his 5th birthday.  He did need help building the batcave, but we had a blast sorting the pieces and grabbing out the ones that are called for in the directions.  He was so proud of the finished product.  The trios stay in place and don't break like legos.  He loved putting together the accessories on his own as it is only a few steps.  I can't wait to see how he decides to rennovate the cave in a few days.  Assembly for us was about 45 minutes, but we were taking out time and enjoying the multi-step directions.  I did not find the directions difficult to follow.  As others stated... it does not give step by step directions for the other caves, but it does give a good front and back view.   Likely, I will have to do more of the work when we are ready to venture in that direction.  GREAT PRODUCT... HIGHLY RECOMMEND.

product_title: Takaratomy Celebi (MC-47): Pokemon Monster Collection 2" Mini Figure
review_headline: A great addition for any Pokemon fan
review_body: The toy was very detailed. I am very happy with the product. I still can't get over the fact how small the Japanese version of the Pokemon characters are. Despite the side, it is a great addition to any Pokemon fan based on the movie. Thank you! I will return to the seller's store.

product_title: Melissa & Doug Sunny Patch Bibi Bee Flashlight With Easy-Grip Handle
review_body: We received this flashlight as a gift. I was surprised to see complaints about the battery life. We've had this toy at least a year and it has withstood a rough 2 year old boy (who loves it and leaves it on all the time) and only needed the batteries changed once. I'm very pleased with the product.

product_title: Crayola Model Magic Animal Craft Kit
review_body: I'm 28, and I loved it! It doesn't stink or get all over everything. Simple and yet still entertaining. I don't think it's supposed to look exactly like the box, as creativity is supposed to be in there somewhere. I think if you can at least tell the difference between your monkey and panda you're doing just fine.  Looking forward to trying the Presto Dots next. I almost wonder if I can sneak it into my cubicle undetected...

product_title: Green Bay Packers NFL 25 Charles Woodson White Jersey Exclusive by McFarlane Toys
review_body: Only bad thing is Mcfarlane just did a repaint of Deion Sanders, which is fine but they did not even take the time out to change the head so it still looks like Sanders.

product_title: Step2  Naturally Playful Sand Table
review_body: After reading all reviews, I decided on this sandbox.  I like that it's elevated, though I wish it were a bit taller.  Today was the first day my 2 year old played with it and she loved it.  She pitched a fit when I told her it was time to go inside.  I am going to keep it on our covered front deck so hopefully no rainwater will get in under the lid, which was one of the complaints others had.  I do think that these things are way overpriced for what they are.  I purchased 3 small bags of play sand at Wal Mart because I wanted to be sure I had enough, and I only put in one bag.  It seemed like enough.  I thought if I put in another one the lid would not fit well.  The bags did not state the weight, so I'm not sure how much I used.  The cashier thought they were 25 lbs.

product_title: Little Tikes Deluxe Cozy Convertible Car
review_body: I bought three of these for my triplet grandsons and boy were we disappointed! No pedals!!!! There is a detachable pushing handle on the back for adults to push this little car.....but unless you want to remove the bottom and the babies use their feet like Fred Flintstone........it is truly a dud!!! Don't buy it....it's not work the effort to put it together.

product_title: Small World Toys Active Edge - 18'' Hoppity Ball - Colors Vary (uninflated)
review_body:
We bought this for our son when he was 4, and he is 6.5 and still uses it a lot. It has held up perfectly, though we have never tried it outside. Whenever I need him to get out some extra energy (esp in the winter), I have him do hops on the ball. His 3 yr old sister likes it as well, though she is still a bit small for it (she's tiny for her age), and I even put the baby on it on her tummy for playing and to build up those core muscles!
I do recommend actually using the face stickers it comes with for another project (like draw them a big circle on a piece of paper or something) instead of the ball. While it is a cute idea, the stickers came off really quickly and left sticky residue on the ball that got covered with fuzz and such from the floors. No big deal, but if I had it to do again I wouldn't used the stickers on the ball so I thought I'd mention it to give someone else an alternate idea for them.

product_title: Four in a Row- A Strategy Game for Two (Colors Vary)
review_body: Quality of toy was well made.  However, smaller than expected, making it a little challenging to play.  Delivered quickly and in perfect condition.

product_title: 4-LOM bobble-head
review_body: This is defiantly an eye catching, and neat item! It was a gift he really liked it and he has it displayed for all his friends to stare at with jealousy.

product_title: American Clocks Random Color Funny Shock Gag (1 Pack)
review_body: This is not a very good gag because most people don't hand out gum like this. It doesn't feel very durable, and it is only really good for a quick gag.

product_title: Koplow Games - Wolf Dice Game
review_body: A great game for the whole family!  The game comes with some wolf facts and if you want to add to the educational value have the kids keep score!  The instructions that come with it are easy to learn and fun for all ages.  If you want to mix things up try your own variations.  We play so you only score points if you roll an even number and each wolf you roll doubles your score that turn!  You set the number you're playing to.  The tube it comes in makes it a great on the go game, it's small enough to throw in a pocket or purse as you're going out the door.  The wait at a restaurant will fly by once you pull this out and start playing!

product_title: DC Universe Justice League Unlimited Exclusive Action Figure 6-Pack The League United (Superman, Supergirl, Mr. Terrific, Elongated Man, Obsidian and Hourman)
review_body: These DC Universe figures are very well made and durable.  They aren't overly articulated (which I find makes the figure a little more fragile), so my son can play with these without legs or heads popping off.  Also, the capes are attached and made of plastic/rubber material, so they don't come off or rip.  They don't really stand up well on their own, but they're perfect for hand-held imaginative play.  We have a lot of these DC figures, and they've all held up well.  Overall, they're fun to play with and look at since all their costumes are cool!

product_title: eeBoo Sunflower Growth Chart
review_body: This growth chart is very sturdy and adorable.  It is even cuter in person - buy this you will not be disappointed.

product_title: Mirage 3-D Instant Hologram Maker
review_body: The illusion works pretty well.  the actual mirrors aren't perfect, there is some warp.  The plastic backing material is thin and cheap too.  It has already developed some small cracks.  It gets the job done, but barely.    I do believe that this particular item is higher quality than the other imitators (but I can't verify this, not having purchased the others), but it's far from a precision optic.

product_title: Little Tikes-Mobile Ride-On Push Car, Red
review_body:
Ok so I gave it 4 stars because of the difficulty of putting it together, we'll get to that later. This car is ADORABLE! I'd been seeing them instore and online for a while and I dont like the bulkiness of the \\"other car\\" found in most stores. This was the solution to my problem! The handle folding down is probably the best part. It's super cute! My 1yr old fits on it perfectly although I cant really seem him still enjoying it after probably 3, but then again he'll be onto bikes and other toys by then too. The seat could be a little deeper but overall we love the car.

Now my deduction- This thing was a PAIN to put together alone. I'm sure if I had an extra set of hands it would have been easier but the little white plastic things they give you to set the rods are awful. It took me, alone, about 45 mins so its not too difficult but you'd think it would be a little easier or maybe one side would already come assembled, well its not you get the bare basics and do it yourself from scratch on the wheels. Other than that it was simple to put together, the actual car piece is already together of course, and the handle/cup holders are just a few screws.

Overall we are pleased with the car and have enjoyed it several times already! The strap in the middle of the handle is awesome too! We simply attach his backpack to the handle and off we go :) I'm totally hands free, don't have to tote anything along or worry about it not fitting under the hood. I highly recommend this product and while its a few dollars more than the \\"other car\\" and the assembly could be easier its well worth it IMO.

product_title: Childrens Purple Musical Music Box Jewelry Music Box Spinning Dancing Ballerina Drawer-Tune is Swan Lake
review_body: This ballerina jewelry music box was perfect for what we wanted.  We bought it for our 4-year-old girl.  We wanted something pretty and classic, but not too fragile so she could play with it without worrying about breaking it.  This music box is just that.  We really like it.

product_title: Toy Story Pull String Jessie 15" Talking Figure
review_body: I like this jesse doll bc it is realistic looking and sounding.  however, the hat is useless bc it constantly falls off.  also it would have been better if she had stiff legs and could stand.  my daughter wants her to stand like buzz.  she played with her for about a day and hasnt touched her since unfortunately.  i am not sure what the reason for this is.

product_title: VTech Move and Crawl Ball, Orange
review_body: Great toy for special needs children.  I use this with my hypotonic 10 month old to encourage him to get up on his elbows and pivot.  Motivates him to roll and teaches him cause and effect.  One of his favorite toys.

product_title: Dominion Intrigue
review_body: The game is great, however the packaging, not so much. The cards were thrown all over the place. but its ok, it worked out fine and we had all that we needed.

product_title: Deluxe Magic Set
review_body: I ordered this for an 8 year-old boy's birthday. He LOVED it! He was putting on a show for family within a half hour! All his friend's parents were asking where I bought it! Great quality, and price!

product_title: Modern Art
review_headline: Disappointing.... but review is subject to revision
review_body: I had high hopes for this game; even going so far as to schedule a \\"game night\\" party with several families.  The group included several professors (language), a CPA, a translator, AND a teenager, most of whom tried to get through the instructions but couldn't find the wherewithal.    But, for me at least, the biggest disappointment was that both the art and the artists represented were really insipid.  I was hoping the game would have presented tantalizing designs in dizzying colors, but most of the cards were the same palette of bland colors and the same small range of design ideas.    Perhaps if the art cards had been more inspiring, the group might have found more reason to slog through the instructions (or at least to invent their own version of the game), and the auctions would have followed.      If we ever get to playing this game, I'll review the actual game play.

product_title: Little Adventures Deluxe Rapunzel Medium
review_body:
My daughter really likes this dress. She wears in regular clothes about a size 5 (about 35lbs) and this dress fits her perfectly. I was worried when purchasing this dress that it might be too small but it worked out good. Its really pretty but the sleeves are supposed to be 3/4 length and she still tries to pull them down to her wrist. Perhaps that length of sleeve is not the best for a 4 yr old....

Overall, we have been happy with this little dress.

product_title: KidWise Jump'n Dodgeball Bounce House
review_body: Great toy! My husband, daughter (14), and son (8) were all in this at the same time and had a blast.  It's very quick to inflate - in about 2 minutes it's ready to go.  It's also much bigger than I had pictured, which was an added bonus.  The only drawback is that it's a bit heavy, but that's a minimal drawback considering all that's great about this bounce house.  The only thing that remains to be seen is how long it will last, but given the seemingly good quality of the material, I suspect we'll have long gotten more than the price paid out of this by the time it no longer is able to hold air.

product_title: Aurora World 9"  Barney the Plush Great Horned Owl
review_body: I bought this owl for my 1 year old son. He loves the owls at the zoo. I feel safe letting him play with it. It is very cute!

product_title: Bandai Tamashii Nations Super Saiyan Son Goku "Dragonball Z" S.H. Figuarts Action Figure (Discontinued by manufacturer)
review_body: The action figure is well colored, easy to take apart and to pose, I ordered mine from another web site cheaper less than 50 dollars.

product_title: Perplexus Epic
review_body: I loved the original Perplexus so I couldn't wait for Perplexus Epic to come out. I bought Epic at a retail store and I can tell you the guy who invented this thing must be an evil genius! You could speed through the Original Perplexus once knew what you were doing. With Epic, you have to finesse the ball different ways in different areas or that thing is going off the track.Cool new obstacles. One looks like stairs out of an Escher painting. If you loved Original Perplexus you have got to try EPIC!

product_title: Crayola Crayon Maker
review_body: I have a tendency to break crayons as do all of the kids in my family. We got this as a way to reuse all those tiny little tips that end up at the bottom of the crayon box. This makes about half size crayons which tend to break less, that's probably at least half the reason they crayons you make are so small, it makes them more durable. I had remembered melting old crayons to make new ones when I was younger so I was excited about this. Much easier than trying to melt them on the stove where if you aren't careful you end up with just a horrible blob of indistinct color. This Crayon Maker doesn't come with a bulb so I recommend ordering one at the same time.    Great for kids who love to color! Neat way to encourage kids to reuse rather than just throw crayons out when they break.

product_title: Play Tent Princess Castle by Pockos - Features Glow in the Dark Stars
review_headline: Very cute..BUT didn't last more then 1 day
review_body: Very cute play tent, but is NOT worth the fifty dollars. save yourself some cash and look around for another 1. my daughters 3 1/2 and 2 1/2 yrs old had played with this for 3-4 hrs on and off for 1 night. The Velcro was coming off the sides. The thing is pretty much garbage. do not waste your money!

product_title: SpongeBob Squarepants Playset Flying Dutchman's Ghost Ship by Nickelodeon
review_headline: A bit fragile for everyday play
review_body: My children liked the way this toy looked, and enjoyed incorporating it into their playtime. However, the ship's parts frequently fell apart or became detached and required an adult to reassemble. Love that it's Spongebob; there aren't a large number of Spongebob play sets.

product_title: Charmeleon - Diamond & Pearl Secret Wonders - 46 [Toy]
review_body: It's Fire Fang does 20 points of damage to the defending pokemon and only \\"burns\\" it too. It's Flare Tail does 50 points plus 20 more if the coin you flip lands on head and you also have to discard a fire energy card as well. I give this card a 8 out of 10.

product_title: Mattel Hot Wheels 2001 First Editions Evil Twin No. 16/36
review_body:
This little gem arrived on time Im writing a short story and I needed this car for inspiration. what else can be said it's a 50's style cadillac with a good purple coat the grill is awsome it looks very evil with it's headlight eyes with the twin engines in the front it resembles a no nonsense pimp ride and if you look hard enough you can see the silver shift stick as well as the wolfer speaker in the back.

hotwheels over the years has been creating some interesting themes for their cars I can see why collectors are such fanatics of course one would have to roll with care since the wheels are so low but any good clean surface will do.

product_title: Mario Bro: Super Cute 8-inch Goomba Mushroom Plush
review_body: Bought this item in person at a recent event I attended. It is a great size, 8-9 inches and VERY soft material. I like that the eyes, eyebrows and mouth are all sort of screen printed on and not stitched on. There is no signs that they will be falling off of the Goomba any time soon. I read in a review of the 5\\" one that the eyebrows didn't last the day for someone. You won;t have to worry about that with this one. My son loves him, and so do my husband and I.

product_title: Magna-Tiles Clear Colors 32 Piece Set
review_headline: Quite possibly the best toy ever!
review_body: Both of my kids, boy and girl ages 6 and 3 love this toy!  Hours spent creating and playing with this toy since they received it for Christmas.  Worth every penny.  They build houses for little figurines and cars, make pretend pizzas, make car ramps, houses, practice balancing the pieces. Wonderful toy!

product_title: Jumbo Inflatable Dinosaurs ( 6 count) by Fun Express
review_body: These are adorable and my dinosaur-loving daughter was thrilled. However, we only received 5 of the 6 and one was completely torn and unusable. We also got two of the same dinosaur(triceratops). Luckily that's my daughters favorite. Truly disappointing.

product_title: Harry Potter Slytherin Deluxe Tie
review_body: This tie was perfect for what I needed. It looks great and you could wear it as a regular tie too. The only thing is that it was a little long....or maybe I'm just too short.

product_title: Learning Resources Magnetic Learning Calendar
review_body: This handy little calendar is fun to use.  My kids like taking turns switching the magnetic numbers and months, and they especially like figuring out what kind of weather we are having to change that magnet.  We were careful to hang it high since magnets can be dangerous (even fatal) to little people if swallowed.  We simply pull a chair over to update it or pop it off the plastic hooks I used to hang it (not included).

product_title: Crayola Colored Bubble Launcher
review_body: My daughter is into bubbles lately. So when we saw Crayola's colored bubbles I thought we would give it a try.   Brought it home and assembled the gun without problem. My daughter took it outside on our deck to give her new toy a try. In five minutes I had blue stains all over my deck, her outfit, her face and hands.  I ordered her into the yard where the mess continued. The colored bubble formula ran out of the nozzle when the gun was tilted. I grabbed it out of her hands and the next stop for the toy was  the trash can.   I have NO idea how this product made it past quality control at the company. Very poor judgement on Crayola's part to let this thing even make it to market.  Don't make the same mistake I did. Do not buy colored bubbles!!

product_title: ZOOB BuilderZ 500 Piece Kit
review_body: My boys have pinched their finger so often, they hate to play with them.  They are ages 2, 4 and 6.  They concept is great and I love building with them.  I hope as they get older, they will be played with again.

product_title: Disney Tangled Featuring Rapunzel Maximus Horse
review_headline: A great toy for the little ones who loved Tangled
review_body: I actually bought this for my grandson who is 4.  He loved the man and horse in Tangled.  He loves it and plays with it alot.  I would recommend this for any young child.  It's durable and adorable, stands by itself even with the rider on it's back.

product_title: eeBoo Simple Words Puzzle Pairs (48 pc)
review_body: Excellent way to begin pre-literacy activites with your child.  My 3 year old enjoys playing with the simple words puzzles.... I may consider additional puzzle pairs, such as opposites!  I love the Eeboo products!

product_title: Fisher-Price Laugh & Learn Fun with Friends Musical Table
review_body:
I cannot say enough good things about this table. We started using it when my daughter was about 4.5-5 mo. old and haven't stopped yet (at 12 mo). She absolutely LOVES it to this day. She learned to pull herself up on it very early (6 mo) and is now walking- and has been since 9 months! I attribute a lot of that to her wanting to play with this table.

It is fun, interactive, and she loves opening and closing the laptop part... we never had a problem with pinching as others suggested, it isn't very heavy and doesn't auto close so it is fine when it closes on hands.

Honestly, I feel bad for buying OTHER toys since this one was the best- and we also had 2 other tables... and she constantly went to this one, so I feel like I can give this a pretty good review.

The only bad thing is that it does slide if you apply a lot of pressure to it (like an excited 8 mo old) and since we had hardood floors this was an issue, we got creative with sticky dots, etc. and now it is 100%. =D

Overall- don't read any more reviews... just buy it! You won't regret it.

product_title: Schylling Color Changing Top
review_body: I was quite disappointed to find that the red and blue \\"handle\\" of this toy is made out of plastic ...  Since it is such a classic toy and is partially tin, I had expected the other parts to be a higher quality and perhaps to be made out of wood.  I don't think I would have ordered it if I had realized beforehand that about 70% or so of this toy is plastic... It just feels cheap.  Love the concept, hate the plastic.

product_title: First Toddle® for Boys, the 5-in-1 Play, Entertainment and Development System
review_body: This is not at all for a baby with any strength.  My daughter can pull the blue straps right off and the nets do not stay on the little goal at the edge.  It's not much for the price.  She like it for one day and hasn't crawled to it since....too much money for too little product.

product_title: Lalaloopsy Fashion Pack - Pajama
review_body: I bought this for my 5 yr old granddaughter.  She absolutely loves these dolls and their outfits.  She plays with them by the hour.

product_title: Leapfrog Tag Storage Case - Pink
review_headline: Good, sturdy case for your child's TAG books
review_body: We like the TAG case, ours is the pink one, which our daughter loves. The case is made out of a thick plastic, that will (we know this from experience) withstand the weight of a 40lb child standing on it, although I don't really recommend trying this out. The hinges come down from the top of the case, and slide into grooves on the bottom of the case, and yes, they pull apart if your kid is really yanking on it, but they pop right back in with no problem. The case holds six books plus has a little spot for the pen, which is nice, because otherwise it would rattle around in there. For us, it was a good purchase, we bought it for $14 and I feel like we got our money's worth. Yeah, you could just buy a zip pouch for it, that's true, but if it gets stepped on, or something spilled on it, you'll wish you'd sprung for the plastic case, because your TAG pen will be ruined, and that's no fun for anyone.

product_title: ALEX Toys Ready, Set, Go! Red Trike
review_body: We had an older trike before with push bar, which had no foot rest. When my 15 mo old would try to ride it, he would get off of it after a few minutes, because his legs got tired from dangling (can't reach the pedals). I purchased this for him so that he could comfortably ride until he was old enough (and strong enough) to pedal. Yes, is is somewhat like a stroller for now, but he likes it more. Now we can ride it to the park and back. It was easy to assamble (Alex's website has video instructions) and the sun canopy is very helpful too. Some people said it was all plastic. Don't listen to them. It has thick, but light metal frame only the accessories and the seat is made of plastic. My 4.5yrs old can ride it well too. I love that the push bar can be extended for taller people, but my nanny can push it too who is 5'2\\". Colorful and fun, this trike will be used for many years and more.

product_title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: Super DX Plush - Kaworu Nagisa
review_body: I love this plush, it's big and soft. Very well made and just plain adorable!! my mom doesn't even watch anime but she liked it a lot, also my little cousins were marveled by this cute little guy. Even if you're not an anime lover/EVA fan, this plush would be a great item for your room. As for me this is perfect because Im a huge fan of Kaworu, wish they could make one of Shinji as well.

product_title: Schleich 4 x 4 Vehicle with Driver
review_body: My 9 year old daughter is a big horse lover. We have purchased many Breyer products for her. We are very diligent in telling her to be careful with them, but alas some of broken or been damaged. This past Christmas, we took a chance on Schleich vehicles and fence. We already had some of the horses. The SUV, trailer, fence, and crates we bought are outstanding, fit the horses and other Schleich animals perfectly, and are STURDY! My 5 year old daughter now joins in the fun and we don't have to worry about anything breaking. We also don't have to give up the quality of the look of the horses. They are very well done.

product_title: Fisher-Price Sesame Street Silly Sounds Remote
review_headline: If your baby/toddler loves remotes, get this!
review_body: My one year-old nephew has loved gadgets for most of his young life. He has been trying to pry people's cell phones or remote controls from their hands for as long as I can recall. I got this toy remote control for his first birthday, and it is a hit! He still likes \\"real\\" devices, but he enjoys this one, too, and he can put it in his mouth and drool on it to his heart's content!

product_title: Disney Tangled Rapunzel Deluxe Story Bag
review_body: My 5-yr-old granddaughter is a big Rapunzel fan & she loves this set. The figures are not very big, though, & she is very careful to keep them all together. However, the price I paid was $21.99 & I see that it is now $37.50! I would NEVER have paid this much for this toy.

product_title: TY Beanie Baby - BERNIE the St. Bernard Dog
review_headline: Baby St. Bernard Cute as it can be
review_body: Cute as it can be.  We own a real 165 lb. St. Bernard and our 3 year old neighbor girl thinks he's great so when her baby sister was born we got her a baby Toby for her to take care of.  She loves it.

product_title: Harry Potter Tomy Interactive Lights Sounds InfraRed Battling Wand Hermione Granger
review_body: This is great.  Looks realistic (for plastic).  If you are looking for a toy, this is what you want.  If you are looking for something more authentic then buy the replica.  Got this one because it makes noise and battles other wands.

product_title: Bubble Light
review_body: It can get a litle messy because you have to dip the front piece in bubble soultion.  I did not let the kids do this inside.  I did do it for them.  I am not all too interested in the light part.  When the batteries run low, you will get bubble soultion slpatter not bubbles.  For what I paid I am okay with the product.

product_title: Radio Flyer 32 All-Terrain Steel and Wood Wagon
review_body: I remember my wagon was a favorite toy as a child, which is why I decided to purchase one for my son as an early present. I shopped for a few weeks and read hundreds of reviews. The decision was between this wagon and the Radio Flyer Big Red Classic ATW which both appear to be durable, well designed wagons that stay true to the beautiful classic style little red wagon. Radio Flyer All Terrain Wagons have pneumatic tires, which is a requirement for anyone who wants to use this wagon going to the beach, camping, outdoor concerts, etc. I didn't want to be stuck if there was a rocky hill to climb, sandy road or if there was a muddy path to cross. The wooden side walls are nice and high enough to keep both my son and Brussels Griffon in the wagon safely. I did read that some users felt they were weak, however, I think you can replace the wooden slats if required fairly easily with a short trip to your local home improvement store. Personally I think the slats will hold up well and allow for good air circulation. I like the oversize wagon base, as there is enough room for a small cooler, the baby and a few toys/small diaper bag. I will be putting a child sized sleeping bag or soft cushion and a boppy in the wagon for added comfort. We received the wagon 2 business days using super saver shipping which was awesome. My husband was able to assemble the wagon in 15 minutes with a screwdriver and wrench. We look forward to many years of enjoying this wagon.

product_title: 1:24 FORD MUSTANG SHELBY GT-500 2007
review_body: I ordered what appeared in the ad as a red Shelby. I GOT A WHITE ONE. There was no where to specify a color, so I new there was some risk, bit for goodness sake the ad showed a red one.

product_title: OTC - Kid's Coloring Books 5" x 7" - Great Party Favors!
review_headline: It's cheap, it's a coloring book
review_body: SO, this is not what you normally think of when you think of a coloring book, but at about $0.50 each these are great to stuff in a party gift bag.  They're more like coloring pamphlets, but they also have hilarious pictures and you can color them, 'nuff said.

product_title: Bendomino: Dominoes with a Twist! Tile Game
review_body: Fun game. New twist on dominos. Easy for younger family members to play because of the colors. Helps teach colors, numbers and addition.

product_title: Ty Baby Pups - Pink Dog Baby Pups - Pink Dog
review_body: My son gave this little pup to my daughter the day she was born. It has been her most favorite lovie. She is 20 months old - I need a few of these pups so I can trade them out to wash.  She sleeps with it and carries it where ever she goes.

product_title: Toy Story - Deluxe Woody Hat Adult
review_body: We purchased this hat because the other reviews mentioned that it may be too large.  The costume hats that you can purchase in stores are too small for our 4 year old son.  My son absolutely loves it.  This hat is a little big on him, but not so much that it falls over his eyes.  He has enough room to grow.

product_title: Lord of the Rings
review_body:
Been looking for this for a while and just managed to find it at a local thrift store for under a buck, and after playing a few times, am really enjoying it.

This is a hobby type cooperative boardgame where all the players work as a team to defeat the board. This concept takes a little getting used to. If you are a casual gamer, you might find a pretty steep learning curve. That might be reflected in the lower reviews.

However, I played this game with my 6-year-old, who didn't have any trouble following along or having fun. She wasn't able to determine when to strategically play cards, so we had her play her cards on the table to \\"help\\" her. She also plays the cooperative \\"Forbidden Island\\", to give you an idea of her experience level.

Also, the game is notoriously difficult to win. It comes with a \\"Hall of Fame\\" sheet to track your scores because you will not be winning all that often. Think of it like a video game- you get better at it and get closer to the end, and there's a real thrill in beating the final boss.

If you can find a used copy of this game and know what to expect, it's a fun recreation of the books and the movies. Just keep in mind it's got more depth and difficulty than mass produced games.

product_title: Diggin Skuut Metal Balance Bike
review_body: We bought this off another website for our just turned 4 year old.  It is cold where we live so our little one only got to use it the first day and maybe one more day over the course of a couple weeks.  Two weeks after purchase she is riding her bicycle.  It is amazing!  She was able to pedal before with training wheels or a tricycle, but balance was the one thing holding her back.  I cannot believe that after a couple hours of using this she is riding her bike...and at 4!

product_title: LeapFrog SpongeBob SquarePants Fists of Foam Learning Game (works with LeapPad Tablets & LeapsterGS)
review_headline: Too much fighting not enough math
review_body: The characters are fun but the math is minimal.  And I don't know why there's all this fighting in this game; it seems very different from the image I have of spongebob.  And even the fighting is often too difficult at one point in the game for my six and eight year olds and they ask for adult help.  And then there's very little educational value.  I don't recommend this game.

product_title: Scooby-Doo Fun Fur Throw [48 x 60 Inches]
review_body: I bought these for my daughters who collect Scooby doo.  When she saw what she got my daughter did a happy dance.  Very warm and soft and cuddly, just what everyone wants to hold on to.  All the other kids were wanting one too.  Really a great buy.

product_title: Twirl N Top Pizza Shop
review_body:
The recommended ages on this toy said 3+, so I borrowed two of my nieces - aged 3 and 7. The seven year old had a blast. She figured out how everything worked and loved shaping the dough, grating the cheese and molding the toppings. The three year old needed help, as she had a little difficulty with the cheese grater and with getting the toppings out of their molds.

The wonderful thing about this set is that it encourages imagination and creativity. The girls loved playing 'pizza parlor,' and seemed lost in their own world. The set is sturdy, well made and brightly colored, so it held up well to a lot of play. The first pizza was perfect and even though the dough tended to get mixed together after that, the girls still seemed to enjoy playing with it.

Overall, we liked this set very much. There were a couple of minor drawbacks, but they weren't fun-wreckers: the pizza cutter jams all of the colors together, so if yours are the kind of kids who like to keep their colors separate, it's best not to cut the pizza. Also, the cheese grater was a little finicky and we got some dough stuck in the bottom that was a little hard to get out. Neither of those things kept us from enjoying this set.

product_title: Gabriella Guardian Angel Plush Teddy Bear by Bearington
review_body: I bought this bear for an embellishment on a baby shower wishing well.  Very pretty and I especially liked the \\"Angels watching over you\\" pillow.

product_title: Bandai Hobby #01 Strike Gundam 1/144 Seed Action Figure
review_headline: Good for beginners; But look for another version
review_body: The No Grade 1/144 Strike is a very basic model kit that I would almost recommend for beginners, if I didn't know about better options. This model, as I said, is very basic; 2 parts for arms, 2 parts for legs, a body and a head. Doesn't move around much and it's only in 3 colors, basic as it gets. It can look fantastic with a bit of paint, just like in the photo or in the shows...BUT, if you really want a cheap Strike gundam, I suggest looking for the Buster/Sword versions. You'll get the exact same parts you see in the photo of this model kit, as well as the parts to make the Sword or Gun-wielding varients seen in the show, for the exact same, if not a better price. This one's not bad, but, certainly you can do better?

product_title: Cuddlee Pet Pillow Turtle 15"
review_body: I bought this as a gift for a friend of mine who loves turtles.  I figured it couldn't hurt to get a cheap knockoff of a pillow pet instead of the real thing.  I just opened it, and it is smaller than the real ones, but I was expecting that and knew it ahead of time.  The material is soft, no holes/rips, but it is a tad under stuffed.  My poor turtle has a tail that is about 2-3 inches to the side of where it should be though (basically, his tail is coming out of his thigh instead of his bottom when he's folded up).  I thought it was rather hilarious actually, and think my friend will be amused by it as well when she sees it.      Overall, it is cute, very cuddly, and unique.  I am very pleased with it, and highly amused!

product_title: First Orchard: My Very First Games
review_body: i bought this game for my niece's second birthday.  she likes it very much and the whole family has played it together.  it's a great introduction to colors, counting, matching and turn taking.  my daughter just turned two and i'm thinking about getting one for her, too!  great educational toy!

product_title: Nerf N-Strike Barricade RV-10
review_body: This nerf gun is a bit disappointing due its lack of power and the noise of the flywheels. The darts are fired by two spinning flywheels in-front of the revolver chamber. They don't spin fast enough to get any good range out of it and it has to be constantly on. This drains the battery really fast and is rather noisy in comparison to any other gun in stand-by.    After some mod's, this gun is usable for battles. Connected the pressure switch in the gun to spool the flywheels when the trigger is pulled rather then having it always on. Changed the motor and gearing for next-to-instant max speed speed on the flywheels which also increased the speed speed and firing power.     On the plus sides, right out of the box, its a great gun for anyone of any age. No priming mechanism means it doesn't need to be pump'ed, cocked, or primed. Easy access to the dart barrel so its easy to load, although it does take some time since it holds 10 shots. Its easy to use and good for younger people.     I'd recommend it as a gun for younger people, but not for serious fire fights until  after many power improving mods.

product_title: Urahara Kisuke Hat
review_headline: Great Hat at an Affordable Price
review_body: Overall, it's great.   Good solid construction, and it doesn't feel like it's gonna fall apart for a long time.   It's 100% Cotton, and has a nice texture and feel to it. Others have complained that it's colors don't match those of the anime, but it isn't as bad as it's made out to be, and any Bleach fan will recognize it right away.  It's a little snug on me, but doesn't feel like it's squeezing the life out of me.  I highly recommend this to fans of Bleach, or for those in the market for a unique hat.

product_title: Syma S107/S107G R/C Helicopter *Colors Vary
review_headline: This is a fun (and solid) purchase!
review_body: What a fun engineering feat!  This thing is perfect little flying machine.  Like everyone else has said, it's about as simple to fly as possible.  Not only that, but unlike the competitors, it has six-way control...and it is as intuitive as a video game.  No more lame four-way controls that only turn right.    If you don't have fun with this inexpensive (but quality) helicopter, no one can help you! :)

product_title: Halo 3 Deluxe Master Chief Mask Adult
review_body: I wish the people who make Halo toys took the same pride in their work that the game designers did.   For it's price, the quality of this helmet is disappointing and leaves me feeling like I my son was ripped off (he used a gift certificate for this). I read the reviews and warned him it could break, so he was warned. But he loves it anyway.    It broke within minutes after being taken out of the box.  Perhaps the problem is with poor package design and damage that occurs during shipping. The left side light fell off then snapped when it hit the floor. I might be able to super glue it back together.

product_title: Syma S107/S107G R/C Helicopter *Colors Vary
review_body: My first helicopter great for indoors very durable to crashing and doesn't hurt to bad when you get clipped by the blades.  Only downside is infer red controlled, remotes and other helicopters interfere easily with it. Theres only too settings for  the controls and its hard to get them to not run the same. I bought 5 of these for family and it was a nightmare trying to run them we had to do 2 at a time of course but any time we switched we had to mess with them a while to get them on different freqs and simply switching the button on the controller didn't work.

product_title: Bachmann Trains 0 Scale Water Tower
review_body: I do not have anything good to say about this item.  It looks nothing like what is pictured.  The roof and the girders/pillars are molded in brown, while the body of the water tower is molded in gray.  Even worse, the whole assembly is very flimsy and will not stay together.  Even after applying airplane glue in various places, it still comes apart at the slightest touch.  At over $14.00 in price, you should get far more for your money.  I will not buy anything else from this line of accessories.

product_title: Beechwood Veneer 0.4" Go Table Board Goban
review_body: Excellent for teaching my 6 year old granddaughter the basics and the squares are large enough for my go stones and the board is good looking .

product_title: Crayola Glow Station Day & Night
review_body: My son got the Glow Station, night time only, last year for Christmas and it was a huge hit.  He saw an ad for the day and night on TV and wanted it for this Christmas.  The TV ad is completely misleading! The picture on the box is misleading! The daytime blue line is barely visible and completely disappointing. My son was so frustrated by it that we had to put it away before he started crying. If you are considering this product, buy the Night time only version, it is tons of fun and a real crowd pleaser. Don't bother with the day version, it is useless.

product_title: Bop It Bounce
review_headline: Buy Batteries...and Avoid Ball Loving Dogs!
review_body: Fun version of the old-fashioned paddle-ball game. What I like...active, challenging and addictive fun. Pretty much it is what it says it is, so no surprises. What I didn't like, the Bop It voice is kind of annoying. And I'd recommend rechargeable batteries and not playing around dogs who love chasing and chewing balls!

review_body: Absolutely no instructions.  Put soap in, it just leaks out, put water in with it (? I don't know, once again no instructions) and that leaks out too.  Don't get it.

product_title: Power Wheels Kawasaki KFX with Monster Traction
review_body: 2 year-old-grandson's birthday gift was a hit with he and his 6-year-old brother! Came just in time for the birthday right to my door. Easy to assemble, according to Papa

I will admit it took a few minutes to understand the rules of the game and it was a little frustrating at first, but once we got the hang of it, it went well. product_title: PURRZ - cat
review_body: We have had Tig (in his heart of hearts, he's a tiger even if he's in a kitten's body) as a member of our fmaily for 4 years now and while he does have a few body doubles here at the house, he is without a doubt a durable toy that has been there for many hours of play, love, and imagination.  Tig has never had surgery of any kind but we do rotate Tig out so that he and all his body doubles are equally loved.  Tig LOVES coffee but is a bit of a snob and prefers Starbucks (though any will do in a bind), he loves spaghetti, and driving the car (but he is only allowed to drive the first mile from home).  Well worth the investment we made years ago!

product_title: Webkinz Koala Bear
review_body: I am so happy with my purchase of the Webkinz Koala Bear. The price was extremely reasonable, the bear arrived in perfect condition, the mailing process was easy and just as was guaranteed!  The bear will be used as a mascot for a group of 5th & 6th graders that I will be taking to Australia this coming summer. THEY LOVED THE IDEA AND OUR NEW MASCOT!  Thank you!

Her hair is perfectly styled and the curls are sewn in place to stay nice, the only thing that really bothered the girls was the umbrella not being a working little umbrella, but I would absolutely still buy it knowing that now.

product_title: Fisher-Price Shake 'n Go! XTREME Speedway

If you have the chance to get the \\"frustration free packaging\\", do it. It was soooo much nicer and easier... plus recyclable. Would definitely recommend.

product_title: Star Wars - Saga Collection George Lucas: Stormtrooper (Ultimate Galactic Hunt) (UGH Mailaway)

Keep it in its clear case and even the box to avoid light or air degrading the quality of the card. So for fun it gets 4 stars because its fun to know you have Georgy-Porgey dressed as a Stormy. As for educational value, 5 stars as it shows you how now matter what someone in Hollywood preaches, they will sell out everything about themselves.

product_title: Cow Pet Pillow 18" Plush Stuffed Animal
review_body: A cow pillow pet was hard to find, but my teenage daughter wanted one for her bed. She loves cows and her pillow pet.

product_title: Rummikub -- The Original Rummy Tile Game
review_body: Rummikub has been a favorite game in our family for many years. It continues to be a well-made, durable product. All ages can enjoy playing Rummikub.

product_title: Little Tikes Endless Adventures Jr Play Slide
review_body: We received the slide quicker than I expected, and since we've set it up for our son who is a little over 2 years old, he has taken only short breaks in between playing on it.  He loves it!!!  The only problem we had was getting the safety brace in place that is under slide so that it doesn't collapse in on him, but it just took a little more effort than we expected.  Other than that I can't complain, I feel like this was a great buy!

product_title: Agricola (Discontinued by manufacturer)
review_body: This is an interesting game for competitors with varying strategies.  There is no one way to win.  The rules are fairly complex, but once you understand, the game flows well.

product_title: Syma S107/S107G R/C Helicopter *Colors Vary
review_headline: Back to being a kid again!
review_body:
I'm probably the last person to be getting such a device. I'm a 24-year-old male saving for a wedding, house, and paying off a car, but with all the rave reviews, I decided to jump the gun and get this ONE toy.
Flying RC devices never piqued my interest, and I always thought they were a gimmick when I saw them at mall kiosks. Sure, they were cool, but never something I saw myself interested with for more than a few minutes.

When I placed the order, the only color showing was red, but to my great pleasure, a blue one arrived! It is indeed a varying color option that you sort of no way of knowing which color you'd get, and to ensure a blue one on Amazon.com I had to spend an extra $30 (when I bought mine; now it looks like they reduced the price), so I was intently hoping for a blue one, which I got.

I rushed home and opened it. I wasn't sure what exactly to do when starting it up, but it was louder than expected. Because I've never flown a toy before, I didn't realize how unsteady it was, and mine was constantly leaning right. I then realized the knob on the communicator (is that the name of the control?) was slightly right, so I adjusted it straight and voila! No more angling.
It takes a while to control it perfectly, but when it does, it's a lot of fun. It's rather noisy, so don't go expecting to sneak up on people with it. It's very responsive, though, and the longevity of battery life (about 5 minutes) doesn't disappoint.

product_title: Dinosaur wallet from Stephen Joseph
review_body: My son loves having his own wallet.  The dinosaur is so cute and the wallet is the perfect size for a young child.

product_title: Micro Machines Wheel Works Double Takes Transforming Playset
review_headline: I miss Micro Machines! FUN FUN FUN
review_body:
Micro Machines were tiny plastic toy vehicles, much smaller than Hot Wheels at about 1.5 inches long. They were made by the Galoob toy company in the 1980's and 1990's. The cars were usually sold in a 4 pack of related vehicles. They included civilian cars, truck, boats, planes, construction vehicles, and military equipment. They had unusual items like spacecraft, monster trucks, hang glider, surfers, all kinds of things. They also had franchise agreements to make toys for different movies and shows such as James Bond, Star Wars, Star Trek, Indian Jones, Predator, Terminator, Aliens, Babylon 5 and more. They made plastic heads the size of a shoe, that opened up into a related playset, such as a Yoda head that turned into the Dagobah swamp, or a Race Car helmet that transformed into a race track. The Galoob designers were very original and creative, and designed some of my favorite toys ever. In 1999 Galoob was the 3rd largest toy manufacturer in the USA, and competitor Hasbro purchased them in 1999. The new owners promptly shut down production of many of the Galoob toys including Micro Machines, and sold off the inventory. You can occasionally see the Micro Machines name on Star Wars toys, or toys sold overseas but they are gon for now. This makes the old sets, especially those that are still new in the box, very collectible. Now that the kids that owned them in the 1980's are growing up, the price can only go up on the collectibles market.

As for the playset on this page, it is part of the Double-Takes playset series, which were twice the fun. This model was made only in 1995 and is quite rare now. The concept is, you have an interactive playset for your Micro Machines cars, boats, construction vehicles, etc. Then with a few changes, it transforms into a totally different playset. In this example called \\"Wheelworks\\", you have an auto factory with smokestack, moving conveyor, ramps, car elevator and more. Push the smokestack down and lift the side and it transforms into a super test track with a race car and two pit crew figures. Figures are very rare in a Micro Machines playset, so this is a treat. It is a fairly big set as Micro Machine playsets go, not as big as the Super Auto World, but fairly big. The box is 15 x 11 x 3.5, but the set is much bigger when assembled. Once you put it together for the first time, it will not fit in the box again. A great toy, and I wish they still made these today.rms into a super test track with a race car and two pit crew figures. Figures are very rare in a Micro Machines playset, so this is a treat. It is a fairly big set as Micro Machine playsets go, not as big as the Super Auto World, but fairly big. The box is 15 x 11 x 3.5, but the set is much bigger when assembled. Once you put it together for the first time, it will not fit in the box again. A great toy, and I wish they still made these today.

product_title: Play-Doh Elmo Shape and Spin Playset
review_body: The toy is a great idea in theory, but it has several flaws in the design.    Pros:  Interchangeable impression discs with Elmo, Big Bird, and Cookie Monster's faces  Comes with three small containers of Play Doh  Recognizable shapes as well as others such as a pentagon, hexagon, and octagon.  Elmo talks when you press the button  A play mat with shapes for matching  Entertained my daughter    Cons:  Doesn't cut shapes well and Elmo's hands are hard to press all the way down  The release button (with an imprint of Dorothy the fish) doesn't always line up with the rotating shapes which don't lock into place well  No place to store the interchangeable discs  Elmo bust isn't firmly affixed to the base and tips over when pressing down the hands (This is the most annoying problem.)    Verdict:  Save your money and buy some shape cookie cutters to use with your Play-Doh.

product_title: Tron's Kevin Flynn Deluxe Identity Disc
review_headline: Tron's Kevin Flynn Deluxe Identity Disc
review_body:
OK - so I bought it -Why? because of old memories
it's nothing like the original Identy Disc from the original movie
it's not a toy - it's a shelf display item

and as usuual remakes never live up to memories of the original movie

worth seeing the movie - but I am so glad I didn't try to see it at midnite when it first opened

product_title: Iron Man Arc Light and Mask Set
review_headline: It's Iron Man!  Is there anything else cooler?
review_body: Well, this was just the coolest gift as far as my 4 year old son is concerned.  He absolutely loves Iron man and together with those arm things, this made the perfect surprise!  I even bought an Iron Man costume that was on clearance to complete the ensemble.  Too cute!

product_title: Green Toys Tea Set
review_body:
My four year old mostly non-speaking daughter (she has apraxia) has come alive with this little set (as well as the cooking set) from Green Toys. She's finally started saying \\"tea\\", \\"cup\\", \\"sugar\\", \\"milk\\", and although that wouldn't be a big deal to a parent with a child who can speak, for me it is amazing because every new word is a blessing.

Although the tea pot does leak when filled, that's a non-issue since we do real tea in an actual tea pot and play pretend only with her toys because she gets frustrated by messes when she can't communicate that she has what equates to a national disaster in her world.

The set holds up really well and they're easy to clean when she does decide to use actual food or liquids.

Mostly, it's been enjoyable to watch her go from signing only to attempting to say the words that help her play with her tea set.

product_title: Thomas & Friends: Thomas Goes to the Fair - 60 Piece Puzzle
review_headline: Great puzzle . . . until the end when you realize there's a missing piece or 2!
review_body: This was a gift for our 4 year old son.  He loves working with this puzzle.  We were so proud the first time he sat quietly and worked diligently to put it together.  It took him longer than his usual lower-count puzzles, but it wasn't too difficult.  The only negative is that it's missing a piece or 2 and it's brand new out of the box.  That was disheartening.

product_title: Illuminated Mega Sudoku Puzzle Game
review_body: This was a gift for my dad. He has recently gotten into Sudoku big time, and this is great for him, as it has various levels of difficulty.

product_title: Uncle Bob's 54" Circuit Round Snow Tube
review_body: I got mine from \\"e b surf and ski\\".  My experience with the tube was the same as reported by the other reviewers... product_title: Monopoly
review_headline: This version turns Monopoly into the  Mediterranean Avenue of board games
review_body:
Please feel free to read this review in its entirety, or save yourself some time and avoid this version of Monopoly and buy the \\"Monopoly - Classic\\" version instead. While it is about double the price, it is the game you know and love. The less expensive version (reviewed here) is a piece of garbage.

I regret this purchase. If you grew up playing Monopoly, you would be much, much better off buying \\"classic\\" or a used version. There are several major issues with this version, as well as some minor ones. If you buy this to teach your children one of the most beloved games of your childhood and a part of Americana, you are apt to be disappointed.

The major issues involve quality and design. The board itself no longer folds in two. It is cut to fold into quarters and barely sits level on a table. I do not hold out much hope it will last very long. The property cards are flimsy, made smaller than in the past, as well as being thinner. The Chance and Community Chest cards are also of poor quality, much thinner than their predecessors, and take on color changes, now being blue/white and orange/white, instead of the familiar yellow and orange, respectively.

The money is a big concern as well. The money is thin and there are not enough slots provided to use money in the bank during play, or to store after gameplay, and in fact there are raised areas in the plastic money tray which prevent the money from even sitting in the spaces. The raised areas are somewhat random and follow no logical pattern. So forget using the box/tray component for the bank during a game or storing money neatly. The tray is essentially useless. I have no idea what Hasbro/Parker Brothers was thinking here, and apparently neither did they.

The minor issues are some game changes: The money is different color and handed out in different amounts. Very minor, yes, but now you have to get used to $10 being blue (used to be the $50) as well as some other color changes. You are also starting the game with different amounts of money. Also the Income Tax space is now a flat $200 instead of \\"10% or $200\\", and Luxury Tax is $100, no longer $75. Again, these are minor but worth noting.

I would avoid this cheaply made version. At the very least this should be advertised as what it is - \\"revamped Monopoly.\\"also starting the game with different amounts of money. Also the Income Tax space is now a flat $200 instead of \\"10% or $200\\", and Luxury Tax is $100, no longer $75. Again, these are minor but worth noting. I would avoid this cheaply made version. At the very least this should be advertised as what it is - \\"revamped Monopoly.\\"

review_headline: It's just ok but it depends on what you are hoping your child will get out of it.
review_body: I purchsed this toy as a gift for my 3 year old for Christmas....    PROS: It is pretty durable, she dropped it several times within the first few days of having it and it still functions really well.  The applications are easy to use (once you download them). I like the fact that it does entertain children for a time. My daughter likes it for listening to music and coloring.It is easy for a child to use and my daughter quickly learned how to navigate through the apps.     CONS: The toy requires you to purchase different \\"software\\" but I feel they all do the same thing.  It comes pre-loaded with one and I purchased a second one, the only difference between the 2 different softwares are the music and pictures for the children to color. The coloring is unrealistic and doesn't allow them to actually practice having control and staying in the lines. It is a WASTE of money to buy too much software for the toy.  Speaking of software I dont like that EVERYTHING is done on your computer.  I had some trouble installing the software and I had to wait until my daughter went to sleep to do anything. The touch screen is rather sensitive and when my daughter attempts the write her numbers/ letters or color the screen changes every easily.  .  This is not nearly as educational as I thought it would be, as a teacher I'd hope this toy would reinforce some of the basic things I am teaching my daughter as well as provide her with writing, and coloring practice. I am disappointed because I thought it would almost be a combination of her tag reader, her scribble and write and a music player with extra applications but it isnt what I expected it to be.  If you dont get her hopes you you wont be disappointed I think I will get a Leapster to add to the \\"playful educational toy \\" collection especially since I wont have to change everything on the computer with a Leapster.

product_title: Ravensburger Mystery Garden - Children's Game
review_body: Pros: easy to learn, interesting for wide range of ages  Cons: possible to memorize the game after a while    My six-year-old daughter got this game for Christmas. It was fast and easy to set up, and the rules are very simple and understandable - each player draws a card that has a small picture on it. Each of the pictures are somewhere on the game board. Players ask yes or no questions to try to figure out the picture on the card, which the first player answers. Each time a question is asked, a peg is moved so that the number of questions can be counted. If the picture is not correctly guessed after a certain number of questions, the first player keeps the card for a point. The first player to three points wins.    Our six-year-old caught on to the game after a few rounds and really enjoyed the challenge of asking and answering questions. Our three-year-old daughter struggled a little with the Q&A, but that is to be expected. For that age, it would probably be better to have the children asking questions (that could be more than just yes or no) and an adult answering questions. I can imagine that several six-year-old players would be able to play this game without help from an adult. If someone played it long enough, it would be possible to memorize the pictures and work out a question list that would guarantee that you guess each picture with a minimum number of questions. That would take a fair amount of time and effort, so I doubt that will be a problem for most players.
