product_title: Werewolves of Millers Hollow
review_body:
Bought this game after watching a group of 12 or so teens play it intensely for a couple hours. Game has a simple narrative structure: town invaded by werewolves and every night (players close their eyes) the werewolves decide one team member they \\"kill\\" who is then out of the game. Everyone \\"wakes up\\" and votes someone off the island, so to speak, trying to target the werewolves and rid themselves of them. But since the werewolves look like ordinary friends and neighbors during the day, it becomes tricky to figure out who is mortal and who werewolf. The game itself is a pack of cards which are dealt out all around. Some cards provide special powers (the \\"little girl\\" card allows its holder to peek while the werewolves are meeting--but the holder has to be careful not to be caught peeking) and these add to the suspense and intrigue.

After we purchased it we played with another family whose kids are the same ages as ours--mostly teens. They have one younger son--about 10--for whom it was a bit of a challenge. He wanted to protect his mom and favorite sister at all costs and wasn't really able to be objective about who might really be a werewolf (his mom). So I think there are age limits on the game. Since we have bought this game, the kids grab it first when they head out to parties at their friends' houses, since it is a big favorite.

We have purchased the add-on game, but since the game requires a rather large crowd (8 player minimum)we have not yet had the chance to try it out--only 5 in our family. It appears to make the game a bit more advanced, with additional roles, possibilities, and cards. In looking it over, it seemed it would be perfect for a crowd who had some experience with Werewolves and wanted to ramp up the action.

Very fun, entertaining, smart game. If you've got teens in the house--they'll love this.

product_title: LEGO Portable Storage Case with Baseplate 2856205
review_headline: A must-have for kids who love Legos!
review_body:
Let me start off by saying honey, do *not* buy these online for $25 plus shipping. It's a plastic box. I found these exact same Lego boxes at Walmart for $9, base plate included. The boxes themselves are Iris brand and are available at most craft stores for $5. This one's cute, though, since it's a pretty color and has the Lego guy's head on it.

To get on with the actual review - the box itself is fantastic. It's a nice wide size so you can fit a base plate and a whole mess of Legos in it, the top is hinged and clips in front and is secure but still easy enough for a kid to use. My son is seven and has no problem latching and unlatching this box. It's not particularly deep so tall creations in progress may not fit - Iris makes other deeper boxes that work great for this purpose. This hinged box fits inside of the deeper boxes, which is awesome for keeping things consolidated.

I can't really go on much more about it because it is just a plastic box, but it's durable and easy to use and it helps keep my childrens' Legos from being permanently scattered all over the floor. It's a good size for them, too, with a built-in handle for carrying. Get yourself one or three!

product_title: Say Anything
review_headline: No game collection is complete without it!
review_body:
I got this for my birthday a few months ago. We have had an absolute blast playing it with family. It's a great game to play with people who know you well, and it would also make a great ice-breaker game for a first-time game night with new friends!

A question is read by the reader, and all others race to write down the answer the reader would most likely pick. Only the first four answers get used, so there is a time limit to beat everyone else! Once the answers are all written, the reader picks his favorite selection on a wheel then places it face-down. Now everyone gets a chance to score points by placing small coins on the answer they think the reader selected! Once all coins are placed, the reader reveals his answer and points are counted! Then the next player reads his question and the fun continues!

It's fun to also have the reader reveal how he would have answered the question at the end of the turn. It's a great way to get to know people better, whether you've known them forever or not!

This is our favorite game now and is requested every time we head somewhere for a game night. It's family-friendly and clean, but also fun and fast-paced. One round is never enough! I love how it is personalized and contains answers from us!

I highly suggest you get this game and quickly!

product_title: Fisher-Price Smart Cycle Racer [Old Version - Discontinued]
review_headline: perfect for hand eye coordination/ entertainment
review_body: My 3-yr old son recieved this as a gift for Christmas and he loves it! If I let him, he would play this all day. First the cons of the toy... 1) it runs on batteries which seems like a poor design. 2) Some may feel the games aren't challenging enough. My 5 yr old likes to play with the Racer as well and the mental challenge isn't there for her. As a matter of fact, its a little under my son as well. A more structured level system would be beneficial. 3) Another reviewer mentioned zero resistance in the pedals and I would agree... even the slightest resistance would be good because 'real' bikes have resistance. I was hoping the Racer would be better exercise for them, and its just so-so. Now the pros... 1) It is a lot of fun for my kids. They play with it more than any other toy. 2) My sons hand eye coordination has greatly improved since he started playing with the Racer. 3) although the graphics aren't high-end, video game quality, they are cute and remind me of video games I loved as a kid. Simplicity is best for the age bracket the toy states on the box anyway. 4) Overall the assembly was easy and the bike seems secure and not cheaply made. Now only if the manufactuer would lower the price of the cartridges... I guess that is was holidays and birthdays are for.

review_body: I built and painted this model over the course of several weeks. Every major seam is well hidden and there is a lot of detail throughout the kit. The clear blue holographic pieces for the legs, arms, chest and head are also a really nice touch. My only complaint is that the spur connections could have been better placed  on the chrome plated pieces.      Articulation: The articulation of this model is really fantastic. The joints have a large range of motion, yet they're still very stiff. Exia has no problem holding the gigantic GN sword over it's head, or in any number of dynamic poses. The feet, hips and ankles also have a good range of motion, but the knees are a bit of a pain to bend.     Color: The molded colors look good right out of the box. product_title: Battle Zone Field Command Military Micro Machines Playset
review_body:
This particular playset was discontinued in 1992 and is very rare now. It is part of the Military series called \\"Battle Zone\\". This model is the Field Command playset. It is a Command Post that includes 1 M551 Sheridan Tank and 1 Humvee, and 3 troops. Later sets had only one vehicle, if that. It has a bunker the tank can hide in and shoot from, sandbag position on the roof, revolving radar dish, and more. Road through desert like landscape with a hidden land mine that flips the vehicle over. Nice way to display your military miniature vehicles. You can find more vehicles at Amazon if you do a search, and they have them used at garage sales, flea markets, and auction sites.

Micro Machines were tiny plastic toy vehicles, much smaller than Hot Wheels at about 1.5 inches long. They were made by the Galoob toy company in the 1980's and 1990's. The cars were usually sold in a 4 pack of related vehicles. They included civilian cars, truck, boats, planes, construction vehicles, and military equipment. They had unusual items like spacecraft, monster trucks, hang glider, surfers, all kinds of things. They also had franchise agreements to make toys for different movies and shows such as James Bond, Star Wars, Star Trek, Indian Jones, Predator, Terminator, Aliens, Babylon 5 and more. They made plastic heads the size of a shoe, that opened up into a related playset, such as a Yoda head that turned into the Dagobah swamp, or a Race Car helmet that transformed into a race track. The Galoob designers were very original and creative, and designed some of my favorite toys ever. In 1999 Galoob was the 3rd largest toy manufacturer in the USA, and competitor Hasbro purchased them in 1999. The new owners promptly shut down production of many of the Galoob toys including Micro Machines, and sold off the inventory. You can occasionally see the Micro Machines name on Star Wars toys, or toys sold overseas but they are gone at this time in USA. This makes the old sets, especially those that are still new in the box, very collectible. Now that the kids that owned them in the 1980's are growing up, the price can only go up on the collectibles market. Other really fun sets included the Hyways & Byways series with models like Wildcat Canyon, Colonel Cobbs Farm, Spikes Auto, Big Dady's Drag Strip, On-M-T Gas, Deep Sea Drive-n, Earls Auto Repair, Drawbridge set, Roadbuilders, and so much more.that are still new in the box, very collectible. Now that the kids that owned them in the 1980's are growing up, the price can only go up on the collectibles market. Other really fun sets included the Hyways & Byways series with models like Wildcat Canyon, Colonel Cobbs Farm, Spikes Auto, Big Dady's Drag Strip, On-M-T Gas, Deep Sea Drive-n, Earls Auto Repair, Drawbridge set, Roadbuilders, and so much more.

product_title: Nogglers NG-002 4 Inch Missing Marble
review_headline: You know it's in there;but to get it out.
review_body: Is it simple or difficult?Depends on how patient you are.The concept is simple.There is only one hole.Therefore the marble had to go in there,and it has to come back outthe same hole.Inside there is a maze.To construct the maze,5 holes were drilled into the block,but you don't know if they intersected or not.Then,4 of the holes were plugged,leaving one open.Thus a maze was created.So,the challenge here is to move the block around and feeling the ball move,until it finds the exit hole.When you finally get the ball out,simply drop it back in,rotate the block a few times,then the challenge starts all over again.Challenge yourself on how quickly you can get it out again.

This is a pretty decent set and if you don't want to pay the mega $$ for a wooden set.. this isn't a bad choice at all! I am a former Preschool teacher myself and I would definately put this in a preschool setting as well- they are that durable!

Very Happy with this purchase!

product_title: Blip Squinkies Cupcake Surprise Bakeshop (Recolor)
review_body: My 4 1/2 year old daughter received this for Christmas and really likes it. So does her 2 1/2 year old brother who keeps taking the little squinkies. My daughter loves things that are tiny that she can hold in her hand. I like that you can buy replacement or collectible pieces to go with it. I can see the draw to this toy as my kids love to get gum and prizes from vending machines. We'll see how long the thrill lasts.

product_title: Fisher-Price Disney's Handy Manny Flicker the Flashlight
review_body: Like most of the other reviews state, once you stretch the head off the handle part, it's nearly impossible to get it to click back into place. It is still fully functional though, and our 2.5 year old loves it.

product_title: 4Gr8 Kidz Jungle Series Kids Wooden Table and Storage Chairs Set
review_body: This table is shorter than I had imagined, but, it clearly states that it is only a foot tall.  I have a two year old and he loves it. His older cousin who is about to be four sat comfortably on it as well. The little chairs/ottoman/storage devices are very sturdy, and so is the table. My son sits at the table and will also play at the table on his knees. This is so cute. :)

product_title: Pink Dress with Pink and Blue Lace with Silver Seguins on the Bodice Made to Fit Barbie Doll
review_body: this is a very beautiful soft pink gown.Very well made...i use these dresses to dress my dolls..they are not played with.this one is very princess like...Lovely.B.W.

product_title: Makit Products Inc. Make A Plate
review_body:
I just recently did my 1st make a plate with my 2 boys and my 3 nieces and it was so fun! The kids got to be creative and make something that moms and dads can keep forever, and I do mean FOREVER! I know several members of my in laws family have been doing make a plates for the last 20-25 years and they have a stack of about 10 plates that have been through rigorous use and through the dishwasher a ton and they still look great!

When the kit is purchased it comes with 1 free plate (you do have to pay a $3 processing fee) and then each additional plate that is purchased is $7.95 + $3 processing fee. The kit comes with enough supplies to make 5 different plate templates, just color your picture on the provided paper and mail away the designs. I will also add that when my 5 plates arrived, one of them had a bit of a blister on the top and I was worried that it might affect the durability. I called makit products and they were super friendly and very apologetic, she had a replacement sent to me in less than a week! Great customer service is always a plus!!! I highly recommend this project!

product_title: Fisher-Price Laugh & Learn Smilin' Smart Phone, Black
review_body: I bought this for my daughter because she is constantly grabbing my phone. Not so impressed. The volume is very low (not that every toy should be blaring) but I didn't even know it was on because it's so low. Also it's huge. My tv remote is smaller than this thing. Not that it has to be like a real phone but wasn't expecting it to be so big. I was looking for a small toy to stick in diaper bag. You are better off with that Baby Einstein handheld tunes toy.

product_title: Shippuden Tales Of The Gallant Sage Booster Box (24 Packs)
review_headline: Very bad luck for me this time around...
review_body: I'm loving only about half of the cards I got, not the purveyor's fault, but there seems to be a few flaws in this box.  Mainly that there are some misprints in the box that has one of the Kakashi Hatake cards as a RARE (2 dots), but DOES NOT have a foil name indicating that it is a rare (includes the dots though.  My Itachi Uchiha DOES have the foil NAME, but not the two dots (not supposed to have two dots or foil name).  And no I do not think I'm confusing these rare cards with the SPECIAL ALTERNATIVE ART rares since they announced it would have a RAINBOW FOIL (assumable all around the card).    That being said, I must have bad luck this time around since I found a noticeable amount of duplicates throughout my regular rares and TWO of my super rares...unfortunate; kinda assumed there would be a different super rare in each box, bad luck for me.    Nice set of cards all around and I'm loving the \\"suits.\\"

product_title: Fisher-Price Geotrax Rail and Road System Grand Central Station
review_body: Bought this train set for my grandson's ages 1 1/2 and 3.  Thought the 3 yr old would be the most delighted, but the younger one loved it from day one.  As I write this, my daughter and her 3 yr old son are hard at work reconfiguring the train track for the third time!  I am about to order  more track so they can be more creative.  Love it!

product_title: Wildkin Horse Dreams Messenger Bag - Horse Dreams
review_body: My daughter used this for a couple years in elementary school.  It was perfect.  Too many books in middle school, so she had to part with it as a bookbag.  Now she uses it for overnighters and such.  She still loves it at 11. :)

product_title: LEGO Pirate Code Game (3840)
review_body: I just played this game with my son.  There are several problems with the game:    1. The game play instructions are really skimpy and aren't clear on several of the situations that arise during play.  We just had to \\"wing\\" it as we went along.    2. The game does fall apart easily during play due to some single row overlaping construction. Maybe if we played on a hard surface, instead of the carpeted floor, it might be better.  3. The jewels that you have to handle frequently are very small and difficult to hold on to. You also have to place these jewels in very constricted on the game board.

product_title: Riverstone Goods Women's Soft & Warm Fleece Gloves (Assorted Colors)
review_body: Very thin material, not useful for snow, and truly cold weather. But I bought this for around the office, and it works.

product_title: Quercetti Georello Toolbox, 165 pieces
review_body: I think this is a great toy, the storage box is awesome.  Myson is 4 and can make a few simple gears.  I enjoy building the advanced gears listed in the manual that is included.  A few of the pieces are difficult to attach and take apart which is the only reason I rated the toy a 4 stars.  The toy is well durable and well made.

product_title: Main Blade Assembly Micro Rescue & Micro Ranger
review_body: this part of a helicopter is cheaply made. the same day we got this part, we tried it and it broke immediately. the quality is not good. don't buy it.

product_title: Discovery Kids Digital Photo and Video Camera
review_body: Bought for my 4 year old for Christmas, she only used it for a day! Before it broke! No flash so most of the images taken inside are completely black.

product_title: LEGO Creator Fiery Legend (6751)
review_body: Hard to find-not even available through Lego ! My son spent hours assembling and reassembling-He just loves the 3 in 1 Lego sets!

product_title: How To Train Your Dragon Movie 4 Inch Action Figure Hiccup
review_body: My son was very excited, until the head broke off 1 minute after opening it.  All the wings fall off the dragons contantly as well.

product_title: VTech Kidizoom Camera - 2010 Version
review_headline: Fun, but don't count on printing any pictures
review_body: This is a great toy. I wouldn't call it a camera however, as the pictures this camera takes are horrible.  I went to print a few pics that looked good on the tiny rear screen, however, after looking on the computer, i decided against it.  Again, great toy, but not practical as an actual camera.

product_title: Scooby Doo Mystery Machine Large Backpack
review_body: This backpack is cute and does the job for my school boy! Has been durable and easy to use with plenty of room!

product_title: Give Peace a Chance 1000 Piece Jigsaw Puzzle
review_body: Fun puzzle to do. Worked on it while at the beach with the family. It wasn't easy but kids 13 and up were having fun putting it together. It was so nice my daughter pasted it and hung it up on her wall. Great pictures and it really got us talking about history.

product_title: Melissa & Doug
review_body: This calendar has many preprinted holidays and generic activities.  My son loves arranging it and looking at it to see what the plan is for that day.  There is also a dry erase board where he can write messages or memos.  I would highly recommend this product.

product_title: Air Hogs Blue Sharp Shooter Ch A
review_headline: Overpriced, and Can't buy Replacement Parts
review_body:
The Air Hogs Sharpshooter is a lot of fun to fly. It's a bit tough to trim, especially because the trim changes as the battery charge changes. However, once you get the trim sorted out, the Sharp Shooter flies quite well. Since it's only a 2-channel, it will never hover. By design, it always flies forward. It doesn't fly very fast, so it's great for a beginner.

Luckily, the Sharp Shooter is pretty durable. It took a full month of abuse hitting ceilings, walls, floors, couches, etc. Eventually, things on it started to break. Some can be fixed with epoxy. However, a tiny plastic bar that connects the rotor to the balance bar finally broke off. It could not be epoxied. The helicopter cannot fly without that connection.

That leads to the HUGE DOWNSIDE of owning an Air Hogs Sharp Shooter: You can NOT by replacement parts. None are sold by Spin Master (the manufacturer of Air Hogs). A different companany sells generic replacement rotor heads, but they do not work on the Sharpshooter, so don't waste your money. With no other options to fix my Sharp Shooter, I threw it away.

SHARP SHOOTER PROS
* Charges quickly
* Easy to learn
* A LOT of fun to fly
* Durable, takes a lot of hits lives to fly again

SHARP SHOOTER CONS
* You can NOT buy replacement parts
* It will eventually break - when it does, you might as well throw it away
* As a 2-channel, it cannot hover - it must always be moving forward
* It only charges from the radio which reduces power of radio batteries rather quickly
* Based on the above, and on what I now know of another heli, this one is WAY overpriced!
* I would not recommend that you buy this helicopter

Now, if you'd like to buy a helicopter that's even easier to fly, is 3-channel so it will hover, is gyro controlled so it's stable as hell, and you CAN BUY REPLACEMENT PARTS, may I humbly recommend the Syma S107 (also known as S107G - both are the same - both have gyro control).

Here is why I can recommend the Syma S107: After I tossed out my Air Hogs Sharp Shooter, I really missed it, but refused to buy another due to lack of replacement parts. Therefore, I bought a Syma S107 sold on Amazon. You can buy it for less than $30 with free shipping. That's about $10 less than the Air Hogs Sharp Shooter. I had read to be careful about getting \\"fake\\" S107s, but the one I got from Amazon is the REAL thing!

Flying the Syma S107 makes flying the Air Hogs Sharp Shooter I used to own seem like a dinosaur in comparison. The S107 flys dead solid perfect! I didn't even have to trim it right out of the box. IT IS A GREAT LITTLE HELICOPTER!!

COMPARISON OF SYMA S107 TO AIR HOGS SHARP HOOTER (AHSS)
* S107 is 3-channel, AHSS is only 2-channel
* S107 has a gyro, the AHSS did not
* S107 gyro makes flight VERY stable - you can hover without effort
* S107 will fly forward or backward. AHSS would only fly forward
* S107 is more powerful with quicker reaction time than the AHSS...
**** S107G has the power to recover quickly from mistakes before crashing
**** AHSS, once it started to fall, you could not bring on the power fast enough to save it
* S107G can be charged via provided USB cord from your computer, or even an AC/USB wall adapter. AHSS only charges from radio conroller.
* S107G flies about 8-minutes on a charge. The AHSS flew about 5-minutes max
* S107G costs about $10 LESS than the AHSS
* Every S107G can be flown on three different channels. The AHSS had to be purchased by specific channel
* MOST IMPORTANT: You can purchase spare parts for the S107G. AHSS has ZERO available replacement parts

Please, if you want to by an inexpensive helicopter to learn on, buy the Syma S107. product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Soothe and Glow Seahorse
review_headline: picky sleep fighting baby loves it
review_body: This seahorse is great at calming my baby down for sleep or if he wakes up a little putting him back to sleep. I use it as bedtime/nap time cue. It lives up to the hype.

product_title: ThinkFun Zingo (Discontinued by manufacturer)
review_body: I, as a grandparent, gave this game for a Christmas gift for our 4 year old grandaughter.   It was an immediate hit and I enjoyed playing it with her as well as our other 3 older grandchildren. Not only is it fun, but it also helps to improve memory. So it is educational as well. I highly recommend this quick game!

product_title: Fisher-Price 2-in-1 Singing Band Walker
review_body: Bought this toy for my 7 month old grandson.  He absolutely loves it!  He is able to work the keys to make the music.  He cannot walk yet but will be able to use this toy as he gets older and can push to learn to walk.

product_title: Edu Science Astro-Nova 102 Telescope - Toys R Us Exclusive
review_body: Are they serious with this telescope?  I am 50 yrs., old, I've been an ameteur astronomer the better part of my life. Last X-mas (2010), my unsuspecting girlfriend purchased  a \\"Astro-Nova 102 telescope\\" for me because my Meade 4\\" reflector had been stolen by so called \\"friends\\" - I could look at the box and see that I needed to be ready for a big disappointment but opted to give the telescope the benefit of the doubt - I was correct!  The telescope itself is POORLY made -to the point where I'd love to ask the person who designed it; \\"What were you thinking? drinking? or smoking?\\". I doubt the lenses are really much more than plastic (I might be wrong). the lens tube should be at the angle of the sighting scope (at least @ a 45 degree angle), the sighting scope deserves another set of retaining (adjusting) screws to hold the scope in place properly. The tripod is garbage (at best), the telescope (when mounted) it (and the telescope) shakes like a bag-o-cats - touch the unit and it's a visual 8.6 on the Richter scale; you cannot even put your eye to the eyepiece without the unit vibrating to a ridiculous level.  The tripod is dodgy, the complete mounted unit is upsetting (at least) when trying to use this telescope AND they neglected to pack the software -I looked online for the answer to get the software and found nothing concrete; it struck me as the cyber-runaround. I feel sorry for my girlfriend who realized (too late) that she had spent $150.+ dollars on a piece of junk as a Christmas present. I personally hope that you read this HONEST assessment of this product before you buy one for yourself or someone else. It matters NOT that toys-R-Us is a \\"kids\\" toy store or that this product is actually made for children, adults or both ... it's not worth the money - Toys-R-Us should be ashamed for offering this telescope to the public at any price!   I wouldn't rate this telescope with the benefit of \\"1\\" (one) star if I didn't have to rate it with something[[ASIN:B001NLOQN2 Edu Science Astro-Nova 102 Telescope - Toys R Us Exclusive]].    *** EDU-SCIENCE/ TOYS-R-US; Do you see what customers are saying about the telescopes and microscope that you sell to the public?   we await a response!  officeassistant@myway.com

product_title: LeapFrog Cook and Play Potsy
review_body:
I got this for my 1 1/2 year old niece, and she has fun putting the foods in, taking them out, stirring to make music, putting the lid on, and waiting for the \\"Done!\\" She has learned what the included foods are. Exactly as described, very cute toy!

Update: my niece is now almost 3 (in one month!) and still plays with this toy! She is still learning with it, and it is an integral part of her \\"kitchen\\".
Very sturdy, still working, no problems with it!

product_title: The Magic Labyrinth Board Game
review_headline: Great game for the whole family!
review_body: This game is fun, it was easy to learn the directions & everyone can play. My 10 year old has some special needs & it is very hard to find games that we can play as a family but he loves this game & so does my 15 year old. A main piece of the game is made out of cardboard so I wonder how long it will last. You can put in 15 blocking walls for a fairly easy game or put them all in for a much harder game. The game takes only about 10 minutes to play so we usually end up playing 3-4 games at each sitting. It really makes you work on problem solving & memorization.

product_title: Fisher-Price Thomas & Friends DC Ferdinand
review_body: Ferdinand is plenty of fun for my now 3 yr old.  He has twin bothers Bash and Dash and we have all 3 trains along with the Misty Island Rescue Station. It's a take and play set so, we take it and it's played with.  He recieved it for his 3re B-day and has hours of fun with it. His imangination is infinite and he does learn with his Thomas video's and applies it to life.  This is good Stuff...  a loving mom...

product_title: Melissa & Doug Sticker Collection - Blue
review_body: I bought this for my 9 yr. old daughter for Christmas and she LOVES it.  She is having so much fun putting together the outfits.  She makes the dolls on paper, and then draws backgrounds for them.  She's having a blast sending the pictures to her pen pal and to my mom.  What a great product!

product_title: Crayola Beginnings Color Me A Song
review_body: Honestly, I gave this toy to my 2 year old nephew and he absolutely loves it! He drags it everywhere he goes (very durable) and can easily pull out the crayons from the crayon drawer below without adult help and he just knows what to do! He likes to press the buttons and it does play faster the faster you color on it. I'd recommend this product to anyone!

product_title: Hello Kitty Mini Town: My House
review_headline: When this product says "Mini", it means extremely "Mini!"
review_body: This is not for a small child. The little girl that I Nanny,(age 5)and myself (age Grandmother-ish) spent two hours trying to put everything together using the numbered directions for decals. Every piece is so tiny that my fingers which are not huge just made it near impossible. We had some fun in the process. We even labled a shoebox so she wouldn't loose all the tiny pieces. A week later the pieces were all over her bedroom and I wouldn't even try to put them back together again. So, for all the effort it took to make it look like a little house with a tiny yard (no town involved)and the hours of enjoyment, I would not recommend this product to anyone buying for a young girl. You pay for the brandname. When we picked it out online it appeared to be much bigger than it actually is. It is made of cheap plastic and cardboard.

product_title: Manhattan Toy Baby Stella Blonde Hair Soft Nurturing First Baby Doll
review_body: Bought this doll for my neice's 1st birthday.  This doll is well made.  She is soft, durable and has appropriate body parts.  She is the perfect size for a 1-3 year old girl.  I like that I can buy the accessories from her line along the way to add to her collection.  I will buy dolls from this line/collection again.

product_title: JapanBargain Wooden Nesting Doll Set
review_body: I ordered these for my 4 yr old daughter for Christmas and my husband and I couldn't get the innermost two apart. Because of their shape, there was nothing to grasp and I eventually had to use pliers, trying not to damage the wood or paint. These would have been much better if they had just a little more to grab into or more of the classic \\"doll\\" shape, rather that totally rounded. She has played with them a lot but has a hard time getting those little ones and get frustrated. Her other sets that are the usual shape, she loves and plays with all the time.

product_title: Set of 3 Copters: 8" Die-cast Combat Apache AH-64A, Pull Back Action
review_body: These copters are awesome! We bought this for our 9 yr old grandson but my husband immediately started playing with them. The lights and sound are a great bonus and they are built very well.The only thing we did not like about them is they just came in a brown shipping box with packing material, no decorative box.

product_title: Little Tikes Shopping Cart - Yellow/Red
review_body: Our daughter loves playing grocery store with her little shopping cart.  It is durable and a fun toy for a young child.

product_title: Schwinn Roadster 12-Inch Trike
review_body: Well built.  Great for my almost two year old.  The seat can be moved forward to accomodate his short legs.  His big sisters love it as well.

product_title: Plush Light-Up Christmas Turkey Hat Pkg/1
review_body: I looked for the perfect hat for the Holidays, and this fit the bill! It is funny and a great conversation piece. Was my favorite gift to give this year!

product_title: The Queen's Treasures 15" Complete Doll Clothes for American Girl Bitty Baby Bitty Twins, Blue Velvet Dress, Hat, Tights, Shoes. Packaged with Reusable Plastic Hanger
review_body: My niece is very happy with her favorite dolly's new Christmas outfit.  It's well made, very pretty and perfect for her doll (Berenguer 14\\" doll).

product_title: Norscot UPS P80 Delivery Truck
review_body:
Smallest, most overpriced \\"toy\\" I ever purchased. 3 yr old Grandson was looking for this for a long time. Really loves it. Parts on back door came of within hours of coming out of box.

It's not a toy folks. It's a collectable and I wouldn't move the door too often - like more than once.

product_title: Fisher-Price GeoTrax Transportation System Remote Control Timbertown Railway
review_body: Cute train set.  My 2 yr old loves it and can control it.  Its nice because you can change the track to different shapes/loops.  You can't touch on it too much because it will come apart.  My son can be a little rough at times but it doesn't break.

product_title: Make Your Own Lip Balm
review_body: We got this as a gift, my daughter was so excited with it until we actually started to make it.  The bowl, measuring cup and spatula are too small so everything spills or slops out of the containers while mixing.  It is very sticky, think lipstick left in your pocket after getting laundered. It gets everywhere and is nearly impossible to get clean.  It left such a residue on the little colorful containers that the stickers wouldn't work so we couldn't even decorate them.

product_title: G.I. JOE Hasbro 25th Anniversary 3 3/4" Wave 4 Action Figures Comic Book 2-Pa...
review_headline: GI Joe celebration figures are Great!!
review_body: I love this figure 2-pack! The comic inside was surprisingly a GI Joe 25th celebration exclusive, leaving me quite happy with that( I had presumed that it would be a re-print of a Marvel issue from G.I. Joe A Real American Hero 1984-1993).  As for the figures, I love this version of Copperhead, as he is a modernized version of the Copperhead which came with the Water Moccassin vehicle( by far one of my favourite Joe toys of the 80's). I like this version of Shipwreck, as he has a more mordernized/acurrate Naval uniform, & it comes with a little parrot named \\"Polly\\". Shipwreck was a major role player in the 80's G.I. Joe cartoon, as well as a core Joe in many of the comic series( the excellent Devil's Due runs predominantly).

product_title: KidKraft Majestic Mansion Dollhouse
review_body: My daughter just loves this house and there is plenty of room for her and her friends to play.  There is lots of furniture too!!  It is very durable and my 2 1/2 year old loves it!

product_title: Melissa & Doug Child-Safe Scissor Set
review_body: These are good first pair of scissors for a toddler.I was very happy to get these scissors so that I needn't worry about giving it to my careless toddler. And my toddler loved the colors of the scissors. But she wanted to use the red ones but could hardly use it. The blue scissor works great.But I gave 3 stars because of the fact the red scissors are very hard to use even for adults leave alone a toddler .But this product was definitely helpful to introduce scissors to my toddler without any fear.

product_title: Disney Princess Favorite Moments - Jasmine
review_body: This Jasmine toy is great, but you can buy these at Target for MUCH cheaper. My daughter has the entire collection. The clothes are very hard to put on and break easily, because the princesses all wear pointy high heels and the clothes are just a stretchy plastic material. My 3YO absolutely LOVES them, so it's worth it. But I would never spend $12 on these!

product_title: 6 Wax Candles - Set of Native American Indian Items
review_body: Purchased these as a gift for my Mom. They are sooooo realistic. The photos do them NO justice. No regrets whatsoever. So lifelike, with abundance of attention to detail. Absolutely gorgeous!!!

product_title: Hamusuta the Happy Hamster in Ball
review_headline: Works as advertised (for a while). Bad cat toy.
review_body: I bought this to roll around the floor and entertain my cat.  She is just not interested in anything that won't move on its own, so I tried this.  The toy does roll around the floor, and quite well.  If it hits something, it just turns around and goes the other way.  The problems are that it makes too much noise - cat just stares and runs away - and the battery dies after about 30 minutes of use.  I bought the heavy duty energizer batteries, and the thing just piddles out after 1 or 2 uses.  Not very economical (or environmentally friendly).  This might be fun for a very small child, but no good for a cat.

product_title: Lionel Little Lines Train Playset
review_body: I had previously owned several kids train sets, including thomas train sets, that were also made of plastic, but this one is by far the best constructed and functioning set of them all.  The track was easy to put together, the train stays on the tracks, it has forward, stop and reverse.  Exceptional buy for the money, and a great starter set for younger train enthusiasts! I had read other reviews that said this train set was not good, and I have to wonder if they are reviewing the same set, and if they have had experience with other trains sets to compare this set with.

product_title: Crayola Crayon Maker
review_body: I purchased this at my nine year old daughter's request.  I was surprised at the amount of time she and her friends spent making crayons.  The kids had a big drawer of pieces and they have had a ball taking the papers off the pieces and making new colors.  I would not recommend this for younger children as there is really nothing for them to do but watch the wax melt.  My only issue with this toy is that the wax melts faster than the time allotted by the timer.  So you end up pouring the crayons and then having to wait for the timer to go off so it unlocks and you can clean it.  By the time it opens the wax has almost cooled in the trays before it can be wiped off. So it can be a pain to clean.  The new crayons are not very big either, they are about half the size of a regular crayon.  I would recommend this for children that love crafts.

product_title: Fisher Price iXL Learning System Software Toy Story 3
review_body: Bought this for a 4 year old. I like that the games load into the player, so no cartridges to loose. He can play it easily on his own without adult help. The game keeps him engaged for long periods of time with the various options available.

product_title: Best - Lock Military Attack Copter, 240 - Pieces
review_body: These are inferior quality and harder to put together than Legos.  One year later my son has two unopened boxes that he did not care to play with.

product_title: Snoopy Plush (Sit)
review_headline: Small, hard, not really pulsh little Snoopy
review_body:
My oldest daughter was given a plush Snoopy when she was a baby, and he has been her constant companion every since. Well, I finally decided that it was time to \\"send Snoopy to the Doctor\\" and replace the old dingy one with a like new condition one.

This Snoopy was not the one I was looking for, even though the picture looked the same. I ended up giving this one to our youngest daughter, and she never plays with it. It is not very soft, and by definition shouldn't really even be called \\"plush\\".

What I was looking for was a \\"Kohl's Cares for Kids\\" plush Snoopy, not this small, hard, little thing. I would say it would make an okay dog chew toy...

product_title: Loaded Questions
review_body: I bought Loaded Questions as a game to play on Christmas Day. We played with both adults and teenagers.  We had a blast.  Lots of laughs. No pressure. Just fun.

product_title: Cobi Small Army Special forces Includes Tank, Fighter Plane and Accessories, 300 Piece Set
review_body: My 13 year old son received this for Christmas. His comments:\\"Cobi toys are really fun and the instructions are super easy to understand. I like all the weapons it has, and most of all, the blocks are compatible with Lego!\\"

product_title: LEGO Ben 10 Alien Force Chromastone (8411)
review_body: How can you go wrong with Lego and Ben 10?  My 6yr old loves these toys.  Very simple to put together, and they stay together to be able to play with them.

The common retail price for this item is $.99 - $1.09, do NOT spend more than that on this product.

product_title: Traxxas 3638 Rear Shock Tower
review_body: The rear shock tower (part: 3638, by Traxxas) is a part that holds up the rears shocks, keeps back tires firm, and has the motor wires go through the center so they are not swinging around while driving. The item works with the regular and VXL versions of the electric Bandit, Rustler, and Stampede remote control cars. It is easy to replace by just unscrewing 8 screws from the older tower (with the 3 types of allen wrenches you got with the car) and screw them back in with the new tower.       The part is plastic but can last a good amount of use. I didn't have to buy an extra until after more than 1 year of almost constant use. It usually breaks when it does big jumps because the springs push the top part from the bottom and it breaks in half. This item is very cheap to buy and will last a while but there is an aluminum version (part: ST3638S) which of course will most likely not break at all, although it costs $20. So you may as well just buy 5 of the plastic ones instead. I highly recommend you do not buy the aluminum one unless you race the cars at real stadiums or do very high jumps which then it would be a good idea to buy.

product_title: Street Corners Super Set Micro Machines Playset
review_body:
I can't believe the reviewer that complained that she bought this for her kid that was being potty trained and it was too hard to put together and too many small parts. First of all, this page and the packaging clearly state it is NOT FOR CHILDREN UNDER 4 YEARS OF AGE, CHOKING ON SMALL PARTS IS POSSIBLE. Second of all, the whole concept of Micro Machines is that they are small, tiny, micro sized.... That is why they are called \\"Micro Machines\\". They are meant for older kids, and even adults collect these. The reviewer also stated that you cannot find the cars anywhere. Yes and not. The company closed down in 1998, so this and the cars are rare. But you can find tons of them online, including here at Amazon. Just enter the name \\"Micro Machines\\" and about 800 listings come up, several hundred of these are the cars. planes and boats that go with these playsets. Either do a search or click at the top of the page under the title of the playset on the blue words, Galoob Micro Machines. They have tons of brand new ones from unsold inventory at Amazon, and the auctions sites have used ones by the thousands. I used to buy these from Amazon when they were still being made, and my son was nuts about them.

Micromachines were tiny plastic toy vehicles, much smaller than Hot Wheels at about 1.5 inches long. They were made by the Galoob toy company in the 1980's and 1990's. The cars were usually sold in a 4 pack of related vehicles. They included civilian cars, truck, boats, planes, construction vehicles, and military equipment. They had unusual items like spacecraft, monster trucks, hang glider, surfers, all kinds of things. They also had franchise agreements to make toys for different movies and shows such as James Bond, Star Wars, Star Trek, Indian Jones, Predator, Terminator, Aliens, Babylon 5 and more. They made plastic heads the size of a shoe, that opened up into a related playset, such as a Yoda head that turned into the Dagobah swamp, or a Race Car helmet that transformed into a race track. The Galoob designers were very original and creative, and designed some of my favorite toys ever. In 1999 when Galoob was the 3rd largest toy manufacter they were bought out by competitor Hasbro. The new owners promptly shut down production of many of the Galoob toys including Micromachines, and sold off the inventory. You can occasionally see the Micromachines name on Star Wars toys, or toys sold overseas but they are gone for now. This makes the old sets, especially those that are still new in the box, very collectible. Now that the kids that owned them in the 1980's are growing up, the price can only go up on the collectibles market. The company slogan was \\"Think Big, Play Small, Micro machines!\\"

The playset on this page was part of the Street Corners series, known for the ability to link the sets together with pieces of track and playsets from the Hyways and Byways series. I did not find any of these hard to put together. The Street Corner sets were popular in the 1980's. In this release from 1992 I believe what they really did was place 4 separate street corner sets in one box. These are 1) City Motors a car dealership with a rotating car display 2) Jiffy Lube Oil Change Center with a working vehicle lift 3) Shell Service Station with gas pumps 4 a house called 27 Maple Avenue with a working garage door. No vehicles came in the sets, and individually the Street Corners sets were one of the smallest they made.d into a race track. product_title: PlanToys Activity Blocks
review_body:
I bought these for my baby when he was 10 months old....... younger than the age recommended.....so maybe thats a problem...i dont know......but my baby loves blocks so i thought he would absolutely love these.........he plays with them...but doesnt absolutely love them yet.........maybe as he gets older and really explores the difference between the blocks he will come to really love it.....

he is now a year old....and is slowly starting to finger the different textures and such.....but i wish i had of bought the HABA discovery blocks instead......the problem with these PLAN toy blocks is that the mechanisms of the blocks are not exposed........meaning....the sound blocks make noise....but baby has no way of telling how and why it makes sound.......with the HABA blocks...the mechanism is exposed......so for instance the PLAN toy sound block with the bell is completely covered and there is a tiny hole that allows the sound to escape........whereas the HABA block with the bell.....the bell is exposed......so baby can finger the bell...shake it....and then pick up the sound block with the wooden bead....finger it...shake it...and begin to understand the difference between the two.......the texture and vision blocks in the PLAN toy set are not as interesting as the ones in the HABA set as well.....

so my rec....buy the HABA blocks........and maybe these ones for a much older child.....

another thing to note....the the texture and vision blocks that come in the set are not like the ones pictured here....the textures: velvet, felt, corduroy ...are actually inset into the blocks.....so it is actually difficult for little fingers to to explore...

review_body: I received the Dwinguler mat as a gift for my daughter who is now starting to crawl and walk.      The design is very colorful and is wonderful to look at. I have seen babies get rug burns on their hands and knees as they crawl around on carpet, but with these play mats, there is no worry for any kind of rug burns.  Also, they are easy on the babies tush.  As she falls down from taking a couple of steps, we don't have to worry about hurting herself as the cushion absorbs most of the weight of her fall.      Have you purchased an exercise mat?  I would say that this could be used as an exercise mat as well.  The cushion is like a really thin memory foam bed.  Stand on it for a while and your feet dig into the mat, walk away and the cushion regains it's form and is ready for you to stand on again.      It's also great for when your child spills grape juice.  Doesn't stain the carpet and just a quick swipe of a paper towel and you are good to go.      I would say, if you have a little one at home, this mat is perfect for you!  Overall, I enjoy playing with my daughter on this mat as it gives me assurance that my daughter won't get hurt.
