review_body:
This was an item \\"ON THE Christmas LIST\\" for my 5 year old, so I broke down and bought it, though I have to say I usually will not buy any sort of play dough machine since all the pieces seem to get lost and consequently do not get used whatsoever.

I actually ended up buying two of these, the first from Walmart, the second from Amazon after I found it cheaper here, planning to return the other to Walmart next time I was there.

However, my daughter was having so much fun playing with it her brother wanted to get in on the action. It is not easy for two children to play with this at the same time without a lot of cooperation and sharing (um, huh). So, I pulled the extra out of the basement and the two toys provided a lot of entertainment for the kids.

Do I think it's great? Not really, but they are the ones playing with it, and they love it!

product_title: Playskool Mr. Potato Head Silly Suitcase-Colors May Vary
review_body: I must say Im very impressed with my order. Shipping was very fast and product showed up when it was suppose to. Great price as well!! My Nephew was very happy to get this for Christmas.

product_title: SKIP BO Card Game
review_body: My large family used to play this for hours and hours growing up.  It was an absolute staple during our summer trips to the beach.  Just ordered my 30+ sister a copy of the game which she promptly (and excitedly!) introduced her boyfriend to.  The card game is strangely addictive and is easy to master at any age level.  Such a wonderful throw back to child hood and a must for anyone who likes games!

product_title: Syma S107/S107G R/C Helicopter *Colors Vary
review_body: After a month of research I decided that the Syma S107 got the best marks, so I bought one. This thing was way above what I thought it would be. You can buy extra parts for these, which I did, but have not needed them. I also have a cheep 2 ch. heli, and a high $$$ heli, but the Syma S107 is \\"by far\\" the best bang for the buck. (Don't waste your money on a cheep 2 ch.) This thing flys GREAT and is very easy to fly, my wife flew it around the living room and said \\"I want one of these for my self\\". After hitting \\"everything\\" in the house doing stunts and crazy stuff, I have not broke any thing on the chopper, (notice I said on the chopper!) these things are tough. Best advice is get it off the floor (flying) and trim it out, it will stay where ever you want it to, it is very stable, if it looks like you are going to hit something or crash, cut the power, this keeps from damaging the blades. This has to be the best toy chopper there is!

product_title: Ant Farm Viewing Habitat - Escape Proof Ant Hill Kit Includes Sand And Activity Book
review_body: This ant hill is awesome. My five year old loves it. You can see every little move the ants make and the way its set up is really cute. Ants took a long time for delivery but was worth it.

product_title: Fisher-Price iXL Learning System Software Shrek Forever After
review_body: My mother-in-law bought my 4 year old the iXL for his birthday and this was one of the games we bought him for it.  He loves the iXL and this game.  One of the games is a matching game that gets progressively more difficult and I enjoy it too!! :)  It provided a good learning experience, teaching him to be methodical rather than just randomly opening boxes.  He also likes the game where Shrek runs and you make him jump and add letters to form a word.  At this point it is teaching him letter recognition and he will be able to progress to purposely picking the correct letter to spell out the word.

product_title: Crayola Water Soluble Oil Pastels set of 24
review_body: These are the creamiest smoothest pastels, easily blendable with a delicious texture.  the only negative to it is they changed the color of red-violet from the rich, bright, gem tone that it used to be, to a duller, more subdued tone, which does not jump off the page like it used to.  i was very disappointed by this, actually.  The red-violet was my favorite color and i used it for so many of my paintings.  now i have to go to the trouble of attempting to mix to try my best to match the original color.  all in all, a great tool, beautiful colors, and smooth as cream!!!

product_title: Toy Vault King Ghidorah Plush Toy with Sound
review_body: I am a huge Godzilla fan, I have been since I was a toddler, so when I found this guy, I was overjoyed. Finally, a cuddly villan for my cuddly Godzilla! I ordered this with the 50th Anniversary Godzilla plush with lights and sound, I wanted to keep things even, one villan and one hero. King Ghidorah has always been one of my favorite Godzilla villans, and I know what Ghidorah is supposed to look like, and this one does look like him, and I know what Ghidorah is supposed to sound like and this one...doesn't?????? The necks are very durable, so are the wings and tails, but what's with the weird sound?

product_title: LeapFrog Leapster Learning Game: Tangled
review_body: I bought this game for my child for Christmas. She loves this game and has so much fun playing it. I love the eductional aspects.

product_title: Fisher-Price Laugh & Learn Learning Farm
review_headline: Very Fun toy, my 8month old loves it!
review_body: I bought this for my 8month old. It has a lot of different things that keep his interest. He can even pull himself up on the barn and it won't tip over. My 5yr old even likes to play with it! The barn door is one of their favorite things b/c it makes noise when they open and close the door. The light switch is another favorite; when they flip the switch the light comes on and it sings a catchy little song. I'm glad i decided to purchase this, it is a favorite toy:)

product_title: Star Trek - USS Enterprise Iconic Vehicle (Discontinued by manufacturer)
review_body: My 7yr-old son loves this model.  It especially fun right before bed time in a dark room - pressing the button until you get the \\"Ready to launch\\" sound and the lights go off and you zoom it around in a circle.  Very durable and solid.  We added a couple metal screws to the bottom so we can mount it with magnets on the wall with some other models.

product_title: Little Tikes Tap A Tune Drum
review_body: We have the xylophone like this, and thought we would make a matching set. The kids love it. The strings that are used for all the similar musical instruments are not great. They are designed to be too short for the child to accidentally get tangle in and possibly hang themselves, but that makes it hard for the kids to actually use. The strings inhibit use of the drum, but then again there are hands. My kids love to stand on things, and they have stood on this and it has laster. We will just have to see how long it lasts.

product_title: Disney Princess Ariel Bath Castle
review_headline: Cute and fun for long time
review_body: I bought this toy for my 5 and 1.5 year old daughter. They love it and play everyday. The Ariel doll and Flounder are very cute and small. My daughters barely play the water pumping seashell because it needs skill and strength, but they love the slide and castle very much. Now they are 6 and 2 and half. They still love the castle, it's pretty and durable. My 2 years old daughter will carry Ariel out and play with it any time she wants. The slide do come off easily but it's easy to put it back, too. Sometimes I don't put the slide on so the kids could have more room to play in bath tub. It's a wonderful bath tub toy.

product_title: Playhut Thomas The Tank W Caboose
review_body: It is a great toy for young children. However if you are to purchase this I feel the Thomas himself is enough. We added the caboose and the children don't utilize both. I run a daycare and thought this maybe a great thing for all the kids but they only play in the Thomas.If you have a large room and want both it may work but for average homes it is way to long for both. Overall a great toy for kids.

product_title: Indian Boy with feather headband
review_body: The costume is beautiful and well-made.  The only thing I don't like is that is has to be hand-washed.

product_title: Warmachine Khador Manowar Drakhun
review_body: one of the best solo units out there. My only problem with it was how hard it is to attach the arms. I ended up putting them right on his side, so it looks like he's stabbing the horse. It's ok though, I think the horse likes it.

product_title: Ultra Micro P-51D Mustang
review_headline: i bought this for my husband and he loves it!
review_body: My husband absolutely loves his miro p-51.  He is very pleased with the construction and workings of the plane.

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Soothe and Glow Seahorse
review_body: These are awesome! I received one as a shower gift for my first son, and then purchased a second for our next child, as my oldest son (now 2) still loves taking it to bed with him. I also have purchased the Cloud B products and like this a little better as it does light up, which the other products similiar to this do not.

product_title: LeapFrog LeapPad Educational Book: The Incredibles
review_headline: LeapFrog LeapPad Educational Book: The Incredibles
review_body: My son is using this book and learning from it so that is all that matters. It is mostly story centered vs activity centered like other leap pad books.

product_title: Yellow Label Kids Donut Assortment (Set of 5 with Box)
review_headline: This is NOT the item you will receive!!
review_body: I ordered the item pictured above back in December but received the Donut Plate set (listed for $32) instead. Since I wanted these KNIT donuts, not the pillow fabric crap ones they sent me, I returned the product and re-ordered this item, per Amazon's instructions. This surely wouldn't happen a second time, right? WRONG! They resent me the wrong item a SECOND time! Needless to say, I will not be ordering from this company again! PS- I have written a review on both the StarBright Kids Amazon page, as well as here but somehow they keep getting deleted. I already knew this company was not competent but now I know they are dishonest as well.

product_title: Year Without A Santa Clause "Heat Miser" Head Knocker
review_body: My son loved this gift as much as he loves the movie.  Its a lot bigger and studier than I expected which is nice.  We will enjoy seeing it every holiday. A great keepsake.

product_title: QJ Shape Changing Magic Ruler Puzzle Green
review_headline: Don't buy.  Really weak, break easily.
review_body: This toy broke only a couple of hours after playing.  My kids told me \\"Dad this is not the real one, it's a cheap copy.  Don't be so cheap, buy me the real one.\\"  Yeah you get what you paid for.  I will only stick to brand name toys from now on.

product_title: Games Workshop How to Make Wargames Terrain Book
review_body: This was purchased for my husband who plays tabletop games, he was thrilled with its content and looks forward to putting what he is reading to use soon!

product_title: American Plastic Toy Creativity Desk and Easel
review_body: This product came before it was suppose to, so I am very please with how fast the seller mailed it out and with the quality of the product.

product_title: ALEX Toys Little Hands Paper Bag Puppets
review_body: Don't have to wait till your child is 3, my barely 2yo enjoyed this stuff supervised. I rated this highly for educational value for 2-3 year olds to develop their fine motor skills.  Box contains 5 individual packets of animal crafts, a chunky glue stick and a sheet of illustrated instructions. Each packet contains 1 paperbag, a sheet of die-cut cardboard shapes of features and limbs that you have to glue onto the paperbag, and a sheet of adhesive paper stickers for decoration. My glue stick wasn't sticky enough to hold the cardboard pieces to the paperbag I had to use tape to secure odd shapes otherwise with a little bit of play they come right off. Other than the glue stick everything was of high quality, even the paperbags which are made of much thicker paper stock than what you'd get from fast food joints.

product_title: LeapFrog Reading and Writing System
review_headline: Great for learning, but needs to be more durable.
review_body: This is a great learning toy, but mine quit working in less than 12 months.  Now my child has tons of books, but no tag toy to use for them.  For what I paid for the tag itself, I certainly expect it to work past one year.  I will have to buy another one since my child has so many books, but now it has me wondering, how long will the replacement one last?

product_title: Blue's Clues Notebooks - 4 Count
review_body: If you have a toddler or youngster who likes Blues Clues, these puppies are the bomb diggity. No, they are not the most durable little notebooks out there, but then we're talking about a 2 y/o in my case. The ones he doesn't feed to the dogs will last 2 or 3 weeks though, so I suppose I can't complain. The joy it brings him is well worth the price!     He just got a mini-recliner from grandma this Christmas (his \\"thinking\\" chair) and is in his element. The show doesn't even have to be on anymore. He just goes around with his notebook writing down \\"clues\\" and thinking in his thinking chair. It's awesome.      This review is for the 4 pack, but I just ordered my second 8 pack. Better deal.

product_title: In My Room Star Theater Tabletop Planetarium Light Projector
review_body: My son received this for Christmas.  It has never worked and he was very disappointed by it.  I came here looking for another planetarium and noticed that others have had similar experiences.  I've decided to chime in, thinking that perhaps if the negative review count is high enough, others won't waste their time and money on this product.

product_title: Barbie Fashion Fairytale Marie Alecia Doll
review_body: Actually returned the one I bought at the store to buy this one at a great price on Amazon. Perfect condition. Daughters loves it!

product_title: Furreal Furry Frenzies Cruisin' Carrier
review_headline: really cute toy, not the best of the frenzies, sets though
review_body: It was a good idea I guess. It is really cute and it was fun to watch the dog run around in a circle inside but as others have said this thing snaps apart really easily. Theres not much to do with it, you either have to look from the top or the sides to see whats going on. The doors are too hard for my daughter to open I think the placement of the doorknobs were a bit off since they would have you think the doors would swing open from the sides like a regular door if they had been place in the center near the top I think it would be easy for my daughter to figure out that she should pull it down instead. The dog is really cute and if you can get this on sale it would be worth it plus i guess it would be a nice pet carrier for car trips. She did like the mailbox and the little postcards that you can put inside. Also these toys have a lot of accessories and while some are cute most are unnecessary things that will just get left on the floor or lost somewhere.

product_title: North American Bear Company Little Princess Brunette 10"
review_body: This is a great lovey for a child. It is soft as can be with long hair for holding. The face is embroidered and has nothing that would come off and choke an infant. Its is a small enough size to cuddle with and carry around. My 12 month old adores it.

product_title: Uncle Milton Star Wars Science - Death Star Planetarium
review_headline: Marginal, but delights my 5 year old.
review_body: It doesn't seem durable at all.  It is blurry and doesn't throw much light on ceiling.  However, my five year old daughter just saw Star Wars and Empire this week, and she squealed with delight when she saw it in the store.  She is SO VERY HAPPY with it.  Plus, take of the view from Earth dome, plop on the Death Star topper and you have a top half lit Death Star.  Bedtime was easy tonight, but older, more discerning buyers would likely not like it.

product_title: Rhode Island Novelty Neon 80's Style Party Sunglasses with Dark Lens
review_body: i only got one pair of these cheap sunglasses. it's not a good deal if you only get one pair!

product_title: Barbie Glam Bike! Barbie with Glam Bike
review_headline: It's unanimous - not as great as it looks!
review_body: We were so excited that these were on sale that we bought 3, one for our 6 year old daughter, and 2 for her friends as birthday presents. Now I feel bad we gave them to her friends. It looks so nice, and she loves the look of the Barbie, but I agree with the other reviews that once you get it out of the package (which is in itself a challenge) the product disappoints. The others forgot to mention that her head is plastic tagged to the box in three spots, and there is no way to get the plastic out of her head (we cut it as close to her head as we could without cutting her hair, and because the pieces were still pokey, we shoved them inside her head). As the others said, the bike pedal fell off, the front wheel falls off continuously, and the handle bars and basked too. Eventually after jamming the front wheel into the handle bars hard (out of frustration) they clicked together, and have now stayed put for over an hour. The box advertises that her legs move with the wheel, which if you hold it up and turn very carefully, they do, but it is too hard to move the wheel by just pushing down and trying to make her ride. We got Barbie to stay on, but her arms don't reach the handle bars  very well. My daughter loves the Barbie, so we will keep it, but the bike riding will not happen as advertised. The only reason I gave 2 stars instead of 1 is because it looks really neat.

product_title: Little Tikes Buzz Lightyear Toddler Bed
review_headline: great quality well worth the money
review_body: my husband and i bought this for our 3 year old son and he loves this bed so much that he will sleep in it even though he wouldnt sleep in his last bed so well worth  the money to have my bed back my son is very tall for his age and he fits it well with room to spare i think he will love this bed and be able to use it for a long while i fell in love w this bed from the second i saw it and am still in love w it very well made bright and fun the only thing that would make it better is storage space

product_title: Disney Tangled Featuring Rapunzel Fairytale Tower
review_body: Like the other reviews, this toy is fun, but not made well for the price.  I would not have paid $100 for this toy if it weren't for my 4 yr old who LOVES Rapunzel and it was her 4th birthday.  It should not cost more than $60 for the quality.  It was well worth the $100 to see my daughter's face light up though.  I bought the rapunzel doll that is small and came with flynn and a boat and those dolls fit real well in the tower.  The hair gets tangled up real easily so when mine got tangled beyond fixing I ordered a new hair accessory from Mattel.  The tower is nice because it closes up into a small area and does not take up much space.  Overall its worth it if you LOVE Rapunzel and like to play with dolls.

product_title: City Girls Magnetic Dolls
review_headline: Nice design but magnets are too weak
review_body: These dolls, along with others in the series, are much cuter than other brands of magnetic dolls, but the magnetic backing on the clothes and dolls are too weak to really work. One layer of clothing barely sticks, and you can't add a third layer (e.g. giving the doll a hairstyle and then a hat) without relying solely on gravity to hold it on.

product_title: KidKraft John Deere Step N' Store
review_body: Apparently this is a good product because it was sold out on Amazon and we couldn't find it in stock anywhere else.

product_title: Splashing Jojo and Motorized, Musical, Squirting Submarine
review_body: My daughter LOVED this toy for the three days it worked.  The factory installed batteries died after 3 days, which was fine.  It has like 6 screws to get the battery cover off and takes forever, so that is a negative on it's own.  It was wet in the battery case even though they were factory installed.  I replaced them anyway, screwed the cover back on & the toy ran through the program non-stop - it was already shot to crap at that point.  2 of the screws are already rusty and it's just a floating bath toy now.    Great in concept, poor in execution.  Don't waste your money.

product_title: Ideal Sure Shot Hockey Tabletop Game
review_body: I'll give it 4 stars although I've had 2 of the problems that people have mentioned.  I also played versions of this when I was a kid, and I was floored that this one has players that can go behind the net.  Very cool.  I did have trouble with one of the behind-the-net players moving and turning smoothly, but a few drops of oil on the top and bottom fixed that.  But one of the players broke off; the black pin where it connects to the board broke.  I am going to try to see if the company sells repair parts, but from some other comments, that doesn't seem too likely.  So I'd either buy another one (for many spare parts) or get a more expensive one.  WARNING: before I got this, my 5 year old son would pester me every day to go outside and shoot a puck around.  After we got this, he'd rather play this game !  I do think it is fairly educational about the game.  He has a tendency to want to \\"jam\\" the player forward and backward to try and score goals, and sometimes that works, but at the same time, I haven't lost my touch, and I can score on him almost every time just by passing the puck around.  So I'm hoping he learns from that.  And most of my goals come from the outside wingers where I can cycle the puck pretty good, all things he needs to know about the real game.  I just wish it was more durable.

product_title: HEXBUG Bridge Battle Set
review_headline: Love nanos, but the bridge is lame...
review_body: I was excited to buy a bigger habitat for my starter set plus two bugs that I got for Christmas.  I thought the \\"battles\\" would be fun, but the bridge platform is pretty lame.  The bugs walk over the side all by themselves with no contact from another bug.  It should have slightly higher walls to prevent this.    That said, this is a great value.  I got mine at Walmart for just under $40.  The pieces, even without the bridge battle piece are a good value compared with other sets.  It has four hex cells (retail $10 for 2) and two bugs ($8-$10 each-and these are\\"extremely rare mutations\\" worth more on the nano website), six curved connectors and two straight ones (about another $10), plus the legs. So without the bridge it's worth well over $40. I took the pieces, plus my starter set, and the configurations are almost endless for my five bugs.    OK, I'm a 50-ish lady in a wheelchair, and I'm having great fun with this.  It's a great diversion and much more fun than a fish tank.  It's an ant farm without the \\"ick\\" factor.  This is a toy, but still interesting and fun for adults. The scientific principles are sound, and you can learn about the evolution of the bugs at [...]. I can see it as a desktop toy for an executive.  It's awfully relaxing to watch the bugs scurry around, flip over and correct themselves and race around through the connectors.      Wait till the kids start back to school and take a while to play with theirs.  You may get hooked, too!

product_title: Doll House Furniture Set Woodcraft Construction Kit, 1/24 Scale
review_headline: Wonderful creative project a  patient adult help a must
review_body: I am an adult collector. This is a slot and groove set not a puzzle. Glue is needed. Furniture is VERY sturdy and can be decorated to taste.It was VERY easy for me to put together but I am experienced and am very good at discerning puzzles. The directions are somewhat obtuse. The wood pieces are unmarked and  you have to match the diagram numbers to the punched out pieces in the wood sheets. There are NO numbers on the wood pieces. I am sure if you are intuitive you will have ease of construction as well. If you are non intuitive you may have a harder time. You MUST have patience because if you don't this wont work for you. It all goes together VERY nicely. I think good for children  (with adult help) or adult creative people collectors. Gave me the extra furniture I needed for my 1/4 inch scale doll house for a fraction of the price of bought sets!!! Good deal, patience and creativity needed. A lot of fun for the creative person.

product_title: Corolle My First Fashions 12-Inch Blue Striped Set
review_body: This is adorable and made out of really soft fabric, which isn't obvious in the description. Fits the smallest Corolle Baby perfectly. Seems durable!     A bit of history, my daughter took his first outfit off and wouldn't let it go back on. We ended up having a naked baby for months. But now, my daughter loves this outfit so much that her naked baby has clothes again. For anyone with kids, you'll know that this must be cute to switch her out of her tendencies!

product_title: Dino Museum Velociraptor Claw
review_headline: That's not very scary. Looks more like a six foot turkey
review_body:
Try to imagine yourself in the Cretaceous Period. You get your first look at this \\"six foot turkey\\" as you enter a clearing. He moves like a bird, lightly, bobbing his head. And you keep still because you think that maybe his visual acuity is based on movement like T-Rex - he'll lose you if you don't move. But no, not Velociraptor. You stare at him, and he just stares right back. And that's when the attack comes. Not from the front, but from the side, from the other two 'raptors you didn't even know were there. Because Velociraptor's a pack hunter, you see, he uses coordinated attack patterns and he is out in force today. And he slashes at you with this... a six-inch retractable claw, like a razor, on the the middle toe. He doesn't bother to bite your jugular like a lion, say... no no. He slashes at you here... or here... or maybe across the belly, spilling your intestines. The point is... you are alive when they start to eat you. So you know... try to show a little respect.

Other than that, its a plastic replica of a raptor claw. It is a little smaller than I would have liked, but its cool anyway.

product_title: Dragon Ninja Weapon Set
review_headline: Swords are very breakable and VERY hard to get into the holder.
review_body: The sword and knife holder is horrible.  My 5 year old could not put the swords or knives into the holder behind his back.  He was VERY frustrated.  You have to have the angle just perfect or they won't slide in.  After we gave up on the holder he played with the swords and knives.  They broke VERY easily.  The costume is fine.

product_title: Dazzlers Dress up Trunk
review_body: I purchased this item for my 2-1/2 year-old granddaughter for Christmas.  She absolutely loved it and played with it for hours. She enjoyed all the different outfits and accessories.  Some of the accessories are too small not appropriate for very young children.  I would recommend this item.

product_title: Star Wars Episode III 3 Revenge of the Sith CLONE PILOT TROOPER With Firing Cannon Figure #34
review_body: I put the fighter in the correct vehicle (V wing) and the laser is chilling on my desk facing the Death Star.

product_title: Mega Bloks Pull Along Musical Pirate Ship
review_body: My daughters, ages 3 and 10 fight over this toy. I bought it for my 10 month old son! He likes to take it apart and chew on it at this point, but the older two love playing with it! It's a favorite for sure!

product_title: Step2  Deluxe Canyon Road Train & Track Table
review_body: I bought this table for my son's 3rd birthday and he LOVES IT!  He has always loved matchbox cars and this is the perfect size for them, he plays with it off and on all day long...when he first opened it he played with it for a good hour :o)    My 8 month old loves it too since it's the perfect height for him to pull up on and stand at and play...it's really sturdy too so I don't have to worry about him pulling it down on top of himself.    Love that the tracks stay in place    The only negative thing (which really isn't even negative) is that it's so light that it slides easily on along the floor when my 3 year old leans on it or something, but we have laminate floors so it wouldn't be an issue on carpet    Overall this is the perfect table for a train or car lover :o)

product_title: Tool Squirt Toys - Set of 6 Party Supplies
review_body: We used these as party bag stuffers for my son's construction-themed 1st bday and the kids loved being able to fill them up and chase each other right away.

product_title: Cars - Hide N Fun Elite Tent
review_body: Where do I start? This toy fell apart after about 2 days of relatively light use. The metal rods used to support the tent broke out and is very dangerous and haphazardous to children. I highly suggest staying away from this product!

product_title: Ticket To Ride: Nordic Countries
review_headline: Fun game to play with 2-3 people.
review_body: Another great version of a really fun series. Makes for a quick and fun game to play when you only have 2-3 people.

product_title: Executive Sandbox - Construction Zone
review_body: This was a Christmas present I sent directly to the recipient and he loved it! The recipient is an executive and I brought it for his office as a reminder of our childhood playing with his Tonka toys on a dirt pile. We had hours of fun for many years. It was meant to be his \\"moment of Zen\\" after a stressful day at work dealing with clients.

product_title: Gund Owl "Hooten"
review_body: Too adorable! I love my owl. I named mine William the Bloody and made him a cute little bowtie. He perches at the top of my bed and is the cutest snuggler ever!

product_title: K'Nex Flatbed Truck
review_headline: Absolute nightmare...no way it's for 5 and up
review_body: My husband just spend the last 1.5 hours assembling this after my 5 year became incredibly frustrated.  It is flimsy, the wheels don't roll properly, and it falls apart immediately upon using it.  DO NOT BUY IT!!!  We also got the K'next dump truck and it's just as terrible!

product_title: Webkinz Signature Deer
review_body: This review is done by my 10 year old daughter:  \\"I received this stuffed animal as a Christmas present.  This is by far the cutest deer webkinz.  My little sister loves to play with the stuffed animals and this deer, (I named her Sierra) was a wonderful addition to our playing.  She is also so much fun to play with on the webkinz website too.  I absolutely love this deer, and I would recommend it to any kid who loves stuffed animals.\\"

product_title: Family Pastimes Secret Door - An Award Winning Co-operative Mystery Game
review_headline: The Secret is.... THIS GAME STINKS!
review_body: Bought this for my five yo who plays it in his class.    The overall compostion of the game is so cheap. It is like it was made on a copy machine. The cards are paper thin, and will not last over time. After setting up the game, many of the cards were already bent.    Next thing is that the directions are somewhat complicated. Maybe I'm impatient, but I just did not get it.     There are so many other games that are truly educational and that are well made. I'm just not sure that this is one of them.

product_title: Hot Wheels Flip ‘n Go Tune-up Tower
review_headline: Run of the mill Hotwheels product
review_body: Nothing spectacular but the 3yr old plays with it all the time with his numerous cars. Worth the price for our household

product_title: Electronic Hyperslide
review_body: The game performs as expected.  Santa was big into games this year so the family can do more things together.  This game is fun for all the ages of folks that played it (47, 38, 24, 21, 11, 7).  What more can be asked for?

product_title: Rose Valley Lifetime Convertible Crib
review_headline: Nice crib; be careful with the color issue.
review_body: This crib has a lovely style, and is very well built and sturdy when put together. People do need to know, though, that the manufacturer does not make the 'Abbey Oak' color anymore, so even cribs sold as such are actually 'Cherry Pine'. (I called the manufacturer to confirm this.) So, in reality it is quite a bit darker than it is shown in the pictures. The color still works in our home, but it is really important to note this difference so you won't be disappointed.

product_title: Syma S107/S107G R/C Helicopter *Colors Vary
review_body: I purchased this as a gift for my (mid 20's) brother. It's pretty easy to navigate, one thumbstick controls power the other turns left and right and moves forward and back.  The previous reviews have helped a bit and I can confirm how durable this thing is... so far it's hit the ceiling a few times, crashed into several walls and it's still going strong.  The tail propeller did get some nicks on it through all of this, but it comes with a replacement.    There's no charging light, but the helicopter charges in almost any USB. We charged it on our 360 port first time. Will also charge off the remote control batteries if you don't have access to USB.    Very fun, durable toy.

review_body: My friends and I (usually 5+) have had game night on a regular basis on Fridays for the past few years and it would mainly consist of party board games, but this year (2010-2011) we started playing this game. There will be yelling (we always have it, no matter the game) and lots of fun. Instruction manual makes learning the rules much more daunting than it is. If someone has played before just have them explain the basics and start playing. Definitely would recommend for any person or group that plays games regularly.

review_headline: Great game!  Seriously playable for 2, 3, or 4!

I recommend getting an expansion set or two, to add to the number of cards (and thus the overall experience).  Well worth the cost!

product_title: Ultimate Playland Play Tent
review_body: I got this for my two boys for Christmas.  I have a 5 year old and a 2 year old, and both boys absolutely love this.  They play all sorts of fun games in it and it really keeps them active.  It is super easy to set up and my 5 year old takes it down when it is time to put it away.  It fits into two small purple bags and easily fits into the corner behind the couches.  We set it up for several days and then when their dad can't handle it out anymore we put it away...until the boys beg me to put it up again.  We have a fairly small area to set it up, but we get up all of the tents and we try a new set up every time.  The other day we set them all up in a row making one long tunnel (with several bends, due to our small living room) and the boys had races seeing who could crawl through the fastest.  We also play with the balls a lot....although rarely in the actual tents.  My boys are super rough with this and I have been impressed with how it has stood up to the trampling.  The long tunnel is a little bent from the boys jumping on it, and a few of the wires on several of the tents got a little bent, but I have found that if you wiggle them around a bit they sort of pop back into place.  For as active as this keeps them and how long it has engaged their interest I think this is highly worth it.

product_title: Magic Pengel: The Quest For Color
review_body: I go into games with an open mind- even if I'm far out of the intended age range for them. Starting Magic Pengel, it reminded me a lot of [[ASIN:B0009KFA5Q Graffiti Kingdom]] and [[ASIN:B0002EJ87K Amazing Island]]. These were both games that I laughed at myself for playing, because I felt far too old for them, but I still enjoyed and played to completion. Like those games, Magic Pengel allows you to draw and create whatever you desire to use throughout the storyline (with varying success, based on your patience with the in-game drawing mechanic). But unlike Graffiti Kingdom and Amazing Island, Magic Pengel simply couldn't keep my attention. The plot is much thinner and I feel that even the innovative drawing mechanic was lackluster in comparison to games intended for similar age ranges, and while those other games can still appeal to older gamers with the novelty of this gameplay mechanic, Magic Pengel just can't because it doesn't contain the same charm.  If you're buying this for a younger gamer, they may still enjoy it, because the idea is still fun, but I'd highly recommend looking into other games that have employed this mechanic better, like the aforementioned two.

product_title: ALEX Toys Rub a Dub Draw in the Tub Crayons
review_headline: Comparison between Edushape and Alex bathtub crayons
review_body:
Updated review:
After buying the Alex \\"Draw in the Tub [[ASIN:B000G2FOLC Draw In The Tub Crayons (6)]]\\" crayons a few times, we wanted to give this one by Edushape a shot. Instead of writing a review of the Edushape version, I thought Ill write a comparison between the two to help other customers pick the one that suits them the best.
1. The \\"Draw in the Tub\\" crayons come in two versions although the product description doesnt say so. The cheaper one does come with the sponge ducky cleaner while the expensive one does. The crayons in the expensive pack[[ASIN:B00004U3FX Rub a Dub Draw In The Tub]] are longer resulting in more crayon write and playtime for the kid. The Edushape crayons are pretty small- about the size of the cheaper Alex version. The ducky sponge cleaner is good to have but once you have one, no point in going for the expensive pack.
2. Both crayons come off relatively easily- \\"relative\\" being the key word. If its erased soon after bath time, it comes off quickly without leaving a mess. If allowed to stay on, it gets harder to remove- occasionally warranting a bathtub cleaner. The Edushape crayons are a trifle harder to clean if you allow them to stay on for a day compared to the Alex version.
3. The biggest grouse I have with the Edushape one is that it crumbles pretty quickly compared to the Alex version. Both sets of crayons are designed for no more than a couple of days of use but when dropped and allowed to stay in a mug of water (yep, my toddler loves doing that), the Edushape crayons disintegrated fairly quickly.
4. Both sets of crayons come with 6 colors and they last one to two showers. No more than that. The bigger Alex crayons last for 3-4 days.
5. The packaging for both brands is deceptive in that the crayon holder is significantly longer than the crayon itself. The crayon holder is also pretty useless in holding the crayon intact. Not sure whats the real point behind the crappy holder design for both products.
6. A minor quibble with the Edushape crayons is that two of the colors- purple and yellow are so light that it requires special lighting to be spotted on a cream/white tub. I wish they chose darker colors instead.

Overall, both products are less than satisfactory but given the choices or lack of it in this segment, one gets to choose either of the two and go with it. I wish there was a third brand that truly created better bath crayons for kids. Seeing how much my toddler enjoys it, I would gladly pay more for a better product!

product_title: 4pc Fraggle Rock Gobo Boober Wembley Red Plush Set
review_body: The lacking inclusion of Mokey with this set is a flaw that makes it an almost unreasonable purchase now that Manhattan Toys has released their new set.  When I purchased this a couple years ago, this was really the only option--the other available plushes were either those from Sababa that looked a bit off or those from the 80s that were few and far between and usually in terrible condition.  The quality of these is pretty reasonable, considering. Our dog got Red and chewed her eyeball to pieces, but I was able to repair it to a nearly unnoticeable condition with some crazy glue and patience.  Wembley's shirt lost its button quickly and almost never stays on anymore.  And the seams do pull apart a bit.  The hair is another point of concern, as it tends to fall out a bit and is not consistent, plus Gobo's hair appeared singed when we got them.  And Boober's tail fell out altogether.  But overall, especially based on the availability of better versions at the time and the cost (I got them for around $30 in 2008) they were a good buy and I'm not unhappy at all.  It served its purpose for the time and made my daughter incredibly happy, but I would never pay $150 for them.  And now I'm considering getting the Manhattan Toys set as well, as they are much larger, include more characters, and appear to be of better quality.

review_body: I got this as a Christmas gift.  I've had a ball flying the Syma S107, and thought this would be a fun \\"bigger version\\" upgrade. review_body: My husband and I have been playing Fluxx since the very first edition was released.  We have since purchased almost every variation of it and have yet to be disappointed. review_body:

product_title: Littlest Pet Shop Activity Set My Collector Journal 2.0 Lady Bug
review_body: Apparently, this is not the \\"My Collector Diary II\\" which is required for the mail-in offer for a free leopard pet.  (Luckily, they honored our request for the newer current leopard offer instead of the former platypus that is written in the journal page to be submitted.)  You have to cut out a form from the journal with two pages which you put stickers on to mail in for a free pet shop pet.  When we removed the papers for the offer it really has nothing after that for my child to play with.  It is simply a few blank pages in a flimsy soft covered booklet. review_headline: Not worth it even at 80% off
review_body: I can't believe this thing ever sold for the list price, as I feel I overspent at 80% off. The Alex Toys cards are nice but the touch and feels are not really all that great -- some are just a smooth shinny surface and the pictures could be better. They have the upper and lower case letter on the ABC cards which is nice. The my first version cards are just a cut above. For starters, they're beautiful. They have suggested questions to ask your little one on the back and ideas for helping them learn the color or shape. They also have the color listed in four different languages on the back with correct way to pronounce them. I was thrilled the with My First series and while I will use the Alex Toys cards, I have to say I will buy the My First cards from now on.

product_title: Hamburgum
review_body: This is a cleverly designed game that really emphasizes strategy.  The gist of this strategic game is that players are wealthy merchants in the city of Hamburg (or alternatively, London) trying to gain prestige by donating to the construction of the city's major churches.  There are many elements to the game.  In order to have the supplies and money to donate to the churches, players have to build industry, accumulate goods, build ships, and sell what they make.  But they can't focus too much on the trade aspect of the game, or else they will lose opportunities to donate before other players do.    Each player has a token that the player moves between one and three spaces around a rondel, each space representing an activity that the player can perform; the affect of this is that a player can do one of only three particular activities during any turn, depending on where the player is on the rondel, and it makes players strategize about where they are positioned on the rondel relative to other players, considering what those other players might plan to do next.  This also eliminates the element of chance, as there are no dice or luck of a drawn card involved.    Because there are so many elements to the game, it can take a little while to learn all of the rules.  However, the game play itself is rather easy because the players' available actions are controlled by their movement around the rondel.

product_title: Cadwallon City Of Thieves
review_body: Cadwallon: City of Thieves is a new game from Fantasy Flight Games that was acquired from AEG.   The theme shines through as you and your fellow players are thrust into a world of thieves competing to steal the most treasure and to run out before time is over. Two to four players choose from a gang of thieves with their own special abilities. There is one group that calls themselves the Executioners whose skills and experience make them good thieves and are repulsed by the idea of stealing from the poor. However, the Nocturnis Gang, is cruel, greedy, and violent who always accomplish their mission and return with treasures while leaving corpses in their trails. Kaldern's Gang is made of veterans who came to Cadwallon to to make a fortune. Lastly, the Cursed Ones, are servants of their dark masters whose horrific plans bring them closer to the destruction of Cadwallon itself!     Every gang is given seven red action point tokens. Then the round counter is placed on square one of the action board and the militiamen are placed in the guardroom and the treasury. The treasure tokens are mixed up and placed on the gsmeboard facedown in each red outlined room. The mission cards are shuffled and three are placed face up on the adventure board. Five purple arcana cards are shuffled and given to every player. The players roll two dice and the player with the highest roll goes first. The players take turns placing their thieves on the edges of the board (deployment space)to begin the game with four spaces on each side of the board. One side appears to have 5 deployment spaces but it is actually only four.      At the start of every turn, the player draws one arcana card which can be played at any time as many as wanted except in battle where only one can be played by the attacking and defending players.Next, the player indicates which militiaman he wishes to move and rolls a die to see how many spaces he is moved. If a six is rolled, the militiaman does not move. Next, the player activates his characters one at a time. One action point may be used to move up to four spaces and then another point may be used to attack another character or pick open a lock on a chest on a roll of 1,2,3, or 4 on all characters. If attacking another character, both players roll two dice unless they play an arcana card or ability that alters that. The winner is the player that rolls the highest die roll and gets to move the loser three spaces away and take one treasure, or if no treasure is held, two ducat coins. In a tie, the attacker wins. A player can not attack another character and pick a lock with one character on the same turn. Also, a character can spend two tokens to bash open a chest and automatically take the treasure without needing to roll a die. Furthermore, a player can spend three action tokens to take a mission card and receive the bonus for each treasure that is written on the mission card as well as the value on the treasure itself. A new mission card is drawn to replace the old mission card. All of a character's movement must be completed at the same time and can not interrupt his movement to perform an action (fight or pick lock) and then resume his movement. Characters can not move through spaces with another character on it.      A character can only leave the town if the alarm has been sounded which is the beginning of turn five on the first mission. Characters may only leave through deployment spaces on the edge of the gameboard that is not blocked by rectangular portcullis pieces that are placed one by one by the players at the beginning of the alarm phase. It costs one movement to leave the town from the deployment space. Characters may only carry three treasures each. Once the game has ended, after turn seven on the first mission, all players must convert the treasures they managed to carry out of the town into ducat coins. Any treasures carried by characters left in the town are worth nothing and the players lose three ducat coins for each character that failed to leave the town. The player with the most ducats wins the game.   Now that I have explained the rules, I will give my opinion on the game.     PROS: The game takes 1-2 hours        The same stats on the characters makes the game more streamlined and faster pick up and play.        The art of the game is fantastic and the miniatures are highly detailed. They are even more beautiful painted.        The replayability is great because there are eight missions to play. All of them have unique rules added to the game.        The game is fun to play and easy to learn, but there is complexity that adds different strategies to win.  CONS: The game takes 1-2 hours which many could find to be too long and the set up time is around 10 minutes.        Many people complain that the characters have the same stats. They could have erased the numbers on the character cards          and made the art bigger. The same stats make the game much more streamlined, faster, and easier to play which is good             considering that this is supposed to be a light, fun game stealing treasures.        The miniatures come unpainted and the prepainted miniatures are pricy at $60 total for all twenty painted.        The replayability may not be great because every mission still has an end goal of getting the most ducat coins to win.      You can complain about the same stats, but after playing the game with four different groups of people, I agree with the decision to make them all the same. The game is long enough as it is, there shouldn't be a reason to slow down the game to look up every character's stats for picking locks, movement speed, and number of dice to roll while fighting. That would make the game more work than necessary and if one truly desires to play with different stats they can easily be changed with stickers and markers. Remember that this game is not supposed to be hardcore, but is supposed to be fast, tense, and filled with fun double crossing and backstabbing. Get rich or die trying is the best way to describe the game.

product_title: Toy Story 3 Lenticular Puzzle - Styles May Vary - (Pack of 2)
review_body: I was excited about receiving this product for my grandsons. When it arrived, however, there was only ONE puzzle, instead of two. Unfortunately I had opened the puzzle, and so could not return it for a refund or replacement. Quite a disappointment.

product_title: Tween Techno Messenger School Bag with Adjustable Shoulder Strap
review_body: I bought this for my 10 year old daughter and she loves it. It's well made and has plenty of room for books and binders and supplies. Recommended.

product_title: American Plastic Toy Utility ATV
review_body: purchased the merchandise for my grandson and daughter. it was in good shape and is a very  much used toy. I recommend it to everybody who is interested in this topy.

product_title: Syma S107/S107G R/C Helicopter *Colors Vary
review_body: Received the \\"Syma 3 Channel S107 Mini\\". Looks as if the package was previously used with the box smashed and halfway open. The backing for the batteries on the remote control were missing too. Charged the helicopter as instructed and took it for a 6 minute flight. Everything worked PERFECT. After another charge the tail rotor stopped working so it will only go Up and Down or Clockwise and Counterclockwise. Not too entertaining now.
