product_title: Radio Flyer My 1st Scooter Pink
review_body: Horrible. Can't turn. Trying to turn makes it tip over. Because steering is so hard and makes you fall, this scooter is a lot more difficult to ride than a 2 wheeler. It's a terrible choice for anyone but especially for a little one who's supposed to learn to ride a scooter on this thing.

product_title: LEGO Star Wars Darth Vader's TIE Fighter (8017)
review_headline: Looks cool, but a bit wobbly
review_body: As with most Lego toys it is easily assembled. Fairly well engineered, but I have to agree with other reviews that state the wing connections as weak. Connecting the wings to the main body is quite easy, but the design suffers a terrible wobble. They do stay put well, but they just...wobble a lot. Nothing a little super glue wouldn't fix if you had no intentions of ever taking it apart! The little flick fired \\"missiles\\" leave something to be desired. Neat idea, but they might shoot two feet if you hold it three feet off the ground and they bounce. Maybe it was a safety feature to keep them underpowered, but I really dislike it. Either way to me it's not some toy I will play with so I it's really not a big deal. It now sits next to my standard TIE in all it's glory! Great display pieces!

product_title: LeapFrog Learn & Groove8482; Musical Table
review_body: I purchased the Leap Frog Musical Table from Amazon last week, and my 8 month old daughter has been playing with it nonstop! She is just learning to stand and she will play with it until her little legs get too tired. Then I can pop the legs off and she can sit and play.  This toy is a refreshing change from most of the annoying, tinny, and repetitive baby toys out there on the market. It introduces baby to a variety of jazz rhythms and different instrument sounds (I love the trombone!) It also has the \\"ABC/123\\" mode, in Spanish and in English. Plus, it is about $15 cheaper (both on Amazon and in stores) than similar products made by other brands, which is nice. This is by far one of the best infant toys we have purchased.

product_title: The Original Stomp Rocket
review_headline: I Wish All Toys Were This Cool
review_body:
I bought this for my two-and-a-half year old son to use at a vacation house this summer. Based on the previous reviews, I didn't see any reason to go with the \\"junior\\" version, even though his age would suggest otherwise. I am so glad I made this purchase.

We took turns stomping the rocket - although he couldn't get them to go as high as I could, he still really got a kick out of stomping the rocket. I had to beg to take my turn! The rocket goes really high! Cheap thrills, for sure, but this is a legitimate educational tool as well (once he gets older).

We used it all weekend long, and again several times at home outside before the weather got cold. I am certain we'll bring it out again in the spring. This seems as durable as you could reasonably expect, and I won't hesitate to replace it if it breaks. Great for kids of all ages, I would say.

product_title: Zillionz Talking Cash Register - Blue
review_body:
We bought this because our 9 and 2 year old daughters like playing store. We bought it at a big box store for a very good price. It came with paper money, plastic coins, credit card, bar code stickers, and batteries. It has 3 language preferences, English, Spanish, and French. That feature keeps my oldest entertained every time she plays with this. The microphone is a very nice feature as well and as another reviewer mentioned it doesn't distort their voices. The number pad works the same way as a basic calculator.

We save some food boxes and containers for their store.(coffee creamer cans, band aid box, butter container, etc) We made copies of the bar code stickers too so we can reuse them. Our daughter was the one that figured out it will scan real bar codes. However, the prices are random that way. We've had this register for a month now and the kids still love playing with it. Plus, it's survived being dropped down the stairs. Oh, and our oldest used it at our yard sale for her snack/drink stand. I highly recommend this toy.

product_title: Chocolate Advent Calendar & Nativity Story
review_body: Okay, I cheated and opened some of the windows a bit early. The milk chocolate really is good, and there's plenty of chocolate for each day. If you're interested for the Nativity story, this Advent calendar is all but unique because it features bible verses that are written clearly in English (from my experience, other Advent calendars often feature bible verses that are poorly translated into English, or don't feature any story at all). As a longtime fan of Advent calendars, this chocolate Advent calendar definitely delivers as a gift for family and friends, young and old.  That said, I'm really here now to buy a few more before Dec. 1.

product_title: Barbie I Can Be Newborn Baby Doctor
review_body: I'm giving this for xmas so don't know yet if it will be a big hit, but it is for my 8 year-old granddaughter who will be having a new baby sister this year. I think she will get some good out of it.

product_title: Melissa & Doug Deluxe Doll-House Furniture- Living Room Set
review_headline: creative and well made doll house furniture
review_body: Most creative and well made of any doll house furniture I have seen.  Eye catching for my grand daughter.  Fosters her imagination.  Does have small working doors and drawers.  Each room of furniture comes very well packaged.

product_title: Sonic The Hedgehog 6 Inch Super Poser Articulation Figures Set Of 3 - 3 per Pack
review_body: These toys coming as a unit is affordable and fantastic! My grandson LOVES anything that has to do with Sonic the Hedgehog! Sonic-related items are hard to find and when found are WAY TOO PRICEY!!! Care is needed when playing with them as the parts do come apart. Most times they can be pressed back into place, but continuous treatment like that will damage the ends and parts will no longer lock in place. Otherwise, they are colorful, the size is good for easy handling and posing. Great investment for collectors as well!

product_title: WWE Large Rolling Backpack and Detachable Lunch Bag - Nice item for kids
review_body: My son is a HUGE wrestling fan, so he was really happy when I got him this backpack... He used it for the first 2 weeks of school, and I just returned it.  The handle broke..I saw it break.  We were walking into school and it just broke... and there wasn't anything heavy in the bag, and he walking down the school hall, not bumpy or outside.  So I glued that together.....then one of the straps broke and the other is frayed...  I had to return it and he is not happy! If this cost $10 I wouldnt care..I would let him keep it, but for $33.00, no way... I bought a new one from Lands End for $25.00 and it is high quality... Too bad, he really liked it....

product_title: Shrinky Dinks Holiday Fun
review_headline: Shrinky dink, shrinky dink, where for art thou Shrinky dink?
review_body: I am an artist, always searching for ways to push the limit with my artwork. Currently in my early 40's, I have yet to find something as extraordinary and unique as this \\"shrinky dinks\\".The first time I ever learned of Shrinky dinks was when I was a young lad, 26 I believe. I watched in amazement as our instructor showed us how to correctly shrink our objects, anticipating my turn at this amazing and unbelievable act. Oh how I cherished that miniature Elvis I created. To this day, no other art piece has meant more. After that however, I was never to use a shrinky dink, leaving me empty, cold and lonely. I tried over and over again to find a replacement, but it always ended in failures. But since I have found it once more, I'll never again let us part. I'll ignore all those burnt marks on my arms and those memories of betray when it let itself be used by others because dear sweet shrinky dinks,I know that with you by my side, I'll finally be able to sell my art work for millions and will no longer live in my mothers basement. For all of you reading this, uncertain on whether or not to buy this, listen closely: Buying a shrinky dink will change your life forever. So buy it, take that risk! :)

product_title: Yo Gabba Gabba Bath time Fun Bath Buddies
review_headline: They WARP! Then, what's the point?
review_body: Got these for my 4 yr old son to entice him to the bathtub with less resistance since he loves the show. The first time he tried them, most of them were NOT sticking to our smooth tile; maybe for a second once dipped in the bath water, but then they'd fall off again. This is when I realized that if they are a little warped, they don't stick flat enough to stay in place. Yes, they're thick, which I think is a disadvantage, because it makes them heavier and stiffer. I thought I could salvage them by sticking adhesive magnet strips on the backs and have my son use them on the fridge or closet door. But the magnets just ended up remaining stuck to the door and the YGG characters fell off - AGAIN! Now, I'm sticking clear packing tape over the magnet strips to have them stay together...whatever...

product_title: FashionWings (TM) White Feather Angel Wings & Halo for Newborn 0-6 Mo Babies
review_body: I bought these wings as a part of a costume for my 4 month old baby. She looked absolutely beautiful in them! We got many compliments. The downfall is that they are obviously used mainly for a photography session and are not very durable.. the feathers easily break off if they are bent. I never used the halo that came with the wings because as soon as I opened the package, feathers were flying everywhere! I ended up just using a pantyhose headband and big white flower clip and that did the trick as a \\"halo\\". The straps on these wings were also quite long, so I used a binky clip to hold them on in the middle and that worked perfectly. Overall, they are beautiful and did the job I wanted but not very durable. I love them anyway! :)

product_title: Crayola Beginnings Baby Pop and See
review_body: I was disappointed when this toy first arrived. I purchased it as a gift for my niece. It had obviously been opened and taped shut before it was sent to me. I returned it to Amazon. The next one arrived open as well. I sent it back and the item was then out of stock. I normally have great experiences with Amazon so this was very disappointing for me.     As far as the toy itself, I was pretty disappointed. I doesn't do as much as I thought it would. I thought the center of each piece would spin when connected, but the colors just become visible. Not that exciting!

product_title: Takaratomy Arceus (MC-70): Pokemon Monster Collection 2" Mini Figure
review_body: This figure was much anticipated for me and it was pretty good overall. The paint job is superb and the quality is good. I have a few problems though. The legs are of slightly different lengths, so the figure tilts a bit. The pose also makes it even harder to stand. The issue is very minor and the figure itself is good. Recommended for ages above 10.    ~Raika

product_title: BigMouth Inc Le Tooter
review_body: great sounds but hand or pooter needs to be wet. Without wetness sounds are very poor.

product_title: Melissa & Doug
review_headline: Cute but have touch up paint ready
review_body:
This kitchen is adorable. It's quick to set up (it took me about an hour with a little bit of help from DH who quickly got bored and ended up watching a movie while I set it up). When I was building it, it looked tiny but when my 3 1/2 yo woke up on Christmas morning, it ended up being a wee bit bit (yay, he'll get lots of use out of it).

Pros:
-Compact but still has a lot of playing area.
-You can stick it in the middle of a room for playing all around it. My son loves to play chef and is getting a kick out of handing us (his restaurant patrons) plates over the counter.
-Fits Melissa and Doug cookie sheets in the oven
-Seems really sturdy but still lightweight enough that I can move it when I need to vacuum or take it from the bedroom to the playroom.

Cons:
-The edges of the counter are already nicked. I'll be sure to take on of the smaller shelves to the hardware store to color match a little jar of touch up paint.
-The sink and faucet seem a little flimsy for the sturdiness of the rest of the toy
-The oven opens like a regular door instead of an oven. This makes no difference to my son but it bothers me a bit.
-No fridge. The cabinet under the sink has now been designated as the fridge. This is no big deal since the toy takes up very little floorspace. If my son's cooking toy collection grows any more we'll just make a small fridge from some Ikea cabinets (and paint it to match using abovementioned color matched paint).

Overall, we do like the kitchen. My son loves to play with it and I love that it's not a giant hunk of plastic that won't survive to hand down to our baby. The retro design is cute and makes it a toy that I wouldn't mind having in the living room if needed.

product_title: Barbie Video Girl Doll
review_headline: Doll is cute,Video is good outside, Horrible for inside shooting !!!
review_body: This doll was purchased(by request)for my daughter who turned 7 this week. Without a flash it was like filming in the dark. It was fairly easy to use. The editing software was not as easy. If you have studio lighting in your home you may not have a problem. I personally feel that this issue will result in a price reduction in the near future. We have decided to get a child friendly camcorder with a \\"Flash\\" and just get another Barbie doll. Thank you.

product_title: Labyrinth Game Board
review_body: The board showed up chipped.  Not bad enough to send back, but not good for a gift.    My big problem with this order is the company (Back To Basics Toys) gives out your address to everyone that has a catalog.  I do not like my mailbox jammed full of junk catalogs.  I called one company that was kind enough to tell me who they got my address from.  Don't order from this company unless you want a lot of catalogs.  Shame on Amazon for not looking out for their customers better than that.

product_title: How To Train Your Dragon Movie Deluxe 7 Inch Action Figure Zippleback
review_body: We bought the Zippleback and the Night Fury. The zippering of the zippleback does not really work, unless you want to painfully sit for a long time and try to zipper it and then it still does not hold well. Its hind legs are lamely attached at the body, so you can not even stand it up. Leave this one on the shelf. Now we also got the Night Fury and this one is cool, does cool things, and entertains the kids. Both are durable. the night fury gets played with, both our kids say the zipple back does nothing and is dumb.

product_title: Purple Rose Fairy Tutu with Petals
review_body: This tutu is so sweet and cute!  It has such a delicate look and feel but is holding its own with constant wear by my three-year old.  The petals sewn on the inside are so dear and the rose petal decal on the front makes it quite a statement for any aspiring ballerina/princess/fairy.

product_title: Swimways Baby Spring
review_headline: Lasted one round in the swimming pool before breaking.
review_body: Loved it until the seal where you inflate the float starting leaking the second time we used it!  Appears well made and sturdy when out of the box, maybe I just got stuck with a defective model.

product_title: Doctor Who - The Tenth Doctor's Sonic Screwdriver
review_headline: Not bad.  Better than a lot of licensed toys.
review_body:
One of my greatest pleasures has been introducing my young son to all of the geeky things that I love. He's taken to them like bees take to flowers. By far, his favorite geeky thing is DOCTOR WHO. I was so thrilled to be able to order him his own Sonic Screwdriver and he was absolutely tickled when he received it.

So, for a kid who loves WHO, the toy is great. I only noticed one sound, not two, but it was authentic and not loud enough to be annoying to parents. Also, mine didn't have the \\"Psychic Paper\\" pad for some reason. Still, the UV ink nib worked well, which was a big plus to my son. It seems sturdy enough, save for the pen tips, which I suspect won't stay on for long. It isn't quite as detailed as I would have hoped, but, again, I'm an adult. My son never noticed. When he picked it up, he became a Time Lord. In the end, that's what's important.

product_title: Lanlan 2x2 Speed Cube, Black
review_body: I bought this to get my 6 year old daughter with Cubing. I can already solve the 3x3x3 so when I got this I thought this would be a cakewalk. Boy was I wrong. I took me 30 minutes to finally figure it out.  The Cube itself is smooth and feels durable.

product_title: Mattel The Sing-A-Ma-Jigs - New Red
review_body: Someone got us this as a gift, I was very disappointed as, in my opinion, it is very ugly, the toy itself only worked properly for a couple of days and later just made a very creepy sound. As we couldn't return it, we threw it out within the week.

product_title: Safari Ltd Carnegie Scale Model Elasmosaurus
review_body: Our daughter LOVES everything dinosaurs and prehistoric so this was a perfect birthday gift. She also loves the fact that she can take them in the bathtub and that is where they are \\"suppose\\" to be.  Our daughter has a very large collection of animals,fairies, dinosaurs from schleich and we love their quality but they didn't have the underwater ones she had wanted so I decided to give these a try and I was not disappointed. They are of equal quality.

product_title: Baby Alive Bouncin' Babbles - Blonde
review_body:
I was very surprised to see that so many people had the same experience that I did. When this product was delivered to my door, the sound of a baby startled my dog and the delivery person, who was reexamining the box when I opened the door. I think the motion combined with the sound, in the box, gave an illusion that there could be a baby in there.

This toy is surprisingly durable and well built.

I found the audio and motion to be very repetitive. It simply did the same thing repeatedly. That's fine for the targeted age group, but I think anyone in the room will be annoyed very quickly at just how repetitive this toy's sounds are.

The major con I have for this product is that the legs make it uncomfortable for a child to use as a normal doll. I think this leads children to become bored with it quickly. They can't really walk it around or cradle it... it just bops up and down and makes a few baby noises.

If you're looking for this exact sort of item, rest assured it is built to bop up and down and make one of a few baby noises very reliably, but I have to conclude this is quite a poor value for the money.

product_title: Foam Sword [Toy] Style/Colors May Vary
review_body: I got this for my five-year old who loves the Nerf swords.  This one has not been played with much because the sword is all foam--it has no resistance for when he \\"fights\\" with someone else.  If this is what you want, then it's great.  No one should get hurt with this thing, which is good.

product_title: EverEarth Jr. Ramp Racer. Race Track for Toddlers and 4 Wood Cars, Race Car Ramp Set
review_body: I was really excited when I opened the package. The ramp is beautiful but there were no cars included. I searched everywhere including the box it was packed in. So I'm hoping the shipper will send me the cars so my kids can have fun with this toy.

product_title: KidKraft Pink Retro Kitchen and Refrigerator
review_body: Bought this for a four year old.  She loves it.  Compares to kitchen at Pottery Barn for kids, but much much less price.  No assembly and being two pieces is great, you can move it around in different configurations.  Had it for months now and nothing has broken on it.  Just the right size for little hands and so convenient that it came right to the door.  Love it!

product_title: Walkie Talkie Nickelodeon SpongeBob Square Pants
review_headline: Poor Sound, don't work well at all.
review_body: Save yourself some time and just pay the extra money for something that actually works. My 6 year old got very frustrated with not being able to talk on them.

product_title: Gormiti Series 1 Mini Figure 10-Pack Assortment B (Tasarau)
review_body: My sons love gormitis and can spend hours playing with them. But I made a mistake and didn't read the full description. I saw the word mini and purchased them. I was searching for mini gormitis, actually small gormitis about 1 inch high or so.  We have a few this size and were hoping for more to fit inside the Gormiti volcano. These are regular size gormitis that will provide a lot of fun for my boys.

product_title: LeapFrog Scribble and Write
review_body: the little 5 year old receiving it was behind in school.  it really taught her the alphabet and how to write it -- so she is up to speed.

product_title: DIY Children's First Puzzle Clock
review_headline: Clock is ok but works for 3 min then stops
review_body: The clock is OK but works for about 3 min then stops. It is good for education to teach your child how a wind up clocks work. The toy is fun to build but a little frustrating also. I sent the clock because it didn't work right.

product_title: Transformers Movie Voyager Thundercracker
review_body: Thundercracker is back with a sweet upgrade!I actually have all 4 of these figures including Starscream,Skywarp,and Ramjet.Thundercracker is a sweet addition to his comrades.The detail of still keeping the G1 influence on this figure is outstanding.The durability and poseability is an A+.The transformation is advanced so if you have plenty of experience with transformers it is not that difficult.If you are a parent buying for a child of 5-6 or younger you will have to provide some help with the transformation process.Thundercracker has the same body mold and vechicle form as the other three as well.He has 6 missiles that can attach to his arm cannons in robot mode and go under the wings in F-22 Raptor mode.Bottom line Thundercracker is a high quality,well-made,10 out of 10 figure which all transformer fans should enjoy.I highly recommend Thundercracker to all transformer fans out there.Transformers Rock!!!!!!!!!!!!

product_title: LeapFrog My First Book: Good Night Scout
review_body: This was a gift.  I have not heard from recipient but assume it is as durable and enjoyed as much as the previous LeapFrog 'My first book' series.

product_title: Barbie In The 12 Dancing Princesses - Princess Lacey African-American Doll
review_body: I bought all 3 of these dolls for my daughter when she was 4.  My daughter took ballet and loved the 12 Dancing Princesses DVD, so I thought she would enjoy having the dolls to do ballet. She loved watching the dolls spin around.  It was great fun at first, but spinning around was all the the dolls did.

product_title: Connectagons
review_body: These are brightly colored and easy for my four-year-old to connect. We bought the basic set and the \\"under the sea\\" set. The sea set has bases to build on. They are slim pieces of wood that you can build towers from and connect to make a \\"connectagon\\" world. Many of them have broken. They are made from a very brittle \\"balsa-like\\" wood. Very, very delicate. They also create fairly dangerous splinters when they break. Otherwise, this is a great toy.

product_title: Kismet, Dice Poker Game of Modern Yacht
review_headline: if you like Yacht (or Yahtzee), you'll love Kismet!
review_body: If you're accustomed to the rules and scoring method of Yahtzee, you'll easily transition to this game.    The colored pips add the element of rolling pairs and flushes.    I agree with the other reviewer that the print on the score sheets enclosed in this travel-sized edition is very small...you may literally need a magnifier to read it.    Larger score sheets are available in the standard box set and also on the internet for download and printing (just plug \\"Kismet score sheet\\" into your search engine of choice).    With this particular Kismet set, I was impressed with the quality of the dice. I recently bought a similarly packaged version of Yahtzee which had come with relatively poor quality dice, but these Kismet dice appear well-made (different manufacturers/different QA standards apparently).    The price for this edition is also VERY good!

product_title: Disney Princess Bath Beauty Belle Doll
review_body: My daughter was so excited to spend her birthday money on this toy, only to get it home, wait all day for a bath and then when the time came nothing happened with the color change. I did re-read and noticed it said cold water, so we tried cold water - nothing....don't buy the toy for the color change - as a bath tub toy, it's ok.

product_title: Crocodile Creek's Dinosaur Pocket Lunchbox
review_body: I first saw this Lunch Box at Whole Foods but I didn't like the price tag - so when I saw it at Amazon for a lot less I had to get it.  The lunchbox is super roomy and easily fits everything that I pack for my son.  I love the fact that it has structure and it maintains its shape.  My daughter has a Thermos Lunchbox and it is constantly falling over because the sides are soft with no structure whatsoever.  I also love that it is a healthier alternative.  The design is bright and fun and definately appeals to my son.  Will definately be buying more from this company in the future.

product_title: Fisher-Price iXL 6-in-1 Learning System (Pink)
review_headline: Companion software makes the device virtually useless
review_body: I bought the device and four software titles for my daughter for Christmas.    I am a tech-savvy user, a part time web developer. I can't imagine someone who has trouble with computers attempting to install anything on this device. I have been working with it for well over an hour, and still have not been able to load a single software onto it. After loading the initial software for the device (which MUST have admin rights to run) I got numerous error messages. Upon attempting to run the software for the first time, it requires connecting to the internet to download a 90mb update. The software will not allow a bypass to the update, and will not run without it.    The download has stopped three times now (lost connection to their server) and each time it restarts, it restarts from the beginning.    The software titles themselves come with a notice in the case, telling you that it will be necessary to connect to the internet to update the software. Apparently they are too cheap to burn new disks, and instead insist that the customer must go through the effort of attempting to download something from a crappy download manager connected to an unreliable server.    This is a huge disappointment from a company like Fisher Price.  My frustrations with this device, the poor software development, and terrible customer support, I will not be purchasing a Fisher Price electronic device ever again.

product_title: Chessex Dice: Pound of Dice (Pound-O-Dice) Approximately 100 Die
review_headline: One can never have too many dice
review_body: Good quality dice... I got 102 plus the dice set in the bag. Only one had a corner chipped off, which I tossed, but all the rest were in perfect condition. Most were \\"full-size\\" dice too, only a few tiny little 6-siders in there. Overall a great buy!

product_title: Star Wars 94254 R2-D2 Interactive Astromech Droid, 17.1 x 11.7 x 11.5-Inch (Discontinued by manufacturer)
review_body: We bought this toy 5 years ago for my son.  R2 is still out and played with many times a year.  He generally helps give out Halloween candy with me every year and the neighborhood kids ask for him.  I've read a lot of the complaints an suggest that most might be user error or impatience.  Remember It is obviously NOT R2D2 of the movies with an actual brain.  If it is in motion the voice receptor is off (says this in the info)  you tap it lightly on the head and it stops to \\"listen\\" You basically have to wait for the right response from R2.  \\"Hey R2?\\"  (He turns his head and tweets) Do you remember (pause -  He tweets again ) \\"Princess Leia?   (R2 acts excited moves around - turns on his light and transmits the audio message \\"Help me Obiwan Kenobi...\\"  Great fun.  Uses infrared to play hide & seek - he once found the warm laundry fresh from the dryer due to its heat :)  The current Amazon Site says     But a child's first response on seeing this is to blurt out in one quick sentence \\"Hey R2 do you remember Han Solo?\\"  - Not the proper cadence, so the simple processor can't keep up and r2 just shakes its head.  If you take the time to read the literature, speak clearly and modify YOUR actions a bit The R2 is a great toy.  Frustrating for little kids who still believe R2 is alive - Magic for adults and older kids who take time to learn how to control him.

product_title: Ultra Pro White Deck Protectors 100 Sleeves
review_body:
I thought these were the ones for Yugioh since the ones I already have are also ultra pro
these pictures were misleading
next time I will check all the reviews and see if they really for yugioh and not magic sleeves

product_title: Disney Princesses Classic Film Collection Ultimate 10 Doll Gift Set
review_body:
The dolls are really high quality and well made. They're also articulated! The dresses are pretty authentic and it's great to have them all in one collection.

The one I'm least fond of is Tiana. I think they could've made her look better. Or done her hair differently. Rapunzel probably could've been better, too, but her hair is super long! Which will make my daughter happy. :)

It's also great to see that they didn't leave out Mulan and Pocahontas. It's really hard to find dolls of them.

Good for the people who got them on Black Friday! Wish I had one to sell!

product_title: Rubba Bandz Shaped Rubber Bands Bracelets 12Pack Guess Who
review_headline: Good bracelets with some good celebs.
review_body: Very happy, but more variety would have been good.  Worth it for the Marilyn Monroe and Alfred Hitchcock.

product_title: Child's Toddler Classic Batman Halloween Costume (Size: 2-4T)
review_body: I was surprised at the high quality of this Halloween costume!  So many costumes are kind of flimsy; this one is well made, lots of nice details and will hold up through a lot of my 4 year old son't abuse.  It's not even Halloween and he's worn it many times already and it still looks brand new.  Easy to clean too, and it fits him perfectly!  Thank you, it continues to make me smile!  Susan

product_title: Great Planes Pluma 3D EP ARF RC Airplane
review_headline: An Excellent First Foam Flyer ARF ...
review_body: I have two Great Planes ARF foamies and I have to say that G.P. kits are Very Complete, Very Well Thought Out & come with Very Good Instruction Manuals. All in all I would highly recommend Great Planes & Electrifly products to anyone interested in this low-cost area of RC flying. (just be sure to use foam safe glues!).

product_title: Marvel Legends: Monsters Action Figure Gift Pack
review_body: Bought this for my son, who's obsessed with monsters. Can't wait to bring them out for Halloween!

product_title: Transformers Movie Performance Track
review_headline: Great fun, but cheap cardboard pieces
review_body:
The awesome transformer logos an set pieces?
All cheap cardboard. It doesn't show in the
pictures well, but it's basically baseball card thin cardboard.

Won't last more than a week, after that it's just a car
set, but still great fun for kids.

product_title: Royal Rescue
review_body: This toy is absolutely great.  My youngest sees them as fun blocks, my 4 year old can do lots of the challenges and my 6 year old LOVES it.  We took it out of town with us in lieu of a puzzle and got lots of use out of it.  I even like to do it myself (it's hard if you don't think out of the box!)  Highly educational and provides feelings of pride and accomplishment.  Can't recommend it more!

product_title: Melissa & Doug Dry-Erase Marker Set (4 pc)
review_body: As pictures, great product. Thick tipped dry-erase markers that provide hours of drawing fun for my daughter on her easel.

product_title: Peanuts Animated Musical Christmas Snoopy Doll with Santa Hat and Red Present
review_headline: Nice size; best song for Christmas memories
review_body: This is a nice-sized stuffed Snoopy (about a foot tall), and it plays the song that you will recognize from the TV movie.  I found that many of the Snoopy or Peanuts animated dolls play songs that are SIMILAR to what you would expect, but this stuffed animal plays the song you will expect to hear.

product_title: ASOX 6pc Set of Slingshot Flingshot
review_headline: Lot's of fun, bad quality control
review_body: You need to be lucky with this tool, but it's lot of fun. I ordered two a year ago and had to return one as the volume was very low (almost couldn't hear it). The other two work perfect, they scream loud and funny.

product_title: Mattel Ghostbusters Exclusive 6 Inch Action Figure Peter Venkman with Slimer
review_headline: I Came, I Saw, I Gave a Review!
review_body: Another great figure from Mattel!  This figure greatly captures Bill Murray's likenesses.  Venkman comes with everyone's favorite little spud.

product_title: Winfun Symphonic Grand Piano
review_body: We got this for our 3 year old daughter for Christmas and she loves it.  It's made of plastic, but I'm sure she will get plenty of play out of it before anything happens to it.  She's already flipped it over twice and it hasn't broken yet.  I would definitely recommend this toy for a 3 year old.  The only flaw is that the microphone holder won't stay in place.

product_title: IRRESISTABLE ATTACK TOY ARMY MEN AND PLASTIC MILITARY VEHICLE SOLDIER PLAYSET by McToy
review_body: I bought this set and it sucked. when it arrived the trucks were broken the vehicles were off scale and there was a crappy play mat if you are a good buyer then please, do not buy this set.

product_title: Disney Pocahontas Figure Figurine Collection Set of 12
review_body: These figures are cheap Disney imitations.  I have tons of disney figures and these are the cheapest, crappiest made ones I have ever seen.  I am VERY dissapointed.

product_title: Kung Zhu Battle Arena
review_body: The quality of this toy is amazingly poor!  The battle arena doors are so poorly molded that they bind horribly and won't let the hamsters in the arena and don't close if they do happen to get one open.  I had to get out my Dremel and shave off a LOT of plastic to get this thing to work.  We also got three of the hamsters and one had a bad motor right out of the box and wouldn't move at all even with fresh batteries.  Beware of this low quality product!  Even once heavily modified so that it works, the hamsters are finicky to get to work properly.

product_title: Strawberry Shortcake 16" Classic Plush Doll
review_body: Only for the dedicated Strawberry fans.  Buy one while there still around.  Your kid will never let it go.

product_title: Spy Gear Walkie Talkies
review_body: I guess there's a reason that they don't list the range for these - it's virtually non-existant!  My son and I played around with these in our house and the range was 5-7 feet.  At that range they're useless as we could hear each other directly instead of via the radios.  Even though they were very inexpensive ($10) they are definitely not worth it.  We've returned them and will purchase something else.

product_title: Toysmith Wind-Up Diver
review_body: This diver was bigger than I expected it to be. We haven't tried him out yet cause he is going in my little guys stocking for x-mas. But so far...by the looks of it...NEAT!

product_title: FashionWings (TM) Newborn Baby White Feather Angel Wings, Halo & Poster Set
review_body: This item was great, so cute on my baby and very pretty.. The pictures turned out nice

product_title: Ideal Fuzzoodles Jumbo Plush Construction Kit
review_body: The packaging matters not to me or my children. So, when we opened the brown boxes and let spill the colorful contents onto the table, the fun began. The product itself provides hours of entertainment. My girls are 4 and 8 years old, and they had a blast coming up with all kinds of creations. Honestly, I was surprised how much fun this product provided.

product_title: Ben 10, Ultimate Alien, Terraspin Action Figure, 4 Inches
review_body: This figure is featured on the box for the new disk Ultimatrix, but the Terraspin voice does not work with the Ultimatrix.  A real disappointment.  The figure is OK, not great.  My kids managed to rip the arms and shell of within a few minutes.

product_title: Parris Sportsman Shotgun
review_body: First off, this thing looks bad-ass, it fires great(not as far as a real airsoft gun) it jams every once in awhile but its easy to fix with a hanger. i give the design 5 stars but the bullets curve a little and takes some of the accuracy away. Buy it if you are starting out at airsoft or just want to shoot some target practice. Besides accuracy its a great buy for the money.

product_title: Outward Hound Kyjen  PO00261 Pooch Pick-Up Dog Poop Bags with d2w Plastic Unscented, 100 Ct, Green
review_body: I used to be able to purchase this product at the local  pet supply stores, but for some reason they no longer carry it.  The one store suggested I go online. I did & found them.   HAPPY DAY!!  I did find out after I had purchased these that there  was another website where the product was cheaper.  Oh Well, live & learn....at least I have the product now.  I like it because it is considered a \\"green\\" product.

product_title: 1:24 GreenLight SE - Corvette C6 - Cyber Gray
review_headline: GreenLight Cyber Gray Corvette Mini Me
review_body: The whole reason I bought this GreenLight diecast is that it is almost an exact replica of my husband's full size 2009 Cyber Gray C6 Corvette. The two tone interior on the model is the same color scheme as his car. The only thing that does not match is the wheel style.  He has several GreenLight diecasts and their quality for a non-collector priced product is very good.

product_title: LeapFrog Text and Learn
review_body: I bought this for my 4 year old grandaughter. She loves it. The first day, she had already learned to play several of the games and was spelling 3 letter words by memory. Then her little sister who is 3 and a little slower at catching on started playing the game and by the next day, she was spelling a few 2 and 3 letter words. My daughter is happy about their progress. Thank you.

product_title: Tech Deck Sheckler Warehouse - Ramp with Rail
review_body: This is one of the most fun, and most challenging ramps i own, and i own several! It is very tough too. This is an awesome ramp for anyone who enjoys fingerboarding!

product_title: Falcon X mini indoor 3 Channel Co-Axial RC Helicopter with Gyro
review_body: Two big issues with this:  1.  Not durable, you will crash while learning to fly and rotors, flyweights, will bend or break. 2) After a brief time (1-2 days worth of use) the copter's internal battery will no longer accept a deep charge sufficient to power the thing off the ground.    So another toy that is truly a throwaway, lasted less than 3 days and result was a sad little boy (blaming his dad)    As Always, the Customer is the Test Lab.

product_title: Duck Tub Tattoo
review_body: These tub stickers were a great choice; they are fun and playful, and have a good textured surface to prevent slipping. Two things to note: one package will not cover the entire tub, so you should buy two. Also, follow the directions for application carefully; make sure the tub is clean and dry before you apply, or they will not stick completely.

product_title: Fisher-Price Blocks
review_body: I used this product to train my dog.  It lasts pretty well against lots of teeth!  It's a good tool to shape and encourage creative thinking in a dog.

product_title: Moon Dough - Magic Barnyard
review_body: I can't say enough bad things about this stuff!  It is nothing like play dough-you think play dough is messy..think again.  The shapes don't turn out 99 percent of the time.  It is not worth your penny!!  I promise.  Buy play dough or better yet save your money and MAKE play dough instead.

product_title: UPD INC 205291 Disney Minnie Plush Backpack
review_body: When the description says \\"small compartment\\", that's an exaggeration! the 'compartment' has a 2 1/2\\" zipper, too small for my 2 yr. old's hand. You may be able to put a dollar in it IF it is a folded bill. Mickey and Minnie are cute but the shoulder straps are very stiff and scratchy. It's fine if your child just wants to carry their stuffed toy on their back but if you're shopping for a USABLE backpack, forget this one and keep on shopping.

product_title: BANZAI Junior My First Water Slide
review_body: It's really fun for my kids 3 and 1. But it took forever to blow up and the part where the water shoots out for the slides shoots way too high. It was watering my tree on the hills instead of doing it's job of keeping the slide part wet. But overall my kids love playing in it and it was worth the money.

product_title: MAXEB 16GB USB Flash Drive
review_body: I bought this as a gift for my brother. We're both Star War nerds. As for the Star Wars aspect of it... it's awesome.   It's a bit larger than I'd expected. Also, it doesn't have anywhere to attach a chain or anything, so I reckon it'd be easy to lose for people who aren't careful. It looks hilarious though.. and it's 4gb, which is a great amount of space.

product_title: Fisher Price Sesame Street Many Kisses Elmo
review_headline: 3 year old boy loves this toy
review_body: My 3 year old boy got this for his 3rd birthday and he Loves it. He loves to make Elmo kiss and loves to kiss him and loves to get others to kiss Elmo to. I don't really understand why all the toys on amazon seem to be so expensive though.  Grandma got this toy at Walmart for like 16.99.  Either way my little man loves it and will carrying it around everywhere.

product_title: Mega Bloks Mister Fluffy's Bakery
review_headline: Mister Fluffy is a Toughie (In a Good Way)
review_body: Great introduction to the \\"Mega Blocks\\" world. Is not overwhelming for a kid. Durable and sweet. Good value for your bucks.

product_title: White Mountain Puzzles Last Supper
review_headline: Lovely puzzle of Jesus and the last supper
review_body: I purchased this puzzle for my mother on her birthday and she loved this puzzle.  She loves to work on puzzles.  She worked on it a long time.  The ceilings, floor area were the hardest areas and if you want a little challenge this puzzle will do it.  She glued it and hung it up and it looks great.  I didn't work on it but a few times myself but when I did those areas I mentioned were hard as the color variation was just slightly off making it much harder to do. I love the colors of the puzzle. She had fun and really that is what these puzzles are all about, plus this one has it's inspirational message in the Last Supper.  It makes a nice gift for those who like puzzles and a nice picture if one chooses to make it one.

product_title: Transformers Movie 2  Deluxe Autobot Skids and Mudflap
review_body: The product description says that the product is 12 inches.  It's not.  The packaging is.  Don't buy it.  It's small.

product_title: Mattel The Sing-A-Ma-Jigs - Red
review_body: A friend bought this toy for my baby a couple of months ago. At first I thought it was a little odd looking, but after playing with it for a few minutes I was sold and even more importantly, so was my daughter. She is now 11 months old and loves getting it to talk by squeezing the hand. She also thinks its great fun to stick her fingers in the mouth as I make it sing. She can't quite make it sing by herself yet, but she is close to figuring it out. It is not a toy that I would leave in her playpen with her since it has plastic eyes, however we enjoy playing with it together a lot.

product_title: Syma Apache 3 Channel Mini RC Helicopter
review_headline: Great buy for under $20, but a operational gyro would be better
review_body: I have always wanted a radio control heli, but they were always too expensive. Over the years the prices have dropped & they started making cheaper smaller minis like this one. I decided to buy this one & give it a whirl (pun). It is actually very fun to fly.     The range is good, the charge time of 20 minutes is not too long, & after fully draining the battery you get get a better charge & longer flight time. My biggest gripe about this heli is that it lacks a stabilizing gyro. The tail prop works but only if you fly forwards & backwards.     Everytime you give it substantial throttle when ascending & descending it starts spinning. The trim button remedies this but I feel its too much work to control it. I ended up flying into the walls I was trying to fly away from becaus when I would try to use the throttle to ascend or hove it would spin & point right into the direction I was trying NOT to gon in. I just ordered the S107 because it has a gyro & I hear its much easier to control. But for $17.50 what do you expect? Its a tough heli because I crashed it alot & its still in one piece.

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Aquarium
review_body: I love this thing - when my son wakes up in the middle of the night, he just pushes the button and the music helps him go back to sleep.  Worth every penny.

product_title: Fisher-Price Mickey Mouse Clubhouse Singing Mickey
review_body: I ordered this for my grandaughter and when I received the toy he would only sing one song over and over.  I was not happy at all with this toy.  I returned to seller and I still have not seen the credit to my Visa card.    Thank you for your attention to this matter.

product_title: Fisher-Price TRIO Building Set
review_body: As a preschool teacher( 3-5 year olds), I'm always looking for new building materials and these are awesome!  My students can build anything and everything out of them, a great way to get them to use their imaginations!  They are the most \\"popular\\" set of blocks we have!  They are definately worth the money!

product_title: Buddy Bands - Dragons - 12 Pack 2X Double Wrap Bands, Tie Dye Colors (Compare to Silly Bandz, Zany Bands, Goofy Bands, Disney Bands, and Stretchy Shapes) Check Out All the Buddy Band Shapes and Styles!
review_headline: My girls 8 and 9 loved the dragons
review_body: My girls were so happy when they received their dragon bands. They are so colorful.  Perfect for trading since many kids do not have these.

product_title: Nerf N-Strike Deploy CS-6 Blaster
review_headline: first pump action, best range, best gun!
review_body: This gun is awesome!I love the pump action cocking unlike the recon where you cant cock fast and support the gun at the same time. this gun doesnt only have fast cocking, but also good range. the accuracy isnt the best, but its better than nothing. when i had my first fight with it, my neighbor hogged it all to himself and hit me right between the eyes. i ended up not using it that day until he left.pretty much, who ever uses that gun will win.

product_title: Naruto Shippuden Naruto Symbol Wallet
review_body: i loved this as soon as i saw the photo, all thought it seemed like a sleek white, it was just a grayish average wallet feeling, still very cool, it has 3 card slits, and two large slits, no picture areas, though, and of course the large slit for cash. the design seems durable, and the metal symbol on the front has a nice solid feeling to it. the chain seems like any other chain, very nice and strong, i have no doubt that it wont break easily, on one end of the chain is a belt attachment, and on the other is a little clip like device that attaches itself onto the wallet, the clip that attaches itself to the wallet seems to kind of deform the ring part of the wallet if you have the wallet in your back pocket and sit for longs period of time, but overall i love this product, i don't regret buying it, its very cool if you are a naruto fan, and also great if you just need a wallet to carry a few bucks around in style.

product_title: Little Tikes Endless Adventures Jr Play Slide
review_body: I was a little disappointed with the slide.  My grandaughter was 18 months old when I got it and the lenght of the slide isn't very long.  Plus the end of the slide should be above ground so the child doesn't hit the ground which it is not.  I would not recommend this slide.

product_title: Fullmetal Alchemist Anime Cosplay Pocket Watch
review_body: Perhaps my most awaited ordered item! I was a little worried about it, because the estimated arrival was the 16th and it arrived today, the 18th, so I was worried I wouldn't get it. But it was SO worth the wait!

product_title: Melissa & Doug Sticker Collection - Blue
review_headline: tons o' stickers - wish there were some more everyday objects and gender mix
review_body: My nearly 2-year old recently discovered and loves stickers.  Every night he requests coloring time, and we pull out the sticker book and blank pad of paper and crayons.    The sticker quality seems good - sticks well to paper and does not stick as well to other surfaces (this is handy for peeling off walls, floors, furniture). Love the volume and variety of stickers on each themed page.  My only beef is with the content - the sports page was awesome.  But, I think I only found 1 girl in the whole package on the pirate page. I realize its the \\"boy\\" set... but there are female police officers, mechanics, and sports players in real life. Also, maybe we're not at that age yet... but I would rather have a page of \\"everyday\\" objects (stuff from the kitchen, house, or nature) rather than a page of space aliens.     The stickers are such a good storytelling aid, seems a shame to leave out more approachable material.

product_title: 7 in 1 Wood game set including Chess, Checkers, Backgammon, Dominoes, Cribbage and more
review_body: This item looked to be high quality. It arrived broken. I hot-glued the pieces back together. Now other parts are falling apart. It's a chess game. It's not like we're throwing it around the backyard.    I'd keep shopping.

product_title: Toy Story 3 Jessie 6" Posable Figure
review_body: Nice toy. Wish it were more durable as my 2 yr old has already broken a previous one. Hat seems to fall off all the time and can easily be lost. Other than that he seems to like it, especially since he owns other toy story toys.

product_title: VTech V.Smile TV Learning System
review_headline: Poorly made, but it has its moments.
review_body: My daughter's loved games since she was 2, starting with the Nintendo DS. She'll be 4 in less than 2 months, and she's enjoying a lot of platform games like LittleBigPlanet, Donkey Kong Country and the first couple Super Mario Bros. games. She got the V.Smile system for her birthday earlier this year, but hasn't used it a whole lot. Some of the reasons being that, like other customers have pointed out, the system is selective on working, but also because the games can get a bit boring at times. Usually I don't just list out pros and cons, but that's probably the best way to go about the V.Smile, and I don't want to be one-sided on the product when it does have some positive things about it.    Pros:    -You can switch the joystick around so it can be for left or right handed kids. This is VERY cool of them to do, and something they didn't have to include.  -Big, bright buttons that are easy to remember the locations of.  -It uses game cartridges instead of discs, so you don't have to worry about games being too scratched to play.  -The games we've bought so far are more of the standard platform game while being educational, rather than being a learning tool first, and a fun game second.  -Some games have a 2 player option.  -Surprisingly good audio for a cartridge-based system.    Cons:    -The carts sometimes can't be read, and you have to blow into the bottom of them like the NES days.  -The joystick isn't very stable, and can spin around when you move it, making controlling your character hard at times.  -The controller and system both feel flimsy, and if they drop on any hard surface, they're pretty much toast.  -Sometimes the system doesn't start up, even when the cords are plugged in properly, and the cart is pushed in all the way. You'll get a constant loop of the V.Smile start up screen until you turn it off, then try again.  -A lot of the games are overpriced for the content they provide, and you're better off getting them used.    There might be more prosin my view, but the cons are pretty big ones. Regarding the games being fun or sometimes repetitive, it depends on what you get. Some of the more fun ones that I've seen are the Wow Wow Wubbzy, Go Diego Go and Backyardigans one. Those are great for kids 2-4. There are games that lean more toward the educational side (SpongeBob comes to mind here) rather than being regular games, but kids have to be more familiar with numbers and things like greater than/less than in terms of weight. The V.Smile can be a good purchase, and the price isn't too bad. But some games cost nearly as much as the system, and when it won't work at times, then it's hard to say much in the system's favor. If you have friends or relatives who have one of these, give it a test before deciding on buying one for your kids.

product_title: DC Universe Super Enemies Figure Pack-Cyborg Superman / Mongul Figures 2-Pack
review_body:
I like to casually collect the DCUC line of figures for display-only. The sculpts on these two figures are VERY good, and the detail is incredible. The Mongul figure is pretty flawless. The only reason this two-pack doesn't get 5 stars is because the Cyborg Superman figure is a little limited on the posing ability. His arms don't seem to have the range of motion as other DCUC figs, and his legs and spread a little far apart. His cape also had some weirdness on the back where it looked like it was made from separate pieces and didn't melt together completely, so there is a weird square-shaped seam. But, from the front, he looks great. They seem very sturdy too, especially the Mongul figure.

Oh, and I rated the \\"educational value\\" of the toy as four stars, not because it will teach kids anything \\"useful,\\" but because the sculpts and paints are so good that you can use them as a reference if you'd like to draw these characters accurately, which I do. :)

product_title: Elenco  9440 Breadboard With JW-350 Jumper Wire Set
review_body: Purchased this breadboard as a hobbyist expanding my knowledge in electronics.      The board itself is nicely sized (large), and allows for pretty decent sized circuits to be constructed.  Basically, it is 4 standard breadboards side by side, with an additional bus strip run horizontally on the top, all connected to a solid backing.  4 binding posts allow for additional external components to be connected.  It looks like it should last quite a while if treated well.    The jumper wires are of a very wide length of sizes, and allow for easy color coding when working in complex circuit prototyping.  The box the come in (clear instead of the blue shown) allowed for easy organizing of the different sizes.    Overall, it's a pretty good combo, and reasonably priced for the size of board you get.  Other than that, it's not too complicated of an item, so there's not really much else to say.  2 Thumbs up!

product_title: Peg Perego Polaris 800 Twin Copper 24 V
review_headline: Peg Pergo Polaris 800 Twin Copper 24v - Review
review_body: I purchased this item in November of 2009 for a Christmas gift for my 5 yr old grandson.  I was initially very impressed with the speed that this item was delivered.    After receiving this item I followed all directions on the assembly of the item, and then charged the battery as per instructions. On Christmas day my grandson rode the electric 4-wheeler for only a few minites as it was snowing. The next day he rode it and the 4-wheeler stopped after about 5 minutes. Every time he rode it again after that it would laast for about 5 minutes, stop for about 10 minutes, and then he could ride for another 5 minutes. Very frustrating for me and my grandson! The over temp circuit was shutting off the motor.  The 4-wheeler runs great when it's working' Usually it gets just far enough from the garage to be a real pain to push back.  I contacted Pergo - they returned my email after about 1 1/2 weeks, I exchanged emails several times  over about 3 weeks, was willing to buy the new overtemp circuit card when they stopped all contact with me. Now this $500 dollar toy sits in my garage with maybe two hours total riding time on it after 11 months. My grandson weights maybe 35 -40 pounds, so I know he's not to heavy for it.    I'm very disappointed in the quality of the toy and the quality of the Customer service Department of Peg Perego. I will never buy another toy from them, and recomend that others do not either.    John J.

product_title: Take Along Thomas & Friends - Straight & Curved Track Pack
review_headline: MUST HAVE for Take and Play/Take Along trains and sets
review_body: This pack is more than worth the money.  If you're thinking about getting into the Take & Play line, I recommend to start with a couple of these track packs before getting any actual playsets.  If you look at each individual playset (no matter how big or small), almost all include a very limited amount of track.  In my opinion, most of them alone have very limited playability.  Both playsets I have for my son would almost be worthless without extra track.  No only that, but without track packs, it is literally impossible to connect any of them together in ways that would make sense or be fun to play with.  It's very obvious that the tracks are the most fun for my son.  The playsets are the parts that are \\"extra\\".    One of the GREAT things about these tracks is that you can make a layout that doesn't line up perfectly...  The connecting parts of the track pieces flex just enough to allow for this.  So you won't drive yourself crazy trying to change the track layout over and over because one piece is barely too long or short.  This is difficult to explain accurately, but if you buy one of these packs and put together lots of different layouts, you'll definitely \\"get it\\" and appreciate it.  And don't worry, what I'm trying to describe doesn't break the pieces...  I've set up multiple track designs now, and have not had any problems at all.  And there aren't any \\"stress marks\\" on the plastic that would indicate otherwise.  The track pieces are slightly flexible, but still very very sturdy.    I have bought my son a few of the larger playsets available for his upcoming birthday and Christmas, and I will probably buy 1-2 more of these extra track packs as well so they can all be connected and even more fun.    These truly are a MUST HAVE if you're wanting to get into the Take and Play line of engines and train cars.

product_title: D&D Gamma World Roleplaying Game: A D&D Genre Setting
review_headline: A good revisit to an old classic
review_body:
Evertime D&D changes editions there is a great outcry about how can they destroy the game or that they are just doing it to make a quid. Well yeah, they are a company, they need to make money. But far from ruining the game I believe that 4th edition D&D is an excellent product well worth the price. It don't say its perfect for their are a few house rules I enact to overcome the bits I think need fixing, but again, every game is like that.
And as for Gamma World, it is great as well. I had patiently waited for my copy to arrive and devoured it in one sitting. The rules are very streamlined, 160 pages covering character creation, DM's guide and critter collection. This is something that I have favoured since I first bought basic D&D back in '82. Character creation is completely random. Now current trend has been to have the players lovingly craft their characters as they see fit. While I find that good as well, I find it good to play a game where you have to deal with what you get stuck with. Roll a 4 for Strength and deal with it princess. With a few die rolls your characters origin (what genetic makeup you have) is determined, as well as two starting powers. A draw of the cards also determines your major mutant abilites.
Personally I don't like the 7 card mutations deck idea and just have my players draw one card which they keep forever, though I am always doing odd things to them to develop their characters anyhow. Characters only go to 10th level as well.
You also start with basic armour, weapons, and some assorted gear (also random), as well as a high-powered tech device. I also allow my players to jury-rig stuff with the junk they find (a la MacGyver) to make things they otherwise don't have.
As the book is a bit light on (I do believe in the less is more approach) some things were left out. I would have liked to see more of the original Gamma Terra background. The book mentions the big accident with the Hadron Collider which sounded a bit naff to me so I wen t with my own background. Some cryptic alliances are mentoined so I have had to fill in others with previous books I own.
The game is very tongue in check. Which is something I like. I've hear some reveiwers mention beer and pretzels and hell I think thats a fine way to play.
All in all I think that even as something that is only played occasionally it has the ability to amuse your players and can be used again and again. It could even be quite a challenge to get to level 10 as I have heard of a few TPK's happening just with the introductory scenario. product_title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 25th Anniversary Action Figure Shredder
review_headline: I never understood a lot of the designs of these toys
review_body:
Wow, 25 years already? I was a madly obsessed child with these toys when they first came out. Any male kid, or girl, who liked the TMNT had to have as many of these toys as they could. But now when I look back on it, it makes me wonder what the designers where thinking? In particular, this one, The Shred dude. Why is his armor blue and purple? And why is his head so big? Why does he not have a shirt on? It hardly looks like the Shredder from the series... I thought maybe it was due to plastic not coming in the color gray, but then I remembered \\"Rock-steady\\" & \\"Metal Head\\" came in gray, so why is Shredder oddly colored?

Many of the toys compared to the series where very odd, I had the Turtle Blimp too and wondered why in the cartoon 2 turtles could fit on the wings at the same time, but on the toy, you could barley seat one on it. The Turtle van was an odd design too. As where many more. It's nice to see the 25th anniversary bring these childhood memories back, but seeing them again now, well, as I said, what the shell was with the designs of them?

One coin was missing from the collection, and two of another were sent in its place.  One coin was rusty, and unreadable.  I tried to contact the seller (daves1111), but he did not even reply.  Unless he makes good on my order, as advertised, I will not buy from this seller again.  And neither should you!

product_title: Our Generation New Doll with Book - Hally/One Smart Cookie
review_headline: Don't buy if your daughter likes to bush hair!
review_body: I bought this doll for my daughter for Christmas as an alternative to an American Girl doll. The hair is cut several different lengths. On the back right side it looks like a chunk was cut out of the top layer. I have washed it, conditioned it, and blow dried it to try and get rid of the ridges left in it from the braids, nothing works. On top of all that, despite buying a special brush for doll hair, it comes out by the handful every time I try to brush it down. I remember having dolls with descent brushable hair when I was little. Apparently, now days, the only way to get a doll with hair you can brush is to shell out $100 for an AG doll. Guess my baby girl will just stick with Littlest Pet Shop for now.

product_title: Melissa & Doug
review_body: Skip this shape sorter.  The lid falls off, and there isn't enough room in the cube for all of the shapes.  There are a lot better shape sorters out there.

product_title: Star Wars Episode 1 Electronic Obi-Wan Coin Bank
review_body: I bought this so I could complete the set, as I already had the Qui-Gon and Darth Maul banks.  They interact well together.  It's a neat toy for kids, my nephews can't stop playing with them.  And it's a fun show piece, either by itself or with the compelte set.  Enjoy.

product_title: Matchbox Mega Rig 7-in-1 Buildable Coastal Squad
review_body: I have this complete set, this is actually a smaller part of a complete set of an ocean research boat. If you can find the bigger set that goes with this, with a shark cage, large boat, shark, it will offer lots of interchangable peices to make different floating boats. the divers are great too. I purchased mine 3 or 4 years ago. It appears they come out with a different theme set each year, I beleive the jurasic park is this years theme and last year was the pirate ship. There is a snow theme that is amazing, and the space shuttle theme is also fantastic.  You can still find some of these sets, but you are going to pay a good amount for them.     These toys are not indrustructable, but they will hold up to normal play, I use my set every year with my preschoolers at my day care in a small pool and Although after 3 or 4 summers there are a couple smaller peices broken therer is still lots of play left in this toy.

product_title: VIOLINSMART MV01 Violin Package (Size: 4/4, Color: Black)
review_body: Just received in mail today. Rosin was in three pieces and one of the strings was broke. Contacting customer service now for a refund...

product_title: Monopoly Junior Party (EA)
review_body:
I shy away from playing board games with small children because it's hard enough for me to figure out the directions, but then I have to teach a game I'm not familiar with to a youngster, well...it's too much for this old girl sometimes! But, not so with this game.

The directions were easy to follow, the game itself is easy to play, fun, fast and entertaining, even for adults.

Don't be afraid to give this one a try!

product_title: Super Why - Princess Presto Toddler Costume
review_body: This costume was very cute, but unfortunately very poorly made. My daughter looked cute in it and she LOVED it and that is really the most important thing. On the downside, it started ripping just minutes after she put it on. It is sort of a disposable costume as it will not last long. But if you simply want a costume your child will look adorable in for one night, then I say go for it. :)

product_title: Manhattan Toy Winkel Rattle and Sensory Teether Activity Toy
review_headline: Easy to hold and get to mouth!
review_body: My son is 3 months old and this is the first toy he has been able to hold. The rubbery loops are easy for his little fingers to wrap around and it is very easy for him to get into his mouth. The loops are soft and he enjoys chewing on them. I love this toy and so does he.

product_title: Scribblish
review_body: I havn't actually played this game, but would like to suggest a game I have played that sounds very similar to this game. We play Telestrations all the time - In this game each player get a flipbook with erasable pages (you draw with included dry-erase markers). Depending on the number of players (odd or even) you either draw the starting word or coose a word for the next player to start with (there is a deck of cards with fun words/phrases to choose from). On your turn you're either drawing the phrase from the previous page or guessing the drawing from the previous page. This game is alot easier to play and than to describe in words! And ALOT of fun!    [[ASIN:B001SN8GF4 Telestrations the Telephone Game Sketched Out!]]

review_body:
same size as shown on tv. has two sounds if u press the button twice.

only let down is its made from plastic, be careful with children, as black plastic end is a little sharp...

id recommend it for children over the age of 9

product_title: Wham-O Slip-N'slide Boogie family pack
review_body: This was purchased after the season for next year so I haven't used the product. However, I still received Amazon's usual great service =- so no complaints

product_title: KidKraft Pirate Sandboat
review_headline: I would buy again, but could be improved
review_body: We bought this for our son's 3 yr. birthday.  All parts arrived in excellent condition.  My husband and father had fun putting it together...in a couple of hours.  It looks awsome in the yard.  The kids have had a blast with it.  Improvements could be made.  I like the net material that covers the box and can double as additional shade cover, however the snaps have already rusted (within a month and a half)and one of the snap halves came off completely. Perhaps loops and dowles instead of snaps would fix that problem and make it easier to use for shade as necessary. The red wheel has already faded from the sun, so perhaps a different color would wear better.  The blue paint on the railings has started to peel. (my garden sprinklers have not helped this situation...) Overall we do love it!  Hope the company takes advantage of the feedback to make it even better than it already is.

product_title: Lot of 100 - Sharp Fossil Shark Teeth
review_body: I thought these were great shark teeth for my 6 year old sons birthday party. All the kids loved them. Very good quality, compared to what I had found locally.

product_title: Fisher-Price Medical Kit
review_body: Great toy.  My 2 year old loves to give me doctor check ups with it.  The stethescope doesn't really let you hear a heartbeat, but it is still a cool pretend toy for my daughter.

product_title: Tumble Tree Timbers 671-Piece Log Cabin Set
review_body: This was a gift for a 5 year old boy.  He has an 11 year old brother.  I think my 11 year old has played with them more, but I know the younger one will continue to enjoy these as he grows.  It wasn't the highlight of his birthday gifts (there were \\"flashier\\" toys) although, he was happy to have them, but.....the important thing is that these have staying power and have continued to be a delight to play with long after the party was over.  I am considering buying another set of these and I believe these will be something to hang onto for the grandkids (along with the Thomas the Tank Engine trains).      Also, I believe the value is excellent.  Why pay so much more for a fancy label?  These are just what you expect them to be.  They are not flimsy or anything.  There are a lot of the one notch logs (the small ones) but my 11 year old has made quite a few structures at one time with the available logs and roof sections.    There is not a storage container with it, but we have storage drawer carts and the whole set fits in one of the wider ones.    Hope this helps.  Happy Shopping!

product_title: Ty We Do - Bride and Groom (Set)
review_body: This was not bought has a toy. It was for our Daughter that is getting marryed. This way they can start their new lives out with a gift from my husband and I. Maybe some day in the furture they can have fun with them.

product_title: How to Train Your Dragon Fire Breathing Night Fury New
review_body: I purchase this toy 2 days ago from walmart ( selling for $30.) I had my son hold on to the toy while shopping and he was pressing the try me feature and all of the sudden the toy would not stop making noises it was as if the button was stuck so we decided to go back to the toy section and exchange it for another one just in case it was defective.  The dragon features are that if you press the top button , a blue light comes out of its mouth and then goes back inside the dragons mouth and at the same time the dragon makes a sound.  Also the hind legs when pushed inwards are suppose to move the large wings on the dragon. In about one hour after purchasing the dragon the light feature was working but then it would not go inside the dragons mouth.  I tried following the manufactures advise and even changed the batteries but this feature does not work properly.  Also this toy is sensitive to electric devices so your kid can not play with this toy in front of the tv or radio etc or it won't work.  The toys on off button also seems to be constantly turned off and on again for it to function.  Other than that, since my son is only 3 1/2 years old he has fun with it, the dragon is also pretty big.  In order words, my son doesn't know he has been ripped off!

product_title: Masters Of The Universe Roboto
review_body: Roboto here, who had some of the coolest action features with the rotating gears inside his clear chest, stands as one of the very best action figures in the vintage as well as the 200X lines, and his Classics figure is no different.  In fact, Roboto may yet be the most splendid figure in the Classics line as he looks EXACTLY like his vintage counterpart, merely updated for the times a bit, which is what this line is all about.  Unfortunately, there are a plague of tragedies surrounding the Classics Roboto figure including his shoulders being on backwards, sloppy paint applications, visible globs of glue, and the very worst the \\"The Original\\" burst on his package.  Fans and collectors of the line well know that the \\"The Original\\" burst is reserved for figures that receive their second printing, not their first.  Although very distressing, be advised that not all the Robotos were released in this way, and the amount of the perfect, correct Robotos out there far outnumbers the \\"The Original\\" ones.  Of course, if you open your figures, it probably wouldn't matter about your package or not, but if you're a MOC collector like myself, then don't let this distressing news deter you from taking a chance on Roboto, just contact the merchant or website if possible and inquire about his packaging.  All in all, Roboto stands on my list of my very favorite heroes in the line so far.  Just like my favorite villain Trap-Jaw, this upgraded chess player's accessories include interchangeable arm attachments ranging from an axe to a laser to a claw.  As always, Roboto sold out very quickly on his initial release date, so be sure to add him to your collection now.
