product_title: Large 49mm Assorted Superballs (12/PKG)
review_body:
We bought these balls for their size and bounciness but didn't count on their mass and inertia.

Our 8 month old cat had some older smaller superballs but they were always getting lost under furniture and appliances so we were spending a great deal of time trying to recover the lost balls so our cat could play with them again.

I decided the answer was a larger superball so I ordered these. Our cat has played with one of them a little, but is somewhat intimidated by their size. She is gradually getting more accoustomed to the ball and is beginning to chase it around more.

The ball has a lot of bounce so it performs as it should; we're hoping that as our cat grows the size and weight of the ball will become less of a factor.

As a superball I have no complaints about these balls; as a toy for a cat you should be aware that they are rather heavy and can intimidate a smaller cat or kitten. The jury is still out on how our cat will eventually adjust to the size and weight of these balls.
They have completely solved one problem, however, and that is we can always find the ball as it can't roll under the clothes dryer like the smaller ones did.

For the record, two of the smaller superballs are still missing.

Update - The size and weight of the balls continue to intimidate our cat; when she bumps into one of them as they bounce it scares her. I don't hold out much hope that she will play with them as she does with the smaller superballs. At one point we had found both of the small ones, but now one is lost again and despite our diligent looking we have been unable to find it.

product_title: Hasbro Games Monopoly Deal Card Game
review_body: I love Monopoly but can rarely find the time or the willing participants to play a game for several hours. This Monopoly DEAL card game solves that problem by retaining much of the fun of the board game, but making it playable in about 15-20 mins with 3-4 players. It is a simple game that can be quickly learned in a few minutes, but it also manages to retain the core elements of luck and strategy that are present in the board version - although it is probably fair to say that luck is probably a larger part of the equation with DEAL.  Our kids (9 and 6) can't get enough of this game, and even the six year old has won a couple of times. Even my wife, who cannot stand Monopoly, enjoys playing DEAL. So in our family, this gets a full five stars even though some of the cards are showing some wear already. This is an excellent value game and a lot of entertainment for just a few dollars, so we will probably pick up a spare set or two to have around to replace lost or damaged cards.

product_title: Ikea Mula Wood Building Blocks w/ Wagon
review_body:
IKEA has some simple and nicely designed toys and my wife picked up this building blocks with wagon set about 9 months ago. It's all made of wood with bright shiny blocks, cylinders, triangles, etc., which all fit together in a scheme on the wagon floor. Fortunately, there's a marked grid on the bed of the wagon so that I can get them all back in the right order. Our 22-month-old boy has not mastered it as yet, but we can sometimes get him to put some of the objects in the wagon and I expect he'll eventually learn all the colors and shapes. Such is life. In any case, he likes to pull the wagon around. It's a simple, nifty toy and is well built for the purpose. I enjoy having a few old-fashioned wooden toys scattered among his modern plastic and electronic toys. A word of warning is in order. Don't step on this thing while walking around in the dark.

Gary Peterson

review_body:
I am cautiously for the new edition of Warhammer FRP. While the price of the box is extremely high, when you compare it to other Warhammer products (namely WFB), you are really getting your money's worth. I've been a fan of WFRP for quite some time, I still have a copy of the trade paperback version of first edition. I also have a good number of second edition volumes. And as a WFB gamer, mainly the Empire though I do have a number of Chaos figures, I like what I see. So I would have to say that I am coming to this game as someone who has loved the Warhammer world for a long time.

There is only really one problem I have with the game. As noted by many, this game differs from many of the RPGs out there today. I would have liked to see character creation and advancement examples. I'm a bit sketchy on how the advancement works exactly. Just so that I can have something to show a new player what he or she is in for. The books that you get in the box set are well-developed books. The only worry I have about the actual books has to do with the binding. I get the feeling that with a lot of reading and rereading of the various books, the binding might not hold.

What I wish though would be that there would be a connection to WFB. The original WFRP had enough connection to the war gaming part that you could, if you so desire, convert RPG characters to FB characters in order to stage large scale wars. Less so with second edition. Even lesser with this new edition. One would want to hold large scale battles simply because, well, they are enjoyable as a \\"climax\\" to a long and well developed campaign (mainly the Enemy Within campaign of the first edition RGP). Still, you aren't really losing anything if you don't care for the FB version of the game.

What does the future hold for the game? I don't know. I am interested in seeing and reading the new supplements to the game. I like what I see in terms of the new Winds of Magic box set. I also like that they've come up with several campaign boxes. The GM box looks good. I've just bought the Adventurer's box set and like the components. I would also like to see, and again, this is the gaming nerd in me speaking, miniatures that can replace the various character classes of WFRP. product_title: Talisman: The Magical Quest Game, 4th edition
review_body:
The board game \\"Talisman\\" has a well-deserved reputation as one of the best fantasy board games ever made. I have been a die hard fan ever since picking up the Second Edition boxset back in the late 1980s, and I couldn't even imagine how many hours I have spent vying for the Crown of Command. I still have all of the Second Edition expansions, from the Dungeon and City up to the Timescape and Dragons, including the cut-out special characters from Games Workshop's \\"White Dwarf\\" magazine.

Because I love the original so much, (I ignored the Third Edition, which tried to updated things to make the game more in-line with RPGs including things like \\"Experience Points\\" and connecting Talisman even further to the Games Workshop \\"Warhammer Universe.\\") it took me awhile to give this Fourth Edition of \\"Talisman\\" a try. I finally gave it a chance at a local gaming convention and was hooked again.

This Fourth Edition takes a basic \\"If it ain't broke, don't fix it\\" approach to this classic boardgame, keeping the Second Edition essentially intact but introducing some of the better fixes from the Third Edition. The board itself is identical, although enlarged and with updated artwork. The card text is almost unchanged (including characters who \\"plod off to the discard pile\\") although none of the original art was retained.

Probably the most notable change was making \\"Life\\" a variable starting number, just like Strength and Craft. Some of the characters start with five (Warrior) or even six (Troll) life instead of the standard four. The Prophetess, one of the most powerful characters in the Second Edition, has been de-powered a bit. She can now draw one card, and then chose to either keep that card or discard it and draw another, which she must encounter. That was a nice edition as in the old version The Prophetess was so powerful she was boring to play. An additional element called \\"fate counters\\" has been added which allow for the re-rolling of a single die if you pay a counter. Craft-defeated monsters can also be cashed-in now in the same way as Strength-defeated monsters.

Fantasy Flight games has done a tremendous job with the production values of this version of \\"Talisman.\\" Aside from the updated artwork, the counters are all hard-plastic with the Strength, Craft and Life counters being colored cones that come in 1-count and 5-count versions. The cards are on laminated cardstock which will last through repeated shuffling and drink-spilling. Really, everything has gone through a major upgrade.

If I had any disappointments with this Fourth Edition they are minor. The game board itself is too huge, taking up my entire kitchen table, which means that when I pick up any future expansions (of which I hope there will be many after [[ASIN:158994464X Reaper]], [[ASIN:1589945018 The Dungeon]]and [[ASIN:158994691X Frostmarch]]) I will have to move to the floor in order to have a space large enough to play.

I also would have appreciated it if Fantasy Flight had balanced out the gender ration of characters when commissioning the new artwork. This was something I wouldn't have noticed except when I was playing with my wife she wanted to play a female character and all that was available was The Sorceress and The Prophetess. Several characters, like the Assassin, the Thief, the Warrior, the Elf, etc...could have easily been made female in the artwork without changing the game-play in any way.

I have great hopes for this new Fourth Edition of \\"Talisman,\\" and hope that great things are forth coming. I would love to see some old favorites appear, like the \\"Champion of Chaos\\" and the \\"Horrible Black Void,\\" along with some new ideas and expansions.f you pay a counter. product_title: Bachmann Trains E-Z Command Digital Command Control Turnout - Right
review_headline: Took me few moments to figure out how to operate
review_body: I'm using this turnout with basic Bachmann's DCC controller.  I've both the left and the right turnout, and this review applies to both of them.    No problems with operation of turnout so far.  Operation was relatively easy, once I actually read the instructions.    It seems that turnout is hard-coded at address 9.  Looking at instructions, there doesn't seem to be a way to assign it to a different address.  I'm rather new to DCC world, so I have no idea if this is standard for all DCC turnouts or limitation of Bachmann's turnouts.  By default, the turnout is toggled by pressing function key 3 on the controller.  The function key that toggles the controller, as well as default direction on power on (factory default is straight) is easy to change to any function key between F1 and F8.  If more then one turnout is assigned to the same function key, they will be all toggled at the same time (meaning, you can setup up to 8 turnout groups).    Depending on DCC controller, it's more complicated to operate then old turnouts with dedicated control switch.  On my simple entry-level DCC controller, I need to switch from locomotive's address (e.g. 1) to turnout's address (hard-coded to 9), then press another button to switch to function mode, operate turnouts, press function button again to switch to selecting address mode, select locomotive's address to be able to control it again, then do the procedure all over again when I want to operate turnout.  I wouldn't know if this is limitation of the basic DCC controller that I have, or if better (more expensive) DCC controllers allow operating turnouts in a more efficient way (e.g. without loosing control of the locomotive).  On the plus side, there are no additional wires like with the old-style turnouts.  The turnout can be operated manually as well.    Unlike Bachmann's manual turnout that's packaged with their train sets, train will not derail if turnout is switched the \\"wrong way\\" when train goes over it.

product_title: Kato KAT106056 N Passenger Set, California Zephyr (11)
review_headline: Smooth Running N Scale Model with Excellent Detail
review_body:
I have all four releases of this set and find them to be outstanding. The cars are highly detailed and are excellent runners. (I would recommend a radius of 13\\" or greater for best performance and appearance.) They come with Kato knuckle couplers which I have found to function in a satisfactory manner and to be Micro-trains compatible. Others may want to convert them to Micro-trains couplers. The addition of Kato interior lighting sets 11-209 or 11-210 (not included) can add even more realism. The set also comes with enough Kato Unitrack to display all the cars should you desire.

Also available are matching F3A & F3B locomotives painted and numbered to match the prototype locomotives that pulled the California Zephyr.

I really love this set and highly recommend it to anyone interested in N scale passenger operations as well as fans of the CB&Q, the Rio Grande, or the Western Pacific. If you are thinking about entering N scale, this may be the motivation you need.

More info available from Kato USA [...].

It is also impossible to hover in one place. Either it rises up, spins around (that was probably do to the tilt, which was impossible to calibrate), or simply flies away, guided by some unseen pilot. My advice is that if you are going to buy a helicopter, spend a little more money and get a nicer $80 or $100 one, instead of spending $40 for an \\"Air Falls\\".

review_body:
So, the product's \\"out of the box\\" behavior is fine, and as described. My child enjoys playing with it. Is he learning much? I don't know. He's still very young. Mostly we got it so that he'd play with his own leaptop instead of our (real) laptop. It's been somewhat successful.

One of the reasons we decided to get this product was the advertised features of customization. Having customized content for him sounded great. Much to my dismay, the product wanted to install a \\"sniffer application\\" which seemed dubious, but after a precursory inspection, I hesitantly continued.

After getting the application installed, the product wouldn't continue unless I gave them copious amounts of personal information, which I didn't want to do. I called up customer support this morning, and the representative said that I should just put in incorrect information, that it didn't matter. That seemed like a good idea, but that made me wonder about whether a fake email address would work, or whether I would need to validate the email address.

When I asked him about the importance of a real email address, he seemed to gloss over my real question and said something like \\"That would work, but you will miss out on the learnings of your child.\\" Ignoring the fact that he didn't speak or understand English perfectly (despite what corporate America says, \\"learnings\\" isn't a word, and he used it frequently, but that was only the beginnings of our difficulties in communication), my interest was piqued about what they could discover about what my child was learning. It took a lot of repeated questioning, and eventually he said that it would update me on my child's progress in spelling and arithmetic. If you've even glanced at this product's description, you'd know that spelling and mathematics are not part of this toy at all. When I called him on that, he mentioned that that was information that could be gained from other toys, so I pressed for information specific to this particular toy. He eventually said that it would tell me the progress of how well he is learning the alphabet. That claim was dubious at best, seeing as how there isn't really any way of testing that with this particular toy, and when pressed on the issue, the representative didn't understand my query. Eventually he also added that it would tell me the usage patterns of my child. That was actually plausible information, but it took about 15 minutes to get that information from him from the original query about data gathered.

All in all, the toy is fine, I just don't like the company policies, specifically with regards to personal information, and hiring practices. product_title: Talisman: The Highland Expansion Board Game
review_body:
The Highlands Expansion provides an exciting new adventure to the already powerful game of Talisman. I was suprised at the variety of adventure cards available in the new add-on and was extremely pleased to find that it did not conflict with the Dungeon Expansion, in that one can begin their adventure early-on in the Highlands and then move on to the Dungeon later. The only great disappointment was the Relic cards, whose abilities were onerous and frankly not too helpful unless you plan on fighting a Battle Royale at the end. One of the big bonuses to the Highlands was the ability to loiter in the expansion area without having to declare a retreat or only advance one way, allowing for mobility and player vs. player challenges on the death-defying craigs and walkways which plague the Highlands.

This expansion is a must-have for any hardcore or leisure Talisman adventurer and I would strongly recommend picking it up as soon as possible. (The character additions are awesome as well!)

product_title: Star Wars 3-D Deluxe Vehicle Kite - Tie Fighter
review_headline: It's a great kite and owns the field when I fly it.
review_body: I bought this kite a few weeks ago and have flown it a few times.   People and I mean on several occasions stop what they are doing and walk over to ask about the kite. When airborne this kite looks exactly like a Tie Fighter hovering over the field.     As for flight dynamics... this is not a kite to fly in low wind. But most ornamental kites are bad in these conditions. Also, contrary to popular belief, IT IS HARD TO FLY A KITE AT THE BEACH. The air is too turbulent and the inflow winds almost always give way to outflow winds a 100 or so feet in the air. This transition is why so many people have problems flying a kite at the beach. You would want to launch your kite into the groundwinds and would need to start with atleast 100' of string already out.     I love this kite and plan to fly it as much as possible before the summer.

product_title: Twilight Tote Bag / Grey Bts "Alice" Vector Afl
review_body: I'm a closet Twilight fan.  I've read the books; I've seen the first movie and intend to see the second.  I love props and jewelry, and I collect the jewelry props from Twilight.  But it's not my favorite series in the world.    That aside, I also love bags.  I love tote bags because they are large and durable, they hold a lot of stuff and are versatile.    I love this bag.  I haven't even used the bag yet and I love it.  It's a nice neutral gray color, and the vector of Alice is cute without being overwhelming and standing out too much.  The canvas is thick enough to be sturdy and durable, as well as pliable and flexible.  I wish the straps or an inch or two longer, but they fit over my arms easily.  I adore the fact that there is a little zippered pocket inside.  The one downside of using tote bags and a sometimes purse is that I can't ever find my cell phone among the mess; the zippered pocket will not fix that problem.     Overall, I think this bag is a great buy, a great collector's item, and just a great idea overall.

review_body: Great fun!!  Enjoyed this product on Michigans beautiful Lake Huron.  Lots of room to stretch out on.  Cant wait to use it again.

product_title: FAO Schwarz Coral Reef Habitat 7 Piece Plush
review_body: I saw this in Macy's for around $50 and didn't buy it because I didn't think it was worth it.  It's just a plush toy and it's not even that nice.  Nowhere near as colorful as you'd expect a coral reef toy to be.  It's colors a dull and boring.  I'm also not so sure the kid won't get it twisted around his neck.

product_title: HobbyZone Champ RTF Airplane
review_body: First things first - I have last flown an RC plane roughly 8 years ago.  At that time, I would call myself a rookie at best and someone that flew a gas powered indestructible plane, so I do have limited experience (enough to get myself in trouble).    I bought this plane for 5 reasons:  1.  I wanted a plane I didn't need to work on / build - don't have time, just want to fly something  2.  My friend had 2 RTF planes and told me how great they are - he had the P-51 Mustang and the J-3 Cub.  3.  I wanted something that would help bring me back into it  4.  I did NOT want to spend a lot of money  5.  Based on the recommendation of the guy at the local hobby shop - he recommended this Champ over the P-51 or J-3 Cub (and it was cheaper than both, so it was an easy sell for me).    Today was my first day flying it (and I did not practice using the a computer game), I just jumped at the joystick:  1.  Battery charged for 15 minutes.  2.  Read a little of the instructions (not much)  3.  Took it out to the driveway and played around with just the ground control (steering, acceleration, etc.).  4.  Took it to the school by my house (you want it open on he first few flights to get down the plane).    This plane is AWESOME.  In the first day, this is what I have done with it:  1.  Took off from a track with a football field in the center  2.  Landed it in the grass a number of times (it wasn't smooth landings and flipped over, but didn't hurt it).  3.  I nose dived the thing into the grass once (on accident) - didn't hurt it.  4.  I got it caught in a tree (yes, I tried it close to home after I got confident and got it stuck).  Pulled it down with a rope, caught it, did NOT hurt it.    It's a blast.  I would highly recommend this plane.  It's cheap and out for a good time.  If you are a beginner, start it out and get it 50 feet off the ground, if you mess up, just decrease acceleration and lay off the controls, it will correct itself and you'll be good.    Now, the few disadvantages:  1.  The thing is extremely sensitive to wind (just because it's all foam).  Be cautious getting it up too high or you're fighting the wind outdoors.  2.  No ailerons - I didn't realize this till I got home, but you have accelerator, elevator, and rudder, that's it (but this is what makes it so simple to control too).  3.  Charge on the battery is only 10 minutes or so (recommend having a couple extra batteries on you for extended fun).  4.  It won't do a loop (I've tried and it just stalls).  The instructions tell you that, but I saw it after I tried, easy to recover from the stall if you're high enough.  I have not tried to get it upside down yet, maybe my task for the next flight :)  5.  Be ready to trim trim trim.  My plane came out of the box wanting to climb so much.  I am still messing with the controls after 3 re-charges, but I would prefer it climb and fight that, than the dive.

product_title: MindWare Qwirkle Tile Game
review_body: Looked everywhere for this game after playing it with friends. Nobody stocked it after Christmas. All my  grandkids 4 and up love it and fun for adults too. Ordered it 3 days before a birthday and it got here in time.  Highly recommend. Educational too!

product_title: Disney Pixar Wall-E 6" Eve Plush
review_body: My 3 year old loves Wall-E and she adores this toy. She is the first of my kids to enjoy stuffed, plush toys, so I get them for her a lot.  Eve's head turns, and she is small enough to stash in your purse, the car, the backpack or stroller. My daughter takes it to show and tell and sleeps with it.  I would say it is a winner, especially for the price!  I was in the Disney Store over the weekend and this was a steal!

product_title: Disney Mix Stick Lights MP3 Player - Hannah Montana
review_body: We bought this MP3 player for my daughter for Christmas b/c 1)she LOVES Hannah Montana and 2) anything the lights up, shines are sparkles is right up her alley.  Well, it stopped working by February.  Money gone down the drain.

product_title: Junior Archery Set, 39 Inch Fiberglass Bow, 3 18 Inch Arrows, 4 Color Targets, Boxed
review_body: My five year old loves zelda, and we had already bought him a shield and sword, so i thought this would complete the effect for him. It did. We've had it for weeks now and still hasn't broke. comes with targets (although he can't really hit them) and is pretty durable to the kid who is tough but loves the toy and doesn't wanna break it.

product_title: Syma S107/S107G R/C Helicopter *Colors Vary
review_body: Wow...for a grand total of $31.95(including no tax and free shipping) I am blown away by the quality of this heli.  Metal body and extremely well built for a $30+ dollar toy. It took all of about 5 mins to unpack and put the batteries in the remote.  The heli came with about half a charge in it so I was flying immediately.  I adjutsed the trim a tad and it was hovering perfectly in place. Again WOW,WOW,WOW!!!  I will definitely by some more helis from Syma.  Maybe my next one will be the huge radio controlled, outside model the S032. And that one is only about $60.00!!!  This is the PERFECT example of getting WAY more than what you expected.

product_title: Baby Alive Bouncin' Babbles - Blonde
review_body: What a cute little doll! She is adorable and she jumps up and down and giggles! A very sweet and suprisingly sturdy little doll! I would not give to any child under three years old because the body and head are a harder plastic and they bop themselves in the nose, but other than that, I saw no real concerns.  My daughter loved the giggles that were constantly erupting from this adorable little girl!

product_title: Resident Evil Anniversary Series 2 Licker Action Figure
review_body: I bought this for my daughter who is a gamer.  The product itself is disgusting looking, but it is one of the Resident Evil characters, so as the title says \\"it is what it is\\". I have to mention that this is one of the several figures I had purchased for her that has NOT broken.  Many of the other figurines, primarily the ones with guns, seems very fragile and break very easily if dropped, even on a soft surface like a carpet or bed.  The parts on this seem pretty thick and hardy.  Still, pretty gross looking.  :-)

product_title: ImagiPLAY Planet Pixies – Kayla
review_body: So sweet...I'm not an organic nut, but I try. A hair yarn or two might come loose, but who cares?! Great for just general pixie/fairy awareness- one daughter has never been a doll chick (no interest when I tried to tell her about the Everglades); the other is too young for the ecosystem talk. Just get it and snuggle!

product_title: Bakugan Battle Pack (Styles and Colors May Vary)
review_headline: My son and nephews love them.
review_body: I bought this as a birthday gift for my 7 year old son.  He loves them.  There is an opportunity to discuss how magnets work and how they effect this toy.  Not very dourable for younger children but my nephews, ages 4 and 12 also love these toys.

product_title: BOB The Penguin - Tynies Miniature Glass Figurine
review_body: This is an adorable LITTLE figurine.  Maybe 1/2 to 1 inch tall.  I was expecting something a little bigger, but it was really cute. Try wrapping it for a gift and you are a magician.

product_title: Fisher-Price Laugh & Learn Learning Letters Mailbox
review_body: In fact,my 1 year old and 2 year old like it so much, I may have to buy another one so they don't fight over it. They don't mind the open end of the mail box.  They like to see the letters falling through after they drop them in the slot.  It's so simple, yet they play with this more than they do some of their more pricey and complicated toys.

product_title: Hot Wheels Trick Tracks Spin Wrecker Starter Set
review_body: My 10 year old son loves this track. At first we had a hard time getting it together, but after he fiddled with it, it works great. He added some of his own track too.

product_title: Fisher-Price Barbie Tough Trike Princess Ride-On
review_body: My 16 month old daughter was fascinated by a boy's trike she saw at the park recently. We decided to buy this for her even though she's pretty young. The trike seems like it is going to hold up for a long time. The bike goes together fairly quickly, though there is one step they recommend using two adults for and I did need to wait until my husband was home. Our daughter can sit on the bike and navigate the ground with her feet (similar to driving a Fisher Price Cozy Coupe). The only complaint I have is the steering is very tight. I don't know if that is just how it is or it will loosen up with use. A very good value.

review_body: I was mildly disappointed that the the audio cuts in an out after a few months of use.  I was looking for a solution, when I ran into a report that states this toy contains lead, bromine and arsenic!!!  This is terrible in a child's toy, how can this go into production? product_title: Fisher-Price Laugh & Learn Say Please Tea Set
review_headline: A year later and still a Hit!
review_body: My daughter received this for her first birthday and almost a year later she still loves playing with this tea set. She likes being able to serve tea (or coffee!) to people when they come to over. It is the perfect size and weight for little hands. She has learned the shapes (circle, triangle, and square) from the dessert pieces. She says please, thank you, and welcome all the time...this toy helped reinforce what we were trying to teach her! Overall, this is still one of her favorite toys and I don't see it losing its appeal as we start to add more items for a play kitchen as she gets older.

product_title: Melissa & Doug
review_headline: Get this for your 6 month old baby!!!
review_body: I bought this for my then 2 year old son, it has lasted well for almost a year now.  What I didn't realize is how perfect it would be for my 6 month old baby, when he learned to sit, I put him in front of it and it gave him something fun to do while getting stronger at sitting alone. Now he is crawling and will crawl over to it and play it and even pull himself up to a standing position with it.  The best baby item that I spent $100 on!!

product_title: Small World
review_headline: Great game for kids and adults!
review_body: Our family purchased Small World a few weeks ago now, and we just love it!  Our 10 and 8 year old boys enjoy it just as much as my wife and I.  It's a different game each time you play, and it isn't dependent on the luck of the die so much as strategy.  It really is a very well balanced board game in both depth of strategy and accessibility and enjoyability for various age groups.

product_title: Transformers Movie 2 Rc Vehicles - Bumblebee Vehicle
review_body: I baught this toy for Christmas for my 7 year old son, It came earlier then i had expected. He loves the light & all the sound effects. It has a pretty good speed, I wish it was a little higher off the ground. My son has not put it down since Christmas. Over all it is a good toy.

product_title: Pulse Master Water Warrior
review_body: I am a watergun enthusiast and own 50 waterguns.  I've been collecting waterguns for about 20 years.  In my opinion, this watergun is currently the best overall watergun currently on the market (with the exception of older,heavier more powerful super soakers you can purchase on ebay), the water warriors vindicator is a very close 2nd.  Where this gun wins out is on style, and the fact that you only have to pump it 5 times to be fully charged.  The only downsides are that the shot time is short and the grip/handle is on the small side.  Other than that, this gun unleashes a far shooting, powerful stream, has 3 nozzle settings, and has really good capacity. The best review of this gun and others can be found at [...]. Consider no other gun.  Buy this and dominate in any watergun fight.  Have fun for the rest of the summer!!!

product_title: NECA Bioshock 2 Action Figure Big Daddy Prototype Subject Delta
review_headline: Nice detail but doesn't stand up to actually being played with
review_body: I purchased one of these for myself to serve as a collectors item and one for my daughter who loves 'big daddys' to actually play with. Although the figure is very detailed and the painting is nice it doesn't stand up to actual use very well. Within a few minutes the divers knife was broken off Deltas belt and the hoses connecting to the helmet and back tank don't really stay in place at all. The worst part however is that the figure breaks in half extremely easily due to the way its made. Overall its a nice figure if its only purpose is being displayed on a shelf or never leaving the package.

product_title: My First Colorforms - Little Miss Weather Dress Up Set - University Games
review_body: My 2 year old niece LOVED this when I got it for her, but the pieces don't stick AT ALL!!  We've tried everything thinking we were doing something wrong, but nope.  She still likes to play with it but it completely misses the point of colorforms...

product_title: Spring Blossom Barbie
review_body: It wasn't what I expected, but it was nice to see a barbie from when I was a little girl to share with my daughter.

product_title: Carrera Go "Disney "Cars" Slot Race Car Set 1:43 Scale
review_body: I first bought a generic slot car set for C$50. It was so useless I threw it away after a few hours. Then I got this for C$100 and it is absolutely fantastic! It is beyond worth the money. It is a quality product and fantastic fun. Any reviews that are not glowing are missing a few key points:    1) It is easy to assemble but you do need to be careful. Lay out all the parts in orderly piles first! This will save loads of time and make it easier to figure out. Do not force the tracks when assembling. Doing so will cause breaks or bad fits. This does take some finesse.     2) Racing the cars actually takes finesse. This means practice. That is a sign of a *good* toy. Not some disposable mindless junk that most toys are. This is old school quality. And persistance pays off. The cars fly off the track and you will get bored - unless you actually try. After 1 - 3 days of practice (depending on age) you get good. There is a turbo button which we all thought was useless. And then we figured it out after a day.     3) Keep care of the electrical brushings on the car. Just brush them with your fingertips or a pliers as needed.     With the above notes, this is actually *better* than the slot cars I had as a kid circa 1980. Usually people bemoan how things get worse. In this case, the reverse is true! I am currently using it with family in town: boys age 3, 4, 5, 7 - plus two dads. We all fight to race it. And my 3.5 year old often does win.

product_title: Neca - Létrange Noël de Mr. Jack mug céramique Mayor
review_headline: 2 of Nightmare Before Christmas The Mayor Tall Mug?
review_body: Did not get the 2 of Nightmare Before Christmas The Mayor Tall Mugs. Got 2 of Neca Nightmare Before Christmas Long Coffee Mugs instead!

product_title: miYim Organic Plush Storybook Collection - 11" Victoria the Bunny (Pink)
review_body: Absolutely adorable.  The color is more pale than what you see in the image here, but it is still lovely and gender-nuetral.  I purchased this for my friend's son, and he adores it.  My friend likes that her son can put his mouth on the doll without her having to worry about what chemicals or materials are in the toy.  In my opinion, that's the best part about organic baby toys.  Absolutely recommend this item.

product_title: Lego Mindstorm Nxt 2.0
review_body: My son loves LEGOs and this is a great learning device.  He can do things that he likes (build with LEGOS) and learn something about robots and how they work at the same time.

product_title: Marvel Spiderman Cold Pack - favorite Superheroe pain relieve and cold treatment
review_body: After just a few uses, our Spider-Man Cold-Pack came apart.  Needing it for my son's latest bruise, I removed the pack from the freezer, only to discover that a seam on the internal gel-pack had split.  I not only had a useless item, but a gooey mess to clean up!  (The Web-Slinger would not be pleased.)

product_title: Dolfino Adult Strap Swim Fins
review_headline: Works good as a float tube fin
review_body: I bought these not wanting to spend $40+ for a set of float tube fins. Thinking there cant be that much of a difference I spent the much smaller amount for them. They worked great! I moved all over the lake with as much or more ease as my Father who owns actual float tube fins. For the price and for what I use them for I cannot complain at all. I am actually happily suprised.

product_title: Arkham Horror
review_headline: You'll either love it or hate it
review_body: The game is great, as long as you are a fan. I am a fan, so I am ok playing it all by myself, because my husband hates it. It is a sophisticated game with a story, and it would require a player to love horror/fantasy theme or simply be a curious kid in your heart.    The game is suitable for one player or for a group. It does take long time, just as the description promises. With Cthulhu as the head enemy I played alone for four investigators for a couple of weeks. With my husband with two investigators and an easier monster \\"boss\\" we did it in about two hours.    The quality of the game is great. The tokens, cards and gameboard are all top-notch. They are durable enough to withstand an attack of kids, if this is what you are buying it for :) If you can lure kids into it, the game will probably help to improve their reading skills and basic math, because there are lots of both involved.    Basically, I loved this game. Is it the best game ever? That would be an exaggeration. However, it is a great game for a fantasy fan. Beware that your \\"down to earth\\" friends and family may plain hate it.

product_title: 3 Sets of LCR!
review_body: Received product quickly.  Game is fun to play.  Gave as gifts and all enjoyed it.  Thank-you!!

product_title: Mr Jack
review_body: This is a great game that is easy to learn but requires a lot of strategy. It can be pretty quick depending on some luck and how deliberate the person you're playing is. We like to play twice and switch off between the detective and Jack. It is definitely harder to win playing Jack.

product_title: Christmas Story Board Game
review_body: This toy arrived sealed and was supposedly new; however, it was missing the directions.  When we tried to find the directions on line, we found that it was probably better that they were missing because it is a difficult game and the directions are apparently 3 pages long.  In looking at the pieces and playing cards that come with it, it appears that this will be a very difficult game, one that seems like it won't be much fun.  I bought the game as a birthday present for someone who is a huge fan of the film.  For an avid fan, it's an interesting piece of memorabilia, so it's not a total loss.  However, it would have been nice if we could have played the game as well.

product_title: KIDS SMALL TOY SUPERMARKET GROCERY SHOPPING CART *GREAT GIFT IDEA FOR CHILDREN*
review_body: My son just loves pushing the kid size shopping cart in Harris Teeters so much that I had to get this for him.  I do agree with others that the wheels get stuck but for my three year old it is perfect.  I realize I probably would have to spend a little more to get what is actually at the grocery store.

product_title: Briarpatch I Spy Colorful Kids Puzzle (100 pc)
review_body: From the product description, I thought this was the assortment of six puzzles, but it's only the one.  So instead of a good deal on six 100-piece puzzles, it was one very expensive 100-piece puzzle.  It's nice, but I don't think any 100-piece puzzle is worth $12.99.

product_title: Littlest Pet Shop LPSO Harmony the Dancing Dog
review_headline: Initially entertaining with some residual utility.
review_body: We received the LPSO Dancing Dog and both girls were giddy to start playing with it. Each mastered their own rendition of the dog's dance, through which we sat multiple encores of the performance the first day or two. It has some interactivity, in that you can push the nose to make it dance to its own song (or stop!), push nose twice to make it sneeze. If left alone, it will occasionally make noises (yawns and barks) and move until you \\"put it to sleep\\" by holding the tail for a few seconds. When connected to an audio source using the included cord it serves as an external speaker. There is no volume control on the dog itself, so you have only the control on the player. Sound quality is not great, but it suffices for the intended purpose and the children aren't really audiophiles at this point anyway. As the music plays, the dog dances along and blinks the lights. The interaction aspect has not really kept the attention of the girls, but it has been handy for listening to some music without earphones. You also get a code for the website, but If the kiddo is not a LPS fan, you might consider an inexpensive set of computer speakers instead.

product_title: Child Deluxe Madeline Costume
review_body: Just received the Madeline Deluxe Child's Costume size Small which was exactly as pictured by Costume Super Center, plus received it within 2 days of ordering.  The costume is well made, sized accurately as 5/6 and looks like the real deal especially the yellow hat. It's a deluxe price but worth it and I'm happy with my choice.[[ASIN:B001HD4578 Child Deluxe Madeline Costume]]

product_title: Harley Davidson - 1997 XLH Sportster 1200
review_body: Used bike to decorate brothers 50th birthday cake scale of bike was exactly what i was looking for.

product_title: Yomiko Yomiko Wolf 17" by Russ
review_body: I was looking for a cute, realistic, and well-made wolf plush to give as a gift; this is one of the best that I've found.  Very sweet and snuggle-able, with two different textures to its fur.  I almost want to keep it for myself!

product_title: Aquarius
review_headline: Easy to learn, fun to play
review_body: We play this as a family, including a member past his 90th birthday.  It is easy to lean, fun to play and gets to be more fun as players take on new strategies.  The game play can shift in an instant, so it is almost impossible for someone to get ahead and assume they will win.  It's easy to store, seems pretty durable -- as long as you play with clean hands and on a clean surface (common sense for any card-based game).  It is a creative and entertaining way to spend a couple of hours. The games are typically short (maybe 10 to 15 minutes), but we like the fact we can play a number of games and give everyone at least a chance for victory.  Think a cross between dominoes and Fluxx, and you come close to the game-play of Aquarius.

product_title: Super Mario Brothers Yoshi Red Ver 10" Plush
review_body: The toy was broken in the first day so I contacted the seller and I received one new inmediatly, this second one had a good quality.   I am satisfied for the quality warranty offered by the seller, I'd buy other products of this seller.

product_title: Toy Story Pull String Woody 16" Talking Figure - Disney Exclusive
review_body: When I received this product, it was wrapped in a plastic bag.  The pull cord was broken. The toy didn't look new. I bought this toy from Disney because I thought the quality would be of a high standard. I returned the action fiqure, and I didn't ask to replace it.

product_title: Fisher-Price Bubble Mower - Pink
review_body: COULD NOT GET BUBBLES TO COME OUT NOMATTER WHAT WE TRIED. A COUPLE CAME OUT AT FIRST, AND THAT WAS IT. DOESNT WORK AT ALL.

product_title: Clics Bucket Glittering 175 Pieces
review_body: My 4-year-old daughter liked the fact that there are pink pieces. Althought she never initiates it herself, may be because it's hard to take pieces apart (myself, I had to ask my husband to help me).

product_title: Metal Disentanglement Puzzle - Star Shape
review_body: I figure things out fairly quickly so it only took me 15min to figure this one out. Its only a 5 step puzzle but I didn't know that, and it is tricky. The fun part is watching others struggle with it and you already knowing how simple it is just chuckle to yourself. Hours of amusement!

product_title: Barbie Pink Ballerina Doll
review_headline: Ballerina Barbie proves to be another great one.
review_body: We purchased several of these Barbies and as always not disappointed. We do some selling of our own, but we try to chose toys that we can buy for the grandchildren in the lot, so naturally when we saw these Barbies we jumped on it.     The leotard part is made on to Barbie so you can never lose it and sometimes that is a good thing with little ones. A plus also is that is comes with the little pink brush. When you are collecting Barbies, it is always a plus to get accessories that come with certain ones.

product_title: Super Wikki Stix
review_headline: My 7 and 11 year old daughters love them!
review_body: I have never seen another craft item that my seven year old daughter loved more!    I bought these super stix after the first box of regular wikki stix was such a big hit. If your kids enjoy crafts then you can't go wrong with these! No mess, no fuss, just lots of creative fun

product_title: Too Many Monkeys
review_body: My 4-year-old and 6-year-old both grasped it quickly.  It's usually not the first game out of the closet, but it has gotten consistent play over the past two years and has been well worth the money.

product_title: Papo Velociraptor
review_body: This particular Velociraptor toy is an exquisite detailed replica of what the prehistoric reptile might have looked like in real life.  The attention to detail is superior to a great many of toys.  Plus, having the ability to open and close the mouth is a wonderful asset to the toy.

product_title: Fisher Price - Laugh & Learn Learning Table
review_headline: This is better than the Music Table.
review_body: It teaches words, sound and music.  I highly recommended.  The table is not as high as I expected.  My daughter is 13 months old and she has to kneel to play with the table.

product_title: Little Tikes Easy Store Jr. Play Table with Umbrella
review_body: My toddler daughter and I love this product. It can be used outside for a nice sunny day lunch or indoors as a regular eating table. The size is perfect. I love that it is light, and easy to clean. Assembly was okay, just a little tricky. My reason for choosing this product is that my daughter is still learning to sit on chairs, and the fact that she is able to put her little legs over and sit without having to go backward, is awesome!

product_title: Bazoongi PS-WFH Woodland Fairy Home Play Structure
review_headline: Beautiful, affordable, durable and fun -- indoor tent for creative play
review_body: We bought this tent for a birthday present for my 8 year old daughter.  It's certainly a hit!  It was easy to assemble, even for two very tired post-birthday-party parents.  Assembly requires no tools.  The tent is lightweight and durable, and very pretty.  My daughter immediately filled it with her precious things, then brought in blankets and pillows and slept there.  She loves it!  I think it's prettier than in the picture, too.  Educational value was a tough one because the tent itself doesn't teach anything, but playing with the tent promotes creative fantasy play that's far more educational than sitting in front of the t.v. or playing video games.

product_title: Toy Story Headphones
review_headline: Great for kids (even better for Mom and Dad)
review_body: My three year old loves her music so when we needed to take some long plane rides my Mom bought her these. What a great gift! I was a little concerned about ear safety and the like but these headphones cannot get extremely loud. However they are not so quiet and my daughter can always hear her songs and stories. They fit her head snugly and are not uncomfortable. They are always getting dropped and pulled on, yet still work perfect. I think these headphones are a great deal and a good product.

product_title: Crayola Color Wonder Markers and Paper
review_headline: Keep an eye on the tips
review_body: I bought two of these for my twin nieces and I don't know who was happier-- the kids or my sister.  The markers only write on the paper, which is cool.  The tip broke off of one of them, though.  Having said that, the kids press down pretty hard and, so far, that's been the only casualty.

product_title: Professional Bar Dice Cup with Five Dice
review_headline: Was not the same as the picture
review_body: The picture showed a very heavy padded bottom cup. This is NOT what was sent. The cup is small with no padding.   Do not order this by the picture, you will not be happy.

product_title: My Little Pony So Soft Newborn Pony Cheerilee
review_body: I bought this toy as a gift. It is so cute and well made!! The little girl I bought it for has not seen it yet, but I am sure she will love it.

product_title: Sand Mold Pail & Shovel
review_body: This product is only ONE pail and shovel and not two like the photo and description suggests.  I ordered this over a month ago and just got it now. The pail and shovel is cheaply made. Not what I expected.

product_title: Melissa & Doug Vehicles Mix N Match Peg Puzzle
review_body: Others said they did not received all 3 but we did.  My son is 2 1/2 and he is well beyond these basic puzzles so it was a let down. You can only remove half of each animal or car but you can mix and match b/c all the pieces are shaped the same. cute but boring.

product_title: Aurora Plush Guinea Pig Cuddly Critter Pet Carrier
review_body: My grand daughter loves the Guinea Pig. She now has 4 of these Guinea Pigs (this is the only one I bought here, and the only one with the carrier). They are cute and cuddley, and she loves to play with them.    Only one small problem - if you tug on the whiskers, they will pull out. This might not be such a bad thing, if you've ever had a toy with plastic whiskers poked in your face (especially close to your eyes).    So, overall, I highly recommend the Guinea Pig and Pet Carrier.    Don't be surprised if I buy another one or two for my other grand kids...

product_title: Barbie Kelly & Tommy Batman Gift Set 2 Pack
review_body: I'm a Barbie Collector and this Batman set will add great pleasure to my collection.

product_title: KidKraft Avalon Table and 2 Chair Set
review_body: I purchased this table for my daughters ages 14 mos and 3 years for eating and art activities.  It is pretty big for the 1 year old but I wanted something they would not grow out of quickly. Recently at Thanksgiving we had a 3, 7, 9, and 11 year old eating at the table comfortably so I know my children will get to use it a long time.  This is a very sturdy solid wood set and a great value for the price.  My husband and I can even sit at the table with the girls.  We also use it as a prep table when my three year old wants to \\"help\\" me make cookies and other things. The assembly was very clear and quick.  The only thing I would change would be to have it as a set with 4 chairs.  I purchased two separately and they were over $40 each, a little expensive compared to the set itself. I would absolutely recommend this product to someone looking for a solid wood table set for their children.  I searched for a long time and this was the best value I found, including unfinished wood and discount stores.

product_title: Learning Resources 96-piece Toy Gears Set
review_body: I gave this to my 3-year old grandson for his birthday.   He played with it for over an hour and has since, according to his mom, continued to be fascinated with it.   I recommend that future customers read reviews and follow the advice that the Beginner's Set is the best for children under 5 years.   My grandson is not yet able to grasp the building capabilities of this toy, but enjoys stacking the gears like Legos, and spinning them by hand on their base.   His mom is thrilled that other sets can be bought to add as he grows (I'm already thinking about the spinning monkeys for Christmas!)  Super toy!   Wish it came with more than one handle to spin the gears.

product_title: Green Kohlrabi
review_body: I love that Erzi has a fine selection of rather unusual vegetables. My kids have a couple of books they enjoy with turnips, and they're such an unusual play food to come across, so I decided we had to have them (this and the purple one, also by Erzi).     This turnip is a really reasonable size, although the listed diameter of 3.5 inches is actually the measurement of the entire turnip - greens and all. The true diameter of this piece is about 2\\". I don't believe this is even a possible choking hazard.     Its greenery on top is a course rope-like material that seems to be made of natural fiber of some sort. Very attractive, realistic and well-made. Erzi's veggies are something you can't go wrong with.    By the way, all Erzi foods are made in Germany.

product_title: Catan: Cities & Knights Game Expansion
review_body: Our girls are 13 & 14 and were introduced to Catan at a friends house - they loved it so we bought it for the family for Christmas.  It's a great game, especially for teenagers - playing this game they can develop logical thinking, strategy skills and bargaining & trading skills.  Plus it gets them away from the TV & computer and we sit down as a family.  A game doesn't have to take this long but we occasionally we play for 4 hours at a time because for us playing isn't about winning, it's about hanging out and spending time with each other - we have fun!

product_title: Mini Etch-A-Sketch
review_body: I thought I was getting the next smaller size  than the regular Etch a Sketch...  I just bought 2 of the 4 x 6\\" ones cheaper than these and had no shipping at WalMart.  These were not described very well.  Would have never ordered them..

product_title: Kidkraft Limited Edition Waterfall Mountain Train Table and Train Set W/drawers
review_body: I bought this for two of my nephews (two brothers, 14 months and 3 yrs) for Christmas this year. They love it! The quality is high - I expected plywood but the table is made of solid wood - weighs ~50 pounds. Should keep my nephews entertained for a long time.

product_title: Corolle Mon Premier Calin Cheerful Pink - 12" Doll
review_headline: The perfect grandma gift to a little girl
review_body: My almost-4-year-old granddaughter has been pining for a baby doll of her own. So I looked at a lot of them and settled on this one, with the advice and consent of her mother, LOL. Positives: Small, cuddly, short hair (it's probably gonna get cut anyway but at least it won't be tangly), soft, easy to dress and undress, easy to make clothes for (she and her new mommy will have matching bathrobes), cloth body, does NOT cry/pee/poop/eat so there's some real imaginative play value here without manufacturer-directed activities. Eyes are pretty, and they close when she lies down.  Cons: Can't find clothes for her in any of the big toy stores, so I got a few outfits online, and they ain't cheap. I ditched the obnoxious packaging and made her a baby quilt out of scraps from the g'dau's baby quilt to wrap her in. Soft plastic head and limbs have sort of a vanilla smell, not unpleasant at all but I'm not thrilled about more aromatic chemicals in the kid's life, so I am airing her a LOT before Christmas.   Overall, though, I think this is a lovely, soft, cuddly doll which will be instantly adored. Even my husband, who had only boys, likes her.

product_title: Dora and Diego Doodle World Aquadoodle Play Set with Motorized 4x4
review_body: My 3 year old loves it, allows for creativity and fun without the mess (so I love it too).

product_title: Intex Transparent Ring Bouncer Playhouse Ball Pit Toy
review_body: [[ASIN:B001RRWNL4 Intex Jump-O-Lene Transparent Ring Bouncer]]  I was so excited to buy this for my grandaughter that was turning 2 years old because she absolutely loves jumping on everything.....bed, couch, floor....she is definitely a jumper.  Her Mom and I thought that this would be a great way for her to jump to her hearts content and also get her off the bed and the couch....and it worked for about 3 weeks.  Now mind you my grandaughter is only 27 lbs. but within 3 weeks time the jump-o-lene sides started slowing going down.  Well we thought ok....if it goes down really slow I guess we can just keep putting air in it but with in two weeks it was going down within an hour.  And we still can't find where the air is leaking from, which is really baffling me.  Of course, the 30 days has passed and I am stuck with a flat Jump-O-Lene and feel like I totally wasted money.  I would not recommend this unless you are prepared for it to may or may not last.

product_title: Butterfly Waterfall 1000 pc Jigsaw Puzzle
review_body: I know my family and I will enjoy putting it together. Shaped Puzzles look to be the most challenging. Also purchased the \\"Stow and Go\\" The rolling-up part was not too difficult, and it unrolled nicely with the puzzle still intact.

product_title: Safari Ltd In The Sky TOOB
review_body: This assortment of toys was a perfect gift for my 4 year old grandson, there is so many in there and he even liked the cylinder container it came in. He has never previously showed much interest in planes or anything besides trains really and now everytime I see him he has a plane or something in his pocket! They seem very sturdy and just the correct size for him to be able to take in the car and everywhere with him.

product_title: 1000 Magic: The Gathering Cards Playsets (no more than 4 copies of any one card)
review_headline: Very happy with set - Magic newbie
review_body: I got this set b/c my 8 year old son got a deck for Christmas and wanted to play.  I am far from a collector, but my experience with Magic Universe was extremely positive.  I chose them over another seller (that listed for slightly less) b/c of another good review of them (I believe for this product) and I liked their individual write-up about the product.      I did get 17 different cards that were more than 4 duplicates, but they also included extra cards.  By my calculations I was about 49 cards short of having 1000 cards w/o more than 4 dups, so I e-mailed them.  I actually received (initially) approximately 1050 cards.      The response from Magic Universe was within a couple of hours, very friendly and apologetic, and promised to ship me some cards.  I received them soon thereafter, mostly unfamiliar cards to me.  There were 104 or so cards, as opposed to the 50 I asked for (including a few legendary creatures, for what that's worth... my son and I were happy).    I received 20 or more of each land type in the initial shipment.    I know nothing about rarity, value of cards, etc, but I am happy to say we now have 7 playable decks (mixing my son's greens and whites from his two decks) and my wife, son and I are loving playing.    I am extremely happy with my experience with Magic Universe.  I deal with a lot of customer service reps, and most experiences are amazingly painful.  thanks again!

product_title: Step2 Easel for Two Toddlers - Durable Two-Sided Art Dry Chalk board with Magnetic Letters, Sign and Numbers, Red
review_body: This Christmas gift for my grandsons, ages 21/2 and 1, outshone everything under the tree. They have used it twice daily since Christmas day!

product_title: Disney / Pixar CARS Movie Exclusive 1:24 Scale Die Cast Car Frank The Combine
review_body: The dummies who designed this machine, either don't have children or are determined to break children's hearts.  The size of Frank is great and his die cast body is solidly built, BUT the blades which spin at the front are made of plastic and are anchored to the main body by two tiny, weak plastic nubs and the wheels which drive the blades are attached to the blades by a thin plastic rail.  As soon as we saw it, we figured it would break and we felt we had been deceived.  We were correct, it broke while being pushed along the hard wood floors - in short any kids who wants to actually PLAY with it, will break it in no time and that is what happened with our son.    My own son was crushed when it broke and you could see Frank was not as much fun for him without the blades.  Glue did not work, but I managed (with some effort and a bit of time) to reattach the broken wheel (so the blades would spin when driven) with some twine.  It worked and frank was fixed...though a bit uglier with the twine woven in and out of the wheel and blades, however my son was happy and started playing with Frank right away...then disaster - about an 15 minutes later, while my son was pushing Frank across the carpet the OTHER wheel broke off, ....(grrrrr) so I'll be spending some time using the twine again.  Why make a great toy and cheap out on such a key part with plastic...really how dumb do you have to be?  Nor do I recall any of the advertisement or product description listing the blades as plastic...all the headlines kept reading \\"die cast\\".

review_body: I bought these for my hubby, always looking for something fun and that he would never get for himself. Well I did it this year he was surprised. product_title: Fisher-Price Blocks
review_body:
I've noticed a lot of other reviews of the this product complaining that the lid doesn't snap on. That is true, but I haven't found it to be a problem. My son loves to play with the pieces, the lid, the container. While he isn't at the stage yet where he is \\"sorting\\" the shapes, he still enjoys the toy. And I think the fact that he understands how to take the lid off to get the shapes out shows he is in the know.

I will say I would never pay retail price for this or many other toys. I got this one in like new condition at a mom 2 mom sale for $1.00.

As for the toxicity issue, well, we try to do our best to be mindful of these things, but unfortunately, it is almost impossible to know what is really in a product. If you are really concerned, don't buy any plastic toys. On that note, when we do pay retail price for new toys, it is always for natural or wood toys, not plastic! Fisher Price doesn't need any more money then they already have ;)

product_title: LeapFrog Tag Reading System (32 MB)
review_headline: Fun for the kids but the battery cover is bad
review_body:
We bought 2 of these, one for my 4 year old and one for my 6 year old. They love them and they have been a great purchase for Christmas. They have played the longest with these than any other toy we've bought in the past. I like them also and are fun to bring the book alive.

My only complaint is trying to get the battery cover off. The 'screw' is plastic and you have to push down. If the screw driver is too thin then it strips the top of the plastic screw so it is harder to take off the next time. The design could have been better and I think the next time I replace the batteries I'll need to replace the cover as well. The directions say \\"push down and turn using a screw driver, coin or other household object\\". Well I used a penny as well with not much luck. Be warned of this pens flaws.

Other than the battery cover I would highly recommend this.

product_title: HeMan Masters of the Universe Classics Action Figure
review_headline: The Most Powerful Man in the Universe!
review_body: \\"By the Power of Grayskull...I have the POWER!!!\\"  This figure is, simply speaking, incredibly awesome.  The line is called Masters of the Universe Classics, and with good reason.  They are figures of classic Masters of the Universe characters for the modern age with a classic feel.  Released exclusively online by Mattel, He-Man and Beast Man were the first ones released back in December 2008 with Skeletor following in January.  Why was Beast Man released before Skeletor?  Who knows.  This figure is incredible.  Even more muscular than the 80's action figure, this He-Man's muscles are better proportioned with the body (no longer an 88 inch chest and a 12 inch waist) and, for all intents and purposes, is purely an updated version of the original, although this Classic figure truly does look like The Most Powerful Man in the Universe and could beat the living daylights out of the original and the 2002 versions of He-Man combined.  When I first laid eyes on this figure I was blown away.  Considering his size, detail and articulation this was a version of He-Man that had never been seen before.  Extremely expensive now, no true He-Fan's collection is worth salt without this figure, but those of you unwilling to hand over $100 dollars for it will have a chance to get it for around $30 (including s&h) when he is re-released on the 16th of November, 2009.  Sure, it won't be the exact same figure as the one released back in December of '08 (it'll have a few tweaks and a \\"The Original\\" sticker on the package) and probably won't be worth as much, but this is the definitive figure of He-Man, a figure no Masters fan can be without.  Masters of the Universe Classics have very limited releases in very limited time frames.  Get them while you can, I even have to plan my work schedule around some of the releases!  The Most Powerful Man in the Universe's accessories are: Power Sword, Power Sword Half, Hero Shield, Power Axe, removable Armor and loads of articulation.

review_body: We gave these to our two girls, ages 7 & 10 for Christmas. They enjoy the \\"grown-up\\" feel of have their own personal texting machines. We have experienced wonderful reception. product_title: Athearn HO Scale Train Set Iron Horse Express BNSF
review_body: We bought the CSX version of the Iron Horse at a local hobby shop and my 8 year old train-on-the-brain son loves it (we've had it for 2 day). At full-speed it stays on the track nicely, the engine is a very solid metal-plastic combination with metal wheels and a light in the cab. The hand rails around the engine are frail but designed to pop right back onto the engine (instead of breaking off) if slightly mishandled. Perfect size for a 6 foot Christmas tree display (a larger tree will warrant the purchase of a track expansion set). A far cry from my 1st HO set back in the 70's with all the little metal tabs that got lost and bent (yeah for E-Z track). You still have to be careful when connecting the track but it's a lot easier and sturdier that the old-version HO track. The box says 14 years and up, but my 8 year old has played with his grandfather's HO set and he's fine if an adult helps with the track construction and is around in case of electrical problem when he's playing with it. Controller has an internal breaker that will shut it down if there's a problem (red overload light signals breaker went off on the controller). Unplug and wait 15 minutes and the breaker resets.

product_title: Levitron Ultimate
review_body: There were a lot of reviews about the difficulty of getting this product working and I was naturally a little hesitant. Still, I'm very interested in levitation and this seemed like fun so I ordered it.  I got the top working just fine in about an hour and played with it that same night until my fingers were sore.  In a few days I was able to get the top to spin repeatedly for around 2 minutes without any additional products.  I will be purchasing the Levitron Perpetuator next year to keep the top spinning \\"indefinitely\\".    The instructions to get the top going were exceptionally clear and concise.  My kids love moving their hands around the floating top and also enjoy trying to catch it mid-air.  One recommendation: Set the base up on a carpeted floor.  My first few spins sent the top flying around the room and I was afraid of breaking it.

product_title: Radio Flyer Soft Rock and Bounce Pony
review_body:
We, or should I say Santa, purchased this horse for our 15 month old daughter. The price was excellent. We love the Radio Flyer brand too since it's been around for many years and they make quality products.

I admit I was a little intimidated at first when I opened the box to find it in many pieces. Everything was packaged well. Use common sense and it will be simple to assemble. The directions are written more like a diagram with a few short descriptions.

We love the fact that the actual horse is machine washable and easy to remove too. We also like that there are no springs to pinch our daughter. The rubber is very thick and we aren't worried about it breaking. It doesn't make sounds like some of the other horses. However, almost every toy for kids makes sounds now. I think kids need basic toys too. It can teach imagination, balance and coordination.

The only cons would be that the frame is made of plastic, which is disappointing but then again everything is plastic now a days anyway. As long as the child is of the proper weight limit I don't think it would be an issue. Also, I noticed that the belly or feet of the horse could hit the floor a little while the child bounces or rocks if he/she is at the top of the weight limit. It does seem like it could slide on hard floors or short carpeting. We put a couple non-skid pads on the bottom and sort of pushed it on the carpet and it seemed to work better. I do think this horse is for the 15mo-3yr. old age range though. Our daughter wouldn't have been able to rock or bounce on her own at 12 months old. unless someone was holding on to her and doing it for her.

Overall I highly recommend this toy. You will not be disappointed.

product_title: Star Trek Ii: The Wrath of Khan Phaser Replica
review_body: The ST2 phaser is a very good replica/prop with two very authentic sound effects which are quite similar to those featured in the movie.  My only hangup is that there are actually four sounds, and two of the four are made up/invented sounds we never heard and just sound terrible - I'd have been happy with just stun and kill since the others seem like fake variants to fill up the features list.  I am also unsure why the \\"self destruct\\" effect features a transporter sound.  The phaser 1 on this is also a bit on the awkward side - phaser 1 from the TOS phaser is much more sleek and stylish - I cannot imagine the phaser 1 on this to be carried on a belt - it just looks terrible.  But once hooked up the pistol, the entire unit looks wonderful.  I especially like the \\"safety\\" feature and the large button to turn on the unit.

product_title: Nerf N-Strike Recon CS-6 Dart Blaster
review_body: These guns are fun but there is something you have to be aware of if you want to avoid a very serious jam.    There is really nothing to prevent the cartridge or magazine from being inserted upside down (i.e. with the darts facing the wrong way).  It is very easy for a younger child to make this mistake, but anyone could the same thing if they were not careful.  Once one of these backwards-facing darts is loaded it will cause a jam that is extremely difficult to free.    My son's two uncles both independently gave him one of these guns for Christmas (two different models).  Both of the guns have been jammed and in both cases it was due to the cartridge being inserted backwards.  The ease with which this can happen is a design error in my opinion.  In one case an uncle was able to free a jam by shredding a dart.  In another case I had to entirely disassemble a gun to free the jam.    (Although I am happy to report that the gun was well-built enough to be as good as new after re-assembly, I don't recommend this process to anyone as it was extremely complex and time consuming and the gun is not really meant to be disassembled.)

review_body: Like everyone else, I can't believe that the paint is coming off the letters and that the \\"lid\\" is just a piece of plastic that doesn't really work as a lid. product_title: Scrabble Diamond Anniversary Edition
review_body: I read the majority of the reviews for this scrabble set and based on them I thought I would write my own.      This board is really nice, with raised squares so that the tiles don't slide all over like in the basic version of scrabble. I believe one of the reviews claimed that the letter tiles were plastic - this is not the case, they are wooden tiles painted black with silver writing and ours all look perfect (no scratches and you can see what all of the letters are just fine).  My favourite thing about this board is that everything fits inside the little storage slots on the bottom of the board, and then the board folds up to get put away.  Also, the board rotates around in a circle which is handy, and although it isn't whisper quiet (as another review complained about) - who cares!       I guess the one thing about this board that could be better are the racks that hold your letter tiles.  They are cheaper than I expected, even though I knew they were going to be plastic.  I know some people also complained that the colors on the board were changed but unless you're a scrabble champion this probably won't make any difference to your gameplay.    All in all, if you want a great scrabble board that is a bit fancier than the basic version for a reasonable price, this is a great option.  If you want high quality wooden parts a super high quality board, then you should probably look to dish out the $150 for the nice wooden version.

product_title: Axis & Allies 1942
review_body: I was introduced to Axis and Allies through a friend who had the oldest version of this game.  This is the fourth edition and it is the best so far, in my opinion.  It's like a very advanced version of Risk except that you have specialized pieces that have their own abilities, movement, and attack and defense values.  You can have air, land, and sea battles complete with amphibious assaults, as well as endless strategies to achieve your goal of world conquest.  However, this is not a game for those looking for a short period of fun, as many of the games I have played have taken longer than one afternoon and evening.  However, if you like strategy games, you will love this.     As a minor complaint, the board is too small and the game doesn't contain enough pieces.  I have ordered chips from another website and downloaded a bigger game board which I printed out with my computer to overcome these minor issues.

product_title: Game Zone Great States Geography Board Game
review_headline: Does this company have a quality control team?
review_body: This game is fantastic for learning about the states and engaging young children in geography.  The answers are easy enough for them to handle, and the information really seems to stick.  That being said, is it too much to ask International Playthings to proofread their questions?  We came across a number of questions with incomplete answers, which are easy enough to fix when we know the answers.  It makes me wonder about the ones we don't know (state birds?), however.  Are those correct, or misprints?  Also, some of the pictures don't match what is on the card, which makes it tough for young kids when the directions say to match the pictures.  Finally, for advanced play it recommends using the cards that are \\"starred\\" to indicate a question that older children should refrain from looking at the board.  Not one of the questions has a star.  Ridiculous.  Great concept, but this isn't nuclear physics.  Of course we can work around it, but it's unfortunate that the execution is so sloppy.

The hood is a lot brighter than the corset, more of a cherry red color, rather than maroon, like the picture shows, and clasps with Velcro.  It's a decent costume-- not too see-through-- and good if you don't want to show off any leg!  It's down to my ankles and I'm 5 feet 5 inches.

review_body: My son has an affinity for windmills. Unusual, I know, but blame it on Thomas. We ordered this toy for him for his Easter basket, and he loved it. He still plays with it. He does not use it with the Thomas train set, he uses it on its own. It is a durable toy. He has just turned 3 and has not broken it. The windmill will spin when you press the button. He likes that, and the button presses easily, which is good. This is a good toy and something different for a little boy or girl to play with.

review_body: Upon opening the package it was discovered that one of the juggling balls was defective and didn't work.  I didn't want to return them as Amazon directed but wanted a replacement ball (since I would have to pay shipping on a new order). Although the supplier couldn't help me they did in turn give me information to contact the distributor.  The distributor had one set of this discontinued item and sent me a replacement ball. I had wished that Amazon's solution would have been to offer shipping the item back with a replacement one sent free of charge.  It took a little work, but I got what I wanted ... 3 working juggling balls. Guess I'm persistent. I only hope that these balls don't have issues in the future hence my reservation in critiquing their durability.

product_title: Barbie Glam Refrigerator
review_headline: Cute but everything is sooo small
review_body: On the pictures it looks like eye-candy AND looks like it would be good for little girls to \\"play kitchen\\" since they'll be familiar with many of the foods and condiments (like eggs, ketchup, etc.) However, the little food items are sooo small, it's hard to deal with them. First they are ripe for getting lost - very hard to store these, second, when you're trying to put them on the shelves, it's almost impossible because you can't put something on without knocking something else over. When it first arrives it looks great because all items are neatly stored on the shelves. But that's only because they are being held there by plastic. Once you remove the form-fitting plastic, some of the condiments have such a small base, getting them to ever stand upright again would be nearly impossible. It's not a very practical toy overall.
