product_title: Linq
review_headline: Word Association & Bluffing Game, Good for Parties
review_body: Product Description:    This game comes in a normal box with a small box of cards, basic \\"quick\\" instructions, detailed instructions, two dry erase boards, two small dry erase markers, two pads of paper, and six small pencils.  If you wanted to use your own supplies, you probably could.  The concept of the game is rather simple so I don't know why there are two sets of instructions.  There is also a small discrepancy between the two sets of instructions regarding the scoring of the bluffing players that could lead to some confusion.  I think the box could have been designed to make more efficient use of space since there really shouldn't be too much to the game besides the cards.    I don't know if this is my favorite game but it combines word association and bluffing which are both mechanics that I enjoy.  I think my problem with games like this is that depending on who you play with it might be too easy.  I think some people are better are psychological games than others (or maybe it's just that people are bad at bluffing and some games rely more heavily on the bluffing aspect).  In any case it could conceivably work in a party setting or if people have been drinking or just having lots of fun and not taking it too seriously.  I think it's also worth a look because it's a fraction of the price of other party games and it has supplies you can cannibalize for other games (e.g. the pencils).

product_title: DC Universe Justice League Unlimited Action Figure 3-Pack Wonder Woman, Flash and Question
review_headline: Coolest JLU Action Figure 3-Pack So Far
review_body: The addition of the Question action figure makes this the coolest of any of the 3-Packs. His hat and overcoat are finally durable and resistant to harm even when played with. And they got the colors right. (There was a bizarre blue-yellow combination years ago.) These have the traditional blocky bodies of the JLU characters, but the faces are finely detailed as are the costumes painted meticulously.  There are not surprises in artiuclation: just arms, legs, and necks. The Question's head doesn't turn easily. Wonder Woman's face looks great rather than cooky as we've seen her in the past, and The Flash is more broad-shouldered than, perhaps, he should be, but he looks like he's ready to take on anything. But, if you ask me, these three are the figures we've been waiting for. Personally, I would have loved to see a Questioin-Huntress-Warlord pack (talk about a knock-out combination), but this works just fine. We've been begging the question (ha ha!) to get The Question. So here he is. Anyway, the sculpts are some of the best I've seen yet, the selection of characters is awesome (Wonder Woman deserves and now has her own movie; The Flash in a fan-favorite in the animated series, and The Question is the ultimate conspiracy theorist par excellence), the paints jobs are perfect, the characters are perfectly balanced (they all stand up on their own without tipping or falling over), and they're a great addition to any action figure collection.

product_title: Snap Circuits PRO SC-500
review_headline: Great Learning Tool for the Basics
review_body: It is fun, educational, and a great introduction to electrical circuits for both kids and adults who have no experience.  The only down side is that there aren't always good explanations regarding the mechanism by which some components operate (e.g. the whistle chip), but you can figure it out by asking around online.  The product could be improved if a booklet was included that explained the inner workings of the components and maybe included some theoretical background (definition of things like resistance, electrical laws, equations, etc.) and experiments to verify these electrical laws.  If you're an adult or have a bright child, it probably won't entertain you for too long (unless you want to get creative and design your own verification experiments which I just might do), but you will gain some basic knowledge and confidence that will get you started in your pursuit of electronics knowledge.  I highly recommend this product, but I also recommend you get an introductory electronics book to use in conjunction with it to maximize you or your child's learning.

product_title: Cooper Carrymore Golden Cocker Spaniel Dog Large 12" Easter Stuffed Animal Plush Purse Gift By Bearington Collection
review_headline: adorable & larger than you might expect
review_body:
This purse is adorable and a little bit larger than most of the other animal-theme little girl purses I've seen. It's soft and cuddly and (unlike the real thing) needs no obedience or potty training. It seems fairly durable aside from the ribbon around the neck -- which I doubt lasts too long but is not really an integral part of the purse. The purse features a zipper across the dog's bag, and it opens to a square pouch lined in a brown cotton fabric. There's lot of arm & leg compared to purse capacity -- so this is really more like a stuffed animal with straps and a secret hiding place rather than a purse shaped like a dog.

I gave this four stars instead of five for one reason -- it doesn't really look like a cocker spaniel. Cockers generally have longer, much floppier ears. Nor did it seem to capture the essence of a cocker. It's a cute dog, but not quite a cocker. If the dog were simply called Cooper Carrymore instead of Cooper Carrymore Golden Cocker Spaniel, I'd give it a fifth star.

Overall, very cute & cuddly, and sure to please the little puppy-lover in your life.

review_body: My brother bought this toy for my 8 year-old-daughter for Christmas at my prompting.  She had seen it advertised and was so excited about it. Both of my kids wanted PixOs for their birthdays SOOO badly, but after seeing its poor ratings on Amazon I explained to them it really wasn't a fun toy and that were weren't going to buy them.  I should have done the same for this thing, and I feel really badly since my brother had a hard time finding one and wound up spending $25 or $30 on it.  We made one cupcake with it on Christmas day.  She made it and the only person that would eat it was my dad (who will usually eat anything) and even he couldn't finish it, saying it tasted of nothing but plastic.  The icing was too thin and it wound up getting flung all over the kitchen (which was actually kind of fun).  My daughter's feelings were hurt when her Papa said her cupcake tasted bad, and neither she nor I was happy about the mess we had to clean up after making just one little cupcake.  We brought it home, I put it on the top shelf of her closet, and that is where it has remained ever since.  My daughter has not asked about once since Christmas.  I agree, you might as well let your child help you make real cupcakes.  It's easier and they'll taste a heck of a lot better.

product_title: La Belle Dame Sans Merci, Sir Frank Dicksee (3000 pc puzzle)
review_body: This puzzle is beautiful -- the picture is very romantic and being a horse lover and married to a chivalrous husband, it just suits us perfectly.  I ordered this and got it within about 10 days, but it worked out perfectly as a Father's Day gift. Many puzzles over 3000 pieces are city-scapes and other art that are not appealing to us, but this one is beautiful.    The quality of puzzle from this company is fantastic. The pieces are thicker and sturdy and the edges snap together very well.  This is our second large puzzle by EDUCA, and we have been VERY pleased with the quality of their products. They live up to their reputation. The printing is very good quality also, not fuzzy or \\"dotty\\" like cheap puzzles.      My husband did a 5000 piece Educa puzzle a few years back and we glued, framed it, and hung it in our entryway.  It looks so perfect from even a few feet away that most people are shocked to find out it's a puzzle and not a 5' x 4' painting!  Only when they get really close can they see that it is a puzzle -- that is how good the printing and piece matching is with this brand of puzzles!!    The best feature of EDUCA puzzles is that for serious puzzlers, if you lose a piece or one is missing from the box, you can order that exact piece from the manufacturer for a very reasonable price.  When you spend this much time putting something this tedious together, only to have your heart sink when you discover a piece is gone (or the cat chewed it up) it's good to know all is not lost -- replacement pieces are at your fingertips!    Highly recommend these puzzles -- well worth the price. When I shopped for this, as usual, Amazon.com had the best price because of free shipping. Thanks Amazon!

product_title: Sea-Monkeys Ocean Zoo Blister
review_body:
Ahhh Seamonkeys. I recieved my first tank as a child and have been a fan ever since. I grew up and Seamonkeys stayed a part of my life, an important part. After attending culinary academy I landed in a position assisting a chef at a hotel. As time went by I yearned more and more to create my own signature dish. I wanted a pasta dish, reflecting my medditeranean herritage and passion. Fumbling with many alfredo and carbonaras, always missing was that grand flavor I was after...that magic ingredient. One night, returning home from a dreadfully long night; I noticed the last of my latest colony of Seamonkeys had perished. It was saddening, but I knew they lived long and happy and that this was the cycle of life. And then it hit me...
I poured the contents of the tank into the kitchen sink, sifting the water through some paper towels to catch all the little critters bodies and other sediments. I placed this under a heating lamp for 48 hours to dry everything out so I could try my brilliant idea.
Finally, on that 3rd day everything was ready. I may have rushed with the pasta, but the sauce was grand. A thick tomato sauce, slow cooked and brimming with aromatic basil and garlic. I took my Seamonkeys; I stirred them in. In a matter of seconds I was delighted to notice the tantalizing hint of seafood in the scent of my sauce. I lifed the wooden spoon to my lips. Perfection!
My dish became an instant success, and added to the menu. Many a peer has tried to pry my secret ingredient from me, but to no avail.
I will not tell you what hotel, or even where. But just remember next time you are out having that chefs special medditeranean pasta...it could be me! Buon appetito!

product_title: Iwata-Medea Studio Series Power Jet Pro Double Piston Air Compressor
review_body: I have been using airbrushes since 1984. I started off with a compressor that would vibrate right off the table. I then graduated up to a silent compressor which lasted about 15 years. I then bought another compressor that lasted about 10 years and have just acquired a Power Jet Pro compressor from Iwata-Medea, Inc in Portland, OR.    This compressor has so many excellent features and I'll mention them:    -It has two ports for two separate airbrushes. They can be set at different PSI levels. One airbrush can run at 30 PSI and the other at 15 for example. It can also handle the two airbrushes with no lack of power.    -The on/off switch lights up when it is on. With a quick look at the compressor you can see if it is on or off from a distance. The other ones you often have to get really close to see if they are still on.    -The compressor is quite light but don't let it fool you. It has plenty of power. I spray watercolors through my airbrush and never have to go much higher than 15-25 PSI and most fine artists never do.    -It is oil-less. Some compressors require oil and the oil is pricey and messy. This compressor is extremely maintenance free.    -When it reaches pressure it does not have that awful burst of compressed air before it shuts off and you can work in quiet. When it reaches the pressure you want it shuts off quietly.     I have had four compressors in the last 25 years  and would rate this one as the very best for the money. It is distributed by the best airbrush company in the world and they have an outstanding support staff there (503-253-7308). You should look around and get the best price you can.[...]    You can see my artwork at [...].

product_title: Transformers  Leader Optimus Prime
review_body: First off, this toy is NOT for small kids. If you're a parent looking for something for their less than 13 years old or so, I hope you're prepared to be transforming this figure, because your children won't be able to.    This figure is incredibly accurate to the Optimus Prime model used in the movies. Its robot form, truck mode, and transformation are all extremely detailed and designed to look just like the movie version. As a result, its transformation is extremely complicated. I mostly recommend this figure to collectors over the age of 15. The figure is sturdy enough to be played with, I've had mine for months now and all of the joints are in good shape. Still, Hasbro has released many, many different optimus primes (There are gravity bots and fast action battles for younger kids, and the Voyager Optimus Prime is perfect for kids who have some practice with transformers already). So take a look at them all and decide which is best.    On to the figure itself: This Optimus is a BIG improvement on the original leader toy from the first movie. Its only negative aspects are plastic tires (first movie prime had rubber tires) and no individual finger articulation (however, this toy does not bring a gun so its not necessary). It has some lights and sounds (makes the tranformation sound when part of the transformation is done) and actually has the voice of Peter Cullen (who voiced Optimus in both movies as well as the original 80s cartoon). The figure also has a swing out plastic \\"blade\\" on each arm (which can get a little in the way of its possibility at times).    In all honesty though, if you're at all a fan of transformers toys, and think you can handle the challenge of transforming this great, great figure, BUY IT.

The only qualm I would have is that her waist is so tiny it makes it hard for the figure to remain in poses where the waist is bent. But that's small potatoes!
Buy it, love it.

product_title: 1/24 RC 3-Ch Remote Control M1A2 Abrams Tank
review_body: I bought this for my son for Xmas.  The first one shipped did not fire the BBs.  I had to send it back.  The 2nd one did not even turn on.  My son asked why Santa would send him toys that don't work.  Avoid this toy!

product_title: LeapFrog Learn & Groove8482; Musical Table
review_body: This is quality materials and the sound is better than most toys.  We bought this because our 8.5 month old is pulling herself up on things now to stand, so we figured this would be a good reward for pulling herself up.  However the table is not very sturdy, even a 15 lb. 8 month old can pull it down on her while trying to pull herself up.      I would suggest leaving the legs off the table until your child can stand up without pulling on something.  It simply wasn't made for that.

product_title: Fisher-Price Laugh & Learn Learning Phone
review_headline: Not a lot of bang for the buck
review_body: Maybe it's because my son realizes the difference between the real phone or remote and the toy versions but he didn't really play with this one. It is very durable. It works well and has some educational value for a toddler, just not mine. :(

product_title: Little Tikes Handle Haulers Haul & Ride
review_body: We bought this great truck for our Grandson for his first Easter.  He loves it!! He really likes the three noise buttons.  I picked this truck because it is three in one (ride on, push and wagon). It is very versatile and fun.

product_title: Blue Orange Games Zimbbos Award Winning Wooden Skill Building STEM Counting Stacking Game for Kids
review_headline: A great first game for little ones
review_body: I picked up this game for my 2.5-year-old and it's been a hit. The rules are pretty basic: roll the die and then stack the pieces (cute elephants, a clown, a bear, etc.) according to what you roll.     My son is too young to fully understand the concept of the game, but with my help and instruction, we can get through a short game. It's been really good for teaching him about numbers and balance, and also for teaching the basic concept of taking turns during a game. The hardest part, for him, is following the \\"directions\\" that rolling the die gives you. He wants to execute his own stacking plan.    But that makes this game a good toy as well. My son will often ask for \\"Elephant Game!\\" just to practice stacking and rolling the die -- it can keep him entertained for quite a long time.    This isn't a game that'll be fun for years and years... I'm sure kids will outgrow it before they enter school. But it's a great introduction to games for little ones, a good starting point.

product_title: Schleich Musk Ox
review_body: This is a beautiful, accurate, well-made replica musk ox toy.  It looks very much like a real musk ox and is very durable.

product_title: Doctor Who Underground Toys 5 inch Genesis Ark Dalek Gift Set
review_body: the Daleks roll and are poseable by armature, eye and head. The paint and finish are great. The eyeball sticker (flat blue) is lame.

product_title: Ultrasorter Motorized Coin Sor
review_body: we want to send the coin sorter back.  the coins keep jamming in the top.  some fall into the wrong coin size.  Not happy w/ it at all  thank you  janice

product_title: Little Tikes Tap A Tune Xylophone
review_body: I have never reviewed an item on Amazon before despite purchasing a lot of stuff.  This was the first time I was ever moved to take the time to do it because I am very mad.    This product looks like cute and inexpensive xylophone for an infant.  Indeed when I opened it up I thought \\"Neat! My kid is gonna love it and learn!\\"  However to my chagrin, two of the xylophone metal pads are the same tone.  They are a different color, but when you tap them it is clear they just painted them differently.  You can't even play some of the songs right because there are not enough tones in sequence.    The second problem is the music.  The box makes it seem like  you will have hard backed separate music sheets which will fit in the tray above the xylophone.  It is also supposed to be color coded so you can match it on the pads.  However, the music in the box was not hard backed and it was not even color coded.  So you are left with four songs on one sheet of paper in black and white.      Do not buy this product.  Spend a little more and get a fisher price one or just buy some other version of the xylophone.  they are out there....I considered them before I bought this one and I wish someone would have told me to do so.

product_title: ThinkFun Pirate's Gold
review_body: The basic concept of this game is to get the treasure out of the playboard by pushing it out the exit.  Sound  easy? Well think again!!! Thinkfun Has come up with another great brain teaser board game. If you liked Rush Hour, Tip Over, and River Crossing you'lle like this game as well!!  Highly addicting!! Highly reccomend!!!!

product_title: Intex Ocean Inflatable Play Center, 100" X 77" X 31", for Ages 2+
review_headline: great fun for too short a time
review_body: This much-anticipated pool took a while to blow up: too many separate areas to inflate. Our toddler loved it. However as we used the pool, the air leaked out. We reinflated and checked the air plugs to be certain they were correctly and tightly closed. Again the air leaked out! We may have had a defective model, but this pool was a waste of money and time.

product_title: Fisher-Price Laugh & Learn Say Please Tea Set
review_body: My daughter got this for her birthday when she turned one, she dances to the songs and she loves playing with it almost everyday. The only downside is that there are only two songs, it does teach some useful phrases such as when you open or close the lid and makes gurgling sounds when you tip it to pour \\"tea\\". Overall its a excellent product and my daughter really enjoys playing with it.

product_title: Educational Insights Design & Drill Activity Center
review_body: My daughter really can't sit still for much but she seems to be able to for this one. It's an all around great learning toy. It's creative and great for fine motor skills, hand eye coordination etc. It's like an art project without the mess and a game you can play too. The pieces are big enough for little hands yet still a challenge within reach.  There are many different ways to play and use this toy, your child can lead you! And all that practice with tools! Girls don't let that deter you this toy is great for little girls too.

product_title: Fisher-Price Little Superstar Sing-Along Stage
review_body: My son, Xander has been playing with his Sing-Along stage since he was 2 or 3 months old.  He loves playing with the baby in the mirror.  The lights and music facinate him.  The microphone is good for learning to hold and shake things.  So glad I bought this for him.

product_title: Agricola (Discontinued by manufacturer)
review_body: After looking for a board game to move to after years of playing settlers of catan, I purchased this game. While it is not exactly like Settlers (thankfully), it is comparable and everyone has enjoyed it as much as that game.     Once learned the game takes very little time to play through, in fact the game feels shorter and shorter each time we play. It is a strategy game which demands that you plan ahead and make the most of each move. It seems that chance is a minor role when compared to settlers.    This game has many modes to play through and allows for years of gameplay.     I would recommend watching a youtube video on how to play when you get this game, if you do not have someone to teach you. As others have said, the rules don't make sense to newbies. They are clear after you have played the game through, but I know there were many, \\"Ah-ha!\\" moments while watching the video like, \\"thats an action square!\\" and others.

product_title: Le Toy Van Large Wooden Mystic fortress Castle
review_body: We have the smaller version of this castle as well.  Even though this is large, it is quick and easy to take apart and put back together.  We recently even brought it on a trip (road trip) and set it up in our hotel.  Our 5 year old loves it.

product_title: Playmobil Roman Carriage
review_body: This was bought for my cousin's son.  He loved it.  The pieces are very small and are easy to loose.

product_title: National Geographic™ Digital World Camera
review_body: This thing barely worked once opened. Photos are grainy and the camera is complicated for a kid. Not worth the money at all.

product_title: Inuyasha 12" Collector's Figure
review_body: I absolutely love the InuYasha doll! My mom wishes they had dolls like him back in the 60's when she was young. Authentically detailed and fully articulated, he's a must, in my opinion, for any InuYasha fan or doll collector. Too bad the other characters aren't available like this. He really deserves to be standing next to a 1/6 scale Kagome, at least, on display. Anyway, he is nice. Great product!

product_title: Travel Game - Find It Games - "On a Bird Watch" - The Original Hidden Object Search Adventure
review_body: This is a great item to have sitting in a family room, vacation house, or waiting room.  Adults and children love searching for the items--my 5 year old son and my 80+ year old grandmother both love it.  It's addictive like a jigsaw puzzle--but all of the pieces are contained.

product_title: Fisher-Price Kid-Tough Digital Camera Blue
review_body: Battery issues. Sad, because it's a great toy. But no toy is great if it only works for 1/2 a day. Not sure if it's the product lot, because the battery issues seem to be prevalent with recent purchases, but FP will replace this product under one year warranty at no charge. We're waiting for the shipping label. If the new ones have the same problems (or new problems, now that viruses seem to come with them), they're going back to the \\"North Pole\\" for good.

product_title: TY Classic Lambert  White Lamb
review_body: I collect cuddly toys and this one is surely one of my favorites. Cuddly and incredibly soft, this lamb is the most adorable ever.

product_title: Harley Davidson Cam 88 1/2 Scale Motorcycle Engine
review_body: I have built two of these, after finishing the first one i decided that haveing all the internal moving parts clear as they come in the kit made it hard to see them moveing.   on the second kit i spay painted the internal parts differnt colors of candy to make them easyer to see and it worked great. the company should sujest it in thier instructions.   the only negitive thing i have to add is that both of my kits and i assume all kits were wired so that they turn the motor around in reverse direction to how the motor really runs so opened up the base and redid the wireing to correct this and i know i ride one.

product_title: Melissa & Doug Wooden Building Block Set - in 4 Colors and 9 Shapes
review_headline: Love this sturdy, hands-on 'toy'---Great for building imagination!
review_body: Many toys seem to 'do' the play for the kids.  There's nothing for them to do , but WATCH it.  The Melissa / Doug toys let the kids use their imaginations and work the pieces for themselves.  Nothing is done for them.

product_title: Radio Flyer 32 All-Terrain Steel and Wood Wagon
review_body: We bought this for our granddaughter's 1st Birthday.  It arrived very fast but one of the wood rails was damaged.  I contacted Amazon and Radio Flyer who sent out a replacement part right away at no cost to us. Both Amazon and Radio flyer had super customer service.  Our granddaughter LOVES this wagon and we know she will have many years of fun ahead.  Our own chlidren had the smaller Radio Flyer wagon while they were growing up and it lasted years.

product_title: Fisher-price All-in-1 Doll Travel System Deluxe Rainforest Playset
review_body: I purchased this for my granddaughter's second birthday it matched her new baby brothers playset. The playpen does not stay together so it is a little frustrating for her. The stroller fell apart after about six months and the swing is very duriable but the way it hooks on when it is pushed the swing falls off. I was just suprissed it did not hold up better.

product_title: Franklin Junior Arcade Basketball
review_headline: Both structure and electronics are fragile
review_body: We've had this product for a year and a half.  It was a lot of fun at first but out of the box we noticed that the electronics were fragile.  Every game, if played long enough, would result in the scoring system crashing and restarting, apparently due to the shaking and jarring it experienced from being hit with the balls (the electronics are in the backboard).  This was disappointing but my 6 year-old son still had a good time with it until after about a month of on-and-off use the plastic pips began to loosen up and crack and the Velcro that holds the scoreboard in place ripped.  This is through normal use.  I personally am sick and tired of toys that are broken out of the box and that do not stand up to ordinary use that they should be designed for.  I tried researching this product prior to buying and was very disappointed in the end.  I do not recommend this unless you are in the habit of buying disposable toys.

product_title: Fisher Price Kid-Tough Digital Camera for Boys
review_headline: a different perspective... just a thought
review_body: I bought this camera (the pink version) used for my daughter who is 5.  Although she can handle my digital camera, I wanted something for her that she could be rough with, could handle an accidental spill, and would take a memory card. I read lots of terrible reviews on this camera and I can say that if you are wanting sharp, clear pictures, then this is not your camera. However, if you like the look of old-school photography, then you'll love the way the photos look. Personally, I love the way that her shots come out. She takes rather abstract shots anyway, and the slight graininess and color make them really interesting.  I'm not relying on her photos to document our events and lives anyway... they're just an extra perspective and she has a blast with this thing.  One thing that I will say is a big downer is the way the batteries and memory card are stored. You have to remove two screws to do both which means we'll have remember to carry a little screwdriver with us on vacation. I don't think I would have paid the full retail price for this since it's just not that much less expensive than a cheap adult camera, but used it's well worth it.

product_title: Jumbo Sequence Box Edition
review_body: I am very happy with this game, it is MUCH better than the regular sequence game!

product_title: Twilight Pin Set
review_body: Bought them for a keepsake not to use.  Love this movie and all of the books.

product_title: Coraline Bendy Doll in Rain Coat
review_body: I would NOT pay more than retail for this ([...]). I realize this is the most \\"rare\\" of the bendy figures... however, it is VERY small. product_title: Hot Wheels Color Shifters Humvee Car

product_title: Cars Buildable Racers Asst.
review_body: My son was totally obsessed with assembling these cars over and over. He would carry them everywhere with him. Over time he got great at putting them together and taking them apart, which I think was great for his coordination and motor skills. They are durable, and you can mix and match the car parts for some silly looks. We've had them over a year and he still loves them. We don't use the tower that much, just the cars, but I'd definitely buy it again!

product_title: LeapFrog Learn & Groove8482; Musical Table
review_body: Daughter really loves this.  Havne't attached legs yet but will once she starts standing full time.  She loves playing with all the different toys on it.  It keeps her entertained for a while.  I did have troubles with my first one - it just would not work.  But Amazon replaced it for us and the 2nd one works great.

product_title: Transformers Universe Deluxe Class Classic Series Action Figure - Autobot Sunstreaker with Electron Pulse Blaster
review_body: Sunstreaker is the latter of the two Autobot brothers,and was retooled and repainted into Sideswipe.He,like his brother,has an alternate form of a Lambourghini which is painted yellow with a red Autobot symbol.The transformation is the same as his brother's but with a different head.He looks awesome and comes with a rocket pack and an electro pistol.I really like these new molds of the Autobot Brothers and both are awesome.One is cool but if you have both,they truly are great.Both are highly recommended

product_title: FISHER-PRICE Games MATCHIN' MIDDLES
review_headline: Excellent developmental toy for most ages!
review_body: I am a pediatric physical therapist and these cookies are excellent for maintaining the attention of children of all ages.  They promote development and are easy to clean

product_title: Wooden Alphabet Set
review_body: As a preschool teacher, I know it is important to teach lowercase letters first, as too many young children write in all uppercase letters. About 95% of written words that your child will see are in lowercase letters. This is a great hands on tool to teach the Alphabet, whether it's singing your abc's or individual letter recognition. I use this with my own daughter to go on a \\"letter hunt\\". We pick a letter from the puzzle and find items around the house that start with that letter. It is also a great activity for my daughter to do by herself. I only wish they used a single-story letter \\"a\\" as opposed to the double-story, which is why I only give it 4 stars.

product_title: Fame Art Deco 3.5" Chessmen
review_body: As advertised and pictured, these are rather stylish chessmen, hand-painted in red and black with gold and silver trim.  They come sturdily packed in a largish styrofoam spacer inside a cardboard box; mine showed up unchipped, which is all I could reasonably ask.  They do have a delicate feel to them, so I doubt I'll be intentionally knocking them over anytime soon... but they're chessmen, not green army men, so I don't consider this much of a drawback.    I would've preferred some sort of felt on the base, but that's it.

product_title: Leap Frog Leapster2 Learning Game System
review_body: The screen resolution is poor and the display is not crystal clear - Colors look drained. The games for a five year old do not seem to have enough about them (we purchased Wall E with the console). It does not hold their interest for any sustained period. So overall a thumbs down. Maybe should have got the Nintendo DS.

product_title: LEGO Classic House Building Set
review_headline: vERY SMALL PIECES... NOT WHAT IT SEEMS... TAKE A LONG LOOK!!!
review_body: TOO SMALL FOR SMALL CHILDREN... So even if I as the adult wished to put it together... ugh... not worth it...

product_title: Final Fantasy Tonberry Plush Toy 7" tall Brand New
review_body: The Tonberry that appears in the picture and the ones I received were different.  I have the tonberry that appears in the picture because I give them away as presents every holiday. product_title: Laser Target Alarm Clock
review_body: I gave this product to a 13 year old boy and he loves it.  He doesn't mind waking up how so he can have target practice!  I would recommend this clock to young and old.  Jan in Jersey

product_title: Pirates of the Caribbean Buried Treasure Kit
review_body: My five-year-old has a lot of fun with this kit!  He loves to pretend he's a pirate with the coins, bag, and compass.  We haven't really touched the paper/pens yet because he's been playing with the other components so much.  The ship was impossible to put/keep together, but that didn't bother my son at all because he still enjoys the rest of the kit.

product_title: Swimline Deluxe Lounge Chair
review_body: This is not good for adults.  It is too slippery and just too hard to get on.

product_title: Amazing Noodle Chair (Colors Vary, Noodles Sold Separately)
review_headline: Amazing Pool Noodle Chair - Really Is!
review_body: This is a very comfortable and fun chair! Very flexible, and durable.  I recommend it!

product_title: Learning Resources Colored Safety Goggles
review_body: We got these for Christmas to go with the woodworking sets.  They loved them.  It has been 6 months and none have broken or needed repair. I loved the price!

product_title: Scientific Explorer Ultimate Bubble Gum Fun Kit
review_body: I bought this as an introduction to science for my grandsons.  They had a lot of fun making the gum.  The only down side is that the flavor didn't last as long as they would have liked.

product_title: Gund: Mooly the Black Cow
review_body: Very Very soft stuffed animal, great to put in the crib with our 2 year old granddaughter who LOVES this cow !

product_title: Playskool Step Start Walk 'n Ride
review_body: For the price, this walk and ride toy is great!  It was pretty easy to put together and has plenty of little odds and ends on it for little ones to play with and it bright and colorful.  My son loves it!

product_title: Volantex RC 6-CH Simulator USB RC Airplane R/C Helicopter Training Kit for windows XP/Vista/Win7
review_body: Other reviewer was right. Use ClearviewRC or Realflight (with dongle). If using Realflight set axis for channel 2,4,6,8 reverse on all I think. Crash once and you could have bought 2 or 3 of these.

product_title: Disney Pixar Wall-E 8" Talking Eve Plush
review_body: I purchased this Talking Plush Wall-E as a birthday gift for a 2yr. old. The party/unwrapping was on Thursday afternoon -- the toy ceased to \\"talk\\" Saturday morning. Less than 48 hours of functioning!  I called the vendor, who was polite and informative, but was told that there is nothing to do. These toys are made with NON-REPLACEABLE batteries so when it's dead its dead. It's quick and untimely death brought many tears and pleas to \\"fix\\".  I will not buy any more of these toys with non-replaceable batteries.  Also, I don't see anywhere on Amazon.com where it told me that it has these non-replaceable batteries.    Grade: F-

product_title: Melissa & Doug
review_body: A friend purshased this product and was very happy with it.  However, we have owned a very similar one from IKEA for two years for half the price.  Our IKEA product gets put outside on nice days and has been pretty beaten up, but is still in good shape and very sturdy.  If you can't get to an IKEA, the Melissa and Doug product is an excellent choice.

product_title: Playmaker Toys Flingshot Flying Monkey Plush Toy, Brown
review_body: When I was a buyer, I ordered these for a large art store and they sold like hot-cakes!   This is actually my dog's favorite toy. She shakes it back and forth to make it screech and runs around with the monkey in her mouth.  Although they need to be replaced after awhile,this is the best value for a toy and is extremely entertaining for both of us

product_title: Transformers Movie 2  Leader Jetfire
review_body: I really like this toy! I would highly recommend this for any one who loves Transformers! product_title: Babblin' Boo with Magical Little Mikey
review_body:
She's cute, she's cuddly, and she says several incoherent phrases (much of which can probably be deciphered with practice). Now as for the screwdriver; don't have one too far away should you decide to cuddle with her while the batteries are in. I don't know if changes were made to subsequent models, but the one I have does not contain an \\"off\\" switch, so you'll have to either take the batteries out with a screwdriver (that's the only way to open the battery compartment) or wear them out if you don't want to set her off accidentally. product_title: Fisher-Price Little Superstar Sing-Along Stage
review_body: I bought this for my 8 month old for Christmas this year and initially thought it was good, but not great.  My daughter loved the songs and the mirror, so I was happy that she enjoyed it.  As time went on, the damn thing has grown on both my husband and I!  The songs are really catchy (I have to admit, the songs get stuck in your head!!), and it's really ingenious that they made it so that you \\"play\\" the different instruments and change the beat.  I honestly didn't think it did anything except have the kids pop up.  Really neat toy!  Definitely would get again!

product_title: Barbie Store It All - Pink
review_body: This Barbie Case was not very sturdy. The top of it did not even close properly. Instead of playing Barbie with it, the little girl (age 4) sat on it and scooted around the house. When leaving for home...she left it here to play with the next time she came back.

product_title: Jakks Pacific Ultimotion Swing Zone Sports Motion Controller Video Game
review_body: This is a great toy and a lot less expensive than the Wii.  My kids love it.

product_title: Mini Rubber Duckies Water Sports Pair
review_body: These are fun to have in the bath and to be a part of your rubber ducky collection.

product_title: Froggy Tales - 6-Piece Bedding Set
review_headline: Super cute set but being discontinued
review_body: I am expecting a baby early winter.  I bought most of the pieces to the set and I love them all.  it's really adorable and looks great in the baby room. product_title: Murder Mystery Party Games - Pasta, Passion & Pistols
review_body: Had Italian dinner party last night with six guests.  First time I hosted mystery dinner  but have attended several in past.  Had blast and everyone of attendees commented on the fun they had.  Party lasted approximately 3 hours including serving of dinner.  I will purchase another mystery game in near future. product_title: Jakks Pacific G2 Game Girl Hannah Montana Guitar Video Game
review_body: We gave this to our girls for Christmas & they have loved it!  It sold for $59.00 in the stores over the holidays.  I would be disappointed if we spent that much for it, that is way over priced.  But for the price we paid on Amazon we have been very happy.  We have had a lot of fun with it, definitely worth getting if you don't own a Wii.

product_title: step2 Playhouse Neat & Tidy Cottage
review_body: Our kids really enjoy this playhouse.  It was pretty easy to put together, though not perfectly formed to fit with ease, sometimes I had to fudge it alittle.  Bt it all worked out and the kids are having fun!

product_title: Crayola Glow Station can create with Light!
review_body: My 3 1/2 yr old Grandson loves this toy! It is fun to write in the dark and see it glow. Grandma likes to use it also.

product_title: Bakugan B2 Bakuclear Single LOOSE Sub Terra Brown OBERUS
review_body: My grandson wanted the Brown Bakugan's for his birthday.  They were very hard to find in stores.  When I found them on Amazon, I purchased every one Amazon had! t a great price! He was ecstatic when he opened his present and saw FIVE of them!  This was a good buy!

product_title: Marky Sparky - Blast Pad Missile Launcher
review_body: My four year old loves this blast pad.  The rockets have great vertical height and it's very compact when folded down.  I don't think you would regret the purchase.

product_title: Barbie Fairytopia Magic of the Rainbow Mini Dolls Gift Pack with Laverna, Elina, Azura Doll Set
review_body: I received this package from Amazon through Amazon Plush. When the package arrived, Laverna's head was already snapped off, and Elina was loose in the box. product_title: Dark Knight Harvey Dent/Two Face Head Knocker
review_body: It's what you would expect from a headknocker, the detail put into this one is pretty great and it looks spectacular next to the Joker and Batman headknockers.

product_title: Necron Heavy Destroyer Box Warhammer 40K by Games Workshop
review_body: All Warhammer products are an enjoyable experinece itself, since you have to build your own gamer.  The enduring is a little bit problematic, they´re very small and delicate to deal with.  But really good hobbie for medium grown children. Teaches them to have patience and be careful of their team.

product_title: Yo Gabba Gabba 9 Inch Plush Figure Muno
review_headline: My daughter is CRAZY for Muno
review_body:
You know, I didn't realize just how popular Yo Gabba Gabba was until my 1 1/2 year old daughter flipped out when she saw the commercial for the DVD with Jack Black.
Now, the floodgates have opened, and she's nuts about EVERYTHING Yo Gabba Gabba.
Which is great. The show is phenomenal. It's a fun, educational, musical assault on a childs' senses, and the songs are really catchy.

Now the toy. Well, if you have a kid who's into the show, then as any parent knows, you've got to get them the related toys.
And what kid doesn't like dolls like this?

When my daughter saw Muno, she flipped. At first, we thought she might be scared of this odd, cyclops-thing, but it turns out, he's her absolute FAVORITE character.
And the figure, while small, is made pretty well, and actually looks better in person than the pictures on this site make him look.

If there is any ONE single thing I would be concerned about with this toy as a parent, it is his HUGE, PLASTIC EYE. That thing scares me...but not in a \\"supernatural-he-may-come-to-life-in-the-night-and-eat-me\\" way.
More like \\"I-hope-my-daughter-doesn't-try-to-eat-that-eye\\" way.
And of course, any little kid is going to find that damn eye quite appetizing.
She has TRIED to eat it of course, but to this toy's credit, it's secured on pretty well.
Does that mean your kid will NEVER be able to bite this thing off? NO.
I would suggest if your child is under a certain age, do NOT leave them ALONE with this toy.

That being said, if your child likes Yo Gabba Gabba, then ALL of these plush figures are a no-brainer. Every time the show comes on, my daughter will grab the figures and dance around with them during the numerous, catchy songs.
It's hilarious, and priceless to a parent.

So, my verdict is...BUY. If your child loves Yo Gabba Gabba.
You won't regret it.
Just be careful with their eyes, as they are made of plastic, and Muno's in particular is quite large, and definitely choke-material.

Good luck!

product_title: Ben 10 Alien Creation Chamber
review_headline: Age inappropriate, poorly manufactured and difficult
review_body: While the IDEA of assembling your own creatures is great, and our son loves putting together the various pieces to create new \\"guys,\\" this toy is poorly made and will remain forever in our memories as a BAD idea. Our family endured 3 hours of frustration - both child and adult - because this toy is so difficult to enjoy. Each alien requires a TINY grey piece in order to be attached to another part or to the chamber. This is day 2 and several of these have already fallen off and some are lost (no extras are provided!) All the parts are so tiny and difficult to insert that the toy is not appropriate for a 4-year old's manual agility (or a 40-year old) Once we get the alien's parts in the chamber to \\"create\\" him, the dials become immobile. Once we mobilize the dials and turn the creation button, it's almost impossible for a grown-up to, as the instructions dictate, to \\"lock\\" the parts and the press the button to pop out the new creature. My husband has to come over and press the button every time. VERY frustrating. Many tears and fits later, we will not recommend this toy. Great idea, poor implementation. Definitely not age-appropriate, and definitely not worth $30. Get some legos instead.

review_body: Fantastic little figure whether you are a fan of the show or not. She comes with quite a few different arm and leg pieces, and all of her hands pieces except the one specifically for holding her gun, can be changed around allowing even more options. Her gun strap is pretty difficult to change, I recommend leaving the short strap on the gun, balancing Yoko with her gun strapped to her back with the stand is pretty frustrating so I wouldn't even bother.     Getting her to hold her gun is pretty easy once you know the trick. Her gun has two small pegs and she has a hole in her gun hand. Her other hand can be rotated to make her support the other side of the gun.     Overall a great buy, lots of fun.

product_title: Crayola 3 Ct Washable Tadoodles Crayon Buddies
review_headline: Excellent first time crayons for age appropriate toddlers
review_body: I must admit I am surprised by the amount of complaints posted here. I bought these for my 15 month old and they were a huge hit, and still are at 22 months of age. (Although now the traingular markers and finger paints are more excititng for him.)     The crayons should not come out of the holders unless the TaDoodle is held and twisted in a certain direction. One direction raises the crayon and the other direction lowers it.    However, to agree with some of the cons, my little guy did taste test the green crayon on two ocassions, at which time I decided he could only color under my supervision. Problem solved. He does NOT do this anymore, and he even knows the marks have to go on the paper.    At 15-18 months, he did enjoy throwing the TaDoodles, which was a problem for the infamous and aforementioned green crayon. This crayon broke and for the life of me I can not reinsert it because the rest of the crayon is still stuck in the base. So, he only has 2 colors instead of 3 now.    The shape of the crayon is part of the natural developing way a child grasps objects. It's the same idea as hodling a spoon with a fist, etc. Once the child is shown how to hold the crayon it should be very natural for him.

The laser cards aren't quite as stiff as the cards that come with the game, but they are thick enough to shuffle and use with the original cards. Formatting them for using in the printer was a little time consuming, but totally worth the effort.

If you're a fan of Apples to Apples, this is more fun that the other expansion packs because you get to make the game your own.

product_title: Classic Vampire Costume - Child Costume
review_headline: Fabulous price for all the accessories

The colors and fabric are vibrant and comfortable.  There is a tie cape and velcrow cummberbund for adjustments.  I did not like the \\"One Size Fits All\\" measurement. I can fix these issues with a little sewing, but I am not much of a seamstress and would rather have size options. Regardless, I think this is a wonderful buy for the money. review_body: My 3 year old & 7 year do have fun with this product but whenever the commercial comes on my son likes to point out how it is not quiet true. product_title: Step2 Easel for Two Toddlers - Durable Two-Sided Art Dry Chalk board with Magnetic Letters, Sign and Numbers, Red

review_headline: Dd likes it but it doesn't do much.

She likes the necklace itself and has asked for more charms. She does like to Pixie Hollow online and play but she can't get too many \\"butterflies\\" w/o more charms. review_body: I purchased this product for my daughter and not even I (hardware and software proficient) can get it to work.  Direction could not be found anywhere in the package which really frustrates me. I would not recommend anyone purchasing this prouduct.

product_title: Hape Beleduc Spider Glove Kid's Hand Puppet
review_headline: great puppet with friendly spider face
review_body: I was looking for a spider puppet to use in my French classes for preschoolers and Kindergarten/first grade and was not disappointed by this friendly spider.  His face is very kid appealing, not realistic, but that is not what I intended.  You put your fingers in five of the eight legs; the others have stuffing in them.  All the spider's legs stay flat, they are not curved like in the picture, unless you bend your five fingers (and the other three legs of the spider will stay flat).  I use this puppet while sitting on the floor with little kids; the spider is on my knee or on the floor.  The puppet's glove are made for women's hands or children's hands but a man's hand would probably not fit (also not a problem).  All in all a nice puppet for a nice price! product_title: Step2 All Star Sports Climber for Toddlers - Durable Outdoor Indoor Kids Slides with Ball Game Accessories, Multicolor
review_headline: Fun inside and Out, best value
review_body: Got this for my 18 month old daughter after reading all the reviews.  I originally wanted a slide but after researching decided to go with this and we are so happy with our purchase.  Right now it is in the house and I swear the first 6 months we had it she slid down the slide for at least and hour a day!  It was hilarious.  Still almost a year later, she slides everyday and plays basketball and hides in the \\"cave\\" underneath.  That is probably her favorite part right now...hiding.      She just really loves it and we already have gotten our money's worth I would recommend highly to anyone looking for a climber or slide because it has so many options and can fit easily into any room and goes right through doors without taking it apart (we have taken it outside a few times)    It was pretty difficult to put together but I think part of that is because they make it sound so easy in the instructions, but really it takes a LoT of force to get those pieces snapped together, but I would still buy it!

product_title: Blue Hat Toy Company Little Tunes MP3 Player
review_body: I looked high and low for a music player for my 2 year old.  I have tried a few toy \\"MP3\\" players, but none passed the test of his rigorous use.  I noticed the Blue Hat MP3 player at a Tuesday Morning store and decided to give it a try.  (ran about $30)  It's great.  My son loves it and was able to operate it immediately with very little help.  He carts it everywhere.  We easily down loaded new music on it for him.  The batteries have not been difficult to replace, and the first set made it through two weeks of almost constant use.  We often plug it into our portable stereo, and it really takes the sound quality up, although the existing sound quality is just fine for a toddler.  The music that came loaded on the player was quite pleasant and age appropriate.  The buttons are large and easy to use for a toddler, and the outer shell seems very durable and able to withstand being dropped on occassion.  All three of my two year olds have enjoyed this toy, and I'm keeping my eyes peeled for other great products from this company!

review_body: This game is not what I expected at all. I was looking for the US Navy monoply \\"Battleship Edition\\" instead I got a cheap verson of the Navy. It sucked! product_title: LeapFrog Leapster Learning Game System - Green
review_body: We gave this to our little boy on his 4th birthday.  He loves it, is learning tons, and it keeps him quiet in the car.  He is also very rough with his toys and it is holding up perfectly. Great purchase.

product_title: Transformers  Voyager Starscream
review_body: The first movie Voyager Starscream was a bit of a love-hate affair. There were some good things about it... but mostly it left a lot to be desired. Placed next to some of the better designs (e.g. Ironhide), it seemed... rushed.    Thankfully, Hasbro has responded to fan feedback and listened to the criticisms. ROTF Starscream is so much better that it leaves me wondering how the first one got out! The transformation is intricate but not overly complex, with a mech-alive gimmick that's actually quite nice. He's got hands this time, as opposed to just cannons for arms. The head sculpt is better, and overall he's not just cooler, but more movie accurate too. The best thing is probably the jet-mode: it's sooo much cleaner, with far less kibble underneath.    Negatives? He's quite a lot more difficult to balance, having smaller feet, whilst remaining top-heavy. The arms don't pose very naturally, and sometimes can be left in an awkward look (but hey, he's got hands!). And some might not like the new paintjob, which goes against the concept of a disguise.    Overall, this is still a very good Voyager. And so, so much better than the first incarnation.

product_title: Blade CX3 MD 520N RTF Micro Helicopter
review_headline: Really fun for a first time rc heli!
review_body: This is the first RC helicopter I've owned and it was right in my price range, but I was stuck between the cx3 and the cx2. I decided to go with the cx3 because of the upgraded gryo from the cx2 (which is what I was told by my hobby dealer). I also like the body which sets this apart from all the other helis in the same price range. This has been a VERY easy copter to learn on and I can see myself wanting to upgrade soon. It flies well, but not perfect of course. I had slight tail jittering with mine but was fixed by getting a new set of landing gear with proper foam on the part that the body touches to eliminate the body from shaking from the motor. The gear that came with mine was missing foam on the left side (which is the only reason I gave it a 4/5). The spare parts for this are cheap though, so no big deal if you wreck it! It handles very well and overall I am glad I went with this as my first! Word of caution though.....BUY MORE BATTERIES!!! You will be wanting more than a 10 minute flight!

product_title: Hills Rise Wild! (Call of Cthulhu) [BOX SET]
review_headline: A Tabletop Miniatures Game Masquerading As A Board Game
review_body:
One of the best Cthulhu and Lovecraftian board games on the market! After several years playing this, our group has noticed a pronounced advantage for the Whately clan, and a distinct disadvantage for the Cult of Ezekiel, but that does not detract from the fun! Count on 1 hour playtime for each player in the game, and some of our games have run longer. With multiple copies of the game, we have doubled up on a faction to add more players. There is also a random element to the game, besides die rolls, that can throw some unpredictability into play.

Loaded with Cthulhu references, both serious and hilarious, the only complaint I have is that the company has yet to issue any expansions for the game, although some fan-created variants are available for free on the internet. Hours of fun!

review_body:

product_title: Scrabble Premier Wood Edition
review_body: I received the Scrabble premier wood edition before Christmas (within the time frame promised), and was very happy with the product. The wooden edition is sturdy and easy to manage since it is both on a turn table and has its own drawer to hold all of the game's pieces.  The leather pouch is a nice addition and overall, the person who received this as a gift was quite happy. It will be used often!

product_title: ENDERS GAME
review_body: Ender's Game                                                                            324pp. Tom Doherty. 1991. $5.99      \\"Game On\\"                      By: Deanette      Orson Scott Card author of the marvelous book, Ender's Game wrote about Ender Wiggin a six year old boy, who is asked by Colonel Graff to join battle school. Colonel Graff was sent by the head master of battle school to go persuade Ender to go. Why of course Ender was persuaded and decided to go. Ender dosen't knows what will happen to him at battle school. All ender knew was that he was going to battle school to protect so when the buggers come to attack the Human race. But while in battle school ender is being isolated to keep him from losing his creativity. Ender realizes that he has come more independent than he thinks.   In the book Ender fights a kid named Stilson, and beats him hard. Ender sends Stilson to the hospital. Ender also faces Bonzo. While facing Bonzo, Ender realized that he learned to stick up for himself without using violence. Also in battle school ender finds self confidence and he makes new friends by just being himself.   The book Ender's Game begins with the background of Ender Wiggin and his family. Orson Scott Card wrote this book to predict what might happen in the future. The author shows this by describing new computers we might have that will plug into a desk top. The setting of this story is mainly in Space.    My opinion on this book is that there is a lot of action.  I would tell Orson Scott card that he should use more description words to describe the characters. If Orson Scott Cards goal was to make a book to predict the future then I think that Orson has done a fantastic job in achieving his goal.

product_title: Liv Dolls - Sophie
review_body:
My daughter received this for her 7th birthday.
She was really wanting these dolls badly and was not disappointed at all at. She played with it non-stop.

There seems to be a million strings and things to cut your way through to free the doll from her package, so a need to be patient.
The doll it really very pretty. Very lifelike inserted eyes instead of painted on eyes, they really add a nice touch of realism, and are very well done.
The wigs, my daughters main desire to play with really are also nice and I was surprised. The hair is very soft and silky. I like that all extra wigs come with a \\"wig head\\" to store them on, an when not in use, also useful for combing them out.
You will probably need to trim them after your brush them to cleam up some rogue long pieces. It is also very apparent they were cut with a machine, The straight wigs particularly are choppy and even a bit jagged looking, but not something my daughter noticed at all.
At first it seemed a bit difficult to change wigs, there is a hole in the doll's head and a plastic peg in the wig. Then the directions point out you can push your fingers on the wig to pop the wig a bit inside out to easily insert the wig on the doll's head. My Daughter has not needed any help changing the wigs or clothing.
The joints in this doll are pretty wild!! this doll has knee-caps, and rotating wrists and ankles. Very impressive how lifelike you can make movements!! I think that is my biggest concern, how durable are they. My daughter always has played very respectfully with her dolls so I am not as much worried about her breaking it as I am friends who can get a little over-enthusiastic. SO far I can't really see any problems.

review_body: My 6 year old son loves the microscope. The eyepiece screws in funny sometimes, and is plastic... but other than that, it's a lot of fun and seem s to work pretty well.

product_title: Cranium Hullabaloo
review_headline: Lots of fun for the whole family!
review_body: This game is great for young kids and parents alike. I have a 5 year old and 4 year old twins and sometimes it's exhausting trying to keep a board game going and managing turns and dealing with sore losers. Hullabaloo is a fun game the kids can get up and play. Set-up is easy, just toss the pads around the floor and turn the game on. After that, the game issues instructions and the kids follow along until it picks a winning pad. If you are on the pad, you win. Each round is over very quickly and the next round starts right away giving someone else a chance to win. The kids can play on their own but more often than not I join in just for the fun of it.  There are two levels so if you get bored with one you can switch it up. This game is totally worth it, it has made my whole family happy!

review_body: I am reviewing the vendor, not the product.  I ordered several spider man classic heroes for my grandson because I couldn't find them in stores. product_title: Step2  Naturally Playful Sandbox
review_body: We love this sandbox.  It's the perfect size for both my 5 and 2 yr olds to play together or to have their \\"separate corners,\\" and we've even had up to 4 kids using the sandbox simultaneously without problems during a playdate.  The textured outer surface of the sandbox must somehow help to prevent the plastic from getting too hot to touch because my son has never had any issues with removing the lid or sitting on the stumps, (though I usually set up the beach umbrella to shield them from the sun during playtime.)  The lid also does a great job of staying put on super windy days and of preventing water from entering the sand pit during storms. Also, the box is deep enough so that you can get a good amount of sand in the box for some really imaginative play.  We'll definitely be taking this box with us on our next move.  I would definitely recommend this sandbox!

product_title: Arkham Horror: Dunwich Horror Expansion
review_body: Dunwich Horror is an expansion to Fantasy Flight's popular/infamous Arkham Horror boardgame.    Having played many games with this expansion, I can say that it provides many necessary improvements to the base game where it had originally been lacking.    1. The Injuries/Madnesses - Instead of losing items and being dangerously set back when you run out of Stamina or Sanity, you'll draw an Injury (for no Stamina left) or a Madness (for no Sanity) card which lets you continue on without losing half your items but still wind up at the Asylum or Hospital. The cost is that you incur interesting penalties for each injury. The Injury/Madness decks are made of small cards, with several repeats (getting a duplicate card means you are devoured!).    2. Gate Burst - Perhaps the most intriguing addition, and a necessary one, the Gate Burst mechanic causes sealed gates to be torn open. When you draw a Mythos card with the location with an orange background, that means a gate burst occurs at that location. If the location is sealed, it becomes unsealed. This adds quite a bit of tension to the game and keeps the game from slowing down when the major locations are finally sealed (Witchhouse, etc.). The slow-down of the base game is definitely fixed with this mechanic and is quite noticeable as me and my friends are hardcore co-operative horror boardgame players (I'll admit that it's a niche hobby). THIS IS WHY I BOUGHT THE DUNWICH BOARD.    3. The Dunwich Horror - Like the devious Terror Track and Doom Track, each expansion offers a sort of countdown to unspeakable horror. For the Dunwich board, it is the presence of the Dunwich Horror - the world-bound spawn of Yog-sothoth. As monsters move around the Dunwich board, they may fall into vortex spaces where they are eaten up and the Dunwich Horror track increases by one. At three, the Dunwich Horror appears as the game's toughest monster yet! When fighting it, it's abilites vary depending on a small deck of large cards that accompanyit. The reward is the ability to search out and take any one card from the item/ally/spell decks. I've yet to see him make an appearance, but it's been close and he'll raise the Doom Track as he moves.    4. More items, more investigators, more Great Old Ones with even stranger powers (I love Shud'mell and Glaaki). You get more of everything that was in the base game.    5. Adds more Arkham location encounter cards (I believe that Dunwich adds the most out of all the other expansions), so this makes it great if it's the only one you want to get for a while.    And of course, there are more locations. The size of the Dunwich board is about one third of the Arkham one, but loaded with neighbors and unstable locations. My favorite thing is the look on people's faces when they see how monstrous the board becomes with more and more expansions.    The major problem of the Dunwich board is that it suffers from card dilution. As the Mythos deck gets bigger from expansions, you'll draw less Dunwich cards. This can be resolved by separating the Dunwich mythos cards out and rolling a die each turn to see whether you draw from the Dunwich Mythos card deck or the Arkham one. Dunwich probably suffers the most from this sort of card dilution.    Ultimately, the pitfalls are greatly exceeded by the advantages. It addresses many problems that made the base game lag in its final stages. I've heard that adding more boards does not affect the play time that much, and may even make it shorter as there are more and more threats.    If you're looking for your first Arkham Horror expansion, get this one! Especially at the low prices you'll find around here (I'm a bargain hunter when it comes to games).

review_headline: My 20 month old loves it! Replacement pens are fatter but still work.
review_body: My 20 month old looooves this! It's encouraging him to draw more, and since it \\"writes\\" with just water, I don't worry about him drawing on the wall or putting it in his mouth. It also kept him very happy and occupied on our road trip. I am definitely bringing this on our next plane trip. Just remember to put the pen in your 4oz or less zip top baggy when you go through security...    Ours came with a skinny pen, and when ours got lost (on just the 2nd day - you know how kids are!) I could only find fatter replacement pens online from Aquadoodle (almost marker-sized). These fatter pens fit a little too snugly into the elastic pen holder, but they also don't get lost as easily, and hold more water. I haven't had problems with either pen drying out.    Unlike some of the other reviewers, I like the fact that what you draw fades quickly. Maybe it's because my kid is younger, so he doesn't need to see his drawings last for more than a few seconds. And since we started using the fatter replacement pen, our drawings need a little more time to dry since the pen \\"bleeds\\" more water onto the drawing pad - so some users may like this.    One downside is on the 2nd day, my drawing pad already showed some permanent dark blue marks that won't fade anymore. It's like the look of an old speckled chalkboard. The marks are small, so the drawing pad is still very usable.    I just wished I shopped around at Tar-jet and bought this for cheaper. $23 is a bit steep, but still worth it.

review_body: This toy was extremely overpriced and very flimsily made.  My daughter got one or 2 uses out of the table before the legs of the table broke.  There really is no educational value to this toy except for pretend home life.  Would not buy again at this price.

product_title: Blokus Game
review_body:
We are a family that LOVES games. We are always looking for new games.
THIS is a must have game for a game-loving family.
You can play this 2, 3, or 4 players as well as teams I believe.
The 2 player games sometimes gets a bit mixed up on what color on this turn you play, because each player plays 2 of the colors. If you are looking for a game that will be played mostly 2 player the travel blokus could be an option instead.
My 6 year old daughter, 9 year old son, husband and I all enjoy playing this game. There is a lot of puzzling and\or strategy to this game.
I have to admit I have even enjoyed using the board and pieces to make designs when tinkering alone.

product_title: Disney Princess Enchanted Tales Cool-Bake Magic Oven
review_headline: Not as bad as I was expecting
review_body:
With so many awful reviews, I was a little leary about making the cakes in the oven that my 4 year old received as a birthday gift. I was dragging my feet, but my 4 and 6 year old daughters kept asking to make the cakes.
Our cakes turned out just fine and my girls loved them (they are very tiny, so I didn't taste them). All I can think to say in response to all the bad reviews is follow the directions exactly. Our water was very hot and we let them set for 12 minutes. I also precooled the oven before putting the cakes in. I also froze a block of ice directly in the drawer rather than cubes.
Knowing that it's cool bake, I think we will try to make pudding or jello in the future rather than tracking down (and paying for) the Disney refill mixes.
Overall, it was a fun family activity that my girls enjoyed.

product_title: 1000 Magic: The Gathering Cards Playsets (no more than 4 copies of any one card)
review_headline: Weird to think of Magic the Gathering as a toy
review_body: I really LOVED this purchase. There were a lot of fun cards, a few duplicates but since there were an extra 84 cards to offset that it didn't matter. If you are looking for a way to build up some basic decks and to get started playing Magic I would highly reccomend going this way. Also the shipping was amazingly fast. I had it in about 2 days of my order.

product_title: Rummy Set in Leatherette Case
review_headline: This set is overpriced for its low quality
review_body: This is a a great game, fun to play!  However, I would get the cheaper set as this set is cheap but w/ an expensive price tag.  Toy-R-Us has the same game called RAMI-O that you can order online for less than $[...].  This is the same set as the $[...] game and it was $[...].

product_title: Scootin Sounds Thomas
review_body: I can't believe the reviews here. I've purchased a few push n gos but my 2 toddlers love this and use it often.  The sounds are great, the build is good and we like the width (wide = stable!). If you are careful to put the stickers on without touching the sticky side (dont let your toddler do it unless your inept) then they should last for a long time. Of course you could probably get a custom push n go that will last a few generations that can talk and fly for [...]  but I like this at around 40.  I highly recommend this the most used toy in what has become a house of toys.

product_title: Nesting Lawn Mower (Colors May Vary)
review_body: I purchased this for my soon-to-be 4 year old and my 2 year old. I ordered this one instead of the Fisher Price Bubble Mower, which was more expensive. When I received it, I was so disappointed. It is so cheaply constructed. Others have said it is durable, but we'll see. I have some really tough little boys, so getting this thing to last will be a challenge. I now wish that I had paid the extra bucks for the Fisher Price.

product_title: Melissa & Doug Band-in-a-Box Clap! Clang! Tap!  Musical Instrument Set
review_body: Great product. Wish it had dvd's of music w/ a book of suggested \\"rhythms\\" to go with it...

product_title: GIANTmicrobes Plush White Blood Cell Microbes
review_body: My son (who was born in 2003) has a bunch of giant microbes now.  We have the flu, typhoid, polio, fat cells, bed bugs, a red blood cell and a white blood cell.  These are fabulous, well constructed educational stuffies.  They come with detailed explanations and fantastic pictures of the actual microbes.  We've combined these with the Grossology book  for a fun, silly educational experience.   We have a lot of fun with flue in particular pretending to sneeze and throwing it at each other.   The red blood cell is particularly aerodynamic and helps my son understand how blood works and, combined with the lumpy little white blood cell, explain how his blood tries to keep him healthy.   Our Leukocyte, now named Luke, came with rubbed spots on his eyes.  A little disapointed, but still love it.

product_title: EyeClops Night Vision Infrared Stealth Goggles
review_body: I just ask my grandson today how he liked this Christmas gift..he said he loves them..A funny story, he said at night fish don't sleep, cause he wore these in to his bedroom after dark & spied on the fish!!! I just wish he had a friend that also had a pair so they could play outside together...

product_title: Calico Critters Children's Bedroom Set
review_body: The toy is very cute but the parts are too small.  It's difficult not to lose  them.  It was a bday gift for my 5 yr old but I have to hide it or my 3yr old  might misplace them.  Luckily, the girls never put stuff in their mouths or  that would be a big concern.

product_title: Transformers Movie 2  Leader Jetfire
review_body: As you all may know, Jetfire is the most sought-after figure in the ROTF toy line, and his features absolutely justify it. Pretty much everyone else covered the main points, so I'll just list the pros and cons.    Pros:  - Transforms into an SR-71 Blackbird. (One of the sickest aircraft designs in history.)  - Robot mode is very accurate to the film version, such as the hunched-over posture, head, and cane.  - Alt mode is huge. The Blackbird is at least 18 inches long and looks amazing on your shelf, details and all.    Cons:  - The toy has an odd blue body, while in the movie it was solid black.  - Transformation is fairly difficult. Seriously. I spent over 20 minutes looking at the instructions before I finally pulled it off.  - There is quite a bit of kibble underneath, which kinda sucks. However, the alt mode is so massive that in the end it's really not that bad.     Simply put, grab this figure as soon as you see him (or you'll be waiting for weeks until he restocks, and even then you'll have to be lucky). Hopefully they make a premium/voyager version that justifies the cons, but overall the pros outweigh everything else. You won't be disappointed.

review_body: This is well worth the money.  I bought two thinking that I would run out of paint, but ended up painting for 4 hours straight and didn't come close to using up any color (in the one book).  It details designs from elaborate to basic and everything in between!  GREAT gift idea.

product_title: Foam Blocks
review_headline: Blocks MUCH SMALLER than represented by the ad
review_body: Don't be fooled by the picture in this ad like I was. These blocks are not what they appear to be in the on-line ad.Not only are they much smaller than what they appear in the ad, but the colors are not bright and colorful like the ad. I would have sent them back but it would have cost half as much as they cost me because of shipping cost.Our little one did like the blocks however in my opinion this company completly misrepresented themselves.We were very disapointed in this company and think that there should be some kind of rules holding companies that misrepresent their ad's like this accountable!

Frank the Combine & Lightning are plastic not diecast.  Set is sooo easy to put together & take apart.  Great for imagination play for any Cars fan!

product_title: Think of It Go Go Take Apart Hula Hoop

review_body: This Greenlight 2006 Camaro Concept is well made and very nice looking - Great detail for a 1:64 scale model.  Very faithful to the actual car.

review_body: Neat toy, biys loved it. Sword pops up on a push of a button and lights up bright. Makes noise, but not to loud.

product_title: PlanToys Shape and Sort
review_body: This is so cute and very good for the beginning shape sorter. The pieces are chunky for little hands and there are only three holes and three pieces. product_title: Pokemon: Pikachu 6 Inch Plush Doll

product_title: Jakks Pacific G2 Game Girl Hannah Montana Guitar Video Game

product_title: Sofina Caribbean Island - Big Recreational Inflatable Floating Island!
review_body: This is not our first party raft, but it is by far our best.  The design on this one makes sense and comfortably holds many people.
