review_body: these are great! so glad i got them. incredibly detailed, and each has a movable part for added interest. sure to be a collector's item!

product_title: Mega Brands Magnext iCoaster
review_body: My 8 yr old needed help putting it together the 1st time.  After that he seemed to be able to make new designs by himself.  You do not need an ipod to play with this; it comes with a song they can play while it goes through the motions.

product_title: RedBox Toys Electronic Stage Microphone Music Set
review_body: This was great while it worked, which was only about 2 weeks.  After just 2 weeks, the microphone seems to have a short in it.  It only works some of the time.

product_title: Marvel Classic Super Heroes: A Collector's Edition
review_body: [[ASIN:0760771472 Marvel Classic Super Heroes: A Collector's Edition]] The full color book along with the 4 super hero toys made a great educational gift for the children and also added to my spouse's collection.

product_title: Planet Earth DVD Board Game
review_body: The photography is wonderful, the problem is that there aren't nearly enough questions and it was repeating most of them by the second time we played.

product_title: Spring & Summer Toys Banzai 9ft-Long Ships Ahoy Pirate Ship Pool
review_body: Got this at Target for under $50 bucks.  Was a hit at our July Birthday party for 4 year olds.  Totally worth it, but mast does flop over a lot.

product_title: Playmaker Toys Flingshot Flying Monkey Plush Toy, Brown
review_body: I ordered 4 of them.  One came apart the first time I tried it but I was able to sew the rubberband back in the monkey's hand and it works fine now.  Both adults and kids loved playing with it.  I'm not sure how long they'll last but for the moment they're a great toy for any age.  Very cute also.  The noise could get annoying after awhile but still fun to hear the monkey scream.

product_title: James Bond Aston Martin DB5
review_body: Corgi has always made the best James Bond Aston Martin DB5 regardless of scale in my opinion. The sleek lines and finish capture the version as seen in the James Bond films. To think this all started with GOLDFINGER and THUBNDERBALL all those years ago. The legend and fun it brings continues to this day. This Corgi James Bond Aston Martin DB5 is a classic.

product_title: Flippin' Frogs Game
review_headline: Good game, but should be made with stronger material
review_body: My soon to be 5 year old boys really like this game.  It took one of them a little while to get the hang of flipping the frog.  The thing that I do not like about it is, that it appears that the top of the tree is starting to break after only having the game for less than 2 weeks.  You have to push down on the top of the tree to start the game, and the plastic does not appear to be strong enough to withstand all pushing on it to start the game.

product_title: Insect Lore Live Butterfly Garden
review_body:
I have ordered this product before and everyone in the family loves it!!! It is truly amazing to see nature at work and to share that excitement with your children! Once they have turned into butterflies, we take them to the park and watch them fly away.

I think children of all ages can learn a lot from this simple little project!!!

product_title: Small World Toys Ryan's Room Wooden Dollhouse - Relaxing In Style Living Room
review_body: I was a little surprised to hear my granddaughters mother say she already received this same gift from someone else.  I thought the wish list would only let you select 1 gift if only 1 was desired.

product_title: Settlers Of Catan 4th Edition Bundle
review_headline: Great game for adults. Expand to play with friends.
review_body: I really enjoy playing Settlers of Catan. My friends and I used it to bond. Sometimes strategy wins, sometimes luck wins. Use the expansion pack to expand your circle of friends.

product_title: Sesame Street Chicken Dance Elmo
review_headline: Must Have for every 1 year old
review_body: My son had a similar version of this toy and of course he broke it by throwing it.  I explained Elmo wasn't meant to fly and land so hard, but that fell on deaf ears.  Anyway he would get so mad every time he saw the broken toy that it didn't work I decided to find a new one.  This Elmo was a,little bigger and still cute, we were a little stumped by how to turn him on but once we did the fun began!  My son sat and watched Elmo over and over.  I taught him how to turn him on in fear I would never be able to leave the room.  Chicken Dance Elmo makes my one year old a very happy boy!

product_title: Step2  Deluxe Canyon Road Train & Track Table
review_body: We gave this table to our 2 yr. old grandson for his birthday.  He wouldn't open or play with anything else, and finally fell asleep on it.  He absolutely loves it.

product_title: Darda NASCAR Victory Lane
review_headline: Great no batteries, sounds, or lights toy!
review_body: Had a Darda Demon track as a kid and loved it.  My son, turning 5, wanted a Hot Wheels track for his birthday(those are garbage!).  I got him this Darda Victory Lane Speedway and he seems to love it.  Seems to be good quality just like the one I used to have.  The cars can make it though all the loops in the set when you put it all together as one track.  I thought the side by side racing would add a little more excitement to it and it does.  Now we need a few more cars!

product_title: Maisto R/C Street Troopers PT-808 Radio Control Vehicle (Colors May Vary)
review_headline: Transforms nice. Shoots nice. Drives horrible.
review_body: In car mode, your remote control can only control the back two tires. The left knob moves the left rear tire forward/backwards and the right knob does the same thing to the right rear tire.  Both of the front tires only spins and is not able to turn left/right like most r/c cars.  As a result, trying to maneuver the r/c car may be a challenge.    To transform, there is a lit circular button on the remote control. HOLD it down and it will transform from car to robot.  If you let it go halfway, it will in between car/robot.  Holding onto the button again will cause the transformation to continue where it left off.    The missles are spring loaded and fires quite far.  It comes preloaded with 5 missles and you get an additional 3 as spare.    Batteries are not included. The car/robot takes 6 AA batteries.  The remote takes 1 9volt battery.    Overall, the toy itself looks really nice whether it is in car or robot mode.  My only complaint is that I wish the front two tires can turn left/right from the remote control.

product_title: Playskool Step Start Walk 'n Ride
review_body: I was surprised at so many positive reviews for this product.  It is cute but the design was terrible.  the back wheels come out too far so our daughter was constantly tripping over them.  also, as a scooter the front bars roll forward so there is little room for the child to sit, plus not back so children easy slip off the back.  also hard to get on the scooter with the little purple thing sticking out of the back.  we have a tall child so maybe that is why.

product_title: Jakks Pacific Large Classic Plush Opossum
review_body: This is the only original toy that my pup still has when I adopted him. He shredded the normal plushies in a few weeks to a month. I had Giraffe feet and elephant trunks flying all over my house! But oh how the opossum overcame the sharpness of puppy teeth. My Beagle pup has been biting,tossing,chewing this furry beast for 6 months and it's still as good as new. Definitely worth the few extra bucks over a generic plushie. :)

product_title: Rubie's Costume Co PR/Bk Striped Knee Highs Costume
review_body: The shipping costs were almost double the cost of the item.  If I would have been able to find this locally I never would have bought them and paid the shipping

product_title: Family Feud Tabletop Game
review_body: I think this game was very disappointing.  The product looks much better when advertised.  The game was unbearably slow moving and the voice was almost impossible to here.  The game is also proportioned for small kids not really sutable for adults.  I was expecting much more from this game being that I love the tv show... so if you are expecting it to make you feel like your on the show than do not bother with this game.

product_title: American Plastic Toy Homestyle Kitchen -  Colors May Vary
review_body: I'm really glad I started assembly of this product days in advance of Christmas.  It would have been an awful Christmas eve if I'd started it then, after the kids were a'bed.    It was a nightmare to assemble.  Not hard, really.  Just WAY too many pieces, all in their little fabrication \\"clusters\\", that had to be located, snapped, screwed, etc.  I have a Ph.D. in a science field, and it took me THREE HOURS to assemble this $50 toy.  There's got to be a better way.  And if it all falls apart in three days (which I expect it will), I'll be taking it back to the store.    My advice....spend a little extra money and buy something better.  Preferably, something made of wood or laminate, with fewer pieces.  Open the box and look inside before chosing this product.

product_title: Loftus Instant Worms
review_headline: Makes One Really Look At Their Drink
review_body: These come as little hard plastic-feeling pellets/beads that expand to about an inch when wet.  They are flesh colored with red on both ends.    My boys put them in water bottles and it was funny watching the person about to take a drink, then notice something in the drink and look closely until they realize it's a \\"worm\\" - it's real-enough looking to freak out the person and have the bottle passed around until someone calls it.    fun - would purchase again.

product_title: Pop-Onz Barnyard Blocks
review_headline: Great building toy for your young children
review_body: My twin boys would play with this for hours--they received when they were 18 months old. This is a great building toy.

product_title: Bananagrams Deluxe Set w/100 Best Anagrams Listings
review_body: Our family has had so much fun playing this game.  It doesn't take too long to play, many people or just two can play, broadens vocabulary and reviews spelling. Fun and educational!

product_title: Barbie Play Beauty Accessory Set
review_body: I bought this accessory set because it was recommended with the barbie styling heads. What a piece of junk. Everything is a piece of molded plastic - even the makeup brushes. I could have given my daughter a fork to use with the set. The eye shadow and lipstick look real and then SURPRISE open it to find hard molded plastic. I stupidly assumed when this was recommended with the styling head, that some it actually was real makeup that could be applied to the head. This should cost [...] at Walmart.What a piece of junk and what a disappointment to my daughter at Christmas.

product_title: Magnetic Scribbler Baby Boy
review_body: This toy looks very cute, but it is a little disappointing.  The three scribblers are hard for a young child to get out and especially back  into their holder when they switch from one to another. (They are even a little hard for me to snap back into place).  Thus they end up falling out of their designated slot, which is very frustrating.  I also found the writing surface a little small for the size of the chunky scribblers.

product_title: Pinocchio Puppet
review_body: I thought my granddaughter would enjoy it. But once the novelty of making his nose grow wore off, it was never played with. it's a very nice quality item, but I wouldn't shell out the bucks again. Unless your kid eats sleeps and breaths pinocchio I wouldn't waste my money.

product_title: Ideal Mexican Train Game in Carrying Case
review_body: [[ASIN:B000068P9P Mexican Train Dominoes in Tin]] - we have played it several times with family and friends - it is easy to learn and lots of fun to play

product_title: Cabbage Patch Kids 25th Anniversary Doll Blonde Girl
review_body: I ordered two of these expecting them to be a little bit different than each other but they both are exactly the same and look just like the photo.  They do have different names and different birthdates.  Usually when ordering a Cabbage Patch online you get a 'surprise' with different clothes or hair style (because of the listing I knew this doll would be blond) and eyes, but these are the exact same dolls, little dimple on right cheek, brown eyes, pink dress. Great for twins.

product_title: Planet Toys Planet Earth Digital Microscope Kit
review_body: I really can't say enough about this toy.  I originally bought it for my nephew (7 years old) and he immediately loved it.  I say \\"originally\\" because his older brother (9 years old) AND younger sister (6 years) both enjoy it equally as much.  The most amazing thing about it is the age range.  This item is easy enough to use for a 5 year old, but feature rich enough to hold the attention of a child far older.  I have seen it in specialty stores for 79.99, so amazon is definitely a bargain.  With Christmas coming up, I plan on buying several of these as gifts!

product_title: My Lovely Pink Pony Costume (Standard)
review_body: This is the perfect Halloween costume for my daughter, since she loves \\"pink ponies\\". But it's also a fantastic addition to her dress-up collection to play all year round. We'll see how durable it is after she wears it on Halloween.

product_title: LeapFrog Leapster Learning Game System - Pink
review_body: I bought this for my daughter when she was 6, she played it a lot when she first got it but then turned 7 a couple months later and I could not seem to get many games for the older kids so she was bored with it.  But I think for the younger kids 4-6 it's a great learning tool.

product_title: SUPER SOAKER BOTTLE SHOT Use Your Own Bottle up to 2 Liters!
review_headline: Fun. Solid. Fewer parts to break.
review_body:
Very simple gun. You pump it back and forth to make the water spray. It draws water from a bottle with a standard 2-liter-bottle type fitting. It comes with a small bottle. My larger boy uses a 2 liter bottle. This does not pressurize with air as do some other water guns. It is just a water pump. I like that because there is less to break. My boy does not seem to mind it is not as fancy as some of the others. It does spray about 20 feet as claimed. Fairly rugged for an inexpensive plastic toy. It will withstand a few drops to the cement.

Another review says the price is high. The main listing price is somewhat high. If you dig further, though, in the \\"new and used\\" section under the main listing, you will find other vendors with lower prices (at least as of the day I write this). I found one for about $13 plus shipping.

product_title: Thomas And Friends Wooden Railway - Water Tower Figure 8 Set
review_body: I hope I'm not spilling the beans on this, but this is a figure 8 track set, water tower, Thomas train with separate car, water tower, bridge, and a couple of figurines.  It is easily an $80 value for $38.

product_title: K'nex Serpent's Spiral Coaster - 1114 pcs
review_body: My 9 year old daughter was entertained for hours assembling the first maze of pieces.  She improvised a bit but I encouraged it.  Great learning tool for thinking.

product_title: Dirty Minds Deluxe Edition Board Game
review_body: My family and I had a blast playing this game. My Grandmother, Aunt, Parents, sisters and brother in law and I all played a game together. I have a fun family. We divided into two teams. We played a little different from the rules. We read to the other team and if they got the clues (3), they got the letter. If not, they had to read to us. It was a lot of fun. It's amazing how you think of \\"dirty\\" things when it actually isn't. I'd buy it again. :)

product_title: Care Bears 13" Plush w/ DVD Cheer
review_body: My daughter loves this Care Bear and she loves the movie too.  If your child likes Care Bears, this is a great gift or item for them.

product_title: Leapfrog Tag Activity Storybook Spongebob Squarepants: The Tour De Bikini Bottom
review_body: My three year old LOVES this books. It engages her and she likes it more than most other toys. Not to mention all her giggles at the silliness of the story. It is an educational book your child will love.

product_title: Disney's Tinker Bell Wands (4 per package)
review_headline: Don't waste your money on this
review_body: I bought these for my 5 year old's Tinkerbell birthday party as goody bag favors. First they are VERY small, slightly larger than a standard pencil and the string doesn't unwind from the shaft very easily. They are not durable and fell apart within an hour. I won't waste my money on these again.

product_title: VTech Kidizoom Plus Digital Camera - Blue
review_body: Purchased this for 3 year old daughter.  Very easy to learn to use.  She loves taking pictures and playing the games.  Yes, the photos are a little grainy, but little kids can't hold the camera still anyway.  She loves it and that's what matters.  We didn't purchase any extra storage and have yet to run out of space as we download frequently enough with no issues.  Durable, reliable, fun.

product_title: Jawa Bobble Head
review_body: This is probably the coolest bobblehead ever created by man.  Buy this if you like Jawas.

product_title: Playhut Magic Ball Zone
review_body: This is a huge and durable product.  I gave it to my niece for her 3rd birthday and she just loves swimming in the balls.  She had herself and me playing it and we fit comfortably enough together.  It has a tarp bottom which is great for playing outdoors.  This thing is too big when set up to play with in a small bedroom.  It is easy to set up and take down and fits in a small bag which is provided for easy storage.  We played with it in the park and she just loved it.  100 balls isn't really enough though. I would recommend purchasing an additional 100 balls to fully cover the bottom.  The balls are soft and durable not like the hard plastic ones in most play areas.

product_title: Clifford Spring Rocker
review_body: My 15 month old sister isn't really old enough to bounce on this by herself but she LOVES when Clifford talks!!!  THe sayings are so cute.  The toy is very durable.  When you put the forth (and last) spring on it takes a little work though It's hard to stretch it that far to connect to the side of the dog.  But it's a pretty awesome toy!

product_title: megcos My Computer
review_body: have purchased your product and would like to expand the card supply..if available how do I access them?

product_title: Stacking Wooden Rings by Schylling
review_headline: Everything you want in a stacking toy
review_body: This toy is really great. The size and weight are perfect for little hands and it is very durable. Some reviews expressed concern about the quality of the paint. Wood paints, especially bright colors, have to compromise in order to be safe for kids to put in their mouths. If stored in a warm humid place, the rings will stick together, and you will probably get some transfer of color in the course of regular use. But these imperfections do not get in the way of the usefulness of the toy. It is a hand crafted, long lasting toy made of natural materials that I would highly recommend.

product_title: WowWee Alive White Tiger Cub Plush Robotic Toy in White/Black
review_body: My 4 year old  son loves animals and was going through a phase of being afraid of the dark so I was happy to find this.  I thought this cub was fantastic, and my friends even got some for their kids after seeing ours.  After about a month though, the mechanical noises that it makes while it moves did start to grain on my son, and he always asks me to turn it off now when he is going to bed. All in all, a good \\"pet\\" for a boy or a girl.

product_title: Wild Republic Cuddlekin 12" Baby Zebra
review_headline: Is not what was in the picture
review_body: The Zebra in the picture is one that we have had for a couple years and my daughter takes it everywhere with us. I tried purchasing a new one and doing a \\"swap\\" with the one that was starting to fall apart. Well the one sent was close but not exactly like the one pictured. If you are looking to replace a well loved toy then I would suggest trying to find another way to purchase it.

product_title: Small World Toys Ryan's Room Classic Wooden Dollhouse with 6 Rooms and Balcony
review_headline: Huge! Perfect toy for Grandma's and Grandpa's house
review_body:
This is a natural wood dollhouse which seems high quality to me. I never have thought of painting it as mentioned in another review. Seems finished to me...I know you can get kits from Ryan's Room called \\"Let's decorate\\" w/ fabrics, paints and wall papers for the budding older designer children. You could also paint and decorate it w/ what ever you had on hand if the natural finish bothered you...just another way for your children to personalized it.

Have I mentioned that it is huge! We also have the basement addition and the garage which makes it even bigger. All that being said it's kept and grandma and grandpa's because they have more room. It is the perfect toy for their place and will stand up to years of heavy use from grandkids. My daughter cried that we weren't bringing it to our home but we just don't have the room.
We've had 2 - 10 yr olds playing with it and you can't break them away. The size is nice because several kids can reach it at once and play simultaneously. It's great as a special toy for their house. This is quality stuff not junk. I got mine used and for a steal on ebay...I like playing w/ it too! The handle holes on top roof make it easier to move, it is still bulky though a child could not move it alone.

We keep ours against a wall as there is no back accesabilty , just side and front. Some other models have no back wall, that might be a consideration for some.

product_title: Halo 3 Series 2 Arbiter
review_headline: A Little Less Than I Hoped
review_body: Previously I had ordered a Master Chief from the series, and I was very pleased with it.  The Series 2 Arbiter...not so much.  Sure it looks great, but its points of articulation are the big disappointment.  It's hard enough to stand it upright, let alone putting it in any pose you want.

product_title: Thomas And Friends Wooden Railway - Battery Powered Sir Topham Hatt Figure 8 Set
review_body: This set is a good value for the price considering a battery power train alone costs around $[...] to start.  The track is of good quality although does not fit easily with our existing other wooden track (from Ikea- great quality).  Thomas comes with a caboose and they derailed at each corner as the turns were too tight.  We tried to supplement with other track to widen the curves but they did not fit together well.  After my 2 year old fit a couple of other cars making it four long, it seemed to do well.  I guess the weight slowed down Thomas enough and held it down during turns.  My son loves to turn the switch for Sir Topham Hatt on and off.  Overall a good track and great starter set for anyone looking to start with Thomas.  Just a few bugs though.

product_title: Cuddlekins Skunk 12" Plush
review_body: This produce was just what I was looking for. The quality was good and it was especially nice and soft.  More importantly I got this item just in time for Christmas.

product_title: Playmobil Roman Arena
review_body: I was very disappointed to find that no Christian martyrs were provided for either gladiator sport or lion fodder. Perhaps Playmobil can have this issue resolved in time for the next oppressive republican regime, as well as adding a Roman bathhouse for the Playmobil Rush Limbaugh set, complete with male companions from the Dominican Republic.

product_title: Transformers Movie Deluxe Allspark Power Salvage
review_body: I bought this for a birhtday gift for a seven year old.   He was really excited but it was difficult to Transform

product_title: LEGO City Advent Calendar 2008
review_body: Both my son and daughter really enjoyed waking up to each new lego prize.  No matter how small it was a fun item to add to their collections.

product_title: Radio Flyer Little Red Scooter
review_headline: Heavy, hard to manoevre; it rots in the basement
review_body: Grandma got this for my daughter's 3rd birthday.  She was excited to get it, but we have barely used it.  It is very heavy and hard for daughter to use.  When we attempt to take it out, she rides it for a couple of blocks, then gets tired; then I end up having to schlepp it home.  I wish we had the Micro Mini scooter instead, which daughter has tried at friends' houses; much lighter, better scooter; the two wheels at front is a much better design.  Worth spending more for a better scooter, if you want it actually to be used.

product_title: Snap Circuits SC-300
review_headline: Hours of Fun for Child AND Parent!
review_body:
I wanted to find a toy that would excite our son enough to lure him away from spending so much time on video games, and this does the trick! He's played with this more than any other toy he received this year, and he loves to show his creations to his friends.

He was especially proud of the a.m. radio that we worked on together. The more than 300 projects should keep us busy for some time, though several are very similar and require making few changes.

Some of his favorites have been the lie detector, the a.m. radio, a light detector, and a water detector.

The pieces easily snap together and apart, but because there are some exposed transistor parts and light bulb sockets that could be broken off if careless, it is important to caution the user to be careful.

The nature of this toy and its projects easily lends itself towards parent/child participation (one can read the instructions while the other helps locate the needed part, and both can work together to find where it goes on the circuit board). Still, I'd say it is easy enough for a child from 9 - 12 years old to go it alone with just minimal supervision.

Once the child learns how different circuits work there are many possibilities for creating original projects of their own.

Each part has its place on the storage tray, which helps keep the toy organized and protected from damage.

The manufacturer also offers other kits/manuals that can help expand the 300 project kit to make over 500 or more projects.

product_title: 1997 Barbie Collectibles - Bob Mackie Madame du Barbie
review_headline: Exquisite collector's Barbie - Rare in detail
review_body:
Whether you are a fan of Bob Mackie's designs or a lover of French historical costuming - this collector's Barbie, Madame Du is exquisite!
Bob Mackie can be out there at times with design concepts... but this particular French-revolutionary, fictional noblewoman is a work of art.

Although this doll is a 1997 model - she DOES NOT have the 90's Barbie skin pallor or facial features that were typical/cheesy. My husband was lucky enough to find her at a great price and her costuming is even more intricate than the pictures depict. Mackie created the detailed dress and underskirt with hundreds of sequins and gorgeous scrollwork, which make the dress luxurious and sparkling. The expression of coquettish-ness on the face is priceless, as is her lovely coif and appropriate French beauty mark.

If you can find Madame Du Barbie at a decent price - be sure to snag her!
Pssst....(Ebay)

NOTE: Other great Mackie Barbies I recommend that are breathtaking and atypical: \\"Tango\\" \\"Masquerade Gala Illusions\\" and \\"Arctic Fantasy\\"

product_title: Necronomicon Plush Book (pre-school edition)
review_body: Little did the postman know what they transported in good faith could well bring about the restoration of the star-born Old Ones when all laws will be thrown aside and there will be shouting and killing and revelling in joy with all the earth aflame in a holocaust of ecstasy and freedom....    .....or maybe it will just sit on my shelf with plush Cthulhu perched on top.    What a fantastic plush. I certainly didn't expect the enormous size of it and the sheer quality is more than I could have hoped for. It's all beautifully made and bound in (fake?) leather finish with an effective velcro clasp. Once inside each of the, admittedly few, pages is an absolute delight. From opening the monstrous carved portal at R'lyeh to sticking your hand inside a Shoggoth via squeaking Azathoth's squeaker and releasing Shub Niggurath's \\"attachments\\" the attention to detail and quality of construction is never less than impressive.     Possibly the most dangerously original plush in our doomed universe.  My advice; buy them all before Wilbur Whateley gets his hands on one.

product_title: Barbie Totally Hair Styling Head
review_headline: If we can send a man to the moon, why can't they make a styling head that doesn't "shed"?
review_body: I have a 6yr old girl who loves doing her hair and the hair of her barbies, so this was a natural gift.  The review of this will depend on if you talk to me or to her.  She loves it; slept with it at night the first day of having it.  Barbie get's all kind of crazy dos.  My daughter doesn't seem to be bothered by the fact that hair comes out with each brushing and that the once shiny smooth locks are on their way to a mangled mess (although she does notice it). (The comb they supply is just silly it's so useless.) I am not sure why they can't make hair that doesn't instantly tangle.  The barettes are not easy to clip in, probably due to the fact that they are flimsy.  As you might expect, the jewels adn the jewel tool supplied are a waste of plastic.  Our tool did not work; jewels did not come out when applied to the hair (it's the claw part of velcro that is to hold the jewel in her hair).  It was easier to take the jewel in your hand & stick it where you wanted.  We never tried it in our oun hair; I doubt it would have worked any better.  However, my daughter doesn't really care about this; she's got a ton of play jewelry and hair accessories that she uses instead of what they supplied.  She's wanted to bring a spray bottle into her room to work on hair styles, but with a 3yr old brother nearby, that's a disaster (or fight) waiting to happen.  But it's clear she enjoys the pretend play aspect of it (which is why I gave 3 stars for education and 5 for fun).  We've had this head for about a month with no breakage, but the head has not been subjected to anything really bad.  She is a bit top heavy which makes working on her a bit awkward.  Any more expensive and I would say you are wasting your money, but for the price & how much my daughter loves it, it's a good purchase.  It is disapointing that they don't design it better, however what do you want for $20? I've seen styling heads with real hair for kids (about $60), so if you hope to have the styling head last longer & be more useful, Barbie isn't the way to go.  But for the few years my daughter will play with this, it's a good deal, or at least the best I could find.  I gave it a total of 3 stars because I can't get over all the hair that comes off her head. If it were not for that it would have gotten 4, maybe even 5.  Despite the hair loss, you'll be happy to know Barbie is not bald yet.

product_title: Kidoozie Garden Fresh Fruits & Veggies
review_body: My two and a half year old son loves these.  He loves the sound of the velcro as the knife cuts through it.  The pieces are all big enough so there isn't a choking hazard, but kids still need to be watched closely (one of his friend's put the banana in his mouth and was biting like a rabid dog trying to chew on it).  This is all hard plastic so it's very durable, no soft hollow cheapy plastic.  The bag is nice too for cleanup.

product_title: Fisher-Price Go Diego Go Rescue Adventures Diego
review_body: My daughter absolutley loves Diego!  I decided to get her this doll while trying to find her something \\"Diego\\", and he seemed like the cutest and funnest toy out there.  She hasn't put him down since he arrived!  He really is cute, full of fun phrases, and a lot of fun.  The watch he came with (for her to wear) is pretty dinky, but fine for a toddler.  Click the camera is pretty neat, too, but she doesn't quite grasp the concept of peering into the little hole.  Needless to say these two accessories are buried in her toybox now, but she loves her Diego!  I recommend this for any toddler who enjoys the show!

product_title: Playmobil Warrior's Ship
review_body:
After a family watch of the classic movie Ben-Hur (the title is a qoute from that movie - my kids (6 & 7) were very impressed by the battle scenes involving Roman galleys. This toy was a natural purchase to encourage this interest in history.

My 7 year old put the galley together with minimal help from me, and they both have been playing with it for a few weeks now. It is hilarious to hear them humming the tunes from Ben-hur for the galley-slaves as they play, and shout 'Ramming Speed!!'.

As in all Playmobil toys, the parts are not painted, but the color is embedded in the plastic itself. So there is not danger of lead paint in this toy (which was manufactured in Germany).

It is a bit pricey, but it is worth it to see the kids recreate ancient sea battles, and become interested in history.

product_title: Justice League Original Members Action Figure Collection with 7 Figures
review_headline: Two boys' review: Good superhero starter set
review_body:
I rated this four stars because after about six months of play, Wonder Woman and Flash broke. My two sons (ages 5 and 4) really liked this set. We found it on sale, which reduced the price to about $2.50 per action figure -- a great price!

Older children will seek out action figures with more points of articulation (able to move them in more ways). However, this 7-figure set is a great starter for young superhero fans.

product_title: Melissa & Doug Baby Dinos in a Nest - Plush
review_body: I bought this product for my 3 year old son for Christmas. It is absolutely adorable! All the dinos fit in a nest......he can put the nest at the end of his bed and pick out the few dinos that he wants to sleep with. My older children (6 and 8) even want to choose one to sleep with. Very cute!

product_title: Fisher Price Laugh and Learn 2-in-1 Learning Kitchen
review_body: We got this for our 10 month old for Christmas.  She loves it.  She especially likes to crawl under the arch and listen to the songs.  Well worth the money!

product_title: Jakks Pacific Girl Gourmet Cupcake Maker
review_body: My daughter really wanted this toy for her 4th birthday.  It comes with 4 packets of mix and 4 frostings.  We added water to 1 mix, stirred, placed it in the special tray, and microwaved it.  The mix did not cook, but rather dripped through the paper cupcake lining, making a mess in the microwave.  We have not tried the frosting or the mechanism which supposedly applies the frosting.  We have gotten practically no use out of this toy.

product_title: Transformers Animated Activators - Autobot Optimus Prime
review_headline: You just gotta get the hang of it
review_body: After reading the other reviews, and with my son really wanting an Optimus, and having a pretty good experience with the other Animated Transformers toys (Starscream is super-easy, and Bulkhead is no problem), I got this without telling him. After futzing with it a bit, I think he'll be able to handle it once I tell him how. Here's the trick - do Step 1, then do Step 3, 4 & 5. When the upper body is done, then hook the wheels in like Step 2.     Now, in order to do Step 5, the key is to hold his front chest plate with one hand, then pull the back tab straight back with the other. He'll start to tuck in. While he's in mid-tuck, line up his arms properly, then tuck him the rest of the way in. Put the top tab down until it locks (if you look at it from the side, you'll see how it locks).    To robot-ize him, put your thumb on the Grey back for some leverage, and flick the little red button (like in the instructions) to open him up. Works like a charm.    Not intuitive, but no problem once practiced 2 or 3 times.    Now my son (almost 4 yr) can do it. He still has problems locking it sometimes, but can usually do it.

product_title: WowWee Rovio Wi-Fi Enabled Robotic WebCam
review_body: I received the product and it was defective.  I have tried to get help with technical  support but they have been very unsupportive, there are delays in reponse to questions, they only give tech support by email, and have referred it up the ladder but refuse to acknowledge that the product needs to be replaced. It is not a software issue but a defective power switch and charger.  I have requested a conversation with a living person by phone for one week to no avail.  I requested a refund with no response.  I would  recommend waiting for the iRobot as that company has an excellent reputation for customer support.

product_title: Pixel Chix Roomies
review_headline: They don't sell roomies any more.
review_body: It's a fun toy and my daughter likes it, but some of the roomies are difficult or impossible to find.  The \\"bookworm\\" isn't available anywhere in the U.S. as far as we can tell.  Also, I bought a \\"Diva Queen\\" and a \\"Beauty Queen\\" thinking that would be two different roomies, but they are both the same.  You can only have one of each type, so the extra one is wasted.  I wish they would bring back all the roomies.

product_title: HOT WHEELS Trick Tracks Triple Stunt Starter Set
review_body: We gave this to my 3 1/2 year old son for Christmas.  He loves this toy, but we have to set it up for him. Also, the track comes with a car and we gave him a 5 pack.  It would be a good idea to get another 5 pack.  I thought this track was like a race track where you put one car at the start and watch it follow the entire track all the way to the end.  I was wrong.  There are 3 stunts and you fill up each stunt with cars (some take more than 1 car).  You start the first car, when it reaches the first stunt it triggers the second car to go, etc.  Overall, it's a good toy.  I gave it four stars b/c I'm sure for boys 4-7 it's great!  My son loves it & I know he will grow into it.  I was a bit disappointed.

product_title: Marines Uniform Infant Costume, INFANT SIZE: 12-24 Months
review_body: My nephew is 15 months and this costume fit him GREAT.  And he was sooo cute with his \\"muscles.\\"  If I could change anything it would be the short sleeves, it was FREEZING here on Halloween.  But we just put a long sleeve green shirt underneath.  Overall great costume for the money!

product_title: Toy Box - Natural
review_headline: Not the best, but not the worst
review_body: This toy box was a little bit of a bitch to put together, but not too bad.  The lid doesn't open as wide as I had hoped, so nothing too big/tall would really fit.  Does it's job while looking nice.  Slightly on the heavier side, so it's pretty sturdy.  Don't have to worry about your three year old tipping it.

product_title: Bendon Publishing Eight Silly Monkeys Mini Board Book
review_body:
My daughter is 9 months old and she loves it. We've been reading it to her since she was just a cocuple days old and still aren't sick of it. In addition to that, my husband loves reading it to her. As a result, I am looking for more books like this.
.
My daughter is now 12 months and still loves this book :o) YAY!

product_title: Martian Matter Alien Maker Playset  -  Spaceship
review_body: I bought this for my 4 1/2 yr-old son.  He's a little young for it but he really enjoys making stuff and playing with Play Dough etc so I decided to try it. He has really enjoyed using it. He needs some assistance with it but he can do most of the stuff by himself. As he gets older he'll enjoy it even more as he thinks of other ways to play with it.

product_title: Joey Ramone 7" Action Figure NECA

THIS IS A GREAT TOY FOR ADULTS AND KIDS .. OF ANY AGE.  WE LOVE JOEY AND THIS IS A GREAT WAY TO CONTINUE CELEBRATING HIM ... LONG LIVE JOEY RAMONE !!!!

product_title: Schoenhut 25 Key Elite Spinet with Bench
review_headline: Excellent product & worth spending a few more $$$
review_body: Both our adult daughters are piano teachers and have found this toy an excellent choice for a toddler to \\"play\\" with.

product_title: Barbie - Tawny Horse and Barbie Doll
review_body: I was skeptical when I bought this for my daughter.... I mean how well can the horse really WALK?????  I have to say I was pleasantly surprised!  If you keep it on a hard surface (no plush carpet) it walks and whinnys all over!  Barbie actually stays sitting on the horse too, which was another one of my worries, thinking it would get terribly frusterating for her if Barbie kept falling off. Over all, she was super excited, I was pleased it worked so well. Definetly a good purchase for your Barbie lover.

product_title: Wild Planet Hyper Dash
review_headline: My boys' favorite gift this year!
review_body: I am SO glad I bought this toy.  My boys ages 6 and 3 1/2 both love it.  It is wonderful for cold or bad weather days when we are all inside and they start getting hyper.  Now instead of getting frustrated, I just say \\"Why don't you go play Hyper Dash?\\" and they reply \\"Yea!\\".  They play until they are both out of breath (and then they switch to \\"micro dash\\" level - a game option without the running).  Although the recommended ages are 6 and up, my 3 1/2 year old does just fine with it.  As long as the child knows their colors, they should be able to play.  And I'm impressed with how many different options and levels there are to the game.  I don't think the kids will get bored with it because it has so much variety.  The only other game I have purchased that was this much fun was a dance pad game, and that was considerably more expensive.  For $20, this toy is worth the money.

product_title: Dollhouse Miniature The Laurel Dollhouse by Corona
review_body: Bought this dollhouse from BabyAge, who is absolutely wonderful to work with.  This dollhouse kit was provided by Greenleaf, one of BabyAge's vendors.  I cannot recommend Greenleaf.  Quality of materials was extremely poor -- wood pieces fell apart easily, tabs and slots didn't match up, none of the wood matched.  It was all different types and colors.  The only option was to paint everything.  My dad helped build the dollhouse, which is a very good thing.  He had to make pieces to replace the ones that fell apart (very thin laminated wood was used) Thankfully, Dad is a wood-worker.  I will never again purchase a product from Greenleaf.  They seem to either have no Quality Control staff, or they simply don't care.

product_title: Snap Circuits SC-300
review_headline: Lots of fun for all ages!
review_body: I bought this for my 13 year old son for Christmas. He had no problem creating several different projects with it and loves it. It is pretty basic and comes with a detailed instruction booklet. It is great for ages from about 8 years on up. The one thing that I would like to see is something to make it more educational, like a better description of the different electronic components on each part, instead of just color and number coding. I would definitely recommend this, it is a great value for the money and all of my kids love it.

product_title: Thomas at the Carnival 100 pc glow in the dark puzzle
review_body: This puzzle was an absolute delight for the little seven year old tyke who put it together. Each piece was of interest whether flowers, faces, or trains.  She was most excited to see it glow, and waited all day for night to come and for the puzzle to reveal itself in the dark. A truly fun experience in every way.

product_title: Farm House
review_body: I bought this for my grandson (17 months) for Christmas.  He loves to lug it around and push the animals in and out of the doors.  I think it is only going to be enjoyed more as he gets closer to two years.  It goes great with The Little Golden Book, \\"The Jolly Farmer.\\"  It is a great size also.

product_title: Playskool Clipo Figure Bucket
review_body: My 3 year old daughter got the Clipo Creativity Table, but it didn't have enough pieces to build anything with so we got this bucket too.  The problem is that it is nearly impossible to get the pieces together to build anything anyway.  My husband and I are both intelligent, mechanically inclined people and we can't even get these things to work.  This toy is a total diappointment and a total waste of money.

product_title: PlasmaCar Pink
review_body: Although ws dreaded putting this together, it was a breeze (once we figured out the tool provided for t ghtening was too large in one of the two cars we bought.  I have never given a more successful gift for sister(6) and brother (3) team.

product_title: Janlynn Piggy Bank
review_body: I am very glad I purchased this bank, but I think it's important to know what you are getting. The quality of the bank itself is good, and it's not pre-glazed, so it holds paint well. It's not as small as I was afraid from the description (although \\"Jumbo\\" is perhaps pushing it) and it was perfect for what I wanted.    I had always intended to use my own paints and brushes, which was good because the ones it came with were not good quality. The paint colors also don't match the picture on the box. The box shows paint pots that are yellow, red, purple, blue, green and white. The paints it comes with are pink, pink, dark yellow, blue, black and white. I tested the varnish but it was still sticky to the touch after it had dried, so I used my own sealer. I also found that the stoppers were much too difficult for little hands to get out (I had to use a boxcutter on one) so I bought replacement stoppers from another website.    Again, the bank itself is of good quality. You won't find another of this quality at this price. It's everything around the bank that is sub-par. If all you're looking for is a good bank and you already have everything else, you can't go wrong with this one.    ETA: It seems they're now using big black rubber stoppers. The new ones are ugly, but are much more functional than the old ones.

product_title: Playhut Disney Princess Enchanted Bed Topper
review_headline: I am the best uncle ever...
review_body: I purchased this as a gift for my niece.  She is currently going through a disney princess phase and absolutely loves it.  I truly am the best uncle ever...

product_title: Deluxe Shut The Box with 12 Numbers & Dice
review_headline: great for a math whiz kid
review_body: I gave this toy to my six year old grandson for Christmas.  We had a great time with it.  He was so quick to catch on to the different combination of numbers.  The box was very well made and a good size.  The only negative thing about this toy would be to keep the dice with the box when not in use.  It would have been good if there was a compartment to store the dice.  Very educational and no batteries required.

product_title: Alfred E Neuman Bobble Head

review_body:

product_title: Fisher-Price My First Dollhouse
review_body:
[[ASIN:B000NW77J2 Fisher-Price My First Dollhouse]][[ASIN:B000BR34Z0 My First Dollhouse - Baby's Room]]
[[ASIN:B000N6QGJU Sister's Room - My First Dollhouse]]
[[ASIN:B000N6M5N6 Stroll with Grandma Set - My First Dollhouse]]

My daughter who is 17 months old loves this dollhouse and will sit and play with it for quite some time we bought 4 of the extra sets and she plays with them all. As noted in previous reviews the doorbell and phone do not make sounds. Was there another model or previous model that did? Oh well, my daughter loves it!

product_title: Baby Spring Float Sun Canopy
review_body:
We recently bought the Float with the Sun Canopy. We had been using a different Swimways Float without a Canopy for 2 months and the Swimways Floats are just great. We needed the Canopy for the Sun protection.
The Baby is 6 months old now & weighs 16 lbs.
The Canopy is PERFECT. The Canopy has 6 snap clips to attach to the Float. The Canopy is stable. It maintains its position overhead or it will \\"snap\\" in the titled position. Excellent sun protection for the baby that won't keep her hat on.

The Float inflates and assembles Quickly in just 2 minutes. You need to pinch the air valve with your teeth or fingers in order to open the valve flap while blowing up the rings. Some people do have an issue inflating these toys with the one-way Valve (with the internal Flap to trap the air from escaping). It is hard to inflate/deflate if you do not pinch the valve. The Float deflates and folds nicely into the small carry pouch.

The Float allows baby to support and stabilize herself with her arms on the top side of the inflatable inner ring. The Float works great! It supports her well and she can still splash in the mesh area on top of the float. She feels comfortable in it. She moves her legs, kicks, splashes with her hands, and has Fun.
The Float is Very Stable.

Educational? Well, we have been teaching her to swim and the kicking exercises are simple when she is in the Float. She is supported by the float and we can move her legs and encourage her to kick.

product_title: Take Along Bob the Builder - Birthday Surprise Vehicle 4 Pack
review_headline: Great toys for a birthday cake.
review_body: I purchased this set to be used as decoration for a birthday.  They worked perfectly. My son was thrilled and was playing with the characters as soon as they were pulled off the cake.  They are nice heavy trucks and have magnets on most of them so they can stick together.  Lofty's boom extends and the pallet sits nicely on the forklift.  It's a nice set.

product_title: Farkle
review_body: Got this as a Christmas present for my brother. My Girlfriend plays it on her Pocket PC. So thought it would be a good gift when I saw the boxed set. My brother loves it. He was playing it Christmas Eve.

product_title: Scooby-Doo Mystery Machine
review_body: My 4 year old boy is a big Scooby Doo fan.  He got the action figures for his birthday and now he got the Mystery Machine for Christmas.  He loves it.  The Mystery Machine is very sturdy and it is spacious enough for all the gang to fit in it just like in the show (Fred, Velma and Daphne up front and Shaggy and Scooby in the back).  All the doors open and the whole top of the back part opens up for easy access.  Overall it seems to be a very durable toy.  The one negative comment I have, and the reason I don't give it 5 stars, is that it comes with some sort of a weapon installed in the back.  You can see Shaggy holding it in the illustration.  Not only does it take space, it is totally unnecessary and out of character.  If you have ever watched the show you know the kids do not use weapons; in fact, I don't think the villains use weapons.  Other than that, this is a really good toy.

product_title: Martha Jones Action Figure
review_body: We bought this toy for xmas for our daughter. Her brother has the Tardis and Doctor toys. They all look just like they do on the show, and the kids are in for hours of imaginative play as their action figures travel through time and space :)

product_title: Creative Design Intn'L. L Hannah Montana Styling Head
review_body: My 6yo Hannah fan was thrilled, but really...it's pretty lame.  the face is small, so there's really not a lot of \\"making up\\" to do, and we can t get the hair turned around on top of the head!!!  Definitely DO NOT pay more than the stores are asking which is around $30.

product_title: Totes Mens Auto Coin Jar
review_body: Is actually of far better quality than I expected for the price.  Not ashamed to leave it out in the open in my new Volvo.  If they weren't \\"out of stock\\", I'd buy a couple more.

product_title: Easy Bake Decorating Pen Kit
review_body: I got this for my daughter and she has had a blast with it!  The frosting is easy to load into the pen, much better than pastry bags.  She is decorating everything with frosting . . . cookies . . . brownies . . . bread . . . paper . . . I can't get her to stop!  Perfect holiday item, we're doing Halloween cookies this weekend!

product_title: Baby Alive Learns to Potty (Discontinued by manufacturer)
review_body: I thought this doll would be great for my nine year old, but turned out to be very stressful for her. It takes awhile for the baby to go back to sleep after it starts up and a nine year old won't just throw it under the bed. The food and juice stains everything and the diapers are cheap and don't work good enough. I think there are better gifts than this one that a child will have more fun with, what was I thinking to have my nine year old a little mommy anyway.

product_title: Fisher-Price Kid-Tough Digital Camera Pink
review_headline: I am buying this for my daughter because of the Frustration Free Pkg.
review_body: Thank you, Jeff Bezos and FP for finally doing something to address the environmentally irresponsible and incredibly annoying packaging problem!  I am buying this for my daughter for Christmas to support your efforts, and I encourage other parents to do the same.  Just say no to sixteen layers of plastic and cardboard and three feet of steel ties!

product_title: Melissa & Doug Jumbo Triangular Crayons
review_headline: The best crayons on the market!
review_body: My two year old broke every crayon we had. Except for these!!! They are hard, but easy to color with, perfect size for toddler and even chewing on them won't break them!!!

product_title: Melissa & Doug Standard Unit Solid-Wood Building Blocks
review_body: I bought this for my almost-4-year-old for Christmas. Both he and his dad enjoy playing with the blocks, and they are good and heavy. Amazon.com had the best price by far, with free shipping!

product_title: Yugioh Lot, Holo's and Rares
review_body: We got cheated.  We thought we were receiving 28 cards based on the advertised image.  Instead, only 5 cards were shipped.  When we contacted the seller and inquired about it, we were told the order was correct and that we should read the description that was hidden at the bottom part of the web page. product_title: Play and Store Noah's Ark Big Box

review_body:
This giant sharkie has adorable mouth, eyes, tail, fins, everything.

The flappers are filled with little tiny balls which

gives it a weight and funny textures.

It's slick looking will take your mind right away!

product_title: Kids Deluxe Muscle Spiderman Costume
review_headline: Perfect! Exactly what I was looking for.
review_body: This was a very high quality costume. It was much better than what I had seen at Target and Wal-Mart.

product_title: Money Maze Bank by Dragonpad
review_body: Found to be entertaining... Even after opened the box was getting locked up again for others to attempt opening it.

product_title: Yukon Express Wooden Parking Garage
review_body: My boy wanted a garage and we wanted a quality wood product. What we got was a cheap particle board-made-in-China toy with very thin laminated fake wood paper finish. It looks like wood, but it is certainly nothing but sawdust. The painted surfaces are suspicious too... do they contain lead like everthing else coming out of that foresakened country?    We tossed it. Didn't even want to unload it on another kid via garage sale... This toy is NOT \\"real wood\\".

product_title: Calico Critters Living Room Accessories Set
review_body: what kind of house doesn't have a TV, piano, and fireplace? Not a house my critters want to live in! TV channels change and light up. Piano keys press, and fireplace lights up.

product_title: Rescue Pets My ePets Blue Bunny
review_body: She really liked it...everytime i get home from work i see her playing with it online...good investment!

product_title: Black & Decker Junior 62-Piece Deluxe Toy Tool Set
review_body: My son loves this stuff. I have to put some of the smaller pieces up for right now because he still sticks quite a bit in his mouth...but he loves that his power tools look just like daddy's!

product_title: Pink Batgirl Child Costume
review_body: My daughter knew early that she wanted to be pink bat girl.  She loves it and can't wait to wear it for Halloween and any accompaning parties.

product_title: Little Tikes Giddyup n' Go Pony
review_body: Why are these merchants selling these horses so high when you can buy them at Walmart for $179.00?  A little price gouging going on here.

product_title: WowWee FemiSapien Humanoid Robot
review_body: This toy is too hard to program and my daughter has basically lost interest in it because it takes too much effort to get it to the point where it can be enjoyed.  We try to enter commands according to the instruction manual, but it won't do what it says it is supposed to.  Probably would not buy this toy if I had it to do over.

product_title: LeapFrog Leapster Learning Game System - Green
review_body: My little boy who turned 4 on 08/26/08 LOVES this toy.  I also got him some games but he seems pretty happy with the games that come pre-loaded.  If there was 1 thing that I wish was different - it's the location of the on/off button.  It's way to easy to turn it on and off.  My 2 year old can turn it off while my 4 year old is playing.  This is probably more of a discipline issue but still, if it were a switch (instead of a red button that looks very inviting to 2 year olds) then she couldn't turn it off easily.

product_title: THE Original Flying Turtle Ride-On Scooter - No Assembly, Made in USA by Mason Corporation, Ages 3 & up, Engineering Marvel and ~Top-Rated Toy~
review_body: I got the scooter for my daughter for Christmas and she loves it! She uses a scooter like this one at school and now she can ride it at home also. She is 8 years old and just loves it. The price is right and it is a great workout for the kids, instead of all those electric things. No batteries, no headaches. She can not fall off. It is great!

product_title: Go Diego Go Cuddle Pillow
review_body:
I got this for my 3 year old son for his birthday a week ago! He loves it and takes it EVERYWHERE with him! I wish the arms weren't attached to the sides, but with a careful snip I think I could detach them.

I paid [...] for mine a couple of days after Thanksgiving, so the price here seems a little high.

product_title: Flipper Gripper Rattle developmental baby toy by Sassy
review_body: Found this to be a great rattle.  Is very stimulating and easy for child to grip.

product_title: USAopoly Chronicles of Narnia Monopoly
review_body: My boys love this game.  It has all the places mentioned in Narnia and a few we never heard of.  Its the exact same concept as Monopoly, on a Narnia version.  Only downfall is the moving pieces, they are similar and small and hard to pick out when playing the game.  With the background kinda dark and colorful the moving pieces blend in and are hard to find.  All in all its a good purchase, and you will enjoy it if you like Narnia.

product_title: Techno Source Guess What I Am
review_body: This was a great game to play as a family.  We had 9 of us playing aging from 4 to 57.  I would recommend this game for anyone with kids or grandkids, nieces or nephews. This is a game for those who like to play together as a family.

product_title: Techno Source Are You Smarter than a 5th Grader - Illuminated Touch Screen Game
review_body: My son was bored with this after 15 ninutes. The pen isn't attached, so it was lost after day 1. It's been sitting on my sons dresser collecting dust for over 3 weeks now.

product_title: Pokemon Lunch Bag
review_body: Cute Pikachu lunch box, my 6 year old loves it.  Wish it were a little bit bigger to fit bigger snack items in, but overall we're really happy with it.

product_title: Hansa South African Fox Plush
review_headline: Hansa plush animals are the nearest thing to owning a zoo
review_body: I've always loved animals and Hansa has enabled me to feel like I'm traveling to distant lands and returning with keep sakes.  My friends and family are delighted with the safari room I have created.  I look forward to new and unusual creations to come.

product_title: My Workshop Multi-Tool Set Power Tools & Hand Tools
review_body: My two year old angel loves this toy.  The tools are not made cheaply and they are durable.  The tools resemble real tools and they are a nice size for toddlers.  I do not have any problems with the case as it has survived an active toddler abuse.  The case has not broken and it fits perfectly in the back of his F-150 truck.  We bought several different sets of tools but this set is the best.

product_title: Playhut Disney Princess Super Play House
review_body: THis toy was very disappointing in that it is not a tent you take out of the bag and it is instantly ready to play with.  It takes a parent 10-15 minutes to set up.  The poles are very hard to get into the side roof pieces.  I thought about sending it back, but my daughter really like it.  It is a really cool tent, but you either need to make sure you set it up prior to your child wanting to play in it with friends or have a large room where it can just be kept up all the time.

product_title: Wild Planet Hyper Jump
review_body: Product quit working the day after christmas.  Changing batteries did not help.  Kid do not understand why new batteries do not fix a toy.[[ASIN:B0017S4PH8 Wild Planet Hyper Jump]]

product_title: Dunecraft Resurrection Plant Science Kit
review_body: The 2 plants that I bought are smaller than I expected. They opened up quickly but do not seem to be happy. They are partly green partly brown . After three weeks, some of the plant has yet to turn green from the dried brown/gray that they come as. Overall a disappointment.

product_title: Crocodile Creek's Sunflower Pocket Lunchbox
review_body: My daughter loves her new lunchbox.  I was worried when it came that it was smaller than I expected- but after using it for several weeks I've found that it's big enough to put lots in it. Because the sides are soft it can expand a bit and hold items like her small thermos container.  She loves the little pocket on the outside and wants me to put her dessert in there- so that she's not tempted to eat it first!  :o)  It's also easy to wipe clean- which I LOVE!

product_title: Caterpillar Box DC
review_body: Make sure you read the measurements first.  This is quite pricey for the size.  I was expecting a 10\\"-12\\" cube, but instead this one is not quite 5in. review_headline: Great figure, very poor quality. I'd want my money back if i could.
review_body: I bought it from an online store, so it makes no sense returning it (shipping would be more expensive).    Don't get me wrong: Starscream animated is a great figure, it is very poseable, looks pretty cool, and both robot mode and plane mode are very cartoon-accurate. I love the design of the Animated characters.    But the quality of the Animated figures in general is pretty cheap. I bought several at once, just to discover that they were splattered in paint and that the plastic pieces still had rough edges.    I bought the figure less than a week ago, and the automorph feature of the plane's nose has already stopped working. I disassembled it and found out that one of the cogs that slide the nose, is broke. And then Starscream couldn't twist his left hip. I opened the hip, and found that the clicker piece was crushed and obstructed the movement. I had to remove it.    And the hands ! Oh, my god, the hands. They look pretty cool, like claws, but if you open them a little too much, they snap out, and you'll find yourself crawling on the floor trying to find the lost piece. I decided to take a dremel and nail the hands pieces.    And don't get me started with the \\"hidden cannon\\" feature. I slid the cannon into place, and the flaps in their arms flew somewhere else, and the feature stopped working. I had to disassemble the arms this time and sand some parts in order to make it work properly.    You see, Starscream is a good figure, but Hasbro would have to pay me a lot of money because i did a lot of work that they did not. It is a great figure if you don't want to play with it. But if you want to transform it (as it should), you'll find yourself wasting a lot of time trying to find all the parts that snap out and fall to the floor.    The head and the fintails also snap out easily.     Such a great character, such a poor figure. It's a pity.

product_title: Zoob The Game
review_body: I was a bit hesitant to purchase this game based on one of the reviews about it being boring, but I decided to give it a try anyway since I liked that it was a completely different way to play with Zoobs.      To summarize the game, you roll a die and move around the game board in any direction you want as you try to collect all of the necessary pieces to create the Zoob object on your creation card (of which there are 24 included with the game).  You can land on a space with a specific color you take from the box or different action spaces which allow you to take a piece from another player, trade one of your pieces for another players piece, or choose any piece you want out of the box.  There is also one \\"Zoob\\" space in the middle where you don't choose a piece, but where you are also safe from any other player taking or trading pieces with you.  Since the board has many different paths to take, you can count out the spaces in different directions to decide where to move by which space will be of most benefit to you, or most disruptive to other players.  Once you have all of the pieces you need to build whatever is on your creation card, you go to the finish space, then race to build your creation while the other players continue with the game and try to catch up.  The instructions say to keep your creation card a secret from the other players, but we have played it with them showing, too.  It can be a friendly game of gathering pieces, or it can be a very fast-paced game of strategy where you try to get the pieces you need, while trying to keep the necessary pieces away from the other players.  Since there is a limited number of each color of Zoob pieces, it is not unusual for some colors to not be available in the box when you need them, and therefore have to start swapping and swiping from other players, which is where some luck and strategy enters the game.  This isn't always very friendly, but completely within the rules of the game!    When my 4 year old plays, the winner is whoever gets to the finish space first, since she is still learning how the pieces go together.  (Or if her creation card is of something that can lie flat on the floor, she can put the pieces out to match the picture, but doesn't have to have it fully assembled.)  We also keep the cards showing so I can help her keep track of what she needs as the game progresses.  She also loves that the creations on the game cards are a bit more manageable for her to build just for fun.      My 6 year old, who is really picky about playing games, loves being able to take and trade pieces and is already learning the strategy of the game. It is so much more than just wandering around the board collecting the pieces you need to complete a small creation. He quickly learned that he could sabotage the efforts of other players, and has so much fun with this idea, that sometimes he ends up messing up the pieces he is trying to collect in the process. (When the picture on the creation cards is hidden from each other it becomes more of a game of chance, but when each player knows what the other players are trying to get, it makes for a very different game of intentional sabotage!)     This particular set is meant to be a game where creating with Zoobs is just one part of the goal.  It is not meant to utilize the full potential of creating with Zoob pieces.  The game certainly has the potential to be modified in different ways by adding more Zoob pieces or even making up your own more complex creation cards.  You could also make up your own wild cards with or without creation criteria as suggested in a previous review.  For our family, it is fun just the way it is, but I like knowing that it has more potential!  If you are looking for a creative building toy, stick with the larger sets of Zoobs. If you are looking for a game to introduce various levels of strategy, then this is a great start. The closest thing I can think of to compare it to is a very active game of Uno,but with a goal of collecting pieces instead of trying to eliminate all of your cards. It may be a bit of a reach, but if you think of the strategy part of that game, and how fast the game can turn around, hopefully that will give you a better idea. We very highly recommend this game!!

product_title: The Five Love Languages for Singles
review_headline: The Five Love Languages for Singles
review_body:
Gary Chapman's book is the best self-help book I have read for single adults, and I recommend it for all singles. It is a rewriting for readers who are single of his national bestseller, The Five Love Languages, which he wrote for married couples.

The five love languages are: words of affirmation, gifts, acts of service, quality time, and physical touch. Chapman says that we all have one love language that is more meaningful to us than the others and that is the love language we prefer receiving. Knowing your primary love language and that of the other person in the relationship will help you both feel loved. There is a short questionnaire that will help you determine your primary love language. My primary love language is quality time, and that is the main way that I feel loved, by spending quality time with people.

This book has good, practical advice on how to express love to others that will help you with any relationship you have whether it is with family members, friends, or in a romantic relationship.

Conrad

review_body:
First, I want to thank Amazon for shipping this to APOs, and so quickly (before Christmas-yeah!) My daughter is 6 and LOVES Barbie and princesses... Not only was this in our price range, but it was a rarity that it actually shipped overseas to our army post.

The second floor flips out of the way to make it easier to play on the ground. It gives the FEELING of princess. It is satisfying for awhile.

Cons: Extremely flimsy second floor. I see it start to bow everytime she places a doll in the bed. There is not enough play area there, and it is not sturdy enough for some real play. So, child must be careful. So, we'll see how long THAT lasts-not good if child is playing with another. I could also tell there wasn't enough room for barbies to eat on ground floor. I saw her get very frustrated over dolls, plates, chairs constantly falling over. This is fairly big, and NOT portable. There is no detail on back,so play is very one-sided. It sits against my daughter's bedroom wall.

However, from a close study of the photos, I knew this beforehand, and was willing to pay $21 for the PROS. If living in the states, I would look into all-wood barbie-sized dollhouse. The kidcraft ones on this site are SO CUTE, and were even on sale around the time I was looking... Alas, if Amazon would ship these items to military bases, they would \\"make a killing\\" The cost in euros is \\"out of the question\\" for MANY of us...

In short-If you want a touch of princess at a great price,keep castle in wish list, pray and wait for the price to go back down...Do not pay over $30 for this item.

product_title: The Original Rollercoaster by Anatex
review_body:
I saw one of these in my son's doctor's office and he loved it. The one in the doctor's office was an older sturdy model and I was impressed with it. Perhaps we just got a dud but for $50 I would have expected a bit better quality. The toy we have doesn't sit flat on the floor and wobbles a lot because the wood bottom and slats don't fit together well. All five of the last bead on one side were glued to the bottom, one so tightly that I needed my husband to pry it loose. Unfortunately most formerly glued beads left paint residue on the metal rungs when pried loose.

Now for the positive, my son adores this toy. I would have given it 1 star for the flimsy craftsmanship versus how expensive this toy was if it wasn't for my son. When he wakes up the first thing he wants to do is play with this toy. He spends a good portion of the day playing with this toy and we are using it to work on counting. Anything that can keep his interest like that gets at least 2 stars.

So all in all my son loves it and I would too if not for its poor construction. If I were to purchase one of these bead maze toys again I would get Melissa & Doug. I think the bead maze toys are great I just think this one is of poor quality.

product_title: Short Length Flexi-Cables for NXT Sensors and Motors
review_body: These cables are a godsend. If you are making rovers and other small bots, you've noticed that the overall wonderfulness of your design is ruined once you've cabled it. There is only one 8\\" cable so you are forced to use 15\\" when it is overkill, and the cables are black, wide and stiff so its hard or impossible to place them neatly: what you usuall get is a mass of tangled cables sticking out everywhere.The Short Length Flex-Cables solve this problem: there are 2 8: cables and 2 4\\" cables. The 4\\" cables are handy when your output and input ports are really close together, and it's great to have more 8\\" cables. The cables are also a light grey and a little bit thinner so they are unobstrusive. They are not stiff and they are pretty flexible. Buy these. You bots will look way way cooler. (I just did a bot that needed a cable longer than 8\\" so was forced to use a standard 15\\" one. I am going to buy a set of Flex-Cables in the standard lengths so I never again have to use the stiff, black, fat ones. Also I bought 2 sets of the short ones which is perfect for my designs.)

product_title: P.U. The Guessing Game of Smells
review_body:
P.U The Guessing Game of Smells is just that, it is a board game that you play with the whole family that you draw cards and have to guess the smell to advance and win the game. There are other non-scent based cards, but these are just fillers and are very easy.

The game is very fun to play the first time or two, but once you recognize all of the scents it becomes almost no challenge and the original wonder and excitement fades fast. Also with all the \\"bad\\" smell cards, the scents are very poorly done and you can barely guess what they are, except for garlic, the dirty socks, garbage, skunk all pretty much smell the same and don't really smell like anything you can identify, so you almost always get those wrong.

The good smells are almost spot on especially the fruits though. My son enjoyed playing this game as did parents and grandparents, but after a while it loses its appeal.

One thing to note, if the cards are all stacked together some of the scents can mask other cards causing them all to smell the same, this is true especially of the bad scent cards. I heard they have scent packs with new and unique add-on smells to keep the game fun and these might be worthwhile.

product_title: EyeClops Night Vision Infrared Stealth Goggles
review_body: I was originally skeptical of these goggles when I saw them advertised before Christmas.  However, I was stunned to learn that they are not simply some kind of 'green flashlight attached to your head', child-grade night vision solution.    The goggles use infrared (like your TV remote) to produce a true night vision image.  The casing is hard plastic attached to your head by three thick, rubber straps.  The straps are long enough to accommodate even large adult heads.  The straps lead to the battery housing (5xAA) behind your head.  The weight of the batteries acts as a natural counter-balance to the optics in front making the goggles comfortable to wear.    The criticisms of these goggles are all true: narrow field of vision, lack of depth perception, slightly offset image, etc.  HOWEVER, these are true of many military night vision goggles as well.  Despite these drawbacks, navigation (and even aiming a Nerf gun) in pitch black darkness can be achieved.    If you, or your children, are at all interested in playing with a VERY inexpensive night vision solution I recommend these goggles.  They perform much better than you would expect for the price.

product_title: Webkinz Chihuahua with Trading Cards
review_body:
My granddaughter, age 9, collects Webkinz. I had ordered this along with several other items from this seller, Collectors Paradise. She loved everything.

Although Webkinz's are toys, my granddaughter has learned a great deal about money by using the internet and registering the toys. I never realized just how much she learned until I sat down with her and watched what all transpires after the animal is registered. They have to be fed, clothed, etc. In order to do that certain things must be done to earn \\"money\\" in order to buy the food and accessories. It was an eye opener for me. I thought they were only \\"toys.\\"

I had to laugh because my granddaughter had to be away for a couple of days and had asked her father to \\"take care of the pets.\\" If they aren't taken care of such as feeding, they will become \\"ill.\\" I found him logging on to the Webkinz and feeding the pets for her! Yes, she is serious about taking care of them. It truly has been a learning experience for her.

My only negative was with the vendor. I placed the order on December 14th however, the items didn't ship until December 20th. Per their shipping dates, the cutoff for guaranteed delivery was December 15th. I met that deadline. They did not. Needless to say, the items arrived after Christmas.

product_title: Transformers Universe Deluxe Class Classic Series Action Figure - Autobot Sunstreaker with Electron Pulse Blaster
review_body: Having grown up with G1/G2 Transformers (among the best period ever), I've been less impressed with later generations, as they have become too plastic, too brittle, and in some cases, just plain gaudy. That being said, Sunstreaker was always a favorite of mine which I never grabbed 24 years ago when I had the chance (there are many actually). While this figure is all plastic, and the arms and feet pop out with the slightest resistance, they pop back in much easier and in some cases make it easier to transform him. Still, you don't get the sturdy feeling of the largely metal-based G1/G2 series toys. But, I don't feel as though it will fall apart like some of the others seem to.    As for Sunstreaker's looks, this is a very faithful update of the original based on the current Lamborghini bodystyle (the G1 was an 80's era Countach) and the saturated yellow color scheme is spot on. In robot mode, he is much more detailed and more poseable than the G1 version and his head and face look so much better. Really looking forward to the Sideswipe release in this series (never grabbed him in the 1980s, so I just may have to this time around).    Overall, this will never replace the sturdy quality most of us associate with the G1/G2 series toys, but I'm more impressed with this one than I thought I would be. If anything else, it is nice to finally grab Sunstreaker after a 24 year absence, and my son will one day inherit this with my original G1/G2 series toys when he's a little older.
