product_title: Xeko Mission: China - Award Winning Eco Playing Card Game
review_headline: It's All Fun and Games! Xeko Mission: China
review_body:
Xeko: Mission China is the 4th collection of an eco-adventure trading card game where children and adults alike have an opportunity to learn about China's ecosystems and meet the endangered species that live in them.
This award-winning game introduces kids to threatened species and the world's conservation hotspots -the Earth's most ecologically rich and most critically threatened habitats.
The hotspots provide oxygen for our plant and contain many important endemic plant and animal species (as in not-located-anywhere-else-once-they're-gone-they're-gone-for-good species!).
If saving the planet isn't enough, Xeko: Mission China's box design alone should capture your attention with it's stunning pagoda-like shape decorated with animals from China's habitats and dragon illustrations that capture the mysteries of ancient Chinese culture.
Eye-catching pictures of the beloved Giant Panda, endangered Snow Leopard and adorable Snub-Nosed Monkey tantalize you for the fantastic adventure waiting once you open the box.
Dedicated to \\"a bright green future,\\" Xeko produces the games in an Earth-friendly way. Not only are the cards and packaging made of 100% recycled stock, but all printing is done with eco-friendly inks.
Xeko cards are designed for fun and realism with eye-popping artwork that makes the cards especially fun to play with and collect.
Every Xeko game features remarkable plant and animal species from one of Earth's 34 biodiversity hotspots, first identified by Dr. Norman Myers and recognized by Conservation International, Xeko's non-profit partner and recipient of 4% of net game sales. So, not only are you learning about saving the earth, but your purchase of the game actually helps do it!
Like the blockbusters Pokemon and Yu-Gi_oh, Xeko involves collecting trading cards to create a custom library-or in this case a \\"Xeko system\\"-and using those cards to match wits against opponents in exciting game play.
Instead of monsters and fantasy, Xeko uses the actual animal species as the heroes, taking its cue from nature and science to explore fragile ecosystem relationships.
Actual play involves `turf wars\\" where one species invades another species territory in a struggle to balance the competing resource needs of neighboring species, which is all part of the learning that it takes a combination of cooperation and competition to help an ecosystem thrive. Xeko cards and Booster cards are used to improve your species' odds at winning the turf war, and therefore creating the strongest Xeko system to win the game.
Learning the ins and outs of the game is slow and methodical at first, trying to figure out the best plan for creating a thriving Xeko system. While younger children can play and enjoy the game, Xeko is best suited for kids ages 8 years and up. I would highly recommend this for children at or above the fourth grade level because of the reading and strategic skills required.
Once the game-playing concepts are mastered, the ecosystem is yours!
Piquing kids' interest in endangered animals and environmental conservation, Xeko seeks to inspire the next generation of eco-leaders through enriching and exciting game play.

product_title: NERF N-STRIKE Vulcan EBF-25 Value Pack
review_body: After receiving this item I put it together and after the first test shot, it BROKE. Talk about disappointment for a 6 year old. We returned it no problem to Amazon, and purchased the same one at Toys are US, same day. Try telling a 6 year old to wait 5 days.    The gun jams very easy and has a lot of misfires. Its not that durable. I had to teach my son to STOP firing if it jams, otherwise is shears a gear off inside and its useless. The second gun works fine after about a month. The secret to not jammin is 3 things:  1. Make sure you load the bullet string with the logo outword. The bullet clips have writing on one side and blank on the other. If after you load the bullet string look at the bullet casing. If you don't see any writing, its in backwards. Pull it out and start from the other end. No directions on this so maybe its just my luck,  but it makes a difference.  2. make sure you push all the bullets in all the way. If they hang out a little they will jam.  3. Use the bullets they come with. Not other ones with the plunger on the end.    Besides that its a lot of fun. Takes 10 mins to collect all your bullets and reload and about 30s to go through a full clip. Not perfect, jams and missfires, not superdurable, but overall a good item. I would recommend, cause its BAD @ss!

When he clicks on the bubble bottle, bubbles come out and they have to click on as many bubbles as they can and it counts how many bubbles they popped. Plus that one game has many other items to click on and do different activities. I think it is a very good educational toy.  The only thing is I wish the keyboard had an on/off switch. I have to take the batteries out every night. The component that plugs into the T.V. has an on/off switch but not the keyboard. The keyboard is wireless. review_body: We bought this for our daughter when she was 4 months old.  She loved to swing in the reclined position. We were pushing our daughter just the other day in this swing, it was in the upright position as she is now 28 months old (23 pounds, well within the limits of the swing).  We were not swinging her high or dangerously, just pushing her like normal.  She leaned forward over the tray, and when the swing swung back, it flipped upside down.  Thank goodness we were right there next to her and caught her, I don't want to even think what would have happened had she fallen headfirst out of the swing.  Do not buy this swing...we used it safely for over 2 years, then out of the blue it just flipped upside down.

product_title: Lucky the Deluxe Talking Plush Spring Horse
review_body: I purchased this product for my grandson's 3rd Birthday because his Mother had a similar one when she was about that age and she loved it. product_title: Magnetic Go Board with Single Convex Magnetic Plastic Stones Game Set

product_title: Fisher-Price Shake 'n Go Flyers Fighter Plane

There is so much foam hangin over the plastic that when a kid pushes the plane into the launcher it just causes it to rip the foam at the plastic. We had no problems with the launchers. For the review which Fisher price claims to have sold thousands without complaints I didn't complain either (both times), but that still doesn't mean there is not a problem with their design. Its just not to many people complain about items under $[...] (especially toys). I don't think they want to, but they  could fix this by making the plastic part of the plane that goes into the launcher into a solid piece that extends the length of the plane. If it is kept concealed inside the foam part and rounded like a popsicle stick it is still not a safety issue as Fisher Price had eluded to. Great toy that was alot of fun, but the fun will last only a few days (if you have tape handy).

product_title: Webkinz 8.5" Webkinz Husky
review_headline: Fun, but know what you are getting into when you buy one of these!
review_body:
First of all, the husky is very cute, and my five year old boy is in love with it, and the idea of selling cute stuffed animals that have a second life in a web world for kids is brilliant. But, know what you are getting into when you by one of these.

First, you'll of course have to get the pet \\"adopted\\" on the Webkinz web site. Then, you'll have to study the online user manual for the Webkinz web site because unless your child has a certain reading ability, maybe fourth grade, they won't be able to read it all by themselves.

Then of course, you'll have to teach your child what you learned. You might be with your child for a few hours at this site while you both learn your way around. With a five year old it is going to take a while. Of course, you may view it as a bonding experience, so it's not all bad, but there is a time commitment you make when you get one of these.

Then, you'll have to cope with the technical glitches at the Webkinz web site. My ordeal was in getting my son's Webkinz husky to send messages and gifts to another Webkinz husky owned by my son's best friend of the same age. The site has a \\"post office\\" where you can send letters and \\"gifts\\" to a friend on your \\"friend list\\", but they don't tell you on the site how to get a friend on the friend list, so I had to do research out on the Internet to see how this is done.

Once we had mastered that, we found that the mailbox doesn't update with new messages unless you log out of the Webkinz site and log back in again.

Some of the navigation controls on the Webkinz site are very narrow and hard for very young children to master because they require a lot of mouse precision. You may end up sitting with your child at the computer getting them through some of the things they want to do.

Finally, your pet's life is one year on the site unless you buy more Webkinz toys or buy a renewal of your pet at the end of one year. They want to hook you into spending more money. I'm glad these cute little things don't cost too much.

So, now you have an idea of what you are committing to when you buy one of these toys. Good luck!se cute little things don't cost too much. So, now you have an idea of what you are committing to when you buy one of these toys. Good luck!

product_title: Agente Secreto - Secret Agent - Linea de Juegos en Español / Games in Spanish Line
review_headline: Excellent learning tool for children and adults learning Spanish
review_body: This game is similar to the English game \\"Guess Who?\\" but instead of a character's name, it introduces the interesting element of the spy's country of origin (since they are supposed to be incognito, I imagine). For each character, the game also presents the country's flag. There are four rows of 6 characters each.  The countries listed are:  Alemania, Argentina, Bolivia, Brasil, Canada, Chile, Cuba, E.E. U.U., Espana, Francia, Gran Bretana, Holanda, Iraq, Irlanda, Israel, Italia, Mexico, Noruega, Paraguay, Peru (my country, yeah!), Suecia, Suiza, Turquia, y Uruguay.  Even if the instructions are in Spanish only, learning how to play this game is a \\"no brainer\\":  (1) Each player picks a card from a deck of 24 cards.  Your card has the spy your opponent must guess, and you must do the same for his/her card. (2) Guess who the character your opponent has is by asking \\"yes\\" or \\"no\\" questions, and (3) Collect $1,000 for every spy correctly identified. After several rounds, whoever has the most money in the end wins.    I am a Spanish speaker and teacher and bought this game to use with adults learning Spanish. I love it, and so do my students. It is excellent for introducing the uses of \\"ser\\" and for naming nationalities, especially the \\"E.E.U.U.\\" which stands for Estados Unidos and for explaining the term \\"estadounidense,\\" --the proper nationality name for a citizen of the United States-- which surprises many.     Two last items, the seller of this product (Shopjuegos) is also awesome: very friendly, generous and resourceful. I also recommend \\"El que busca, encuentra.\\" -- a similar version of this game but with animals. Cute.    Hope this helped make up your mind.  Get this game! You won't regret it.    Mari

product_title: Once Upon A Time
review_headline: Good game for creative individuals or a classroom setting
review_body: This game is for 2 to 6 players and is recommended for ages 8 and up, although all you need to play are basic reading skills and a healthy imagination.  The game consists of a 16 page rulebook, 112 \\"Once Upon A Time\\" storytelling cards, and 56 \\"Happy Ever After\\" ending cards.  Blank cards are included, so players can add their own ideas if desired.  The object of the game is to use up all your storytelling cards, and end up by playing your ending card.  All the other players are trying to direct the story towards their own ending.  There are two ways to interrupt the current \\"storyteller\\" and take over the direction of the story.      The \\"One Upon A Time\\" cards are divided into five different groups as follows:  Characters, Items, Places, Aspects, and Events.      Examples of ending or \\"Happy Ever After\\" cards include:  \\"And there they sit to this very day\\",  \\"As dawn broke they could see it was perfect\\" - and my own personal favorite - \\"And he listened to his mother's advice from then on.\\"      Could be educational as well when used in a classroom setting (such as literature, theatre arts, etc.) to explore the different elements of a good story and how they are woven together.

product_title: New 2010 Model Intex 15' x 42" Easy Set Pool Set (with Filter Pump, Ladder, G...
review_body: We bought the 16' 42\\" pool.  We have had this pool for about 2-3 weeks now and are really enjoying it.  We did just a little prep work to the ground to ensure it was level. It wasn't perfect level, but the best we could do.  The spot was \\"eye ball level\\", but we scalped a little off one side and added some sand to the other to help make it even better.  Make sure the ground doesn't have any sticks, rocks, acorns, etc.  Set up went well. The ground cover is VERY thin, so we weren't sure what good it was going to do. The DVD was helfpul, but pretty basic.  As it started to fill, we made sure to spread out the floor to keep wrinkles from being there. It took our pool about 12 hours to fill up. Before you start adding the water, take note of where the drain hole is in case you want the water to go in a certain area when you drain it, or you can hook a hose up to that. Also, note where the pump goes so you can place that in the right area.  The top air ring inflated easily. We did notice that the outside temperature really had a bearing on how firm it was. If you inflate it when it's cool, don't air up really firm as the heat will expand it.  You will need an air pump of some kind to blow it up.  The ladder assembled easily and seems stable. The pump has received some bad opinions, but I don't think we have had ours long enough to really know how it will perform. So far so good though.  We have been enjoying this pool every day. We've had several kids playing in it at a time, and as kids do, they can get to splashing and playing pretty rough at times.  The sides are soft and do give a little, but would be very hard to push down.  It seems very sturdy.  We filled the water to just under the ring, so the depth of the pool isn't water level, it's pool side height. So subtract about 8-10\\" off the depth to know water level.  The skimmer and vacuum that came with it, work well. They are necessary items to help keep the pool clean.  The cover seems heavy duty. It ties on and seems secure.  Overall, I think this is a great pool for the money.  ********  Edited to add:  We have now used the pool for 2 summers.  We drain, dry, and store in our basement through the winter months.  Set up and take down has been quite easy for a pool this size.  The pump, ladder, and pool itself have all held up well and we have not had one issue or problem. No complaints.

product_title: Roborally
review_body:
There is a place in our lives that is rarely spoken of and even less often brought to life with such perfection and beauty - that overlap between the strict von Neumann architecture that has defined our modern computer technology, and just plain silliness!

Robo Rally is simple enough for many pre-teens to play, yet complicated enough for professional software engineers (such as myself) to really enjoy! It teaches the ultra-basics of computer programming in a very fun manner, while letting experts laugh at themselves and each other for silly mistakes or elements of chance and competition.

While I think this game would be great for anyone who is vaguely interested in the subject matter, speaking as a software developer I can't stress enough that this game, for its unique combination of technical aspects and sheer silliness, is an absolute MUST for all nerds, geeks, hackers, and the like.

As with nearly all re-makes, this second version with its plastic pieces and only four maps is of lesser production quality than the original. But the soul of this game isn't about metal versus plastic pieces (as much fun as metal miniatures can be to paint extravagantly for no reason).

A big part of the magic of the game is the wide variety of maps and configurations. While the price of the original, STILL OUT OF PRINT expansion pack(s) has skyrocketed to collectors-only prices, tools and means of making your OWN custom maps are available. Still, with just four two-sided maps in this Robo Rally re-print, the physical configurations are many. Multiply that by the somewhat player-defined goals and you can get quite a bit of play out of the stock game!

I'm not so sure there is \\"tons of strategy\\" in Robo Rally, but strategy is certainly very important. Will you race your robot the long way to try to get on the fast conveyors, risking making even bigger mistakes? Or will you intentionally pause to try to do damage to or mess up the program of another robot? With every turn your available options change.

While two can play this game and enjoy it, the more robots there are the more likely random chance, strategy, and tactics, will make a seemingly simple and mechanical trek across the floor of a factory into a silly and frantic game of repairing or recovering robots running wild.

The fact that this is a board game may draw sneers or comments of \\"How quaint!\\" from computer gamers (assuming they talked like that), but this is not just any \\"board game\\" in my opinion. I AM a complete FPS addict, but I love and adore Robo Rally! It's very nice to have a game that I and my fellow techno-geeks can enjoy where we aren't just staring at a screen. I would never put down the virtual rocket launcher for a Parcheesy or a Life, but I gladly would for a Robo Rally.your available options change. product_title: Kato Steam 2-8-2 USRA Heavy Mikado C,B,&Q
review_body:
I have several of the Kato 2-8-2 Mikado N-scale locomotives and have found them to be excellent runners. Unlike earlier releases, this run comes with detail pieces already installed which is a great help. The lettering is razor sharp which is a plus. The model comes with a working Kato magnetic knuckle coupler on the tender (trip pin is user installed) and a semi-automatic coupler on the front pilot which can mate with the Kato coupler on the tender to allow \\"double-headed\\" operation. Along with the trip pin, the parts pack also includes a non-magnetic knuckle coupler and a Rapido coupler for the tender. I have used the Mikado on Kato Unitrack with a 9.5\\" radius curve but I recommend using larger radius curve for better operation.

My Kato Mikados are the best operating N-scale steam models I own. They have excellent slow-speed operation and the prototypical side rod motion makes them look great while in motion. I have tested the Kato 11-604 traction tires on one of my units and I think that little locomotive could pull straight up! I recommend the conversion as it is not too difficult but does require a small/mini philips screwdriver. The minimum age recommendation is 8 years-old which is about right for unsupervised as there are small parts. With supervision and a little practice putting the locomotive on the rails, my six-year-old cousin became quite the expert.

This is an outstanding model and equal to Kato's high reputation in the N-scale field and worthy of a great line like the CB&Q. I give it my unqualified recommendation.

The idea of being able to attach plastic finger nails to a round platform and paint them doesn't happen; you can not even get the finger nails to stay attached.  There is a blowing fan that is suppose to swirl glitter around; good idea, but does not move anything around.  The case is hard to open and close.  The idea of it is fun and my 6-yr old thinks it is pretty cool to play with, so I do not mind that it is junk.  But I would not recommend it if you are counting on everything working.

product_title: Pokemon AG Mega Bloks Large Set - Kyogre (Japanese Import)
review_body: We had alot of fun putting this toy together. It has nice colors and is one of my son's  favorite characters. There should be more Pokemon block type toys available to the North American market. They would sell like hotcakes! It was a bit difficult to keep some of the blocks in place and to put some into place but generally we did pretty well. My son loves pokemon and Mega Bloks/Lego type toys so it worked out very well all around.

product_title: Melissa & Doug Wooden Chunky Puzzle
review_body: My son has six or seven of the Melissa and Doug chunky puzzles and we love them. However, the tool puzzle that we received is NOT hand painted as described, and like all of the other ones that we have. Instead, the pieces have sticker pictures on them and several of them are already peeling off at the edges. (We got this today.) Durability aside this is a good product and I recommend it.

product_title: Woodstock Percussion Folk Guitar
review_body: [[ASIN:B000BXK0VA Woodstock Percussion Folk Guitar]] This is the second guitar I have bought from this company.The first one was over a year ago for a  5 yr.old grandson.He plays it in church.It has held up very well.My 3 yr.old grandson took an interest in playing so I bought another one.Now both boys play in church.  I am very pleased with everything about it.The price was less than most.this is an excellant value.It comes with a carrying case, pick and book.The size is perfect.   To my grandsons,this is a real guitar.

product_title: Brilliant Basics Ready Steady Rider
review_body: My children love this little rider.  It is easy to get on and off of, it rides well on the carpet, it was a black friday bargain!! and it is very durable!  Have fun.

product_title: Playmobil Pirate & Row Boat
review_body: This toy is beautifully made - colorful, durable & fun for child or adult!  Our 4 y.o. grandson played with this for every bath.  The boat floats without the pirate in it - but that's not a problem.  The pirate stands on the edge of the tub and fishes holding his fishing pole (comes with a little magnet & string you have to thread thru the pole and tie at the end).  The plastic fish have metal in their mouth so the pirate can \\"catch\\" them.  It comes with a bucket to put your fish in, 2 oars that attach to the gunwales or fit in the pirate's hand, & lamp that attaches to the back of the boat.  Cute, cute toy.  I had it sitting on top of my printer before I gave it to our grandson.  I may have to get another for myself!

product_title: Fisher-Price Easy Link Internet Launch Pad
review_headline: One of the best new toys this year!!!
review_body: I was so happy to see this toy in the store...a parents dream come true!! I have a 6 year old and a 3 year old who both LOVE to play games on the compuer. This makes mine and their job so easy!! All they have to is pick witch character they would like to play and put it into the slot to bring up that character website and they can start playing. My kids are constantly wanting to switch games and yelling for mommy to help them now they can do it themselves!! this product is an A+ ALL THE WAY!! I am now hoping it takes off and fisher price comes out with more easy link characters!!

product_title: Air Hogs Havoc Heli - Colors May Vary
review_body: We got this for my son's 7th birthday, since he's been interested in all things that fly for quite a while. We had previously tried an Air Hogs rocket, and loved it, and an Air Hogs airplane, and hated it. This helicopter was a very pleasant surprise. It's very cheap for an RC helicopter, so we had low expectations. It doesn't look or feel like much, but it flies great once you get the hang of it, and the controls are simple enough that a 7-year old can easily fly it. We love the fact that you can fly it indoors - our great room with a 20-foot ceiling makes an awesome fly zone! And even when it crashes (which it does, often), it doesn't get damaged. The only problem we've had is that hair and fuzz gets caught in the tail rotor, causing it not to rotate. When this happens, the helicopter still flies, but just spins out of control. Taking out the hair/fuzz made it work properly again.

product_title: Superman Inflato Suit w/Fan, Mattel J7019
review_body: Purchased this for my nephew last Christmas and he played in it all year! I am sure he will be opening this year's gifts while wearing this suit. He loves it! He has so much fun showing off his huge muscles and running around trying to watch the cape flap behind him- too cute! GREAT gift!

product_title: Ben 10 (Ten) Animating Omnitrix Watch Alien Viewer
review_body: My son requested this toy for his 7th birthday.  He's a fairly good fan of Ben 10.  With most plastic toys I try not to spend much on them as they break fairly easy with my three boys.  This one has thus far proven me wrong and has held up to the abuse of three boys who eagerly await to take turns wearing it.  It's proven amusing to watch them pretend to morph into the different Ben10 creatures.  I give it a 3 in educational becasue I think making use of a child's imagination is worth at least that in the way of education if not more.  All in all I'm glad I purchased it.  Well worth the money spent.  No regrets.

product_title: LeapFrog FLY Fusion Pentop Computer
review_body: I think the fly fushion pen is amazing it is very smart for just a little pen. You can do so many things with it the notebook does lots of things for you. Also with a regular you can't refill the ink but with the fly fushion pen you can. I am just a kid and I really highly recommend the fly fushion pen. It can help you with your homework it can give the answer. Or even better it can tell you like bring down the onwe and subtract. It and awsome and fun toy.

product_title: Banzai Jungle Blast Water Park
review_headline: NOT DURABLE- SLIDE LITERALLY BLEW APART AT THE SEAM
review_body: I purchased a water slide before,and our kids loved it. After much research,I decided to purchase the jungle blast this year. I figured,a newer model meant better quality. WRONG!!!! This slide has fabric that is thin,and lightweight. Not durable at all. Within the first few hours of use by our young children(ages 8,6 & 5),the slides seam split apart.Not just a little bit,but the entire seam.  Immediately after inflating the slide,I had reservations about its' durability. Yes, the small time my kids used it the had fun,but,anyone wanting to buy this should plan on it only lasting a very short time;probably not even a full summer. Also, this slide is HUGE!!! A large amount of space will be needed to store this when it is not in use. It is also very heavy!!  Overall, I don't recommend this slide. If it wouldn't hold up for my young kids,it won't hold up for yours!!

product_title: Ultimate Soldier RUSSIAN SPETZNAZ 12" Figure
review_body: This toy is actually a prize for the most important reason that RUSSIAN soldiers liberated Europe. I remember playing with one of these as a child in Norway and wondering what it was like to fight in battle, my father told me that Europe would be a different place if it wasn't for all the RUSSIAN soldiers who died to free it. This is a RUSSIAN soldier from the 1941-45 RUSSIAN campaign, main battles included Minsk, Smolensk, Stalingrad, Leningrad, Kharkov, etc. This is one of the best in the line and it is very durable and good for many hours of playing.

product_title: Fisher-Price Little People Lil' Movers Airplane
review_body: This toy was exactly what appealed to my one-year old grandson. He was immediately intrigued by the airplane and the little people inside. This was not a toy he needed to warm up to! He was immediately pushing it around the floor, making it take off (these little ones already know all about air travel!) and getting all the passengers out. Of course he preferred to pitch the little people around the room but he can sometimes enjoy putting them back in their seats. Highly recommended from a grandma who isn't always sure of what the little ones will enjoy.

product_title: Reaction 1/10 2wd RTR Nitro Truck SWK1280
review_body: Hello, I am 14 years old and I have always loved rc cars. I decided to step it up to Nitro rc cars, and this is my first. This car is a very good beginner car for anyone, one reason for that is the electric start feature, it is very useful. I would suggest this car for a beginner, the controls are very simple and the car goes on all kinds of terrain(road, grass, gravel, dirt, mud, and sand). I hope this helps you

product_title: VTech Kidizoom Plus Digital Camera - Blue
review_body: I gave this to my four year old granddaughter. She has been into taking pictures with her parents and my camera for a while. (of course its hold your breath everytime). Now she has her own camera that comes in a big small hands friendly hard case. It takes very acceptable photos. and my granddaughter loves it.  WELL THIS IS AN UPDATE, THE CAMERA STOPPED WORKING AFTER TWO MONTHS WE COULD NOT EVEN DOWNLOAD THE PHOTOS ON IT. tHEY WON'T LET ME CHANGE THE STARS BUT IT IS NOW A ONE!!

product_title: Big Burger Drive Thru Playhouse
review_body: It's a drive thru store. Very fun. It's large and spacious (can accommodate 2 or more small sized adults comfortably) It's kind of flimsy which is expected in this kind of products. It's very interactive which allows friends to play together. And you can put your toy register, tables, chairs and foods in the store for play if you want. You can even be creative and make it a different store by taping different ideas on the tent. I recommend it.

product_title: Spiderman Twist and Twirl Straw
review_body: Nothing special about this straw.  Definitely not worth the price!!  Especially when you realize that what you paid for shipping is 3 times the price of the straw!!!!!     [[ASIN:B000YACW8Y Spiderman Twist and Twirl Straw]]

product_title: Playhut Dora Mega House
review_body: We bought this product last year for my daughter.  She absolutely loved it.  The tent also seems durable, although we never got to test the durability too much.  Why?  Because we returned it.  Taking this tent down was awful.    The tent was very large, and we were unable to leave it set up in our daughter's bedroom.  When it came time to take it down, we could not get the \\"EZ Twist\\" tent to twist correctly to fold down right.  I had multiple people try together, following the instructions to the letter, and no luck.  It would never stay twisted correctly, so even if you twisted it down to a compact size, it would spring back out again.  After 20-30 minutes, it just became too much of a bother to deal with the thing, so we coiled it up as best we could and shoved it back in the box as it sprung apart into a twisted nightmare.  Back to the store it went.    If you're going to set it up and leave it, then I think this is a great product.  If you need to take it down frequently, I would advise against buying this.  I found it much less frustrating to take down a real tent than it was to \\"EZ twist\\" down this product.

product_title: Pittsburgh Steelers Hammer
review_headline: For the Steelers Fan Who Has Everything
review_body: My brother-in-law is a huge Steelers fan and every year I get him Steelers attire, this year I opted for a different approach.  The hammer is a nice heavy hammer, it isnt' just for looks.  I haven't asked him about it since I gave it to him, so I can't give you an update on the usefulness of this item.  But it was a good novelty gift that is also useful for the handyman.

product_title: Hornet Copter Microlite Flying Remote Control Helicopter (colors may vary)
review_body: Doesn't fly, never did, after too many attempts to count. Would love to find out the contact information for the manufacturer, although I don't hold out much hope recovering my $29.95. Just wanted send them the feelings of a disappointed 7 yr old. My feelings are unprintable for this site. I tried giving no stars, but it wouldn't let me complete my review.

product_title: Webkinz Chocolate Lab
review_body: I ordered this for my daughter for Christmas.  When we went on the website to register, we were told the secret access code had already been used and we could not register our webkin.  My daughter is very disappointed and I am now waiting to hear back from customer support at Webkinz.

product_title: Princess Luciana
review_body: My daughter loves this Barbie. It goes with her other Barbie's from the Island Princess movie. The dress is holding up well, although her shoes don't stay on very well at all. They were lost the day after we opened the box. She sings a song when you push her necklace, but unlike the Island Princess Barbie, Luciana only sings one song. Overall we've been very pleased with this purchase. The shipping was very fast from our seller.

product_title: Melissa & Doug Cutting Food
review_body: This is a really cool toy. It allows my children (two yr old son & four old daughter) to cut vegetables and other foods just as I do on my cutting board. The cutting sound (velcro) is pretty cool, too.

product_title: Playmobil Advent Calendar: "Knight's Duel"
review_body: We buy a Playmobil Advent Calendar every year.  The kids got a kick out of opening the box each day.  I especially like the knights because my son will enjoy playing with it for the rest of the year.  It's great for children from 3 to around 7 or 8--sometimes older depending on the child. (My 9 year old is now over it and no longer interested; my 6 year old is still excited to find out what's in the box each day.)  Takes a while to assemble all the boxes and put the toys in but definitely worth it.  Toys are well made.

product_title: Badge Factory
review_body: I got this to use as a Christmas present maker.  Unfortunetly it only got the badge ready to put together, but did not.  Then, the inside cracked unexpectedly, not from pressure.  You honestly should not waste your time nor money on this product.        I thought it might have been junk because of its looks...but still wanted to give it a go.  If you really want one, buy the expensive ones that last.  I really regret buying this, worst of all though, now I have to create, or in other words, buy new presents. Wish me luck!

product_title: Melissa & Doug Fairy Tale Castle Jumbo Jigsaw Floor Puzzle (48 pcs, 2 x 3 feet)
review_body: Their puzzles are awesome...the pieces go together well and they have a good finish on them and are very durable. My 3 and 5-year olds haven't been able to destroy them under constant use!    I do wish Melissa & Doug had a better policy for lost pieces though. It seems wasteful that you have to toss a puzzle after losing just one piece. I was told that pieces don't always fit 100% which is why they don't supply them, but kids wouldn't care - - they are so bummed they lost a piece to one of their puzzles!

product_title: Fisher-Price Sing-Along Activity Barn
review_body: Just got this toy in and I enjoyed playing with it!  It's REALLY much bigger than I expected.  I LOVE fisher price and their farm stuff.  This think the kiddos in the church nursery will love it and for the $8.90 I paid it was a steal!

product_title: Tangoes Junior
review_body: I bought Tangoes Jr. as a Christmas gift for my 4 year old daughter this year.  She loves it, as well as her 6 yo brother and 8 yo sister.  I was pleasantly surprised to see how sturdy the case is and that the shapes have a nice little storage compartment that slides in and out...no lost pieces yet:)  It is also a fun activity for an adult and child to play together.  My brother-in-law came over after Christmas and he and my daughter played with her Tangoes for a good while.  It was so cute to see her showing him the \\"right way to play\\".  Tangoes Jr. is both fun and educational.  I like the way it engages her motor skills as well as her thinking/problem solving skills.

product_title: Bulles Enchantees Barbie Poupee (Bubble Angel Barbie Doll) (1994 French Foreign Version)
review_body: This Barbie was given to me by my grandmother in my birthday when i was a little girl. I was looking for this Barbie forever since my wings were lost and when we moved from my childhood home the Barbie was lost. I am so excited I can't wait to have this durable lovely doll. It was the best gift I received in my entire childhood since i love fairies. I cant wait for my unborn daughter to have it! Its a lovely memory and an awesome simple toy.  -Norma Garcia

product_title: Little Tikes Sing Along CD Player with 2 Microphones
review_body: I got this for my 3 year old grandson who lives with me. He loves it and so do we. He listens to classical music every night for bedtime, and loves to sing along with other toddler CD's. It has a repeat button so he can have the music playing all night long. Its nice that it does not go up too loud too. Just loud enough.     IT does not come with an ac adapter, so if you don't want to go through a ton of batteries, pick one up.  Its nice to have both, so if your child wants to walk around with the player he or she can. Easy to use buttons as well. I recommend this product.

product_title: Melissa & Doug Wooden Shape Sorting Clock Educational Toy
review_headline: Wooden clock by Melissa and Doug
review_body: I ordered this clock for my 3 year old daughter.  I wanted to make sure she could tell time using an analogue clock, and not just a digital one.  She's having a blast with the puzzle pieces, and now her 18 month old sister is also playing with it.  It's been very durable, and it's great to watch the two of them playing with it together, singing \\"Tick tock, hickory dickory dock!\\"

product_title: Brightlings Dancers
review_body: My 7 month old received this for Christmas.  He likes the yellow one that lights up when the top is pressed, but the others are pretty boring.  The pink one has something inside that whirls, but the plastic covering is not perfectly clear, making it hard to see that it is whirling when it is pushed.  He just uses the blue one as a rattle.  (It stands up when knocked down.)  I don't recommend this.  There are better things out there.

product_title: Disney Hannah Montana Pop Star Electric Guitar
review_headline: Guitar is cute, headset has completely stupid design
review_body: I purchased this guitar and headset/mic for my 5 year old daughter. She loves the guitar; however, the headset/mic has an utterly ridiculous design, almost to the point that you wonder how it got past the common sense of whoever in the company gave it the OK.  The earpieces are shaped in an odd manner to rest on top of the ears-- whose ears, I don't know, because they are not adjustable and don't even fit over or around my 5 year old's head, so an older child would have an even harder time.  Also, they are just begging to take an eye out. ( Take a look at the pictures and you can see what I mean.)  Overall she loves this guitar, but I will tell you, every time I hear \\"Mom, the headset won't stay on, it keeps falling off!!\\"  I want to smack the designer upside the head.

product_title: Barbie Fashion Fever - 12+ Pieces Fashion Clothes (2006) Pretty in Peach L0685 - K8501
review_headline: Your being ripped off if you buy it here
review_body: I bought this exact same item at Target the other day and paid ten dollars for this particular item. Infact all the cloths that come in a twelve plus piece pack usually sells anywhere from 10 to 12 dollars. I can't believe amazon is letting consumers be so abused by someone's greed.

product_title: Giggling Elmo Hot Tomato Game
review_headline: Loads of fun for little ones
review_body: Our 4-year-old twin nieces absolutely love this game.  It's most fun with 3 or more people.  You turn on the giggles by pushing Elmo's nose, and then start tossing it to each other.  The person who is holding it when it stops giggling \\"loses\\".  Theoretically at that point the loser would leave the game, and play would continue until only one person hasn't lost, like musical chairs.  But with our girls, we just started over with the same crowd.  They were absolutely riveted.  I think they'd have played it till bedtime if we'd let them.    The game helps youngsters with their motor skills (tossing, catching) and also with learning to tolerate losing.  If you have a child who cannot bear to lose, this probably isn't a good game for you.  Everybody loses at some point in this game!  We just said, \\"Ohhhh\\" sympathetically and then started right back in.  Worked for us.    The game includes a set of cards for older kids.  When you start the game you choose a card, which has items of one color on them.  I think the rule is you have to name an item similar to the ones on the card before you can get rid of Elmo.    Two thumbs up from us. We're planning to buy two more for our other nieces!

product_title: Jirachi - Pokemon Bell Cell Phone Strap (Makes sweet sounds as it dangles) (Japanese Import) ***Free Domestic Standard Shipping For This Item!***
review_body: Advertised as a cell phone strap, but will be a nice necklace or bracelet charm. My little girl loves it and it really topped off her birthday last month. Seems to be very durable, like it can take the abuse of a 6 year old. Not crazy about the bell sound, it's a little subdued, but it was not important to me anyway. All in all, a nice way to make a kid think they have their own Pokemon they can take with them everywhere!

product_title: Fisher-Price Sesame Street Elmo's Learning Fun Laptop
review_body: My 19-month-old grandson loves to push buttons. This toy is an adorable \\"computer\\" with lots of buttons to push, changeable disks for learning while playing, and easy to carry along.

product_title: Find It! 1-2-3 Floor Puzzle
review_body: after doin this puzzle a few times, my daughter learned her numbers very quickly.. it is fun and educational

product_title: Snap Circuits R/C Snap Rover Electronics Discovery Kit
review_body: [[ASIN:B000GG7XXK Snap Circuits RC Rover]] We bought this for our 6 year old grandson.  He has another smaller set and absolutely loves it.  By following picture instruction he can quickly assemble electronic circuitry that actually performs a task.  It encourages him to experiment and gives him a sense of accomplishiment.  It's like an electronic erector set that was so popular when I was a kid.  Very good desigh and sturdily built, even the case is compartmentalized for neat storeage.

product_title: Gloomy Bear: Standing Bloody Gloomy 12" Plush (Pink)
review_body: I purchased this for my daughter as a Christmas present. She collects monster plushes (I think her interest in Pokemon evolved). She loves the Gloomy Bear. It is well build and sturdy. My only criticism is that the arms do not move independently.

product_title: Lil' Mermaid Toddler Costume - Toddler Medium
review_body: I love this costume.  It is adorable!  It's like a dress, so it's easy to slip on and off, and it's easy for my daughter to walk in.  It shipped very quickly.

product_title: Star Wars 30th Anniversary Darth Vader to Death Star Transformers HUGE Figure
review_headline: It's as cool as it looks on TV
review_body: Ok, so I put this as a 5 for educational value, only because you should get an honorary degree in physics just for figuring out how to transform this toy!  (even with the instructions!)  We have several Star Wars transformers toys, and none have been this difficult to change around, except maybe the General Grevious one...  Even the Milleniun Falcon was easier than this!  Seriously hoping we don't lose the instruction sheet that goes with this one!  In its favor, my son LOVES it, it is cool looking, but if i had it to do all over again, I really think I would have left this out, at least until my son hs a few more years on him (he's 5, might consider another toy this difficult when he's about 10-13ish)

product_title: Fisher-Price Infant To Toddler Swing in Red
review_body: Easy to set up, stable for my 10 month old. Glad we got it, he loves it.

product_title: Radica Brain Games
review_body: My child loves the 20Q product made by this company but this one has disappointed us. My 9 year old gave up on this quickly because  the simplest level 1 speed was too fast and frustrated her quickly. It's definitely aimed at adults.  I was looking for activities for my children; i.e.  hangman, math facts, recall. I took a risk on this item based on its very vague description here at amazon. I couldn't find detailed info about it anywhere on the web, nor did I find the product in any stores. It's not what I was hoping it would be.  This is our second electronic toy disappointment this Christmas morning. Now I wonder what the return policy is for products which must be forcibly extracted with a utility knife from their plastic package before you can actually find out what they are!

product_title: Warne Bros Scooby Doo wallet : Blue Trifold wallet
review_body: This is just the right size for my four year old's hands and pockets. We are able to teach him about saving money and being responsible in a cool Scooby Doo way. No complaints!

product_title: Radio Flyer 12S Classic Walker Wagon
review_headline: I thought this was American, NO it china why wasn't this in the add. Quality good. Not telling American's is fraud
review_body: With all the lead paint from China. You would think Red Flyer would place on their adds Made in china. My box had the handle missing. That shows me the quality is where. It still looks as of old Red Flyer with china paint, wood & attachments material. Nothing about the safety Well I hope someone wil test the paint!

product_title: Stage Microphone with Amplifier Disney's Hannah Montana
review_body: I was greatly disappointed in the product I received for the money I spent. But I am glad that I didn't pay the market value for it.  I can't believe this thing was selling for almost $90.00.  If you pay that much you are simply paying for the name.  It is the most cheaply constructed thing I have seen - all plastic and it doesn't appear to have much output in volume either.  That said, my daughter loves it and was thrilled to receive it for Christmas.  We didn't see her for a good couple of days.  So due to her reaction, I am glad that I purchsed it for her.  I just wish I had known more about it and maybe found something a little nicer.

product_title: Organs Slime Four Body Parts in Bright Red Goo
review_headline: its fun to play body parts
review_body: This stuff is a lot of fun. We threw it on the ceiling at work and it stuck. I highly recommend this product for the work place!

product_title: DuneCraft Super Snow SO 0066
review_body: I used super snow during a science lesson about polymers.  This particular lesson focused on some of the strange things you can do with these unusual meolecular bonds.  I was able to give students 1/8tsp of the snow powder, which is mixed with water, in a small ziplock bag.  Students shook the bags vigrously for about 2.5 minutes and they had a handful of snow.  The \\"flakes\\" are spherical and sticky and you can control the texture by slightly altering the water/powder ratio.  This experiment and one where we put a wooden skewer through a balloon were the most popular.  The students are in grades 5-8.

product_title: Sea-Monkeys Sea-Bubble
review_headline: Sea Monkeys make awesome dorm pets.
review_body: I'm a college student living in a dormitory. With classes, jobs, and other things I don't have very much time for taking care of a pet. The sea monkeys are great because they were easy on my budget, they don't violate any dorm policies, and they are EXTREMELY low maintenance. I'd recommend sea monkeys for any college kid or busy high schooler that wants a pet but doesn't have much time.

product_title: Talisman The Magical Quest Game (Version 2007)
review_body: An older buddy of mine recently introduced my friends and I to Talisman. He, being a good deal older than us (he's 36, we're 24) owns the second edition version as well as the Dragon, City, & Dungeon Expansions. When all played together, the game is beyond amazing and brilliantly complex.     Too many board games these days promise 2-4 hours of gameplay and rarely deliver. Talisman brings forth a great deal of detail, flexibility, & you'll be playing it for hours! The more players, the more complex it gets, and you can run with up to 8! That game took about 10 hours. it was AWESOME! If killing monsters, dealing with followers and the dark ages, and fantasy games are your thing, GET TALISMAN!! It'll become a great thing to do with your Friends & Family!    DO IT!! HOOHA!

product_title: Dark Ages Spawn - The Raider
review_body: My \\"The Raider\\" is a different paint scheme than the one shown here in the picture, mine is much darker, with a black body.  I LOVE this figure.  I'm a fan of the fantasy style creatures that McFarlane does and this one is pretty cool.  Because of his large hooves you can make him stand fairly easily, though he does not keep hold of his weapons all that well.  The actual figure is very sturdy and durable, though I'm not a fan of the tail (plastic fiber hairs like barbie) they either needed to make it thicker (as in more hair) or they needed to have it plastic molded.  Mine looks like he's thinning... The accessories he comes with are fragile and not for little hands to play with.  As with all McFarlane toys, this is not for children.

product_title: Interstar Rings
review_body: We bought this to compliment the other Interstar connectors and our kids love them.  Lots of neat ways to put them together.  Keeps there imaginations going.

product_title: F-16B Plus Fighting Falcon 1/72 Hasegawa
review_body: The kit has a lot of problems and I do not recommend buying it. To start with, the instructions cut a lot of corners making you frequently refer to the photos of the aircraft on the internet since the box art does not help.    The intake fits together very badly. I had to cut & sand quite a lot and tack glue pieces together. Some things (like the tail fin)  feel like they have been hacked into pieces just to give you more to do instead of give you the feeling that you are putting something together. The main & tail wings are inserted horizontally into the fuselage meaning you must use a protractor to have both wings exactly parallel to the ground. You must keep checking the wing's angle as the glue sets.    Also, do not try to fix the kit in a flying position as the doors will not shut without sanding. This is the first kit I have ever had this problem with as others are designed to allow you to choose either wheels up or down.    The missiles have very little detail & definition and when fixing them to their mounts, there is a a lot of play, making it hard to align both sides symmetrically. The same thing applies to the mounts themselves & the drop tanks.    The reason I gave it 2 instead of 1 is because I got it generously discounted. Had I paid full price for this, it would have gotten a 1.

product_title: Little Tikes Play Smarter Cook 'N Learn Kitchen
review_body: We got this kitchen for our 4 year old son who loves to help in the kitchen.  He got it yesterday and he hasn't played with anything else since.  He has made all kinds of meals and snacks for us.  It is a wonderful kitchen that encourages creative play.  We already have plenty of tools, trucks, etc and this was a nice change for him to add some diversity to his playtime.  He loves being able to \\"crack open\\" the egg and have the yolk come out.  I only wish I could find the additional food sets but they are out of stock.  I only rated the educational as 3 stars because he already knows colors, sizes, etc.  Overall this is a wonderful toy.  Thanks Little Tikes for always being a quality choice for toys!

product_title: RoseArt Glam Gear Nail Salon with 5 Stations
review_body: Not worth the money - the glitter station doesn't work very well, the fake nails don't stay on, the polish is pretty bad, and the sticker roll doesn't hold the stickers right.  But my 6 year old and my 3 year old really like it.

product_title: Nyokki-Monkey
review_body: This is a really cute product!  My daughter saw a Chia pet commercial around Christmas time and wanted it...I found these on Amazon and thought they would be a better choice for my 4 year old.  So the Easter bunny left a couple of these for my two kids.  We watered the little critter, as per instructions, but the grass never grew in all the way...a little pricey to not work.  It's still really a cute little thing and we are going to empty it and grow our own grass in it...

product_title: Matchbox Mega Rig Shark Adventure
review_body:
I bought this toy for my 3 year olds birthday. He tries to play with it mostly in the tub. It's kind of hard to play with, the pieces don't float as well as the box would make you think. Some of the parts are hard to press together to get them to snap in, and some come out too easily (this is brand new) But for him it is perfect.

The best part is the shark. It eats the diver. You have to pull him out of the sharks belly!! May sound a bit rough, but for my monster/shark/dinosaur loving 3 yr old boy, it cracks him up.

Best toy shark I've seen.

product_title: LEGO Make & Create Eiffel Tower 1:300
review_body: I've been a Lego fan since I was a child and bought this product the moment I saw it. It took about 10 hours to complete. The final product is very tall (box says 42\\" tall, but mine measured about 45\\") and absolutely beautiful.  Amazingly there was not one point in the instructions that was in any way confusing. Only difficult part of building it is digging through the 3400+ pieces to find the one you need.  For years I've wished Lego would make models of real-world skyscrapers. I guess the Eiffel Tower probably falls more into the world monument category. Either way, I look forward to more world monuments and skyscrapers in the future.  Worth every penny!

product_title: Police Officer Child Costume
review_body: The picture makes this costume look alot nicer than it is.  The sizing states small 4-6 when it is really a 6-8. It is paper thin polyester with a raw edged pant hem.  The badge is a stick-on that fell off after five minutes.  The belt and the night stick broke within a few uses.  Unfortunately the return policy of the costume company is not buyer friendly.  I will have to keep this one and lose the $30.

product_title: Girl's Padme Amidala Blaster and Holster
review_body: I purchased this for my 9 year-old daughter who is going to be Padme for Halloween. The gun works great and looks great. The belt fits well, even though she's very slim. The only downside is that the holster came off the belt almost immediately. We tried gluing it back on, but that only lasted about 3 minutes. We finally just tucked the gun into the belt and that works fine.

product_title: War On Terror Board Game
review_headline: Truth, Justice, and a Healthy Slice Of Oil-Rich Land: How WOT Can Help YOU!
review_body: The game is a well-designed product which has elements from many popular games, so picking it up is no challenge for anyone familiar with 19th Century World Domination Game, 20th Century Real Estate Robber Baron Game, Abstract German Island Game, any game involving the reading of cards, and the general concepts of lying, cheating, backstabbing, brown-nosing, bulldozing, pyromania, monomania, paranoia, politics, and pushing your superior agenda onto the rest of the world.     It can save your sanity, save your job, save your family, save your wallet, save your soul, slice, dice, mince and puree. It is great for treating obesity, diabetes, high blood pressure, high engine temperature, high pitched whines, low blood sugar, low tire pressue, low minimum checking, hypothyroidism, hyperthyroidism, superthyroidism, no-thyroidism, priapism, headaches, backaches, pancakes, seasonal affective disorder, disordered thoughts, distressed muscles, distended ligaments, decomposing vermin, deep vein thrombosis, oily skin, oil fires, fiery heartburn, and sudden onset spontaneous combustion.     There are people out there who are angered by this game's content. These are obviously people who've never looked inside the box, as the material there is so blatantly satiric it's hard for me, a guy who has just the right shade of skin to freak out airport security, to find offense. Nothing in the box explicitly targets any one politician, or any country, or any form of terrorist organization. (Terrorists depicted range from turbaned men to folk in beekeeper suits to crazy white guy survivalists nutjobs to..)     This game has been out a year, and in that year I've yet to find anyone who didn't like this game. Hell, I've had Irish Catholics and Protestants around a game, making odd alliances and going terrorist together. My favorite was a mini game between several young sons of Isaac and a few followers of Mohammad, and they were laughing at each other rather than fighting.     Maybe if thisgame were introduced to the West Bank, or Iraq, or Afghanistan, there would be less violence and more laughter.. Then again, there are soldiers in at least Iraq and Afghanistan who actually *do* play this game.     While this game is suggested for 2-6 players, the more the merrier. (I ran a few 6-man games a month ago, and the game play was wild.)     I taught the game to new players in ten minutes flat. Easy to learn, easy to play, and you get the fun of launching the occasional nuke and deploying WMDs against your enemies.

product_title: Tinkertoy Classic Jumbo Set
review_headline: Tinker toys are still great fun
review_body: My grandchildren love these Tinkertoys. They are great Lego fans so I was not sure they'd be interested.  Their ages are 5 - 10 and they all really enjoy them and are always thrilled to show off their creations.

product_title: Fisher-Price Little Superstar Sing-Along Stage
review_body: At 6 months our son is more active with this toy than he was at 5 months.  we can sit him in front of this and he will bang away on all the buttons (for a good 15 - 30 minutes without crying for mom/dad/boredom).  we like the mode where the more noise you make the more the lights flash vs the 4 or 5 songs that play continuously.  my nieces that are 3 and 4 like to play with it also.  i'd the say the value of the entertainment for the price is well worth it.  the only downside is that the legs don't fold up so it does take up room.  we have it tucked in a corner of the living room so we don't trip over it.  and sometimes we'll catch our schnauzer going up to it and looking in the mirror.

product_title: Jessica Rabbit Special Edition Doll By Disney Collectors Dolls
review_headline: Excellent likeness, well done, not very posable
review_body: This Jessica is indeed a good likeness of the movie character, but it's not very posable, just a bit of arm and head swivel, and the clothes don't come off, so you can't change her or have her posing.  At least they did give her that little bit of movement, I suppose.  She's a fun gal, just limited.

product_title: Disney Toy Story & Beyond Pull String Woody Doll Deluxe Figure with Cowboy Hat and Guitar
review_body: I got this for my 4 year old for his birthday (along with Buzz) and he loved it - until his tory story phase was over (not into Cars) and also Buzz was much cooler with the pop out wings. But little sister adores woody, hugs him and carries him around and pulls the string. So it wasnt wasted. Although he only says one phrase from the movie and there is a strange phrase about \\"hey I am lookin good\\", but other than that he is very sturdy and cute. Looks EXACTLY like the Woody from the movie.

product_title: Spinmaster Aquadoodle Rainbow Colors Mat
review_body: This is a good toy.  We gave this to my 3 year old for her birthday.  She likes the colors on the rainbow mat.  I agree with some of the other reviewers, the mister is a complete waste.  The stencils just seem to make a big blob, too.  Overall, though this is a fun toy.  My husband and I had fun with it too!

product_title: Hasbro Spider-Man & Friends Super Pal Spider-Man
review_body:
when you get poo on a beloved toy, what can you do?? head to amazon, that's what!! plus, this really is a pretty great little toy. when you need to urge you \\"not tired!\\" smallfry to bed, spidey helps you out. basically, with his blanket and sleepy demeanour, that is achieved with the flick of his well-hidden button, he helps you get said fry to bed.

pretty awesome, i think.

product_title: Learning Resources Spanish ABC Puzzle Blocks
review_body: A very fun way for the kids to learn the alphabet and vocabulary.  My son 4 and daughter 2 enjoy this very much.  I do need to sit with them and help them out because it is so many pieces.

product_title: Buzz Cola, The Simpsons Movie promo item from the Kwik E Mart!
review_headline: Sickeningly sweet (in more ways than one)
review_body: Think of RC cola crossed with Jolt. Super sweet without a lot of flavor to back it up. Looks pretty sweet on the shelf next to your Frosted Krusty O's. If only they made a Duff beer...

product_title: Be Amazing Geyser Tube
review_body: This is a must have tube for the Diet Coke, Mentos experiment. No guess work it gives you the right load without a mess.  It is a great buy and save money, buy the Fizz Factor Book along with the Geyser Tube. Loads of fun for the young and old.

product_title: Take Along Thomas & Friends - Percy and the Carnival Set
review_headline: Do not waste your money.Parts are cheaply made and product falls apart with normal play.
review_body: This toy was a waste of money and provided nothing but frustration for my six year old son as it fell apart every time he played with it. It was put together by my brother who teaches Physics and Chemistry and more mechanically inclined than me.Even he could not get this thing to stay together.    I do not understand how after the recent Thomas recalls the company is apparently not even trying to produce a better quality product.A total disapointment especially to my son who LOVES all things Thomas.

product_title: Ferret
review_body: It's a little figureine of a ferret. Anatomically, yup, it's a ferret. I don't really know what else i can say. I was a little surprised at the size, but that is my fault for not reading the description completly. If your like me, FYI, it will fit in the palm of your hand. Which is fine. I just picked it up cause my wife and I are ferret nuts, not for any real purpose

product_title: Chocolate Fix Game
review_headline: No it's not tic tac toe - but this beautiful game stands on its own...
review_body:
This toy stops people in their tracks. The chocolates are so luscious and cute, people are always curious about the game, and the first thing they ask is, \\"Is it tic tac toe?\\"

Well, no, given that there are 3 colors and not 2 but who's counting :)

In this game, you are given clues and must figure out where to place the chocolates. For example, the clue might tell you (visually, not with words) all of the chocolates in the first row are pink, and all of the chocolates in the first column are circles. You use that information to determine that the pink circle chocolate belongs in the top left space.

It is very similar to Gridworks, although not as good for travel (Gridworks uses magnets).

This game comes with a spiral notebook instead of cards like most ThinkFun games, and I really like that -- it makes for easier clean up and reduces the chance of losing/misplacing individual cards (which we often do -- we have over a dozen ThinkFun games tossed in a basket and none of them has a full deck of cards).

Well anyway, this is a beautiful little game, lots of fun to play, highly recommended.

product_title: Fisher-Price Little People A Christmas Story
review_body: A wonderful toy, but available from Toys-R-Us for $24.99 with free shipping. This merchant should be ashamed of itself for gouging like this!

product_title: Radio Flyer Wagon Canopy
review_headline: Great Addition to a great wagon
review_body: We purchased this canopy to go with our Radio Flyer wagon and we have nothing but great things to say about it.  the canopy is large and covers the entire span of the wagon.  It clips onto the sides of the wagon so for the tool challenged, it is great.  I love the fact that you can lean the canopy forward or backwards depending on the direction of the sun.  My girls love it and think they are riding in a chariot.

product_title: Batman Begins Trifold Wallet
review_body: And by \\"even better than expected\\", I am talking about my nephew's reaction. This was a fairly inexpensive gift that was given in addition to a pirate sword that lit up and made noises and a Lego set. Guess which gift got the most attention? The wallet. This was a gift for my nephew's 4th birthday and he was so excited to have a wallet like his father and that it had Batman pictures on it was even better. If you're buying for a young Batman fan, this will probably go over very well.

product_title: G.I. Joe: Mission Set - Mantis Mech 2.5"
review_body: My 7 year old son really likes GI Joe, so when he received a DragonHawk for Christmas, he was eager to save up for accessories to go with it.  He bought the Mantis and enjoys that as much as the DragonHawk.  Good purchase; a lot of fun.

product_title: Mio Pup White/Pink
review_body: My 4 year old has been pining for one of these for months. She loves it. We've only had it since Christmas but so far it has given her lots of entertainment. I agree with the other reviewers that the Mio Pup manufacturers should offer bone replacements. In all actuality, there's not much to the thing really. It talks, sings, and interacts with the child. It would be up to the individual child as to how much actual entertainment value Mio Pup brings them. But overall, it's a pleasing design, not so robotic looking as the last few years of electronic animals. Brilliant bit of marketing to design robots to appeal to females in what had previously been a male dominated toy field. My 4 year old now says she wants to grow up to be a \\"Mio Pup Designer\\".  I would have given this toy a \\"5\\" if the manufacturer was kind enough to offer replacement parts. I gave Mio Pup a lower educational value rating because while the toy does foster imaginative play and memory (non-reading children must memorize the icons to know what the dog is feeling) it offers little else development wise.

product_title: Folkmanis Mini Monarch Butterfly Finger Puppet
review_headline: My special needs daughter LOVED this!
review_body: This is a beautiful large butterfly puppet that fit perfectly - stays in place well. Great to use in read-along butterfly stories. My special needs daughter, who is non-verbal loves this butterfly! It lights up her face each time.

product_title: VTech Whiz Kid Learning System
review_body: I gave the VTech WhizKid Learning System to my niece's son for his birthday.  She told me that it really holds his attention and he really loves it.  She believes that he will ues it for years to come. I give this toy 5 stars.

product_title: PlayTV Baseball 3
review_body: My just-turned-5-year old is a baseball fanatic, so after reading the reviews I purchased this game for his birthday.  He LOVES it - he prefers this game over the Xbox baseball high-tech graphics games.  The interaction is key.    He has difficulty with the timing as it is not the same as \\"real\\" baseball or with the higher-technical games, but he has adjusted.  He has thrown the bat accidentally a couple of times while hitting, and it still works fine.    My 14-year-old also enjoys this game.  Not as much as the 5-year-old, but they have fun playing against each other.        UPDATE 8/17/08:  We have now owned this a year, and it just broke/stopped working.  My very-soon-to-be 6 year old plays it A LOT, so he will be getting a new one for his birthday.    We also own a Wii and have 2 baseball games (my son is a baseball freak), and he plays those games, as well.  All three games (two Wii games and this one) are played about equal in time (only when the weather is bad or it's dark outside, cuz he'll be outside playing baseball if he can).

product_title: Smush Bush
review_body:
I bought this little guy because it seemed safer to throttle a piece of foam than ... well, anyone I know. Besides, I do a lot of typing, and squishing a foamy toy is good for the tendons, I've been told.

He fits the bill very well -- feels great to squish, smish, gouge, and likewise abuse, and he's too small to do any damage if you throw him. He does come apart fairly easily, but that's not necessarily a bad thing; if you've just got to rip his head off, it's satisfying to have it just come off without arguing. I may have to stock up ...

product_title: DR. JEAN AND FRIENDS CD
review_body: I am a preschool teacher and my students LOVE Dr. Jean! I use the days of the week, months of the year, and weather songs for calendar-they absolutely love these songs. I have most all of DR. Jean CD's and use them daily! The kids ask to sing her songs!

product_title: Melissa & Doug African Plains Safari Jumbo Jigsaw Floor Puzzle (100 pcs, over 4 feet long)
review_body: We love all Melissa and Doug puzzles!  The quality of the pieces as well as the pictures are excellent.  These are puzzles we always plan on keeping to pass down to the next generation.

product_title: Winning Moves Pass the Pigs Classic Party Game
review_body: This is a really cute game if you're looking for something casual.  It's small and portable and can be played by anyone who can count.  I would definitely reccomend this to anyone who likes to have games around to play with friends or family.  You can play it in 10 min if that's all you have, or play it over and over again for hours.

product_title: Classic Wooden Mancala Game Board
review_body: This Mancala board is great.    To summarize quickly:  \\"This board is excellent quality. It has an aged look that makes it seem more like a piece of art than a gaming board. Quality wood and quality paint work that doesn't look like it was stamped out by a machine assembly line. The pouch which holds the manacala stones is a great additive which adds to the overall look of his manacal board\\"    It looks a little more aged than the picture does which I think is appropriate for a game that has been around since BC.    The board itself looks to be made of actual wood. Not sure what kind but it definitely isn't that cheap plastic wood that you usually see nowadays.    The locking mechanism they speak of is just a pouch with a leather strap that is intertwined around the top. The pouch is also attached to the top of the board.    The board is also appropriately sized and the slots are as well    When they described the locking mechanism I though it would be a compartment on the side of the board. I was slightly dissapointed to learn it was only a pouch.    The pouch is sturdy and it adds to the overall aged look. Hung on the wall it looks like a piece of art.

product_title: Deluxe Magicians Magic Hat with Tricks: Perfect Gift Idea for the Little Magician Ages 4 & up!
review_body: I have a 4 years son, the stuff its just not what i hoped. Is a good quality hat, also the rabits and the cards but the idea of magic itself its far away from fun.  I actually have to make the tricks to him, its dificult to him to repeat.     There are just 4 kinda-good \\"Tricks\\", the others are useless.    Also my son got bored in like 20 min after he opened.  For the price i could buy a better Hat with a nice Bunny.     I REALLY DONT RECOMMEND THIS STUFF, go get some action figures or outdoor plays.    $40 for 20 min, dont work for me!

product_title: The Settlers of Catan
review_body: Settlers is a great game, we really enjoy playing it with our family and friends. Everyone we teach it to seems extremely bored with the list of rules at first, but once they play it once, they are begging to come over and play it more. The rules are somewhat complicated in the beginning, but after playing the game several times, everything makes perfect sense. A great game that actually requires some strategy and thinking.

product_title: 1 1/2" Smile Face Stickers
review_body: These stickers are small and cute, just the right size to put on my child's toy van. They are yellow smileys with a little pizazz - they are shiny and are shaded from yellow to a peachy-pink. As far as rating them for educational value and durability - they tear easily like any non-plastic sticker and they don't really have any educational value unless you want to use them while explaining the history of the smiley face in the '60s.

product_title: Zapf Creation Baby Chou Chou 14" Ethnic Doll
review_body: I love this doll.  I got for my 1 year old daughter who plays with her all the time.  She loves to try to put the pacifier in/out of the baby's mouth.  The only thing I wish was that the doll had hair, but all-in-all great doll.

product_title: Guillotine
review_headline: not a comment on the game
review_body:
The shipping for this game is a hefty $5.45.
Very disappointing considering the box is not large at all.
So, really you get no savings on the game.

product_title: Thomas and Friends Ready Bed with Battery Pump
review_body: [[ASIN:B000YTDUJA Thomas and Friends Ready Bed with Battery Pump]]    This product is perfect for our 3-year-old who is now too big for his travel cot.  He slept well all night and the zipped up sleeping bag attached to the base meant he didn't roll out or get cold.  We put his comforter on top as it was a chilly night and he was very cosy.  We inflated it a month ago and just threw it in the car to come home.  It hasn't lost any air....we'll probably just leave it up until next time!

product_title: Nintendo Luigi 12" Plush Toy Stuffed Animal
review_body: I bought both Mario Brothers for my Three year old who is obsessed with watching her brother play Super Mario Galaxy.  She loves these toys and uses her imagination to bring Luigi and Mario to life.  Great toys, not as durable as you would think though, the suspenders on both dolls have become unattached, but with a needle and thread they are good as new.  If your a gamer who wants a collectable or have a child who is just obsessed, these are really great toys.

product_title: Flower Tin Tea Set
review_headline: nothing lasts forever no matter how wonderful
review_body: This is a great play set because it does not break like ceramic or china. My kids like to put water (and real tea) in them for tea, and well, metal does rust. So, it may not last forever but it sure is fun.

product_title: Answer Me Buddha
review_body:
I purchased Answer Me Buddha for my brother, the ultimate boy-trapped-inside a monk's body. He's a grown man who practices a zen lifestyle, but still has childlike tendecies and pasttimes. He absolutely loves Answer Me Buddha, perhaps because of the clever answers it gives or perhaps because it reminds him of the Magic 8 Ball he played with when he was a boy.

This product is fun, offers silly responses like, \\"Look to the lotus\\" and \\"Bend with the wind.\\"

It appears to be very well made and its smooth, marble-looking appearance means it can sit on any shelf and still look good. Across the room, it looks like a statue, not a toy.

product_title: No-Spill Bubble Whistle Diego
review_body: This is not like Little Kids other No Spill toys.  This is not \\"No-Spill\\"  There is a little door that needs to be open to use it, and when not in use it needs to be closed and what 3-4 year is going to remember to close it?  it doesn't even work well, you only get a few tiny bubbles before it needs to be refilled.  I have called and sent an email to Little Kids and there has been no reponse.

product_title: Hooked On Phonics Hip-O's Menu Match
review_body: First let me say I love games where kids are learning something and having fun at the same time. I think the concept behind this game is great, but the problem falls in the letters. The idea is to flip the cards over and match the picture with the letter, but the letters are written in such a funky way on the cards, it makes it hard for a preschooler who is just learning letters to recognize them!! There are so many loops & tails on the letters, there were a few I really had to look at to figure out what they were. I did contact the company though and they said that the hooked on phonics people were already aware of this and changing the letters in the next production!!  They did also send me out free of charge a copy of one of their other games (roll and read, which had the same letters!!) Anyways, my suggestion would be to check and make sure this is the \\"new production\\" before you purchase, or you will be taping your own letters on the cards like I did.... I still give it 4 stars, because once it is fixed I think it is a good choice.

product_title: Banzai - DVD Betting Game
review_body:
Already a fan of the show, I received this game as a gift for Christmas and we havn't stopped playing it since. I does not matter if you have seen the show or not, it is so funny and addictive that everyone around wants to get involved.

The game play goes by fast enough to keep all entertained and seems to be designed to get everyone involved in playing. I recommend that this game be played by people 13 years of age and older because of some of the content.

product_title: Fisher-Price Geotrax Rail and Road System Grand Central Station
review_body: [[ASIN:B001111YUM Geo Trax - Grand Central Station w Bonus DVD & EXTRA Car and Figure - Rail & Road System Playset - Fisher-Price]] My 3 year old Great Nephew loves it. I got it as a birthday present for him and he couldn't wait to get home to set it up.

product_title: Manhattan Toy Groovy Girls Troop Groovy Accessories, Drowsy Dreamer
review_body: I am satisfied with what I purchased.    My granddaughter really plays with it a lot.

product_title: Cube World Series 2: Handy & Dusty
review_headline: Great for "wh" ?'s for kids with autism! :0)
review_body: Our son who is autistic is really taken with these cubes. We were able to get him to talk about the stick figures antics which is an accomplishment for a child with autism.  He'd narrate what they were doing...and answer lots of \\"wh\\" ?'s which impressed his therapists.  We never know what will tickle his funny bone and have wasted money on things he doesn't even blink at.  We bought these on a whim...(we had a store credit and they were on sale....) not expecting much but we were pleasantly surprised at his positive response.  He would just belly laugh at their antics.(Handy and Dusty do lots of boy stuff...fart, go to the potty, fight with each other etc...)  He didn't care that they often repeated what they did...in fact I think that aspect added a positive for him.  For adults..these cubes would probably get tiresome very quickly...but for kids with autism and other issues..they are a hit.  I think even \\"typical\\" kids would enjoy them.  I also like that this is a small compact toy that doesn't take up much space.  Easy to take in the car so if he is antsy he has something to focus on.  So...they may not meet other people's needs...but they have sure filled a niche with us.  We will be buying lots more slowly and using them as rewards for positive behaviors.
