Hope this helps someone! :0)

product_title: Reagan with Brown Hair and Brown Eyes
review_body: My 3-year old daughter loves Reagan.  She has an adorable face and nice hair.  It's great to find a baby like this that isn't stiff.  My only complaint is the connection area of her head and arms to her body - not so cute.  We can only get her clothes that cover those areas - no sleeveless dresses for this girl!

product_title: Disney Enchanted Tales Musical Carousel Coach Playset
review_body: It looks great but the kid cannot move the horse attached with the carousel.The horse remains stationary when the carousel spins slowly while the music plays.It would have been better if the horse could be moved along with the coach with the princess.

product_title: Toy Water Pump
review_body: The water does pump, but it doesn't go very far out.  Not much fun for little boys who love big splashes.  You have to pump really hard to get water to move and a lot of it runs right back out the bottom.  It hasn't broken yet, but then again, they don't play with it much because it doesn't work very well.  We were all disappointed.

product_title: Transformers Nightwatch Optimus Prime
review_body: This is a fun toy!  Easy to change from truck to robot to truck.  Not recommended for little kids 6 and under.

product_title: Melissa & Doug Take-Along Tool Kit
review_headline: a very nice and creative toy thaat is a lot of fun for my kids
review_body: A great toy, my kids enjoy playing with it.  The colors and the way its built is great and it is comfortable to take from place to place

product_title: Red Power Ranger to Legendary Lion -  Power Rangers Morphin
review_body: I bought this Power Ranger for a 5 year old kid and he loved it. It was a great purchase!!!!

product_title: NASCAR Kellogg's Monte Carlo
review_body: These cars have a great wind-up mechanism that is individually replaceable.  The cars are also very lightweight, which is great because they can go very fast.  That way we don't end up with dented furniture, with the side benefit of the car just bouncing off of whatever it hit.  These are spectacular cars.

product_title: Silverback Gorilla Cuddlekin 12" by Wild Republic
review_body: This gorilla is more life-like and realistic than most stuffed gorillas. My daughter loves it.

product_title: Little Tikes Scribblet
review_body: My kids love this scriblet, the fight over it so I got them more! They bring them everywhere and are always doodling on it. I would recommend them to everyone.

product_title: MGA Zapf Creation Baby Born, Mommy Look I Can Swim Doll
review_body: This was a christmas present and my 5 yr old loves her.  All three of our kids have had lots of laughs in the tub watching this doll swim in circles!  I hope chlorine doesn't bother her because I think swimming in a larger area like a pool will be even more fun.  But in the meantime she seems durable and has been lots of fun to play with.

product_title: Reagan with Blonde Hair and Blue Eyes
review_body: This doll is very durable.  I bought this for my 3 1/2 year old daughter and she can brush her hair and clothe her with ease.    Also - if your child likes to have multiple outfits for this doll - don't waste your money on expensive doll clothes - she fits preemie clothes perfectly!!  You can find these at Babies R' Us and Walmart for a lot cheaper.

product_title: TOMY Gearation Building Toy
review_body: It was my son's favorite toy from age one to six. Great for coordination. I bought an amuzement park too. We bought him Snap Circuit when he was six and he finally stopped playing with gears, but still couldn't give it away. He was sitting on it, stepping on it, but it kept working. Great toy! All our older kids played with it too.

product_title: Super Mario Brothers Yoshi Green 10 inches Plush
review_headline: Excellent item for a Mario fan!
review_body: Product is very big and super comfy.  A must have for any Mario/Yoshi collector and fan alike!

product_title: Little Tikes Beach Ball Sprinkler (88 Inches) (Colors May Vary)
review_headline: God idea but didn't have good luck.
review_body: I was hoping this was going to be a hit but the kids didn't care for it.  Also it never moved around like it was supposed to.  We ended up tossing it out.  Regular sprinkler was more fun for the kids.

product_title: Fisher-Price Laugh & Learn Learning Toolbench
review_body: I've read a lot of reviews on this item.  Still in the box it is in Demo mode, therefore doesn't play the entire alphabet, like many toys when you take it out you pull a little tab, and it plays in full mode.  I just bought this for my daughter tonight and am going to give it to her for Christmas.  She's 22 months old and I was about to wrap it when I decided to let her play with it for a few minutes.  She went crazy trying to pull the hammer out of the box to hit the buttons.  She was so excited to see the lights and get it to make noise.  Even in demo mode she was thrilled with it!  Usually she gets bored more quickly than she did with this toy, and it's still in the box!  I'm so excited to take it out for her Christmas morning!

product_title: Gazillion Bubbles Ariel Motorized Bubble Blower
review_body: This is a fun and simple toy.  Keeps a child occupied for a while and easy to use.  Not a whole lot of educational value, but activity while they chase the bubbles.

product_title: Aurora Plush Baby 6" My Photo Safari Carrier with Sound
review_headline: Wow!  Wow!  Wow!  I cant wait to buy the others
review_body: I bought this for my 10month old after a trip to the zoo.  She has carried that silly car around for the last six months.  The animals are a perfect size for her little hands.  As a teacher I love the animal names stitched onto each animal.  I think the noises on the giraffe and hippo could be more realistic... but this is a baby toy and my daughter doesnt seem to mind.    I gave durability a four only because my daughter has worn the batteries out of the elephant (It is her favorite because grandpa makes that noise with her).  However, in saying that, I called the company up and told them that I could not replace the batteries (they are stitched inside the animal) and they are shipping me out a free replacement.  Very excellent customer service.    I just found out there are three or four other sets of these toys.  We will be getting the rest for our daughter for Christmas this year.  I wish I could give them to her now!!!    ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~  UPDATE - My daughter is now 2 1/2.  I cannot explain how wonderful of an investment these sets of toys are to us.  We have spent many HOURS playing and pretending and acting.  We have most of the animal sets.  She still plays with them to this day as well as her 7.5 yo sister.  I would also increase the durability to 5 stars as we have had NO problems with any of the animals in any set.  Enjoy.

product_title: The New Touch: A Game of Sensory Perception & Memory
review_body: I purchased this game for my 6 year old daughter for Christmas. Everyone wanted to play it. Age is no advantage here. This game is fast paced, different every time and totally fun.   All these random pieces are in the dome,you spin for a card to see what you need to find, the timer is set and you have to feel(not look)for the pieces on your card as well as the pieces on your opponents cards. You have to have all the pieces on the card to keep the card, otherwise your opponent may find the last piece and get to keep your card. My kids love this game, their friends love this game and all the adults visiting us at Christmas loved this game.  In addition, there are multiple expansion sets when you need more challenge which hasn't happened yet for us.  GREAT GAME!

product_title: Creativity for Kids Fiber Fashion Studio
review_body: I bought this toy for my Goddaughters, ages 9 and 7.  It seemed pretty impressive with everything it contained.  But, the loom broke immediately, we were never able to use it, and I believe the crochet hooks and knitting needles are way too small to learn on, especially for a child.  I think you would be better off buying larger hooks and getting a beginner pattern.  This just frustrated them and me.

product_title: Lauri Peel and Stick by Numbers - Dinosaurs
review_body: This is a great product and makes beautiful pictures.  It's so helpful for kids that can count and put the correct sticker on the correct number.  It's a nice quiet and educational toy.  The end result is beautiful and encouraging for the creator.

product_title: Micro Chem XM5000
review_body: This is the first chemistry set purchased for my 8-year old grandson.  He is thrilled with it, and can't wait to try every experiment available. Of course, as with any chemistry set, it does require adult supervision, which is a good thing, and as a side benefit it allows some dad-and-son bonding time without the distraction of a 3-year old brother. I would highly recommend this as a beginner's set for a responsible child.

product_title: Forum Novelties - Genie Lamp Accessory
review_body: Thank you so much.  Product was just what I needed, and the transaction was problem and worry free.   Thanks again!

product_title: Bratz Big Babyz The Movie Crazy Karaoke Jade
review_body: I gave this to my 7-year-old niece as a birthday present (it's what she asked for).  It's really cute.  She moves as she's dancing, though, and falls off the edge of the table if you aren't watching her.  The sound is good.  The little karaoke machine that comes with it for the person to sing along is kind of cheap but it's okay.  Overall, it was a good buy.

product_title: LeapFrog Fridge Phonics Magnetic Alphabet Set - Styles May Vary
review_body: My 2 year old son got this as a gift and loves it.  In less than a week, he was able to recognize almost all of the letters and now, after 3 months he is remembering sounds of the letters.  He still gets a little confused once in a while, but for the most part he knows just about all the letters and sounds.  This is probably one of the few toys that he plays with every single day.  It keeps him entertained while I cook or do dishes, or am tending to his baby brother.  He likes to bring me the letters and tell me what they are and what sound they make, and then he places the magnet into the slot and listens to the little song.  He is always so proud when he gets it right.  I have never been so impressed with a toy.  Definitely worth having all those magents on the fridge.  Also, they are much safer than the old fashioned letters I had when growing up.  The magnet is covered so no worries of swallowing magnets.  A nice durable toy that will provide much entertainment.

product_title: Brightlings Exploration Station
review_body: This is a great buy! Both my 18 month old and my 29 month old Love this toy! I thought it looked a little girly but both my boys dont mind! Almost every part is interactive and does something! Very fun learning toy!

product_title: Ikki Tousen Ryomo Shimei Pvc Figure
review_body: This Kanu figure is a piece of art. It's so beautiful, well made, and beautifully colored. I love it! It does look like the pictures displayed and it comes in a really nice box.

product_title: 7-Eleven Slurpie Maker
review_body: I purchased the Slurpee Maker for my daughters 6th birthday.  Use the instructions and you will have great success with the Slurpee Maker.  The only delay I had in making the Slurpee was the ice canister didn't turn on the first attempt.  Checked the directions...  followed them and had the first Slurpee ready in 5 minutes.  The maker works fine, cleans up easy but only makes around 12 to 15 ounces at a time.

product_title: Bob the Builder - Take Along Lofty Multi
review_headline: Good toy for Bob the Builder fans
review_body: My son loves his Bob the Builder toys.  His toys take a lot of abuse, and this one is durable.

product_title: Fisher Price Light Sketcher
review_body: I bought 2 of these for each of my 4yr old (going on 5) twin boys.  I think I play with it more than they do!  They like using the stensils.  Other reviews were annoyed by the flashing lights.  We don't even notice the lights.  Just use a different setting and the lights stop if you don't like them.  Would HIGHLY recommend.

product_title: Learning Curve Bob the Builder - 12 in. Soft & Cuddly Nightlight
review_body: Doll looks soft and cuddly.  The flashlight really works.  My 3 yr old daughter is thrilled that she will be giving this to her little brother for his 1st birthday.  Only worry is will she actually let him play with it or is she going to keep it for herself.  :)

product_title: Rock Tumbler
review_body: I bought 2 of these one for myself and one for my grandaughter, both have stopped within the 2nd step and required alot of re-starts.  It is also makes so much noise you can hear it throughout our home.

product_title: Crayola 3 Ct Washable Tadoodles Crayon Buddies
review_body: When I heard that the TaDoodles had won a design award, I assumed they had been tested among children and parents. I just brought the crayons and markers home tonight. After tearing apart the packaging to get them out I was extremely disappointed with the fact that the crayons fall out. I will be calling Crayola and returning the crayons. The markers work fine, but until my son figures out how to turn them upside down he'll have a lot of marker on his hands.

product_title: Cars: Doc Hudson
review_headline: A Car For the Old Timers.
review_body: Doc Hudson is my favorite character from CARS.  This toy version of Doc is a must have. It's incredibly detailed, right down to the miniature red \\"hornet\\" written along the grey stripe to the hubcaps on the wheels.  The quality of the metal is also quite durable and can stand up under a great deal of playing time.  A great gift for any fan of CARS. Highly recommended.

product_title: EyeClops Bionic Eye Multizoom, Green
review_body: I bought this toy for my 4 year old son. I took it out of the box, set it up to the tv and my son went to exploring different things in the house. Everything he could find to bring out and explore up close. He checked out everything from his own skin and hair to pennies and carpet. He uses this thing still. If a 4 year old can use without any further assistance, I think anyone can!! This toy magnifies so close to your skin you can even see veins through your skin if the veins sit up high, not deep down ones. very cool educational toy!!

product_title: Killer Bunnies and the Quest for the Magic Carrot; Blue Starter Deck
review_body:
I randomly came across this game as I was at an obscure game shop looking for \\"Ticket to Ride,\\" (another excellent game, I might add), and I just laughed looking at the box. What an odd title for a game! I love bunnies, so I just bought the game hoping that it would be fun.

Well, my husband, my mom, and I spent a few hours figuring out how to play it, and when we figured it out, we had so much fun that we played it multiple times a day for 3 days straight.

Our friends come over all the time to play it, and they say that they are addicted.

It is very very difficult to figure it out yourself for the first time, but once you get it, it's really quite easy. It's easy to teach to others and pick up if you are playing with someone who knows what they're doing.

If you like to laugh at nothing and like to have fun with friends, then this is the game for you.

product_title: Learning Resources - Smart Snacks Set Amazon Exclusive
review_headline: Hours and hours of creative play
review_body: I finally had to breakdown and get this for my 3 year old after she played with it at numerous friends' houses. This is an absolute must for preschoolers who love pretend play. She plays with it in the kitchen (bakes the cupcakes), but also separates the pieces for tea parties, picnics, etc. (her favorite type of pretend play at the moment). And as she has gotten older, she identifies the shapes, numbers and colors. Soon I think it will help her learn to spell the colors. This is a great toy that works on many levels. Very durable as well--better than most pretend food that come with kitchen sets. My only wish is that the ice cream came with more cones (comes with 8 \\"scoops\\" of ice cream, but only 2 cones--makes it hard to share with friends sometimes). A great value to buy all together--I had bought the cookies separately, but a couple months later ended up getting the others anyway and ordered this set (was pretty much the same price as buying ice cream & cupcakes separate and this way we got another jar of cookies as well).  The perfect present for a 2 or 3 year old--but older kids who love to play in the kitchen will love it too.

product_title: Deluxe Magic Set
review_body: I think we found a great gift for our budding 7 year old cousin. He was quite taken with the magic set. It was very complete and nicely packaged. It has a wide array of tricks and seems easy to follow. The pieces seemed like they would \\"last\\". Of course he has just received this so hopefully some magic shows are to follow. But he was excited at the prospects.

product_title: Cinderella Costume Girl - Toddler 3-4T
review_body: We bought this item as a gift for our 3 1/2 year old niece for this past Christmas.  She tried it on for us as soon as she opened it and the dress and accessories came as described.  I had just wished that since we paid more for this particular brand over others that it would've been of better quality material and more durable-looking to withstand multiple changes.  The main thing is that she loves it!  Overall, we're very happy we went with this choice for a 3 1/2 year old girl.

product_title: Color Creativity Set 82 Pieces
review_headline: I bought this for a college student
review_body: I first saw this at a different site, when I went back it was gone. I bought it here because I could not get out to buy it at a local store.  Later I saw it for a lower price but overall I am happy with the art kit  as my college student grand daughter has just decided she likes art. This is a good way for her to practice.

product_title: Fisher-Price Sing-Along Activity Barn
review_body: I highly recommend this product. It is so cute and has a lot of activities for the child. This could be a favorite for a long time for a child as it doesn't seem like it would get too boring for kids probably up to age 2 1/2 or 3 years old.

product_title: Puzz 3D Cinderella's Castle
review_body: My daughter was very excited to get this toy and it turned out to be garbage.  This has got to be one of the worst produced puzzle ever.  The included instructions say to remove all pieces with red dots on them as they are \\"unnecessary\\".  After spending an hour and and a half removing these puzzle pieces, as many of the red dot pieces were attached to \\"good\\" pieces, we ended up with a pile as big as the \\"good\\" pile!  My daughter and I decided to try anyway, but after a while, it was clear there was something very wrong and we were missing a lot of pieces.  The worst part of this experience was how disappointed my daughter was.

product_title: DuneCraft Windowsill Greenhouses Desert Hothouse
review_body:
I've had the desert hothouse for about a week and a half. The directions were easy to understand, although the sand and gravel doesn't look much like it does in the example picture. I only \\"planted\\" about half of the seeds, expecting to have to add more if the majority didn't germinate. Much to my surprise, after a week and a half, I count at least ten little cacti and one or two succulents already springing to life! I'm very excited that they're doing so well, although I realize that it will probably take at least six months before they look like anything resembling what you see in a store or greenhouse. I have it in an east-facing windowsill, which the plants seem to like quite well.

The downside: this is a wet hothouse, plus the plastic has the imprint of windows and beams on it, making it completely impossible to view the cacti unless the plastic is removed. Since it's kind of hard to remove the plastic without jarring the plants inside, this project is less like a \\"view every day and see the results\\" project, it's more like a \\"view every couple of weeks so as not to bother the growing plants\\" project. Small children may get bored or frustrated, especially since they won't even be able to peer inside for a glance at the sprouts. Still, I'm very pleased with what's happened so far and I look forward to more growth!

About me: I'm an amateur gardener with no children. This was for me, not for any kids :)

product_title: Mario Bro: Yellow Star Keychain/Toy + Pin
review_body: My son likes it enough to probably never let it go, but it's a keychain and my son doesn't have any keys yet. It's very durable and cute though.

product_title: Bucket of Buddies
review_headline: Can't keep my older daughter out of them!!
review_body: I bought these for my son (then 4.5) last Christmas and I bought my daughter (6.5 at the time)a bucket of regular Knex.  Well within a week dd was begging ds to play with his Knex box and they both still play with them daily a year later.  I ended up buying another bucket plus another kit because they love Kid Knex so much.  Dd and ds rarely touch the regular Knex because they have so much fun with the kid version.  They come with cool eyes and wings and shapes and the kids love to make all different kinds of creations with them.  I am now back on ebay to buy a couple more bins of these because the kids are fighting over the pieces again because they want to build so many things!

product_title: Discovery Exclusive Radio Control Wicked Toy Plane
review_body: The wing fell off the plane immediately.  They are held on by a mere piece of tape.  Never even got off the ground.  Waste of money.

product_title: Classic Chess Set - Walnut Wood Board 12 in
review_body: This chess set has a nice finishing, the pieces have good size(although they don't weight too much).I use the set to replay games i do on my excalibur portable chess computer.For the price it is a good deal.

product_title: DC Direct Japanese Import Collection 3 - Batgirl
review_body:
Finally.... a Batgirl action figure with the costume she started out with.
\\"Yamato Toy\\" import of excellent workmanship and detail. A must for any true Batman collector.

product_title: Small World Toys All About Baby (Tip-Up Bottle & Cup) 12
review_body: My daughter wanted a bottle for her doll, and I remembered these \\"magic\\" bottles from my childhood.  They are just as I remembered them, magic enough for children but with some amusing side effects as the fluids flow up the narrow walls.  Fine for kids, and my daughter loves them.  A nice touch that they come as a milk and juice set.      Absolutely fine for the price, recommended.

product_title: Ideal Solid Wood Domino Trays
review_body: We enjoy playing the tile game Spinner.  These tile trays make playing a lot easier and fun.  If you have younger children these trays would be great.  You aren't always knocking your tiles over. I already have purchased more trays.

product_title: Cinderella Princess Dress with Wondercharms Necklace - size X-LARGE (7-9)
review_body: My 5 year old granddaughter loves her cinderella dress. I would suggest ordering the slip to go with it to make it fuller. She has one, and loves it with the slip.

product_title: Capsela 400 - MX Trooper
review_body: I bought this toy for my 6-year old son as I had a Capsula set when I was his age.  When we opened it up one of the capsule's was broken, not a big deal but then they didn't mate up tightly, the switch didn't always make good contact and the list goes on.  I can honestly say that I would not buy another one of these to expand the set.

product_title: 2-in-1 Vacuum
review_body: i purchased this vacume for my 3 yr old son. i shopped around trying to find a nice vacume and something that wasn't girly cause little boys like to play with stuff like this too. it is a little misleading because it doesn't suck that well but he still plays with is and enjoys it i would reccomend it to anyone

product_title: Toons Wooden 3 Piece Table and Stool Set
review_headline: Wonderful for a car loving little boy
review_body: Our son LOVES cars and trucks.  We purchased this set for him and it has provided hours of fun.  The center section for storing little cars is perfect and he loves to do everything at this table from coloring to eating a snack.  It was super easy to assemble and good quality.

product_title: One Dozen (12) Rubber Ducky CHINESE DUCKS Party Favors
review_headline: These ducks are a happy set.
review_body: I bought these on a lark.  They are adorable.  They fit in your palm. I am keeping most of them, but I have given some away too.  They bring a smile to everyone.  I am ordering more.

product_title: PERFECTION
review_body: We had this game when my kids were little.  It got used a lot, but proved to be very durable, and was exciting and competitive.  I was surprised at how even young kids can enjoy and master the shapes and the time constraints.

product_title: VTech Kidizoom Plus Digital Camera - Blue
review_headline: Hope that yours doesnt break... It takes 4+ months to get a replacement from VTECH!
review_body: My 3 year old son received this as a christmas gift.It broke... I mean broke (whole thing shut down) several hrs later.  Mailed it back to VTECH and we STILL have not received the replacement... seems they have been out of restock inventory for more than 3 months... funny since if you walk into any Target or Walmart in the country, you will find it on their shelves.    I would not recommend this product based on the lousy customer service from VTECH.

product_title: LEGO QUATRO My First QUATRO Set
review_body: My two-and-a-half year old and my seven month old both love these blocks.  My mom gave my oldest a bin of them for Christmas last year and he plays with them often.  I bought this set so there would be more for him to build with.  If your kids are older than two, you might want to skip straight to the Duplos (which my two year old also has and likes), but the large size of the Quatros makes them perfect for little hands.  My seven month old obviously doesn't build with them yet, but he loves to play with them and chew on them and I don't mind because there are no small pieces.  And, as another reviewer mentioned, the quatros have the rounded corners where the duplos are square with pointed corners.  One thing to note... Lego says that their three block types -- Quatro, Duplo, and Lego -- all interlock, but the Quatros and Duplos we have don't really interlock.  You can kind of stack them together, but not build anything structurally sound (the quatros will usually 'stick' in on top of the duplos if you work at it, but not vice-versa).  It doesn't matter to me because we usually only have out one set or the other, but if you were wanting them for that purpose, you might want to just buy all the same kind.  In any case, I am really happy with these and glad I was able to purchase this set to add to our existing one.

product_title: Taboo For Kids
review_body: As one who really had fun playing the Taboo for adults game, I wanted this for the playroom we have for our granddaughters. I didn't realize it takes four players, and I paid more than I thought I would, but I think it's going to be something we'll all enjoy with them.

product_title: Sudoku Jr 4X4 by Thinkfun
review_body: Suduko Jr. is a wonderful educational game that children can do by themselves.   There are 4 levels of challenges and over 40 cards to do. It is magnetic and holds all the numbers and cards neatly in a small self contained box.  It's durable, quiet and well organized.  It teaches reasoning and logic.  My two girls ages 4 and 6 love to do this activity.  I even bought one for their classroom.  Great product!!

product_title: Bella Dancerella Disney Princess Dance Studio
review_body: I bought this for my niece for her 4th birthday.  She wanted to play with it that first night and she loved it - as did her 5 year old sister.  They have had Bella Dancerella products in the past and their Mom thought this version was great!  Both girls are still enjoying this on a daily basis.

product_title: Melissa & Doug Deluxe Wooden Ramp Racer Game
review_headline: Other wood car sets don't fit track.
review_body: I purchased the track along with a set of race cars, as suggested by Amazon. The other cars do not fit the track, are way too large, and it only comes with 3 cars. Hot wheels do work on the track also, so that was a life saver. My 18m old loves it! I love it because he can't take it apart. Dissapointed about the other cars tho.

product_title: Cranium Cariboo
review_body: A perfect first game for our 3 yo. My daughter is delighted with the magic key (which is a nice fine motor skills exercise), the rubber balls and with the chance to practice her numbers and letters. It's a collaborative game which is great since she doesn't \\"get\\" competition yet. She seems to recognize the campy fun in the treasure chest at the end -- it's not a big reward, but something fun to end on. I can see where this would be boring for a 4.5 yo, but if you have an advanced 2.5 (recognizes some letters, can count to four and no longer puts items in his mouth) or 3 yo on your shopping list, this game will offer a lot of fun and is a nice introduction to the concept of games. Highly recommended.

product_title: Learning Resources Pretend & Play School Set
review_headline: Great Gift for a 5 year old
review_body: I bought this for my 5 yr old niece for Christmas.  She just started Kindergarten this year and loves school.  She absolutely loved it.  As soon as she opened it, that was all she wanted to play with.  I did have to buy some dry erase markers for it but that was no big deal considering how much she loved the gift I gave her.

product_title: Gamewright Castle Keep, the Game of Medieval Strategy and Siege
review_body: The basic concept is simple enough for a 6 year old, yet fun enough for adults to enjoy.  The pieces are pretty to look at.

product_title: Ty Weensy - Elephant
review_headline: Roll Tide, Big AL has a Big Alice
review_body: We are Alabama Crimson Tide fans.  One of my granddaughters had started collecting elephants.  Each were much smaller in size than this one, so she decided they needed a mother.  Big AL was not an appropiate name for a mother of several baby elephants.  So, Big Alice was born and it was decided to be the new wife to Big AL.  This stuffed toy is huge, my granddaughter uses it as a pillow and is so soft to hold and touch.  The only con is that the toy is a bit pricey.

product_title: Grindhouse Death Proof Baseball Cap [Apparel]
review_headline: this Death Proof cap is GREAT!  Buy it today!
review_body: this cap is fantastic!     i love the way it fits.  it doesn't have the HUGE bulky top that most redneck caps have, and the fabric is nice and different than any other cap i have.      and, who the heck even owns this cap?  in this world you gotta be different and with this cap, you are.    support one of the great films to come out in the past few years, and get this cap today!

product_title: Barbie B-Smart Desktop Computer
review_body: First of all this is not a REAL computer. It has a tiny screen and is very hard to read with all the loud colors around it. Its frustrating for younger kids, my three year old, as they to TYPE in a Game code and hit ENTER evertime they need to use it. Our older kid finds it too obselete, as it doesn't do stuff the \\"real\\" computer does. The error message is relentless and constantly tell your kid has made a mistake a thousand times. Its also a nightmare for parents as it requires parents to intervene often. Moreover the display is black and white and small. Reminds me of UNIX command line programming I used to do eons ago.  Please stay away from this obselete design.

product_title: K's Kids I Am the Boss
review_body: I bought this as a Christmas present for my 7 month old son and he absolutely loves it.  He will sit in the dinaosaur and kick the balls around, a great way to learn balance while sitting and kicking.  I'd say the best toy we own.  When we take it to go we throw other toys in such as blocks and rattles and he's set.  Even our friends 18m and 3y old couldn't resist playing with it.

product_title: UB Funkeys The Bones (red)
review_body: This is what my son wanted for Christmas. He had been talking about the Funkeys for so long. He finally got them, installed them in the computer, but after a week or two, he stopped playing with them. I am not saying it's a bad toy. Just that, it did not work for him. He expected more from the game. He found it a bit boring. I suggest you do a little bit more research before buying them for your kids.

product_title: Snorta Party Card Game
review_body: Fast paced game of animals noises.  You have to be at the top of your game to win this one!  Lots of fun, silliness and laughter will accompany the playing of this game.

product_title: Fisher-Price Peek-a-Blocks Press & Go Train
review_headline: Kids played with this train a lot
review_body: My daughter got this train for Christmas when she was three months old.  She really started playing with it a lot at about 9 months and still plays with it now that she is three years old.  The funny thing is that her older cousins also love to play with the train (age ranges 5-8 years old).  And her baby brother (11 months) loves the blocks a lot and just became interested in the train.  It still works well despite a lot of use.  The only downside to this train is that it won't run on our carpet.  Luckily most of our house has tile flooring.

product_title: Child Sized Cooking Set
review_body: I purchased the pan set for my 3-year old granddaughter.  She uses the biggest pot to keep her play spoons and forks in.  The pots are well made but they are on the small side.  Wooden spoon and pot holder are nice.

product_title: Official McFarlane The Simpsons Movie Homer Movie Mayhem Figure by Unknown
review_body: This toy looks great and fits in great with any collection of Simpsons toys except for one problem. The sound on mine didn't work. I put batteries in and made sure everything was fine and still no sound. So it looks great but isn't perfect.

product_title: Power Rangers Backpack School Bag
review_body: Our 4 year old grandson Ian was thrilled. We had looked everywhere for a Power rangers backpack for him - he's the Red ranger, by the way! Anyway, I was online and found your product and it was perfect! Thank you so much for making a little boy's wish come true!    Sharon Solis

product_title: Lady Bug Costume all Dressed Up
review_body: This costume was the hit of the play!!  It was true to the picture, but ran a bit small.  I ordered the 6x-8 and it was snug on my 7 year olds who are small for they're age.  I would order a size bigger than I normally would if you are buying one.

product_title: Tommy T-Rex 14"- Make Your Own Stuffed Animal Kit
review_body: I gave this to my great nephew, who is in 1st grade, for Christmas.  He absolutely loved it... opened the bag immediately and started stuffing before we knew what was going on.  He sleeps with Tommy every night.  It's a nice interactive way to introduce a stuffed animal.. and dinosaurs are difficult to find in the stores.  Would definitely buy again if needed.

product_title: TUBBY - hippo
review_body: I got this little guy for a gift and the recipient really liked it.  It was very cute, cuddly, and soft.  This was for an adult (Christmas joke - see the book, \\"I Want a Hippopotamus for Christmas\\").  The size seems like it would be good for a baby too - not too small and definitely grippable because it is very squishy.

product_title: LIttle Tikes Easy Store Jr. Play Table
review_body: This is an adorable little picnic table that arrived a few days after I ordered it (in a huge box with no instructions). Luckily it was not difficult to figure out how to set it up. I love it and my child does too. I'm sure it will last for years and later be passed along to another family to enjoy further. Note, it has a little hole in the middle of the table top, I guess for an umbrella if you choose to buy one. I cannot see the hole in the picture, not sure if the description mentions this. It's perfect for either indoor or outdoor use and seats 4 toddlers comfortably.

product_title: Disney WALL-E Figure Figurine Set
review_body: Even though I try not to teach my boys about guns at the same time I want them aware of the world around them so this was a fun version of a gun being that its called a blaster and it can help get rid of bad guys so its alot of fun for them and lots of fun sounds and lights its a great toy overall -

product_title: Radio Flyer 12 in. Classic Red Tricycle
review_headline: is teaching my son balance, coordination, and independence
review_body: My husband and I purchased this bike for our son when he was about 2 1/2.  His feet barely reached the pedals, so we helped him until he got big enough.  Now he's 3, his feet reach the pedals, and every couple of days we go for a walk, and he rides his tricycle.  He is not a fast kid, so he stays right next to us, and occasionally he does start to tip over, but we usually catch him in time to keep him from getting hurt.  He climbs right back on and we go again.  We bought a helmet, knee pads, and elbow pads at the same time that we purchased this tricycle, and he wears them EVERY TIME.  He is also always within reach when he's on the tricycle.      I have read many one star reviews, and I would agree with them that your child has to be just the right size to ride the bike--perhaps being taller and heavier makes it harder to stay upright, thanks to inertia and wind resistance.  I can also see that if your child is more physically inclined and likes to go fast, this would not be the tricycle for you--it's more like a cadillac than a mustang.  However, it's been a good, safe tricycle for my son, and has provided him with hours of learning and fun.      One mechanical issue is the bell: the screws have loosened and it hangs beneath the handlebars.  This could be more an indicator of my husband's procrastination than anything else, though.

product_title: Deluxe Backpack Giftset - Emergency Set
review_body: I got the car set for my 5-year-old boy. I am very surprised by the quality and details of these set of cars. The cars are corlorful with nicely painted details. No stickers.  My 5-year-old has a big collection of hot wheels and matchbox cars. The quality of this set is the same as the more expensive car sets. My son has been playing with the cars for about a month now. I have not notice any parts felling off the cars. The fire truck is the cutes piece with a rotating ladder. A super buy.

product_title: Travel Mastermind
review_body: The game itself is quite fun and entertaining, but the form factor of the design needs improvement.   I got the game to entertain my 8-yr old during a cross-country road trip.  She learned the game quickly and enjoyed figuring out the strategy.    But this travel version has a few problems.  The biggest problem is the <<tiny>> round-headed colored pins that tend to easily scatter around the car and are very difficult to grasp.  I've got fairly large hands and fingers, so I wasn't surprised that I had problems, but my 3rd grader also had problems picking up the pins.  The most difficult part is placing and extracting the 4 code pins from the end of the board - the clearances are very tight.  The codebreaker pins are also difficult to place into the holes.    Generally this is a very fun game, but you may want to take look at the larger version for car trips.

product_title: MGA Zapf Creation Baby Born, Mommy Look I Can Swim Doll
review_body: I bought this for my 3 and 5 year old girls for Christmas.  They both think it's a lot of fun to play with in the tub.  My ony gripe is no on/off switch.  The doll starts swimming when she gets wet and doesn't stop until you take her out of the water.  Sometimes they would like to play with her without the swimming feature.  Oh well, still a cute doll.  Would buy again.

product_title: Large Bull Plush Coin Bank
review_body: Super cute little piggy bank my daughter love to put money in and her the moo sounds it makes! I keep it on a high shelf so that the plastic tummy won't break...im sure it's pretty durrible but you never know with a 20mo old plus it would be covered in all kinds of stuff by now if I didn't!

product_title: Spinmaster Air Hogs Battling Havoc R/C Helicopters
review_body: I bought this for my 5 year old son who had to have it after seeing the commercial about it. I was apprehensive because of some of the other reviews I had read, but bought it anyway because it was the only thing my son wanted for his birthday. He LOVES it. What's great is that it comes with 2 helicopters so he and his sister can both play with them and \\"shoot\\" each other (you really can shoot your opponent down). My 5 year old son can work this product with a little guidance and my 8 year old daughter needs no guidance working it. They both really have been having a ball with these helicopters. Even my husband plays with them.  It's important to remember to read all of the instructions before using this toy and familiarize yourself with the \\"trouble-shooting\\" booklet so that you can rectify any situations that may come up that affect flight, like a propeller being knocked crooked, for instance(which is easy to fix). My son has crashed his helicopter to the floor many, many times and it still works fine. I would buy this product again because my kids have a ball with it. The only negative I can come up with is that I wish the helicopters would run longer on a charge. It seems you get about 20 minutes of quality flight time. Then you need to charge it again for about 20 minutes. Also, perhaps it's a bit over-priced. But, again...my kids love it and play and play and play with it.

product_title: Hape Quadrilla Wooden Marble Run Construction Basic Set Add On
review_headline: Excellent basic set that will leave you & your child wanting MORE
review_body:
This is a really fun set, and kids unequivocally love it. However, you are pretty limited in marble run configurations, since there is only 1 switch (marble goes right or left) and 1 fancy piece (the whirlpool).

Your child will have so many more creative options with a larger set. Plus a larger set will keep them entertained for a longer period of time, and more kids can play. This set is pretty much for 1-2 kids at a time. They'll set up one configuration, run the marbles, set up another one, run the marbles, and pretty much be done.

If you can't swing a larger set at this time, the Basic set is a good introduction, and you can add on another Basic set or the Basic Expansion set [...] at a later date.

product_title: Kid-Tough Fp3 Player Case - Pink
review_body: This case is great for protecting the player but wish it was in brighter colors so it wouldn't show the dirt so easily, even black would be great. We also got the speakers, so the player is in the speakers most of the time so that both girls can hear.

product_title: 25 Words or Less: People, Places, Things
review_body: This is a great game for older kids and adults. It makes you think! It is similar to TABOO in that you have to guve clues to make your team guess the words, but it has a twist, you have to bid on how few words it will take you to give clues to get your team to guess all five words on the card! We had a lot of fun playing this over the holidays! Definitely a new games night favorite!

product_title: 2-Channel RC Super Sonic Radio Control Airplane
review_headline: it is a real thrill but haven't really flew it much.  too windy or rain
review_body: seems durable and fun.  just we need time to fly it and a big field.  we can't wait   did a bit but not enough to get a real thrill.  I can't wait till we do.  What we had done was GREAT!!!!

product_title: Polyhedral 7-Die Borealis Dice Set - Clear with Black
review_body: I just started playing D&D and I found these beautiful dice. They have awsome multi faced color bits like fine glitter and they shift and change in the light. I liked them so much I bought 2 more sets! Get these they're wicked cool!

product_title: Klutz Bead Loom Bracelets Craft Kit
review_body: This is a great book for children and adults!  The directions are clear with good illustrantions and photos to show the exact steps for creating different types of bracelets.  The loom that comes in the kit is a good quality loom, the kit comes with everything needed to get started.  Beading on a loom is so addictive you will want to buy beads in every color imaginable so you can create bracelets with your own designs.  I say this is another great book by Klutz.  I have many different books and kits by this company and they make crafts easy and fun to do.  I will be ordering more products from Klutz!

product_title: Quadrilla Extension Set for Rail, Twist, and Twist and Rail Sets
review_body: We added this expansion set to the Twist and Rail Set so that we would have all the pieces for the examples in the instruction book. Awesome!  Kids, parents, grandparents, aunts and uncles have all been occupied!

product_title: Fisher-Price Dora Friendship Adventure Dora
review_headline: The best gift I gave this Christmas
review_body: I gave this toy to my 2 1/2 year-old niece for Christmas.  Instantly she started panting and giggling before we had even removed Dora from the box.  For the next couple of days she would constantly run over and hug it, introduce her other toys to it, and talk (her language skills aren't that great yet) to her friend Dora.  I can't attest to the toys longevity, but this was by far the best $40 I have spent in a very long time.

product_title: Foam Board Cutter
review_body: Get this only if you like frustration!  After only a few cuts, the blade was dull and the edges of the foam board were getting caught and bunched up.  Good I guess if you only have about 10 inches to cut, otherwise don't waste your money or time.

product_title: Fisher-Price Amazing Animals Sing and Go Choo-Choo
review_headline: Great Fun for my little guy!
review_body: We got this for my little guy about two months ago.  He wasn't really interested in it except to put it in his mouth.  Brought it out of the toybox the other day and he followed it all around the room.  He likes the animals (especially the clicking noise they make) and even \\"dances\\" to the songs that play. product_title: Remote Controlled Light Up Flying Saucer UFO
review_headline: Got different product than what the picture shows
review_body: The remote was completely different. The flying saucer was extremely small. The charger didnt fit in the charger slot. I did not get what I purchased. I am angry and would like what I purchased. Please send it to me. My cousin has this product: his is larger and can be charged. product_title: LeapFrog Alphabet Pal® Caterpillar (Colors May Vary)
review_body: My son was not yet 2 years old when I found him singing his ABCs along with this toy. It had not even occurred to me to teach him this yet, but apparently I didn't need to, because as much as he played with this toy, he had taught himself!

product_title: Melissa & Doug Horse Puppet (Full-Body)
review_headline: Too small for an adult hand
review_body: We were really disappointed to discover that this puppet is too small for a normal sized adult hand.  It's great quality, but adults can't use it unless they have really tiny hands.

product_title: Pirate Treasure Chest Bubbles
review_headline: Cute but doesn't blow great bubbles!
review_body: These bubbles are cute but they are tiny and the little wand inside is even tinier!  The hole to blow bubbles out of on the wand is probably only 1/4 inch or seems like, so it blows tiny, tiny bubbles! If you're looking for functional, they are not so good!

product_title: Blue's Clues Talking Mailbox Toy
review_body: While the toy itself is compact and the voice on it not to loud, I would never pay 30 bucks for this thing.   I got it at a discount store for five dollars.   And that's all it's worth.   It has about 5 phrases it will say when you touch the latch and does sing the song when your child presses the smile.   That's it.   Wouldn't the biggest thrill of playing with \\"the mailbox\\" be finding a letter?  You would think so but it does not open!  So kind of a pointless toy if it doesn't even do that.

product_title: Soccer Ball Pinata
review_body: A friend suggested that I let the kids kick this totally cool soccer ball rather than hit it with a stick (it is, after all, soccer!)  It took about 35 kicks and the kids had a (groan:) ball!!!  Excellent product, I tried to overload it with candy - impossible.  It's sturdy, looks great, and comes at a good price.

product_title: Encore Game 2008
review_body: I have played Encore with a church choir group, and now I am using it in my classroom - when we have extra time available. product_title: Gazillion Bubbles 460ml
review_body: These make great bubbles, especially if you have the electric bubble maker on a breazzy day.  Enjoy.

product_title: Forest Fairies and their Woodland Home Craft Kit
review_body: This is a really beautiful and fun craft kit.  Includes a very sturdy cardboard house that you decorate and material to make five fairies.  My daughter and I spent several hours making the fairies and had a great time.  However, she is almost six and had a hard time making the fairies herself. product_title: Special Edition Colonial Barbie Doll
review_body:
Combine your love of Barbie and 18th century history with this wonderful \\"fashion baby\\" that pre-teens and adults will adore. Mine is in an honored spot on my bookshelf, holding court next to Pilgrim Barbie.
She is a treasure!

product_title: Scientific INTERACTIVE AMAZING DINOSAURS (WITH TRY ME)
review_headline: Your child will love it if they love dinosaurs

He knows so many of the facts about the dinosaurs, and quizzes us!  He also is learning how to answer true and false questions because of this toy.

product_title: Jerry Garcia Grateful Dead Super Stage McFarlane Six Inch Action Figure
review_body: Amazing detail! Best captures Garcia in his later years. A must have for all collectors.

product_title: Real Heroes Space Shuttle
review_headline: There is no other toy like this on the market.
review_body:
Space toys (not movie related) are rare. I was surprised how large this toy is when it arrived ! It looks small in the photo on Amazon. Don't let that fool you. Although it doesn't include any figures, any 6-inch style figure will do. Our daughter is on an astronaut kick (after visiting the Museum of Science and Discovery during summer camp), and this was the closest thing I saw that looked like it would be a good space / adventure / pretend type toy. The one side has 2 doors (upper / lower) that open, the top has two hatches that open. The interior has two seats, a console, and there's a ladder for one of the 4 legs.

Once you put it together, it sits around 15 inches high, about 18 inches square around the 4 legs.

product_title: KidKraft Lil' Doll High Chair

product_title: Burswood 49 Key Electric Keyboard

review_body:
I got this keyboard to teach my 4-year-old how to play, but the whole family has fun with it! product_title: Littlest Pet Shop Exclusive Single Pack Black and White Pig [Apples & Wheelbarrow]
review_body: This LPS is a black and white pig, not a cow.  Kids know the difference.

product_title: Step2 Naturally Playful Playhouse Climber & Swing Set Extension
review_body: I chose this play set because the reviews indicated that it was easy to assemble.  I could not agree more.  I transported it from my garage in the front of the house to the backyard and put it together by myself in 1-1/2 hours.  It came with pretty poor picture instructions that weren't very clear, so I had to back track a couple of times...but overall very easy and intuitive.  It was definitely manageable for one person.  My one year old loves it.  The play house under the slide is perfect for her, and I'm sure she will grow into the rest of it.  It is very sturdy and stable for little ones, but I doubt it is strong enough to accommodate older kids.  The plastic bowed slightly under my weight and the slide is too narrow for an adult bottom.  The plastic got quite warm under the hot Texas sun, but was not hot enough to burn skin.  Parents in hot climates will probably need to check the temp or hose it down before little ones get on it.  Overall, I am a very pleased mother so far. I only wish there were add-ons to it for future play.

product_title: Constructive Playthings Mondo Neon Inside Out Ball

review_body: It would be helpful to know how many you get in your order. The item description is vague and confusing. Do you get 4 balls (like in the picture)? Do you get a 65mm ball AND a 45mm ball (like in the description)?  Am I the only one confused by this?

product_title: Breyer Traditional Grooming Kit Horse Toy Accessory

product_title: Fascinations AntWorks

product_title: Healed and Sealed Soda
Mega Bloks Pyrates - Fort Defiance
review_body: This product is lots of fun.  My child is a big fan of the Pyrates, and this is a nice addition to the collection.

product_title: US Army Monopoly

We were right!  The only issue we had was that the game box was crushed in one of the corners but not so much as it would affect the shape of the game board.

product_title: Fashion Insider Ken Doll Gift Set Barbie Fashion Model
review_headline: Well made addition to the Silkstone line
review_body: This is a very well made collectible from Mattel. The quality is exactly what you would expect from a Gold Label Silkstone Barbie. Mattel hasn't released any other Silkstone Kens, to my knowledge, this would make a great addition to any collection.

product_title: LeapFrog Fridge Phonics Magnetic Alphabet Set - Styles May Vary
review_body: What can I say that hasn't been said 500 times before?  My son (now 3 1/2) got this toy at age 2.  He been watching the Leapfrog videos with his older brother since he was a baby.  He adored this toy when he got it, and he still plays with it today.  The letters have put up with being dropped, thrown, washed (I even submerged them, though I would not recommend that), lost under the fridge and recovered, and one even got dropped into the crab's tank.  Anyway, I'm a faithful Leapfrog customer now (especially since my 3 1/2 year old is reading at kindergarten level).

product_title: Melissa & Doug
review_body: I have a 13 month old who currently uses this as a Put and Take Toy - take shapes out and put them in - with the lid off.  She is already trying to put a few of the shapes in the proper holes.  It is a great toy for stacking a bit, learning colors, shapes, and placement.  Lid comes off very easy, which makes it perfect for my baby's age.  When she is older I may put velcro on the lid to keep it shut more, so it is easy to flip as she put the shapes in.  Great product.  Small and better for environmental than plastic.  Very pleased with this toy.  This is exactly what I was looking for.

product_title: BumbleRide Indie Stroller
review_body: My husband and I enjoy the outdoors and needed a light weight stroller that we could easily maneuver with one hand on the bumpy terrain (broken sidewalks and gravel, rooty trails) as well as accommodate top rated car seats. We also wanted a stroller that was lightweight and folded up small. The Bumbleride Indie met all these criteria and more. The stroller is very easy to maneuver, weighs only 20 lbs, fits easily into the trunk of my husband's car, and accommodates as well as coordinates with our Chicco Key Fit 30 car seat.     When compared to the other all-terrain strollers we were impressed with how many features were included in the Indie that the other strollers charged extra for, such as: foot muff, cup holder, large storage basket, tire pump, etc. While my girlfriends are pushing their pricey, high-end strollers, wearing diaper-bag backpacks (because their storage baskets are tiny), manipulating their water bottles (no cup holder) while maneuvering the front tires over and around obstacles (small, non-inflated front tires), we are cruising along effortlessly anywhere we go.     We also loved the added features the Indie offered: a lockable front wheel so I can jog with it (disclaimer, I am not a serious jogger, more of the speed-walker/jog type); three large inflated wheels, two of which have mini-shocks for a very smooth ride; seat that reclines almost completely flat so we could use it as a bassinet when our son was younger; large, adjustable canopy; one-step foot break/release; adjustable handlebar that accommodates my height and my husbands; stroller lock so that it doesn't unfold when you pick it up; and fabric that is totally washable and can be replaced with the newest fashions and color for the next baby.     To be fair, the Indie has one draw-back, the stroller takes some practice to fold-up--you have to disengage the handlebar and then pull on a lever behind the seat to fold it down. However, both my husband and I can now do this in a matter of seconds. Tip: After you disengage the handlebars, step on the break while releasing the backrest lever and pulling the lever towards you and to the ground--it collapses right up.    I would highly recommend this stroller to those parents who describe themselves as the fashionable, outdoors types.

product_title: Radica Cube World Global Get A Way
review_body: The Radica Cube World Global Get A Way isn't nearly as much fun as I thought it would be. Basically, it isn't worth the money spent. review_body: I got this for my daughter. It did not work. Followed the directions exactly, didn't overfill, waited 45 seconds, 1 minute, 2 minutes. No bubbles. review_body: This looks like they ultimate in pampering.  The dog is very cute and my daughter loves the tub to soak her pup in while she is taking a shower.

review_body: I really like this newer version of Monopoly.  It moves quickly and is fun.  If you like playing Monopoly, you will like this version.

product_title: The $100,000 Pyramid DVD Game (Discontinued by manufacturer)
review_body: We have the original Pyramid board game and love to play so we thought the new electronic version would be fun.  It's a complete disappointment.  The DVD is so slow in responding when you want to advance to the next word that it takes 2-3 seconds per clue.  The clock keeps running so it's almost impossible to just get through the first round. product_title: Marvel VS System Trading Card Game The Avengers Booster Box 24 Packs
review_body: My son was very happy with the purchase and I was pleased with the speed. Thanks!

product_title: Melbourne Koala Mini Flopsie 8" by Aurora

product_title: LeapFrog Explorer Smart Globe
review_body: I have been teaching for 45 years and I highly recommend this Smart Globe!  I gave it to 2 of our grand-children and we ended up playing with them and just loving it!

product_title: LEGO SpongeBob The Krusty Krab
review_body: This is the first of the Spongebob LEGO sets my daughter recieved.  She got this one for Christmas and loves it.

product_title: Melissa & Doug

product_title: Your Special Vibrating & Talking Snake: 2-Pack
review_body: I gave these to my granddaughters for valentines day and they were very pleased.  They had never seen anything like them before and no one had one like it.

product_title: Puzzle Calico Cat
review_body: I bought this for my three year old and she just loves it. It has the softest fur, it's nearly life size, it's squeezable, and even the eyes look realistic. Great stuffed toy

product_title: Melissa & Doug Deluxe 300 piece River Run Cardboard Jigsaw
review_body: My 5 year old daughter loves horses and loves to work puzzles.  She really enjoyed this puzzle.  We finished it over the weekend and she was really excited.  Nice and colorful.

product_title: Ty Beanie Babies - 6 Inch Black and White Panda - Wonton [Toy]
review_body: I love the panda bear.  It's small and soft and cuddly. My son loved having it for his project.

product_title: KooKeys Giraffe
review_body: I wasn't sure whether to get a Webkinz, Kookey or Shining Star for my daughter. With a little research I noticed that Webkinz's fans were mostly middle school aged and very hostile toward \\"knock-off\\" competitors, but yet there was a huge fan base. I decided to get one of each to see which my elementary aged daughter preferred. As a toy, I would score Webkinz the lowest in quality and Kookey and Shining Star equally high. The websites are all very similar, but my daughter much more preferred Kookey's because it had a navigation map and unique homes that were not just rooms, but neighborhoods. I preferred that Kookey does not have access to chat with other members (as does Webkinz). Even more important, Webkinz website is limited to a year's membership, while Kookey's has no such limitations.  I also recommend Shining Star for its educational benefit with the star registry. My daughter was tied between Kookey's and Shining Star, and Webkinz failed in comparison.

product_title: Curses The Side Splitting Party Game
review_body: I bought this as a Christmas gift for a friend. My friends and I played it at a sleepover and had an absolute blast! It's really fun to watch your friends do stupid things. :P    The only thing I'd say is that it'd be nice if they sold an expansion pack because if you play this too many times it can get old.     But overall, a great party game!

product_title: Melissa & Doug Giant T-Rex Dinosaur -  Lifelike Stuffed Animal
review_body: I bought this for my daughter's fourth birthday, she is really into dinosaurs, and I know she will love it. The colors are really vibrant and fun. Overall, especially for the price, its a pretty cool toy.

product_title: Mad Science - Bubble Experiment Lab
review_body: This was the most incredibly time-wasting, useless piece of junk that I have ever encountered.  Horrible design: Grandaddy (who has a Ph.D. in science) spent hours struggling to get it to work.  Never did.  Tubes were bent and occluded, so we could not get the fluid into the chamber, precluding any use of the elaborate set up that might or might not have produced some interesting effects.  Shame on Mad Science for marketing this abomination.    Sad grandad

product_title: Go Diego Go - Bed and Bath - Folding Potty Seat
review_body: I bought this because I thought it would be great to have with me as I potty train my 3 year old son. He hates it though. He says it pinches him. It's nice that it folds, however because it folds it's very uncomfortable to sit on.

product_title: Ringgz
review_body: We love love love this game.  It's been the perfect thing for us (the parents) as well as for all of our kids, even the five-year-old.  It's addictive and quick, and it requires strategy to win.  It's fun to see how our kids' minds all work differently!  Great product.

product_title: Wildlife / Domestic Animals : Skunk 10" Plush Stuffed Animal Toy
review_headline: Stinky Face found a loving home.
review_body: The plush skunk has been named Stinky Face and lives in a card board \\"cave\\" (don't worry, it has air holes).  She matches the skunk in a toddler's favorite book and is taken out, played with, and then always replaced in her cardboard home.  She was a definite hit and appears to be well made.  She is carried around by her tail and all is still intact.

product_title: Toddlerz Electronic Push Toy - Counting Corn Popper
review_body: I brought this as a gift for my nephew and he loves it. When we went home my nephew, my boys 2 and 3 played with it. it is a very durable and great toys our boys are ages 1,2, and 3 so these ages are great. We had the old popper toy the addition of the electronics is great. This is a great toy I give it a 10 in toughness and enjoyment

product_title: Star Wars Basic Figure Kotor Darth Malak
review_body:
Darth Malak is the primary antagonist in the original Star Wars Knights of the Old Republic (Fondly called KOTOR) video game. This particular figure is a fan's favorite that was released with the 30th Anniversary of Star Wars coin collection. I understand that it's quite rare given the success and fan base of the video game.

Anway, there's not much to say about the figure. the detail is great and the articulation is above par for a Star Wars' figure, but he doesn't have the same menancing appeal as he does in the video games. There's just no respecting him - especially if you happen to own the Darth Revan figure. At best he postures and broods like a good apprentice standing behind his master.

The nicest part about him is that you can actually remove his face plate - revealing the missing jaw (Darth Revan cut it off). Is it gross? Yes it is. However, purists of the video game will love it.

As with Darth Revan, he comes with two lightsabers, one lit, one not lit, and a 30th anniversary Star Wars coin with his image on it.

product_title: Melissa & Doug
review_body: My students enjoyed this toy for the first week or so... than they began to grow very bored with it and it stayed on the shelf ever since.  I'm glad I bought it, because I can use the pieces for other educational uses and since they have played with the game in the past, they can relate to the other uses better.

product_title: Dungeons & Dragons Inn Fighting Dice Game
review_body: I was looking for a card game that runs a little faster than Munchkin. I've been waiting for this one. The first time we played, we had 5 players. It took an hour to complete 1 game. It was rather enjoyable. It has a nice mix of D&D rules and traditional card battling games. Its well-balanced and documented. Make sure you have plenty of counters!

product_title: Swan Lake Ballerina Skirt
review_body: I bought two.  Our four and five-year-old grand daughters loved twirling and dancing in their skirts.  I like their becoming a tad familiar with classic music while they do.  And they learned quickly where the off button was when they wanted to use their own music.  It was a hit for close cousins to act out being princesses together.

product_title: Barbie B-Smart Learning Laptop
review_body: my god-daughter loves her barbie laptop........all she needs is an adaptor since the batteries runs down very quickly. Anyone purchase an adaptor or know if ther's one available. Other than that great educational toy for a child.

product_title: Kid's Silver Screen Starlet Costume (Size:Md 8-10)
review_headline: Cute, but not as cute as the picture
review_body: In the picture, this dress is adorable, but in real life, it doesn't really translate the same.  The actual color is more of a perriwinkle blue, instead of silver, it is also not as form fitting as the picture shows (which, I was actually glad to see, since I didn't want the dress to be inappropriately clingy on my daughter), however, since it wasn't as form fitting, the bottom part of the skirt isn't as cute as it is in the picture.  Also, there are little doilies (sp?) attached around the neck that I had to secure to the dress because the final stitch was not knotted.  Dispite all these comments, I did like the dress - the material of the dress was good quality (not that scratchy, cheap costume material), and my daughter loved it, which is all that matters.

product_title: Magnetix I-Coaster
review_headline: Such a horrible waste of time
review_body: This seems like a brilliantly fun toy. However once you open the box it is easy to feel sorely disappointed. There are a million pieces, most of which connect via magnet. If this item had a stronger magnet it might be better, but the connection is so fragile and weak. The slightest little brush breaks everything. We spent so much time fixing the track that we didn't really enjoy playing with it.    In addition, the examples in the booklet are very hard to follow.  Some english (or whatever your particular language is) would be nice to see here.    I would never recommend this toy and suggest returning it immediately if you ever accidentally get it.

product_title: Mini Hughes 300 RC Dragonfly Syma Fairy Remote Control Helicopter (styles and colors may vary)
review_body: Great helicopter. I thought it would be really flimsy and break relatively easily(for the price, I thought it would be worth it), but this thing withstands so many crashes. Took a bit to learn how to fly, though. I broke an ornament on the Christmas tree with it accidentally. But a great toy for any age.

product_title: Webkinz Clothing - MAROON HOODY
review_body: My daughter received this hoodie for Christmas & immediately put it on her new Beagle. When we took it off 1 week later, his white underbelly was PINK. I was able to clean off some of the discoloration with stuffed animal cleaner. It's still alittle pink. I'm going to try a little oxyclean too. I wouldn't recommend this item for any lighter colored animals. She currently has this on another stuffed animal that's actually washable & bleachable. It's too bad, because she really likes the hoodie.

product_title: Mattel Hot Wheels Flip N Go Spin City Playset
review_body: \\"Santa\\" just put the Spin City together just after our almost 3 year old went to bed here in Christmas Eve.  The first thing we did was cut the tether that holds the toy together into the box.  Big mistake, that plastic tether is what goes inside the tower to make the spiral lift work.  No instructions point this out.  The instructions look like tax law.  The toy itself is a miserable and flimsy design.  Why not have the car launch and KEEP going down the spiral instead of taking pit stop for the child to have to physically turn the car to allow it to continue the remaining 50% down the spiral ramp?  The sound effects are on the ramp itself, meaning, the car has to be physically HELD DOWN underneath a plastic hook to understand that \\"hey, you're getting a tune up\\" or \\"hey, you're getting a paint job.\\"  Santa is not pleased but has become more skilled with duct tape in making a desperate repair before Christmas morning arrives.  Good thing we have a well made Melissa and Doug art easel we are happy with!

product_title: X-Kites 22" FlexWing Glider: Merlin Dragon
review_body: Don't waste your money.  I bought this for my boys for the beach and it didn't even last the vacation.  It is cheaply made and doesn't fly.  You can make a paper airplane and get similar quality!

product_title: Radica Electronic Password Journal
review_body: Got this toy for both of my girls.  They were very excited about it.  It worked less than half the time.  Very aggravating when it wouldn't recognize the password after many attempts.  Don't waste your time or money on this one!

product_title: Halloween Party Decor Haunted Bowls
review_body: when i opened the box,i was surprised.This is a beautful bowl.It is eye cathing,so,i put it in the kitchen forall to see.It really is an amazing detailed bowl.It's creepy looking and very cool.I use it for my halloween napkins and it is spooky.For my nieces,and,nephews to say its cool,than it's cool.

product_title: Bobbin Bumblebee Game
review_headline: Fun for adults and kids alike
review_body: I own the original Loopin' Louie and love it to death.  I wanted to get a back up because it gets so much use.  Bobbin' Bee is a clone with some really cool updates to the production.  The artwork is cute and well themed, the paddles are a nice touch, and the bee does a lot more flips when hit.      The original Louie has a little better physics going for it.  In Bobbin' Bee it is extremely difficult to make a 270 degree shot to knock the person to your left out.  I think taping a quarter to the weight end may help.  I'll have to experiment.    This is great fun for adults as much as kids because adults are usually better at developing the feel of how hard you need to hit it to force a knock out of your opponents.  At late night drink parties this is a real hit.  I think one previous reviewer didn't understand that it's not so much about protecting your honeycombs as it is hitting it just right so that your opponents can't defend against a dive bomb.    To play a full game, the winner of each round pulls out a honeycomb and the winner is the person that has only one honeycomb in their rack that doesn't get knocked out.  I don't think those rules were included.    All in all it's a great substitute if you can't get the original Loopin' Louie and I'm happy to own both especially at amazon's price.

product_title: Baby Einstein 1st Birthday Felt Party Hat Child
review_body: It's nice, but it's too small and i believe you can make it urself. and u gotta make sure u buy other stuff together cause although the price is good, the shipment kills you.

product_title: LeapFrog Fridge Phonics Magnetic Alphabet Set - Styles May Vary
review_body: I was skeptical at first; honestly, when I heard it while still in the box, I thought, oh no.  Not another annoying toy.  And yes, some days I think I will go crazy if I hear \\"H says hhhhh, H says hhhhh\\" one more time.  That being said, I think it has helped my son learn the alphabet and recognize letters.  He got it for his second birthday and at 3.5 yrs old, still plays with it all the time.  My younger son who is now 20 months has loved the toy for some time.    It is easy for kids to put the letters into the \\"machine\\" and doesn't cause frustration.  It has been dropped on the floor, thrown etc innumerable times and still holds up.  I have only changed the batteries once in a year in a half.  I highly recommend this toy!

product_title: Melissa & Doug Standard Unit Solid-Wood Building Blocks
review_body: I bought this for my sons 3rd birthday and boy did it go over well. These are large blocks with all sorts of shapes and sizes. These are not the dinky little blocks that get lost all over the house. My son builds roadways, buildings, rockets, whatever he can imagine.  They come in a nice box that they are easily stacked in.  They may seem expensive, but they are very much worth it.  I wish I coulda bought 2 sets!

product_title: LEGO Creator Fast Flyers
review_headline: A nice and not too specialized Lego
review_body: I usually try to find Lego kits that are not too specialized, because I want my children to be able to build things in addition to the ones in the instructions. This kit is very good in that respect. The models in it are very nice. My 5 year old built them with little help from me.

product_title: Family Business
review_body: Family Business was the most fun ever. Okay, that's an overstatement, however I do have to say it was the most consistent fun and didn't hurt the brain. Alliances were formed and broken as players sought strong positions and attempted to weaken strong adversaries or to quickly take out the weakest. The first time I played it was - let's just say - several years ago, in high school. A friend bought it and a bunch of us gathered around and played. Even when you lost the game was fun, but look out if you won - the rematch would usually (not always) find every other player ganging up to take you out first.     After just one night, people would have their favorite gangs and \\"grudges\\" would carry over from night to night. In most cases we were co-ed, the simple rule among the gentlemen was to not attack their girlfriend until she landed the first jab; then all bets were off.     I have been looking for a replacement set for a few years. It is a great party game - one that is easily picked up and hard to put down. Strategy and tactics do come into play, though as often as not it comes down to laying low and playing your cards right. If you've been marked by a grudge because you won the last round or were perceived to be the big winner the time before, you might as well have fun going out quick.    The games are fast and furious, loaded with good memories.

product_title: Russ Berrie Shining Stars Brown Bear
review_body:

I don't know how long the softness will last, but so far so good. It's a bit smaller than I expected, but true to the product dimensions listed. review_body: Overall, the quality of this product is good. Also the delivery was just on the limit date specified. I would still recommend this product but you have to be very patient for the delivery. I didn't know until I placed the order that the delivery would take full 3 weeks to reach a big country like Canada from the UK. review_body: I bought this toy for my 18 month old nephew, and it is great! He loves to chase it around the room. Great on the carpet and floor. It is also very durable. However, I wish it had a greater range.

product_title: 2" FLASHING EYEBALL SUPERBALL

review_body: I bought two of these as part of a Halloween costume for the Three Fates. Neither flashed. They were just a basic oversize superball with an eye pattern.

product_title: Henry Dog 14"
review_body: My son is 37 now. When he was a little guy, he had Henry. We had to take Henry everywhere. He talked to him, and he blamed things on Henry. product_title: Pokemon153;  Champion Island DVD Board Game
review_body: My son (9) loves Pokemon and this was a great buy for him! If you do not know a lot about Pokemon this game will not be that easy, but it is still fun. My son knows a lot about this game so the trivia in it is a bit easier, but his friend who did not know a lot of the answers still liked playing it too.    The game is very interactive and your child learns trivia and reading while playing. My son likes the game so much, he sometimes plays it alone.    I highly recommend this game if your child likes Pokemon!

product_title: Quercetti Marble Run with Motorized Elevator, 177 Pieces
review_body: The idea for this toy is great but the implementation not so good. The chain that you put together that pulls the elevator is the worst because you snap all of the links together only to discover that they give you too many links for it to fit snugly around the gears. Then, when you pull it apart to take out some pieces, the plastic stretches and the chain perpetually breaks. The plastic is so lightweight and the assembly to flimsy that it breaks again and again. If continuous fixing is your child's idea of fun, or your idea of an \\"educational toy,\\" then maybe this is for your family, but for my kids it was frustrating.

product_title: Guernica - Pablo Picasso Panoramic Puzzle 3000 Pieces
review_body:
This one is a tuffy. I completed the Sistine Chapel 3000 and it was a breeze compared to this one. Because there is little color variation, it gets very confusing. After 2 weeks i was able to complete the border and the center part that has little lines all over... on the third week i completely failed at finding a single piece to fit anywhere, got irritated and took it apart.

This puzzle tests the love for jigsaw and is for the truly dedicated (aka someone with a lot of time)

review_body: this is a great mushroom plush. it's the perfect size (not too big and not too small) and it has a loop on top so you could hang it up somewhere. and the fabric is of the highest quality; soft and fluffy. highly recommened.

product_title: Disney Pixar Cars Movie Moments Mia & Tia
review_body: They are a cute almost completely identicial pair of additons to my collection. Plus, I like the movie characters.
