review_body: I love this game.   We play it at 'girls' nights.   It especially great because its easy to leave and come back too, when you have to change a diaper or settle a toy dispute.

product_title: Awesome Origami
review_headline: Fun for kids with the attention span
review_body: Even though my granddaughter is only six, she loved this kit.  She is very good with her hands and I was able to show her how to do some of the designs.  Some adult supervision is needed with children of this age, but the kit is flexible enough with all its little decorations and feathers that children can use their imagination to make their own creations without having to follow the rules step by step.

product_title: Revell 85-8883 1/4 Visible V-8 Engine Plastic Model Kit, 12-Inch
review_body: I imagined that this would be a good father/son project.  However, I had to build most of it alone.  If you appreciate precision fit, you won't find it in this kit.  Epoxy is not fun to work with.  Cementing little metal nuts to plastic and then finding later that the holes don't line up can be extremely frustrating.  Eventually, I got it together.  It works, looks impressive, etc.  However,this is not the ideal project to create a bonding experience between father and son...unless you have some M-80's, lighter fluid, or a sledge hammer.

product_title: Marvel Legends Series 17 (Hasbro Series 2) Action Figure Thor
review_body: This is an excellent sculpt of Thor in one of his armored periods, the joints are good, with none of them being loose out of the package. The figure makes an excellent addition to my Marel collection.

product_title: Mon-Sieur Bome Vol. 18: Gunbuster Noriko Takaya PVC Figure
review_headline: One of the most beautiful things you could have on your shelf!
review_body: Created by master Anime sculptor Bome, this is one strikingly beautiful plastic display piece! Wearing a uniform that must have been designed by the gods, Noriko Takaya is the lead character in \\"Gunbuster\\", one of the few Anime productions I've been exposed to outside of Sailor Moon, and an instant hit with me (largely because of the beautiful Noriko). She's a humble, spunky mecha pilot who, as you can see in the promo photo, is a guy's dream come true. This sculpture of Takaya is a lightweight pvc and is glorious to behold. Extremely, graceful and fluid, expertly created. It's a must-have for fans of Gunbuster or beautiful Anime girls in general. I haven't watched Gunbuster in a while, but getting this figure has increased my desire to upgrade my tapes to the DVD set. Figure also comes with base.

product_title: Mattel Matchbox Dino Adventure - Adventure Set
review_headline: love the Dino Adventure Pop Up Playset
review_body: My son has played with the Dino Adventure pop-up playset with such enthusiasm. We both love the way it all folds up into the case and is easy to carry.

product_title: Moon Sand 7 1/2lb Mega Bucket
review_body: My boys (9 and 5) both LOVE this stuff.  I was thrilled to purchase two of these mega tubs from Amazon for $9 a piece!  Yes, this stuff is messy, but at this price, I'm able to just vacuum up what's on the floor instead of worrying about picking most of it up.  I disagree with the mom who says Play-Doh is better: Play-doh is cheaper, but it dries out - this stuff never dries out, and my 5 year old can drive his cars in it!!  They spend hours playing in it, just using their imaginations.  WE LOVE MOON SAND.

product_title: Leapster L-MAX Hardware (TV Feature)
review_body: I still cannot believe what an amazingly horrible experience I had with this company's customer service.  We bought the Lmax for our son from another retailer.  He used it for about 10 minutes and was having a great time - until we plugged it into the TV to play on the big screen.  The cable fit into the port on the game so loosely that any movement caused it to fall out.  Needless to say, it was nearly impossible to use in that mode.  We took it back to get another but they were (and still are) sold out, so I called LeapFrog customer service to try to get another.  That's when the fun began.     First, I was told that the system was down and that someone would call me back within 24 hours.  When I didn't hear back, I called again and was told the same story.  Days later, still no call from Leap Frog.  So I decided to email customer suport.  I never got a response to this day.  A week after my original call, Leap Frog finally contacted me - but I couldn't get to the phone.  No more than two minutes later I called back - only to get a recording that the company was closed and to call again another day.  Two days later I called and got the  exact same runaround - leave your information and someone will get back to you.  After asking for a supervisor, I discovered that the \\"answering service\\" that Leap Frog uses can't help with the Lmax, and they can't transfer me to anyone who CAN help me.  Alll they can do is take messages.    Finally today I got a call from an actual \\"Lmax support\\" person.  I was told that I should just use the game without moving it.  Are you kidding me??????  I was told that Leap Frog is aware of the problem with the TV cable and customer service is waiting for a response from headquarters about what to tell people.  I was also told that, in the mean time, Leap Frog is still producing and selling this product knowing that it is not working properly.  This is one of the absolute worst customer service experiences that I have ever had.  I had planned on just eventually getting another, but the fact that they continue to sell toys that they KNOW don't work is disgusting to me.  It's a shame, because the games seem really wonderful and my son did have a great time with it.....for 10 minutes anyway.

review_body:
I copied the following from my review of the original Time's Up. It all applies to this expansion.

\\"I love Time's Up! It's simple and fun. You take a stack of cards, each one with the name of a famous person, and try to get your partner to guess the names. You play three rounds. review_body:

product_title: Rubik's Cube (Discontinued by manufacturer)

review_body: The most fun ever! My 16 year old son went online for tips and solved this Christmas night - Just a great mind teaser!

product_title: Transformers Movie Deluxe Allspark Power Stealth Bumblebee
review_body: This is the alternate color scheme to Bumblebee, but besides that is the same. The Cliffjumper transformer is also identical other than the color. In response to the reviews that say this is difficult to transform and that is why it is awful, I would say that yes, it is difficult at first, but once you do it a few times, it's easy.     I bought this one for my five year old and spent at least 10 minutes pouring over the directions while transforming him from a robot back to a car (more difficult than the car to a robot). The second time, it took me about 5 minutes and the third time, I discovered the trick to it and from then on I could do it in just a minute or two.    It's kind of hard to put it into words, but the best way to do it is to start with the legs and make sure they are lined of and snapped in to form the rear of the car. Then, make sure the arms are in the right position (pulled all the way out and straight at his sides) and pull back the compartment right under the back of his head. Now you should be able to pull of the front end of the car. You shouldn't have to force it, if it doesn't go easily, then readjust the arms until it does. Now that you've gotten it this far, push the arms in and line up the top of the car and snap it all in place. The doors actually have a small peg that make them snap in tight. Like I said, it's difficult to put this into words, but with a little experience and some effort, you'll pick it up soon enough.     For the durability argument... yes, I agree, the parts do pop off from time to time if you (or your 5 year old :) are rough with it. But, the easily snap back in. Even after re-attaching his head and arms dozens of times (my 5 year old is rougher than most on his toys I suspect), the joints are still solid and everything still transforms very tightly.    Bottom line, no, a five year old probably can't transform this. However, with a little patience, an adult can do it easily enough. If I had to do it all over again, I'd still buy this toy for my son. He loves it and plays with it every day..... and I must admit, I enjoy transforming it upon request. It's kind of like a robot Rubik's Cube.

review_body:
I got this toy for my daughter for Christmas. She really likes it. I consider it educational in the way that all building toys are - it teaches about structural integrity and mechanical linkages.

Now he's better at it but tries to climb up on the side of the tent walls too, not just the front. There is no way to discourage a child at this age from doing things like this. He is just now beginning to enjoy crawling through and around it.     He does love it and wants to play with it everyday. Absolutely loves the doorbell and the ladybug. We found it a bit loud though and put a piece of tape over the speaker to quiet it down. However, don't read too much into the list of features. product_title: Family Game Night Book and Game Set, Four Great Games In One CLUE SORRY SCRABBLE YAHTZEE
review_headline: Clue Classic Detective Game - Parker Brothers 1998
review_body: A Classic Detective Game! In Clue, players move from room to room in a mansion to solve the mystery of: who done it, with what, and where? Players are dealt character, weapon, and location cards after the top card from each card type is secretly placed in the confidential file in the middle of the board. Players must move to a room and then make an accusation against a character saying they did it in that room with a specific weapon. The player to the left must show one of any cards accused to the accuser if in that player's hand. Through deductive reasoning each player must figure out which character, weapon, and location are in the secret file. To do this, each player must uncover what cards are in other players hands by making more and more accusations. Once a player knows what cards the other players are holding they will know what cards are in the secret file. A great game for those who enjoy reasoning and thinking things out.

product_title: Zobmondo Entertainment The Ladybug Game
review_headline: Great at first but started to bug me later.
review_body:
This attractive, original, and educational game has provided a lot of fun for my two young sons. They enjoy getting their respective ladybugs past the bad praying mantis and the bully ants and back to their flowery home.

They've learned about ladybugs, aphids, ants, and praying mantises and they've gotten a lot of practice counting through the process of reading the cards and counting forwards and backwards on the board. Then there's the counting of aphids to give them even more practice with numbers.

But after playing this game five or six tims with my sons I found myself wishing they could just play against each other and leave me out of it. This is an open ended game which can go on for a long time. The cards basically contain numbers which move you forward and backward, forward and backward. Then there are instructions on some of the \\"squares\\" along the journey that have you moving backwards too. Furthermore, there is one place along your journey where you can get into a seemingly infinite loop going around and around trying to collect enough aphids to get past those bully ants.

As a parent who is obligated to play this game when the kids want to, I can say that it has gotten quite tedious, and when the kids want to play it I just wince. Still, it's not nearly as bad as Chutes and Ladders.

So, I recommend this as one of several games to cycle through over the course of days and weeks. If I had to play it every night, I'd just rather be eaten by the praying mantis.

product_title: Nerf Dart Tag Strikefire 2-Player Duel System (Colors May Vary)
review_headline: Great value and esp. good for small hands.
review_body: My kids also have this set as well as the Firefly, Maverick, Recon, Night-Finder, and a few others from another manufacturer.  Overall, this is a very good value.  We tested the load-fire-reload rate of all our guns, and these shoot just as far, and are the fastest within one minute.  Their other Nerf guns have rapid fire up to 8 darts, but the reload time takes much longer.  These Strikefire guns can only shoot one dart at a time, but it can shoot all the different types of darts, while the guns that use clips can only shoot 1 type.  The kids like the Suction cup and Whisler tip darts the most.  The vest works, but the kids don't use them.  Instead, they prefer to use the glasses and fire darts at each other, esp. the head.  We tried the \\"shoot only under the neck\\" rule, but that was impossible to enforce.  The foam darts seem very safe, as long as they wear their glasses (which is an absolute requirement if they want to play with the nerf guns.)  Their favorite battle is to use barriers in our large family/rec room, and to shoot at each other across the room.  Playing indoors makes it a lot easier to find the darts during and after the battle.  Outdoor battles can be fun also, but more difficult to hit each other, and a lot harder to find all the darts.  Buy extra darts to have longer battles.  I think we have almost 200 darts, but still run out during a battle before we're ready to quit.  Overall, very good play value.  Just don't forget the glasses - it's very easy to get hit in the eye and never fun whenever someone gets hurt during a game.

review_body:

product_title: Cardinal Family 10-Game Center in Wood Case

review_body: My 4 year old sons enjoys the game. It is not very sturdy when using the legs but on the table it seems to play better. Would be more enjoyable for him if it had more lights and sounds on it.

product_title: TY Beanie Baby - SUNDAR the Snow Leopard (Internet Exclusive) [Toy]
review_body: my neice loves this one, she is 9, I got it as a gift and she goes everywhere with it. I know beanies are collectables, but my kids play with theirs for hours, They are practally the only kind of stuffed toy I buy for them because they are the right size for packing around, They usaly have one in their hand everywhere they go, and they are good quality so they hold together well. my girl is 4 and my son is almost 8 and he still loves his select animals.

product_title: Hasbro Elefun
review_body: All three of my grandkids loved this toy, and it has lasted for over 10 years, which is pretty good.  I bring it out to encourage cleaning up of toys after play time.  The nets have all stayed in tact.  You will need to be careful with the plastic trunk when packing.  Sometimes the butterflies stick, but a gentle tap and up they fly.  I will agree with others that the batteries are a drag and more butterflies would have been great, but the grandkids love it, move around with it, so I couldn't be happier.

product_title: Melissa & Doug Easel Paper Roll
review_body: This paper can withstand quite a bit. I just wish I could find it in stores instead of ordering it, but oh well. I would recommend this paper and have recommended Amazon since this is the only place that sells it the cheapest.

product_title: ToyPresidents Inc Talking President William Clinton Doll
review_body: There are so many of these talking Clinton's out there...and it's nice to know that this one says a lot of obscure stuff.  Great item to complete your collection of Clintonia.    The doll is very well presented--lots of detail.

product_title: Shrek Babble & Play Orgre Baby Boy
review_body: Cute, arrived quickly, if bumped, moved, or even walked by, the baby would start babbling...and babbling...and babbling for about two weeks, before I was finally able to get it off my hands to obviously drive my daughter-in-law crazy with it...Real Critic...the kids... it was for 2year old little grandaughter (*who absolutely loves Shreck III ) she fell in love with the darn thing...that's what's it really all about!!!!Thumbs up!

product_title: Little Tikes Push & Ride Racer
review_body: We purchased this item about 4 months ago when our son had just turned 1.  He has really enjoyed it.  In retrospect, I should have ordered it earlier--when he began to walk (an early 9 months old) as it could really have been safely and enjoyably used from that time.      The item does not have a steering column, and we have observed that our son seems ready to move on to a vehicle he can steer.  Don't get me wrong, he certainly compensates by scooting and sliding around corners without any real struggle--but we think he is ready to graduate and have ordered one of the small Radio Flyer trikes that have 'real steering'.    The quality of the vehicle is standard heavy Little Tikes plastic.  Unfortunately, on our unit the plastic on the body of the vehicle cracked at the back axle (the axle is metal) which now makes for a wobbly ride, but we chalk that up more to our kid's rough sense of play and delight in tipping and crashing the unit than a universal lack of quality.  Therefore, we are generally pleased with this product and would recommend this gift for any walkers-early or late.

product_title: Mr. Potato Head: Santa Spud Claus
review_body: I bought this as a gift for my youngest nephew who is just two. I don't think you can go wrong with Mr Potato Head. Great potential for imaginative and creative play for children of all ages.  Light enough to post to the UK and doesn't cost the earth.  The fact that it is a Santa is just the icing on the cake at christmas

product_title: Pacific Play Tents  Super Duper Dome
review_headline: Great indoor toy and great value too!
review_body: I bought this tent for my 5yr old who just recently broke his foot. We were scrambling for ideas and activities that didn't require lots of movement for his foot. Not only did this tent encourage independent play, but since he was already crawling around all over the floor anyway(becasue of his cast) this was just perfect! And an added bonus is that there are flaps where you can add the tunnels for crawling through and there is a 'lip' to the tent so if you want to add balls for playtime, you can do that too. We found a construction themed rug at our local Wal-Mart that is just about the same size as the 'floor' of this tent and so we put the rug inside and I didn't see my son for hours (although I could still hear him just fine!)!!! He was having a great time. Another bonus was that it's $10.00 LESS online at Amazon that it is at the Toys R Us store AND that's WITH the free shipping!!! It got here super quick too- just in a matter of days and arrived UPS. All in all, this was the best purchase I made since he broke his foot. Not only has it kept him entertained, but I imagine it will in the years too come- even dad kind of enjoyed it- they're planning on camping-out in the living room!!!

product_title: Tomy Pull Along Puppy
review_body: I ordered this from Toyscamp and don't know if I got a defected one as I can't return it. When you pull the puppy the front wheels seem to lock up, make clicking noises when you pull it, and the puppy falls over.

product_title: LeapFrog Leapster TV Learning System
review_headline: Good fun education while they are playing games
review_body: This system is very durable. My children have pulled at it, stepped on it, dropped it, etc. and it still works fine. The graphics aren't the greatest because it is meant originally for a much smaller screen, but it gets to the point of the system to play a game and learn. Games are well done and can use the joystick or the pen. The only problem I have encountered is that games designed for the touchscreen like the draw and write one don't translate entirely well to this. When you could easily trace a letter on the touchscreen my son and I find it difficult to do easily on the joystick touchpad accurately. Other than that everything works fine and would recommend it.  Each game has multiple levels which opens up new features and game content when played. The games can be on sale sometimes and are worth it.

product_title: Radio Flyer Ultimate Family WagonTM
review_body: We haven't used this on a vacation yet (though we plan to in a couple of weeks), but my kids already love this wagon.  At a recent birthday party at my house the kids wanted to take turns getting pulled around the yard in it.  We also love the canopy!  It will work out great for our upcoming vacation.

product_title: Manhattan Toy Skwish  Rattle and Teether Grasping Activity Toy
review_body: My son is seven months old and he enjoys his skwish toy. He likes to look at it and shake it and examine it and chew on it.  It arrived less that 48 hours after ordering it with standard shipping. I had a question and I called the toy company's customer service and they were quick, courteous, and helpful. I needed to verify that it was OK that the baby chewed on it (with all the toy scares in the news) and my fears were put to rest. YES, it is safe for the baby to chew on!

product_title: Erector Best of 50 Model Construction Set
review_body: This set can make the crane truck, but not multiple projects. Its not 50 models at the same time.  The shaft collars are weak, when you have gears driving gears they should have screw locking collars instead of rubber and plastic collars. The instructions are a little weak also. My son, 6 yrs old, enjoyed the building but was disappointed in the functionality.

product_title: American Girl Doll Clothes Green Formal Dress
review_body: I bought this for my Chatty Cathy to wear for the Christmas season, she was lovely.

product_title: Melissa & Doug
review_body: We bought this for our 5 year old for Christmas. He loves to draw. I also bought dry markers and an eraser so he would be ready to get started. IT WAS A HIT! The directions were difficult to understand but if you can look at the picture on the box you can put it together! Unfortunetly, I didnt check the box when it came and there was no paper roll in it. :( I called when I opened it and I received a credit to my account. He has played with it everyday since Christmas!

product_title: Jakks Pacific Toymax Lion King Telestory Cartridge
review_body: The Telestory system is an inexpensive way to entertain and teach your child about reading.  Each cartridge has two stories on it.  Your child can choose either to have it read to him or read himself.  The video quality isn't crystal clear, but he doesn't seem to notice.  The bad thing is that most of the stores that had the cartridges put them on clearance.  I don't even know if the company makes these anymore.  I over all rated at one star because of this.  It is very difficult to find a variety of cartridges. Since these were clearanced out of virtually every large toy store, I don't forsee them making more.  So a good, cheap toy for your toddler/preschooler if you know that going in you may not be able to get more cartridges easily.

product_title: Standard Go Game
review_body: When I purchsed this board i was very happy with it until I began to get into a full game. I learned that once the game gets around the half way point the small size of the board (13in x 13in) and the oddly shaped stones make it very difficult to continue. It becomes hard not to shift entire lines when trying to remove captured stones or even place pieces. However, the game is still fun and I do enjoy it. I just wish the stones were a bit smaller or the board a bit larger. For beginners this board would do just fine.

product_title: Roll-It Tic-Tac-Toe Board Game
review_body: I actually bought this for my 6 year old son as an intro to math game.  But we have been playing it as a family and it has also been a tool for my 8 year old to reinforce begining math skills.  We have all been having fun with this.  The board does come apart too easy and the chips do move around, but I just have to remind my boys not to bump the board.

product_title: LeapFrog ClickStart My First Computer Adapter
review_headline: You will want to get this
review_body: We ordered the Leap Frog ClickStart My First Computer for both our 3 year old grandson and grandaughter, and on the recommendation of others we got the adapter to go with them. I'm so glad we did. Now their parents don't have to worry about constantly replacing batteries. I might add that the computers have been a tremendous success. The children play with them daily. Our only complaint with that product is that the mouse pad (or paw, in this case) is too small and frustrates the children sometimes. But they are learing to master it.

product_title: Naruto Mattel 3 Inch Mini Figure 3-Pack #3 (Naruto Uzumaki, Sasuke Uchiha & Sakura Haruno)
review_body: I found these to be smaller than what I expected about 2-2.5''.  however they do have excellent detail for the size and price.

product_title: Usaopoly Pirates Of The Caribbean Trilogy Edition Monopoly
review_body: The \\"Pirates\\" Monopoly game is a fun collector's item for anyone who loved the series of movies. And for fans of Monopoly. One version of the Pirates Monopoly includes the lyrics to the \\"Yo-Ho\\" song, printed on the inside of the box. I bought both versions. One to keep as a collector's item, and one that we get to play with. It made a great gift!

product_title: Disney Peter Pan Neverland 12" Infant Wendy Plush Doll
review_body: This is a very cute sturdy plush Wendy doll from Peter Pan.  It is a great soft toy for any young one who enjoys imaginative play with dolls.

product_title: Megatech Airstrike Radio Control Airplane
review_body: Father bought me this aircraft.  The first time I used it, I hand launched it.  It flew about 30 feet into the air, then the gears in the engine snapped apart and the plane nose dived into a pond.  After sending it back to the company and 8 weeks later (which made it winter)  I received it back and the gears were still broken.  Never buy an electric again.  Gas engines work better.

product_title: Beach Bucket with Two Sand Shovels
review_body: It's nearly impossible to find sand pails and shovels on line.  I was so glad that I found this on amazon.com.  For the money, this is a great value.  All kids enjoy a pail and shovel at the beach.  I like how it came with 2 shovels, too - so you can play with your child and not just be an observer.

product_title: Radio Flyer 12S Classic Walker Wagon
review_body: We got this walking toy as a gift for my Twin's 1st birthday and LOVE it. They can push it on carpet, wood floors, grass, and sidewalk. It is different from most other push toys because it cannot get away from them! I would highly recommend this push toy above all others. They also can both fit in the wagon (it is a tight fit) and enjoy being pushed! Great product!

product_title: Portapuzzle Deluxe 1000 (Jigsaw Puzzle Accessory)
review_body: I have always looked for something that was portable that I could do 1000 piece puzzles on, but I have never found anything, until now. This portable puzzle holder is big enough for 1000 piece puzzles and it is easy to move. If you have some pieces already put together, it is no problem moving them, because they stay put while you move the case. I am so happy with my purchase, and I know that it will last a lifetime.

review_body: This toy is adorable!!! As soon as I sat my 7 month old son in front of it he fell in love. product_title: Esphera 360 12" Globe Puzzle
review_headline: Very fun and super cute decoration!
review_body: My boyfriend and I love working puzzles. I read reviews of other sphere globe puzzles and this one intrigued me the most. It's the largest globe puzzle I have seen (960 pieces). The pieces are curved, made of plastic and fit together nicely.  We started with the countries (not using the #s) and then used the #s on the back to put the bodies of water together.  It was a little challenging to put the last piece at the very top, but the finished product is very nice!  It's so pretty I don't want to take it apart.  I would like to give as gifts. review_body: We pulled ours out again yesterday...we've had it for about a year.  I am very impressed with the quality of the construction, and the ease of use. product_title: Fisher-Price Little Superstar Sing-Along Stage
review_body: My eight month old stays occupied with this toy for 15-20 minutes at a time which is *huge* for her.  She loves the lights and music.    I love that unlike some toys with buttons to press, it's not a problem if she presses different buttons (the drum, the trumpet, the keyboard, the guitar) more than once while a song is going.      When you initially press a button, a song starts with a full band sound playing.  While that song is playing, you can hit any one of those buttons and the background band music will suddenly feature *only* the instrument you pressed.  This lasts for a phrase or so and then the entire band comes back.  Then you can press a different instrument in the same song and *that* instrument only will be featured.  Very cool.      She doesn't understand all this at this age, but with parental interaction as she grows older, I think it's a great opportunity to talk about the different instruments.      Fantastic toy!

product_title: Happy Birthday Singing Cake Plate

product_title: Kidkraft Nursing Stool
review_body: Usually when the ad says, \\"Easy to assemble\\" I cringe because I have not had many experiences when that process ended up \\"easy.\\"  In this case, their advertising was correct. I'm not sure why they would label it as such when it is just a wonderful little foot stool.  I use it under my computer desk and it is lovely to have something to rest my feet upon.  It is beautiful and functional too.  I highly recommend this product.

product_title: Pokemon Junior Ready Bed
review_body: I bought two of these for my 3 1/2 year old twin boys for a upcoming trip (thought they would be better than getting roll away beds in the hotel room). This product is perfect for my 3 1/2 year old, but too small for my 8 year old, so I wouldn't buy it for an older child.  For the price, I think it is a great buy and I am happy with my purchase.

product_title: Step2  WaterWheel Activity Play Table
review_headline: Lots of Fun for the Price
review_body:
I recently purchased the water wheel table after looking at just about every kind available. Although I originally wanted a sand/water combo, I'm glad that I went with the water-only version. My 21-month-old is not known for sticking with one activity for very long, but she seems to love this toy.

Though we haven't had the table for long, I am very glad I didn't spend more on the larger combo tables.

Here are the pros:
~ Extremely easy to assemble. Absolutely no tools required and assembly, from box to completion, took less than 5 minutes.
~ Very light-weight and compact. The table is easy for an adult to lift (without the water) but it is still sturdy enough for a toddler. While this table is more compact than many on the market, it will accomodate 2-3 toddlers quite easily.
~ Less messy than combo tables. No sand to mix for a muddy mess.
~ Comes with water wheel, cup and two sail boats.

Here are the Cons:
~ Mine does not appear to have a plug. No leaks this way, but a bit harder to drain. However it is small enough that an adult can easily tip it over for cleaning.
~ No cover. This is my only real complaint. If a cover had been included, this would be ideal. However, the compact size makes it easy to drain and fill, so the lack of cover isn't really a big deal.
~ The water wheel is not attached and can be knocked over pretty easily. Not a big deal, but something to note.
~ The toys are just okay. I'll be adding more.

Overall, I found the water wheel table to be a good value, particularly if you want a more compact water table that is easy to assemble, move and store.

product_title: Girls Ladybug Mini Backpack - Pink
review_body: I bought the backpack for my 6 year old daughter. She loves to carry her small toys/stuffed animals around. This small backpack fits what she wants when we go out for the day and is easy for her to carry. She loves to use it.

product_title: Marvel Legends 6" Figure: Bishop
review_body:
In case you are unfamiliar with the character of Bishop, and my title confused you, Bishop is one of 2 X-Men who have been temporally dislocated from a possible future into our present timeline. The other is Cable in case you were wondering.
I recently had the chance to pick up both versions of Bishop, and I must say the Bald Variant, is by far my favorite figre of this series, possibly of the entire ML line. Part of that could be his resemblence to Avery Brooks a.k.a. Captain Benjamin Sisko from Star Trek: Deep Space Nine. Okay, okay, a really pissed off Captain Sisko.
Both figures are well made, and seem to feature a brand new sculpt.
Both are well articulated, and very beefy figures. The accessories, the two guns, are very nice, and seeing as some figures in this line don't even have accessories other than their Apocalypse piece.
The varaint features a slightly different head scuplt, as well as slightly different paint ops, and does NOT come with Bishop's almost signature red bandanna (though the card back pictures it with it).
This is a great figure, ready for some serious Kick-Tush! Even if you don't want Apocalypse (are you crazy?) Bishop is still worth getting as he is a great figure in his own right. If you pass this one up you'll just wind up with a sore backside later on.

product_title: Little Tikes Carry Along Musical Keyboard with Teaching Lights
review_headline: Broken in Just a Few Weeks
review_body: My daughter loved this toy, but it broke in just a few weeks.  We changed the battery, tried different brands of batteries, and it still will not work.  She is crushed.  I called the number on the back and they said I have to send the piano with a note and they will send a replacement in 4-6 weeks.  I don't even want another one - it is an absolute piece of junk.  Also - way too many Christmas Carols.  They couldn't find any other songs to include?

product_title: Sea-Monkeys on Mars
review_body: We did as the instructions said. Quite a few monkeys hatched, but quickly died off. There were only 3 left after we got to the first feeding day per the packaging and they were gone before we got to the plasma kit. The kids liked setting it up and watching them hatch, but quickly lost interest.

product_title: Fisher-Price Winnie The Pooh: Turbo Tail Tigger
review_headline: The most wonderful thing about Tigger....
review_body: He makes my son jump! My son got this as a Christmas present at 5 months old. He didn't do much more then stare at it until he hit about 7 months and was sitting on his own. Now every time Tigger sings my son jumps up and down! It's a very cute and he loves his Tigger! He's 1 and still gets a kick out of it. I'm sure he'll enjoy this for a long time!

product_title: Melissa & Doug Fire Truck Jumbo Jigsaw Floor Puzzle (24 pcs, 4 feet long)
review_body: My three and a half year old has had a ton of fun putting together this giant puzzle.  The pieces are large and fit together easily.  If your child loves fire trucks this is a great investment.

product_title: Fisher-Price T.M.X. Tickle Me Elmo
review_body: WOW I love the TMX ELMO, TRUE, I must say I wish it were Softer, Not so Hard, I think my 1 year old is too small for it, I bought it for her, but i must Admit I love to hear him Laugh, Everyone that has come by my house since we got it on the RELEASE DATE, I have shown it too.  WE LOVE ELMO, She watches him on TV everyday I buy all the Elmo and Seasame Street TAPES, SHE LOVES HIM. The reason I think she is too small for him is because she watches him for like 10 seconds and immediately she wants to HUG HIM and LAUGH, I try to keep her from touching him until he is done, She is not as ammused as I am by the Tossing, and Slapping his leg, and rolling over.  I think it is Hilarious, WE LOVE HIM, The kids know that when I get mad and fuss they tickle elmo and it puts an instant smile on my face.  NO HE IS NOT CUDDLEY, But he is still cute Elmo,  I bought her another elmo that was soft for Hugging, But she still wants to hung the Funny Elmo.  I think that is so Sweet.  Definately worth the orignal Price, I would not pay these outrageous EBAY people the big prices for him, They will eventually get one in at the stores for you, I paid right around 45 dollars for him the week before he came out (that was including Shipping charges), I recieved him one day after his release date.  WELL WORTH WHAT I PAID.  Don't get ripped off, or Scammed.  Just wait for the stores to get you one in.

product_title: WEDGiTS Deluxe Set - 30 Piece Set
review_body: This is a great toy for a child who enjoys stacking things.  You can also expand the collection as your child advances his/her skill.  Highly recommended.

product_title: Freightline USA Train Set
review_body: Great ho starting set, pretty advanced with bridge and two tracks changing lanes. Good quality of detail and finishes in the locomotive and cars, plus lots of accessories. Functions perfectly, sure beats other brands because life-like comes with tracks that snap perfectly and don't move around.

product_title: Ben 10 Deluxe OMNITRIX
review_headline: BECOME THE HERO WITH THE OMNITRIX F/X
review_body:
Without a doubt, one of the coolest toys in Bandai's Ben 10 line is the Omnitrix F/X wristband, an exact replica of the one that Ben wears on the hit Cartoon Network animated TV show. This wristband is adjustable and should fit all but the tiniest wrists without a problem. The toys is filled with various lights and sound effects that are taken direct from the TV show.

On the dial is all 10 of the heroes that Ben can transform into. A green light inside illuminates the dial so you can see each of the figures. Turning it makes one sound effect. Keep turning the dial until you find the figure of your choice. Now press the dial all the way down to lock it into place and watch out...several green lights blink all over the wristband as the sounds blare and Ben, or your littler one, become Heatblast, Ghostfreak, Fourarms, or any of the other seven characters, and you're ready to battle the evil Vilgax.

Once your ready to switch characters, just press the button, a red light will blink, and the dial will popup with yet another sound effect and you can now choose a different character on the dial. The lights will remain lit for a short time and eventually turn off by themselves, again with its own unique sound.

The Ominitrx F/X was a very fun toy and fans of the show will love it.

Reviewed by Tim Janson

product_title: S&S Worldwide Keepsake Paperweight Craft Kit (Makes 12)
review_body: When I received my order, I was very surprised to find that these are actually glass ashtrays turned upside down and not paperweights.  They even have the impressions for resting your cigarettes on.  Needless to say, I returned them for a refund.

product_title: LEAPERS -frog
review_body: My 9 month old loves this frog.  He had one and it was lost so I wanted to find him another and of course I found it on Amazon.  He loves it and it is very durable.  We call it Mr. Frog.

product_title: Fisher-Price Little People A Christmas Story
review_body: This is the perfect holiday toy.  It teaches the nativity story and is a constant reminder of the birth of Christ.  We keep it out for months before and after Christmas and my daughter plays with it all the time.  I love it!

product_title: Dollar Bling Necklace - Gold
review_body: Rock this chain & get into the hottest clubs in Vegas.  Creates instant \\"Playa\\" status.  Screams \\"Money\\" which can be used to educate kids.

product_title: Toysmith Touchable Bubbles
review_body:
I've purchased this product many times. People cannot believe the cool things you can do with it! Blow the bubble solution inside in a big space if possible. (Like a gymnasium or standing on stage in front of kids without fans blowing in the room, or if you need to, on a low-wind day outside.) Make sure to aim upwards when you blow. The bubbles will dry for about 30 seconds and float towards the floor. As they float, kids can catch the bubbles on their fingers and stack them into snowmen and other fun configurations. It's fun to see people walking around with bubbles stuck to their heads.

If your office is of light humor, blow them around the cubicles when no one is looking (or even if they are!) The bubbles will land on desks and other things, and stay there for up to 3 weeks. (That's the record I've seen - when a bubble isn't disturbed.)

Bubbles that are fast and wet are full of water and pop quickly by comparison to these - these bubbles are slow and dry and last forever. The wand is small in size, though, so you can only make marble-sized bubbles. FUN!

product_title: Radio Flyer Little Red Scooter
review_body: Item packaged well, arrived on a timely basis, grandchild loves her toy, and it was a smooth transaction. Thanks. Ray arenasart.com

product_title: Bratz HandBag CD BoomBox
review_body: I bought this for my 6 year old daughter for Christmas and she loved it. It is her first CD player and is easy for her to operate. Great sound quality, and the handbag shape is a hit with my older girls.

product_title: Shut The Box, 12 numbers SWI2424
review_body: In the literally hundreds of times that I have purchased off of the internet, this item qualifies as the worst product that I have ever seen for the following reasons: the green \\"felt\\" in the picture is actually a green colored adhesive backed \\"paper\\" that was not even attached to the game, the wooden frame of the game was so out of square (at least 1/4\\") that it wobbles dramatically when placed on a flat surface- not exactly what you want with a dice game(!), and the sides of the dice area are not high enough to play the game effectively.  I do not need to even open the other box to see that I want an immediate refund.  Even if the seller complies, I still have to pay the shipping and \\"restocking\\" fees.  In my opinion, this product is so shoddily manufactured it should never have been offered.  What a disappointment...

product_title: Creations by You Plateworks Design Your Own Plate
review_headline: Becoming a much loved annual tradition!!
review_body:
This is our third year having the children's artwork turned into plates. We have not had any problems with the creation of the plates from this company. The first year we used the Make-it plates and some of the children's artwork was cut off, probably due to the kids coloring over the 1/2 inch boundary (not a problem with this kit). We have also used the kits with special markers where the kids color directly on the plates, and we have had extremely poor results with those kinds of kits - the artwork has not lasted.

Anyway, the kids just love using their art plates and seeing how their artwork has changed over the years. If you have to buy gifts for many children of different ages, this is a particularly good gift because you can kill a lot of birds with one stone - meaning, this gift will satisfy children from 2 up through early middle school, boy and girl.

product_title: Animal Planet's Big Tub of Dinosaurs, 40+ Piece Set
review_body: We got this for our son's third birthday. He knows the dinosaurs' real names and he and his older sister will play with these for hours! I love how they are sized and that they have their own storage bin... Except for throwing away the boulders, which fit neatly into a three year old's mouth and can also kill your feet when stepped on, we have enjoyed everything about this toy! Well worth the money, very much recommended, and I have already told 5 other mothers about them!

product_title: Little People: Beeps the Bus
review_headline: Priced too high...toy great, but not rare
review_body: My son loves this toy...but it is far from rare.  Last week, I bought one for a gift and paid $15.  Try any toy store.

product_title: Win & Start Box
review_headline: Darda Race Tracks are great for Toddlers on up
review_body: My sons are into race cars and tracks since seeing the movie CARS.  They are to little for the electrics race tracks so I bought them a set of Darda tracks and they are so thrilled.  They like designing their own tracks and having races with the cars.  Tracks are very reliable and are plastic to have some give.  Very impressed with Darda Tracks!  Wish they sold them in regular stores.  They have the hardest time waiting for a package to arrive!  They love to have races and start on your mark get set and go!

product_title: Melissa And Doug USA Map Wooden Jigsaw Puzzle
review_body: I purchased this as a Christmas present for great-grandchildren in Japan. They will be moving to the U.S. next year, and I hope this will help them learn about their new country. Their father is a U.S.Navy officer, and mother is Japanese. This looked sturdy and easy for small children to handle.

product_title: Pixar Cars: Chick
review_body: Great little car for your youngster to carry along anywhere.  Perfect to fit in pocket when not in use.  Very durable.

product_title: Bome Dead or Alive Vol 15 Kasumi Figure
review_body: i'm a big fan of monseiur bome, despite only having 3 of the PVCs he's done. the kasumi PVC, like all his others, is extremely well-done..and i'd recommend it for any DOA fan.

product_title: Kristal Educational Dig! Discover Civil War
review_body:
This is a great product. Kristal Educational does a fantastic job in teaching archaeology, palentology, astronomy, or geology through a toy.

This toy also teaches patience and perseverance. Sure, there is a mess issue, but it can be easily contained by simply using newsaper, a little attentiveness, and a \\"project area\\".

Note: This is a \\"project\\" toy. It does take some time to complete. I would not recommend it to any child that has a low attention level.

My daughter received the Wooly Mammoth Dig Kit as a gift and she enjoyed it immensely. She still proudly displays it today.

product_title: VTech - V.Smile TV Learning System
review_body:
I purchased this system for my 4 yr old daughter. The joystick is very easy even for the beginner to use, and the games are entertaining, and most importantly educational. The game it comes with is surprisingly fun, and I even find my husband taking over the control, and playing himself! The top is a storage unit, so we don't lose any of the games. My daughter is reinforcing the shapes and color knowledge, as well as reviewing letters and numbers.

I would recommend it to anyone.

product_title: Step2  Stock Car Convertible Bed
review_body:
We got this bed for our 2 year old son, who was just leaving his crib, and he LOVES it. He sat in it the first day and just pretended to drive for hours.
The only problem I have with it is when you use a crib mattress there are 4 inch gaps around the top and sides. The first night my son rolled off the mattress into the gap and woke up. We fixed the problem with a few blankets stuffed in the gaps, and the next night had no problems. I just wish I could have seen that before I bought it.
It was real easy to put together, but I will agree use a power screw driver and save your arms!

product_title: Spin Master Toys Phlat Ball
review_body: This toy is not worth the money.  Buy a frisbee and a ball instead.  The commerical shows how it magically turns into a ball when its in the air.  The box states that this will happen only at random times and the more you play with it, the better it will work.  It turns into a ball when it hits the ground usually and our kids lost interest very quickly.  A big disapointment!!lang war, um es auf das CD Cover zu drucken) seine neue Liebe: Liebeslieder. Doch auch diese bleiben unverschont von seinem Wortwitz und hin und wieder einem makaberen Hauch.    Wer also Klavier, Wortwitz und eine dynamische Show liebt, ist bei Bodo Wartke genau richtig. Doch auch wenn man kein Freund von Klavierkabarett ist, dann kann man schnell in dessen Fänge geraten (und da spreche ich aus Erfahrung!).  Für dieses (zweite) Programm empfiehlt es sich jedoch, das erste Programm \\"Ich denke, also sing' ich\\" mindestens zu kennen. So bemerkt man auch die Anspielungen auf die alten Zeiten und kann auch die Reaktionen des Publikums besser verstehen.

product_title: Pop-Onz Building System: Pop 'n Twirl Building Table with exclusive bonus
review_body: Teaches them good building skills! We really like that it has a storage compartment underneath it, it teaches them how to keep their toys altogether and organized! They really like the spinning action too! It really is a Great Toy! And since the price came down, it's even more afordable!

product_title: Fisher Price - Little People Pirate Lil' Sea Skiff
review_body:
We got this one before Santa brought the big Pirate Ship.
This littel one is actually a bathtime buddy.
Unfortunately, little people have holes so the water gets in.
The boat sinks since it is not designed to be in the bathtub. But that is where our kids use it.
Hold up really well. And is like every little people toy, fun to play with, look at and have around. Durable, easy to clean and to store away and individually or together with the big Pirate ship it makes a fun toy to bring alone in the car, or even bathtub, or just to play daily with it in your home.
The price is good.

product_title: VS-MAXX 5-in1 Speed Racer Video Game
review_body: I had previously been in contact with someone at Senario, and she informed me that this project has been scrapped. The release date for this product has changed at least a dozen times since January. If you do order one, and it does arrive, please leave a review.

product_title: Sunsout Trout Story Shaped 1000 Piece Jigsaw Puzzle
review_body: - Nice picture but there is a white border along the outline of the trout.

product_title: Fisher-Price Laugh & Learn Love to Play Puppy
review_body: This has the potential to be a really neat toy, but frankly, it is WAY too sensitive.  My daughter doesn't like it because the sounds end up being a jumbled mess. It also pipes up for no reason and the \\"off\\" button has yet to work!

product_title: 13' x 33" Simple Set Pool System
review_body: My in-laws bought this pool for us last year- actually for my son. We first filled it up- all the way- and it tilted so bad because the land was not perfectly level. So we dumped out all the water and my poor husband completely dug up the grass and leveled out the ground (or so we thought). We filled the pool up again and enjoyed a couple of weeks of swimming until the pool started tilting so bad you could see the bottom seem on one side. We got to the point where we were afraid it was going to bust. Again we dumped out the water and just put it away for the rest of the summer.   This summer my husband has completely built a new concrete patio- with caissons and everything. We happily filled up the pool thinking \\"this is it! It's going to work!\\" Until it started tilting again. But it wasn't bad. So we left it- thinking maybe it was stretched out from last year? This morning, once again, we could see the bottom seams!! I'm sick of this!! So we called Toys R Us and LUCKILY  we had purchased the 1 year warranty. Toys R Us did not seem at all surprised and told us how we can easily get our money back. Now we're trying the metal frame- but we'll be sure to get the warranty again.  This so called in expensive pool ended up costing us over $[...] for everything we needed to do just to fill the stupid thing!!

product_title: Spinmaster Aquadoodle Draw N' Doodle Mat Asst.
review_headline: A gift that keeps on giving!
review_body: We got this Aquadoodle basic mat for our very creative nephew and neice. They both love to draw, and going through a million sheets of paper a day for every scribble can get crazy. Not to mention it can be a little limited at times. The Aquadoodle gives them the chance to draw their hearts out without making any mess. The pen holds a good amount of water, so there is no need to constantly fill it up! Not only do you have the pen to use, but you can use virtually anything that you can get wet, such as your fingers, finger painting style! : ) Since there are two of them, we had to buy some extra accessories because the basic mat only comes with one pen and didn't want them fighting over it. I recommend getting the extra pen/stamp set. They love it! The mat is featured with letters and various shapes along the edges which also assist children in learning new words and writing them out. It's not only a fun toy but it's great for teaching them new things. I highly recommend the Aquadoodle! It keeps kids busy with hours of countless fun, and there's no mess to be cleaned up! It's the perfect gift!

product_title: Power Rangers Mystic Force Mystic Morpher
review_body:
I'm typing this for my 8 year old son:

I had a Toys R Us card with $20 on it and I bought one for my brother and me. I think this toy is cool because it can flip out and out again and makes really fun sounds. It also comes with three codes...

123 - transforms you into any Ranger
124 - calls your motorcycle
125 - turns you into a Ranger Robot

And I just think this toy is really awesome!

product_title: Barbie in The 12 Dancing Princesses: Interactive Princess Genevieve "Let's Dance" Doll
review_body: My daughter likes this toy.  It's fun to watch her do the ballet moves.  It takes a lot of batteries though.

product_title: Go Fish for Letters Card Game
review_body: My students enjoy this game and are learning to make words at the same time.  They are now convinced that you can't make a word without a vowel - a concept that was difficult for them to remember when they were writing.

product_title: LeapFrog Fridge Words Magnetic Word Builder
review_headline: Great toy once the kinks are worked out...
review_body:
My kids got this for Christmas. As some other reviews mentioned, the letter identification was not always correct. My husband discovered that a piece of plastic on the \\"reader\\" (the area in which you place your magnetic letter) had gotten jammed down. Once he popped the piece out, it began functioning correctly. For some reason, the letter \\"M\\" is not magnetized in our set; it won't stick to the fridge. We are waiting to hear back from LeapFrog on whether or not they can replace that one letter.

On the whole though, it's a great \\"toy\\". The kids just love it - my 4 year old and 2 year old both. One thing of interest is that it will not pronounce words that may be considered offensive. One that surprised me was that it will not read \\"GOD\\". That's not a problem - but just something I found interesting.

In spite of the few minor problems we've had, I would absolutely buy this product again. I'm hoping to add the Lower Case letters at some point... if we can find the room on our refrigerator for even more Leap Frog products! :-)

product_title: Disney Cars: Radiator Springs Mountain Challenge Track Set
review_body: My son received this for Christmas.  I thought it was a great idea for something to do with all of the cars.  He has almost every car since he loves the movie.  He played with it for a few days and never turned it on again.  The \\"wheel\\" does not really work well.  I guess you can only watch cars race along a track so many times.....

product_title: HABA Sleepy Princess and the Pea
review_body: My 3 year old daughter loves this game and it comes with two types of play - one is simple enough for her to understand and the other is a little more complicated.  That way, the children can play the game for years.  The whole thing is just so cute.  I would recommend this game to parents looking to buy a first game for a young child.

product_title: Radio Flyer Fold 2 Go Trike
review_body: Bought this for our son when he was 18 months old.  He's a very physical child and picked up on peddling quite quickly.  By 2 yrs old this trike became unsafe.  He was going so fast that this trike would constantly tip around corners.  Not due to my sons steering but the trike being so \\"light in the pants\\".  We bought him a 12 inch big boy bike just after his second birthday and he is much safer on that than on this trike.

product_title: Tri-Scooter - Blue
review_body: The scooter is great.  The company it came from did a poor job with the shipping (arrived late), but the product itself is high quality, very stable, fast enough to be fun but not so fast as to be uncontrollable.

product_title: Lamaze Musical Inchworm
review_body: I think this is a great toy for a baby once they are able to grab things and want to touch everything.  My little girl is almost 6 months and is just now really appreciating how cool this inchworm is!  She loves the crinkle sound and the song it plays and all the different textures - it makes her smile.

product_title: GeoTrax Working Town Train Railway Playset
review_body: what a wonderful first train. i bought this for my grandson who is 4 and he loved it. played with it with out batteries for hours. i almost hate to buy batteries, his imagination just exploded.

product_title: Scotland Yard Board Game
review_headline: Good idea - but dull in practice for less than 6 people
review_body: This game does not work with less than 6 players - playing as a family of 4 over the Xmas & New Year holidays we found that the detectives simply cannot move fast enough to catch the mystery person, and it quickly becomes rather tedious.

product_title: Cranium Bumparena
review_body: We are a big game family and have all of the Cranium games.  I love the new ideas they have and am constantly impressed by their uniting of intelligence and fun, however, bumparena is not their best work.  Now, my daughter might be a little on the old side for this game (9), but she still loves Hullabulo and Cariboo, which are aimed at the younger kids.  Bumperena is just not fun over and over.  It also is a pain to set up and doesn't fit back in the box.  The idea is cool, and the pieces are cool looking, but the game is not exciting and it sits on our shelf collecting dust.  You would do better to invest in Cadoo, the Family Fun Cranium or Balloon Lagoon.  These days, my daughter is really into Conga, but if your kids are under 7, I wouldn't recommend it, there is a lot of writing with out assistance.  Bumperena is overrated.

product_title: Learning Resources Jumbo Farm Animals
review_body:
Great, great animal set! My 25 month old daughter is just NUTS about animals! Our 14 mo. old son likes them too- He's just learning animal names and these are a help.
1. Love that there is a good variety- horse, cow, sheep, goat, pig,
rooster, goose.
2. Animals are a nice size- perfect for little hands.
3. Even though they are a little big, our kids love to use them with the Little People Farm set.
4. Our kids like to play games with them- where is the rooster....? Or, because they are a good size we'll take something small, like a soup cracker or something and hide it under, on top of , beside, etc. an animal. Then ask, \\"where is the cracker? It's *under* the cow...\\"

The only con.... There is no wild animals set! We'd buy another set if they offered one.

product_title: LeapFrog LeapStart Learning Gym
review_headline: I wish my daughter loved this as much as I do...
review_body: This activity center is diverse, educational and well made. I had a little trouble putting it together, in that the pieces were a little difficult to snap into one another in some places. My daughter has two activity gyms, one, the leap start, and another, some generic playmat that a family member gave her as a christmas gift. When I got the generic mat, I was thinking I would never use it, but it travels easily so I went ahead and put it together. To my surprise, my daughter loved the generic mat, while she seems to really dislike the leap start learning gym. She is still on her back and not sitting up on her own, I am hoping as she gets older she will enjoy the gym more. It's great that is has more than one mode of play, but right now whenever I put her under it she cries. Maybe it over stimulates her a bit. Maybe it's just my daughter though, and you will have a better experience with it. Right now, my recommendation is to get one that is cheaper, and your baby will probably like it just as much if not better than the leap start, especially if you are using it while he or she is still laying on the back to play.

product_title: 4-Ever Best Friends Bumper Cars
review_body: These little bumper cars are so cute.  My daughter loves watching the ride at the amusement parks so these are fun for her to put the dolls in and make them collide like the ride.  They have a removable bumper so your child can play with them as cars (with wheels).  Very cute!

product_title: WowWee FlyTech R/C Dragonfly (WW260BLU)
review_body: I bought this on a whim, and am I glad I did.  This is the first flying RC I have ever bought, and right out of the package, with 10 minutes of practice I had this beast flying 40 feet in the air.  Very durable (a plus when you are beginning), this thing flies indoors and outdoors.  I fly it in the gymnasium where I work. Outside, the wind must be minimal, but the sky is the limit.  The more you play, the better you get at doing tricks and dives.  A great bonus is it charges off the remote (6AA), flies around 8-10 minutes a charge, recharges in 20-30 minutes.  Just plain fun.

product_title: Baby Einstein Language Discovery Cards
review_body: My daughter has had these cards since she was born, I think, or shortly after. She has learned so many words from them! I love that the reverse side has hints for the parents of things to say while showing your child the cards, they also have translations of the word into chinese, hebrew, russian, french, spanish, and german all on each card! The photos are clear and colorful, and the sets includes blank cards to add your own pictures. We added a picture of me for \\"Mommy\\" and Dad too! She's 19 months old now and she asks for the cards frequently. They are really durable, I discourage it but she does bend them in half and chew on them occasionally but they're still in great shape!

product_title: Cars Little Rides - Mater
review_body: my little one was so excited to see he got his favorite tow truck - Mater...but was quickly discouraged at how dificult it was to \\"drive\\" Mater with the control (Mater did not go where he wanted it to go)

product_title: Win, Lose or Draw Video Game
review_body: Yes, I agree, the drawing can be a little difficult. But, in my opinion, it makes the game so much more fun. Because the things that are normally really simple to draw get slighty more challenging. Everytime I play this game with family or friends we have the best time. So many people ask me to bring it to any get togethers. We always end up laughing so hard at what everyone tries to draw. It really is a whole lot of fun.

product_title: LEGO Technic Mobile Crane
review_headline: Third lego crane - keep em comin
review_body:
Another AFOL here. I bought this for my own Christmas present, needed to wait 7 weeks, and finally got to put it together over the spring. There are gobs of nice parts, and the crane does a very good job teaching mechanical concepts. As a learning tool it is a great value. As a parts tool it is a very good value.

From shelf appeal, its better then ... well, a lot of things come to mind!

One thing that is quite odd. The crane hook goes up and down w/ the boom as the boom extends. I reassembled the motor assembly twice, and the box indicates that they are separate control functions. Very odd.

review_body:
This particular model was produced on Breyer's popular Sham mold, which was sculpted in the mid 1980's. This mold has never been produced in many colors but never black, making Walter Farley's The Black Stallion a unique addition to any Breyer collection.

This model is a small traditional scale horse, meaning that some other horses in the traditional scale will be fairly larger than he is. However, the scale different is not as appear ant as with some other models and he should fit in just fine with the rest of you herd. He'll just be the little guy.

This model shows a beautiful and accurate depiction of a traditional desert type Arabian, or Egyptian Arabian. Desert bred Arabians tend to be smaller, more delicate in appearance, and blessed with an abundance of flowing mane and tail. As you can see, this horse has all those characteristics. He is proud and alert.

Accurate and educational, this horse is also suitable for play. He stands squarely and poses no danger of tipping over. As with all Breyer horses, his ears are a bit delicate and may chip if bumped against a hard surface or dropped. Breyer's also occasionally break legs after taking bag falls or being dropped. But they hold up well to play.

A great toy for any horse loving child. Collectors favorite as well!

product_title: LEGO Exo-Force Sonic Phantom
review_headline: Not as durable as you want....
review_body:
I'm Toysrus's new critic and my (not real) name is D.L.Smith (no I didnt' pick the name Mom X5, that is my mom's review name) . I used to collect LEGO movie sets like Spiderman and Harry Potter. Now I just use those sets to make new things like forts , but occasionally I'll buy sets that have ships and tanks. This is why I like stuff like LEGO Vikings, Knights Kingdom, and Dino Attack to add cool stuff to my forts. Anyways, that is why I first decided to buy LEGO EXO Force.I thought the cool weapons and robot fighters would make a neat addition to my expanding collection, so I bought two sets so far: this product and the Fire Vulture. I must say that the Sonic Phantom hasn't impressed me much. You will see why.

Durability. That is the key word that LEGO's need to have, and I must admit this is not a very well put toy. Small parts would snap off (after it was done) and it would be annoying to keep putting them on. The one part that snapped off the most would be the laser canon. The laser cannon was pretty annoying and cramped in a narrow space so so you couldn't keep it at a decent angle. Also, the laser canon had a very pathetic beam. I turned off all the lights and put my hand in fromt of it and it didn't shine my hand. I would be willing to pay a few extra dollars for LEGO to make it at least as strong as a laser pointer key chain. If you can't stand badly-put-togheter toys then I do not reccomend buying this toy for all the annoying parts that never seem to stop falling off.

Even though this toy is not too durable, it can still be fun to run around with in your hand like a toy airplane. It has a great place to hold on to to and shoot with the missile( shoots about 7 ft.), which is why I would give the toy 2 and a half stars if Toysrus.com would let you. JUST MAKE SURE NOT TO DROP IT,TRUST ME. The set comes with a small robot to operate the set, nothing special about him. All in all, this toy is fun if you just like to run around with toys shooting stuff.

product_title: Fisher Price ESPN Fast Action Football Electronic Game Table
review_headline: Pretty fun, and a decent workout too
review_body: [...]    Had they priced it in the neighborhood of what it's actually selling for these days [...], run a few TV ads, and maybe had some in-store demos to show people how it worked, this might've been THE hot toy for the 2006 holidays.  It's a very clever idea, it works just as it's supposed to, and it's something that kids and adults can play together.    It took me about 90 minutes to put together, but I was watching TV at the time.  Had I been focused, it probably would've taken about an hour.  The only necessary tool is a phillips-head screwdriver.  One person can assemble it alone, and you don't have to be a handyman to do it.  You do need to apply a little elbow grease to fit everything together, though.  It's an adult job (albeit an easy one).    The gameplay does indeed resemble those old LED games we used to play years ago, with the obvious addition of the footpads, as well as voice and sound effects.  The \\"screen\\" consists of a 7x10 grid.  Each spot on the grid includes 3 separate LEDs: a red player, a yellow player, and a football.  The field is only 7 spaces wide, but scrolls to be 100 spaces long.  The scrolling works very well during play.    The player that you control is differentiated from the others by blinking.  Sometimes it can get a little confusing when lots of players are bunched together and moving around, but for the most part it works fine.  The fact that there are separate LEDs for the red and yellow teams makes the game more versatile than its monochrome ancestors.    Controls consist of a 4-direction joystick, a large football-shaped button, three small arrow-shaped buttons, and of course the footpad  (each player also has a drink holder, large enough to hold a soda can or beer bottle).  The footpad is a soft mat, not unlike the inexpensive dance game mats you can buy for video game consoles, and is permanently attached to the game's legs.  The large button is used to hike and pass, while the three small buttons are used for play selection.  To move your player on the field, you hold the joystick in the desired direction and run in place on the mat.  For every 2 steps (one with each foot), the player will move 1 space on the field.  The faster you run, the faster he moves!  When you kick or punt, a football will zip back and forth across the field, and you try to step on the footpad when it's lined up with your kicker.  I recommend playing in socks rather than shoes (except for small kids), as the footpads will last longer that way.    There are 3 play modes:  Practice, Rookie, and Pro.  All of them can be played alone against the computer or head-to-head.  There's no NFL license, but you get to select your team's location (matching all the NFL teams), and the in-game voice announcer will refer to it during the game (\\"New England has second-and-eight at the Chicago 43\\").    Practice Mode features ten different minigames, including things like a simple 100-yard dash, open-field tackling, and 2-minute drills.  They're good for practice or just for quick competition.  Open-field tackling drills are especially fun for 2 players.    Rookie Mode lets you play a full game in 4-minute quarters.  There is no play calling other than deciding to kick or punt -- you just hike the ball and then run or pass as you like.  There are also no turnovers.  The computer is a real pushover in this mode, though.  It's best for younger kids.    Pro Mode adds play-calling, interceptions and fumbles to the mix.  The computer is also much faster and tougher.  Quarters are still 4 minutes.  Fumbles are pretty rare, and interceptions happen when you pass and an opposing player is in the way (but not every time -- the pass might just fall incomplete).  Play-calling is pretty simple -- you can select run or pass, and left, middle, or right.  You can also punt, kick, or try a fake kick.  Play choices are the same on offense and defense.    Note that the computer doesn't manage the clock properly -- it won't always call a timeoutwhen it obviously should stop the clock.  But if you're looking for a serious football game, you're better off with a PS2 or XBox disc.    So is it fun?  You bet.  It's not going to enthrall an adult or teenager for hours on end, but if you like electronic games and you want to get a quick workout, this is a good way to go.  You can really work up a sweat in 16 minutes of running in place!    One last comment, regarding the physical size of the game -- it's a bit bigger than I expected, which is both a good thing (most adults can play it comfortably) and a bad thing (you need a decent-sized space in which to keep it; it's not something you can just take apart easily for storage).  It's not all that heavy, but it is fairly sturdy, with most of its weight in the metal legs.  One adult can lift it, although it's a bit awkward for one person to carry around.    I am 6 feet tall, and I wouldn't recommend it for people who are much taller than that.  At my height, I play with my hand resting on top of the joystick.  The shape of the joystick (a large sculpted plastic football player torso/ head) makes it easy to play that way, which is good because the grip part of the joystick would be too low for me.  If you're much taller than 6 feet, you might have to bend over enough that you'll be uncomfortable.  Also, if you are a very wide person, the foot sensors might be too close together for you.  I weigh around 200 lbs and have a fairly average build, and it's totally fine for me.  If you weigh 300, then it might be hard for you to stand between the game's legs (which are not adjustable).    To summarize the last paragraph, if you are really big, try before you buy.    So if you're looking for a serious football game, look elsewhere, but if you're looking for a fun and different way to get a little exercise, or a way to get your video-game-addicted child off the couch, this is a great toy (at the prices it's going for now, that is -- $200 is way too much, but the $35 I paid was a steal).

product_title: Ravensburger Enchanted Forest - Family Game
review_body:
The good King is looking for someone to take over the Throne as he has no children. He has decided to ask people to locate magic treasure to prove their worth.

The board is made up of twisting and branching paths that lead from the village, through the forest, and into the castle. Cards are used to determine what the King is looking for. The card has a scene from a popular fairy tale and a picture of the desired object. Players move their pieces through the forest looking for trees. Each of the tree pieces has a treasure hidden under it. Players landing on a tree get to secretly look at the treasure. Once they know where the desired treasure is, they can head to the castle to tell the King. The first player to successfully find three desired treasures wins the game.

Magic can also be used in the game. On certain rolls of the dice, players can teleport to any tree of their choosing, go to the castle gate, or randomly change the desired treasure card. Movement is a little different than in most games. Two dice are used but they are not added. For instance, a roll of a 5 and a 4 can get you nine spaces along but it can also get you five spaces in one direction and four in another. In this way a 4 and a 5 can be used to move one space. Thus subtraction skills become as important as addition skills. While my two kids love the game (ages four and seven) it has elements that make it palatable to the adult as well. Check it out.

product_title: Mattel Hot Wheels 1999 1:64 Scale Gold BMW 850I Die Cast Car Collector #1093
review_body:
Yes, the 840/850 series is no longer in production (1991-1997). (I have to wonder why it took Mattel another two years to produce a model of this vehicle.) And yes, this Mattel model is no longer in production, a collector's item of a collector's item, so I guess that makes it something to hold onto. That being said, this is jut a plain sloppy and shoddy representation of what is arguably the finest body design BMW has ever rolled out. This model is off in so many ways: the slope of the hood, the shape of the cabin, and especially the length and slope/taper of the trunk. The rearview profile also is off, as is a head-on view. Yeah, it's a toy car that retailed for $2.89 or so in its day, but that's no excuse to produce something this shoddy, especially if that BMW name is going to go on it.

That, and BMW never produced one of these in gold. Some evil, deluded gomer somewhere probably violated this car by painting it gold, but I see in Mattel's decision to offer a gold version of this masterwork vehicle just further evidence of their model vehicle designers' and product managers' complete and utter ignorance of this vehicle specifically, and BMW's prestige and achievements in general.

Buy as a collector's item, not as an homage to BMW engineering and design.
