review_body:
The release of this cool figure in a packaging that mirrors the original vintage item is almost like a present from Hasbro to loyal fans and collectors of Star Wars Toys.

Although the price is a bit steep for a 3-3/4\\" figure, this item most certainly must feature on the must-buy, must-have list of every Star Wars fans and avid collectors.

Releasing this item with a protective case makes for easy shipping which ensure that the item inside the protective case remains in a mint condition. This will no doubt please most collectors. Good move, Hasbro!

I cannot vouch for the durability of the item outright because mine is likely to be card and case-bound since I am a collector. But looking at this figure, one can easily tell that it will not just break apart even if handled by a 5-year old kid. The only problem if a kid is to play with it, is that the small blaster pistol might probably get lost in a few minutes.

For collectors, you may want to note that there is a variant in this figure. Whether this is intentional or not, I am not sure. But if you look carefully at the belt of this Scout Trooper, you will notice that some of it comes in a completely white-coloured scheme, almost like the colour for the main part of the figure's body. The variant will come with a slightly yellowish-brown colour in the belt while the body of the figure remains white.

product_title: HABA Half Dozen Wooden Eggs in Real Egg Carton Realistic Play Food
review_body: I found this purchase to be in reality what I expected it to be from the advertising photo.  It is a reasonable size (the eggs are 1 1/2\\" long), and likely to stand up to many years of play.

product_title: Barbie Hot Tub Party Bus Vehicle Play Set
review_body: I bought this for my 4 year old daughter who just loves Barbie. However this is the most cheaply made toy I have ever seen!! It constantly falls apart when trying to play with it. We returned it the next day. I was so dissapointed with this. Even my daughter was not upset to take it back.

product_title: So Soft Baby Girl
review_body: I bought this for my grand daughter's first Christmas and she seems to love it (she is 11 months old).  It is very soft and cuddly and appears that it will launder well - haven't had to do that yet.

product_title: Barbie Fairytopia Mermaidia Playset
review_body:
My daughter received one of these from her grandparents for Christmas. I read a review stating that this was junk and so wasn't in a hurry to set it up. I put it together this morning. It went together easily. I had no directions to follow (daughter opened the box and may have lost them). I easily put it together by looking at the pictures on the box. It seems quite sturdy to me. My daughter has been playing with it for quite a while with no repairs needed.
The only negative thing I can say about it is that it doesn't come with any dolls. It clearly states that on the box but my 5 year old can't read very good yet and was only going by what the pictures showed.
My daugher didn't have any mermaid dolls so she was using regular Barbies with this set. Yes, they are a little big but that's where imagination comes into play. My daughter did just that this morning. (My Little Ponies work well too!) I confess, however, I just got back from picking up a couple mermaids for her to play with. She got the one shown hanging on the side of the playset and it really isn't much smaller than a typical Barbie.
I was so impressed with this toy and the $4.99 Amazon price that I just ordered one to put up for when I need a birthday present for one of my daughter's friends.

product_title: Fisher-Price Bubble Mower
review_body: My sons can't get enough of this toy.  Everytime we are outside or of course if my husband is mowing the lawn then this lawn mower comes out.  My 4 year old got this for his birthday a year ago and has yet to lose interest.  My 14 month old loves to follow him around and chase all of the bubbles coming out of it.  Its really great and we have absoulutely no complaints.  It's not an educational toy but some toys are just to have fun and this definitely fits the bill in our family!!!

product_title: Viewmaster Finding Nemo Deluxe Gift Set
review_body:
I gave my 2 year old daughter a Viewmaster for Christmas and it has turned out to be one of her favorite toys to play with. She has as much fun with it as I did with one when I was a kid.
It makes a grea toy that the little ones can share with others as they see all the different things when she pulls the handle and the picturers change.

product_title: Fisher-Price Interactive Baby Grand Piano
review_body: My one-year-old got this for her birthday and it was an instant hit.  (We haven't had any trouble with pinched fingers, so I'm going to have to check that out.  I'm having a tough time picturing how that could happen.  Poor kiddos!)  I like that you can set the piano to play music notes, colors, or solfeggio.  Our five-year-old is even enjoying playing all of the songs and practicing her piano skills!  I would highly reccommend this toy- it seems a little pricey, but it totally worth it because of all the features!

product_title: GRACO: Umbrella Doll Stroller in Bear Friend Print
review_body:
My mum bought this for our 1 year old daughter in New Zealand!! My husband and daughter are American and all our baby gear is from there including her Graco travel system. It was very cool that we could get a toy stroller that matched her real one so far away from home!

She absolutely loves it and even though it said from age 3 it is perfect for our early walker. She has a doll that she puts in it and pushes round all over the house. It is light enough for her to manoeuvre easily even though she is really small.

I can't say enough good stuff about this toy and I am seriously considering getting the other Graco toys sent over for her for when our second baby comes so that she can pretend to me a mommy too.

product_title: Hasbro i-Dog Robotic Music Loving Canine - White
review_body: I just got my pink idog today and think it is just the cutest thing. Although I am just learning how to use it,so far I am just so interested in watching it's movements and colors. The problems that I have encountered are that it is quite difficult to \\"turn\\" the pup off and that the \\"on\\" button (nose) is much too sensitive. All you have to do is very lightly tap the nose and the pup makes noises. In addition, I have found that the batteries are a pain to insert as you need a screwdriver. I wish like my ipod, there was a \\"hold\\" button to avoid accidently activating the toy and \\"wasting\\" expensive batteries. I might make the investment and buy re-chargable ones to avoid the cost. Anyway, I look forwars to using it on desk at work.

product_title: Scene It Dvd Game
review_body: My friend bought a different movie DVD game (a much cheaper version) and found it disappointing. After reading other reviews about this game I decided to buy it for her for her birthday. In the past two weeks since she received it, we have played 3 times together and it has been a blast. The questions are creative, the movies clips are of movies we have actually seen (unlike the cheap knockoff) and so far we haven't had any repeats in the questions. The game can be fast or long depending on how you play it. It is also great for playing with 2 people or in teams. I look forward to trying some of the other versions in the future.

product_title: Bratz Wild Wild West - Kiana
review_body: Is she supposed to be a Native American or a cowgirl? The bluish teal color and tannish material make me think she is a Native American, but then when you look at the hat and boots she looks like a cowgirl. So which one is it? Overall she is pretty, I don't like the shredded skirt and leather pants though, so I would not buy this doll.

product_title: Sequence Tin
review_body: I had played this game before and was hooked on it.  It is a fast, easy game where kids can even play with the adults.  It is a great game for when family and friends are over as well since quite a few people can play it!

product_title: Marathon Convertible Car Seat - Olivia
review_headline: Should have bought this one to start with................
review_body: When I first wanted this one with my first child my Husband said no. There was no way he was going to pay that kind of money for a car seat. She is now 2years old and the Evenflow we first bought seems too small for her. We finally bought a Britax and DH went out and even bought a second one for our 8 month old son. Ah I love it when I'm right. I also love the new features like the latch system. It is so easy to install I can do in 5 minutes tops. I can also WASH IT!! Big key in why we had to buy a second car seat. I know the it's very pricey but little key features on it are well worth it. Oh and did I mention it goes up tp 65 lbs??? +++++

product_title: Blue Orange Games Zimbbos Award Winning Wooden Skill Building STEM Counting Stacking Game for Kids
review_body: Great for toddlers through young children.  My son loves animals so he really loves these blocks. Great non-electronic game for kids!

product_title: Mega Bloks Dragons Metal Age THORON Platinum Armor Dragon 9625
review_body: This is perfect for any stop-motion animator. With over 30 posable joints, Thoron is inexpensive compared to other figures.Also, Thoron's nemosis,Stendhal, is a great figure for animation.

product_title: Black-Hasbro i-Dog Robotic Music Loving Canine
review_headline: This dog has legs (my son uses it still after a few months)!
review_body:
Most plastic electronic toys have a lifespan of several days. Some break, most just really aren't as interesting as they appear to be. iDog is different: my son really loves his and he uses it regularly.

It's not a great speaker, but it is an amusing little device with some clever \\"behaviors\\". It gets happy, sad, dances and its ears wiggle to the beat. It doesn't eat batteries. It's not as \\"smart\\" as the manual would have you believe, but it's smart enough. Hey, he's just a dog :-).

The iDog will accept music from any audio source that has a mini plug for headphones (not just iPods). It has a little speaker, but also comes with a cord that you can plug headphones into, as well. It also can \\"listen\\" to music (and respond) without being plugged in at all. Simple, and pretty neat. And the price is right.

Nice job, Hasbro!

product_title: Hasbro Year 2007 Marvel Movie Series "Spider-Man 3" Limited Edition 5 Inch Tall Action Figure - Black Costume SPIDER-MAN with Wall Hanging Web
review_body:
Well first off, why would anyone purchase a limited edition action figure? Answer: to collect. What are collectors particular about with their collections? Answer: the packaging. When I received this product it was already opened, and like a slap in the face, taped back up. I'm mean really, the only difference between this one and the other, non-limited edition one, IS the packaging. The figure itself isn't very detailed, but does have many movable joints.

If your getting this to collect, don't bother and buy from a brick & mortar store. If your getting this as a toy, still don't bother and buy the non-limited edition.

Take care,

product_title: Curious George - Tickle N Giggle
review_body: My son got this for his second birthday, and loves it. He loves \\"tickling\\" George, aka pressing on his feet and belly to get him to laugh. The Magic spot, is indeed magical, we hardly ever find it, but when we do it's a hoot. I haven't seen any of the commercials for it, but do you really expect a toy to be \\"just like in the commercial\\"? Come on now, we all know better than that. I also bought him a \\"little george\\" since for a good while George had to travel with us EVERYWHERE, and my son's first reaction was \\"It doesn't work\\" since \\"little George\\" doesn't giggle, is just a doll. I highly recomend him as a toy and companion for your child...and newborn shirts fit him perfectly!

product_title: Little Virtuoso Sing Along CD Player
review_headline: Excellent Entertainment for Your Small Fry......
review_body:
What a lovely music player for kids! There are toys on the market that don't perform half as well, and some cost twice as much as this. Here is a player that will do the job nicely because it is a REAL player, not just a toy, but it is strong and sturdy and colorful and bright, so it catches and keeps the child's attention, all the while teaching him or her about music, audio storybooks, and so on. What I like about this is that you can never teach a child too early in life how to respect electronics equipment, and with this player Mommy and Daddy's equipment is more safe; first the child will have their own version of the grown-up player, but more importantly by the time they graduate to more grown-up players themselves, they will have respect for the buttons and knobs and whatnot.

An excellent investment in your child's growth and future as well as fun!

product_title: Playmobil My Take-Along Farm
review_body: My boys love playmobil stuff, and have acquired quite a collection over the years.  I love the quality, and these toys really seem to spark imagination.  The moving parts and other details are very unique.  The actual farm house is a bit \\"junky\\" for Playmobil, but still better than most toys for the same price or more.  The hinges that keep the house together separate too easily, but they snap together just a easily, so it's a quick fix.  It's just a little frustrating for my 3 and 4 year old when it comes apart.  The animals are wonderful, and they have played for hours with this and their other playmobil sets.  Overall, I think it's a good buy, and we will get many more years of play out of it (if we can manage to keep all the little parts together, of course!).

product_title: LEGO Star Wars TIE Interceptor
review_body: This is from a Die Hard StarWars fan, and Lego lover (since I was a little boy). My 7 y/o son is staring to build legos, but I bought this one for my 11 year old son. He has a lot of them ,and this made a nice addition for his Star Wars collection.

product_title: Fisher Price Kid Tough FP3 Song & Story Player - Blue
review_body: The idea behind this toy is great & ours has lived up to its durability claim.  My husband did not complain about adding songs to it, so it could not have been too bad.  Batteries:  this eats through them like crazy - and we used Duracell.  Volume:  the idea of volume control is good, but the highest volume is way too low.  I can't even hear anything until I get it to the mid-setting.  My 5 yr old son takes his to wrestling matches to listen while he waits his turn, but the background noise of the gym drowns out the sound in his headphones.  We probably should not have bought this until next year, maybe Fisher Price will have improved it by then.

product_title: V.Smile Interactive Learning Handheld Game
review_headline: Great system, but have trouble with shutting down.
review_body:
My 5 year old received this for christmas this year, and she absolutely loves it! So do my 3 and 6 year olds. The games are very educational, and even my 3 year has learned a lot from it!

My only issues with the system, is it keeps shutting down on us and freezing. I have contacted the company, and their advice is to hit the reset button (which does get it running again) or change the batteries. I don't want it to freeze in the first place! We had bought an adapter for it, but the adapter port has already broken. It will only work if you hold the plug to the side, and you can't do that and play it at the same time. It does eat the batteries fast, too. The company would take it back to repair, but the gift giver no longer has the receipt, so we're just kinda stuck dealing with the freezing screens. Maybe it was just mine, I'm not sure, but I expected more for about $80.

product_title: Super Soaker MT TIKI SOKI
review_body:
This toy soaks you! You can spend hours and hours of playing.
The water shoots up more than 15 feet high! This toy is very
easy to set up. This is a great toy to play with in the summer!

product_title: Little People A To Z Learning Zoo Playset
review_body: We received this toy as a first birthday present, and from day one my girls were playing with the animals, and still prefer the animals over the actual zoo.  They are bright and colorful, and the set and playmat seems sturdy to me.  I saw a recent price of $99 which seems quite expensive - I believe the person who gave my girls this set as a gift paid around $40 (so shop around).

product_title: Bendable Velvet Cobra
review_body: This stuffed cobra is just adorable!  It has the king-cobra's trademark - the horeshoe-like spots and loop.  I also like it because it's small enough for children to take around with them, and fits easily into a purse or carry bag.  And it doesn't take up a lot of room in the car, but it's not so small that it's easy to lose.  Great for snake-lovers, especially because the king coba is truly unique among all the different species of snakes.  Hissss!

product_title: Loftus Special Police Badge Costume, Silver
review_body: The child this badge was given to loves it.  What more can I say?

product_title: Hasbro Playskool Crew Dusty The Talking Vacuum
review_body: I bought this for my son after seeing him mesmerized when I used our real vacuum cleaner. When I left it unattended he would push the real vacuum cleaner up and down the hallway. At first he did not recognized what his new toy was, but after I started using the real vacuum cleaner he started imitating me with his new toy and he will not put it down, even after I stopped. He no longer cares about the real vacuum cleaner. One drawback is that the hose attachment comes off once in a while and he is not happy when it does. He is a 1yr and 8 mo. old so it is not easy for him to put back in place, so he may get frustrated. I still gave it 5 stars because this may be just due to his personality and other children may not care. Overall, great toy.

product_title: Sky Dancer with Launcher and DVD - Angelica on Unicorn
review_body: My daughter was very excited to get this toy after the commercials were playing constantly on t.v.  It was very hard for her to get the doll to fly more than a foot or so high.  The cord also sticks and it is definately a hazard if you ar not careful as it hurts to get hit in the head with it.

product_title: Fisher-Price Little People Noah's Ark
review_body:
I don't actually own this item. What we own is the earlier version, where the animials are all plastic.

I went to buy this for a friend and was very disappointed in the change. One of the best things about this set was that the animals were durable and easy to clean. My son carried the zebras with him everywhere and I could even put them in the dishwasher after he \\"fed\\" them sweet potatoes.

I don't doubt that children would love to \\"touch and feel\\" the new, cloth parts. What I doubt is that parents will WANT them to touch and feel those parts after a few months of accumulated grime.

I suggest finding the old set gently used, and buying that instead.

product_title: Radio Flyer Scoot-About
review_headline: My baby is so happy with this flyer scoot,
review_body: I received the flyer scooter in excellent condition, \\"\\"\\"my baby believes tha he is the best driver in the word\\"\\"\\", he enjoys it so much....

product_title: Magna-Tiles 97132 Solid Colors 32 Piece Set by Valtech since 1997
review_body:
My son turned 3 in February and received the Magna-Tiles as a Birthday gift. Through trial and error he began to learn the concept of building through magnetic attraction, rather than clicking plastic blocks together. In the beginning, he made simple right angle box-like buildings that any child at the age of 3 could do. As time went by, his creations became more complex. Less than 6 months after his birthday, he's forming highly structured 3-dimensional buildings that would astound any parent, teacher, adult, etc... (I keep asking my husband if he's been playing with the tiles). What's even more inspriring is how my 4 year old nephew, who was diagnosed last year with high functional autism, took to playing with the tiles. When we visited he and his family a few months ago, we brought the tiles along with us. It was thrilling to see how he uses his brain to construct buildings and the satisfaction on his face when he sits back to admire his work.

My son is still interested in playing with his tiles because of their diversity. It's not the same old-thing, day-in and day-out. I can't get enough of watching his pride in his accomplishments. The 32 piece pack is an excellent choice for first time users, and then your little architect can graduate to the 100 piece pack which offers even more opportunities. I'm not sure how accesable the 100 pack is because each time I've researched it, they are out of stock, but I'll also admit I have not spent a lot of time looking...the 32 piece is still working nicely for us.

In addition to the creativity of these tiles, it's another fun way to incorporate teaching shapes and colors. What do I not like about the tiles?....the box it came in. It's too flimsy and tears easily, especially when your three year old decides to lauch it across the room. Not a big deal, though. Since the tiles are magnetic, you can easily stack them on top of each other and place them in a gallon-size ziploc bag...making it easier to store (and travel)... They fit easily into a carry-on bag and will aid in occupying your young ones attention on those long flights.

Hands down this is a five-star toy.

product_title: Micro X Copter - XRotor Electric RC Mini Helicopter
review_body:
Wow, this is an amazing toy, I can't believe that the little guy can fly and is so stable! Mine worked perfectly out of the box, was stable, flies great indoors. Takes a bit of time playing with it to get used to the controls, and starts out just hovering. To get some forward motion you need to bend the tail boom clockwise a bit when looking from the back toward the front of the helicopter or add a bit of weight to the front of the 'copter, both actions result in the 'copter tilting a bit forward and thus creating a bit of forward motion.

Note that this is a 2-channel copter, you control up/down and clockwise/counterclockwise rotation. With the technique described above you get a constant forward motion, and the clockwise/counterclockwise rotation can then turn you right and left.

This entertains adults for days (10 minutes at a time, 20 minute recharge, repeat) and is great fun for pestering cats and other indoor pets. A no-regret buy for yourself or anyone else who likes toys (kid or adult).

product_title: LEGO Mindstorms Robotics Invention System 2.0 (3804)
review_headline: Don't buy this great set (if you can wait...)
review_body: I own this set and several follow-on sets. It is a lot of fun to build with and program. However, Lego is bringing out Mindstorms NXT in August 2006. Price should be about US$250 for a much more powerful set. I would no longer pay $200 for a set that is about to be replaced.

product_title: VTech Finding Nemo Smartridge for V Smile
review_body: My son loves Nemo more then anything his room is nemo, his last 2 birthdays were nemo. So you can imagine how excited he was to recieve this game. We do not like it at all I find the graphics to be horrible and its def harder then alot of the other games. He will play it for a few minutes and then he goes right back to toy story

product_title: Buttons 5 In 1 Large Diaper Bag - Green
review_body: I got this bag for two colleagues at work who were having babies at the same time. They both loved the bag. I got the pink one and the green(unisex)bag. Its very roomy and comes with a baby wipes holder to match the bag. Everyone loved the bags, and for a good baby shower idea all you need to do is stuff the bag with some baby products like diapers, bibs, bottles..etc, to make it complete.

product_title: Duncan White Yo-Yo String, 5-Pack 100% Cotton
review_body: I've had the same Duncan yo-yo since I was about four. It's survived international moves, cross-country moves, been rescued from garage sales and give-away boxes, but it was no match for my pre-schooler with a pair of scissors. The string got cut and I thought it was all over with. Then it occurred to me, \\"You can buy anything else on the internet, why not yo-yo string?\\". I searched for yo-yo string and came up with this. It came the other day and works great. There are several pieces of string in the package, so if you have more than on yo-yo needing string, you only need to buy one package.

product_title: Hot Wheels Criss Cross Crash Track Set w/ 10 Bonus Cars
review_body: My 7 yr. old son got this for Christmas. It was extremely easy to put together and it stays together. It doesn't take up as much space as some of his other track sets do. When you have to move it to another spot in the house, it stays together. My son has been playing with this since he got it and it has yet to come apart. He loves trying all different types of cars to see if they will work and crash.  Some work great and some don't...as like all hotwheels track system. Part of the fun is trying different cars out. I would reccomend this if your child likes to see fast moving cars and watching them crash!

product_title: 1:10 Monster Truck
review_body: This is actually a remote control truck. The truck uses a rechargeable 9.6V battery. It comes with charger and a 9V battery for remote control. The suspensions are not independent but looks pretty sturdy. The truck doesn't go really fast. The turning circle of truck is large. So it makes more sense to play this outdoor. Overall, it is a nice RC truck to impress kids. I would not pay $60 for this. You may want to wait until it is on sales.

product_title: Mega Bloks Command Ops-5504 White Ops Whitewash
review_body: I purchased this for a 6 year old boy and he had no problem putting this set together. Keeping the parts together was another matter, however. The directions are clear and it was fun to put together.  I don't prefer to give toy guns to children, so if this is a problem you might want to look at another set or take the guns out beforehand.

product_title: Arcade 3 in 1
review_body: This toy was such a disappointment that i sent it back.  The balls are so small and cheap, and the toy itself looks very cheaply made.  I didn't even let my kids see it before I sent it back.

product_title: Disney Princess Twinkle Lights Cinderella Doll
review_body: I find it rather stupid that the dress is permanently fixed to the doll, but the shoes come off. I got this for my dd's 2nd bday because she loves Cinderella. Her feet look really dorky lighting up with no shoes on, but those had to be put up. Either way, my dd plays with it for the 30 seconds she plays with all of her other toys, so it was a good buy. Its also very beautiful. :-)

product_title: Ganz Lil'Kinz Striped Alley Cat Plush, 6.5"
review_body:
I'm not sure if this is normal or not, but the Lil Cat had two different
color eyes. Also the \\"thread\\" on the cat's paws came undone and I attempted to repair it for my Grandaughter. She absolutely loves it
and enjoys it very much.

product_title: Thomas and Friends Gordon Battery Powered Train
review_body: I bought this and Henry for my son. He played like anything, misused like anything but still these runs great and functioning well. Only con is connection between two compartments is very weak.

product_title: Tonka Mighty Dump with Construction Helmet
review_body: We bought this truck for our sons 2nd b-day...my husband was atimant he needed to have a Tonka Truck...and our son LOVES it. He wears the hard hat everywhere...and although biased...I've got to tell you he's adorable. He loads toys into the back and pushes it around...sometimes we load HIM into the truck & push him around. It's a great 1st Tonka for any child...and his or her parents!

product_title: Step2  Push Around Buggy (Pink)
review_body: ..after a few rides, to our surprise, my daughter found to be so loud that she puts her fingers in the ears, trying to block the noise, I guess. She has done it 3-4 times so far, so it's gotta be the noise! As soon as the buggy stops, fingers are out!!  Now, I am looking to put something on the plastic wheels to reduce the noise.    Other than that, the buggy is pretty cool, she loves it. The storage compartment is userful too. Removable handle helps take it around in the car.

product_title: Check-Up Time Elmo
review_body: This wonderful Elmo, along with the DVD Elmo Visits the Doctor, have been such a powerful tool at making doctor visits easier.  We are also at the stage where my daughter is OBSESSED with boo boos - so she was very excited to see that Elmo had a bandage on.  Wish there were more things to do with this Elmo, but my daughter is just tickled with him.  Any Elmo fan will just adore him!

product_title: TY Beanie Babies AWARENESS Breast cancer awareness bear
review_body: My 9 month old daughter loved this bear, it was just the right size for her.

product_title: Fisher-Price Little People Lil' Movers Motorized Train
review_headline: Super cute and great for girls too!!!
review_body: We had a wonderful wooden train set but no where to set it up and my girls are really in to princess etc (ages 4 and 2) but also love trains. We gave the other set away and got this for our youngest for her 2nd birthday and they both played with it literally all day long. It worked great, super simple to set up and dismantle. The sounds are no overly annoying and it's compact shape works great in smaller homes or if you just don't want a giant train table. I would definitely recommend and will buy as a gift as well.. great product!

product_title: 5" Zord Battlized Figure Red Ranger to Red Zordman
review_headline: Not the best Power Ranger toy
review_body: I wouldn't recommend this particular Power Ranger toy for a few reasons. First it comes with many small pieces that are easily lost. Second these pieces don't always attach to the ranger as they are supposed to. I would recommend buying the basic action figure such as the ones with the light up shields instead. I also would recommend the Dragon Morphin series if your child wants to have something to transform. Those are of a much better quality.

product_title: Monkey Chase
review_body: My daughter loves to watch this toy.  I don't know how she'll like it when she is old enough to crawl, but at 5 months old this rolling monkey fasinates her.  It's great for tummy time because she will hold her head up for long periods of time to watch this toy.

product_title: Peek A Boo Jack In A Box
review_headline: Magnetic hands get in the way, but still fun!
review_body: These magnetic hands to play peek-a-boo sounded great, but they stick all over the outside of the box when trying to stuff the monkey down in there. My son gets frustrated trying to do it himself, but he's learning and it's really fun when he can do it. I would say just don't think it's going to be a hands-off toy for kids under three, that's why I took away one star.

product_title: Fisher-Price Backyardigans Pirate Tub Time Adventure
review_headline: Is it right for my toddler?
review_body:
While it looks like fun and does float, we found that the pole that the sail is on doesn't fasten correctly and so as soon as the child grabs it, the sail & pole pop off of the boat and doesn't fasten back on well. The characters that come with the ship have room inside for storage but must be placed in an exact & specific way usually too complex for a toddler, While there is an area to snap the treasure chest into that will secure it, there is no way to keep one of the characters behind the wheel. If you are looking for all of the peices to be apart & floating in the tub, it works.

This product didn't meet our expectation though and we are returning it.

product_title: Thomas And Friends Wooden Railway - Byron the Bulldozer
review_headline: For Fans of Jack, Alfie, etc.
review_body:
If your little one is a fan of Thomas the Tank Engine and Friends, you've no doubt seen the episodes featuring construction vehicles like bulldozers.

Byron is a giant bulldozer capable of moving tons of dirt. His size, strength and skills are very impressive--and he knows it! He doesn't like to waste his talents on jobs which he thinks are beneath him in importance.

Like Jack and Alfie, Byron is made of plastic. His \\"caterpillars\\" are made of rubber and are movable, and if you press down on the back, the scooper moves up and down.

If you're familiar with the wooden trains by Learning Curve, you may be a bit disappointed that characters like Jack and Byron are made of plastic.

If your child enjoys construction vehicles, he/she will no doubt love Byron. My son is very happy that he added Byron to his collection!

product_title: TY Beanie Babies AWARENESS Breast cancer awareness bear
review_body: There isn't much to this bear but it is for a great cause so even if you don't have kids to give it to - you should still buy one and put in on your desk or the back of your car - or anywhere else that will display your support.

product_title: Mayfair The Settlers of Catan Board Game
review_headline: The Best Board Game I've Played in Years
review_body:
My brother introduced my friends and I to this game and we all love it. I received my own copy as a gift and really enjoy playing it.

The goal of the game is simple. Each player is competing to colonize an island. Building settlements, cities and roads provides victory points. Raising the largest army and accomplishing certain achievements gains additional victory points. The first player to 10 victory points is the winner. As is the case in most interesting games gaining these victory points is challenging. The players compete for land and the resources they need to build their civilization. To add to the interest, players may trade resources with each other making the game something of a mini-economics lesson.

The initial learning curve is a bit steep, but after playing one or two games you will wonder why you thought there was any difficulty at all. The rules are clearly spelt out in the instructions and it helps to walk through the first game you play taking it slow.

Unlike games such as Monopoly that take about as long to play, Settler's games tend to be close until the final one or two turns which keeps everyone involved and playing to win. The level of player interaction is high due to the competition for resources and the trading aspects. The playing pieces are reasonably durable, made of heavy cardstock and wood and should last for may years of enjoyable play.

product_title: Marvel Legends Series 15 Action Figure Moon Knight
review_headline: When the Moon Hits Your Eye
review_body:
Moon Knight, part Batman, part schizophrenic, part Egyptian ninja Moon Knight is a dude who runs around beating the crap out of people to atone for his sins as a mercenary.

His figure looks fine and he does come with some accessories, his numb chucks and adamantium bo staff. Part of what makes Moon Knight's look though is his cape and cowl. He suffers from a problem I've seen before in that this accessory is too thick and heavy to really look good. It's shaped correctly but pulls down over his head and limits his possibility. If you take the cape off him he no longer looks like Moon Knight and becomes a funky ninja. He comes in a variant lighter colored costume but really looks about the same either way. He comes with his comic, back drop and a piece of the menacing MODOK.

MODOK (Mental Organism Designed Only for Killing) is an artificially mutated super genius with a bad temper and big fat ugly head. He makes a cool build a figure too. This guy's sculpt is where he really shines. He sits on a cool flame type base which represents the rockets of his flying chair. The chair itself looks great and his arms and legs are suitably stubby. But the detail in that big fat face of his is great. Each wrinkle of his face and each tooth and even his lips are sculpted to perfection. He looks like he just jumped off of the page. He has fewer points of articulation than normal, but hey, he's mostly just a giant head. I'd give him at least 4 ½ stars on the sculpting alone.

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Aquarium Cradle Swing
review_headline: Probably my favorite piece of baby gear!
review_body:
I think this swing was the best investment in baby equipment I made for my second child. Unfortunately I waited until he was almost two months old before I made the purchase. I wish I would've had this from day one.

I think I paid not quite $90 for it and it was worth every single penny. My son, even now at 10 months old, still loves his swing. The Fisher Price Aquarium Swing is great because it rocks side to side like a cradle or back and forth like a traditional swing. My son prefers the cradle motion so that is mainly what we go with though I do change it around for variety now and again. He also enjoys looking at the fish and lights above.

I have read other reviews on this product and it seems that many people have had problems with the mobile not working after awhile. Well we experienced this problem also but it wasn't really a big deal for us. My son could care less if the fish are moving around in a circle or not. He just likes to look at them dangling above. The lights and music still work fine and more importantly, the swing itself is still going strong.

I was pleasantly surprised at the mileage we get out of a set of batteries. This swing gets a lot of use in our house and we do not need to change batteries all that often.

All in all, this is a great piece of baby gear and I would highly recommend it.

review_body: The picture and description show that it's for ages 6 to 12 but the box I received says it's for 8-12. Strange.

product_title: Air Hogs Havoc Heli - Colors May Vary
review_body: I have read a number of reviews regarding this heli. I have been flying radio control aircraft for about 10 years now. Never have I run across such a level of complexity in such a small package for such a small amount of money. I really got to hand it to the designers of this model. Flying radio controled anything takes a little savvy and patience in learning. Helis are even more difficult to fly than airplanes, but can be mastered with practice just as well. I found this little machine to be a real blast. I have never flown a heli before. I had this thing hovering in just a few minutes once I had the trim set. The trim will also change as battery power is used up. Not a huge problem, just expect a little difference in performance. If you do not use the nose weights provided the heli will only want to hover. I have all three weights on, one on top of the other placed at the nose and still need a little more to tip the heli nose a little downward to enable foreward travel. Little kids are not going to be aware of this and will find limited performance in the model if flying by themselves. With some adult help they will do better. The charge plug is delicate as it should be for this size model. I had a little trouble inserting the plug the first time. You really don't know how much pressure is needed till it finally snaps in. Make sure you have a perfect line up with socket and plug. After the first time it is much easier to connect now, and it stays in just fine too. My 4-1/2 year old daughter was bugging me to death to try it out. I just knew she was going to destroy it. The first time she flew it she really turned up the power. It flew straight up and hit the ceiling falling to the ground. No damage at all. This was repeated two more times. No damage. She had this thing flying as good as me in only two chargings. She hovers it around then makes it spin to the right then to the left. Her landings are a little rough yet, but overall she did great. The heli bumped off walls, floors, and lamps while she learned. No damage. The foam body absorbs impact well. The thing is so light and moves rather slowly it can't hurt much of anything it hits, especially itself. This little chopper takes top honors from us, a great little toy for sure. I bought three to give as presents (mostly to adults). I think with a little logic and common sense approach linked with some patience most people will really love this little guy. Oh Yes!!!walls, floors, and lamps while she learned. No damage. I think with a little logic and common sense approach linked with some patience most people will really love this little guy. Oh Yes!!!

review_body: I purchased the Disney Dream Sketcher for $45 for my daughter for Christmas.  Immediately the screen kept freezing and I'd have to unscrew the battery doors to reset it.  The batteries kept popping up inside their doors even though the doors were on tight.  A tiny screw fell out without our noticing and the sketcher no longer worked. DON'T BUY THIS!!

review_body: Great game... the kids love it and can play it in the car on a trip.  Teaches them spelling too.  I would definitely buy another one for them.  Their only comment was that they wished the colors on the board were the same bright colors as on the bigger games.

review_body: My son recieved this toy for Christmas when he was 6 months old.  He didn't play with it much until he was almost 1, but then he loved it. review_body: We enjoy this product.  My son is still quite young but the ceiling projection is such a soother...and an easy \\"put to sleep\\" piece!  Love it and would buy it for friends.
