review_body: I was a bit disappointed in this toy. It certainly looks great. It comes apart very easily and is just not terribly well made.

product_title: SHADOWS OVER CAMELOT
review_body:
I'm not a fan of role-playing, but my husband is. While this isn't an actual role plating game like D&D or Shadowrun, it has similar elements and style. In this game, the players don't compete against each other but against the game (unless one of them is the \\"traitor\\" but that's another matter!). Players work together as knights of the round table to complete quests before evil wins the game. Different knights have different skills, and each quest has a different prize to help the players win the game. While this game is fun, my main issue with it was that the odds seem stacked in favor of evil.

Evil gets an action every turn. Knights are allowed one heroic action per turn - but, movement counts as the turn. For example, if I am working on the Grail Quest, I can lay down a grail card as my action. But, if I don't have a grail card to play, I have to return to the round table in order to draw cards from the draw pile - but returning to Camelot counts as my heroic action so I have to wait until the next turn to actually draw the cards! Plus, there is the added problem that one of the players may be a traitor working against the team. So, my husband and I made a house rule that drawing cards still counts as a heroic action, but you can draw from anywhere on the board.

The game is nicely designed, but with a lot of small plastic pieces, the durability isn't as good as it could be. I recommend this game for anyone looking for something new and interesting to play.

product_title: LeapFrog Leapster Learning Game System - Pink
review_body: My daughter started out with the LeapPad, and my 3 year old son has the Little Touch LeapPad, My first LeapPad with desk, and the original LeapPad.  We never owned the \\"older version\\" of the Leapster, so I never noticed differences.  However, from what I've seen of my nephew's older one, I'll keep the new one. A slightly larger screen isn't important enough to me or my 7 year old to override the more bulky, less efficiently designed older one. Aside from this Leapster being very easy for my daughter to handle, she loves that it fits in her purse, instead of having to tote around another bag, and I love that it's so easy to change the batteries, she can do it herself!  Also, neither my daughter nor myself have ever noticed \\"commercials\\" on it.  I highly recommend the Leapster as a fantastic educational & fun alternative to video games-which aren't allowed in our home.  Even the built-in games (including an educational version of my childhood favorite, \\"Frogger\\") are very fun.  My 3-year-old son sits and watches and helps my daughter answer some of the letter & number problems.  In the short time that we've had it, just from watching over his sisters' shoulder, he has learned his entire alphabet and can do simple addition too!  A+ for this Leapster!  I only wish there were more games available for 1st through 4th grades!

product_title: LeapFrog Learning Table
review_body: I bought this for my son for Christmas and right after about 3 months, it broke! It no longer makes any lights nor does the sound work. I tried changing the batteries and wiping the contacts with rubbing alcohol, but none of it works. The warranty runs out after 3 months-how convenient! My son was only 9 months old loved it while it lasted. It sounds like I just got a dud....

product_title: Spongebob Cookin' up the Speed Rolling Backpack Luggage Bag
review_body: This backpack is great. Holds up and the kids love it.  Worth every penny, especially for spongebob fans.  It is also cool for the kids because not many kids have this.  I have not seen any kids at my son's school with it so my son feels like he is one of a kind with it.

product_title: Mickey Fire Engine Team Activity Ride On
review_body: He loves it, he pushes the buttons, loves the sounds, spins the wheel, rides it and loves te fireman hat. Good value!

product_title: Play - Discovering Colors Crawl Mat
review_body: Keeps my baby entertained for very long period of time.  Helped him to have an interest in crawling and though he is walking now, he still loves it.  Portable, we can take it with us anywhere.  Soft plastic, just a really great toy.  Have bought several as gifts and all the moms love it as much as I do.  A+++++++

product_title: Wild Planet Verticon Air Battle Arena
review_headline: A Lot of Hype, A Lot of Headache
review_body:
All my son wanted for Christmas was this thing. I was so excited to find it and be able to get it for him. In the comercials, it shows these balls flying over the arena bouncing into each other and knocking one of them out. In reality, the fan is not strong enough to propel the balls high enough to actually create this type of duel. We have tried putting two balls in with no weapons and they still don't float above the areana piece.

It is loud, the pieces don't work properly and I'm exceedingly disappointed.

product_title: Jardine Madison Lifetime Convertible Crib - Cherry
review_body:
I knew I had to have this crib the moment I saw it. The cherry finish is absolutely beautiful. We also bought the matching changing table and glider and ottoman. Some of my friends were worried that the cherry was too dark for a baby's room, but I was able to lighten the room by pairing the furniture with sage and white bedding. I am very happy that our daughter will be able to use this beautiful piece for many years to come. We will certainly get our money's worth.
The major drawback to many of these new convertible cribs is that nobody makes mobiles that will attach to them.
The shape of the headboard does make it a little harder to tie the bumper ties, but it can be done. It would take little effort to attach longer ties to your bumper if you are really having a hard time.
I know a couple reviewers have stated that their child's arms or legs have become stuck between the slats in the bed. To that I will say that the crib meets all the necessary safety requirements. I measured the distance between the slats myself when I first put the bedding on, and the space measures to the maximum allowed distance. Having said that, common sense would tell you that small arms and legs could still fit through the spaces. THAT'S WHAT BUMPERS ARE FOR! Anyone who would place a child in such a crib without bumpers is not exercising common sense. And if your child got stuck once and you didn't immediately buy a bumper, that is negligent. Don't blame the furniture.
I highly recommend this crib to anyone that wants to add some elegance and class to the nursery and have a piece of furniture that will not become outdated as their child grows.

product_title: Connect Four
review_body:
There are often times that the classics times we had and we still have with our parents never goes away. That is also said with some of the most classic board games like Connect Four. The game is fun and filled with skill. The object of the game is very simple, you have to try to make four in a row across, vertically, or in a diagnally row. The game is fun and challenging for all ages. Although many people might think that this ios a baby game, where there are more challenging games out there, but it still is a lot of fun to play, and I still love playing this game. It is a great buy.

Price: B

Fun & Convience: B+ with somebody; D+ if you're playing it alone

Overall: B

product_title: Fisher Price Medical Kit
review_body: I purchased this for my 3 year old son for Christmas as his first doctor's kit. He took immediately to it, and wouldn't put it down. The peices are a bit tricky to fit into the case, especially for little hands, but I usually wind up putting them away anyways. The kit is EXTREEMLY durable! There is a band-aid, stethescope, thermometer, seringe, ear scope, and a blood pressure wrap. The thermometer takes your temperature by twisting the end of it and you either get a happy face or a sad face. There are some downfalls that could've been thought through more, such as the band-aid will not fit the average adult. It barely even fits my 3 year old. So whenever he wants to have the band-aid follow the shot-we have to get the shot in our wrist, as that's just about the only place it will fit. Also, the stethescope has a bit of foam at the end where it's pressed up against your chest. That was torn off just about the first day my son had it. And the stethescope is more of a prop-it didn't work at all for hearing a heart beat. If your shopping for a first time doctor's kit, this is definately a great choice!

product_title: Melissa & Doug Standard Unit Solid-Wood Building Blocks
review_body: These blocks are EXACTLY what I wanted. They are sturdy, durable and they smell beautifully. (of wood) They are the classic, chunky blocks that every child should have. It is also great that they come in a sturdy wooden box. These blocks are beautiful enough to have on display in our living room. If I had to rate these on a scale of 1-5 I would seriously consider putting them in the 6 category even though it doesnt exist. I am very pleased.

product_title: Lionel The Polar Express Diner Car
review_headline: Add more fun to a great train set
review_body:
The author and artist of the original Polar Express book watched Pere Marquette passenger trains near his house in the last days of steam. When he painted the Polar Express train, he based the artwork on the real trains that had run in those days. Ironically, Lionel had also based a passenger train series and Berkshire locomotive on the passenger trains of the same time and place. So when it came time to make a model of the trains shown in the Polar Express movie, Lionel was ready to go.

\\"Heavyweight\\" passenger cars were called that because they had concrete in the floor to make them ride smoother. The \\"Clerestory\\" roof originally provided ventilation and headroom - later, when air conditioning came along, they still provided headroom. In other words, these cars represent the \\"glory days\\" of North American passenger service. And few cars said more about luxury travel than the dining car, where meals were actually cooked (and not just reheated) for passengers of all classes.

This car will go with ANY Lionel train, but it goes especially well with the Polar Express train. Look for the Baggage Car and the Hot Chocolate car, too.

Paul Race, editor, Big Christmas Trains(tm)

product_title: 7" Donkey Kong Plush Doll
review_body: Bought this for my little Mario Brothers fan. Very hard to find item. Very pleased with quality!

product_title: Star Wars - The Saga Collection - Basic Figure - Snowtrooper
review_body: A decent sculpt, but he's still just a retread of the figure with the cannon. Can stand, but not well. I know there are a lot of Hoth junkies out there, but this figure, while not bad, could have been better.

product_title: White-Hasbro i-Cat Robotic Music Loving Feline
review_body: I love playing with my new iCat! I'm a professional musician, so I have to practice a lot and he just dances and lights up right along with me. Also, his Copy Cat mode is pretty challenging, a lot like the Simon memory game I played with as a kid, only trickier. Finally, I've noticed that he holds a few little personality suprises that emerge as I play with him. Boths paws way up!

product_title: Fashion Satchel Diaper Bag - Black
review_body: i gave this bag a 5 stars, just because of the way it looks.  i love it and i get a lot of compliments ..  i will be honest, i never used all the little extras they give you like the wallet, bottle bag, and cell phone holder,  i think that there is not enough room inside the bag after you put all of baby's things in it.  i use this bag as a purse and a diaper bag.  i will probably purchase the pistachio color just to switch off bags for another stylish look.   fyi: this bag is not for a travel diaper bag, only for everyday going out and running errands.  i use a very large duffel type diaper bag for long distance travels.   Hope this helps....

product_title: UglyDoll Little Cinko 7-Inch
review_body: I have absolutely fallen in love with this series of stuffed companions, and I love the smaller version of Cinko, especially his color. The material is very soft and not at all ugly, despite the makers' statement that these dolls are made from the \\"ugliest materials\\" they could find. In addition to being soft, Cinko is adorable, not just his impolite tongue and three eyes, but also the fact that he is a creature of the deep who should never get wet. Since I also cannot swim, I feel I have a very special connection with my new friend.     Your friend Cinko comes with a small card describing him in detail. For those who decide they like Uglydolls, I recommend a visit to the official website for a peek at their T-shirts, keychains, etc. The smaller versions of the dolls are all different colors than the corresponding larger ones.     J.H. Sweet, author of The Fairy Chronicles, and Uglydolls collector

product_title: LeapFrog Leapster Educational Game: The Incredibles - For Original Leapster and Leapster 2 systems.
review_body: My six year son loves to strive to get the access cards.  Even though he has me doing all the work in the adding section he sits there and watches me and is learning from me.  This is a little too advance for him as far as the math.  But he is learning slowly but surely.

product_title: TWO-Inflatable Designer Fashion Pool Lounges Floats
review_headline: the only fun way to get sun
review_body:
These inflatable rafts are quite nifty, however, to blow one up you need to have good lungs and lots of patience. Otherwise, you'll be sitting around all day in the house trying to blow it up in time for the pool party!

You can rest two people on this inflatable raft. But I don't know if it can actually support two people (I never tried it). It probably can. I mean, it wouldn't be on the market if it couldn't, right?

Most people use them to lay around and get some sun. Personally, I don't think it's safe to fall asleep in one, in case you happen to fall out and go into the water.

Pick one up this summer and make your swimming pool even more fun.

product_title: LeapFrog Original LeapPad Learning System from 2004
review_body: Anything Leappad is great . Its one of the best things to come from the computer toy area for kids yet. My son is ahead of his class in reading with the help of Leappad. At 6 he reads at a midrange grade 1 student and is progressing quickly. I highly recommend This and any other Leap pad book and toy . Most schools have dropped Phonics from the classrooms and Leappad has brought it back in a fun form your little one will love...So set your child on the road to loving reading and learning in a fun way...I wish it was around for my first childs begining years...

product_title: Spiderman Deluxe Backpack w/Free Water Bottle: Full Face
review_body: I am writing this review based on THREE purchases of this book bag. One being my own which is an excellent book bag, my son has had this for one full year and it is still in tact. My son's friend who also has the same book bag also have had this for a year and this is in great condition as well. The problem with this bag is another young child I saw whose spider man face was totally tore off. I don't know if he was ruff or not or cut it. I know from experience that if your child likes spiderman, this bag would be a great addition to his daily school travels. Just need to make sure they don't tear it or destroy the plastic like face front. I must add this bag is very roomy you could put alot in this bag.

product_title: VTech V.Smile - Lil' Bratz Smartridge
review_headline: A good choice for little Bratz fans!
review_body: I like this Bratz game. It has many games to play that are fun enough for the older ones(4-5) but still easy enough for my youngest (3). A good choice for little Bratz fans!

product_title: Cars: King
review_body:
My kid loves it !!

He has the whole characters collection from CARS the movie ...

He is never tired to play with them.

These toys are durable, easy to play, and perfect size to take along !!

product_title: Cars Shake & Go Racers - Mater
review_headline: Can't go wrong with Shake 'N' Go!
review_body:
My son got his first Shake 'N' Go racer for his first birthday, and figured out how to use it almost immediately. He's since gotten a couple more, mostly of his beloved Cars characters. They're even more fun than the regular racers since they say cute things in addition to making engine sounds. In general, the Shake 'N' Go series is one set of toys that he doesn't seem to get tired of, and Mater is his all-time favorite cartoon character. An added bonus is the fact that these toys teach cause and effect (the more you shake it, the farther it goes), which is less trivial than it sounds for a 1-year-old.

Note that the Big Toy Hut price listed here is about double what this toy costs in the major retail stores. I don't know why.

product_title: Barbie Collector - Barbie as Titania - Queen of the Fairies in Shakespeare's A Midsummer Night's Dream
review_body: this is a beautiful collectors barbie, I rate as educational because the link to Shakespeare's play Midsummer Nights Dream, and the chance to learn the play, or gain interest in the ballet from it. Besides this the doll is gorgeous, such a nice face,costume, colors, and pose. So beautiful you would want to take her out of the box.

product_title: Little Tikes Push & Ride Racer
review_headline: No Bells & Whistles but my son loves it
review_body: This little race car is great.  Nothing fancy, but is easy for my son to crawl on, push around, ride on and do whatever else he wants to with it.  I bought this when he was just starting to pull himself up and he has progressed from pulling up on, to pushing, to now riding it and making all the appropriate 'car' noises.  It has been lots of fun and you can't beat the cost versus a lot of the other push toys out there.  Extremely durable - I highly recommend!

product_title: LeapFrog Roll & Rhyme Learning Elephant
review_body: My 10 month old son loved this when I first bought it and plays with it every day.  He's played it so much that he'll roll the barrel until one of his 2 favorite songs comes on and then he dances...very sweet.

product_title: Xbox 360 Core Bundle Mature
review_body:
I can only speak for my own experience although I've heard others have had similiar problems. My XBOX 360, after two days of playing a game (Madden 06), created scratches/marks on the disc bad enough that the game would no longer play (disc unreadable error). I meticulously handled the disc, so I'm positive the scratches were not created by me. I've heard moving the unit can cause this problem but I'm pretty sure I didn't do that either. So, are the drives flaky? I don't know, but if you get one be advised and take extreme caution with the discs and the unit itself.

As far as this bundle goes, it's silly to buy all this and pay a premium and not even get the hard drive. I've seen local retailers starting to carry the XBOX (with zero games included and no markup), so my advice is to wait a little bit longer if you want one or better yet, avoid it all together and wait to see how the PS3 stacks up.

product_title: National Products 12V F-22 Raptor Blue Angels Fighter Jet Ride-on
review_body: Stefan's my grandson who's three.  His first reaction seeing the Blue Angel Jet was, \\"Can I fly it Papa ?\\"  He absolutely loves it. He drives around the yard, through the bushes and flowers and anything else he can hit. (ha ha)  Actually, he rides it really well.  My one year old granddaughter loves to sit in it and play with all the buttons and loves the sounds.  This birthday gift was a huge hit with my grandkids.

product_title: Deluxe Trend Nursery Center - Malawi
review_body: I used this pack n' play as a bassinet for my newborn and it was wonderful! The changing table and iPod hookup is what got me. The bonus is the storage area for diapers, wipes, powder, pacifers, rattles. Plus there's an additional pocket on one side. The negatives of this item is that the frame is a bit too wide to fit through standard doorways, so you need to partially collapse it to get from one room to another. Also I was hoping to be able to transport this for the 'grandparents'; however it is too heavy to take apart and put together regularly. Both sets ended up purchasing smaller pack n' plays for their homes.

product_title: DC Comics Ultra Blast Batman
review_body:
Bought this as a present for my 3 1/2 yr old grandson & he loved it.
It's a large sized, colorful batman.
The foam \\"bullets\\" seem to be very soft and safe, and the price was a great deal for the product.
Would recommend this toy to friends with small children.

product_title: Micro Fiber Upholstered Swivel Glider - Sage
review_headline: I bought this one because the gingham one was discontinued
review_body: I tested and purchased this at my local babies r us and it was very comfortable.  I read the review for the gingham upholstered one and thought those were very helpful.  It is made for a petite person, definately.  I am 5'2\\" and it is perfect for me.  I had it for a month now and used it occasionally (I am 7months pregnant); but the back cushion has already slumped down a bit.  I would also recommend a lumbar pillow, which I am also looking to buy for myself so that I will be more comfortable once the baby gets here.  The suede-like fabric is great, but to make it last longer and with 2 small youngins running around, I covered it.  So far, my 2 girls and I are enjoying this very soft and comfy rocker.

product_title: CHH 15-Inch Standard Wooden Chess Set(Discontinued by manufacturer)
review_body: My boyfriend has been wanting to teach me how to play chess, but neither of us had a set, so I got him this one for his birthday. It's fantastic. Very compact, easy storage. Looks sleek. Pieces aren't very heavy, but they also don't chip (which his old ones did). A great selection for beginners and casual players.

product_title: GeoTrax Workin' Roundhouse
review_body: I wish I hadn't paid the money for this one. It only works in certain directions, its more of a pain than it is fun. I don't recommend adding it to your collection. There are plenty of other FUN accessories that you could buy instead.

product_title: Giddy-Up Blendy Pens Pen El Grande Activity Kit
review_headline: Not as great as in commercial...but good enough.
review_body: My 4-year old had to have Blendy Pens, and I have to admit, they are pretty neat.  But a 4-year old has a hard time with the twist-and-wait concept...so his color doesn't come out quite like we see in the commercial.  The pens make him happy, and keep him entertained - and that's good enough for me.  The paper that comes with the pens is the best part; I just wish they supplied more or had refill options.  We've gone through the paper and the pens have lost their luster to him on their own.  I'm buying another Grande set, it makes the most sense money-wise. Worth the money if your children love drawing.

product_title: American Girl 300 Wishes Game (2004)
review_body: I really like this game too.  The other reviews tell how the game works so I'll focus on why I liked it.  My 12 year old daughter received it as a Christmas gift.  We played the game for an hour and my daughter wanted to keep playing and asked when we could play it again so I know she liked it.  I found the comments each of us made about some of the wishes helped us get to know each other better - we get so wrapped up in everyday life it's difficult to really communicate.  There are 4 categories of wish cards (Experiences, Treats and Treasures, Accomplishments and Family Fun).  Some of the wishes are very \\"girly girl\\" and ironically her Dad seemed to end up with a lot of those wishes.  So, after we played it the first time by daughter separated those wishes out so the rest of the wishes would be more appropriate for her Dad.  My daughter plans to use the girly girl wish cards when she plays it with her girlfriends.

product_title: Mater the Truck Activity Ride On
review_headline: My sons favorite toy... by far
review_body: My 15 month old son received this Ride-on Mater for his 1st birthday.  It was a hit from the minute he got it.  He has not had a day or even a playtime pass that he doesn't \\"Play with Mater\\".  So far it has held up to some pretty tough beatings my son has put it through, and the only \\"battle wound\\" is a torn sticker on Maters rear bar.  I would recommend this product to any child around his age group for hours of fun, especially if you love the Cars movie as much as our family does.

product_title: World of Warcraft - Trading Card Game Heroes of Azeroth Random Starter Deck
review_headline: An interesting game, but not easy to learn.
review_body: I picked up two starter packs to try this out. I'm a big fan of the PC Game and a long time Magic player. The rules were a little confusing, but the game is interesting. Although, I think I prefer Magic to this card game. A friend of mine really enjoyed playing it. This game may be better if you have someone show you how to play and buy a few booster packs so you can create your own deck.

product_title: Hot Wheels Double Shotz Dragsterz Assortment
review_headline: Sounds cool, but does it really work?
review_body: My son and I spent several hours trying to get this to work. It never did. Pumping up pressure took forever and then you had to roll it really fast to get it to move up the ramp. Most of the time, the water jet never worked or released way to late for any jump action.

product_title: The Incredibles: The Incredible Mr. Incredible 12" Action Figure
review_body: Purchased from toys-r-us and it came damaged. Too much of a hassle to return. He is very loud and the harder you push on him the louder he gets!

product_title: Intex Swim Center 73-by-71-by-21-Inch Summer Colors Pool
review_body:
I got this pool for our back garden - I have a toddler and I'm heavily pregnant - I wanted a pool that was comfortable for both of us to sit in. And it's PERFECT.
The aircushioned bottom is great for letting my toddler jump and land and splash around without hurting himself, and the sides are robust enough for me to lean against. Also they are robust enough for him to lean against from the outside and play with his boats in the pool (obviously only when supervised!) Because of the cushioned bottom, I could quite easily spend hours justing sitting in there; it's really comfortable.
We got a little electric pump and it took no time to pump up, and although it takes a while to empty the water out of the bottom valve, you can do it without any effort (no heaving and tugging to turn it upside down).
We're really happy with it.

product_title: Liberty Renegade Walker - Pink
review_body:
MY daughter loves her new Jeep!!! It was a sinch to put together, the one and only thing i dont really like about it is that its so hard to adjust the height. But its worth it.. and also the steering wheel pops out so you can use the tray for feedings or whatever you want.. makes clean up easy!!

love it !!!

product_title: Gear Action 20 Model Building Set
review_body: My son had been asking for some gears for his construction things, legos, k'nex, etc.  I had checked with lego education to find their smallest set to be over $100.  Theses K'nex ones are great, especially for the price.  The case is a little difficult to open, but then again it keeps his sister from opening the box and losing a peice or two.  I gave it a four because I wish the set had a few more gears in it, my son's only complaint.  I will probably buy some individual gears to add to his set from K'nex Education site.  It is well worth the price to teach a kinetic child the concept of gears!!!

product_title: Little People A To Z Learning Zoo Playset
review_headline: A Uriel looks like a Big Horn Sheep
review_body: The 26 animals included in the set make this well worth the price. I bought this for my then 18 month old daughter. Her favorite part of the set is still the bag of animals. She likes to take them out one by one, examine and name them, then place them on the table across the room.  Then she puts them all back in the bag, one by one. She tired of the rock and tree quickly. Still enjoys the \\"iceberg\\" though. She likes the splashing noises the water illustrations make on the mat but not the mat itself. Maybe when she's a little older. At first, I didn't like that the letter U was represented by a Uriel. What is that?! My daughter continues to \\"correct\\" me and tells me it's a sheep. But then I tried to think of another simple real animal that began with the letter U and came up empty. Overall excellent value.

product_title: Nintendo Super Mario Brothers Mario Party 6 Inch Plush Yoshi by Sanei
review_body: Very pleased with the quality of this very hard to find item! Very cute, very soft. Great buy!

product_title: Giant Building Block 40-piece Set
review_body: I got these for my daughter - 20mos - and feel she'll like them more when she's just a little older.  I didn't realize you had to put them together yourself and just how much room they take up when put together.  They're great for the imagination, but I think because I am the one that put them together, they aren't folded tightly and don't necessarily stay stacked on top of each other well.  But I would recommend them for others, just be sure to find some space for them.

product_title: Thomas - Thomas and Friends High Back Chair
review_body: My son recieved this for christmas this when he was 15 months old and it is still his favorite furniture in the house! It has a very high backing full of thick foam that also bends perfectly as a recliner when he pushes his back. The chair is not flismy. It is VERY comforable with its THICK plush fabric. I love that it has a zippered fabric so it can seperate from the foam and wash easily. My son likes to put it upside down to sit it it like an oversized lounge chair or lay it on it's side and it becomes a pretty cool climber. WE both love this chair! Highly recommended!

product_title: 3 Piece Corduroy Pant Set - Burgundy : 6-9 Months
review_body: I ordered the 3 piece corduroy pant set for my daughter. With her being in daycare, it is very durable for play time.  I love seeing her in it.  It is just precious on her.  She wears the light jacket with other outfits as well.  I am very satisfied with the quality of the material and stitching of the appliques on the jacket.

product_title: Barbie Collector Zodiac Dolls - Gemini
review_body: This doll means a lot to me. I am a Gemini and my mom bought it for me a year or two ago. It is still in the box above my desk.

product_title: Aquatic Paint & Play
review_body: We purchased this set for our son's 4th birthday and he was SO excited when he opened this gift.  That is, until we actually got into the box and realized that half the paints were hardened, rubbery, and dry.  The 4 sea creatures are made of cheap and thin rubber and are actually super or hot glued together, poorly.  There is glue all over these creatures.  The paints that were usable are water based and do not adhere to the rubber material.  Needless to saw, we tossed the entire set out of frustration.  My son cried on his birthday...thanks Wild Republic.  PS.  The store that sold these on Amazon.com was AWESOME about responding to us quickly and courteously and issued us a refund even though we had tossed the set.

product_title: Learning Screen Karaoke
review_body:
We bought the Learning Screen Karaoke for our 31/2 year old grandaughter for Christmas. Another one of her little friends have one and she enjoyed playing with it on occasion. She just loves having one of her own and we know it is going to help her learn her alphabet and sounds etc. We like the fact that you can actually hear the sounds. Some products are so soft you have to strain to hear it. Thank you for such a great product. It is worth the money.

J.& M. Thomas

product_title: PAJAMA BEAR - 8" blue
review_body: This bear is the softest stuffed animal ever, and with no separate parts for eyes/nose, it is safe for older babies to sleep with.  Our toddler sleeps with it every night (we have two - just in case).  For such a soft feel, this bear is incredibly sturdy - it has survived over 30 \\"baths\\" in the washing machine on the regular cycle!  We also have 3 of the bigger version.

product_title: Sun Smart Baby Float - Sunshade Water Buggy
review_body: we had the buggy for a couple of outings in our pool. It was purchased for our 6 month old granddaughter. The top will not stay inflated and we have decided not to use it anymore since it defeats the purpose of keeping the sun off of her.

product_title: Clue DVD Game
review_body: This game was definitely more involved than the original, but so fun and really makes you think.  It's a great family game.

product_title: Star Wars E3 BF76 COMMANDER BACCARRA
review_body: Now, while this clone lacks knee articulation, or verticle articulation of the left arm, he is still suitable for play and posing.  The posing is somewhat limited by his lack of knees, but he can still be positioned into some cool positions, most of which involve shooting or snipining.  For leading troops into battle, he can appear to calmly assault everything, do to his perpetual upright stance.  The fact that he comes with two weapons is a plus, as they can be used to replace lost weapons.  Also, his shoulder armor can be removed and placed on any other clone (roughly, as the latch cannot snap, but the pad stays on nonethe less) and can result in sick looking specialized troops.  Good for mixing and matching.

product_title: Mega Bloks WINTER BATTLE PLAYSET
review_headline: Poorly constructed toy won't fit together
review_body: What a disappointment.  My 7 year old son was so excited to get this Narnia toy.  He loves putting things together.  The way Mega Block makes the pieces, they don't always fit together properly.  He was frustrated and in crying after 15 minutes.  His older brother tried to help and even his father; the pieces were not made correctly.  He was devastated. If you're going to make a building block set, make sure the pieces fit.  Never had a problem with legos like we did with this product.

product_title: 70 Count Magnetix Metallic Set
review_headline: FUN PRODUCT AND I HOPE THEY DON'T RECALL THESE ONES!!
review_body:
Despite all the recent happenings with recalling magnetix because a little boy died after ingesting them...I would still buy this set again anyday for my kids!!

It says ages 3 AND UP FOR A REASON! The plastic pieces may fall apart but we've had ours for 4 months and my kids play with them non-stop and we've NEVER had a problem with the magnents falling out. But these are not plastic they are metal and they do not fall apart like the plastic ones.

If you do not think your kids are old enough to not put something in their mouths then do not buy this product. But I have a 3 and 5 year old that love their set more than anything else in the house!!

product_title: Shake & Go Racers: Raceway Playset
review_headline: Too loud, drives my Westie crazy!
review_body:
This is a fun toy but I can hardly let my son use it because it is very LOUD and drives my dog crazy. Even just the sound of driving the cars on the carpet makes him nervous.

I am not sure how much time my son would spend doing it because it is a simple track. I just wish it wasn't so loud.

product_title: Koala Baby Cozy Blanket - Pink
review_headline: This blanket really is the best!
review_body: I have received many blankets for my newborn daughter, and all I can say is that this is the best one by far.  It's very plush, a great color pink, and it washes well.  I've washed other blankets that we have, mostly fleece, and they have pretty much all pilled after two washings.  Not this blanket.  It washes very well and does not pill or pull.  It's super soft, just what you want for your new baby.  Ahh, if only they made it for adults!!

product_title: Gobblet
review_body: We had played this game with others, so wanted to have one for ourselves.  A good game and three dimensional thinking for old folks like us.

product_title: Snap & Style Doll - Elena
review_body: My daughter loves this doll.  She got her for her 3rd birthday.  We have also bought bedtime, birthday and rainy day. The clothes are easy for little hands to get off and on.  The clothes and accessories are adorably cute - fashionable with bright colors.  We took the doll on a trip to the beach with friends.  The three little girls fought over who got to play with her the entire week.  My six year old daughter wants her own doll.  The only problem is we are having a hard time finding one for her.  I rarely write reviews.  It was worth my time to sing the praises of this toy.

product_title: Tamagotchi Connection V4 - Plumeria Flowers
review_body: My niece loves this toy. She plays with it everyday along with the Tamagotchi I got for my daughter. They are having fun, learning some responsibilities, and more importantly they love this toy.

product_title: Christian Crafts/Gift Giving
review_headline: Will be giving this book to many people!
review_body:
I highly recommend this craft book. My children and I used it for Christmas gifts and family members loved them. I am a Girl Scout leader and will be using it for my troop. This is one of the better craft books I've ever seen.
Thank you!
Sherry Linn

product_title: Natural Glider/Ottoman Combo with Beige Fabric
review_body: I purchased this combo myself when I was 8 months pregnant. Being impatient, I decided to assemble it while everyone was at work. Easy to do! Our son is going to be one tomorrow and I'm not even thinking of getting rid of it yet. He woke up a little sick last night and the only way I could get him asleep was in the glider. We fell asleep with our feet up in the chair. He still loves it and so do I. My only complaints are that the arm is loose all the time (because my husband leans on it ALL THE TIME!) and the fabric is a little dirty (AGAIN...my husband). But no manufacturing problems!

product_title: Strawberry Shortcake 9 Bin Toy Organizer
review_headline: Good If you know how to follow directions!
review_body: I purchased this item for my daughter to organize her huge amount of strawberry shortcake & other misc. dolls. This item was sent to us the very next day! So that was great but when we got it we were a bit sad on the size (its really small). Also for those that can assemble, its fine, but those who get stressed on directions this is a process to assemble. Also the buckets are really small, only holding a few small dolls or tiny toys. So if your looking for something to hold larger items this is not for you. But if you want a cute tiny piece in the corner for a few of her dolls, she will love its bright pretty tubs and adorable Strawberry Shorcake image on the sides.

product_title: 1/350 US Navy Aircraft #2
review_body: since this is really used for scale modeling and not a toy, it would rate higher. I have several sets in order to fill out my flight deck.

product_title: Zoombox DVD Entertainment Projector
review_body: i recieved this as a Christmas Gift and this is much better than an HDTV any day. I played Old Playstation Games like Revolution X And Pac-Man world Now they look like they are in 3D. product_title: Magic the Gathering: Core Set - Tenth - 10th - Edition Theme Deck - Arcanis's Guile (Blue)
review_headline: Not a bad place to start if you're new to the game
review_body:
This product is intended primarily for people who don't already have a collection of Magic cards, and who want to be able to purchase an instantly playable deck without having to try to construct it themselves and without needing to purchase several booster packs of cards to get enough that work together to make a deck.

5 of these premade decks are available--one for each color. These decks include cards that compliment each other well and work toward a common \\"theme\\" (essentially a strategy to beat your opponent). They also include enough land cards to play the deck effectively. A mix of common, uncommon, and rare cards is included as well, so you'll get a wide variety of cards that vary in power.

There are a few advantages to buying a premade deck such as this. The most obvious is that you can play it right out of the box, and these are actually fairly decent decks. If you've never played the game these decks will give you the opportunity to see how a deck is built and what makes it run smoothly, and hopefully give you an idea of how to eventually put one together yourself. You can also use this as a base and tweak it as you buy more cards, swapping out more powerful cards or cards that do different things as you acquire them.

One thing, however, is important to note. While these premade decks are a good place to start and will be entertaining if you pit a couple of them against each other, they're not going to hold up well against custom built decks more advanced players will have. These are common theme decks that are pretty easy to play, but take them to a card shop or something and play them against other people there and you'll likely not do too well. This is a place to start, nothing more--if you want to compete in the game you're going to have to get more cards and eventually learn to build decks yourself.

review_body: Typical of Lanard the quality and accuracy are not the main concern.  Playability is this sets function, and on that note it's okay. The figure has a pretty good head sculpt that needs a repaint, but the body has over-sized hands and roto-cast feet/boots (like the roto-cast Hasbro Star Wars figures). Following the advice on the box to \\"Navigate the Extreme!\\" I don't think this guy would survive very long. He is supposed to be from \\"Avalanche Rescue\\" but I would count more on the dog for help. Overall I am glad I got the set for the helmet and especially the dog but I can not really recommend anything else about it. The pieces in this set are a choking hazard so parents this is not a toy for younger kids (three years and under).

product_title: Hot Wheels Terrordactyl Track Set
review_headline: A little complicated, but it can work
review_body:
I was hesitant to buy this for my four-year old for Christmas because it looked way too complicated to work properly, but it was # 1 on his list so I bought it for him, and I was pleasantly surprised. It takes a while to put together (probably around 20-25 minutes), but I found the instructions and markings on the pieces adequate to get it together. And it does take some practice to keep the cars going around the track, but both my son and I are now (after two days) able to make the cars go around as many as five and six laps and make the cars set off the pteradactyl.

It's not perfect, though. Sometimes the very first try sends the car flying off the loop, or the accelerator lever gets stuck on the car (the car that came with the set, mind you - nice selection Mattel). One of the lanes works better than the other, and it definitely requires some timing. The fact that a set with two lanes only came with one car is a real joke. C'mon, Mattel, you can't include an extra 25-cent car along with a $40 set?! Overall, though, I'm pleased with it and my son is definitely happy.

product_title: Fisher-Price Doodle Pro - Dinosaurs
review_body:
Even though this is a child's toy, it is not just for children. When I was a child we used to have a device that had a thin piece of pink plastic that covered over a hard white plastic bottom baseboard. When you wrote on it, the plastic would smash together and allow you to see what you wrote. This method worked poorly to say the least. The letters would start to disappear immediately.

My hard witting is not as good as I want it to be. I have been doing handwriting exercises to improve it; but this wastes a lot of paper. So I went looking for the Pink Board. I found out that it had been replaced with this Magnetic-type board. The Doodle Pro seemed like the perfect tool for my needs and it truly is. The Doodle Pro is very solid. Made of hard plastic. It works by using thin Iron pieces locked in between two plastic sheets. When you use the magnetic pen, it drawls the Iron partials together and forms it into what ever shape you wrote it in. The idea works very well. You can shake this thing like crazy and the Iron pieces will stay in there place. When you write out letters, they stay pretty much as they would when written on a sheet of paper. Which makes it perfect for adults who are looking to improve their writing skills.

So if you want to buy one of these for a child, it will withstand their abuse with ease. Just don't feel ashamed if you find it to be a useful tool for yourself.

(((NOTE: Just make sure you buy a Doodle Pro and not some cheap Chinese knock-off. I wasted $30 on some piece of junk being sold here on this web site.)))

product_title: Star Trek Classic Enterprise NCC-1701 by Diamond Comics
review_body:
This is a toy. Plain and simple. It was made for the six year old in each of us. In fact, this is the very toy I'm sure we all wished we were given on our sixth birthday. Most of us, however, probably got the old AMT model kit with the sagging nacelles that never lined up properly. But this version of NCC-1701 is the real deal we wanted to play with. It feels solid in the hands. It lights up in the right places. It has the actual sound effects from the show. Its detailing is accurate enough to evoke memory and imagination. It looks great on your desk, and for the actual kid in your home it makes a great night-light for their personal frontier, patrolling the darkness to keep unfriendly aliens from interrupting their slumber.

The adult in me is aware of the limitations indicated by other reviewers, but I didn't buy this for the adult in me, who would probably settle for nothing less than the actual Enterprise hanging in the Smithsonian. No, I bought this for the kid in me. And for the kid in you, this ship will carry you far into space, and back in time to one of the coolest spacecraft ever to streak across a television screen.

This Enterprise doesn't come with working deflectors or shields; make sure it doesn't break your personal orbit, or else it will go the way of its successor, NCC-1701 D.

Take the helm, Mister Buyer. Set a course for the planet Play!

review_body: My 3 year old daughter was very excited about this gift, but quickly lost interest.  The version that we have is not the one pictured with the gold-colored reins, but the one in the customer-supplied picture with the pink reins.  The horse's harness and reins do not stay on the horse no matter how hard one tries.  If this flimsy contraption doesn't stay on, you can't pull the carriage with it. review_body: Okay tons of tiny pieces, a parents nightmare!   However we didn't purchase this toy for ourselves we purchased it for our 8 year old daughter.  She and her 6 years old sister love this toy.  They play with it for hours, filling the pool and hot tub with water makes it even more fun!    From the parents perspective.  My daughter had this item on her Christmas list and I looked for it a several stores where the cost of the item was $[...] plus!  I wasn't willing to fork over that kind of money.  Then I saw it here at Amazon for $[...]!!! KA-Ching!!!!  Thank you Amazon!  Product was easy to assemble, took less than 5 minutes!

product_title: Hasbro Star Wars Transformers - Jango Fett and Slave 1
review_body: My 6 year old absolutely loves this Jango Fett Transformer and the other Star Wars transformers he has.  After looking at the instructions once or twice he can make the transformations in a snap. He loves ALL his Star Wars traditional action figures and for the smaller kids the Galactic Heroes figures RULES.  YES there are small parts, he knows not to lose the parts and has so far been careful about it. If you and your kids are INTO Star Wars, these are a must.

product_title: Master Replicas Pirates of the Caribbean Souvenir Necklace
review_body: The chain is much too thin.  It broke taking it out of the package.

product_title: Longrack - Transformers Cybertron Deluxe
review_body:
I first owned Longrack from the Japanese Beast Wars series where he was a giraffe. I mention this because when this figure was commissioned for the Cybertron series they used the same head design as the JBW figure; I really enjoy it when a nod is made to a TF predecessor (i.e. Energon Downshift & G1 Wheeljack)

The back-hoe to robot transformation of this figure is rather elementary. I usually make a case for the non-symmetrical TF designs, but this one went a little awry. I like that the scoop is his right arm & hand, but because of the cyber-key activated \\"steel punch\\" feature it's very heavy and unbalanced (on the JBW Longrack, the giraffe's neck & head are the right arm, although it's better balanced).

One feature I really liked is the fact that the arms in robot mode are off-set at approximately a 45 angle from the torso giving Longrack a \\"body-builder\\" like appearance, unfortunately you cannot see that in the provided picture.

For those inflicted with children: Here's a TF that will stand up to the standard mindless abuse rug rats subject their toys to & it's easy enough to transform that it won't give them an inferiority complex.

For the Collector: Longrack isn't the best mold out there, but because of the homage to the Japanese Beast Wars Longrack it is a must have for any collector.

product_title: FLY Through8482; Spanish Pocket Translator
review_body:
The fact that almost all the reviews are children should tell parents one thing when considering this for their child...This is FUN and it is what YOUR children want. Imagine a great \\"toy\\" that is also an \\"educational tool\\". Parents and children are BOTH happy with this purchase. My child will be starting Spanish in the fall.....this will be a MUST in our household.
Actually I want a Fly too!!!! :-)

P.S. A great tool for the homeschooling family!!!

product_title: Rainforest Eco Expedition
review_body:
Imagine my disappointment when my little boy brought me his tree frog on Christmas morning saying \\"help, help\\" because the frog's leg had broken off. We bought several of these sets, and immediately parts started falling off the minute we took them out of the box. I felt really sorry for my little guy, having this happen on Christmas morning! I felt so bad for him because he loves animals and had been so excited when he first unwrapped these toys.

I'd like to give it only one star, but the idea behind the toys really was good. Also I was happy to see animals made out of hard plastic, which kids don't want to chew on like they do the rubber ones. Other than that, though, these toys are terrible. Don't buy them unless you enjoy gluing things together and keeping them in a curio cabinet.

product_title: Fasion Angels Magnetic Dress Up Doll Sets- New York
review_body: I bought this for my daughter to keep entertained on vacation.  It's a great travel toy.  It's light weight and small.  Because the pieces are magnetic it stays in place.  Some pieces are extremely small so you would have to be careful around small children.  The plastic storage bag that came with toy ripped easily but I happened to have a ziploc bag with me.

review_body:
I got this for the kids last week- after seeing the commercial. First of all, this product is hard to find (I mean it is hard to find the real floam). I HIGHLY RECCOMMEND THIS PRODUCT!

product_title: Barbie in The 12 Dancing Princesses: Interactive Princess Genevieve "Let's Dance" Doll
review_body: There are a lot of instructions for this little toy, so you will have to teach the little girl how to do it correctly. Once you've done that, it's a wonderful toy for a little girl who loves to dance!

product_title: Wit's End Board Game
review_body:
The questions are the soul of a trivia game of this kind, and it always strikes a sour note when you get a question that's either ambiguous or just plain wrong. Wit's End questions come in four categories, and three of them are perfectly fine. But the \\"Teaser\\" questions are mostly in the form of the \\"A is to B as C is to D\\" analogies many of us remember from standardized tests. However, \\"Wit's End\\"'s versions of these questions might better be described as fractured analogies. Many are not analogies at all. For example, the question \\"Protoplasm is to prison as multinational company is to . . . tree.\\" Tree? Their explanation of why \\"tree\\" is the answer is that protoplasm and prisons both have cells, and multinational companies and trees both have branches. This is not an analogy. The two pairs do not share a relationship. (More seriously, a glance at Wikipedia defines protoplasm as \\"the living substance inside the cell\\"-- not as something that has cells at all.) Roughly a quarter of the questions in the game are \\"Teasers.\\" A game like this only works if you trust the answers, and if you have the sense that you're learning something. \\"Wit's End\\" merely confused us.

NOTE: I don't disagree with this review, but I didn't write it either. Hey, Amazon, check that database.

product_title: Construction Wooden Jigsaw Puzzle 48pc
review_body: We gave this puzzle to our 5 year old grandson and his 7 year old brother will hardly let him play with it. Thay both love the puzzle so I guess we'll have to get another one for them. The puzzle is very bright and seems to be quite durable with the wooden frame. The 48 piece puzzle is just right in difficulty - Fairly easy but complicated enough to keep them involved putting it together over and over again. Thank you Amazon and Melissa and Doug puzzles for a great product.

product_title: Fisher-Price T.M.X. Tickle Me Elmo
review_headline: Is this really about "supply and demand"?
review_body: There seems to be two sides to this Elmo story...those that wanted the doll for their children and weren't able to find one (or were able to) and those that went to the stores and bought as many as they could to resell for much more than they paid for them...when the reviewers keep saying \\"this is all about supply and demand\\" I ask, \\"but what about the fact that the \\"supply\\" dwindles when there are people intent on hoarding the supply so that they can make money which in turn pushes up the \\"demand\\"? Whereas, if they would not intentionally hoard the items, the supply would be much greater for all of those who truly want the item for their child and the \\"demand\\" is more evenly distributed. (By the way, I saw Elmo advertised on Amazon the morning it came out, it was \\"in stock\\" but I decided that for  $40.00 plus tax and shipping I could buy my grandchildren a couple of really neat toys that they would probably like better and keep their interest alot longer than this toy would...so passed it up...I'm not sorry..I believe this is a toy more for older people to enjoy..and they truly will..but certainly not at the scalpers price)...if they can \\"justify\\" hoarding at the expense of others and call it \\"supply and demand\\" then they are just rationalizing for their own consciences...this is really NOT the \\"American Way\\"...it is the way of a few opportunistic, selfish people but I believe MOST Americans are thoughtful, giving people that won't take advantage of others in this materialistic, selfish way. The \\"Supply\\" will be there if the hoarder/scalpers would leave some on the shelfs for those that have a legitimate \\"demand\\" for the item.

product_title: Fisher Price ESPN Fast Action Football Electronic Game Table
review_body: My son, age 7, loves this Fast Action Football game! It is great because he can play it with a friend or alone. It is so neat because he loves playing and he is not a couch potato while he is doing it either! LOL, anyway, I think this toy was even better than described!

product_title: Barbie Doll Special Edition Wal-mart Country Bride 1994
review_body: This doll was issued a few years ago, but I thought it was simple and sweet, were most of Barbie Bride dolls are elaborate this one is sweet and simple a nice change.

product_title: Fisher Price - Laugh & Learn Learning Table
review_headline: Fun Music, Bright Colors, Not Sturdy!!
review_body: I bought it for my 8 month old daughter.  The first thing she did was try to pull herself up and it tipped over on top of her.  It is a great toy without the legs.  I didn't want another toy for her to sit and play with.  I am bringing it back tomorrow.

product_title: Star Power Swashbuckler Pirate Pistol Gun, Burgundy Silver, 13"
review_body: This toy is a great accessory for school plays, role playing, or just plain child's play. It is safe and does not easily break, and is semi-realistic--the trigger and hammer work perfectly.

product_title: See It and Sign It Game-Intro to ASL
review_body:
We recently added this game to our homeschool library after a friend recommended it. This game would be excellent for introducing sign language to anyone interested in learning. The box says \\"7 and up\\" but my five year old is quite good at it and even my three year old had fun playing with us.

The DVD is very clear and the game is fun. I hope to see more advanced versions of this game, as it wasn't much of a challenge for our family (who has been studying ASL for the last year).

My only regret is not having this on hand last year for the homeschool co-op class I taught. Definitely worth the money.

product_title: Fruits and Vegetables Basket
review_body: Realistic play food, good quality, durable basket, toddler has a lot of fun with them.

product_title: Wild Planet Verticon Air Battle Arena
review_body: One of the hazards of Christmas is that during the absolute pandemonium that accompanies multiple children opening multiple presents in minimal amounts of time is that directions get lost.  In this case I could find nothing regarding the importance of removing two of the three bottom baffle plates that otherwise decrease air flow to the point where the 'warriors' could barely bestir themselves from the bottom of the 'stadium.'  Once this corrected the unit seemed to function reasonably well and my kids (ages 4 and 7) really seemed to enjoy it although victories are sometimes hard to distinguish from the randomness of the air flow.

product_title: Mayfair The Settlers of Catan Board Game
review_body: My son played this game on a rainy day at summer camp.  He brought me a little piece of paper with the name of the game and the manufacturer and asked me if I could get it for him.  Since it wasn't a video game and he had kept this little piece of paper for one week without loosing it, I decided to buy it for him.  Our family has really enjoyed playing this game and I am looking forward to purchasing the knights and cities expansion pack.  I would recommend the online tutorial.  The game is not as hard as it seems when you begin reading the instructions.

product_title: Fascinations GreenEarth Butterfly Kit
review_headline: Son loved it - BUT... very costly for what you get ... only 5 babies hatched
review_body: This toy is a great idea!  Though very costly for what you get (mostly just a square netting with a few cheap accessories!  You must buy the eggs separately - we only had 5 babies hatch - and after 3 days only 1 is alive!  My son loved it when they hatched, but he is VERY disappointed he only has one left - and he is assuming that one will die quickly too!  We read lots of extra information on how to keep them alive - but not much worked!  It might be better to keep them in their natural habitat!

product_title: Fisher-Price: Elmo's Musical Sing and Teach Gym
review_body: We received this toy as a gift when our son was born.  He loved lying down and watching the flashing lights, and Elmo popping up and saying \\"Peek-a-boo!\\"  He is now 6 months old, and it's still his favorite toy!  Since it converts to a sit up position as well, it really grows with your baby.  It does use up batteries pretty quickly, but it's a small price to pay for a toy that makes him so happy.

product_title: LEGO City Passenger Plane
review_body: This plane was a gift for a lifetime lover of Lego and he is still enthralled with the plane!  Lego is fun for all ages!

product_title: Toy Agamid Lizard with Sound
review_body: The Agamid lizard is a cute toy, but is not as realistic as it appears on the computer screen. I was looking for realism over cuteness. I guess the addition of a \\"squeaker\\" should have been my first clue. Not for science class.

product_title: My Scene Chillin Out Chelsea Doll
review_body: I LOVE this Chelsea! First of all,she comes with skis with flame decals (she can actually fit her feet in the skis),snow boots for the skis,a helmet,ski poles (DUH!),and a brush. What she's wearing is,a puffy jacket (that looks like one real people wear),a striped pompom hat with matching scarf,orange snow pants,a almost baseball jersey looking shirt,furry leggings (which is why I got her!),REALLY cool boots (if you have the Un-furr-gettable Chelsea their boots look almost the same),and lastly snow goggles. Hope this helps you! :P

product_title: Children's Pretend Little Helper Play Toy Ironing Board *Perfect Gift Idea*
review_body: The ironing board was great-just didn't know you had to buy iron separately. It shows both in image for board only and ONLY if you scan down-which some of us don't, does it say sold separately. Company did make good by shipping it to us for free and charging a $1.00 less for iron. NIce customer service.

product_title: YOUniverse ATM Savings Bank
review_body: This bank is great if you don't plan on opening it often (or don't want it opened by you children!).  The lock doesn't work very smoothly, and usually doesn't open on the 1st try.  It also does not recognize $1 coins.  Counts them as quarters.  Otherwise it is a great concept, and has taught my children that there needs to be money IN an ATM before it can be taken out and used.  Both my children also like that they can quickly see how much money they have saved.

product_title: Videonow Jr. Player Purple/Green
review_body: I purchased this toy for my 3yr old in December last year. He has not been able to use it since we have not been able to find ANY products (discs, carrying case etc) for the videonow. I have called the company several times. Everything is always unavailable and I do check on a regular basis. My son has been watching black and white discs recently from his older brother on the machine so he will get some use out of it. It was a good idea but the company leaves a lot to be desired. If you make a product make sure that there are enough discs. It is simply a waste of money and time. I cannot continue going on line and checking a couple of times every week. I hope this info factors in in your decision to purchase this toy.

product_title: Gator 4x2
review_body: Excellent toy for my grandson who is all boy.  Price was good, only problem with this toy is that the gear shift is loose and in a position where it gets hit easily by the child's leg as they get on & off of the gator. This knob broke off easily soon after he got it.  Otherwise, a great toy!!

product_title: Fisher-Price T.M.X. Tickle Me Elmo
review_headline: Do you people even read or pay attention??
review_body:
Amazon is NOT overcharging for the item. Amazon is a showcase for other vendors who are overcharging so if you want to spew your venom, direct towards those vendors' way.

Well, come to think of it, its not the other vendors problem either. Maybe you should look to the rest of America where parents overcompete to win their child's love and buy outrageously priced toys that wil be forgotten in a month, 200.00 shoes that get dirty in a second, cellphones & pagers etc etc. If the people are out there wanting to spend money to buy their kids affection instead of teaching them to grow up w/ morals and values and not to live by greed and selfishness, then why shouldn't the vendors make their money off of these fools and their spoiled brats?

And by the way people, its only mid-September. The holdays are a LONG way off. You dont think Fisher Price has a ton more of these in stock?? If you had paid attention, you would know the companies only release a limited amount of a new item to cause this kind of frenzy. Why buy into it?

No one ever died not getting what they wanted for Christmas. Why don't you people try and enjoy the holiday and your family and not worry so much about how much money you can spend, how many presents you can buy, and how much you will cry about those credit card bills you will be paying on the next 20 years when TMX is in a landfill somewhere and your kid lives in another state ignoring your phone calls.

product_title: LeapFrog: Tad's Counting Farm Smart Block Book
review_body: This is a great toy for my son because it encompasses all of the things he loves the most: books, animals, farms and music!  I love it because it's something educational for him.  But best of all, it's a book that can't be destroyed!

product_title: SpiderMan 3 Movie Exclusive LIMITED EDITION Action Figure Venom Capture Web
review_body: This is the way Venom should have been done in the first place without it being a Wal-Mart exclusive. It's color accurate and just looks better. I had one problem with mine though. I have 3 of these and opened one, the paint they use to get that shiny look chips of easy so, for kids I would be careful but, for collectors..I would highly reccomend this. Get one before it's gone, these are very limited edition and once they are gone they are gone for good.

product_title: Melissa & Doug Noah's Ark 24pc Floor
review_body: Easy to put together because of the size of the pieces....very colorful and the puzzle pieces are extremely sturdy

product_title: eeBoo I Never Forget a Face Matching Game
review_body: I agree with the other reviewers that the pictures are fantastic of all of the children, but wanted to point out the box mine came in (maybe all the boxes?) shows each child's picture with the name of their home country.  My 3 and [....] play the game and shout out the names of the countries the children are from as they play.  It's so great to hear my kids yelling \\"Tanzania!\\" and \\"Norway!\\" and \\"Puerto Rico!\\" while they flip the cards.  I highly recommend this game for your own kids, kids you know, birthday presents for ages 3 and up.  Our whole family plays together and the kids sometimes beat the adults : )  We also love eeBoo's \\"Life On Earth\\" matching game with amazing illustrations of various flora and fauna on our planet.

product_title: Little Tikes Americana Table and Chairs Set
review_body:
I'm having a really hard time figuring out what makes these chairs (apparently) so hard to operate for some children. We bought this table set for my son when he was 18 months old, and not once have we had any disasters result from the use of it. The chairs are perfectly sized for the recommended age, and my son has no problem using them (they are chairs for heavens sake). The table has a perfectly surface. The set is easy to clean, I can easily scrub crayon and washable marker off with baby wipes.

If your child if proficient in chair use, go ahead and order.

product_title: Barbie Princess Mini Castle
review_body: My daughter received this castle for her birthday.  She loves all the dolls that are sold separately.  For the money, it is a decent buy.  I was disappointed that it didn't come with more furniture.  A bed or a little couch would have been a wonderful addition.

product_title: Fisher-Price Laugh & Learn Love to Play Puppy
review_body: I was trying to get my grandson a gift that would help him learn because he is having problems learning right now and I couldn't think of a better gift then the Learning Puppy, it teaches colors, numbers, hands, feet, songs, left and right, etc....  I think this is a perfect toy for any child to learn with.

product_title: Disney Mack Truck Playset
review_body: My son loves this toy (he's [...]), it allows McQueen to do many activities inside Mack.  It is thin plastic though and seems like it would break easily if it fell or was thrown.  As it is, sometimes when he plays it, pieces come off easily-though they pop back on quickly.  If you have infants at home, I would steer clear of this toy for that reason.  If it were a little sturdier, I would have given it 5 stars.

product_title: Pacific Play Tents See-Me Connecting Tunnel
review_body: We bought this tunnel over a year ago for our then-crawling almost-one-year-old. I figured it would encourage her to crawl more, which it did--she loved it!     Now she's a running, screaming, jumping, independent 2 yo who still drags this tunnel out of the back corner of the play area (where I've tried to hide it) and squeals excitedly when we pop it out for her to play in.     Her older sister, who is now 3 1/2, also loves the tunnel. She copies her aunt's ideas and stands upright in the tunnel to pretend she's a monster, or hops with it around her and pretends to be a caterpillar or a frog.     We don't yet have any of the tent accessories, but we build our own tents with sofa cushions and sheets, then stick one end of the tunnel in a gap, and you have a secret entrance to a special hideaway.     This is one of those classic toys that children of all ages can find lots of uses for--it sparks creativity and imagination, and gives Mom a few minutes' break to go clean the kitchen. ;-)    UPDATE: We've now had this tunnel for several years, and despite much use and abuse, it is still in great shape!! My oldest was 3 1/2 when I wrote this original review. She recently turned 8, her younger sister is 6 1/2, and they now have a younger brother who is about to turn 3. They all still LOVE this tunnel! It gets dragged out every so often for everything from building tents to pretending to be dogs in a doghouse to walking around with it over them like a sock and pretending to be a monster. This is probably one of the most useful, long-term toy purchases we've made. I can't think of any other toy we have that has been used this often and has retained this much favor with kids of both genders over so many years and ages and interests.

product_title: Dora the Explorer: Dora's World Adventures Collectibles -Tanzania 5"
review_body: Love this doll.  It great to have a toy that with a bit of research can teach children about the world around them.

product_title: Candy Grabber
review_body: This was one of the worst products I've ever purchased. Quite frankly the idea is great! It's just too bad that the product was poorly designed and is cheaply made.

product_title: GeoTrax Working Town Train Railway Playset
review_headline: Excellent train for your toddler to grow up with!
review_body: My 2 year old son got this for Christmas and it's played with constantly everyday since!   It's simple enough for him to help put it together, and the train controller is easy to use and has great sound effects.   Very realistic.  This is a great starter set, but only offers enough track to get you hooked.  After 2 weeks, we're already talking about expanding the set.  The train was frustrating at first for our son because it does come off the tracks easily, but once he learned how to put it back on, everything was fine.   I would highly recommend this train set to anyone with a 2-4 year old wanting a nice train set that isn't too complicated, but that your child can grow with.

product_title: Avalon Hill - Vegas Showdown
review_body: I am a big fan of board games and have a lot of fun exploring new ones, so when I was introduced to this game, I was hooked.  You start with a hotel/casino floor plan then build it up which gives you more income, options and fame.  Every person that I have introduced this game to, really enjoyed it.  Every game is different and the replayability is very high.  I highly recommend this game.

product_title: DuneCraft Dome Terrariums - Gothic Garden
review_body:
I am sorry to report that this item was a total failure. We followed directions explicitly. At first, two or three of the plants \\"sprouted.\\" Then, they withered and died, and the soil started to grow surface mold. The concept and the packaging were good. The product is not.
I did return the item and received a refund, so the company was very good about their refund policy.

product_title: Tyco R/C AirBlade Hovercraft 49MHZ
review_body: I give two Tyco R/C AirBlade Hovercraft to my nephews and bouth work very well. Of course not like in the comercial when they cross over the water, that not really hapen, but they really enjoyt. There is one single problem and like in other RC the battery ran out very fast. But if you have and xtra battery you gona have very good time.

product_title: Barbie Plug N Play
review_body: I have to agree with the other on here. I got this for my 5yr for christmas and She seemed to enjoy it the first day using it but now It sits in her room plugged into the tv and she hasnt really gotten much use out of it. I was thinking it was going to be more of a mat where you learn to dance from the mat, not oh watch the charaters on the tv and follow thier lead. I tried and didn't think it was all that fun either. I threw the box away and I'm sure I need that to return it. If I could I would get her something else in return that she could use.

product_title: Deal or No Deal DVD Game
review_headline: Save your money  stick with watching it on tv or play online
review_body: OK I got this game on christmas played it well it froze..So I brought it back to the store exchanged it..Well it froze ..I love deal or no deal watching it but not recommend buying this..I am planning on calling the manufacture and complaning because I am not the only one that has had this problem .Sorry Howie No deal on this dvd game..

product_title: Fisher-Price Interactive Baby Grand Piano
review_body: This is a great product. My daughter loves it. It gives a kid great starting interest on music. Now, she is trying to play my wife's big keyboard.

product_title: Tamagotchi Connection: Version 3 - Zebra Stripes
review_body:
I bought this toy for my daughter, aged 7, who drops EVERYTHING.
She's had it since September 2005. No problems. This is not like the $3.00 neo-pet toys at Walmart, which broke in 2 days when i purchased it for my daughter. If you would like a tech toy for your child, to shut them up in the car, or wherever, this is the toy for you.

product_title: Step2 Lifestyle Deluxe Kids Pretend Kitchen
review_body: I purchased this kitchen three weeks ago for my grandchildren.  The instructions were great for assembly.  Lots of storage space for all the kitchen food,dishes and small appliances.  I have it set up in my kitchen and it fits in well with my decor.  It has all the \\"bells & whistles\\", that my 4 year old granddaughter and 18 month old grandson really seem to be enjoying.  It takes up a good size spot in my kitchen but it's totally worth it to see the children having fun with it.

product_title: Disney Princess Ariel Swim Gear
review_body: My daughter got this set at age 6.  Although she has worn the goggles some, they don't fit as well as her Speedo brand goggles, so she doesn't wear them often.  However, she loves to wear the flippers and hand fins - they do seem to help her go faster in the water, and they make her feel like a \\"real\\" mermaid.  The flippers are pretty adjustable size-wise, although I think they'd be cumbersome on a really young child.  She has enjoyed them so much that I got a similar (boy-themed) set for my son.

product_title: Melissa & Doug Hands Counting Wooden Peg Puzzle (12 pcs)
review_headline: Another great learning tool from Melissa and Doug
review_body: Our little girl absolutely loves puzzles, and this one presented a real challenge. The pieces are somewhat irregular, left from right, which allows for growth in her problem-solving abilities. I bought this when she was 22 months, and she has been able to master it quickly. Not only do the pegged pieces help define fine motor skills, but the numbers, colors, and left/right make this a multi-dimensional learning tool. She's 24 months now, and has most colors down as well as learning to count. The colors were really helpful, because being the neurotic parent, I was beginning to wonder if she had some colorblindness because she wasn't recognizing colors at first. But silly me, I forgot she was a toddler. So much for my fears of why she isn't solving quadratic equations.

product_title: LeapFrog Fridge Phonics Magnetic Alphabet Set - Styles May Vary
review_headline: Kids favorite toy, not bad for adults too!!
review_body: This great learning toy has survived both my 4 year old and now my 2 year old.  This includes my boy throwing it on the tile floor to see how loud it is when it hits.  They have both loved the ABC song and the sounds of each letter.  Great for adults as there is a volume switch!!  Also fun to use as a word puzzle.  We adults (and sometimes teenagers) try to use all of the letters, like scrabble for the fridge.  I will purchase this again if my son ever actually breaks it.

product_title: Sesame Street Finger Paint Fun Kit by Mega Brands
review_body: My almost 2-year old son loves this set, but we went through most of the paint in one sitting.  We did get more paint to supplement the fun though and he is still enjoying it!

product_title: McFarlane Sportspicks NHL Legends Series 1 Wayne Gretzky Kings
review_body:
This figure of the great Wayne Gretzky is a must-have for those who collect hockey memorabilia.

The figurine is life-like, with Gretzky's expression looking just as it did whenever he scored a goal.

What I love most about this toy is that you can purchase Gretzkys that wore different jerseys to represent the eras in hockey his playing career spanned. If you are like me and collect Gretzky memorabilia (pictures, cards, jerseys, etc), this is an artifact that will fit quite nicely in your collection.

product_title: Channel Craft Boomerang Spirit of Earth
review_headline: A lot of fun.  Perhaps there are better options for first timers?
review_body:
I bought this after trying a friend's (free) plastic boomerang. It was the first \\"real\\" boomerang I'd ever thrown, and I had a great time with it. I'm sure there are better out there, and I'm not sure if I'd recommend it as a first boomerang, only because there is little available description online for comparison sake (flight range, weight, etc.), and I have no reason to think this is the best to learn with. But it certainly did return for me (I'd say I catch it 20% of the time), and everyone that has seen me throw it, friends and strangers alike, has left the field excited. I have thrown only one other since then: it was a much lighter (still wooden), more classic looking boomerang, and although it was probably easier to throw, the flight path was nowhere near as pretty, and all in all it was far less exciting. I'd certainly choose this heavier, longer range boomerang over that one as my first.

I still don't know the dimensions, but I remember the packaging said the range is 45 yards.
