product_title: Deal or No Deal DVD Game
review_headline: The Presentation Is Rather Different Here.
review_body:
DEAL OR NO DEAL is the most popular and, so far, the hottest game show on television. The game itself appeals to a large audience because of the average people that appear as contestants, host Howie Mandel's connection with normal people, twenty-six beautiful women who just open numbered metal cash cases, and the emotional manipulation of the audience by the show's producers. Combined together in a game show involving no knowledge whatsoever in a high stakes game of playing the odds, and you've got the set up of DEAL OR NO DEAL. It should come as no surprise, then, that the creators of the show have licensed several at home versions of the game.

One of my family members is a huge DEAL OR NO DEAL fan and I purchased the INTERACTIVE DVD version of the game for him as a gift. We played the game several times on our own and at a recent family gathering split the family into teams for team-style play. We were able to do this because the game allows both single and double play.

Like the show, you one case out of twenty-six. You select six other cases to open. Then Howie receives a telephone call from the banker who offers you a sum of money. You can then either choose to take the offer or continue opening cases. If you continue, you open five cases and the format repeats until you're opening one case at a time. There are a couple of problems with the presentation of the INTERACTIVE DVD game. For starters, you never get to see all the cases at one time. Instead when picking case numbers, you have to scroll through all the cases left using a remote control. Also, you always start at the case number that you chose at the beginning as your case. It takes time to scroll through all the numbers and it can be tediously getting to the number of the next case you wish to select. The other problem this presents is that until you scroll through the cases, unless you're keeping tabs yourself, you're not for sure which cases you've already opened. This problem could have been easily fixed by showing all of the cases left at one time, as is the case with the online version of the game. The only other complaints I can find with the game are that Howie Mandel repeats himself a lot (especially if you play the game more than once) and the only time you get to see the Deal girls are at the very beginning of the game.

The presentation of this version of the game isn't the best, but it could have been a lot worse. It might not be as exciting as the actual game show itself, but the basic format of the game show doesn't change and the game can be a lot of fun to play as teams with family or a group of friends.ed. product_title: GeoTrax Rail & Road System - Rocky Falls Tunnel
review_body:
This is a good addition to a Geotrax collection but I would make sure you have the High Chimes Clock Tower in your collection first. The clock tower also has the motion sensor and sounds. It also has the ability to accomodate different elevations (and that opens up a great world of building possibilities!) unlike the Rocky Falls Tunnel. The final reason I would go for that item first is that it will probably be discontinued first so get it while you can. :)

The Rocky Falls' Tunnel is pretty nifty. I wish there was a way to choose which soundtrack gets played or at least a way to just turn on the nature sounds. Since you can turn the wheel on your own (rather than relying on GeoMotion) it would just be cool if you could operate water sounds to go with it.

Building seems a bit limited with this item. You can either choose to forgo using the whole tunnel or you have to build a train large enough to accomodate a crossroad. Not a big deal, just something to plan around.

Finally, we bought 2 of these this week. The first one had a lubricant like film over one of the pieces (the one that houses the main unit, the one with the battery compartment). I contacted F.P. and they said it was not normal. (I didn't think it was!). So, we are shipping it back to them in exchange for a $20 voucher. They had no replacement items in stock so we just bought a new one. It was residue free. Just wanted to make note of this in case it happens to someone else.

Geotrax are awesome and this will be a good addition to your collection. Just make sure you buy the older items first! You don't want to have to search for a discontinued item that they are showing in the product inserts or on the box. :)

product_title: Why Did the Chicken..? Joke Writing Game
review_headline: Great fun. Great game. Great chicken.
review_body:
I have played this game with over 100 different people and the thing I've found is:

1) People learn the game in 30 seconds
2) Anyone can jump in at any time (but seldom jump out)
3) The 4-8 players is a suggestion. Theoretically, you can play with more (though the game slows down)
4) People who don't think they're funny can learn to strategize in a right-brain sort of way (and win!).
5) I find this game highly addictive. Follow-up game: \\"Why Did the Chicken take Methodone?\\"

I make no bones about it. I am a creative person. I love to write, and I'm a professional comic. Whereas I don't use the jokes from this game on stage, I find it extremely fun and fascinating. I win sometimes, I lose sometimes. Sometimes I don't agree with the judge, whether it's for or against my joke. But usually, by the time the game ends, someone else has to tell me if I won. I just don't care. It's the journey, not the destination that matters.

People think as a comic, I'll win this game every time. I've lost to computer people, shy people, unfunny people, unemployed people, clowns, and even a pet goldfish. (It's hard to think when you're in a fish tank, drowning. That did have the other goldfish laughing though.)

Win? Lose? I don't care. This game is just fun to play.

My only criticism would be that for some of the letters, the audio is not good for the child to hear the sounds correctly (which is my problem with most of the leap frog toys).

Also if your child is very young (under 18 months, they will just take the magnets off the refrigerator, and then a few days later - it is in their bedroom - which is what happened for us). We received this as a gift when our daughter was a little younger, but now she really plays with it. (I only wish I had the spanish version of it now).

review_body:
We bought this for our 9-mo. old son, who is now 12 mos. old. He loved it from the start, and still plays with it. It is stable enough that he can pull himself up without the walker tipping over--he can actually walk all around it, holding on to the handle from different angles, without it tipping.

I don't understand the reviewer here who complained of \\"sharp parts\\" and not enough room for legs/feet when configured as a walker. Our son is big for his age, and he has no trouble walking comfortably behind the walker. (In fact, our 4 year old has no trouble, either.) As for \\"sharp parts,\\" there are none. This is a perfectly safe toy.

Bottom line: both our kids love it, and they play with the various spinning balls, flip-over pieces, etc. We're very happy with the toy, and after comparing with other available walkers, we think this one offers a great value for what you get.

product_title: Simba Cable Control Giant Workstation
review_body:
our child enjoys the cable control workstation very much. it is easy to
work the remote buttons and operates well.
the only problem i found with the cable control workstation is that the
black cables on the top of the crane seem to unhook often causing both sides of the crane to collapse. i think if the cables were a little less flexible it wouldn't unhook as much.

product_title: Mega Bloks: Pirates of the Caribbean - Water Wheel Duel Playset
review_body: Was looking for Mega Bloks Pirates toys when I found this one. Was VERY HAPPY to see it still available and for such a GREAT PRICE! Love the packaging, so much more fun than the usual rectangular box. It was lots of fun putting it all together! It was shipped next day, which was great because I hate the waiting after I buy something online.

product_title: Quiddler
review_body:
We play this game allowing 'helping' from other players after the first person goes out. We are competitive AND cooperative. A dictionary is a must.

It's fun, educational. a great gift, plays in one hour...unlike other interminable games that few busy families have the time for.

product_title: Webkinz Tree Frog
review_body:
Overall a cute concept. If you are not familiar with it, here's a run-down

Webkinz stuffed animals come with a code that allows the user to register the \\"pet\\" on a website. Your child can name the pet, decide it's gender, and then log on to play with it. So, you are not just buying the stuffed animal, you are also buying access to a website that gives you virtual money to buy pet supplies and virtual locations in which you can feed, groom, and entertain your pet. I am assuming while you do this the \\"real\\" stuffed animal sits alone in another room. The virtual animal has a meter that lets you know how happy and well-fed it is. If you neglect it, it will suffer (or at least become less happy).

I suppose some could argue this is a good way to teach children about the responsibility of pets or to let them feel as if they have a real pet (but without the mess).

Consumers who object to excess use of video games and tv, probably should opt for a traditional stuffed animal that does not come with a virtual counterpart that requires the use of a computer.

product_title: John Deere Mighty Trike
review_body: My 3 year old received this for his birthday in August.  He loves it!!!  My husband and I liked it more at the beginning but each time a peddle falls off, we get a little bit more aggravated with it.  We have had to put the peddles back on this bike at least 10 times in 2 1/2 months.  It would be more enjoyable if it was made a little bit better.

product_title: Room Moodz Desk Fan
review_body: This fan is much smaller than you may think. It also has these crazy little lights that are on the blades. I received the fan it and was broken and was shorting out. I recommend avoiding it because it will cost more in shipping to than what its worth. (eg. recieving/send back)Its also made in china, you get what you pay for.

product_title: PAJAMA BEAR - 12" blue
review_body: This is the softest, cuddliest little stuffed animal. Our Grandson likes it so much it has become his security blanket and sleeping buddy. We ordered 3 of them so one could be in the wash (washes up beautifully), while one is still in his crib, at home and one could be kept at Nana and Papa's for naptimes here. He calls him \\"teddy\\".

product_title: Kiddi-O Fold 'N Ride Tricycle (Pink)
review_body: We used to have one of the nicer Kettler trike with the push bar and rubber tires and loved it. Unfortunately we loaned it to friends that moved out of state with it, so when our youngest needed a trike we went shopping. I couldn't justify another expensize trike this last time, so we bought this one. What a mistake. The cheap plastic wheels don't turn easily at all. One barely turns period. The push bar is too short to be ergonomic either. I'm 5'7\\" and have to stoop to push it. I wish we had gone ahead and spent the extra money on a good quality trike.

product_title: Walt Disney's Cinderella: Enchanted Evening Castle
review_body: This castle is very overpriced and very flimsy.  I am glad this was a Christmas present and I am not out the money for this thing.  We are giving her a three story large dollhouse for Christmas this year so that we can throw this piece of junk away!!!!

product_title: 78" x 60" 36 Pocket Sun tanner
review_body: These pool floats are very nice.  My family and I have used them every day for 3 weeks and they are holding air fine despite our extremely hot weather. I ordered 2 from Amazon for less than the price of one similar float available locally.

product_title: Learning Resources Mgears Building Set
review_body: I got this for my 6 year old grandson for Christmas.  He is very good at building things, but the parts on this are hard to put together.  It takes some force to snap the pieces together.  There are lots of things to make and hopefully as he gets older, he will be able to use it.  I think the age should probably be for 8 and older.  Otherwise it's a great toy.

product_title: Little Tikes Push & Ride Racer
review_body: We bought this for our grandson's first birthday. He had only walked a few steps prior but when he got this, he crawled over, threw his leg over and TOOK OFF! He loves it. His 6 year old sister rides it too, with no ill effects so far. It's not gimmicky, needs no batteries. He sometimes uses the back handle to walk along behind the thing.

product_title: BRIO Curious George with Bicycle
review_body:
I picked this up at Tuesday Morning for 3.00. I am infact shocked at the price Amazon is selling it for, WOW. I was more than pleased with the quality of the toy. My son loves Curious George and this was a fun addition!

Overall our Brio toys have held up to a beating and still look brand new. They are worth the money.

product_title: Bicycle® Masters Edition RED Playing Cards Deck by Ellusionist
review_body: This deck of cards is simply amazing.  They slide better than any deck i have ever seen and the ace of spades is stunning.  I ordered off the companies web site and the super saver shipping only took 5 business days.

product_title: Toy Story 12 Inch Nighttime Rescue Buzz Lightyear
review_body: My son LOVES this toy! He is 3 and just can't get enough of it...  I, on the other hand want to throw it away and buy the Disney version of it.  Here is the probelem with the Hasbro model...  The wing span & backpack fall off every 30 seconds of play.  So my son is constantly saying...  \\"Look mommy his impressive wingspan fell off again!\\"  so sad.  I hope this help  :)

product_title: Stare! Junior Board Game - 2nd Edition
review_body: Stare Jr. is a very simple game that can be challenging for adults. I like the fact that there are only 3 simple rules. Children of varying ages can play this game. It is also fun for adults. I work with Autistic children and I have been playing this game with them.

product_title: FindIt Puzzle Game
review_headline: The best no-mess, ADDICTIVE game I've ever played!
review_body: I came across this game in a little privately owned toy shop on Long Island, NY.  My sister bought the kids version and I bought the original for my husband for Easter.  After I started looking for the objects, I couldn't put it down, and my husband was lucky enough to look at the box--but has still not played with the game.  I found all the objects--including the penny in about 3 days.  The object the eluded me was the darn washer.  It was the most frustrating thing in the whole game to get my eye on.  Just this morning I finally found it--and VICTORY WAS MINE!  I conquered the Findit game,and in just 3 days--not bad.  Get this game, it's terrific!

product_title: Shadows Over Camelot
review_body: Shadows Over Camelot is a great game, although pretty complex.  It takes a couple of times of playing to get used to all the details.  It is a good game for adults to play and not that great for kids...

product_title: Educational Insights Playfoam
review_body: I bought this for my son since I am not a big fan of Playdough (it sticks to everything). Granted the playfoam doesn't stick to other surfaces like playdough, it isn't as pliable either. It doesn't sculpt as easily as they say it does. I will not purchase again.

product_title: Cars: Doc Hudson
review_headline: Great car from a great movie
review_body: My daughter gets a huge kick out of these little cars. spends hours playing with them. I'm trying to get her the whole set. Would have bought some on Amazon, but the price gouging is insane, these things are like $3.17 at Wal-mart. shop around so these gougers get the message that this sort of thing is just not right. Same car $4-5 bucks on ebay.  Merry Christmas.

product_title: Pack 'n Play - Windsor Wave
review_headline: Good item, but has a few areas that need to be improved
review_body:
The Pack 'n Play isn't a bad idea but I found a quiet a few things that bother me.

Cons: ~The changing table is uneven. Madelyn keeps rolling
towards the diaper organizer. I have to lay her
diagonally to prevent her from rolling.
~The wipes compartment dries the wipes out, so we don't
even use that feature.
~The mattress pad has a HUGE lump at one end. The middle
of the mattress just sags.
~The mattress cover doesn't fit well. It's pretty loose.
The cover that we bought was designed to be used with
the mattress.
~The light feature is useless. It's not bright at all.
Also the canopy is in the way, it doesn't matter if you
have it up or down it blocks the little bit of light that
is given out.
~The music isn't loud enough. Granted it's not suppose to
blast your babies ear off, but it's barely audible.
~When you cycle through the music it's so low you never
know if it's off or if it's just too low to hear. Maybe
they could install some kind of display that tells you
what features you are using. Or at least have an off
button.
~It takes up a lot of room. It's also very wide so I'm not
able to fit it through the doorway. I have to take the
whole thing apart to move it.

Pros: ~It's sturdy. The materials seem like they are good
quality.
~The changing table can be flipped up by just pushing the
button on one side. This is a great feature because
we have the Pack 'n Play against the wall. It's also
helpful because after the last diaper change you
sometimes forget to flip the changing table back up, so
you can hold the baby in one arm and use the other to
flip up the table.
~I like the way it looks. The color is unisex.

Hopefully this review will help.

product_title: Connect 4 Folio
review_body: My son (just turned 5) really enjoys playing with his 7 yr old sister.  They both are great at strategizing by creating their own rows to win while also blocking each other.  It's a good way to make children use critical thinking skills and work on focusing continually.  This is great for summer, play it outside, play at the hotel, bring to a restaurant while waiting for your food to arrive.  This is really worth buying (and I bought it for under $10 from Amazon a couple of months ago, look for a sale!)

product_title: Cars Little Rides - Mater
review_body: I purchased the \\"Tow-Mater\\" and \\"Lightning McQueen\\" for my seven year old grandson for Christmas.  I don't know who enjoyed it more, my grandson or my son-in-law!  The only problem we found that the control for the \\"Tow-Mater\\" would also control the \\"Lightning McQueen\\" car.  Which my son-in-law found amusing, but my grandson found frustrating, because Dad was controling his car too!  These cars are definitely fast action.  It might be hard for younger children to control the cars.  I will definitely add more of the \\"Cars\\" radio controlled vehicles to my grandson's, (& son-in-law's) collection.

product_title: Family Games IQ Collection Brain Teaser Brain Baffler (Level 1)
review_body: This gift was perfect because that's what the gentleman who got it loves to do.

product_title: Kiddi-O by Kettler Supertrike 2 with Stroller Handle
review_headline: Wide wheelbase, less tendency to tip.
review_body:
We bought a Radio Flyer \\"Fold2Go\\" prior to this Kiddi-O Supertrike 2. The Kiddi-O has a much wider wheelbase and does not have a tendency to tip like the RadioFlyer.

Minor issues: The Kiddi-o front wheel assembly was a bit difficult because the instructions were not clear on how the \\"gear\\" was supposed to be put together. The assembly of the rest of the tricycle was not difficult. There's no padding on the handle bar.

Overall a good and durable tricycle. It's the tricycle we see other kids riding around the neighborhood. For the price, it can't be beat. We also went and bought a Supertrike 1 after this one.

product_title: Loftus Fancy Salted Mixed Nuts
review_headline: Classic toy with a choking hazard
review_body:
There is a small white bead in the bottom of the SNAKE NUT CAN; it is a choking hazard for young children. (I think the bead is included in the bottom of the \\"can\\" so that it sounds like there is something inside the can when you shake it.) When I opened the box of 25 SNAKE NUT CANS, many of the white beads and bottom lids were all over the box.

The SNAKE NUT CANS have too many pieces: plastic can, screw top, yellow spring(which represents the snake), bottom lid that pushes and comes out easily (it is supposed to conceal the hits bead), and white bead.

I expected it to have 3 parts: can, screw top, and spring (which represents the snake). The bottom lid is cumbersome (and comes out easily)and the white bead is a choking hazard.

Vendor did not allow me to return this item because I ordered more than 24. Amazon helped me resolve this issue.

product_title: Ben 10 DNA Alien Heroes: Heat Blast
review_body:
My son had the following to say:

This toy has a really cool light-up head. The DNA slime bubbles appear to ooze when the button on his back is pressed. [My son points out that the figure tips over easily -- the center of balance is high because of the large hands -- but I think he poses just fine. This figure has knees, but they do not bend. Each arm flexes and rotates at the shoulder and elbow].

review_body:

I wrote to Amazon to ask what was going on and their only question to me was do I want to cancel the order!!! no, I want my table, very upset!!!

product_title: Black Knight Role Playset

review_body: Although many of the figures are incredibly cool, Marvel Legends is really starting to tick me off with their manipulitive marketing. I saw this figure at Wal-mart and passed it up because frankly it looked bad, I didn't know the character, and they didn't have the rest of the figures in stock. Then as time passed I ended up getting the other figures later and I can't complete Apocolypse because she is the onlly figure I don't have. I don't even care about this figure but I've got these other stupid body parts with no head for Apocolypse lying around. I'm going to quit collecting after I find this one.

product_title: T Neez: The Groove Mall Playset with Exclusive Doll
review_body: This item was cheaper than some of the Polly Pocket sets but served the same purpose.  My daughter uses the Polly dolls to shop in the mall.  Great!!!

product_title: Animal Alley White Teddy Bear
review_body: It's the softest teddy bear I have ever felt perfect for a baby.  It has the cutest smile and ears.  It is bigger than I imagined for the price.  A perfect teddy bear for a toddler.

product_title: LeapFrog Fridge Phonics Magnetic Alphabet Set - Styles May Vary
review_body: My daughter absolutely loves this fun and educational toy. It stays on the fridge so it stays separate from her other toys, the minute she walks in and pushes a letter in her attention is caught for a while. She is turning three soon and knows a lot of her alphabets and also knows the entire alphabet song. She can count well past 10 and its mostly due to her playing with this often. It has 2 sound settings so it's not too loud, its small enough for her to play with alone and very colorful. And we all love the songs it plays! Highly recommend for children of any age!

product_title: The Farmer Says
review_headline: Good to see this still around
review_body:
I've been observing some toy stores for a developmental psych class I'm taking and it's been fun to see some old toys that I remember from ages ago.

I had a \\"Farmer Says\\" back in the day. I got it in 1988 at age two and played with it for a few years after that. This one keeps the charm of the old one yet has a few significant improvements:

1. More stuff. Last I checked \\"Farmer Says\\" didn't have as much variety as this one.
2. Quiz mode. You can check your understanding now!
3. The big one: no more pull string! Anyone who had a See 'n' Say in the 1980s knows about these. They could get pulled too far and cause problems. The lever that replaces it appears to work much better!

The other thing I like about this toy is that there is no character propaganda on it. I get sick of seeing Dora the Explorer or Spiderman on every single toy that's out there.

Highly recommend this one for anyone with 2-5 year olds.

product_title: Doodle Pets - Crafty - Purple Purse
review_body:
On a recent trip to Toys R Us, my little sister got a glow in the dark blue doodle bear (see my review for that too!) and then we spotted the doodle pet $5 deal. We thought it would be so cute if Artie (the bear) had a pet puppy!

When we got home, we instantly wanted to play with Artie and Crafty (the dog). Crafty is soooo cute and the perfect size to be a doodle bear/monster/girl pet! Plus, it comes with a carrying case you can also color on with the markers!

The only thing is: the pets only come with 2 markers. My suggestion is: buy the five pack of markers (see my review for that too!) which work on any doodle product. All in all, super cute! I'm looking into the pink one for me and my future pink doodle bear!

review_headline: Nice looking toy, but difficult to play with.
review_body: My son wanted this for a long time, and he finally got it for Christmas.  Once it was assembled, the frustration began.  The construction is not very sturdy and my son had to keep putting wheels or panels back on.  Other Lego sets have been much more durable.  This set appears to be made for display, and not for play.

product_title: LEGO Star Wars A-Wing Fighter
review_body: I love the original trilogy. The A-wing was an awesome fighter. I loved it's sleek design and speed. The original Lego A-wing wasn't the best set around. I love this new re-design.    This set features the use of white and maroon parts, different from the original grey and red. I actually like this color scheme and if you don't, well, you can change it. The model itself is awesome! The only flimsy part is the back fins, which don't fall off all of the time. Swoosh away with this model! Or display it. Although the nose isn't movie accurate, and the stickers are another dread, they're only minor problems. (Hey you may even like stickers.)Another problem is that the pilot lounges in the cockpit and the computer screen, I don't like either one of those. The cart that comes with it is basic. It's simple yet effective.    The figures are pretty cool. The smilies I don't like but I modded that. The technician has a cool torso and wears a helmet that he can skateboard with! The pilot is dressed in a sleek green with a nice racing helmet. Not movie-accurate helmet but still cool.    This is a very good set. It's only $[...] more than the original and comes with more pieces and accuracy. It's definately worth the money. Buy multiples, you won't regret it.

product_title: Sno-Baller Snowball Maker; Colors May Vary
review_body: My kids really liked this sno-baller!  Easy to use and fun.  Now we have perfect snow balls in our freezer all year long-just in case we need one.

product_title: 2174 40' Metal Boxcar CP HO
review_body:
This car and all metal train products are better in my opinion, the most train set qulity sets or cars. I like to start with the pros, the mass weight, most the weight is too much, ya if you are going by NMRA standerds, but the weight to me gives the car a more realistic feel. By that I mean you give your locos a run for the money, lots of weight gives you that real train feel. Another pro with car is with this heavy weight you can do real kicking with out much force. Model Power has also produced this car with grade A RP-25 metal weels, wich roll great. Watch out though, if you set this car out on a slight grade it will roll, yes even if there is more then one. Down they go.... it is just like when you bleed-off the real thing. Now on to the paint sceme, another grade A, My cars out of the box are like proto 2000 in compairison with the paint.
Now, onto the cons, we will start with the molding style of the car, Model Power it seems did not do as good as they could have done. The qulity of the body is equal to proto 1000, the grab irons do not stick out, and the sterups are plastic NOT metal, the laders and sills are molded into the side of the car. This poor qulity mistake will be pasted up by the \\"proto-type\\" modeler, what a shame. That is why I can only give this, or any Model Power Metal Train series, a 4 star rateing. A easy con is the plastic knuckle cuplers, they give to much slack. Easly fixable with Kadee #5 or #58 what ever you like better.
Now to bring it all together, this car is good and you got to give em' credit. For most will be happy with these cars. Good qulity at a good price and with todays prices in freight cars $12.00-$15.00 is not too bad for what you get. Enjoy your new car, hope I was of some help.

p.s. Because of the mass weight as in the text above the Metal Train series is best on metal type track (nickel silver) Atlas Snap switches with plastic frogs will be destroyed with regular use of these cars. Stay with the metal frogs or use Peco track. These cars will also hammer code 40 track, so beware of where they are going to, beleave me, I know from experience.

product_title: Peapod Teeter Totter
review_body:
My boys 3 & 2 love their new peapod teeter totter!

It's light, and designed with little feets in mind :)

product_title: Little Tikes Bubble Belly Party Machine
review_body: Great if you only want it to work about 5 times. Now it just turns back and forth and no bubbles come out. Little Tikes doesn't carry it any longer (thank goodness) so hopefully consumers will be able to throw away their money on something else.

product_title: Manhattan Toy Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile for Cribs (Discontinued by manufacturer)
review_body: We placed one mobile over the changing table and one over the crib.  Even at a few days old he was staring at the images.  I love that it doesn't require batteries, flash, spin or make noise.  My only complaint is that the cards fall easily if they are accidently bumped by me and the mobile is then off balance (and baby can easily reach up and grab the mobile).

product_title: LEGO Star Wars TIE Interceptor
review_body: The detail on this model is excellent and it has all of the features you would expect on a lego model. Unlike other sets this one is very fragile so stick to the age on the box, your younger child will break it apart with every touch. And that really is my only gripe, it is just not a play toy, this is more of a display item so keep that in mind when making your purchase. The lego's from this model have since been incorporated into the general pile becaue the Intercepter was never fun for my son to play with.

product_title: Deluxe Wooden Mini Play Bead Cube By Anatex. Great Pre-school Educational Toy or Waiting Room Toy. 5 Games in 1 Wooden Toy.
review_body: While this product is slightly smaller than I thought before I saw it, the construction, unlike in other reviews, is *solid*.  This item is played with by many children throughout the day in my store, and it has held up for months with little to no signs of wear.  The wood construction is (I think - it's not in front of me) 12-layer solid plywood, nicely cut, and very well put together.  Each side has its own activity, and each seems nicely made.

product_title: Piranha Panic Game
review_body:
I bought this game for my (just turned 4 years) son and he just LOVES this game. It is SO much fun. it doesn't take ages to play either.
Even his grandparents who aren't in to playing any type of games like this. I highly recommend this! the only thing negative is that on our game the 2 \\"legs\\" to the game don't really attache well but it doesn't matter as long as you don't pick it up (then they will fall out, one of them anyway) because you don't have the game up in the air when you play it. This game is a big hit in our house!

product_title: Hot Wheels: AcceleRacers AcceleDrome Playset
review_headline: great track set, does what it says
review_body: I researched this track set and ended up buying it on ebay, it was worth it.  It does exactly what it says, nothing more, but the important thing is it works.  It's a little noise but that isn't an issue.  Two kids can compete with each other ( or in our case my son & husband).  Not all cars are capable of making it to the wheel of power, but that's half the fun of the track, to see which cars are winners.  Definitely a must have for Hot Wheels lovers.

product_title: Tyco Radio Control Terrain Twister: Green (49 MHz)
review_body: To start with I think it is a good idea that Tyco make an r/c that is not totally useless to people who don't live in California, Florida, Georgia, Carolinas, Texas or Arizona until summer and whatever I left out. Many times I will get an r/c for Christmas and unable to play with it do to snow, wetness, or cold temps(I live in Michigan and am 14). Airhogs r/c airplanes all require very little wind and a temp above 45 degrees. That doesn't easily come in Michigan until May. Especially this winter because my area normally gets 35in of snow and already we have gotten 72in. The record in my area is 75in. That brings me to how well this r/c works in snow. Snow is by far the best terrain this vehicle goes in in terms of speed. In deep snow sometimes snow gets caught in a space between the screw and round cap. To prevent that I spray wd40 in there and it eliminates the problem. This is probably been the best year to get this due to the abundance of snow. This r/c does not mind getting wet or dirty, when I use it in my backyard and there is only snow in certain places it is real muddy and the TT is often caked with mud. The next best terrain to use this in is probably water, it goes quite fast and doesn't consume much power. I could imagine it working well in wet sand, but not dry plus dry sand wrecks r/cs. This r/c  works pretty well in dirt with no grass. The worst attribute of all is grass which I think explain why many from the south and California did not like this product because grass is all they had to run it on most of the time. It also doesn't work to bad on carpet. The terrains on how the TT works on starting with the best goes like this snow, water, carpet, dirt and last and least grass. This r/c works horrible on concrete and will only wreck the blades on screws. This thing has massive torque becuse it can go up hills that are very steep and cake with ice and snow. This review is based on the fact that I only payed 48 dollars in total for this. I bought one from Meijer that had been opened and the box wasn't in the best shape, so it was only 48 dollars instead of their regular 65 dollars. I already had the 30 dollar flex pack also. If I was a southerner and had to pay 95 dollars for this I don't know how happy I really would be. The educational value comes from how advanced this things movement is and why it works on surfaces cars like the vertigo don't work on. If this only went as fast as it did and it used wheels like a normal car I wouldn't be impressed, but since it is so cool the way it moves it is alright. I have mastered the use of sidewider mode and angling the screws can also get you unstuck from like a few frozen footprints in the snow. For me it was worth the money.

product_title: Eddie Bauer 3-In-1 Elite Convertible Car Seat - Mercer
review_body: I have not yet tried this car seat out in the front facing position, but rear facing it is a pain to install.  It is near impossible to get it reclined as instructed.  When I put this in my car I refused to drive with her in that car.  When we took a trip where my baby fell asleep her head would plop down to her chest which is VERY dangerous, especially for newborns.  When the police came to help install it they placed 3 pool noodles underneath it and it was still not reclined as instructed.  Actually, every car seat I have had needed noodles and it is ridiculous and should be against the law.  If a car seat needs to be \\"rigged\\" in order to be installed correctly, it should be taken off the market. On a good note, the harnesses are easy to pull tight and loosen.

product_title: Soft & Fuzzy Pooh Mobile
review_body: you have to CONSTANTLY go wind it up again! I didn't think about this when I registered for it.  I've actually ordered a new mobile now with a remote control and one that is battery operated and not a wind-up type.  Cute mobile, son loves it, but too much effort to keep it going.  It only rotates for about a minute or so on full crank up.

product_title: I Play My First Baby Doll Plush Babydoll Set by International Playthings
review_headline: Great learning tool and toy for the very young
review_body:
My first daughter is 21 months old and I am expecting a second daughter in 3 weeks. I have been very diligent to get non gender specific toys, I just didnt want to pigeonhole a girl into only \\"girl\\" toys. However when I found out I was pregnant again I knew I would get a baby doll for her to play with and learn.

I was very pleased yesterday as I opened the box and saw the quality of the doll and her accessories. She is small (but so are my daughters hands) and very cute, as is her bottle, bear, blanket and diaper. The moses basket that it all comes in has handles for easy carrying.

Within minutes of opening it up and showing my daughter how to \\"feed\\" the baby with the bottle she was doing it herself saying \\"baby, juice\\". She then would hold the baby and give it some love, put it in the moses basket and place the blanket over it. I was very impressed with her natural insticts and ability to play with the toy so fast. Im hoping that this will make the transistion in the home easier for her now that she has her own baby to take care of while I take care of her new baby sister.

I had gone to Toysrus to look for this doll but they didnt have it. They did however have many other baby dolls, most of which were far too large for my daughter. The one they had that was small enough she simply wasnt interested in. I was extremely happy how interested she is in this sweet little doll.

If your having a new baby and your oldest one is still very young I would highly reccomend getting this doll. I was a little hesitant at first since the price tag seems high for such a little doll, but if it works and they like it then I can live with paying 20.00.

product_title: ETO Plug 'N Play Drawing System
review_body: I would not reccomend this toy.  It is very difficult to see the images and the directions are confusing and it almost impossible even for an adult to operate this toy.  The advertisments are misleading and inacurate.  This \\"toy\\" is a waste of time and money.

product_title: Fast Lane Action City Parking Garage Playset
review_body: Wish I'd read the other reviews before purchasing this piece of junk!  Like the other reviewers, ours falls apart at the slightest touch.  Its really a shame too since my son loves playing with it.  Problem is, I can't leave him alone with it because as soon as he touches it, I have to fix it.  I can't believe Toys R Us puts their name on this thing.

product_title: Disney Radio Player: Retro Player "Up Down Touch"
review_body: My daughter (4) did like this toy although I found it to be quite a rip off.  The player was reasonably priced but the \\"clips\\" cost as much as buying a full length disney music CD and I could have bought her a cd player with real music cds for about the same cost.  The music is just that...\\"clips\\" of real songs which are very short in playing time and not the full length song.  Yes this is kid friendly but for the money it wasnt worth it and the clips are almost impossible to find!

product_title: Triumph DLX Convertible Car Seat in Marimba Print
review_body: I researched for a long time before deciding on the Triumph V - then I went to BabiesRUs and saw the DLX and was sold - so much more padding.  I like it very much.  My baby sleeps fine in it - although sometimes his head slumps and I don't like that.  The only thing that I really don't like is the the latch release is sometimes a bit hard to trigger.  In all, it is a safe seat with the same kind of foam that Britax uses.  I feel that my son is safe and I didn't have to spend so much money that I couldn't buy one for each vehicle.

product_title: Just Like Home 17 Piece Polka Dot Porcelain Tea Set
review_body:
This tea set is perfect for a little girl wishing to play tea party. Though it is breakable, I find this set much more delightful than a plastic one. Very reasonably priced and a cute design. The only problem I have with it is the packaging it comes in. It was very flimsy...only had a taped on plastic cover (not completely sealed...just 4 peices of scotch tape) which caused one of the spoons to have fallen out somewhere between the time purchased and Christmas morning. Of course this was discovered after the packaging was thrown away so I am unsure how to contact the company to have a replacement one sent to me.
Overall, I recommend this set.

product_title: Fisher Price Roll-a-Rounds Swirlin Surprise Gumballs
review_body: I bought this toy today for my 1 year old son thinking it would be fun.  But when we got home and opened the box, there is really not too much to it.  The balls go in through the top of the head and when the blue button is pressed down, they roll out to the sound of music.  I am thinking about taking it back but reading the other reviews on it, maybe my son will enjoy it after a few days more of playing with this toy.  We'll see!!!!

product_title: CareBears Dance 'n Play Piano
review_body: Overall this is a good toy.  My one year old got it for her birthday.  She loves to push the keys and watch the bears dance.  The biggest drawback is that is is LOUD!  There is not a volume switch.

product_title: Little Touch LeapPad
review_body:
I read many many poor reviews of this item. So many that I almost took this toy back after I had already purchased it. However, we have enjoyed learning this together. Granted, my 15 month old isn't much into the book yet, but he is learning the cards and gets SO excited when he pushes something (anything) and it rewards him with a tune. His attention span with the toy gets longer each time. He hasn't had any trouble pushing with his index finger.

I think it is important to understand that this item was not designed for babies to play alone. It is a great interactive toy for parents/babies. He enjoys it just as much when mommy makes it play.

product_title: Step2 Step 2 LifeStyle Dream Kitchen
review_body: Great toy, my two year old loves it!  I am happy that I read the other reviews and took the advice about allowing time for assembly.  It does take time to assemble, but well worth the two hours to watch my daughter have so much fun!

product_title: Language Littles - Anna Speaks Russian Doll
review_body: I mailed Anna to Four year old Miriam in Lviv, Ukraine.  She and her Mother love the doll.

product_title: Chess Teacher (styles may vary)
review_body:
I had an \\"Educator\\" Chess Set when I was a kid. It looked just like this one. Big difference was that the pieces of that set were solid plastic where-as in this set they are hollow and open-bottomed. That set had a nice weight and feel to it. This one just seems cheap.

I guess I got what I paid for. Used to be that plastic items where the mark of inexpensive/cheap products. Today, we wouldn't want you to have too much plastic-it would seem tacky.

product_title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Power Cards Skateboard
review_body: Yu-Gi-Oh skateboards arent even for little kids unless they plan on never using them because if there to little they'll hurt themselves and once there old enought to actually ride a board they should get a blank deck with gel wheels and bullet trucks so the wheels will slow them way down, while they have somthing decent to ride. If your looking for a blank deck any local skate shop will have them \\"there usually the cheapest\\". As for me i ride a Mystery deck with Destructo Bam 3 trucks and Pink and Black checkerd Zero Chris Cole Wheels with reds bearings. So ive been skate'n for quite a while and i know that you should never waste your money on something as cheap and usless as this item. Thats why i rated it a 1 star (Sorry I couldnt go lower). So if u plan on buying this please burn it as soon as u get it or hang it on your Son/Daughters Wall cause this item is USELESS!

product_title: Triumph DLX Convertible Car Seat in Marimba Print
review_headline: THE STRAPS ARE NOT LONG ENOUGH
review_body: My daughter is 8 month old weighs 20lbs and is 30inches long. She does not fit in this seat. The Shoulder straps are too tight. I tried to release them (and this was not an easy thing to do, the latch seems to be stuck) Sure I hadn't released the straps all the way, I pulled harder, but the straps were released and still were not long enough. I took all the padding off, which is why I purchased the DELUX in the first place and sat the car seat all the way up and she did not fit it the seat any better. Seeing that most people are buying this seat for a LONG-TERM USE I would not purchase this unless your child is very small!!  We have had this car seat for 3 weeks now and I am taking it back.

product_title: LeapFrog Learning Table
review_body: We bought this for our grandson and it is his favorite toy.  He never seems to get tired of playing with it.  The best toy on the market by far.

product_title: Fisher Price Loving Family Twin Time Dollhouse with Exclusive Bonus Accessories
review_body: This dollhouse is very well made.  It's very pretty, and folds up to very small !  The house is roomy.  There is no attached furniture, and this house comes with several pieces--the mom, dad, daughter, 2 babies, 2 chairs, sofa, 2 cradles, small kitchen microwave center, kitty bed and cat.  Ours came with a special bonus of an entire playroom which is a computer desk, glove, bookshelf, and chalkboard.  The house is sturdy.  I like the many doors that open toward the inside--so you don't have to play on the opposite side of the house to use the doors.  The flower pots have flowers that can be removed.  There is even a cloth curtain and bay window with cushion.  The feature my 3 year old daughter likes is the bottom floor closes up with a door as big as the whole room.  It opens to double size the bottom middle room.  There is lots of pink in this house. It takes up less room than the Talking Dollhouse, and can be easily transported from room to room as it folds up so small.  I'm quite impressed!

product_title: Mr. Potato Head - Darth Tater
review_body: I have always loved Mr. Potato Head and have acquired quite a number of potato head pieces. This one I like for what it is. It looks nice and is built well. If you are a collector then this is a must have. I only wish they would have made some different shoes for him. He comes with the same shoes as a regular potato head except they're black. The rest of the pieces are very nicely designed. He also comes with a few extra pieces so you can change his face around with just what comes in the box. It isn't perfect but it would make any potato head or star wars fan happy I'm sure.

product_title: Wolverine : Wolvy-Bot To Aero Slasher
review_headline: Cheap! Don't buy it! What a disappointment
review_body: This is the LAST time I buy ANYTHING to do with Marvel Comics/Toy Biz for my kids. These Mega Morphs are poorly made and parts that aren't even supposed to be removed come apart on their own. Too add to it, they don't really \\"transform\\" you change their position and push/pull a couple of items and then ADD extra LITTLE parts that change the look of the toy. Then there is the \\"power pack\\" which consists of what looks like a little pump with a 4 in. piece of hose that in actuality is a cable. Each of these toys has a certain action it can perform (shooting discs, plastic missiles, etc.) that requires you to plug in the power pack hose tip into the itemand press/pump a button. Guess what? The hose doesn't like to stay locked in and soemtimes doesn't even deliver on the action it is supposed to perform. I bought two of these(different models) for my sons and BOTH of them aren't worth the packaging they came in. Don't waste your money. Get them a GI Joe Sigma Six Figure or something. What a disappoinment. I\\"ve bought countless items made by this company for my kids because they liked the Marvel Heroes. This is the LAST time.

product_title: All in One Reclining Booster
review_body:
This chair is amazing! The recline feature allows small infants to sit in the chair. My daughter has used it since she was 4-months old. We placed toys on the tray and she would giggle at them. At age 3 she is still using this booster. The height adjustment feature is great because as she gets taller the chair can be made shorter. I like the stability of the chair. Even when fully reclined it was not prone to tipping. The chair goes camping, out to restaraunts, to family gatherings, etc. It serves as a place to keep my child busy coloring as well as for eating.

I now purchase this chair for every baby shower I attend! The moms love it and everyone I know who has one has no complaints.

If one thing could be changed about the chair it would be to add a padded seat of some kind because the hard, slick plastic can be a problem at times. But I simply place a dish towel or small blanket under my daughter and she is fine.

product_title: Hilton Single Crib - Cherry
review_body: We've found this crib to be a GREAT one for the price.  I love the color of the wood, and it went together pretty good when we followed the instruction.  My daughter is now 7 months old and it still looks just like new.  It's a great buy!

product_title: Pooh Candyland
review_headline: come on daddy, let's play a game!
review_body: we got this game for our son for his 3rd birthday and he still loves it, and he is going to be 4 next week. every night he asks us to play a game and it is always this one, and we play over and over for an hour or so.  some of the colors are similar but he has not had a problem with them.   over all I would say this one is a hit at our house!

product_title: SpongeBob SquarePants Bounce Round 8' x 8'
review_headline: Sponge Bob is a great toy for kids who like to jump on the bed!
review_body: I bought this toy for my grandson because he loves to jump on my bed.  He especially likes it when I throw in his giant stuffed animals (he's three and doesn't have other children in the home).   If you have a large playroom it might be good inside on a rainy day, but it would be difficult to anchor it so it would be stable.

product_title: Fisher-Price Incrediblock Activity Center
review_headline: Glad I didn't waste my money...
review_body: I was going to buy the Incrediblock for my daughters 1st birthday. I am so glad that when I went to buy it they had it on display. The thing is cheaply made and didn't do enough for the price they wanted for it. Instead I went for the peek-a-block wagon. I am glad I did that because my daughter loves to pull it around the house. Why do company's make one toy crappy and another of the same set excellent?

product_title: Little Tikes Handle Haulers Sonny Semi
review_body:
My two-year-old received this toy for his first birthday and he's still perfectly happy with it.

Like most children his age, he likes to carry things around the house with him and the handle on this truck fits the bill perfectly.

The door at the rear of the truck opens up to allow him to load his cargo (usually his Fisher Price Little People) and haul them away. He's pretty rough on toys, but that door is still on nice and tight. It opens easily and closes completely without help from an adult. Seems like such a simple thing, but doors on toys never seem to work properly. Not true in this case.

This toy is perfectly safe. It's made of plastic with no sharp edges. There are no design flaws that I've seen in the past year. Unless you wrap your child in bubble wrap, they're going to get hurt sometimes... this toy wouldn't be the cause of an injury, so purchase with confidence.

Inexpensive toy and money well spent.

product_title: Fisher-Price Infant To Toddler Swing in Red
review_body: After reading others reviews of this swing, I had to comment.  I bought this swing for my daughter when she was 18 months.  She is now turning 3 and the swing is still in wonderful condition(even the ropes!) even though it's been outside for 1 1/2 years.  That's even inluding a storm that brought us about 5 inches of ice.  My daughter loved this when I bought it for her and she still does.  She could swing for hours if it wasn't always raining in the Northwest.  I would most definitly buy this again if I have another child.  As for those that are complaining about the ropes...  they are ropes!  They are eventually going to unravel unless you happen to have a rope from a shipyard that is ment to hold vessels and not a child that ways less than 40 lbs.

product_title: Ocean Wonders Aquarium
review_body: My son started using this as soon as we broght him home and he loves it!  We have a large \\"real\\" aquarium he loves to stare at and when its time to go to bed the Ocean Wonders Aquarium does the trick.  I do wish it would stay on longer as he doesn't quite get to sleep fast enough (it shuts off after 5, 10 or 15 mins depending on the mode)but i usually wait and push the button again for him. We have had it for 4 months and haven't had to change the batteries yet eithr. A big plus when you have a house full of battery operated toys.

product_title: Fisher-Price Peek-a-Blocks Tumblin' Sounds Giraffe
review_body: This toy is cute, but that's about it.  I expected the blocks to actually \\"tumble\\" down the giraffe, perhaps in a zig-zag fashion. But they don't; they just \\"drop\\" straight to the bottom. There's a button at the bottom that plays a cute little tune when the block hits the bottom, but that's all this toy does. I guess I just expected more from it. We returned it. As a side note, we also got the Peek-a-Blocks Train and both my girls LOVE it! Costs a little more than the giraffe, but is worth it!

product_title: Toysmith Measure & Mix Set
review_body: This was a cute addition to my little girls kitchen stuff!  It has held up and is just the right size for little hands.

product_title: Eddie Bauer Summit Booster Car Seat with LATCH - Brown Tech Print
review_body: Well...I've had this seat for awhile now and when I first wrote a review I gave it 4 stars (after owning it for 2 weeks), but after owning it for about 7 months, I change my mind...The straps do get twisted up about once a week.  Also one side is definately tighter than the other.  I have to pull on it several minutes to get it snug on my daughter as it does not tighten easily.  Even when I yank on it I sometimes feel as if my daughter is not as tight in it as I would like.  I hate the time it takes to put her in the car.  I'm thinking of switching it to just the booster now and letting go of the harness as she is able to use it either way right now.  I hope that helps it...Either way I think I will probably use it as a second seat in my husband's car and I may look for a new safe seat.  It may have gotten good consumer reviews, but that won't make a difference if the straps aren't working correctly or fitting correctly around my child.

product_title: LeapFrog Hug & Learn Baby Tad Plush
review_body: The buttons on baby tad's chest are hard to press, his morning button (on the left palm) already broke (has a short in it already after 1 - yes 1 day of playing), it only plays up to 6 minutes of nite nite songs (ever tried getting your baby to sleep in 6 minutes?), you have to keep pressing buttons to keep it from say \\"bye bye\\" and turning off. She liked it for about 10 minutes. It's not a very good buy. I love leapfrog products but this one failed consumers.

product_title: Barbie Fairytopia Azura Doll by Mattel
review_body:
I may be biased I am a fairy fan.

My daughter recieved this for Xmas and I think it is cute!!

HEr hair is a bit weird because it is hard, like over hairsprayed BUT IMO that is actually a bonus to save it from the normal ratty barbie hair in a few months...

Her dress is adorable, I LOVE the shoes!!!!!

ANd IMO her wings are PERFECT and it was a smart design to attach them to the clothes so the kids wont break them off as easy. (FYI Disney store's fairies are designed the same way, for those that liked this doll) Wings IMO should be light, airy and dainty. Not hard, gaudy, illogical.

I also totally appreciate that her \\"tights\\" are actually painted on her legs!! I am a bit anal about not wanting to lose clothing or having kids destroy items trying to dress and undress them.

My daughter has not really gotten onto the barbies yet, thanfully for me, but I am really digging the fairtopia barbies after this doll!!

product_title: Batman: 3.5' Batcave with Bonus Action Batman Figure
review_body: WARNING!!! CAUTION!!! Parents do not waste your hard earned money or valuable time with this toy. I am the proud father of two boys who were so excited to receive this batcave from Santa. Boy were they disappointed with the substandard quality. This has to be the worst display of a children's toy that I have seen in awhile. I feel that Mattel has stolen from me by misrepresenting this gypsy junk as an actual toy. Please do not purchase!

product_title: LP GAME: Mind Wars Jr.
review_body:
Silly me did not but the board so all my sibs have is the game pieces.
Great game

product_title: Fisher Price Learning Home (Discontinued by manufacturer)
review_body: I just purchased this toy for my 1 year old son and he absolutely adores it!  This is well worth the money!  He loves the all the songs, opening and closing the door, and turning the light on and off! It really keeps him occupied, one of the best toys we have purchased so far!

product_title: Boggle Junior Game
review_body: Rather than call Boggle Jr a game I would call it an educational tool.It is very boring!It has several dice and each of the sides are labeled w/a letter.There are also flash cards that you put in the holder and cover up the either 3 or 4 letter words and look at the picture to spell the words with the dice.That's basically it.Whoever spells the most words correctly wins.Not the most fun game but would be great to teach or improve childs spelling.

product_title: Hasbro Elefun
review_body: My daughter really wanted this after she saw it in the store so I got it for her birthday. It's a great concept -- if it actually worked the way it's supposed to. She actually has fun with it when we can get the stupid butterflies to come out. The instructions claim they designed it so the majority of the butterflies would come out within two minutes. Well, as I write this, the thing has been running for five minutes straight and has shot out exactly six of the 25 butterflies inside. I can hear the rest swirling around in there, doing nothing. Milton Bradley needs to up the power of the fan and include more butterflies. Also, the nets need to be deeper. They are very shallow and when my daughter moves quickly to catch another one, all the ones she's already caught pop out of the net!

product_title: Spinmaster Aquadoodle Thomas Toot N Doodle
review_headline: Definetly takes aquadoodling t a whole new level!
review_body: I love my Thomas the Tank Engine Toot N' Doodle! I've only had it for a few days, but I feel I've been Aquadoodling my whole life! The best part is it makes virtually no mess!

product_title: Little Tikes Double Easel
review_body: We just got this easel for our 20 month old daughter and she LOVES it!!! It comes with a piece of chalk and a large writing tablet and didn't take too long to put together. I would definitly recommend this easel to any one with a child who loves to color.

product_title: Disney Winnie The Pooh Ride On - Hundred Acre Jet Activity Ride-On (Colors may vary)
review_headline: Disappointed - not suitable for age range
review_body: I bought this for my nephew for his 1st birthday.  He loved it - that is until he kept getting pinched by the wings and 'owwies' from the propellers.  It tipped over a lot too - in the end it was easier to throw it out than to deal with the injuries it caused!  He had it less than 2 months - what a waste of money.  Wouldn't recommend at all.

product_title: High Chair Cover Up - Navy
review_body: Let's face it - the perfect high chair pad would have no \\"nooks & crannies\\" and wouldn't let anything fall underneath the pad. Since this doesn't exist, this is pretty close. My Graco high chair is almost 7 years old and on my third child. It was perfectly fine except for the pad. This doesn't fit perfectly over the wide top/back of the chair but it's definitely not coming off. It's really got minimal nooks for crumbs to lodge into and it's so incredibly easy to wipe clean. Highly recommend this pad to replace those that are cracking or hard-to-clean cloth (it's a cushioned microfiber-type material).

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Aquarium Cradle Swing
review_headline: 8 months old and still loves it!
review_body: This swing has been a lifesaver for us.  Although never colicky, our son had a serious reflux problem and I was scared to death to let him sleep in his crib, lest he aspirate his ample spit-up.  He slept in this swing from the time he was born until almost 6 weeks old.  He used it for naps until he was 4 months old, and any time I needed a few minutes hands-free.  He loved the mobile, the lights and the music, and the fact that you could change swing directions was a HUGE Bonus.  I was amazed at how long the batteries seemed to last, even now that he is 8 1/2 months old and TWENTY FOUR POUNDS (he's a big boy!).  The swing is still swinging him as well as ever, and even though I've had to remove the mobile toys because he is so big that he can now reach them, he STILL loves his swing!  I would recommend this to anyone and everyone!

product_title: Koala Baby - Satin Edge Fleece - Sun
review_body: My babies love these. My 3 year old twins and my 8 month old twins. They are great to sleep with and cuddle with. My kids love laying thier face on them, and covering them when they are one the couch. They hold up to many washings and they are very pretty. They were swaddle blankets when the kids were young, but now they are \\"the blanket\\". They are used in the car, in the stroller, in the beds/cribs on the couch, at naptime and when the kids are drowzy, tired or cranky they cary their lovey animals around and one of these blankets, we have a blue, a pink, a white and this yellow one, the most popular. They are very pretty and the satin only began to come off the 3 year old blue and pink ones, so we bought new ones. They are very soft and definatly a blanket to last.

product_title: Barbie as The Princess and The Pauper:  Interactive Serafina Plush Doll with 10-minute Audio CD
review_body:
I bought two Serafina cats for my two girls(yep gotta buy in doubles) and I think it is adorable-it does react with the cd provided with the cat and it does react with the movie dvd-another thing it does is react to the computer when you go to Barbie.com and play the Princess and the Pauper game-all you do is the same thing as if you were using it with the cd-place the jewlery box and Serafina in front of the computer speaker and she will react to the game on the computer-not too many reactions, but she does react. Works well in the car too-just dont forget to bring the jewlery box and try not to stop short-otherwise you'll get a fat lip or get a black eye from the jewlery box flying towards you -I speak from experience.HAH!!
Being a cat person myself-I wanted the girls to have this even if we had not purchased the movie-very adorable and I love it when she asks you \\"Would you kiss my nose\\" and she kisses you back when you kiss her. I would recommend it-but as a previous reviewer had said \\"It is a battery vampire\\" for certain, but then again, what battery operated toys isn't? You will see your little girl smile from ear to ear with eyes wide open, when she first sees Serafina react to the cd or movie.

product_title: Step2  WaterWheel Activity Play Table
review_body: My kids LOVE this toy, from 18mos, 3yrs, to 9yrs. Most kids love to play with water, and this table is a great way for them to play safely (always with supervision of course).  This water table is great quality, and the accessories with it are cute.  It teaches cause & effect to little ones, and bigger ones can play 'dolls-are-swimming' imaginative play, or everyone can just have fun splashing and cooling off.  It's great for either the yard or even on the deck, and it's easy to empty.  And the price is great.  (I just wish we could have found it in a store,  instead of just online.)  Definately recommend it!

product_title: VIDEONOW Color Personal Video Player: Red
review_body:
We got this video player nearly a year ago and our three year old loves it. We've got discs of The Wiggles, Bob the Builder, and Scooby Doo. Its a great way to keep the little guy happy on log trips to the grandparents or just for running around town. He even prefers it to some of his DVD's when we're knocking around the house. Very nice, because it plays the color discs, the Junior discs, and even the older black and white Video Now discs.

I need to second the reviewer who said this is is a more cost-effective player than the JR model. Of course, it will depend on how well your particular child handles something like this. If he or she is apt to bounce it off the wall, or a younger sibling, you may want to opt for the rubberized version.

product_title: Madagascar 4-Figure Pack
review_body:
My son was a fan of the Madagascar bunch even before we saw the movie. In fact, he is utterly in love with Gloria the Hippo (go figure!)

Alex the Lion, Gloria, Marty the Zebra, and Melman the Giraffe are all posable, and great fun for imaginative play. My son keeps them on his dresser most times, but last night, he asked if he could sleep with them...so I put them on his pillow. Needless to say, he was delighted!

Each of the figures have movable heads, which is an added bonus.

My only criticism is that Gloria the Hippo sometimes wobbles...to the point of falling off my son's dresser entirely. If I open one of his drawers, Gloria usually takes a dive onto the floor.

But for imaginative play--or just to have on display--these figurines are great for young Madagasar fans!

product_title: Triumph DLX Convertible Car Seat in Marimba Print
review_headline: This seat is great if you never plan to need to clean it!
review_body:
I, like many other reveiwers, was impressed by the Triumph car seat. It was easy to install, adjust, and Consumer Reports loved it for safety. The downfall is that it is just impossible to clean the straps!

My daughter is 3 months old and is still using her infant car seat travel system (she has yet to use this seat, ever) but over the weekend we kept her 24 month old cousin. We thought \\"how great\\" we can just pop her in and go... and it was nearly that easy! Unfortunately, she got car-sick and vomited all over the car seat, I didn't really worry too much, I have had to dissassemble my Graco seat and easily washed all parts of it. I assumed that I would be able to do the same here. (Silly me!) I was able to dissassemble the seat and remove the seat pads (after a GREAT DEAL OF DIFFICULTY!) but the staps are not removeable. Now the seat still reaks of vomit and it is just a nightmare to try to put back together (eight screws and very little by way of instruction in the user manual.) Actually all the pieces are still dissassembled here in my living room floor, AUGHHHHH! This seat is great if you never plan to need to clean it.

I am very dissapointed in this product and would not purchase it again. This was the only Evenflo product that I purchased for my daughter (as I have little cofidence in the Evenflo name)I won't be purchasing any more Evenflo products in the future.

product_title: My Scene Goes Hollywood Nolee Doll
review_body: Come on, bratz lovers...cant we all just get along? Brats are awesome,and so are my scene...and another thing.. My scene are NOT ugly...They are beautiful..and so are bratz. So my advice, get over it! Im fed up with this debate.

product_title: Bratz: Limited Edition 24" Cloe Collector Doll
review_body: These dolls are gorgeous, but the big ones are for display only. Thank goodness my 7 year old likes collecting and understands the value of taking care of her toys. She saved her own money and purchased this on sale after Christmas at KMart for 50.00 Great deal for such a wonderfully appreciated doll.

review_body: My 5 year old keeps beating me!  Could it be because I let him?  This is a very nice racing set.  I love the fact that it's electric, no batteries required.  The only thing I wasn't too thrilled about was the feeble little flags that became unglued and wound up all over the floor.  Nevertheless, this was so insignificant, it was hardly an inconvenience. I noticed that by increasing the speed gradually, one can \\"floor the pedal\\" and the car will stayed glued to the track, but if you just pull the trigger suddenly, off it goes.  This is great for the \\"father-son male bonding ritual\\".  No speed limits, no brakes, unlimited power supply, what more do us guys want?  On your marks...

review_body:
My daughter got it for Christmas and really likes it, but the external AC to DC power adaptor has died. The unit seems durable enough (compared to other portable DVD players) but the external power pack seemed too weak considering it was putting out 15V and 1.2 amps (and guess what...it failed!!)

review_body: Lost Cities is a really fun game, and very addictive.  I've personally played over 200 matches already on the free online version available at [...]  Check it out and play against some really good players across the globe and get a feel for the game itself before buying. review_headline: I'm gonna go chill with..... with my dad

review_body: This is a very stylish diaper bag.  I love all the different bags that it comes with, however there is not enough room to fit it all in the bag.  This bag is great for short trips.

The downside is the cover that goes over the \\"boat\\" which your child lays on is very thin and underneath is the hard plastic of the frame. review_body: We bought this for my daughter after Christmas, she was a little over one month old, and we used it then to put on the changing table to keep her enterained while we changed her diaper, and it really worked.. and now at 9 months it is one of her favorite toys, especially in the car!

review_body: I know this toy has gotten some bad reviews but my son absolutely loves it. If your child loves music and Elmo, they will probably love this toy! review_body: I am very please with the Neat Diaper Disposal.  Easy to use and keeps the odors in.

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Aquarium Cradle Swing

review_body: My baby has been in love with this swing since she was a week old.  She is now 3 months and still loves it.  How ever I am not as easy to please! product_title: Walter Farley's The Black Stallion Model and Book Set
review_headline: A great tribute to Farley's classic children's story!
review_body:
As a horse lover from a very young age, \\"The Black Stallion\\" is one of those books that was read to me when I was little, which I later read on my own, and of which I still have fond memories today. The first of Walter Farley's twenty-one books, \\"The Black Stallion\\" has become a staple in children's literature. It tells the story of Alec Ramsay and his partnership with a remarkable horse, referred to only as the Black. In this gift set offered by Breyer Animal Creations, you can get both the original story in paperback book form, and a beautiful, durable portrait model of the Black.

The storyline is as follows: While returning from a trip to India, Alec's ship is wrecked in a storm, leaving he and the Black as the only survivors, washed up on a deserted island. For nineteen days they must survive there, and in this time a strong bond is formed between boy and horse. Once Alec and the Black are rescued they return to New York, where Alec asks a neighbor if he might stable the Black in his old barn. As it turns out, Henry Dailey is a former racehorse trainer, and he immidiately recognizes the Black's potential. Thus, man and boy pair up in order to train the spirited horse, hoping to turn him into a competitive runner. At this time the racing world is abuzz about an upcoming match race between two champion horses, each said to be the best racer in the country, but who have never run against each other. But when the Black shows more talent than Dailey would ever have thought possible, he begins to think that this wild, unpedigreed stallion just might have what it takes to beat them both...

The story is a bit far-fetched and idealistic, but it nevertheless makes for one whopping adventure. Farley was an avid horseman and he puts his knowledge to good use here. His descriptions of the proud, fiery Black bring the wild horse magnificently to life before our eyes. The prose is simple and fast-paced, with one event leading rapidly into another, but it still maintains a richness and depth that allows the reader to develop a strong attachment to the main characters. You can really feel the bond between boy and horse, and you can't help but care about them. \\"The Black Stallion\\" is an absolute must-read for any young horse lover. The book has a timeless quality to it, and retains every bit of its magic even for modern readers.

After penning \\"The Black Stallion,\\" Farley went on to write twenty more horse stories, most centered around further adventures of Alec, the Black, and the characters that surround them (the exception being \\"Man O'War,\\" which is an account of that famous racehorse's life). I have read every one of these additional books, some more than once, and would recommend them to anyone that has read and enjoyed this first book. I don't know of a single die-hard horse lover that hasn't read at least the first few books in the series, and many adult equestrians cite Farley's books as being what got them interested in horses to begin with.

The model horse included in this set is the most recent of many different Black Stallion models Breyer Animal Creations has produced since the company was founded in 1950. It is a simple, solid black paint job on the Sham mold, originally used to depict the horse from Marguerite Henry's book \\"The King of the Wind.\\" Breyer horses are surprisingly durable, made of cellulose acetate plastic. I've been collecting Breyers since I was seven years old, well over a decade ago, and have had them take all sorts of tumbles and falls from high shelves without incurring anything more than a light scratch, and often not even that. The recommended age given here is eight years, but the model is a perfectly suitable toy even for younger children. Conversely, it would also make an attractive shelf piece for adult collectors. It comes in one of Breyer's fancier boxes, with a tropical island scene printed on the backdrop.

To top it off, the price listed hereof $19.99 is an unbeatable bargain. You won't find this set for under $40.00 in most toy stores. If you're looking for a gift idea for a horse-loving youngster, or simply want to revisit your own youth, this is definitely a worthwhile purchase. The only downside is that, if you already own the book, the model is not available for sale individually. You might also consider the movie version of the story, which appeared in 1979, though it is no replacement for the book.sted here of $19.99 is an unbeatable bargain.
