product_title: Amazing Amanda
review_headline: UNFAIRLY RATED.............. Great doll if used right!
review_body: I bought this doll, thinking I would need to return it after reading all the bad reviews. I am a 32 year old working mom and gave this doll to my daughter on her 5th birthday, this Saturday, December 10, 2005. I thought the doll was great and has been shot down unfairly. The only way I can explain, is to comment on the other reviewer's comments. First issue is batteries. We have been playing with the doll for 4 days now and no issues with the batteries getting hot or dieing. I bought cheap batteries too? All toys eat batteries but I think the earlier comments were kind of stretching it a little. Second is programming. I found the doll very easy to program and it only took me about 5-10 minutes max. I have no idea why others are taking an hour or having to reprogram after turning the doll off? First you do not turn this doll off, you simply tell her \\"Go to sleep\\" after she asks, \\"what do you want to do mommy\\"? Then if turned off, you don't re-program, she has the same info already programmed you just need to say yes after she tells you the date and time. That doesn't take an hour to say? To program you simply answer a few questions about the date and time....She will say, \\" it is December 10th 2005, is this correct\\"? You say, yes. If it is not, you say No then she will tell your to squeeze her hand when she says the correct month or day.... easy. Third is operation. I believe this doll should be treated like the computer it is. You have to use it properly for it to work. There are key phrases you must say, \\"no\\", \\"yes\\", \\"Go to sleep\\", \\"Lets play\\" and \\"time to eat\\". I may have them off a little but the booklet tells you the phrases and yes you have to wait for her to finish her question or comment completely then say the proper answer or phrase in a clear voice. My 5 year old went through the set up with me and I explained to her how she works and yes she will mess up or not hear you if you talk over her or answer, \\"lets play\\" to her asking for a cookie..... It is a computer, not a real baby. We have not had any issues and I find it very well made. This doll is for a little girl that is well spoken and can under stand how to use her, i.e. waiting for her to completely finish her phrase before talking etc... Not good for under kids under 5. The doll also sings 3 or 4 songs, plays different games like funny faces, tea party, animal sounds and she knows when to eat and when it is bed time etc. People are not using her right or expecting her to be perfect when it is a computer. I say if your child is the type to speak clear and understands how to follow patterns and directions this is a well made doll that does all and more of what the commercial claims she will do.

review_body: My 4 year old daughter really likes this toy.  She loves the Animal planet channel and is fascinated with whales. The whale is really lifelike and when you pull his top fin back it makes his mouth open and close. When you pull the winch hook down it automatically lifts itself back up. However when you attach the net with the whale in it you have to manually pull it up because the whale is just too heavy for it to do it alone.  The two gripes I do have is the helicopter is too light weight...it tips over when you are lifting the whale if you don't hold onto it. Also it is a little difficult to get the men seated in the cockpit so you can close it.

product_title: Handy Tools in Carry Case (7 Pieces), Includes a 20 Peice BONUS!! of Screws Etc.
review_body: My 4 year old daughter loves to play with this toy.  She loves to have tools just like her Daddy and it keeps her hands off Daddy's \\"real\\" tools.  She goes around the house pretending to fix everything just like her Daddy.  Great inexpensive toy!

product_title: Polly Pocket! Adorable Storable Cruisin Closet Carrycase - Purple
review_body: We bought this item for our daughter for Christmas.  It was a big mistake that we will never make again.  The plastic drawers tip back and the items fall out.  You have to remove the drawer to get to the items that fell behind it.  This is a big hassle for the parents since a four year can't do it on their own.  We thought it would be great for keeping our daughter's polly pockets organized while we travel and in the house . . . Boy were we wrong!  Don't buy this product.  It's a waste of money.  It's better to go out and purchase a multiple drawer storage unit for CD's than this cheap rolling storage unit.

product_title: Graco Travel System: Stroller, Travel Seat and Car Seat in Princeton Print
review_body: You know, I would've given it 5 stars for fun but it isn't any fun when my daughter can't walk across the living room before the wheels fall off. I thought I did something wrong in putting this together until I read the other reviews. Now I have to take it back - huge hassel and try to find something else.

product_title: Leapster Recharging System (For ORIGINAL Triangular Version Only)
review_body: Leapsters are fun, and fun requires batteries.  And leapsters eat batteries.  We bought the rechargers and running out of power is no longer an issue.  And when my twins are happy, I'm happy. :)

product_title: Fisher Price Learning Home (Discontinued by manufacturer)
review_body: We got this toy for our 7-month-old daughter for Christmas, but couldn't wait to give it to her!  So far she has really enjoyed it.  She likes to spin the flower petals around and also the spinning toy in the grass.  Her favorite thing is to chew on the mail from the mailbox!  She seems to respond well to the music, although there are a couple of songs I find annoying.  Most of the songs are good and recognizable, but a couple of them I have never heard before.  The learning mode is great.  She is still too young to fully realize what everything does, but with repetition I think this will help her learn everyday concepts we don't normally think about.  The window says up & down, the mailbox says open & close, the light switch says on & off.  I have really enjoyed playing with her with this so far.  It is a larger toy, but the base is not to wide so it fits nicely against the wall. It was a little more than I would like to pay for a toy, but I think there will be several months worth of play out of this toy.  It definitely deserves 5 stars.

product_title: LeapFrog LeapPad Educational Book: Leap and the Lost Dinosaur with Interactive Cards
review_body: I bought this for my 5 year old son. This is by far the best leap pad book he has received. He has played with it almost daily for over a month now. The cards make it extra fun for him and they are easy to keep track of if you keep the book/disc and cards in the package.

product_title: My Very Own House Coloring Playhouse, Cottage
review_body: Love it, easy to assemble. This is a great toy - it keeps my two daughters busy for hours!  They color on it & love it, they play house with their dolls in it & have picnics with it.  I have just purchased my third one, my friends kids come over to play & rave about it.  Now it's one of my standard gifts to give!

product_title: Little Mommy Swing for Baby Dolls
review_headline: DO NOT BUY!!! Piece of junk! WASTE OF MONEY!
review_body: I bought this for my daughter along with the other Little Mommy furniture accessories last Christmas (Doll Carrier, Care Center, Shopping Cart, and Swing) and it was a piece of junk. It constantly fell apart that my kids (ages 4 and 2 at the time) lost interest and didnt even want to play with it anymore. Too hard to take dolls in and out of (even the Little Mommy dolls made to go with it) and its not made very well either, the plastic is flimsy, the top of the swing kept popping off the legs and it would collapse, we just ended up trashing it. It was a COMPLETE waste of money. The Little Mommy dolls and outfits are great but the furniture is worthless, you'll literally be throwing your money away in a matter of weeks.

product_title: LeapFrog Learning Table
review_headline: One of the best toys out there!
review_body:
We registered for this item and are so glad we did. It amuses my 9 month old, who loves to stand at it, slap it and watch the lights. Our 2 year old neighbor also loves to come over and sing along with the songs it plays. It plays some neat little jingles - including some that are so catchy to adults that it is ridiculous! I find myself singing along all the time! It is very interactive and teaches a lot - songs, concepts, colors, numbers and the alphabet. Completely worth it.

I also love the fact that the legs can come off very easily. When we travel, it is very easy to take it apart and throw it in the trunk of the car. No other toys this size can stand up to its versatility. I truly believe this is one item every child should have!

product_title: VTech - V.Smile TV Learning System
review_headline: Vtech V=Smile game system is a wonderful toy!
review_body:
This is a wonderful toy. My husband and I bought this toy as one of our 4 year old daughter's presents for Easter earlier this year. I must say that she really likes this game system and it is just right for her age. The controllers are made just right for a child within the age group for this game. If you take a look at the bottom of the controller the controller pad can even flip to the other side if your child is left handed, which mine is right handed but I thought that it was a cool feature.

The games are very appropriate and easy to play. I think that the graphics are fine too. I think that this game system for children in this age group is better than another kind of game system because it is educational, easier for them to take control of the controller, and easier to play and understand the game. The games also have 3 different levels to play too plus mini games that they can play.

With that said it would be nice if the price was lower and if the adapter was included. But when a new product like this comes out usually this is how it goes. Maybe it will lower a little after a while. It already comes with a game and we also purchased the Winnie the Pooh game, The Hunny Hunt, too. We will be getting her more games around her birthday time and Christmas time. It is also a good idea to check different stores that carry this line because I have realized that some stores carry more of a selection than others.

I dont have much trouble out of this game system but do realize that with cartridge games sometimes they can act funny. A lot of the time if you blow into them to get the dust out it usually will start acting fine. Also you can check how the game is hooked up and the tv setting to check if the hook ups did not get out of place.

This was a wonderful purchase and our daughter loves to play with her Vtech V-Smile game system.

product_title: #2139 Estes Beta Series Fat Boy Model Rocket Kit,needs Assembly
review_body: One reason that I like this rocket so much is that for some reason it reminds me of myself.  Another reason is for its durability.  (I have a friend who has 50+ flights on his.)  Still another reason is the ease with which it can be transformed into an upscale of the legendary Goonybird series.  I've turned Fat Boys into an upscale Star Snoop and Cloud Hopper, and I have the parts cut out for an Zoom Broom.  By itself, the Fat Boy is incredibly stable and an impressive performer, so whatever reason you buy one, you come out a winner.

product_title: Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Sneak Preview R4-G9 Action Figure
review_body: This toy is increadably kewl but is deffinately not and R4 unit, it's an R2, althougfh it has an inaccurate name it is still and awsome looking and durrable little toy! a recomended buy!

product_title: Transformers Cybertron Voyager Crumple Zone
review_body:
Crumplezone is a fantastic transformer.his poseability is great,his detail is utterly fantastic,and hiss key feature activates two huge,shoulder mounted cannons.he has a big hulky look to him,huge arms,short little legs,but thats a good thing.his big lower jaw even moves.

if you own him and Ransack,it's a great duo,the 2 of them remind me of George and Lennie from Of Mice & Men,the novel by Steinbeck

but ANYWAYS........ BUY HIM,YOU WILL DEFINATLEY love it

product_title: Sesame Street Tub Puzzle
review_headline: THE Best Tub Toy out there!
review_body: My daughter Riley received this toy for Christmas(I'm just a little late)  I had to write this review because it truly is a great toy for the tub!  It is great for imaginative play and was well thought out!  No holes in figures so they can't get water inside and mildew like most tub toys. I highly recommend this for everyone's child!

product_title: Pack 'n Play - Windsor Wave
review_body: I don't understand why windsor is more expensive than any other similar products?

product_title: LEGO Creator: The Race to Build It Board Game
review_body: I bought this when my son was 6 years old and we played for a long time. I say \\"we\\" because I enjoyed playing as much as he did! Lots of fun for the whole family!

product_title: Disney Princess 6" Scooter
review_body: Comes unable to assemble, ready to return.  Has engineering problem with plastic rings needed to assemble handlebars.  Rings are pre-disintegrated from the factory.  We accidentally bought 2, and couldn't salvage enough parts from both to assemble 1 good scooter.

product_title: Rock-A-Bye CHOU CHOU Doll
review_body: My daughter had this doll about 1year ago and we have not been able to find it for a while. She has been asking for another doll ever since. I have been hesitating, hoping we will still find it, but so far no luck. It has been awful to see her go with out it. So, Christmas is coming and she is getting a new one. And even if we find the old one, it will still be worth it. This doll is so great that I am willing to spend the money to buy another, And this doll is not so cheap. Definately worth the money.

product_title: MV Play and Store Space Mission Big Box
review_body:
Our 8-year-old son wanted space stuff for Christmas and this was about the only set we could find. I couldn't tell by the picture how big the figures, vehicles, etc. were and the other reviews were not really very helpful since they were mainly complaining that the set was not meant for small children.

The set is actually very small. It is the equivalent to something you could find in a dollar store, but with more stuff and a nice storage box. If I had to guess how much the set cost I would say no more than $8...I paid $15.

On the plus side I was able to fulfill my son's wish to get astronauts and space vehicles for Christmas, although it was not exactly what we had in mind.

product_title: Olympia Crib - Dark Pine
review_headline: Great crib, and the mobile fits!
review_body: I assembled this 90% of the way in 30 minutes while 9 months pregnant. The spring board was a little challenging to fit, but we figured it out and it went together perfectly.    It seems very sturdy, and I don't see the non moveable side to be a problem, since you can raise the mattress height. We have it at the highest for now.    As for the mobile, while the setup for the original one didn't work, we did have a second one that was a perfect fit...    **************UPDATE***************    My son is five months old now and we still LOVE the crib...    He has teething rings to chew on, so we haven't had a problem with him biting the rails as some other customer mentioned.    We were able to fit a bedside cd player on the side rail, as well as the aforementioned mobile.    Also, the woods on my changing table, armoir, and toy box seem to all match perfectly with the crib. If there is a difference, I don't see it.

product_title: Little Tikes Handle Haulers Frankie Fire Chief
review_body: My parents bought this truck for my son when he was about 1 year old and it was an instant hit. It doesn't make noises or do anything special. It just has a hole in the back of the truck and a handle on the top of it. My son just holds the handle at the top and drives it all over the place. He loves to put his toy cars and people in the back and drive them around, too. My son never got hurt with this toy (never hit him in the head or anything like one reviewer said) and he's been playing with it since before he could walk. He'll be 2 soon and he still plays with this truck. Simple, but a good basic toy, especially if your boy loves cars and trucks as much as mine does. :)

product_title: Lucky Ducks
review_headline: How to TURN OFF the Quacking
review_body:
Yes, the quacking can be turned off!! We needed to take out the batteries to travel -- as it was turning itself on during the ride home from Grandma's house. My wife discovered that putting only two of the batteries in turns the \\"pond\\" but NO QUACKING!

PS - It is still loud.

product_title: LeapFrog LeapStart Learning Gym
review_body: We purchased this for our son when he 2-3 months old.  He did not enjoy it very much at all until he was able to sit up.  The only thing he liked and could reach at that time was the mobile on the bottom, and his crib mobile was much more entertaining.  Once he could sit up, he liked to play with it a little bit, but was never entertained for long.  Now that he can stand, he likes to pull up on it, but has even less interest in any of the buttons.  I was intrigued by the international/multi-language aspect of this toy, but I think it was too much for an infant.

product_title: GeoTrax Rail & Road System - High Chimes Clock Tower
review_headline: Our favorite addition to Elevation Series!
review_body:
My son received this for his 3rd birthday. This clock tower is a must for your elevation series of Geotrax. It makes it easy and fun to incorporate all levels into your existing track. You will need a couple of the elevation sets in order to do this though. We have sort of made the clock tower the centerpiece of the track. We have 1 of each of the 3 elevation packs and that's enough to connect all the elevation accessories we have (clock tower, suspension bridge, mile high mountain).

The sound level is perfect for this toy, as the lighthouse seems too loud for little ears. The clock will play 4 different songs as trains pass through the tower and a light sensor sets off the song. You can also hit the little chimney at the top to set of a chime. The toy will shut off on its own after a few minutes with no play (it may be 15 minutes, not sure). It will chime to let you know it is turning off. Great feature, as batteries aren't cheap!

Definitely add to your Geotrax, its worth it! Your child will love it and so will you!

product_title: Barbie as the Princess & the Pauper: Erika Dress Up Costume
review_headline: Great, just like doll, but the flared front is a good tripper for kids
review_body:
I love this dress, it is so gorgeous and my daughter loves looking just like Erika in Barbie's Princess and the Pauper. She is a tall three year old and fits it perfectly with room to grow, the length is great too, just below the knee, the main problem is that while the flares at the front of the dress are perfect for a Barbie doll, for an active little girl they are in unfortunate places, right where a little foot ends up. These are for playing dress ups for smaller kids

the Princess Anneliese is much better for an active running around girl. Both dresses are just beautiful, and my daughter just loves playing in them and playing with her dolls.
They seem to be very well made and for the lovely frivolous-ness of them, they seem to be quite hardwearing. A few problems with cleaning them, of course. But worth it, my daughter adores them!

product_title: Fisher-Price Pop-Onz Pop 'N Twirl Table Building System
review_body:
We bought this table and a number of Pop Onz accessories for our son, who is almost two, for Christmas. I thought the tactile \\"popping\\" would be great for building and stacking pieces, since he tends to prefer crashing block towers to building them.

He just isn't interested in this toy. When you press a button, two circles rotate and play music. The music isn't annoyingly loud, and he's happy to press the button, but then he presses the circles--stopping their rotation and causing a very unpleasant grinding sound. A neighborhood friend his age did the exact same thing when she saw this toy. I have to say, though, it still works, even though he presses on the circles while they're moving quite often.

Several adults have played with this table \\"with\\" him, but he's not so impressed. Since the top of the table is bumpy, it won't function as a regular table, either.

We have had the same problem with the one leg coming off as other reviewers, which makes the netted storage bin underneath pretty useless.

I really wanted this toy to be something he'd like, but it hasn't been a favorite with us.

product_title: Roaring Dinosaur Wearable Sound-FX Fantasy Toy
review_body: I sent this present to my nephew.  I never saw him in it, but i heard that he really enjoyed it.  I heard him over the phone running crazy in the costume having a good time.  My niece apparently liked the outfit a lot too.  She usually dresses up like a princess or a fairy. Now my nephew has a costume to enjoy too.

product_title: Star Station Deluxe Giftset with Additional Kids Bop Rom
review_headline: Not worth the price or time
review_body: The picture is hazy at best.  The difficulty of setting up the station was not worth the time and effort.  I would not advise anyone to purchase this item.

product_title: Barney Move 'N Groove Dance Mat
review_body: I guess this toy would be ok-if you just want the dancemat. We got this toy as a gift and have used it twice.  The problem-Barney does not stay up and constantly tips over.  We've tried to fix him but still doesn't work-now we're going to toss it.

product_title: ChatNow Communicators 2 Pack Flip Style - Blue
review_body: What a great idea for the pre-teen set.  My daughter got this for her birthday and has not stopped using it since.  No calling plans, and no worries about her talking to the \\"Wrong\\" people!  Great idea.  I plan to buy more for all the preteens on my holiday list.

product_title: NFL, ABC Sports Monday Night Football Lighted Stadium Accessory
review_headline: Please, DO NOT pay more than $10-15 for this!
review_body:
It's mostly cardboard, requires a ton of batteries, and basically makes the (NOT INCLUDED) electric football game harder to play.

(...) In fact, I happened to get one bundled with the Monday Night Football elec game board for (...)

product_title: Disney Princess Ballet Studio
review_headline: Great fun for my 3 year old daughter
review_body:
This toy deserves the 5 stars for fun only if you have at least two other ballerinas to accompany the one that comes with the studio (the \\"Limited Edition\\" Cinderella)! After an exhaustive internet search, and after seeing that ebay sellers are gouging the prices (especially for the rare Jasmine, which is available by mail at a reasonable price if you have purchased the Aladdin DVD), someone here posted a note about going directly to Fisher-Price.com and ordering the remaining four ballerinas from there (go to the shop from a previous catalog icon). She puts on her ballerina costume and dances along with her princesses - it's so cute! The memories the toy have created are priceless. Thank you so much for all the advice posted here - it's great fun for the child, and entertaining beyond compare for the grown-ups.

product_title: Travel Lite Crib - Windsor
review_body: This is a really nice crib, I purchased it for my daughter who is 6 weeks since my husband travels alot for work and we are going to travel with him.  Set up was easy it took all of ten minutes!  The mattress is padded and appears to be very comfortable.  It is a great color for girls or boys.  It doesnt take up much room in our bedroom next to our bed.  Light weight easy to carry, just wonderful!  Graco outdid themselves with this product, I just love it and so does my daughter!

product_title: Sassy Tub Toy Organizer 124
review_headline: Theyre cute but are a waste of money
review_body: These are cute bath addition but thats about it, they do not hold really any toys and they do not stay stuck to the wall. They are always falling down off of the tiles so i have to say they are a waste of money. 3 stars for being cute!

product_title: Quattro Tour Travel System - Mocha
review_body: I have only good and positive things to say about this stroller!!  If you want a stroller that is going to last, that is going to roll great on any surface and easy to fold up and put back in your car...look no further!  This is my second evenflo stroller, only because my first stroller...after almost 5 years of consistant use that stroller was still in mint condition and was sold.  When I found out I was pregnant again I was really sad not to have my evenflo stroller, and I knew that would be the brand we'd purchase again.  My first evenflo stroller held my son's weight right up until he was 4 years old...at 60 pounds, not to mention when we took it on vacations and filled the basket with our stuff and the basket was filled with at least 30 pounds, so between my son's weight and the items in the basket the stroller held 90 pounds with simple ease.  The stroller still pushed great and I loved the one handed feature to push the stroller to give an extra hand for something else.  After all the years of use that stroller worked great.  So when I saw this stroller I knew it was the one we wanted.  This stroller even has more features to love than my last stroller.  I can not tell you how great the feature of the tray opening up to easily get your child out, that is the greatest feature ever!  No more will your child's feet get stuck trying to pick them up to get them out quickly for a bathroom trip or to get them out and put them in the car.  The two cup holders have grips in them so there is no way of spilling your drink and the compartment between the drink holders opens and closes, so if you wear sunglasses in a store of something you can put them in the compartment and not worry about them falling out.  This stroller was well thought out with all the features. The basket is extra large so if your planning a trip to the mall you don't have to worry about packing any bags around, they will fit in the bottom of the stroller.  Planning a vacation has never been easier with a stroller that pushes so easily and is easy to push even in grass!  I love the car seat as well.  Most car seat handles are straight across and believe me they are harder to carry an infant in this handle has a easy hold middle grip turned side ways to easily hold on too.  This is the best design for a car seat, I have tried the others and wonder how people can pack their infants around without breaking their arm.  The car seat is one of the nicest I have seen and the base that comes with the seat is simple to install in a car.  To get the infant seat in you simply snap the infant seat in place and then its even easier to get out the seat by just lifting on the lever in the back.  Once the car seat is snapped in the base though it is in tightly and snug for a safe car ride for your little one.  There was only one thing to put together on the infant seat and that was the shade, which only took 30 seconds to install.  The stroller only had a few things to put on and within the time we took the stroller and car seat out of the box it was put together in less than 5 mins.  The stroller is so simple to push around even my 5 year old son was pushing it around the house with one hand.  I could not be happier with this stroller.  Some people worry about the bulk of the stroller but if the stroller is too light it will not push good outdoors at all, we take a lot of vacations and go on nature walks this stroller can take all that terrian.  If you purchase this stroller it will be the only one you will ever need.  I highly reccommend this stroller and give it 5 stars!

product_title: Radica - Girl Tech Electronic Password Journal (2002)
review_body: I think think this toy is so fun beacause you get to make up your own password and accaully keep your own secrets to yourself in Password Journal 3! What I do not like about it is that you have to remember your password and sometimes it does not let you into it. What else I love about it is it does not let any of your friends in! I tryed it with my buddy's Journal and it ONLY did it with her! If I were you I would get this toy!

product_title: My Scene Goes Hollywood
review_body: This outfit, as seen on Nolee in the Hollywood movie, is very cool. It includes blue pants with a star studded pink belt, and a classical-looking button-down white shirt with pockets. There are also some purple flip flops, a starry purse, a necklace, and sunglasses. It is a classy and sporty oufit - totally Nolee's style.

product_title: Bratz World London - Pretty 'N' Punk Cloe
review_body:
To all you angry people who have written in, stating you are \\"real\\" punks...let me break it to you gently.

No. You're not punks. Shopping at Hot Topic doesn't make you a punk. Dressing in plaid and chains doesn't make you a punk. Having dyed or spiked hair does not make you a punk. If you didn't live throughout the 80's, you have no right to call yourself a punk. Being that I'm *over* 30 years old, I experienced the punk generation firsthand-- a genre of music and a way of life.

Your \\"Good Charlotte\\" and \\"Simple Plan\\" are NOT punk. Neither is your dear AFI. It's pop all the way, baby. Nowadays, \\"punk\\" is just a label. People slap this label on their foreheads when they want to walk around in spikes and plaid and look cool. Sorry, babe, get over yourself. The real form of punk is a dead art. To attempt to relive it, turn off that crap you call Good Charlotte, Simple Plan and whatnot, and put on some of the late 70's/80's punk rock like The Clash, The Misfits, The Circle Jerks, The Ramones, Blondie, Richard Hell, etc.

Anyway, to the doll review-- I can't tell whether or not it's promoting the dead art form known as \\"punk\\", or just displaying the shallow, mainstream act people LIKE to call \\"punk\\". Either way, she's very cute-- whether it's what she's wearing or not. I think it's just the way she looks in general. There's an innocence to it all despite what people say about the \\"collagen-injection lips\\" and \\"huge eyes\\". It's just the art style-- I doubt the companies intended to make kids want to get plastic surgery (I'm sure there are kids that want to, but that's usually due to a deeper problem, and not just because of these dolls, haha). Obviously, these dolls were intended to have a cartoony look with their big lips and eyes; an almost anime-styled look. Granted, I don't think they're as pretty as the recent Winx Club dolls, but they're close.

product_title: Simon Says Sit'n Spin Interactive Game
review_body: The age on this toy starts at 15 months I believe.  My son is almost 2 and a half and has just now learned to spin it.  It is very difficult and i think that it had to be broken in.  My son does love the music but it took forever to get it broken in.  Definetely for older stronger kids.

product_title: Marathon Convertible Car Seat - Portland
review_headline: Durable, comfortable for child; a bit inconvenient
review_body:
Have owned a Britax Marathon for 2 years now, and it has been all over the U.S, in cars, on planes, and even on trains. This thing has been through the wringer. I can definitely say it can put up with a lot of wear and tear. Our family is bicoastal and we travel every month across the U.S., we visit friends and family in several states quite often (at least once a month), and feel like our car is our third home.

The downsides to this very highly rated seat are its weight and size, and difficulty in installation. I've lugged this car seat on the plane dozens of times (before I finally caved and bought a car seat for the West Coast). It does take a while to get the seat strapped into car seats if they are not LATCH seats, and if they are leather seats, I generally sit in the seat to make sure it is very secure on the leather. (I know you can put a rubber pad down, but I'm not so anal to carry that around). Another downside is that cars with the LATCH system have just been shown (5/05 Consumer Reports) to have inferior test results than those cars that use safety belts only. You can verify this for yourself at [...] I don't know if you need to be a subscriber to read the report.

Regarding ease of cleaning, in this area it is not well designed. I've had to clean my share of vomit, and it is not a pretty time taking off the cover and the straps and the foam, and the cover I have is not machine washable. I would highly recommend getting one that is, if there is one....

In terms of comfort, my daughter loves this seat and doesn't have any problem falling asleep in it when we are driving. I appreciate that this seat is well-designed for a child to sleep in, as it can angle back so a child's head doesn't flop down and around (making it difficult to get air). If your child doesn't sleep in her/her seat, this seat is worth looking at for that reason alone (an hour of peace is worth the hassle of installing the car seat).

Good luck on your search for the best seat for your angel.r />
Good luck on your search for the best seat for your angel.

product_title: Star Wars OTC Original Trilogy Collection Exclusive Y-WING FIGHTER with PILOT Action Figure
review_body:
This is the same Y-wing fighter for the Hasbro 3 3/4\\" Star Wars figures that was released several years ago as a Target exclusive, save that it is painted with a red trim, blue canopy frame, and silver body. It is essentially a copy of the origional Kenner Y-wing from the early 1980s, but without the electronics and removable R2 Robot unit. The landing gear retract using a switch, a bomb can be attached and dropped by pushing a button, the canopy opens sideways (like in the movies), the cockpit is detailed and seats one figure, the ion cannons elevate and rotate, the R2 Robot's head turns.

I was surprised when I found this at a Toys R Us, and quite pleased as I had previously been unable to purchase the rare POTF Y-wing released at Target. My hats off to Hasbro for providing a second chance. The vehicle, while undersized in scale, nonetheless appears accurate to the movie version. It is NOT loaded with funky, innacurate features as some Hasbro Star Wars vehicles are. A removable R2 unit (like on the large X-wing just released) would have been preferable, however. The paint job is nice and includes some wear and tear. All in all, the Y-wing is a good addition to a Star Wars vehicle collection.

product_title: Dora Explorer Gift Set: Dora's Talking Doll House Figures - Dora, Backpack, Puppy, Diego w/Jaguar, Abuela, Tico, Boots
review_headline: Cute figures, and good size for little hands.
review_body: My only complaint is that the poor Abuela is so huge and doesn't bend at all, so she can't do anything but stand around cooking in the kitchen - poor woman can't even sit to eat with the family!!! That is just nuts!!!!  I would like to see a car for Tico to drive the Dora gang around in!!!  We love our \\"papi house\\" as my 2 year old calls it!!!

product_title: FurReal Friends Go Go My Walkin' Pup
review_body:
This toy is good only for a stuffed animal and even then it isn't very good; white fur, too heavy etc. It does NOT listen to it's commands. We gave this to my daughter for her 6th birthday.

She had a hard time with the instructions \\"pat the side twice to follow you, pat the head to stay, rub the back and...\\" Sorry but it never (and I do mean never) did what we asked it too. Instead it would just go around and around to the right. Bad toy!

product_title: Olympia Crib - Dark Pine
review_body: The crib is pretty, but I have to be very careful not to touch it with anything because it will scratch it.  I noticed my cat walking around the edge of the crib and her nails were scratching the wood.  My son is only 6 months old and I don't see him being able to use the frame as a bed.  By the time I am able to change it to a bed, I am sure it will look even worse. I hate to see what it going to look like when he can pull up and chew on the rail.

product_title: Triumph DLX Convertible Car Seat in Marimba Print
review_body:
If I could give this seat six stars, I would. I love everything about this seat and don't have a single complaint. If you don't have the money to purchase a Britax or Decathon, this seat IS the one to buy as it ranks right near its competitors. Easy to install and use, extremely comfortable, SAFE, and affordable.

SIX stars.

product_title: Playmobil Pirate Treasure Chest
review_body: I just opened this for my son to play with for the first time. This could be the perfect toy for a little boy as too often boys toys are things that take hours to put together and then fall apart within 2 minutes. I was delighted to see that this is a durable set that you don't have to put together. Yes there are tons of tiny detailed pieces, (swords, guns, crabs...)but isn't that what they love?! My son has been playing with it now for over 45 minutes and he is totally engrossed! I love that the toys can all be stored within itself and folded up in a snap. I agree with the other reviewer about it being hard to open the doors, however for me this is a plus as too many toys are made flimsy and would pop open spilling the contents. I think over time, the mechanism will be get easier to open. This is an awesome toy and great for the money!

product_title: VTech - V.Smile TV Learning System
review_body: My twins, age four, recieved the V.SMILE for Christmas last year.  We had to by the power cord (batteries do not last long) which I felt should have been included.  The games are fun and educational.  My kids loved it!  However,after about 3 months, the power would not stay on.  We tried adjusting the power cord, bought a new power cord, tried it with new batteries.  Nothing worked.  My kids were very upset to have this wonderful toy and not be able to play with it.

product_title: HO Die-cast 1967 Ford Galaxie Police Car MWI30159
review_body: I Paid Almost $15.00 for this police car.The description says mini and boy they were not kidding.My poor son was almost in tears when he opened the large box that contained a little car that I could of purchased at a dollar store!!!!

product_title: Fisher-Price Laugh & Learn Love to Play Puppy
review_body: First I'll say that I am a collector of \\"toys that make noise\\" so when I saw this for my daughter I just had to get it.  It is so cute.  My daughter hasn't really figured out yet how to make it play or talk, but I do it for her and then sing the songs along with it.  She laughs, don't know if she is laughing at the toy or laughing at me making a fool of myself, but in any case she enjoys the toy.  It's very durable.

product_title: All in One Reclining Booster
review_headline: Liked it at first but learned to hate it...
review_body: I got this chair as a shower present and loved it but when my daughter started eating table food I quickly changed my mind.  The chair is wonderful for younger babies who just need a place to sit while being fed baby food or even cheerios but once we atarted on table food it was impossible to keep it clean.  Food goes down the holes for the straps and is nearly impossible to get out (I even tried using my shop vac).  Once my daughter figured out the food could fit down there she thought it was funny to put it in there.  I ended up buying a new Fisher Price Healthy Choice Booster and like it much better.  I would not recommend anyone spenmd there money on this product because it is unsanitary.

product_title: Glider Travel System With Diaper Bag & Extra Base - Wellstone
review_body: This system deserves more than 5 stars.  I have had this same stroller for four years now (only in a different pattern) and it is still going strong.  I use it all the time, every day.  I take my daughter on hour long walks.  This is a tough stroller.  It's been though two children and still looks brand new too.  I highly reccomend it.  Accolades to Graco for manufacturing such a quality product.

product_title: Ty Beanies Babies - Pinky
review_body: Though interesting, Flamingoes aren't exactly a favorite of mine, speaking of animals and birds.  His legs are loose and floppy.  He isn't the most fun to play with, so of course, he is in good condition.  I can only see collecters wanting him badly.

product_title: Risk: The Game of Global Domination (2003)
review_body: This game facilitates a wonderful blend of chance and strategy.  I enjoy playing this with our family.  There is never a dull moment, even when it's another player's turn, because they could choose to attack any other players' armies.  Our 7-yr-old and 9-yr-old kids love this game, so even though the box recommends ages 10 and up, don't underestimate the desire (nor the ability) for your little one to rule the world!  I compare the strategy needed to succeed in this game to the thought process required to play Chess, maybe not quite that technical and varied, but so many possibilities exist during each turn. It's not too hard for younger children when guided by older siblings or parents.  Actually, my kids helped me remember all the rules when we first learned how to play.

product_title: CD Boombox with AM/FM Tuner
review_body: Don't be fooled when it says plays CD-R/CD-RW. This player only plays original cds... I was in for a surprise when all my newly burnt cds.. either skipped, or plays with distorted sounds.. When I played my original cds.. it was perfectly fine.. Then I realized that it was the cd-r cause the player itself doesn't indicated that it plays cd-r/cd-rw. Look at the top of the player!!! Cause usually any other player would indicate that it plays burnt cds..Sounds is ok but if you need a solid bass sound and a loud volume then this is not for you....

product_title: Mini Big Bubbler Sword - Blue Sword w/Yellow & Purple Handle - 4+
review_headline: If you like bubbles you will love this....
review_body:
This thing is awesome. My daughter is 2 1/2 yrs and she can work it just great. She just dips it into the solution and twirls around making tons of bubbles. We purchased this and the Big Bubbler and just love both, but this one is easier for little kids than the Big Bubbler.

The only problem is that you have to be careful opening it, because if you unscrew it from the very top instead of the yellow middle piece I have found that it ends up breaking the sword off. I bought another one to replace it and am more careful with it now.

I don't know what the other reviewer was talking about having trouble making the bubbles. It is definatly an outside toy. We don't let the solution drip off though, we just dip and move it back and forth or twirl in circles. Sometimes if you get the wind to catch it just right, it works while you stand still. :)

product_title: Step2 Push Around Buggy Toddler Pushing Car - Durable and Safe Outdoor Wagon Cart for Kids - Red
review_headline: THE BEST FIRST CAR OUT THERE!
review_body: My twins LOVED cruising the streets in these cars!!!! They still fit great at 1! I believe they will out grow within 6 months due to the fact that there are no doors and soon their feet will be able to touch the ground! But for the 1st year - awesome!!! They were not able to fully sit up yet but they were able to ride in these cars!

product_title: LeapFrog Learning Table
review_body: My 1yr old daughter received this as a birthday gift in August and she continues to play it everyday!!  I would highly recommend this to all families!!

product_title: Little People Doodle Pro
review_headline: Sad to see - not easy  for a toddler to use
review_body: I had previously purchased the standard blue Doodle Pro for my 3 year old, and he loved it - a great toy.  So when my 1 1/2 year old twins started showing an interest in drawing, I purchased one of these Little People boards for each of them.  Much to my disappointment, the tip on the end of the pen was so short that its impossible to draw unless the pen is straight up and down.  The soccer ball slide eraser is so tight that they can hardly move it.  The only good thing is the magnets are nice and big and easy to use.  I have to say that all in all, this is taking the product downhill - stick with the standard Doodle Pro, you'll be much happier.

product_title: Techno Source Illuminated Touch Screen Sudoku Puzzle Game
review_headline: Take your play style to the next level
review_body:
I was pleasantly surprised to see this one when a friend gifted me this. It is very attractive and looks cool. All my excitement to explore this toy kinda bit dampened the moment I got the this powered up. It's the display, lack of backlight to be specific. In other words, this won't work in dark. Without the backlight, reflection on the glass is very distracting. In addition, in playing mode, the digital background of the cell indicating the number for unfilled cell also can be distracting. That's why this item gets 3 stars. If one can ignore this inconvenience and get used to this gadget, it's very simple to play.

I like the intuitive interface. Stylus based operation is simple. Users can choose different levels for varied levels of difficulty. I found even the basic or level 1 to be not that easy .

I look forward to version with a backlight.

product_title: Learning Curve Thomas and Friends Wooden Railway - Murdoch
review_body:
If your child enjoys acting out the Thomas & Friends episodes, Murdoch is an engine designed to pull heavy freight. He's the largest engine on Sodor, and has a butterscotch sort of color, like Annie and Clarabelle do. Shy as he is strong, Murdoch wishes for some peace and quiet, but his friends are always full of questions.

Murdoch and Arthur are unique engines. They are the only large engines in the wooden range with 2 wheels in front and 6 wheels in back. All the other large engines have 4 wheels in front and 4 wheels in back.

If you could use a heavy freight engine every time there's more milk, logs, cattle, or other various cargo to deliver, Murdoch is highly recommended!

product_title: My Little Pony G3: Celebration Castle Playset with Music, Lights and Baby Pony Pink Sunsparkle
review_headline: It's cute, but it's also a real piece of cr@p.
review_body: My daughter has been asking for the Pony castle for 2 1/2 years.  Even after reading all of the reviews, I went ahead and bought it because 1. daughter would continue asking for it until kingdom-come, and 2. I was hoping that it wasn't all that bad.  Well, it was the biggest waste of money ever; if it weren't for the fact that daughter loves it, I would pack it up and return it.  The smaller playsets (salon, dress shop, cafe) are a much better bang for your buck; go for those.  The castle is a complete and utter disappointment.  All of the reviews above that go into detail are absolutely correct; this castle is junk.

product_title: Music & Lights Sit 'n Spin Rockin' Tunes (colors vary)
review_body: This toy is lots of fun with the lights and music.  However it is very difficult for my two year old son to use.  It takes a LOT of coordination that he just doesn't have.  Hopefully when he gets older he will still find it fun and be able to use it then.

product_title: Aquasaurs
review_headline: 8yr old thinks it is great - written with Mom's help
review_body: I really like watching the aquasaurs swim around in the tank.  I think that some people should read the directions better.  My mom read to me the other reviews so I wouldn't be upset if they died or didn't hatch, but I have lots of aquasaurs.  I keep a light on from a lamp and it keeps the water warm.  Maybe that is what helps. I love this toy!

product_title: InteracTV DVD System Compilation In-Pack
review_body: I bought this for my daughter who loves all of the characters that are featured on the trial DVD.  She just loves it.  She sits for an hour playing all of the games.  She is 3yrs old and can put the DVD in and start the game on her own.  The sensor is able to reach the DVD player from various locations in our living room.  Interac TV is very fun and educational!!  I am very glad that I purchased it.  We will be buying them for other children that we know for Christmas.

product_title: Step2 Naturally Playful Summertime Play Center
review_body: When we were in the market for a sandbox, I saw this one and fell in love!  I thought it was pretty expensive though.  However, when I started pricing sandboxes and a table/chairs/umbrella set separately - this Naturally Playful Set was actually a reasonable price.  It only took about 15 minutes to put together, and it is plenty big.  We couldn't be happier!

product_title: Marvel 2: X-Men United Electronic X-Jet
review_headline: There's a reason this one is on clearance
review_body: My son loves Wolverine and when he saw this toy, he had to have it.  He was spending a gift certificate he got for his birthday, so I let him choose.  Boy, did I regret it!  The wings were difficult to get on and unbelievably, once I managed to get them on, they fell off almost immediately once he started playing with it.  I ended up gluing them on, but that didn't last either.  The jet sounds are also annoyingly loud.  He got very frustrated after a few days with this toy and I threw it out after a few months.   Believe me, he hasn't missed it!

product_title: Tomy Pirate Ship Bath Toy
review_body: This is a nice boat for in the bath tub. We have had this toy for over a year now, and my son of 3.5 years old still likes to play with it, he especially likes to squirt the cannon. This toy definitely invokes imaginary play and the several components have held up quite nicely, nothing is broken yet. I rated it four stars because the little boat tumbles off the big ship very easily. It would be nice if that specific feature could be redesigned.

product_title: PEEK-a-Blocks 2-in-1 Activity Wagon
review_body: my daughter got this toy when she was only 5 months old. Now she is 1 and she still plays with it. She loves to push it around, put the blocks in the different places, and now tries to walk with it. The sounds and lights are great. She will be playing with this for a long time. This is a must have!!

product_title: Kidoozie Little Doctor Kit – Includes Stethoscope, Blood Pressure Gauge, Reflex Hammer, Thermometer, Squeaking Syringe, Auriscope, Laryngoscope, Pretend Bandage, and Bag – Ages 24 Months And Up
review_body: Hard to fit all the pieces back on the case. Case fell apart shortly after purchase. Stethoscope does not fit well at all. To big for average childs head and very short. Blood pressure band also falls apart very easily.

product_title: Tomy Splashy the Penguin
review_body: Splashy the penguin, more like trashy the penguin.  My daughter doesn't really play with it.  I was really excited about this toy when I purchased it for my daughter for Christmas.  She seems somewhat uninterested in it.  She is 20 months old and plays with other things in the tub, like cups, and small figure toys, but she hasn't shown much interest in this toy.  I am somewhat let down.  The toy is made well though.

product_title: Tyco Radio Controlled Shell Shocker 27 MHz
review_body: We got this toy for our son for christmas, it was his big request on his list.  We played with this toy for less than 1 hour before the gears stripped, it will not morph anymore, and it is completely useless.  What a rip off!!  It was very disappointing for our son, there is no reason a toy that costs as much as this one does should have so many complaints about it, and I cannot believe that the people at TYCO don't know that this toy breaks so easily if they did testing on it.

product_title: Fisher Price Little People Sweet Sounds Home
review_body: I bought this toy because I think it's adorable.  My 13 month old daughter likes to lay on her tummy to look in and push all the buttons and hear the cute music and sounds.  My 3 year old niece has this toy and still loves to play with it as well.  Even my 4 year old nephew likes to get in on the fun sometimes.  I know we will have years of fun with this toy!!

product_title: Puppy Surprise Lavender Poodle
review_body: My daughter loved her puppy surprise She grooms her and the puppies She got four puppies 3 girls one boy? The boy well was different and offended some of my family members and I was told to throw him away but I thought that was ridiculous. he is cute Well, where the other puppies had a head body legs and snout and looked like little poodles, he is just an egg shape with a face and sewn on paws He is just different but she loves him just the same

product_title: Original Memory
review_headline: Fun game, even young children can play
review_body:
The cardboard pieces are hard enough that it takes a lot of teething on them to ruin them. THey do not bend easily. My only complaint about the pieces is they are a bit small. The small size makes it a bit difficult for small hands to manipulate them at times.

THere are many small pieces so if you loose one or two, you just take the match out of the pile and toss it away too. The game will be just as fun and no one will be the wiser.

In fact, when we play with our younger children, we often times just use half of the pieces.

THe game is the traditional memory game that almost everyone has played at one point in their life. It develops eye and hand coordination, following rules, taking turns, memory skills, picture skills and more.

Well worth the money.

Enjoy.

product_title: Graco Out Ridder Doll Stroller
review_headline: You get what you pay for!!!
review_body: My  2 1/2 year old daughter loves to use her doll stoller, but the seat fabric is constantly slipping off, which makes her extremely frustrated.  Also, the plastic piece that holds the canopy is place snapped off on both sides, rendering it useless.  I called the company to try and get a replacement, but they said they cannot offer one, nor can they replace the canopy part.  I wish I had paid an additional $15 for the next model up!!  Overall, I'm very dissatisfied with this product.

product_title: Crayola Fashion Light-Up Tracing Desl
review_headline: My husband & I loved this item, but kids :(
review_body: My husband and I liked this item and the quality of this item. My oldest loves to draw and was into tracing pictues under lamps and on windows so we searched for a tracing table. We weighed our options and we liked this one more than the roseart that does not require batteris etc. My daughter wanted the roaseart as seen on TV. I still think this one is better than the roseart you dont have to draw free hand. What do I know I am just her mother not an artist. MaryAnn

product_title: I/R T-Rex
review_headline: Wonderful toy for a little dinosaur lover!
review_body: My 3 yr. old son received this t-rex for his birthday.  It is a little hard for him to maneuver on his own, but he still has a lot of fun with it.  I do feel like it isn't made real well and like it may break at any second as it is very sensitive. It's a little hard to open the remote (he can't do it himself).  You really have to \\"slam\\" it open in order for it to catch and turn on.  Once it is on, the remote is very sensitive.  It has to be pointed directly at the dinosaur at just the right angle for him to move.  Regardless of those flaws though, my son still loves it and if your child loves dinosaurs as much as mine does, he'll love this realistic toy.

product_title: Power Wheels Lil’ Quad
review_headline: LOVE, LOVE, LOVE this Lil' Quad
review_body:
I purchased this Lil' Quad for my nephew for his first birthday. It took him a couple weeks to figure it out, but now we can't keep him off of it. He's 1 1/2 now and has absolutely NO problem making it go. He doesn't quite understand how to steer, but we're always with him when he rides so we help -- it's never been a problem. The battery holds up very well and is SUPER easy to charge. The power cord and battery pack all fit in the seat so nothing gets lost and the seat \\"locks\\" so little hands can't get it BUT can \\"unlock\\" quickly and easy with the twist of the lock button.

My niece will be 1 this weekend and is getting her own for her birthday. She has been riding my nephews for about two months now. They are usually really good at sharing, but this is one toy we needed to have two of. (Yes, I got her this one...bought some \\"girly\\" stickers to pretty it up because I didn't want to pay the extra $20+ for the Barbie quad.)

I recommend getting a helmet for wearing...it sets good habits of helmet wearing AND when going uphill or when learning kids balance isn't that great...there is nothing on the toy that will keep them on.

Also, this is definitely for a young child. My 2 year old niece tried it when we first got it and was too big. If your child is older I'd recommend looking into something bigger as you won't get a lot of use out of this one. Also, when it says it goes two miles an hour, it really does go that slow; an older child would probably not enjoy that speed very much.

Be sure to check Walmart...when I was looking for this I ran into Walmart just to check and found it for $58.88...just bought the second one there six months later for the same price.

This was THE BEST first birthday present I've ever bought. Only problem is now I don't know how I'll top it for the 2nd and future birthdays.

product_title: MEGA Bloks Fill & Dump Wagon
review_body: We have had this wagon for over a year now.  We got it for my then one year old son.  Since then this wagon has experienced a lot of rough play.  My son has launched it down a flight of stairs to the tile floor several times.  My older daughter has put my 30+ lb. son in there & pulled him all around the house repeatedly (note:  the wagon is not supposed to have kids in it- it is not stable & could easily flip over backwards- but I tell you this to let you know that this wagon is tough!)  We have had no problems with the wagon and expect it to last for a long time to come!  And the blocks are great of course too.

product_title: Arcade Alley Bowlercade
review_headline: Saturday afternoon bowling with my Son
review_body: I just purchased this item and it is great it is just like a real bowling alley and my 6 year old loves this item we play at night and every Saturday afternoon  .The item has electronic scoring and automatic pin reset and ball return which is just like the real thing and the item work great .I would recommend this game to my friends along with other Moose Mountain Aracade alley items                     Dom New York

product_title: Video and Game Station
review_body: Bought this for my 6 year old gaming/tv freak, very sturdy construction with no worries of tipping the 27 inch tv. Currently we have a DVD/VCR combo on the second shelf and a GameCube on the bottom. The only problem we have had is the spacing slats that hold the DVD's in place don't hold them tightly enough and they sometimes fall off of the stand. Easy to put together and even easier to keep clean.

product_title: Swim School: Baby and Me Float
review_body:
As soon as I seen this float I knew that we had to have it. And I was right because my one year old daughter loves it!! She feels safe and can still kick her feet and \\"swim\\" and I can be right next to her without her tying to drown me; which is what happens if I try to hold her with her life jacket on. I do wish that her side would blow up more because if you get out of the adult side it doesn't feel as safe, but I am always with her, so its not that big of a deal. Kate is really comfortable in the pool using the float to let her swim in comfort and style, but I make her wear her life jacket even when she's in the float when we are at the lake (Our lake is 500+ foot deep in some areas.) She does fit in the float with her life jacket, but not as comfortably as she is without it.
The size of the float is nice too. I thought it would be bigger when I opened the box, and I was worried that it would be too small, but it is a good size to leave in the boat or put in the car beside the two car seats. I also love that they made it yellow. If there ever is a problem and you get out too far, everyone will be able to see you!!

This float is really comfortable for both mom and baby and well worth the money!!

product_title: Laugh & Learn Musical Learning Chair
review_body: We bought this toy for our youngest daughter for her first birthday. She adored it! She loves anything that plays music. She loves to sit down and get back up over and over to hear it tell her she's on the chair, off the chair. My oldest daughter, who is almost 3 also was immediately taken with this chair. Unlike the other person's child, she has no trouble at all playing in the chair and she too is very tall for her age. Also, neither child has had fingers pinched attempting to turn the pages. The chair is a little smaller than I thought it would be, but this hasn't been a problem for us and it is big enough so that it doesn't tip over when they are rough with it. It is sturdy and durable and it takes a beating and keeps on ticking. Love it! Highly recommend it!

product_title: Playhut Fire Engine
review_headline: A major hit with our son!!
review_body: This was a gift for our son last year for his 2nd birthday, and a year later it is still one of his favorites!  It takes less than a minute to set up (and less than a minute to put away, too!), but it is still durable enough for rough toddler play, yet flexible enough so he doesn't get hurt if he knocks it over!  It's large enough for an adult to get into, too, so the whole family has a ball playing firefighter!  I highly recommend this fire truck tent! :)

product_title: Dinosaur Play & Store Big Box
review_body: I bought this two years ago for Christmas for my daughter when she was 4.  It's still one of her favorite toys.  She can sit and get lost in this little world for a long time while learning about the different kinds of dinos.  The best thing about it for me is that it comes with a plastic box to keep everything together.  To this day all the pieces are together while other sets are scattered in different containers.  It's been well worth the money.

product_title: Arcade Alley Bowlercade
review_body: I recently purchased the Bowlercade as a birthday present for my 5 year old nephew and you wouldn't believe what a hit it was at the party, even I played with it. I was actually quite amazed at how quickly we assembled it (only 13 minutes). The game is so magical; the kids loved the automatic pin resetting and ball return. Let me tell you what pain in the you know what it is chasing down balls. With this item the balls come right back every time. With automatic scoring and cute sounds, the item was a hit all day!!! I would ABSOLUTELY recommend this item to anyone.

product_title: Animal Alley 18 Inch Talking Geoffrey
review_body: This is the second giraffe we've gotten.  The first one stopped talking several months after we bought it, but my baby loves it so much we had to buy him a new one.

product_title: Athens Crib - Natural
review_body: This is a great crib, and the price was great too!  It is very sturdy, and it was very easy to put together.  It also looks very nice.

product_title: Lite-Brite Cube
review_body: This was a great Christmas present for my 6 yo and 4 yo to share.  They both loved it and it is easy to operate.  I do agree that there need to be more sheets included.  We ran out the first day.  There is nowhere to purchase them online anywhere or any store.

product_title: Fisher Price 5-in-1 Ocean Wonders DOLL Stroller
review_body: I really like this toy it's very cute and well made it's just like a real baby stroller. The only problem I have is the fishbowl snapping out of place but only when my daughter has leaned on it with all her weight. At first when I put the stroller together everything seemed to fall apart then I played around with it for a few minutes and realized I had some of the pieces backwards that's why the canopy kept falling off. There is a certain way you put this together it will not lock in place any other way. Seems like some people just got frustrated and probably didn't even read the directions. My daughters extremely happy with it and plays with it everyday she likes to take scamps for a ride. And btw my daughter is 2 and can push this stroller fine. If you can figure it out it is definitely worth the money it's not easy and make sure you put the spacers between the wheels cause they are almost impossible to get off.

product_title: Jojo's Circus Get up and Play Jojo Doll
review_body: My 2.5 year old daughter loves JoJo's circus, and since getting this doll, she brings it everywhere. It seems pretty durable, and it is just as cute in person as the online pictures reflect. I would definitely recommend this toy as a good purchase for the child in your life!

product_title: Snugride Infant Car Seat in Newport Bears Print
review_body:
When I found I was having twins, my husband and I wanted to find nice carriers, that would also be easy to use two.

This car seat is loved for many reasons:
* Easy to use with double-snap-n-go
* Has GREAT crash test ratings
* Has a five-point harness thats easy to adjust, easy to buckle/unbuckle, and comfortable
* Has very comfortable, (and cute!) fabrics, doesnt make baby too hot, but also great in cold weather. Its easy to wash, but also easy to spot clean.
* The canopy rotates for baby, always blocking the sun.
* The handle is nice to hold, I dont find myself constantly swithching arms like my friend does with her EvenFlow. Its also easy to adjust for carrying, or car useage. ALSO GREAT WITH CARRIER TOYS!
* Its not too heavy, but also not extremely lightweight... This makes it feel very secure and durable.
* It snaps into the four bases that we own easily, without waking them, but yet still keeping them very safe.
* The bases were easy to install, and very secure...
* It reqlines very nicely, and easily for different places.
* My sons LOVE sleeping in it! And they sleep in it long after our outing!

There are a few things annoying about this carrier...
* It doesnt fit in shopping carts, that makes it hard to go foodshopping alone, actually IMPOSSIBLE to do without someone else, annoying indeed!
* Its too easy for my 2 1/2 year old daughter to push around, probablly the same for for all carriers, just wish it wouldnt
* It doesnt fit in restaurant highchairs either, I have to keep it on a chair, and I am very nervous!


I love this carrier, its very easy to use and excells in crash test ratings. Its comfortable for my boys, and I will be using it for a while (sons are premies)

product_title: Girlz The Real Knit And Gem Machine by Mega Brands
review_body: This was one of the two presents 'Santa' gave to our 6 year old for Christmas.  After turning the crank about 12 times, the machine jammed.  We took it apart to see what was going on inside (I'm an engineer at heart) and saw the plastic pieces come out of their intended position when it's jammed.  After putting it back together it jammed again.  Over and over this happens until finally 2 of the plastic pieces finally break in half.   Worthless piece of junk that left our whole family a little depressed on Christmas day.

product_title: Transformers Cybertron Scout Clocker
review_body:
With every new transformers line comes the flood of reviews for all the Primes, Megatrons, and Starscreams. With all the established names and bigger bots being most fans' priorities in terms of purchasing and reviewing, it's easy to understand how the little basic t.f.'s, or \\"scout\\" class as this line is refering to them, would be over looked. This is also why most people don't know what there missing.

What Energon started, Cyberton continues as these are some of the best basic (yes, I know it's scout but for the sake uniformity let's stay basic) Transformers you could ever own and Clocker is quite a cut above the rest. First, let's focus on vehicle mode. Being from the speed planet Clocker's vehicle mode definetly conveys a sense of speed but if you look closely some of you older TF fans might notice something interesting. At first I didn't notice it until somebody else brought it to my attention but this little guy's vehicle mode bears a very nice resemblance to the vehicle mode of G1's Hot Rod. For me, being a long time fan of Transformers, this alone would convince me to buy Clocker and so...I did. Luckily for us this toy also offers a lot more than a G1 homage. While the color scheme doesn't match that of Hot Rod, Clocker's color scheme is quite appealing. The translucent blue of the windshield and wheels mixed with silver, light blue and orange really lend themselves well to the youthful autobot in both modes.

Speaking of other modes, after a simple yet clever transformation you're left with a very articulate little robot. His arms, while a little long, can move in and out shoulder 90 degrees or so, 360 around and at the elbow. Legs bend at the knee and have ball joints at the hips and his head turns 360 at the neck. All this articulation really makes for some nice posing. His Cyber Planet key feature (a hidden double barrel gun) works well in vehicle mode but seems a little clunky in robot mode but it's not too distracting. Even his side exhaust pipes can act as weapons by fitting them into his hands. With G1 homage and visually appealing vehicle mode and an articulate and equally visually appealing robot mode all for about $7, I really hope that Transformer fans young and old don't forget to pick up a little back up for their Optimus Prime.ot too distracting. Even his side exhaust pipes can act as weapons by fitting them into his hands. With G1 homage and visually appealing vehicle mode and an articulate and equally visually appealing robot mode all for about $7, I really hope that Transformer fans young and old don't forget to pick up a little back up for their Optimus Prime.

product_title: My Scene: Shopping Spree Kenzie
review_body:
My mother got this doll for me for Christmas. It was, or still is a great gift. She is sitting in my room with my other dolls, Delancey(my fav!), Nolee, Madison, Chelsea, Hudson, Sutton, and River. I need Barbie to complete my collection. I totally love this doll (we were talking about Kenzie) IS one of the coolest!
She's got awesome assecories and a cash register that comes with $20 and two credit cards. And make-up tons of it! I totally recomennd this doll.

product_title: 1313 Dead End Drive - Board Game
review_body: AWESOME GAME!!!! Best I have ever played. I would recommend for any age!!!! Anyone who has a problem with this game cannot clearly understand ENTERTAINMENT...oh boy

product_title: Triumph 5 Comfort Touch Convertible Car Seat with LATCH: Aristotle
review_body:
As did many other people, we bought this seat based on CRs crash test ratings. Unfortunately, we are going to be returning it to the store. This is a carseat for our second car. Our little boy is 3 months old and already seems too tall for the lower strap setting (he is only 11 pounds and 23 in. long) and the next highest setting is above his ears. The staps come out at least an inch or two below his shoulders, so when we tighten the straps, his shoulders crunch down before the straps across his legs get even close to being tight. I have tried pulling them through and everything, but it's just a pain to have to deal with every time!

Another thing that I don't like about this seat when it comes to small infants is the size of the straps and the clip. The straps themselves are wide, so they basically cover my child's entire chest and even stick out past his shoulders. The clip is ENORMOUS and seems terribly uncomfortable.

The loosening and tightening of the straps is a pain and is not good if your child is in between \\"clicks\\". They are either too loose or too tight.

After reading other parents' reports on the difficulty to clean the cover, I have made my decision to return it. I am a clean-freak and I will not deal well with the difficult-or impossible-to-clean cover. I think disassembling the seat would surely compromise the safety.

We are planning to purchase the Britax Marathon. In TN, the law states booster seats until age 8, so we should get at least 4 good years out of the Marathon before going to the booster seat.

product_title: Pokemon Advanced Pokedex
review_body: my 5 year old son loves pokemon so we got him this pokedex for a preschool \\"graduation\\" gift. he was so excited and carries it everywhere in the gameboy carrying case we also bought. (a little big but works) he's just starting to read so some of the games are a bit hard (like the quiz) but otherwise he loves it. he used up the batteries already and it wouldn't restart after we changed them until we pressed the reset button. might be why it didn't work for others who thought this was a bad toy. we think it's great, i'm glad we bought it. my son won't go anywhere without it! i only wish that it talked like the one on the show.

product_title: Magnetix 150 Count - Translucent
review_headline: Great for all ages over three!
review_body: My aunt got this last Christmas for all three of my kids (ages 4, 6, and 10) they all love it and play with it all the time.  I will get another set to go along with what I have so the three can play better all together. Educational and fun too!  Balls would be choking hazard for young ones.

product_title: Fun Folding Kitchen with 18 Accessories
review_body: I chose to buy this toy kitchen because my son wanted to play with a kitchen set, but my husband and I really didn't want a play kitchen that was purple, pink, or said Barbie all over it. This one has some pink on it, but it wasn't nearly as \\"girly\\" as the others available in this price range. As it turns out, both my sons like pretending they're making meals for the family. There are lots of accessories with this play set that make the toy seem more realistic, and they're all made of durable plastic. Our only complaint is that the accessories end up all over the house at times.

product_title: Barbie Primp and Polish Styling Head
review_body: 1st pull the pieces of hair that are course OUT of her head.Then you will have more fun her facial make-up changes color with warm water and ice.I love her hair color. She is the best Barbie styling head ever made thats a fact.

product_title: Fisher-Price Deluxe Jumperoo
review_body: My 5 month old boy absolutely LOVES this jumper. He'll jump in it for 45 minutes, taking short 30 seconds to rest his legs. He loves the music it plays (activated by button or jumping) and gets a kick out of our excitement as he jumps. When he sits on Grandma's legs and someone else touches the Jumperoo, his legs start jumping on her knee. He loves the toy even when he's not in it!

product_title: N-Vision Plug-N-Play Power Rangers Dino Thunder Game
review_body:
I bought this for my son and took it back to the store the same day. It doesn't work at all and the graphics are terrible. The only thing it did well was make a lot of noise by playing the annoying power ranger theme song over and over.

Avoid this toy at all costs.

product_title: BOOK: Animal World
review_body: This is a nice book.  Both my two year old son and I like it a lot.  It has the normal animals like DOG and LION, but also unexpected animals like DINGO.  It shows the animals according to their habitat and you can hear the animals' names and their actual sounds, plus extra miscellaneous activities.

product_title: MGA Little Tikes Wide Tracker Activity Walker
review_body: My son loves this toy.  He got this toy as a gift when he was 10 months old.  Yes the doors fall off but my son could care less. He uses this toy to walk all over the house.  It is also light enough that we take it to the park, shopping, etc.  so he can walk on his own when we go out.  He has fallen down a few times as other people mentioned - but I assume this is the case with most early walkers.  Now that he has the hang of using it he pulls himself up with the bar and has few problems walking around with it.  I would say this is one of his favorite toys we own so I think it is quite a deal for the price.

product_title: Little Tikes Sing Along Microphone
review_body:
My problem/compalaint with this microphone is the static. I guess the speaker is too close to the microphone and causes feedback and static. My kids can't hear themselves sing over the noise and it is VERY annoying to anyone around them.

I didn't look up this microphone on Amazon.com before buying it. I REALLY wish I had. I love Amazon.com reviews--real people tell it how it is.

product_title: Cranium Booster Box 2
review_body: I thought the Booster Box was supposed to have all new questions.  In fact, it advertises just that.  When I received the booster box and started playing, we realized this was just another set of cards from the original game.  Advertising very misleading and I wouldn't waste my money.

product_title: Cogno: Deep Worlds Board Game
review_headline: From the Board Games Editor at BellaOnline.com
review_body:
The concept of this game is silly and fun: each player takes the part of an alien and tries to cross through an ocean on an alien land. The game board is a bit confusing at first (there are often several options of which way a player can go, and players are allowed to move both backwards and forwards), but it makes more sense once you've played the game for a few minutes. In order to make it back out of the alien ocean, the player must collect three fuel cells.

The rules of the game are fairly complex and it will help to go over them a couple of times before attempting to play the game, but the diversity of all of the different rules and parts of the game board will surely keep kids interested. They'll want to play it over and over, and they'll learn while they do it. What more can you ask?

One of the very best features of this game is that all of the science trivia questions come with a full explanation in an accompanying book (The Book of Y). Very cool!

product_title: Story Reader SpongeBob SquarePants - Grand Prize Winner
review_body:
It teaches my daughter to listen and to spend quiet moments with a book. It is not a subtitute for me reading to her but it does help when you can't.

It is fun for both of us.

product_title: Disney Princess Cinderella Talking Vanity
review_body: My daughter received the vanity for her 4th birthday. I had  already purchased the Step 2 vanity which I liked much better, but Daddy went and got her the one she wanted.  It was the only thing she asked for. It is very flimsy and tips over very easily if placed on carpet. Within 5 minutes I noticed a large scratch on the mirror. I contacted Disney to find out about replacing that part but am waiting for a response. The light up feature in the mirror is pretty neat. My daughter likes it, but the quality is poor and I don't expect it to last too long.

product_title: Sesame Street Flip-Open Sofa
review_headline: Musical  is not musical, just so you know
review_body: Maybe I read it wrong, but I thought this couch was a \\"muscial\\" flip open sofa for some reason and looked like a moron trying to see where the music comes out!  I have to laugh.
