THey may want to reword that.  Anyway, we love it musical or not, its soooo cute and my daughter thinks its great.  very durable too!

product_title: Reveal Entertainment Candyman Board Game
review_body:
This game was a good time. It's definitely an adult game, and best played in a spirit of mean fun. Cries of \\"Take one to the peppermint, Bitey!\\" and \\"Oh, no- not my tasty little legs!\\" accompany gameplay. It's a pretty amusing parody of Candyland, a game which (while we may remember it fondly from our youths) sucked. The basic game play is similar to the original, but the addition of \\"treat\\" cards (which give you special powers) and the ability to attack other players change it from a game entirely based on chance to a game with an element of strategy.

Gameplay is okay, though not inspired. This is a game you play for the fun of the situation, not for the brilliance of the game play.

product_title: Fisher Price - Laugh & Learn Learning Table
review_body: I bought this for my son when he was about 6 months.  We used it then without the legs attached.  He loved it.  As he learned to pull up on things we attached the legs.  They were made different then and it flipped over on him very easily, which scared him.  But he liked playing with it so much he kept at it.  As I said, the legs are made differently now and it looks much more stable.  If you have a little one just learning to pull up, you might try one out in the store to make sure it doesn't flip.  Or, you could just leave the legs off until they are more proficient at pulling up.  My son is now turning two and he still really likes this toy.  I think toys are worth the investment if it will hold their attention for this length of time.

product_title: Melissa & Doug Deluxe Wooden Stamp Set With 16 Stamps, 2 Inkpads, and 7 Colored Pencils
review_body: I purchased these stamps for my art project loving 2 1/2 year old even though the package says 4 years +.  She doesn't use them to make pastoral scenes as shown on the package, but loves the stamp graphics.  Much cleaner than other projects we do and the stamps are very good quality with two stamp pads (so no fighting with her cousin over them).  It's nice to know she will enjoy these for a long time and they seem durable enough to last as her artistic ability grows!

product_title: Geotrax Rail & Road System Highland Scenic Lines
review_headline: Better than Thomas for young ones
review_body:
Thomas is great but not very sturdy..And too expensive to keep adding, plus the pieces fall off, like the faces. So I tried this out and think it's great for my rough little boy who likes to throw or drop things on occasion.

Also I think you get more for your money with the geotrax system too. Who couldn't use a break on their wallet when they have kids.

product_title: Early Years Crib Mirror
review_headline: Loved to stare at himself for hours!
review_body: Great idea, my son laughed at himself for hours looking at his mirror. It's so cute to watch them talk to themselves in the mirror!

product_title: Prima Donna Panache Analiese
review_body: I purchased three of these dolls and feel they are completely misrepresented.  Although they look like their picutre, they are so small they would fit in the palm of your hand (smaller than a Beenie Baby).  It's not a doll a child could play with.  Had the specifications/size of the dolls been available, I would not have purchased them.

product_title: Fisher-Price Deluxe Jumperoo
review_body: he is 7 months and seems to enjoy this bouncer. however not so much as to fall asleep. we are still looking for that fantastic item. good buy !

product_title: Beatles Saturday Morning Cartoon Figure: Paul
review_headline: Great Toys For a Subpar Cartoon Show
review_body: Bootleg videos and DVD's of the original Beatles Saturday Morning Cartoons can be bought at Beatlefests and various Comic Book Conventions. Upon watching them... at best, they are really dated, crude, and somewhat unwatchable(yet very nostalgic!) McFarlane Toys released the  Beatles action figures based on the YELLOW SUBMARINE animated musical several years ago and those were excellent.  Now McFarlane Toys has produced the Beatles action figures based on their Saturday Morning cartoon show. The toys are a great companion piece to the YELLOW SUBMARINE versions. To reiterate that the cartoons are not very good but the action figures serve to keep the spirit and nostalgia of the cartoons intact. For harcore Beatles fans, these are a must have. The \\"Ringo On Drums\\" is probably the best of the bunch (and it seems to be the one thats out of stock.)

product_title: Baby Einstein Animal Orchestra Stacker
review_body:
We received this toy as a gift when my daughter was 6 months old. She liked the toy because it made interesting sounds, but it is WAY too loud. I had to put a scotch tape over the sound holes to make it quieter.

Although my daughter liked the sounds, the holes on each toy was too small for her to successfully stack the toys. She is 13 months old now, and she still gets frustrated with it.

After about two months of use, this toy started to make noises on its own even if no body is near the toy.

My daughter likes the cheep ($4.99) classic stacking rings by Fisher-Price far better than this toy.

product_title: Training Rewards Soft Seat Potty & Stepstool
review_body: My daughter loves this potty! I love this potty! The step stool is sturdy. The cover easily lifts up and down. The only bummer is my daughter likes to empty the potty herself. She watches mommy and daddy do it and wants to help too. But this isnt the product's fault. I highly recommend this potty!

product_title: Strawberry Shortcake: Filly Groomin' Salon With Honey Pie Pony
review_body: This toy could have been made out of duct tape and my daughter would have still loved it.  She is quite infatuated with Strawberry Shortcake and her Fillies and was so excited to get another Honey Pie and tons of accessories.  True, the stable is flimsy and pops apart easily, but my daughter is 4 and manages well with it on a table.  At night I always have to reassemble the walls and gates so that her fillies can sleep inside the stable.  (A super glue project may be in our future.)

product_title: Triumph 5 Comfort Touch Convertible Car Seat with LATCH: Aristotle
review_body: I read numerous positive reviews about this product - I really do my research when it comes to keeping my baby safe.  However, after 2 weeks with this seat I've about had it!  I did not meet any of our expectations, other than it was nice looking.  We had a horrible time installing it in both our SUV and our sedan.  In addition, the knob that releases the harness doesn't work 9 times out of 10. I end up having to duck my head in the car and reach over my child and toggle the harness knob until it finally turns and I can loosen the harness.  Furthermore, the seat cover has already torn in a couple of places.  We are currently researching another carseat and the very day I find what we are looking for I'm taking this one back!

product_title: Lincoln Logs Wild West Ranch 150 Piece Set!
review_body: When the toy arrived I was overwhelmed with the contents..I feel like I scored big ... the kids will love this christmas morning.

product_title: Floor Lamp Base - White
review_body:
The lamp itself was pretty pricey for what it actually is. $29.99 would have been a more appropriate price point. It looks good, is not of the greatest of quality but does the job for a child's room. The bigger problem, the manufacturer says it takes an 8 inch harp for the lamp shade(which it does not come with) and when you purchase an 8 inch harp you must take apart the top of the fixture right beneath where the bulb goes. On this lamp this part does not detach and is glued together. If it did detach you would also have to rewire it to get wires through the harp, a big pain.
Moral of the story... if you plan to buy this lamp, make sure your lamp shade is the kind that does not need a harp and fits on easily underneath the bulb. We could only find one red shade that went with the room and unfortunately it was not that kind and we will be rigging the $54.99 lamp(not including $12.99 shipping) and the $40.00 shade to somehow make it look decent. We definitely overpaid for this item...GOOD LUCK!

product_title: Playhut Fire Engine
review_body: This is a pretty fun item, at first my kids couldn't stop going in and out of it, my son would put on his fire hat and a toy house and go inside and play firemen for awhile.  The initial thrill has worn off but still quite frequently both my kids (2.5 and 1 yrs old) still will pop in and out of it once in awhile.  Rough play can cause the tent to collapse but it's not too frequent.

product_title: Quattro Tour Stroller - Windsor
review_body: I've read several reviews for this stroller that were negative because of its size.  Yes, it is big & bulky, but I love it.  My son is only 5 weeks old & hauling the car seat around is a little heavy on the arms.  The car seat locks in just like in the car and there are double locks at the top to prevent it from tipping backwards.  It's perfect for walking at the mall with the car seat in it.  The basket has plenty of room for stuff & it is very easy to maneuver.  If you have room for it, spend the extra money, it's an awesome stroller!!!

product_title: Fisher-price Little People: Christmas Village
review_body: I have 4 children so it's a lot of fun to have decorations the children can play with. I have all the Little People Christmas sets (check out Fisher Price's website to see them all). I pack them away with the Christmas stuff, so every year it's like a brand new toy. I keep them around the Christmas tree so they can play with it all they want. Even my 9 year old likes to push the buttons and hear the Christmas music.

product_title: Little Tikes Bath Bubble Maker
review_body: My husband and I bought two of these toys yesterday and we're taking them right back.  We put it on that night for my 15 month old daughter's bath and it was SO loud.  It only churns water around at the base of the fish, so water just bubbles up right in that area and hardly at all.  The water easily got into the star knob, that's when it started to die down and then it stopped working altogether.  We took it off, emptied the water, started it up again and, as soon as water got in it again, it died out.  The second toy was for our niece - I would have been so embarrassed if this poor quality gift was given to her.  The only good that has come from this is that I was able to try it out before sending it!  What a waste of time and money!

product_title: Parkway Express Booster Seat
review_body: I do love Britax car seats and my son has had the marathon for 2 years now and was ready for a booster. I bought this one and took it back. I thought it was rather cheaply made. the cupholders are absolutely worthless. Yes, this is not a safety feature but still it's important to my son to have his cup nearby and they just fly out of the holder while you're driving b/c they are not deep enough. I also don't like that it didn't have armrests and though I like the idea of side impact protection, this seat snugs their head a little too tightly and my son couldn't tolerate it. he was constantly leaning forward trying to see out the window. anyway, I'm sure like all Britax products, this is a safe seat but just not the right one for us.

product_title: Razor E200 Electric Scooter - Red
review_body: For anyone considering purchasing a Razor electric scooter, I encourage you to read my experience with Razor before purchasing.  I purchased a Razor E200S in December, 2003.    Within about 2 weeks the charger went bad.  I called Razor customer service ...  and they agreed to send me a new charger.  It arrived in about 2 weeks.    Next, about a month later, the throttle stuck while my 12 year old daughter was riding the scooter.  She ran full speed into a fence. Fortunately she wasn't injured. I called Razor customer service ... and they said the throttle was a known defect and sent me a new throttle assembly with installation instructions. It arrived in about 2 weeks.  I installed the throttle assembly, about a 45 minute job.    Next my daughter had a flat on the rear tire.  No big deal right. Well I spent about an hour trying to get the tire off and gave up.  I called Razor customer service ... and they said the tire could not be changed ... I had to buy an entire new rear tire assembly.  I reluctantly ordered the new rear tire (what choice did I have).  I placed the order and my credit card was charged $18.50 in August, 2004.  They said it would arrive in about 10 days.  It is now November, 2004 (three months later) and still no tire assembly.  ...  ...  Never another Razor product for me.

product_title: Country Cottage Playhouse
review_body: This was a birthday present for my 2 year old daughter. The box it comes in is huge, we had to take the pieces out to put them into the back of our van.  This was very easy to assemble, my 10 year old son helped me and it took us 10 minutes.  The kids both love it; they played in it immediately.  They put a Little Tikes table and chairs inside and had lunch.  It was a tight fit but they were able to sit in there.  I think this is well worth the money, there's plenty of opportunities for imaginative play.

product_title: WWE Ruthless Aggression Series #15 (Gold Belt Giveaway) Mark Jendrick
review_body: Nice detail to this figure with his debut figure (think he has another figure out now as well in a 3 pack?). I still will never figure out why they had most of these guys come with belts they've never had (unless i missed when they won them) but hey, we can't have an over run of HHH or Angles, its good to give the new guys like Carlito, Jendrick, and Coach a nice angle (Carlito is the one I know that deserves the title since hes won U.S. and Intercontinental). A great figure to get to round out your collection and a new one to get as well.

product_title: Pixter Color Learning ROM - Global Passport
review_body: This game will provide some basic geography skills, but could go much further as a learning tool.  There it little offered as to the countries and their culture, and the various famous landmarks are not explained.  Perhaps the sofware and hardware capabilities are limiting, but a little more from our animated hosts other than hello and goodbye would have been welcome.  Also, the object of the game is to collect passports from various countries.  This can take a while, and we have had no luck saving and continuing a game to date, although the manual says this feature is supported.

product_title: Spider-Man 2: Spider-Man vs Dr. Octopus
review_body: My twin sons love Spiderman so I bought this building set for them at Christmas time. What a disaster! The \\"nubs\\" for the blocks are too short and the pieces won't stay together. Every time the boys touch the buildings, they crumble. It's not just children who can bring them tumbling down. I can't keep the pieces together when I'm using them either - and I'm an architect. It's very frustrating for everyone. Did anyone bother to try out this toy before they put it on the market?

product_title: Pacific Play Tents Lil Nursery Tent
review_body:
I would give this tent 5 stars except for two reasons: be careful if your child tries to pull him/herself to standing while in it because it can tip over. Also, I wish it had a shoulder strap to make carrying it easier. It is featherlight though so even without the strap, you can stick in a bag and carry it that way.
Overall, we love the tent and it is the best value for the money spent!

product_title: Batman Backpack with Lunch Kit: Swinging
review_headline: Looks really cool, lunch bag not insulated, only held together a few weeks....
review_body: My six-year-old son wanted a backpack with a detachable lunch bag, and he really likes Batman.  I got him one of these in August, intending for him to use it for the entire school year.  However, the detachable lunch bag is not insulated, so it can't keep anything cold for any useful length of time.  I began packing his lunch in a separate insulated lunch bag, then stuffing it inside the detachable lunch bag.  This worked fine, but over the next few weeks the Velcro that holds the lunch bag on the backpack gradually weakened, and now it will no longer hold his lunch on the backpack.  I solved this problem by stuffing his lunch down inside the main body of the backpack.  Unfortunately, early this past week one of the plastic thingies (sorry, I don't know the technical term) that holds one of the straps together broke irreparably.  My son is a first-grader and only carries one or two very small books in his backpack at a time, and this backpack could not even handle that.  So now, we are reusing his backpack from last year, and the really cool-looking Batman one is in the trash.  And we are only about 1/4 the way through the school year....

product_title: Little Tikes Sing Along Karaoke
review_body: While my two and a half year old loved this item it is not a quality little tikes toy. After just a month with an adult using it the toy ate the tape. When I called to have the tape replaced I was directed to a company in association with Little tikes to get the replacement part. They want a letter sent to the corporate office in order to receive the tape. I was also told to return the product and not use it. Don't waste your money. This is not a quality Little tikes toy. Shame of it all is my son loved singing into the microphone.

product_title: Barbie My Scene My Bling Bling Barbie Doll
review_body:
You are wasting bandwidth my little children. Some like Bratz as I see, and some like My Scene. Is there a problem with that? No. Is it petty of you to argue about it? Yes. Grow up little chickadees. They are dolls, you are fighting, calling each other names, using words I know your mom would use soap to wash out your mouths with, all over dolls. You are 100% entitled to your opinion, but on this review option you are asked to review this doll, not dish out on the other young girls. Seriously misses, you're being incredibly immature over a petty little thing.

As for my review...I babysit young girls who own both My Scene and Bratz, at the moment they prefer My Scene because their Barbie clothes fit on My Scene. After looking over this doll with their mom, we both decided that these aren't the most tasteful looking dolls. The girls can't wait till they have them, but all in all, it portrays a bad message I think. Bling bling and skimpy outfits? Thanks for the offer, but I'll have to pass. Basically, be careful if you buy these for your children, make sure that they understand that materialism is not as important as a lot of things are saying it to be. The dolls are pretty and have fun and flashy outfits and accessories..but they could have done it without making them look like \\"Pretty Women\\".

product_title: SnugRide Infant Car Seat - Blackwell
review_headline: graco is the best, like always
review_body:
this car seat is great. the color is really fancy and looks very nice. like always graco has the best in safety for infant car seats. they recommend you wash the product before using it with an infant and it washed really good. we bought the matching stroller with it and they work great together. you can't go wrong with this car seat, believe me I have bought many and ended up returning all of them and getting this one. I have bought the super expensive european ones and ended up liking this one better. I bought this one for my own daughter and have bought it for my two nieces and nephew also and everyone loves it.
a very happy mom

product_title: Sunshine Symphony
review_body: I gave this as a gift and it was a great hit.  I recommend it to anyone that wants to give a great gift.

product_title: WowWee Robotics RoboPet
review_body:
It's like he is a real dog!!! This toy, I mean pet, is great!! The only problem is that Robo Pet is rather loud, and sometimes when I play with it, my parents get a little mad because it is fun, but it makes a lot of noise, but I don't regret it, even though $80 is an outrageous price for this, but it is still awesome.
Soooooooooo, go ahead.
Buy it!!!

product_title: Dr. Dreadful Super Lab
review_body: My son loves it.  This toy is fun and educational and I would much rather have my son play with a toy like this and learn something than be stuck in front of the tv. For anyone who is \\"upset\\" about the commercial and feels it is discriminating - loosen up!  Boys are also discriminated against - go into any clothing or toy store and you will find there are much more girl items than boys. Try having nothing to choose from for clothes except for jeans and t-shirts!  I for one am happy to see something \\"cooking\\" related made for boys.

product_title: VTech - V.Smile TV Learning System
review_body: I want to get my 3 year old a video game for her next birthday because she has 3 older siblings that play PS2 and wants to play too. However, after researching I don't know weather to get the VSmile or Interactive DVD by Fisher Price. Has anyone had experience with both?

product_title: Teletubbies Talking Tubby Plush with Video: Po
review_body: this plush toy is very duraBle and you can hear the phrases really well, there is no educational value, the toddler enjoys it very much. if your child is into the teletubbies, they will certainly enjoy this.

product_title: Eddie Bauer Designer 22 Infant Car Seat - Blue Glacier
review_headline: good  car seat but wont use it for next little one
review_body: it's a nice car seat but the snap that goes in between the legs is very hard to get together if your child move just alittle. it's to much of a fight. it is pretty heavy. we have a truck and its pretty hard to get in the vehicle and it takes forever for it to snap in. this is the only child we will use this one for.

product_title: Laser Challenge Neutralizer
review_body:
Call me a kid, but as a Resident Assistant in college, I found that this toy is awesome. One of the dutys of being a Resident Assistant is to keep the residents busy and having fun (along with school, of course). I liked these guns so much, that I bought 13 boxes of them! It's a great toy for young children and college students alike.

I would recommend the Laser Challenge Disarmed (and any other Laser Challenge produc) to anybody.

product_title: Mosaic Compact Travel System - Summit
review_headline: Good for a smaller travel system
review_body: I want to start out by saying Graco usually makes good products.  When I saw this was coming out I was very excited because my quatro tour travel system is rather large.  I wanted something smaller and a little more portable.  The fact is I found this stoller rather awkward.  It was hard to fold up quickly - unlike what I was used to, and the stroller itself did not provide as much support to my 5 month old daughter as my quatro tour does.  I will say that if you are short on room or have a small car this is probably a good option, but I returned mine and just purchased a maclaren umbrella stroller.  My quatro tour fits fine in my camry and my daughter is much happier in it than the mosaic.  As far as the car seat goes, it is great as all graco snug rides are.

product_title: Gazillion Bubbles Nemo Motorized Bubble Blower
review_headline: Is not working the way it should
review_body: I think this toy would be awesome if it worked properly.  The air coming out of Nemo's mouth is not strong enough.  Therefore, it blows one bubble and it pops!  My friend has one and her's works great!  Can this be replaced?

product_title: Disney Princess Shoe Trunk
review_body: My granddaughter is almost 2. She loved the shoes. The only problem I have had is the gems come off the crown easily. Other than that, she is having so much fun!

product_title: Tamagotchi Best True Friends Collection: Version 2 - Flowers
review_body: I really like this Tamagotchi!  My daughter is 8 years old and it is giving her responsibility for something she has to take care of and feed!  I know its just a little game but I think it show how hard it is to keep something going.  She usually get bored very quickly with toys but these have really gotten to her!  SO I think its a good thing for kids to have and its will show them when they want a real pet how much work it is!

product_title: Magnetix 200-Piece Collector's Case
review_headline: finally a toy that WON'T be in the garage sale next year!
review_body:
My 5 year old loves this! We got him a small set last Christmas when he was 4 y.o. and he liked it so much that we got him this larger set for his last birthday.

He will play with it for hours! He has built different shapes, a boat, a castle, and skyscraper, a large tent... he is always coming up with new creations.

The only downfalls:

1. His little sister loves it, too but she is only 15 months and too young for it.

2. We had a couple of the magnets pull out and my husband just superglued them back in.

My son loves his Legos but actually plays with this more.

product_title: FLY 1.0 Pentop Computer
review_headline: Which do u want first; good news or bad news?
review_body: The good news is my 9 yr old has used it a lot since she got it five days ago and she is enjoying it. The bad news she's already out of paper and it's about 17 cents per sheet to buy more.

product_title: Polly Pocket Quik-Clik Boutique with "Magic" Dressing Room and Accessories
review_headline: Daughter wasn't able to get it to work, then it broke
review_body: My daughter was very excited about this toy but could not get it to work. Even I got very frustrated trying to line everything up and use just the right amount of pressure to get it to work. After just a few uses, the ramp jammed, and the toy now no longer works at all. And when we could get the doll dressed, my daughter was frustrated that the clothes pop off so easily, and she really couldn't play with her since she can't bend. Overall extremely frustrating for both of us.

product_title: My Little Pony: Twinkle Twirl's Dance Studio
review_body: My daughter, Christina, is 4 years old.  She HAD to have the Dance Studio and I gave in before Christmas and I'm so glad I did!  She LOVES this item!  There is so much to do and she lights up when she plays with it.  It really gives us both such a good feeling.  She loves My Little Pony-- and so did I!!!  Now we can love it together!  Thank you so much!

product_title: Bell Child Bicycle Helmet: Rex Lavender
review_body: I ordered the Bell Rex Sun and Stars Helmet and this helmet is the one I received. The one I viewed here on Amazon.com did not look like this. I have 2 sons, and this isn't something you give a boy unless you want him to get into fights at the playground!

product_title: Little People Animal Sounds Zoo
review_body: My daughter loves the animal zoo.  When you hit the yellow button you don't have to do much but a little tap, the monkey goes up and back down, and she loves the whistle that the bird makes when it is pressed down.  My daughter got this for her 1st b-d and she is now 2 1/2 almost and still enjoys it.  Defintely worth the money and will your children will light up with delight.

product_title: Mega Bloks Power Rangers: Dino Thunder Megazord
review_body: This toy looks good on the box, but it is not that much fun.  It is to hard for a five year old to put together and it does not stay together.  It wobbles when you try to stand it up and parts fall off continuously.  The parts do move and easily but it just does not stay together that well. Do not purchase this as a toy your child would actually play with or they will be disappointed.

product_title: Imaginext Dragonmont's Fortress with Video
review_body: I must say this was a huge disappointment in our house. We bought this for our 6 year old son.  As others have stated it is so difficult to put together and then it falls apart if you try to move it, or play with it. My son has the castle from He Man and this was a pleasure so we thought we would add on to his castle and get this one...I am so sorry I spent the money. The company should be ashamed of itself for saying it is so easy to put together. This is a big rip off SAVE YOUR MONEY!!!

product_title: Star Wars: Darth Vader Adult Costume - Medium
review_body: DON'T BUY THIS COSTUME, FOR THE SIMPLE FACT THAT WHAT YOU SEE IS NOT WHAT YOU GET. THERE IS NO JUMPSUIT, ITS A PIECE OF FOAM CALLED A \\"PRINTED CHEST PIECE\\". THE MASK IS FLIMSY, WHICH REALLY DIDN'T SUPRISE ME. THE CAPE, ON THE OTHER HAND, ISN'T THAT BAD, IT'S WHAT YOU WOULD EXPECT. BUT NOTHING ELSE IS. I HAVE A STRONG BELIEF THAT WHAT YOU SEE SHOULD BE WHAT YOU GET. THE CONS OUT-WEIGH THE PROS ON THIS ONE.

product_title: Decathlon Convertible Car Seat - Odyssey
review_body: Our little one outgrew her graco snugride way too fast, and so we were looking for the safest possible seat that would last the longest.  After quite a bit of research (pretty much narrowing it down to the Decathlon and the Marathon), we selected the Decathlon, and we're so happy with our choice.  Britax far exceeds American testing standards, so we know we have a super safe seat. Absolutely easy to install (especially as compared to the carrier bases, which were a nightmare), and so secure in the car (we really like the \\"versa tether\\" option).  The fabric is super soft, and the seat is well padded and apparently very comfy (passed the happy baby test).   From what I've read, the seat will no longer be a B-R-Us exclusive later this year, and there will be additional seat cover colors and patterns available. So, while I wish we could have waited another six months for more color options and maybe a better deal pricewise, I would absolutely buy this seat again.

product_title: Monopoly Junior Shrek 2 Game
review_body:
Our whole family loves Shrek & Shrek 2, but we were disapointed with this game. It was almost exactly like Monopoly Jr, the theme-based changes very minor. So the play is fun & educational.

However, the tokens (Shrek, Fiona, etc) are made from cheap cardboard and have little plastic stands that holds the cardboard characters up. I had to glue the cardboard characters to the stands so they would stay in place during play. My kids are gentle, but these would just fall out on their own.

product_title: Little Tikes Cozy Coupe
review_body:
I bought this toy for my daughters second birthday. Shes three now and it remains one of her favorites. Its so sturdy i have to tell my 9 year old to leave it alone LOL.

The only problem that i have withg it is that it only fits one comfortably. But other than that ITS GREAT!!! I highly reccomend it. You will defenetly get your moneys worth!

-L

product_title: YOUniverse ATM Savings Bank
review_body: ok first of all i got this bank last year for x-mas and it worked great for like the first 6 months then my older brother kicked the door off (he didnt really even kick it he barely laid his foot on it and it broke) i put it back on but it still comes off when i try to open it. and what else i didnt like about this toy is that if your younger than 8 then you will need help getting the combination open even i have a hard time getting it open and im 12! i would reccomend the YOUniverse ATM machine instead!

product_title: Land Air Rc Land & Air Stunt Machine
review_body: My son received this as a gift.  He is only 5 years old but is able to enjoy it with supervision.  If you ensure you have plenty of space and fly it on a non-windy day, the plane flies great.  The car is also plenty of fun.  We have crashed the plane many times and it is still working fine.  Fun, fun, fun!!!

product_title: 69" x 69" x 53" Jump-o-Lene Castle Bouncer
review_headline: LOADS OF FUN, takes up major room, questionable durablity
review_body: My 28 month old got this for Christmas.    We used an electric pump that we had for our air mattresses to blow it up.  It was very easy to blow up, it took 10 to 20 minutes. We recruited an uncle to blow it up. :)    My son loves his Castle Bouncer!  He dives into it, jumps around inside, bounces off the walls, and runs around in circles. He also likes to just relax inside his castle, and lays in there sometimes with his blanket.    My 6 month old likes to lay in there too.  He kicks around and likes to grab at the balls (I already had 50 extra balls to add to the 24 that came with this product).      I highly recommend this product for the fun factor, BUT you certainly need to take the size of this bouncer into consideration before buying it. It isn't something you want to blow up and take down often.  I wouldn't recommend buying it, if you are unsure if you have a good place to keep it that your kids can get to easily and isn't in your way.    (Edit: After writing my original review, my son started jumping into his castle without using the doorway.  Do not let your kids use the outside of the walls to dive onto or climb over, if you want this product to last!!!  There is a hole in the wall and it deflated, even though the base is completely inflated.  It is probably going to be a major pain to locate and repair the hole.  It has been stored away for a while, but I am going to get it out and try to repair it because I know the kids will have a blast with it.)

product_title: Hasbro Star Wars Darth Vader Voice Changer
review_body:
I just bought this helmet for my nephew. At first I was very impressed about how real it looks, the \\"Vader breathing\\", etc. But if you look at the name of this toy, it reads in BIG capital letters \\"VOICE CHANGER\\" as if it was it's main thing. However there's a little problem. The voice changer does it's job but at a VERY LOW VOLUME. The actual voice of the kid sounds twice as loud as the toy's. They can't hear it loud enough to go \\"wow, I sound like Darth Vader\\". That's because the speaker is located in the chest part of the toy (far from the kid's ears) and not in the actual helmet. They hear their own voice and an extra little changed voice in the background.

If you still gotta have the helmet, it's GREAT. But if the \\"Voice Changer\\" is the main thing you're looking for, then you might wanna wait till they do an improved version.

They should place speakers in the helmet too so the the kids can hear their changed voice.

FOR ADULTS TOO!!!! This toy can be adjusted for diffrent sizes. I tried it on and it couldn't fit better. I'm even considering buying one for me too.

product_title: Prima Pappa Rocking High Chair - Tan Leatherette
review_body:
I have the non-rocking version of this high chair. I agree with the other reviews that it looks nice, and its features are decent (the tray doesn't reach my toddler's chest either, so there is a big gap over the lap), but I detest cleaning it. I don't agree at all that it's easy to clean. Wiping down after a meal may be easy, but the periodic \\"spring cleaning\\" is awful. If you like things really clean--this chair is difficult to keep really clean.

I have no idea how food gets under the seat cover, but it does, and the cover is not so easy to remove or reattach. I had to take parts of the chair apart with a screwdriver to get at the food buildup caught in cracks and hard to reach places, and there are A LOT of cracks and hard to reach places. I couldn't even get one finger into some of the nooks and crannies to clean. I had to hose those down with the kitchen sprayer. Of course, a high chair doesn't fit into the kitchen sink very well, so water ended up all over the floor. By that point, I wanted to take the whole thing outside and just hose it down. It took around 1-2 hours to clean the whole thing really good.

product_title: Fisher-Price Peek-a-Blocks Press & Go Train
review_headline: Great toy!  My son loves it!
review_body: My dad got this for my son when he was a newborn and from the time he could interact with any toys through now (11 months) he just has loved it.  Very few toys consistently catch his eye but this is one of them.  My daughter, who is 3 also seems to like playing with it.  My son's current favorite thing to do is press it to make it start the music and start moving and then he likes to knock off the blocks and feel where the train parts make the things inside the blocks spin or move.  Hard to explain, but he really is fascinated by it.  A great baby/toddler toy!  :)

product_title: Koala Baby Musical Mobile - Locomotion
review_headline: dangerous---hook broke off and mobile fell on baby
review_body:
We bought this when our baby was born (6 months ago, only used it a few times until recently). He loves it now to get him to sleep. The problem lies in that at 4 am, my husband and I awake to hear the mobile playing...scares us to death since no one else should be around to start it. We go into the nursery and our child is holding it playing with the animals....the clip that holds the umbrella part had broken off, causing the mobile to fall on the baby. (He thought it was the funniest thing in the world, he was okay, thank God.) But the little plastic hook piece was in his hand. If you have a 6-month old child you know that they eat everything they can find. I thank God that he didnt put that in his mouth. It is a great soother for the baby, but be sure there are no defects every day!

Like I said before, other than this, it has been great.

product_title: Rare Playskool Halfpipe Highway
review_body: I really like the speedway.  My grandchildren (four and up) find it easy to use.  There are no batteries!  Hurray!

product_title: LeapFrog Learning Table
review_headline: Need to Ship these out faster or offer money back.
review_body: I ordered this on a Thursday to arrive by Monday as a Birthday gift for my nephew for his first birthday.  It took over a week and a day to just ship it out. Don't believe the info on the web site that says it will ship out in one day. I paid for the faster shipping hoping to get it to him for the day after his birthday but this will only be a very belated birthday gift. Haven't even had a chance to see the product, normally Amazon has not dissapointed me but this time around I am not too happy.  Then even if you try to contact someone at Amazon, good luck, there is no customer service anywhere to be found, the help system stinks and just runs you in circles.  Hope this product is the best thing since sliced bread, it will be like pulling teeth for me to order products from Amazon again.

product_title: Namco Ms. Pac-Man Plug & Play with 5 TV Games
review_body: I picked mine up at Wal-Mart for $12 on a post-Thanksgiving sale.  Haven't had any joystick problems, and the games are pretty much just as I remember them.  Good cheap nostalgic fun.

product_title: Pavilion Table Soccer Game
review_body:
I really can't believe how much they charge for such a poorly assembled toy. This is by far the worst toy I've ever purchased for my son. He hated it. Apparently, the item breaks easily because one of the heads had fallen off during the shipment...and the package arrived in immaculate condition.

I wanted to get something my son could play on a table top, but this toy is worthless. It's unstable and flimsy. I've gotten toys in Cracker Jack boxes that were better!

I gave this toy one star only because zero isn't possible.

Don't waste your time or money.

product_title: Triumph 5 Comfort Touch Car Seat with LATCH - Rockefeller
review_body: We purchased this seat when our daughter was 4 months old.  We thought it was a little difficult to install.  I dislike that you have to take it all apart if you need to wash the padding.  Our daughter was also able to tear a hole in the back side of the padding and had a handful of stuffing ready to stuff in her mouth!!  My sister-in-law had to do some sewing and modify that backside of the padding to prevent further ripping.  I would probably not purchase this car seat again.  My daughter also seems uncomfortable when she is in it.

product_title: Musical Mobile - Paloma
review_headline: Beautiful but can not mount on the wall
review_body: This item is truly beautiful as other reviewers have said, however, it lacks one very important thing.  Unlike several other mobiles it can not be mounted on the wall once baby starts to pull-up in the crib.  My daughter is so unhappy because we had to take it out of her crib.

product_title: Polly Pocket Snow Cool Hotel Playset
review_body: The toy looked cute.  My five year old was eager to play with it.  Only to have it fall apart on her everytime she tried using it.  I forsee this peice of junk being donated or in a garage sale in the near future and she only got it yesterday for xmas!!!  BIG DISAPPOINTMENT!

product_title: Fisher-Price: Doodle Pro - Red
review_body: I have an 18-month-old girl and she's very smart and I really wanted her to start drawing and to start developing her writing skills, so I desided to buy the Basic Doodle Pro: Purple. It's great, she loved it, she didn't want to let go of it, it was easy for her to use and she really liked the stampers. I am very happy with this toy, because I know it will help her with her fine motor skills and especially because I know it will not make a mess or dirty anything around. I truly recommend this toy to any parent, it's a must have.

product_title: Eddie Bauer 3-In-1 Elite Convertible Car Seat - Ballard
review_body: I received 2 of these Eddie Bauer 3-in-1 seats for my shower off my registry (Manchester tan color), and thought I was receiving a great seat.  Safety wise, I do recommend them, they are a bit bulky, but my 7 1/2 month seemed comfortable in it (he outgrew his infant carrier).  The trouble started when I tried to remove the infant headrest - the manual fails to mention that you need to remove the plastic grommets, which I couldn't even get out with a screwdriver.  I had to rip them out, and was lucky the fabric did not rip.  Once I had my son in the seat, the straps were always stuck underneath him, and he cried as I tried to adjust them, they also tangled.  The worst part was the 'puzzle' part that snaps into the seatbelt, I was drenched in the rain trying to line up the puzzle straps! On top of it all, my husband and I could never tighten the harness enough, so my son was just sitting in the seat loose! Then, reading forward in the manual, in case I wanted to wash it, the whole seat needs to come apart, including the booster part, just to remove the cover!  It is just not practical for a mother to spend this much time trying to harnes her child in.  I returned both and bought the Britax Marathon - what a difference!  The seat cover even has velcro on the sides so that the straps can be attached there, and not left lying on the seat!  The cover is held on by elastic, so much easier to remove!  Strapping my son in is a breeze - WELL worth the extra money!

product_title: Barbie "Jam with Me" Electronic Guitar
review_headline: The songs are not age appropriate for the toy
review_body: My daughter's grandfather bought this guitar for her.  He only looks at the \\"For ages 4+\\" part, so he thought it was a good choice.  I think it's a cute toy, although it has no real redeeming qualities.  But it's fun and a kick to watch her pretend with it.  But I do have a problem with the song selections, with lyrics like \\"I'm not that innocent\\" from Brittney Spears and \\"I look but I don't touch\\"!!  I don't really think it's approriate for 4 year olds, and as one other reviewer stated, by the time girls are 7 it's a boring toy.  Not that those songs are for 7 year olds either.  So, I'm a bit disappointed and frustrated that I am going to have to deal with her frustration when I get rid of the song cards.

product_title: Little Tikes Variety Climber with Swing Set Extension
review_body: We bought this for our 22 month old daughter and she just loves it.  We replaced one of the swings with a toddler swing and she is just in heaven.  We were going to go with a wooden play set but then I saw this one.  It is really durable and very safe for her even at this young age.  I think that it will be something she loves for a good 3-5 years.  We have a 7 month old as well and he likes to swing too.

product_title: Bratz Big Babyz Doll - Cloe
review_body: My 5 year ol got this for her b-day.  The pig-tails pop off her head easily, and under her way to short hoochie mama skirt, she was wearing a black see through mesh thong!!!  This toy is obviously not meant for any child who has morals and values.

product_title: Hot Wheels Fireball
review_body: My 7-year-old got this as a birthday gift.  He loves it.  Now for the details:  Adult assembly is essential.  The instructions are awful.  If your track is falling apart, go back and check your connections.  Take the time to get the track connected the right way, it won't come loose no matter how hard you try.  Next, don't buy this for 3-5 year olds.  It is for 8 to 10 year olds.   They won't get so close that they get hurt when the cars fly off the track.  Lastly, it IS noisy.  But, sorry parents, kids don't care how noisy a toy is.  Send them outside so they can enjoy it and you can keep your sanity.

product_title: Dora the Explorer: My Talking Friend Diego
review_body: My boys ages 2 and 4 love GO DIEGO GO!! However we cannot find the toy anywhere!! FISHER PRICE please make more DIEGO dolls everyone wants one!!!$$$$ Jen Cortlandt Manor, NY

product_title: ThinkFun Zingo (Discontinued by manufacturer)
review_body: My daughter got this game for her 3rd birthday.  She and her 4-year-old sister love to play this game daily!!  Now I am buying more to give as birthday gifts to friends/family.

product_title: Speedway Storage Chest
review_body: Please email me the site to order this with cheaper shipping.  This is exactly what I need for my daughter.  I would greatly appreciate any information anyone can give me.  mclark@numail.org

product_title: 9' x 26" Simple-Set Pool with Filter
review_body:
make absolute sure that whatever you put it on is completely flat. Set up was easy - even WITHOUT DIRECTIONS since ours didnt come with any, and I had to set it up by staring at it and winging it. Draining it takes forever. ladies, If you have acrylic nails, have someone who doesnt have them help out, otherwise its totally frustrating.

The kids LOVE this pool. It is alot of fun once its up and ready, and so far seems to be durable.

product_title: Excalibur Talking Gin Rummy
review_headline: Gin Rummy Game has some flaws
review_body: I bought this Gin Rummy game to replace one from Radio Shack that I wore out, and they don't make anymore.  This game has only a few different hands, and repeats them over and over.  It does not take long to memorize them and know exactly what the score will be and who will win each hand.  Also, it sometimes will not let you win when you have a winning hand.   For example, in one hand I had 4 10's and 8,9,J,Q&K OF the same suit.  It would not allow the 10 of that suit to be played in the straight.  Itstead, it kept it with the other 3 10's to make a set of 4.  Therefore, the 8 & 9 were not playable when it should have been.  Also, I would prefer to keep the sound off all them time, but this game requires you to turn the sound off each time a new game begins.

product_title: Little Tikes 8-in-1 Adjustable Playground (Colors May Vary)
review_body: Well, my husband and I are half way through assembly of this product.  I disagree completely with the 30 min assembly as we have inveseted 1.5 hours already.  Both of us are strong and capable of following directions. (I assembled all of our baby gear alone, incl. the crib at 7 mths pregnant with no problem.)  The instructions make assembly seem as easy as snapping together, but the pieces are a lot harder to fit than we thought.  I do feel that my 1 yr old will be safe playing because of this difficulty.  Sometimes too easy equals shoddy.  However, we will try the Pam or WD-40 and maybe add my dad to help out.  (...)

product_title: Fisher-Price Learning Patterns Rocker
review_body: I received this rocker at my baby shower. It was the greatest gift.  My one month old spends most of her time vibrating herself to sleep in it. Whenever she gets fussy, and my husband and I just don't know how to settle her down anymore, we put her in the rocker, turn on the vibrating seat, and she off to dreamland. If she still fusses, then we just rock her in it for a few minutes and she's good. This is by far the best gift we received. I will definitely buy this for the next baby shower that I attend.

product_title: Painted Puzzle Storage Case with 4 Puzzles
review_body:
This is a super value. It includes the four most popular puzzles that children like to play with most. This is a good way to teach children new words to things and to think logically.
Every child should own the best wooden puzzles, and this deal is very hard to beat.

product_title: Baby Annabell
review_body: I love this doll it act's just like a real baby. You can feed it Chang it And play with it i give it 5*'s

product_title: Marvel HeroClix Infinity Challenge Starter Set
review_headline: Finally! Miniatures the Mighty MARVEL Way!
review_body:
What a terrific little game. I'm a happily retired Magic the Gathering gamer who still loves play from time to time. Now that Heroclix is here, my Magic stuff is going to collect lots and lots of dust.
If you're a big fan of the Marvel Universe, then hold on to your web shooters! This game simply rocks! It takes minutes to learn straight from the box (the rules can be a bit confusing at times, but you'll have it down pat after a few games). It has collectability, a great design, and limitless stategy. This means big time replay value.
If there's one main gripe, it's the fit and finish of the product. Some of the dials don't \\"click\\" easily, and forcing it will lead to breakage. The paint job on some of the characters is also blah. And what's up with the look of some of the characters: Boomerang? Elektra?
Take my advice folks. Put away the Magic cards, the Yugi Oh-No cards, the ridiculously high maintenance \\"other\\" miniatures, and run (don't walk), RUN to your nearest game store. Heroclix is THE game to play!
By the way, I gave the educational value a 5. Why? Becuase I feel that ANY game that invloves strategy, mathematics, team work and memory selection is beneficial to anyone who participates. More importantly, is enhances social skills by promoting healthy debate/dialogue. Games, like comic books, are brain food. Let our kids do both!

product_title: Fisher-Price Deluxe Jumperoo
review_body: This is the best investment you can make. You might think that's a lot of money to put toward one toy but it's more than worth it. As your baby grows you can adjust the legs so he can bounce better.  We bought the Jumperoo when Isaiah was 4 months old. It took me about 30 minutes to put together. As soon as we put him in it he started jumping and got the biggest smile on his face.  We laughed and watched him play in it for about an hour. Yesterday he turned 5 months old and every morning he can't wait to get into it for his morning exercise. Everytime he jumps he just stares at the lights and the music. That is worth every penny.

review_body:
My mother-in-law bought it for my son's 8th birthday. Apparently my wife played with Shrinky dinks alot growing up; so did I but didn't know they were back. I wasn't sure if he'd like it, and that perhaps it would find its way into my 10 year old daughters toy chest. Well, he loved it and the Simpsons kit that grandma also bought him. He opened it up at his birthday party and all the kids got a kick out of it. I actually had to run to our local mall (I always get these errands!) to buy more refill kits as his friends wanted to make shrinky dinks too. I ended up picking up the MONSTERS INC kit and a couple basic ones. They went quickly. My wife and I got a bit nostalgic watching them(I remember shrinking Spiderman as a kid!) and I was thrilled to see my kids cutting and coloring for a change and not in front of the TV.
I think this is the first toy besides our PlayStation that my son and daughter have enjoyed playing with together.Great gift for girls AND boys!!

review_body: My daughter got this for christmas last year and all the thing does is fall apart and break.  It is very frustrating for her when she is playing with it.  Not a good product at all don't buy this toy.

product_title: STAR WARS Epic Duels Game
review_body: I have only played this game two times and my friend owns it, but I already think it's one of the best games I have played to date. A good mix of strategy, luck, and skill. Don't be fooled by the picture next to the title, this is not a flashy game for toddlers. Although easy to learn (I learned it in about four minutes), the combinations of characters, good and evil, from   Episodes I, II, VI, V, and VI will keep you playing, with friends and family, all night long!

product_title: Star Wars: Episode 2 Darth Vader (Bespin Duel) Action Figure
review_body:
This is probably one of the weakest Darth Vader figures Hasbro has ever produced. I bought it sight unseen, since Amazon had no image up at the time I ordered it. The figure replicates the scene from the end of The Empire Strikes Back, where Vader offers his hand to Luke on the catwalks of Bespin.
Pro: The catwalk prop is cool; it comes with detatchable beams that Vader can slice through with his Lightsaber. They even have a cool-looking \\"Scorched\\" effect to them. Very nice!
Cons: (Yes, plural...)- Vader is too skinny; The body is out of proportion with the head. The wind-blown cape looks nice, but the Lightsaber slash is useless with the cape on, since you can't get to the button. But that's not really a problem, since it's practically impossible to keep the cape on in the first place. As in all of the other new figures, the magnet is too weak to really do much unless the Lightsaber is almost in the figure's hand to begin with, but since Vader's hand is open, it does work better than most. The figure looks nice, if posed exactly like in the movie scene, but otherwise, it's not much fun. There are better Vader figures to be had, but the ones out now are not so hot. The best, in my opinion, is the one Hasbro issued around the time Phantom Menace was in Theaters.

review_body:
My husband and I used this \\"swim sweater\\" this summer for our 3 1/2 year old and our 2 year old. It did NOT, as another reviewer feared, fall off, as you might expect by looking at the picture. review_body: Our three year old received this for a gift for Christmas.  My husband and I have played it many, many times with our 5 and 3 year old. review_headline: NewWave Plastic Gargoyles for the office
review_body:
This is a fun poseable model right out of the box.
I have two guarding the entrance to my office like new-wave gargoyles. The bricks fit together well and are strongly joined where the limbs articulate. My 4 and 7 year old nieces thought my new \\"pets\\" were a lot of fun. They said it was \\"like playing barbies, but you can bend these more\\". They did tend to \\"break\\" the models by trying to twist them in ways that the joints didn't allow, but the 7 year old got the knack by the end of the night and was actually looking at how the limbs moved so she could rotate them as she wanted without popping the joints apart. Fair warning, large sections of these models are preformed and can't really be adjusted much. Still, I can see some way so \\"tying into\\" what is here and adding some details if you wanted. Me, I am more-or-less considering them completed sculptures at this time and not really trying to modify them at all.

product_title: Lord of the Rings Armies of Middle Earth; Men of the Rohan Army Figure Set 1/24 Scale
review_headline: Men of Rohan, this is your hour!
review_body:
Another in the latest additions to PlayAlongs great Lord of the Ring figures line, Armies of Middle Earth, the Men of Rohan now enter the great field already inhabited by those from the Gift set, The Helms Deep Playset, and the Riders set. In this great set, you get a Rohan Soldier, Rohan Standard Bearer, and a Rohan Archer.
As noted in my other reviews about the line, do have a care with regards to the wee ones in purchasing these figures. The acoutrement of small swords, knives, spears, or standards may not be suitable for those under five. Also, as noted, many of the details such as the arrows and spears are quite fragile, as the plastic that they are made from is a stiffer blend.
The Rohan soldier comes with a very palpable ax. He has minimal arm and waist movement, and his shield is not removable. The Rohan Standard Bearer, clearly the leader of the trio also has minimal arm and waist movement, but some minimal head movement as well. His shield is also not removable, but his standard, complete with the requisite symbol of the Rohirrim, stands beautifully in his hand. The Rohan archer, a welcome surprise to this set, comes with just elbow (the drawing hand) and waist movement, but his bow is removable.
Each of these great men are painted to the outstanding details of which the line is known for, clearly making use of metallics, drybrushing, and colors that do justice to the fine details.
This set is clearly not only a great set to receate the battles of Middle Earth, but also to outfit your Helms Deep playset, as any good castle should be. Since the weapons are removable on some and the poses not all confrontational, this should please those who look to make imaginitive play and scenarios...

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Aquarium Cradle Swing
review_body:
C'mon people- we're talking about your precious children! I don't even have any (yet!), but I bought one of these swings for my living room as a constant reminder of my desire to bear children one day. Sometimes it can be very depressing, wondering if the swing will ever be enjoyed by my own (future) flesh 'n blood. I'm against adoption as well as artificial insemination, so my Knight in Shining Armor will have to make a grand, sweeping entrance soon! (I'm loathe to admit it, but I have entered middle-age.)

I can safely say, this Cradle Swing is very durable and sturdy. The workmanship is nearly flawless- especially considering they're mass-produced! I really question any parent that would balk at the price, as their child would almost certainly love it!

product_title: Ocean Wonders Aquarium Bouncer
review_headline: Diminishing water level, but Fisher-Price is awesome
review_body:
I have bought a lot of Fisher-Price products for my 5 month old daughter, and I do have to say, if there is any problem they will fix it no charge, asap. The bouncer was the first thing we got, and after 2 months of use, the water level in the toy bar started diminishing. Last week I called to ask if there was any way to refill it, and they said they would just send me a new one. That's it. No sending them the item first, or even after.
Their policy is, if it is still usable, donate it. Broken? Throw it away. Awesome. Hands down one of the best companies to buy from. Sassy was also very accomadating with damaged items. Carter's sucks.

product_title: Harry Potter and the Sorcer's Stone Gryffindor Harry
review_headline: a collector's item more than a toy?
review_body:
I have most of the \\"action\\" figures from the Harry Potter sequence. The students are all about 5 ins tall, and surprisingly well made and detailed for the [money] that they cost. They look like the actors in the Warner Bros. film, down to costume and accessories, which is good or not-so-good depending on your point of view (Harry's glasses are silver rather than black). Let me repeat, however: the quality of design and materials is really very good.
Despite being action figures, there is a limited range of positions you can make them assume, mostly because they do not always balance steadily on their own two feet. Hermione, for instance, keels over every time I touch my desk.
The accessories are pretty good. This Harry has a wand and a neat Hedwig. The trouble is, these small bits can get detached from the figure very easily and misplaced. For this reason, I wonder whether the figures are more useful as actual toys to be used by children (not very small children, mind) or as collector's items for HP-obsessed teenagers and adults -- which is why I own them!
Each figure comes with a little trick coin and a token that can be used with the manufacturers' wand duel game to create different effects (which I haven't yet tried).

review_body: I bought this for my 8 month old son thinking he would love it. The first thing I did was put it in the middle of the floor. He went over, pulled himself up on it and the table moved from under him and he fell on the floor. Not at all sturdy enough for him to pull himself onto. Even when he's standing holding onto it, it moves across the floor. I pushed this up against the wall and the entertainment center and it works better. The activities aren't very interesting and my son gets bored with this within a minute. The only thing he likes is to chew on the blocks. I wish I would have saved my money. I like FisherPrice toys, but was very disappointed with this.

product_title: Lego 3402 Grandstand With Lights Set
review_body: Small, cheap, fun.  Only a true Lego product has all three.  This toy has all three.  Its larger cousin, the Grandstand with Scoreboard, goes well with it.  Connect the two together with other Lego Soccer sets for the family sports fan, be it you, your significant other, your mother, your father, or any other relation.  I also highly recommend this set to unleash your creative side.  ANYTHING IS POSSIBLE!

product_title: 1 X Crayola Sand Picture Art
review_body: My 4 year old daughter was given this toy for her birthday.  Peeling the stickers off in the manner required is impossible for me, much less alone her.  The lines peel up and this causes the picture to look incomplete.  After doing the first picture our release button got stuck open and no amount of manipulation could fix it.  Therefore, when you shake the box, the sand now comes out all over the place.  The idea that you could ever \\"release\\" the sand back into the little bottles, even with the funnel is ridiculous.  Due to static electricity you can never really get all the sand out of the box so you don't always get true colors.  The only part of this activity my 4 year old can do is pouring the sand on.  Thanks to the broken release button she can't even do the shaking.  There are only six pictures included and as far as I can see there are no ways to purchase more, which at this point, I am thankful for!  I would expect much better from Crayola.  Save your money, your frustration and your home from turning into a beach and try another craft project!

product_title: Original Crib Tent
review_body: I bought this item for my 23 month old daughter.  Going into a toddler bed was just not an option at that time.  Now I know that she is safe and secure while I am downstairs. review_body: My 6 and 8 y.o.'s really like this toy.  Both boys and girls enjoy it.  It was quick and easy to assemble and is sturdy.  The required light bulb was included.  We have not had a problem with pegs falling out.  Having 4 sides to work on is great so more than one child can work at a time.  They can save their work while doing new pictures.  I think the 8 y.o. younger age limit others have mentioned may be due to the fact that this toy must be plugged in and uses electricity.  I just have my kids tell me when they are ready for it to be plugged or unplugged.  I recommend this toy.

product_title: Ex Kiddio Supertrike 1
review_body: We bought this for our son when he was 2 1/2 and it was the only one we could find to fit his short little legs! Any trike is going to be educational because it teaches the leg movement they need to ride a bike and the steering ability. This bike is so durable! I'd say he actually outgrew this bike at about 4 yrs old, but he's still riding it and he'll get a new big boy bike for his birthday next month!
