product_title: Jungle Gym Jump O Lene
review_body: We received the jump o lene as a gift.  We had no room for it inside our small house, so we put it outside.  It doesn't fit through a doorway, so we had to blow it up outside and leave it outside.  It filled with rainwater, dirt, and dead bugs.  It faded in the sun (we have little shade), and made our yard look like a circus was in town.  My son was scared of it and would not use it.  In the winter we stored it in our small garage, and had to partially deflate it.  It was always in the way.  We sold it at a rummage sale for $$$, and I couldn't be happier.  If you have a place where you can keep it and use it indoors, then it might work out for you, but make sure that the area is well padded.  You might also want to get an air pump.  Definitely NOT an item to give as a gift without checking with the receipient's parents first.

product_title: Beyblades American Hasbro Draciel S A-14
review_body: This top is the grip attackers worst nightmare! It can litterly nock of the grip attackers bit chip. It can nock off any bit chip if you launch it right.

product_title: Deluxe Baby Boat Color Yellow
review_body: We received this float as a gift and have been using it steadily for the last 3 months. Our daughter is 9 and a 1/2 months old and very active, but so far we haven't had any problems with it tipping over as other reviewers have mentioned. The boat did finally spring a leak, however, but ... extremely heavy usage (we leave it at the semi-public pool where we swim every day, and other kids use it when we're not there, so it gets used A LOT), I don't think it's too unreasonable that it needs to be replaced after 3 months. We just purchased another one and would absolutely recommend it to others.

product_title: Barbie CRUISE SHIP Playset w Child Size CAMERA Activates Tropical SOUNDS! (2002)
review_body: My daughter had received this for a gift, luckily I hadn't purchased it. The top front part of the ship does not hold on tight enough. And there really isn't too much to do with it. My daughter was expecting more from it. I also thought that there were some kind of beverages and cups and things that you were supposed to get, did not see them in the box. For a Barbie product, I really am not impressed.

product_title: PEEK-a-Blocks 2-in-1 Activity Wagon
review_body: My daughter received this wagon when she was just 5 months old for Christmas. At first she just played with the blocks, but now that she is 10 months old she loves the wagon. She has not pinched her fingers in the wheel and she loves looking at all the blocks! Yes, the music can get annoying to me (so many of her toys play music) however, she LOVES it and dances to it constantly!! We have since purchased almost all of the other peek-a-block sets and she loves them all.

product_title: Graco Out Ridder Doll Stroller
review_body: I bought this product for my 18 month old granddaughter. She loves to take her favorite teddy for a walk. It is light weight and easy for her to maneuver. She diligently Velcro's the seat strap to ensure the bear's safety. The canopy and package holder add to the realism and play value.

product_title: Solid Wood Folding Cribbage Set (Styles Will Vary)
review_headline: Good game, but there are better boards
review_body: Cribbage is a classic game of strategy and mathematics, great for all ages.  However, this is just a basic board.  Its only advantages are the price and that it has three tracks so you can play with three people instead of just two or four.  It is pretty cheaply made, with plastic pegs and painted-on tracks.  There are much more beautiful boards out there, many with additional scoring features if you really get into playing Cribbage.  You can even make your own board, and any deck of cards will work.  Bottom line: okay starter board for beginners.

product_title: Silly Golf
review_body: This game should be a huge hit.  My two sons, ages three and six, love golf and are always 'practicing'.  They wanted this for Christmas and were thrilled when it was under the tree.  Unfortunately, the excitement ended there as the green does not stay together - it didn't the first day and it has not improved.  We are all frustrated with the construction and find playing 'silly' golf impossible.

product_title: Mayfair The Settlers of Catan Board Game
review_body: CAREFUL! You may not want to stop playing this game once you start. It takes a little while to understand some of the strategy, but once you're into it, there's no going back. We've introduced quite a few friends to this game and most (not all) really enjoy it. If you like strategy and fierce competition, this one is for you.

product_title: LeapFrog Learning Table
review_body:
My ten month old daughter loves this table! She loses interest in her other toys pretty quickly, but she plays with this table all day! It helped her learn how to pull herself up and stand up assisted and alone. Now she's starting to walk already and I think that this table had a lot to do with helping her. There's a lot of music and lights on the top of the table to keep her interest. She likes banging on everything and having it all light up at once and make a bunch of noise. She's been playing with this table since about seven months - and she doesn't show any signs of getting bored with it. I'm so glad that I bought this table for her! It's very durable and very easy to clean off - I just use a soapy sponge to go over everything.
The price on amazon.com is pretty reasonable too! I paid two dollars more for it when it was on sale at walmart! So amazon definitely has a good buy on it!
I recommend this toy for any little girl or boy!

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Aquarium Cradle Swing
review_body:
We really love this swing! We started using this the first week our son was born and it calms him immediately. He loves both the swinging and the cradle motions. The music and water sounds are very relaxing. If it wasn't for this swing, I could never get any housework done!
My only problem was by the time he was interested in the mobile,it made an awful noise, and wouldn't turn! I called Fisher Price today and they are sending a new motor, free of charge.

product_title: Toybiz Lord Of The Rings Return Of King 11" Deluxe Poseable Legolas Figure
review_body: Finally! I got the 12 inch Legolas last year and was very dissapointed. He was fat,ugly, and had YELLOW hair! Now for half the price I got a 100 times better figure! This Legolas is amazing. He looks EXACTLY like Legolas from the movie(played by Orlando Bloom). His hair is plastic, but its very nice and looks very real. The 12\\" Legolas was supposed to have real hair but Toybiz made last minute changes and make it plastic and blowing in the wind. This 11\\" one is better because if you can't have \\"real\\" hair, this is the next best thing! It is rotocast which means it is hollow inside and not filled with heavy plastic. Making it easier to play with and much lighter. His weapons are very nice. Daggers fit in both hands, bow is right size and fits very well in hand, arrows were a bit warped but no big deal. My only complaint would be that you can't move his right arm up and down at the elbow joint. It only moves around. For only 10 dollars this is a amazing deal. Do not waste your money on the 12\\" version. Get this figure it is high in detail,quality, and fun! Thanks for reading my review! (For a longer review and pictures go to [...]  his website has very nice reviews and awesome pictures!)

product_title: Beyblade Dranzer-S Combination Type A-2 Classic
review_body: This used to be the best beyblade there is, but now there is other beyblades like Master Dranzer and Master Draciel which kinda out-class it, but this beyblade is definately one of the best beyblades there is. A word of advice though, keep it in endurance mode cuz in attack mode its rubbish. The only thing thats bad about this blade is its durability, mine broke 18 days after i got it and its now in the rubbish bin.

product_title: Barbie Kitty Fun
review_body:
Blonde is much funner then Mashmellow the cat. She is very preatty
when you dress her up in dresses. She is also lots of fun to play
with. This is a really fun toy. I recamend this 5 stars. Blonde is the funnest part of this toy.

product_title: GeoTrax Tracktown Railway
review_body:
Our son received the train set for Christmas and loves it. We have added to it several times. He just had his birthday(He's a Leap day boy) and he now has almost all the additional pieces. We had set the train up in the corner of the living room for the kids to play with during the party and it was a huge hit. We know at least 3 of the adults at the party that are planning to purchase the set for their children or grandchildren.
Our son who is 4 has played for hours at a time setting up and resetting up the train. This is quite an accomplishment for the toy because his attention span is limited to short spurts generally. It's been a grand help for us as we are currently remodeling and it allows us to get more done while he is occupied.
We had to get a big bin to allow the set to be mobile to go to grandmas when she babysits.
We highly recommend this set.

product_title: Ello Creation System Fairytopia People, Places & Things Set
review_body: This set is great. My daughters (7 and 10) love playing with it together.  My only wish is that there were more of the flat peices so that they could each build a house of their own.  We'll be buying another set to remedy that situation! All of the pieces are easy to assemble, and appear to be quite durable even when the house was stepped on by a rowdy 7 year old birthday girl!

product_title: Fisher Price Twirlin' Whirlin Garden
review_headline: My 5 yr. old even loves it!
review_body: My 6 month old got this for Christmas and she loves it!  The music is a little loud, but she is fascinated by the colors and movement.  My 5 yr. old son loves to play this with her too! He says his favorite part about it is being able to build up the flowers on the spinning discs. Also, the Denmark reviewer stated that there was not an off button. I discovered that the blue button behind the lights turns the music on AND off.  When you're finished listening to the music, hit the blue button once to turn off.  Great toy!

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Aquarium Cradle Swing
review_body: This swing is fantastic. After my son was brought home he would only go to sleep in the car or if he was rocked and with you. I had to wait about 3 weeks before I could get this swing and during that time I lost a lot of sleep. My son has always slept through the night but would wake up after about 5 hours to eat a little and go back to sleep. If you moved him he started screaming. After we got this swing he hasn't had a bad night since. I gave it only 4 stars because it eats batteries bad. I wish there was a way Fisher Price would make it able to plug in but it's a small price to pay when I look at my son smiling and talking to mobile-which isn't really that loud. It's perfect for my son but I can understand why some people would think it was loud. All in all it's a great swing-has to be the best one out there

product_title: Count Dooku Lightsaber Electronic Attack of the Clones Star Wars E2
review_body:
I bought this and the Anakin Lightsaber at the same time. At first, I was unsure at how I would be able to fight with the curved handle, as well as it looking a little silly. But once I tried it, I loved it! The knob at the end allows you to swing it around in your hand with ease. It's unique \\"pistol\\" shape makes for an unexpected ease of change between a parry, and a slash. This was a pleasent suprise!
One thing I noticed about the sounds, On Dooku's, the charge up noise has a higher pitch than Anakin's, but the ambient \\"hum\\" is lower when compared to Anakin's. The \\"crash\\" sounds remain the same however. Cool! Unique FX!
I wish the light shaft wasn't so transparent though, it would make the beam look more solid.
These lightsabers are a great toy for the young, or just young at heart. They sound just like the movie, and look great in the dark.

product_title: Neurosmith Music Blocks Jumpin' Jive Jazz Cartridge
review_body: THE TUNES ARE VERY SHORT AND DO NOT START UP IMMEDIATELY WHEN BLOCK IS TURNED OR BANGED ON.

product_title: LeapFrog Hug & Learn Baby Tad Plush
review_body: Hi Baby Tad is Great my 3&1/2 month old love's him she holds his hand and press's it her self the volume control is in his back under the velcrow.  Baby Tad lights up and she love's that she follows the lights and wants to grab them. This is the best toy I ever bought.

product_title: Ocean Wonders Aquarium Bouncer
review_body: I could not possibly get along without this bouncer.  I use it EVERYWHERE, and I have used it since day 1.  It is great for when I take a shower.  After my husband went back to work I was hesitant about taking a shower with no one to watch the baby, and the bouncer was my answer.  It is small enough to fit in our tiny bathroom, and all I have to do is pop my head out to check on the baby.  I then take it into the bedroom with me so that I can finish getting ready.  I feel comfortable getting ready, because I know that she is saftely straped into the bouncer opposed to laying on the bed.  It also keeps her in a more upright position so that she can see me while I am getting ready.  It is a great help whether I'm fixing supper or folding clothes.  At first she was not interested in the toy bar so I just didn't use it.  Now I put it on sometimes and leave it off sometimes depending on her mood.  My one complaint is that the toy bar made an awful noise when we first got it.  I called Fisher Price and they replaced the part.  We have not had any problems with the toy bar since.  My complaint is mainly in the Fisher Price company itself, because of the four Fisher Price products I have purchased all four have been defective in some way.  If you call Fisher Price they will replace the part for you, but it becomes a hassle to call them everytime I buy one of their products.

product_title: Step2 Art Master Activity Desk for Toddlers - Kids Learning Crafts Table with Chair and Storage - Multicolor
review_body: My daughter got this for her second birthday.  It was fairly easy to put together.  Lots of storage space.  Everything is proportioned right for a smaller child to use.  My daughter has spent hours playing with it.  The side bins are wonderfull for keeping tablets of paper and the nook under the desk top is a great place to keep coloring books.  I have to agree that the light could be better.  This is one of few toys that is fun and has a great kid freindly design.  It will also be something that she will still use for years to come!!!!

product_title: Starry Night Mobile
review_body:
My husband and I received this mobile at our Baby Shower, as we had put it on our baby registry. We were very excited to have received it and it was mounted on our Son's crib long before his arrival! It was easy to assemble (it does have to be tightened with very strong hands), the stuffies are adorable and easy on the eye, and the choice of lullaby's is wonderful. Our Son does prefer one lullaby out of them all...I hear it in my head when it's not even on! lol. As the other reviews stated, after some use the mobile does start "clicking/skipping", BUT after my husband did some "investigating", he removed a white plastic turn dial from the mobile and like magic it works just fine! We love the remote, it allows us to just stick our hand through the door to reach the remote, that we leave sitting on an armoire next to the door, to restart the mobile. Our Son is almost 8 mos. now, and we have used it since he was 1 month old (he slept in a bassinet for 1 month). He can't nap unless it's turned on and he really likes watching the stuffies dance around. The star light show is not used too often anymore, as it "entertains" our Son. We use rechargeable batteries, which I would recommend if you use this mobile frequently throughout the day, and my husband who changes the batteries in this mobile, only complains that there are a lot of screws to undo before reaching the battery compartment...Which isn't neccessarily bad, it's actually really safe. I would higly recommend this mobile...If yours starts clicking, just make that one adjustment and you'll be happy all over gain! It's worth it!
It also turns into a dresser/table mobile which we look forward to using!

product_title: Baby Annabell
review_body: both my daughter's ages 18 months and 6 years love the baby! The younger one really loves how she crys and burbs! Great toy!

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Aquarium Cradle Swing
review_body: This swing is truly a lifesaver. We put my son in it for the first time when he was 2 weeks old and he ABSOLUTELY loved it and still does!!! He prefers the cradle rocking position and without fail, he will fall asleep for hours swinging in that direction every time. He loves looking up at the lighted globe. The music it plays is really nice but this is my only complaint. It only lasts for 3 pretty short songs. My son would sometimes wake up when the music would stop so I would have to run and turn it back on. If the music would play longer or continuously I would rate this swing a 5 instead of a 4. Otherwise, this swing is wonderful - it really doesn't make much noise. Yes, you can hear the quiet motor but it never bothered me, especially when my son would sleep in it for hours at a time, allowing us to get some much needed sleep too! I highly recommend purchasing this swing to all parents of newborns - you and your baby will love it!!!!

product_title: Musini - MagicSensor
review_body: This toy is absolutely addictive -- for all ages.  We got it as a gift for our 4-year-old daughter, and she loves it.  It's a great way for her to \\"go wild\\" in a small space!  But our 11-month-old likes it just as much.  She bops to the music and pushes the buttons.  Did I mention the grownups?  We play with it to, seeing what combinations of music we can produce.  The possibilities seem limitless.

product_title: LeapFrog Learning Table
review_headline: Great Toy!  Just watch those little fingers !!!
review_body:
My son started playing with this toy when he was about 6 months and loves it !!! There are lots of lights, fun music and singing, which has always made him laugh. I think there is probably too much going on for it to be educational, in that it doesn't teach him the \\"abc's\\" or how to count, but I do think it helped teach him cause and effect. Plus it's a lot of fun to watch him play with this.
One warning, though. There's a little \\"book\\" (the editor's review refers to this) in the center of the toy to that baby can flip to change the mode. My son loves to flip this book back and forth, but has left the other hand underneath and has, as a result, pinched his little hand on more than one ocassion.

He has just recently (five months later )begun to tire of all the lights and noise. In infant months, I consider this a healthy life span for a toy (plus I'll pull it out of the closet again in a few months). I believe it was worth the money and space it takes up in your house. Buy it and before you know it you'll be singing all the little jazzy numbers yourself, too !!

product_title: Pacific Play Tents See-Me Connecting Tunnel
review_headline: This along with the Space Dome tent and you're set
review_body: It's too bad the Space Dome tent (ASIN: B00000IURW) is no longer available.  The combination is what makes it fun, that's why I gave the tunnel only 4 stars.  My son loves this tent with this tunnel added on.  He crawls/dives into it when he's feeling a little stressed, and also when he's playing hide & go seek.  Yes, he does kick me out when I try (also if his daddy tries to get in).  If you don't want to see your dining room chairs and blankets used to build a fort (inside and even outside on the lawn!), then get the tunnel with a compatible tent (round openings on the side, zip flap front).

product_title: Leaping Lilypads Game
review_body: My kids and I really had fun playing this game.  It makes for some good quality time together, which most of us don't make time for anymore.  We didn't get bored at all, in fact when my kids friends come over they always want to play it.  So I don't understand the other reviews.  We enjoyed that you can take a chance and keep going.  I would recommend it highly!

product_title: The Hobbit Board Game: Defeat of the Evil Dragon Smaug
review_body:
To call The Hobbit Boardgame a boardgame would be an insult to all boardgames everywhere. It plays as if it were slapped together over a lunchtime and never playtested. The game somehow manages to combine little to no strategic elements with slow gameplay!
I could not think of how to design a worse boardgame than this one, especially associating it with such a valuable and fascinating property as The Hobbit. It is a shame the designers of this game didn't at least play the outstanding Lord of the Rings boardgame. If they did, then they certainly didn't learn anything about good game design or entertaining game play.

product_title: Easy-Bake Oven and Snack Center
review_body: This is a very neat little oven, yes the cakes are small, and the refills are a bit overpriced. I however didn't have a problem getting the light bulb. ... The light bulb also has not burned out within the last 2 years, which is how long the light bulbs been in it. I would like to say DO NOT LEAVE ANYTHING PLASTIC ON THE SHELF wear the pan come out. I left it their for 10 seconds, and it melted, but it was bendeble, so I bent it back into shape.

product_title: Paint N Swirl Art Machine
review_body: My kids in my art class liked this toy until they all got to make more than one swirl art picture and then most of them said that they were getting too bord with this toy. The great thing aabout this toy is that it creates virtually no mess and this toy is very easy to clean up with soap and water. The bad thing about this toy is that it uses up the paint and paper very quickly making it expensive in the long run when you have to purchase paint and paper every 7-16 days. This toy was also not very challenging to the kids and I guess that is why they lost interest very quickly. This toy is great though to use at events such as the Spring carnival we held at my school/work. The kids didn't mind paying $.50 to make a swirl art picture and some kids even came back 2 or 3 times to make another print.

product_title: Disney Sunny Fun For Two Little Ariel Princess Playset doll
review_headline: This Ariel is lovely! She can be "part of your world"!
review_body:
Ariel is very beautiful (well that's obvious, what I meant is this doll is beautiful!), and is made very well. She has lovely red-auburn hair that is long, wavy and luxurious, and she has a cute barrette clipped in. Her eyes are cheery and bright, she just looks adorable!
Ariel comes dressed in her signature yet beautiful mermaid outfit, and her mermaid tail can be removed to reveal a pretty purple swimsuit underneath.
She comes with accessories including a baby Flounder that squirts water,a festive plate that holds two pineapple drinks, two orange pieces, and two strawberry pieces, as well as a purple hairbrush. I wish she came with Sebastian too, oh well.
This Ariel is MUCH nicer and prettier than the color changing Ariel! She is getting harder to find, so it you want her for your little princess or just for yourself, don't wait much longer! She's a decent price, and is worth it for any girl who loves Ariel, young or old (or somewhere in between!).

product_title: Primo Viaggio Infant Car Seat - Synergy
review_body: My spouse and I are Pediatric Chiropractors.  We actually took apart every carseat on display at Babies-R-Us to examine how well they were engineered.  Since an infant's spine will double in length in the first two years alone, excellent support is critical!  The "Primo Viaggio" model was the only "infant carseat" with padding adequate to support a tiny baby's developing spine.  The LATCH system and 5-point restraint are the best available.  We'd choose nothing less for our own baby.

product_title: Leap 2 Reading: Disney & Pixar's "Monsters, Inc."
review_headline: A fun new way to teach reading
review_body: After we saw the Monster's Inc. Movie, my daughter bedded for a book!  It was wonderful when we found out that Leapfrog had developed a book for the leappad.  My daughter has spend hours playing with this book, and playing the games in the book.  It is her favorite leapfrog book.

product_title: Bratz: Flashback Fever! 70's - Sasha
review_body:
This Sasha doll is the most beautiful Sasha dolls that had ever been created!

Sasha's nickname is \\"Bunny-Boo\\" 'cuz she loves the Hip-Hop thang!

Sasha comes to you complete with:

2 Pairs of Snap-On shoes
1 pair of Sunglasses
4 Pairs of Earrings
1 Keychain: Disco ball
1 70's CD
1 Neclace
3 Outfits
1 Furry Black Coat
1 Sasha Card
3 Bracelets
1 Purse

If you are a huge Bratz fan and a huge Sasha fan, like me I would say:\\"Go get this and you won't regret it!\\".

It is a must-have for any Bratz fan or anyone who was born in the year of 70's.

I now have 13 Bratz and 3 Lil' Bratz dolls. I will continue to add more Bratz in my Bratz collection.

(...)

product_title: My Scene Hudson Doll
review_body: My little sister got Hudson for her 9th Birthday even my 2 year old niece Plays w/ it, I dont Know about this other girl but they would have to be doing some pretty serious stuff to the doll, My Niece bangs it on furniture its pretty Durable. And it's also still intacted

product_title: Crayola Fashion Light-Up Tracing Desl
review_headline: My son loves the vehicle version !!!
review_body: Yes, they make a version of this with vehicles to trace and my 6 yr old son loves it!  For some reason the vehicle version is harder to find than the girls' fashion version.  For any boy that loves to draw cars and trucks, this is great.  Also, good for their fine motor skills.

product_title: Just Like Home - Shopping Cart and Basket with 35+ Pieces of Play Food
review_body: I bought this toy for my 2 and 4 yr olds. It fell apart that day. NOT sturdy at all, wheels keep falling off and then the whole thing falls apart. Not a good buy.

product_title: Imaginext Battle Castle With Enemy Dungeon, Medieval
review_body: I think this toy is probably most appropriate for 6 to 9 year olds (if you are looking for something for independent play), but most 4-5 year olds will need considerable assistance or supervision with this toy.  I got this set for my nephew (age 6) and he has played with it for hours.  It's the first thing he goes to play with when he comes to visit at my house.  He always needs help putting Lego sets together, but he has no problems with this set.  He builds and rebuilds in different configurations with ease.  He also tends to be a very active (and somewhat destructive) little boy, but so far he hasn't broken any of the pieces in this set.  I was a little worried when I read some of the other reviews that said it falls apart easily, but we have not had that problem at all (in fact, I sometimes have a little trouble getting the pieces to come apart when it's time to put them away.)

product_title: Power Wheels Harley-Davidson Little Rider
review_body: My 18 month old got this wonderful motorized bike as a gift. Initially, he was a little apprehensive about riding it but liked the buttons and the noise it made. It didn't take long for him to not be afraid of it and now loves it. Even though this is on the heavy side, this is a wonderful toy. I think it's geared more toward older toddlers and small children.

product_title: Hasbro Playskool Lullaby Gloworm
review_headline: Everyone loves Gloworm...but he's a bit loud!
review_body:
I got this Gloworm for my 4 month old baby for Christmas because I loved mine as a child. It's cute and easy for him to activate on his own..but it's quite loud. You definetly can't take it to bed it's a playtime only toy due to how loud the music plays.
It would have been great to have been like the original ones...a little softer and NOT so loud. That's my only complaint. Otherwise, my little Darlin loves it.

product_title: Beyblade Hasbro 37 Master Driger
review_body: I know this blade has alot of problems but its not true ive won 4 trunys with master driger and did not have a problem this blade is good in battal i would give it [4] stars get this blade you wont regret it

product_title: Disney Photomosaic Winnie the Pooh Jigsaw Puzzle 1026pc
review_headline: Don't listen to the other reviews
review_body: These puzzles are great. Yes they are a little challenging, but the reward of finishing one is well worth it. No it's not for young people or old people, it's for EVERYBODY!. They make good family Fun nights. I'm a rather good puzzle builder, so it takes me about a week or two to finish, but on average maybe a month? In a matter of 3 months, my girlfriend and I have completed 6 of them.

product_title: Ocean Wonders Aquarium
review_body: My husband and I bought this toy for our daughter when she was three months old because we were having a really hard time getting her to sleep.  From the first night she would watch the fish swim and listen to the music and bubbles and fall right to sleep.  Now that she is nine months old she has learned to play with the toys and start the lights and music by herself. She plays with it until she falls asleep by herself. It has made a pacifier completely unnecessary.

product_title: Triumph 5 Comfort Touch Car Seat with LATCH - Rockefeller
review_headline: Soooo Comfy!!! Instructions come inside the car seat!!
review_body: Ok, So for all you people like myself looking for carseats for your graduating infant(or not). This is the ideal carseat! Can you say easy to install?? and very comfy. It reclines rear facing which is good when the baby is really small, but it doesn't facing front, but what toddler would want to ride around looking at the ceiling? I would recommend a car seat carrier for young babies. The only tricky thing is the instructions are located on the backside of the cushion in a pocket, where the babies back rests. (Which is neat because if you ever need it you can just pull it out).It says that in fine print on the base of the carseat, Although it was easy to install. I love it, and my son loves it. For the money it's worth. I also noticed in some reviews they had difficulty with the straps. It is rated one of the top safest car seats by the NHSP. So why compromise your child's safety for your convenience?

product_title: Zoids Ultra - Gun Blaster
review_headline: Ammo Wasters, take notice! Your king has arrived!
review_body:
If you think Leena's Gun Sniper from the Zoids anime is an ammo-waster, open your eyes and take a look at the Gun Blaster! This thing has easily 20 BIG guns on its back. It is fairly easy to assemble, a lot easier than the biggest Zoids. It can walk on carpet pretty well, unlike a lot of my Zoids. Three of the guns spin as it walks, but I accidentally detatched the guns once and had to fix them so I'm not sure mine still spin. It's an Ankylosaur-type, so it looks pretty clunky but solid.
If you like dinosaur Zoids (as I do) or ammo-waster Zoids or are just looking for a fairly cheap, impressive-looking Zoid, the Gun Blaster is a worthy choice.

product_title: Transformers: Optimus Prime "Super Base" Action Figure
review_body: this toy is werth your money.if you are looking for a good transformer this is the one to choose.the reason why it is werth the money is because it transforms bye its self and comes with it own miney-con to have a blast with.i also picked it for the super optumis prime.

product_title: Hasbro Beyblade Tops Draciel Defense Type / #32
review_body: This is a somewhat decent Beyblade. From testing this out, it doesn't seem to win too much. On the bright side this is the one that Max from the show uses first, before using Draciel S. product_title: Little Remedies - New Parents Survival Kit
review_body: I am a new mom and I recieved this as a gift.  I love the gas drops, they are a must have.  Also when my 2 mo. old had a cold the doctor recommended nasal drops to be used with an aspirator and it was nice to already have some on hand in my little kit.  The nasal aspirator is worthless, in my opinion, the only one that really gets the job done is the one I got at the hospital (so save that one, you can't find anymore like it).  I have also used the decongestant drops and the nasal gel.  The gel is good for winter time when the heat is running.  But as one of the other mom's already said, so is a humidifier and any saline spray.  I really liked this kit and I am going to buy it for a friend who is having a baby.

product_title: IndyCar Series
review_headline: Lack of Steering Wheel Support A Huge Disappointment!
review_body:
I'm a native of Indianapolis and am a fan of Indianapolis Motor Speedway (IMS) and like PS2 racing games. I enjoy racing around IMS in my PS2 Nascar Thunder and Formula 1 games, so I was very excited about IndyCar Series when it came out and I could race the 230+ MPH vehicles I watched many times in person over the years on the track that I know so well.
But, as other reviewers have noted, there is no steering wheel support for this game (I have the Logitech wheel, which is essentailly the standard for PS2), but I don't think that you would know that from the information on the box for the game. I can imagine the look on my face when I plugged in my wheel and... nothing.
The game plays OK with the standard controller and the graphics and sound are decent, but it just isn't the same as driving with a well-calibrated wheel in your hand. I'll make sure I research my next racing-related product first.

product_title: Monopoly - Star Wars Episode 1 Edition
review_headline: Vwry Cool Version if the Classic Game
review_body: Prior to the introduction of Episode I, I got the Classic Trilogy version for Christmas.  While the Classic version is fine, it is nothing more than a stylized version of the original game.  The Episode I edition has so many cool features that it is almost impossible to remember them all.  The character tokens are quite exceptional; the Deed Cards which are placed on the board at their appropriate lots makes it nearly impossible to lose them.  However, I find the stackable (I'll call them houses and hotels) the best feature.  No more can you accidentally bump the table and scatter the appropriations around the board; they are affixed to the board.  For anyone who enjoys a rousing game of a true classic (whether or not you are partial to the classic that is Star Wars) this is the version to get.  Bring on the Episode II version!!!

review_body:

If they made a better version of this using quality materials, it would be a number one best seller. But for now, buy at your own risk.

product_title: Transformers Energon Optimus Prime Electronic Action Figure
review_headline: Use your money for better toys.
review_body:
As always, it's a good idea not to go with reviews that try and demean the opinions of other reviewers...
This is a mixed toy. Certainly, I'd advise going and finding a picture of it before purchase, because he's not a pretty boy. Not at all. Mishapen and quite tacky, he really looks fairly silly in all his modes. All notion of being a \\"robot in disguise\\" are lost with a vehicle mode that looks more like a math puzzle than a truck (and that with things like painted on windows looks very cheap and tacky). The truck converts into a robot and a base that launches drones. However, the transformation is simplistic and dull, lacking most educational or play value present in other transformers. The base just seems to be the truck trailer on it's side, and the robot really looks rediculous - it's about 90% torso. These are things that will matter to kids and adults alike sadly. The smaller robot then combines with the drones to form a large robot that is better, put doesn't have quite enough articulation to be as fun as it could be.
However, it must be said that it does have some play value, and certainly more than the very poor Armada Optimus Prime. Still, it's hard to recommend. Whatever the age group, there are better transformers out there. There's even a smaller, cheaper version of this toy to be released in future which will likely be better, or the Masterpiece Optimus if you've got plenty of cash.

product_title: My First LeapPad Book: Once Upon a Rhyme
review_headline: Very nice book to add on to My first Leap Pad
review_body:
This book covers 21 nursery rhymes, and is much nicer than the book which goes with the regular Leap Pad. Except for one, the songs are sung by Leap, Tad, or Lily, and the childrens voices are a vast improvement on the quavering high pitched voice on the other book. Nice responses, and games for your toddler -- my 2 1/2 year old really likes the book, and liked to sing along. They can learn about pretending to be a rhyme character, and also learn rhyming words which are highlighted as vocabulary when they point to objects and in the games. As compared to the Mother Goose Songbook, there is no option to listen to just one instrument at a time, or even to an instrument only version, but that is not much missed for a toddler.
4 stars on the durability, since the leap pad as a whole is much too sensitive to be a toddler toy! This one also shuts off if the cartridge is jiggled, though the pen seems slightly sturdier than the green LeapPad, and its great that the flip books snap on to the pad for easier play.

product_title: Jazz Transformers Commemorative Series III Generation One Reissue Action Figure
review_headline: Jazz is great as a model, collectable, or toy.
review_body: I think most people that reviewed this masterpiece of a toy covered all the details. It is evident that the weapons for the hasbro jazz re-issue have been altered significantly (missle launcher and missles are much longer than the original; missles and gun are black instead of the original chrome). However, people fail to mention the most important change of all; the re-design of the mould. You'll notice that, unlike the flawed original version, or even the Japanese takara re-issue of jazz, the hasbro re-issue is a highly polished model. The alignment problem with the roof and back windows is now fixed. In addition, the back windows are not as clumsy and loose as the original/Japanese takara versions. Furthermore, the hasbro jazz re-issue feels much more solid overall, relative to it's clumsy original/Japanese counterpart. If there is one thing that all jazz re-issues share relative to the original, it's the simplistic re-design of the face.  The orignal jazz has a more detailed \\"chiseled\\" look to it's facial structure, especially concerning the chin area.  All hasbro and takara jazz re-issues on the other hand, have a \\"round\\" look to their faces with the chin being almost non-existent!  Despite the differences, the hasbro jazz re-issue is still a must buy even for the most hardcore transfan. Jazz is a great collectors item, display model, or toy; you choose. Definitely an enjoyable toy for adults and kids alike.

product_title: MLB Series 10 Figure: Rafael Palmiero with Black Orioles Jersey
review_headline: Rafael Palmeiro, member of the 500 homer run club
review_body:
Be aware that there are two versions of this MLB Series 10 Figure of Rafael Palmeiro, who just finished third in the home run hitting contest at the All-Star game tonight. One shows the future Hall of Famer in the white jersey of the Texas Rangers while this updated 6" figure has him wearing the black home jersey top of the Baltimore Orioles, the team he signed with as a free agent for the 2004 season.
Last year Palmeiro made headlines both on and off the field. On the field last year, his 18th season in the majors, he had 38 home runs including his 500th, the 19th player to reach that mark. As of today Palmeiro has 539 home runs, which makes him 11th on the all time list (Mike Schmidt is waiting at 548 in the 10th spot), and 3rd among active players behind Bobby Bonds and Sammy Sosa, but still ahead of Ken Griffey, Jr. (for now).
Palmeiro also made news off the field when he appeared in a series of ads and commercials for Viagra as part of a campaign to market the drug to a younger and supposedly virile audience. The player got major props, not just because he was an active major league baseball player following in the footsteps of former Senator Bob Dole to endorse the product, but because he was also a Latino (born in Cuba) talking about a topic that would be considered taboo in a culture whose men pride themselves on machismo. So 2003 was a pretty good year for Palmeiro.
I have tried to confirm my suspicion that this 6" McFarlane Toys figure is based on Palmeiro's run around the bases after hitting his 500th home run last year (a two-out blast off the Indians' Dave Elder on May 11th), but aside from confirming that this took place at Texas with Palmeiro wearing the Rangers white jersey I have not been able to do this. But it makes sense; Palmeiro would not show this sort of emotion while rounding the bases because he is too much of a professional, so I stand by my hunch.
So while this Orioles version of this figure is correct in terms of the team that Palmiero is currently playing, but for fans who do not care what team he is playing with and what to remember he became a member of the 500 home run club, you would want the Rangers figure. Of course, if you get both of them then you will certainly have yourself covered in terms of having the one that will match up with his Hall of Fame plaque.terms of the team that Palmiero is currently playing, but for fans who do not care what team he is playing with and what to remember he became a member of the 500 home run club, you would want the Rangers figure. Of course, if you get both of them then you will certainly have yourself covered in terms of having the one that will match up with his Hall of Fame plaque.

review_body:

I have been very disappointed with this ride on bike. review_body: Let loose in this game of verbal explosions.  It's best to play with an even number of people so that you can split up into teams.  First, your team gets a topic like \\"commands you give a dog.\\" Then you shout out answers for 60 seconds in an attempt to name the commands given on the game card. There are plenty of answers but the ten that score points are the only ten listed on the game card.  I wouldn't recommend this game for young kids since a lot of the topics would be a bit too advanced for them.  A great party game though.

product_title: Fisher Price Sweet Streets Hotel
review_headline: You won't find this one on Hotels.com
review_body:
My daughter received the hotel for her third birthday (She now has the school, beach house, and hotel) and she loves it. Her favorite person is the bell hop. She loves running him through the neighborhood, carrying bags.
The compactness of this toy is great. Being able to close it up is a great plus. I also like that Fisher-Price has tethered the floating ring to the pool. That way this piece won't get lost.
This is another addition to the Sweet Street neighborhood that I think any child (2-10) would enjoy.

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Aquarium Cradle Swing
review_body:
This swing was my first choice because it seemed to have so much more functionality than the others on the market. But for $100 bucks I have been pretty disappointed for the following reasons:
1.Like many others have said the motor is too noisy. I am able to hear the music play over the motor but not the other ocean sounds.
2.The globe light is not bright enough. But that's okay because the seat doesn't recline far enough back for my daughter to see the mobile/lights anyway.
3.The swing itself is very large and takes up too much space. It's the way the legs have to be positioned to prevent the swing from tipping over. I wish Fisher-Price would have considered a more compact design.

With this said, my daughter seems to enjoy the swing just fine. The motor noise doesn't seem to bother her, just the adults trying to have a conversation around her. For the price I was expecting a better swing.

product_title: Dirt Devil Junior Lights Sounds Upright Toy Vacuum Cleaner
review_body: My son has been fascinated with the vacuum cleaner since he was a year old. He would stand at the closet and scream whever I put it away. I bought this hoping to ease his anxiety when I was tired of cleaning! He loves this toy. He is now just over 2 and goes to find his vacuum whever mommy is vacuuming. He loves the button that he can push himself to turn it \\"on\\" and the light is great. It would be nice if it actually picked up dirt but you can't beat it for the price. It's quiet, has no pieces to break or get lost, and is very inexpensive. He uses it on a regular basis and I've never had to replace the batteries in the year+ that I've had it. It shuts off automatically after a minute or so.

product_title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Babbling SpongeBob
review_body: I have a two year old boy that absolutely loves Spongebob.  He received the Babbling SB for Christmas.  He loves it.  It says a whole mess of things that he recognizes.  He gets a kick out of pressing the lips.  It makes a funny sound and he tries to imitate it.  He loves his SB.

product_title: Monopoly - The Lord of the Rings Trilogy Edition
review_headline: The Monopoly Game to Rule them All?
review_body:
With the final movie currently out in theaters, the last flow of Lord of the Rings merchandise is hitting the toy shelves. Make sure The Lord of the Rings-themed Monopoly game is one item you buy. Whether you're a fan of the books, the movies, or Monopoly, this game more than pays for itself with fake money.
With many other themed Monopoly games, it seems as if not much heart was put into their creation. Lord of the Rings Monopoly, however, stands out as a truly remarkable game variation. The locations that the player is able to buy come strait from the book, and are in order of appearance in the books, going all the way from \\"Farmer Maggot's\\" to \\"Mount Doom.\\" The money that is all too familiar from the original game has been replaced by units of power, and the game pieces are great--they seem to be based on original illustrations for the books, which is most apparent in the \\"Gandalf\\" piece (tall and thin, holding his staff like on the old book covers).
The \\"new way of playing\\" that has been added to the Lord of the Rings version of Monopoly adds a new strategy. Players rush to claim as much land before the One Ring travels to \\"Mount Doom\\" and the game ends. It also makes for a quicker game for those who don't have four or five hours of free-time.
Fans of any part of the Lord of the Rings phenomenon will enjoy ever aspect of this game--it truly feels like player an entirely new game. It's great and, without sounding too cliche, Lord of the Rings and Monopoly friends alike will want to play this game over and over again.

product_title: 21st Century 1/18 Scale SdKfz German Halftrack
review_body: The SdKfz 251 halftrack was a key component of blitzkrieg.  This vehicle was revolutionary in its time, as other countries hadn't given much thought to transporting infantry under armor and with the same cross-country mobility as a tank.  It's sloped armor gives it better protection than vertical armor of the same thickness -without increasing weight.  The vehicle is depicted as belonging to the GrossDeutschland (\\"Greater Germany\\") Division; an unusual choice for this series as this unit fought nearly exclusively in Russia...As for the model itself, both MGs swivel, though ..., in the actual vehicle the front MG is mounted to the shield which traverses, the engine panels and rear doors open, and the figure comes with a Panzerschreck (Bazooka) small arms and a Panzerfaust. The wheels and tracks rotate as well. As with other 21st Century \\"toy\\" vehicles, a comparable model kit in 1/18th scale would cost roughtly 2x/3x as much as this already assembled/detailed vehicle. Highly recommended.

product_title: Learning Curve Thomas and Friends Wooden Railway - Battery - Powered Lady
review_headline: Lady IS a really useful engine!
review_body: My son enjoys the battery powered Lady VERY much.  We recently got the battery powered Percy for his 3rd birthday, and Lady appears to be the better engine.  You can move her forward or backward when she isn't turned on (Percy's wheels only move when he is turned on - you can't make him go backward) - and she stays on the track really well (Percy comes off at switches and sometimes curves).  I would highly recommend the battery powered lady for any Thomas enthusiast!

product_title: Marvel X-Men the Movie X Mutations Limited Edition Storm Figure
review_body:
I LOVE THIS SET. I DECICED TO TELL MY AUNT TO BUY THIS STORM PACK BECASE AFTER I SAW THE PICTURES OF IT I NEEDED TO BUY IT.
MOVIE STORM:I THINK THIS ONE IS WAY BETTER THAN THE CLASSIC.HER HAIR IS PERFECT IF YOU BRUSH IT ACUPPLE OF TIMES.HER COSTUMEIS GREAT, BECAUSE IT LOOKS EXACLY LIKE THE MOVIE ONE.HER SCULPT IS EXCELLENT IT LOOKS JUST LIKE HALLE BERRY.
CLASSIC STORM:I DONT LIKE IT ONE BIT BECAUSE,THE SCULPT IS TERRIBLE, WHERE ARE HER LIGHTNING BOLT EAR RINGS? AND HER COSTUME NEEDS MORE FILLING.

product_title: Triumph 5 Comfort Touch Car Seat with LATCH - Rockefeller
review_body: Just a follow-up to another parents review...I just took this carseat on a coach flight and had no problems with it fitting in the airplane seat.  I did have mine forward facing, and in the most upright position, maybe the other reviewer needed it rear facing.  It even fit on a small Horizon express plane (with two seats on one side and one seat on the other side).  I was flying by myself with my two year old son.  While he sat in an empty seat I installed the carseat in about 2 minutes, buckled him in and we were ready to go.  As with other reviews I've written about this seat, I highly recommend it.  We've loved it and so has our son!

product_title: Ansa - Easy-To-Hold Spill Proof Cups and Baby Bottles - Sampler Set,
review_body:
I went to see these in the store before buying them. They are the tackiest bottles and cups I have ever seen.
I decided to go with Avent bottles and cups, they may cost more, but they are more versatile and you can use them a lot longer.

product_title: Designer Ginger Jar Lamp by Kiddie Lites - Moon & Stars
review_body: I love this lamp!  I looked at all of them, and this is the only one I liked.  I registered for it, not thinking anyone would buy it for that price, but they did.  I like it because it has a nightlight in the bottom, which incidentally makes the moon and stars light up on the walls and ceiling. I turn it on at night when I put my daughter to bed.  It is not bright at all, but just enough light for me to see her when I check on her.  The only bad thing is that to turn the nightlight off you have to turn the whole lamp on (twist past that setting).  Since I leave it on all night, its not a problem though.  It really is worth the money.  It is very well made, not cheap looking at all.

product_title: The Simpsons Exclusive Playset Moe's Bar with Duffman
review_body:
To the person who was horrified beyond reason that this was marketed to kids, I would like to point out that this playset was not sold to standard toy store retail outlets but was originally released by Playmates as an exclusive to Diamond Select. Diamond Select is a comic distribution outfit that primarily supplies comic book stores and other outlets that primarily target an adult audience.
Playmates did this to avoid kneejerk reactions of purient minds who might beleive that a bar playset should not exist. Come on! It's Moe's Bar, a very frequently used locale from one of the best cartoon shows ever. Collectors have been DYING to get their hands on this! Playmates' fear of reactions like yours are exactly why this almost didn't get release and why this playset costs so much. This same sort of close minded attitude about toys/collectibles is why we'll never see a Balrog figure from the Lord of the Rings movies. I'd like to recommend the Care Bears and My Little Pony playsets for you, instead of looking at a cutting edge license like The Simpsons.
As for why Toys R Us is now carrying this item, I don't know why Diamond Select would basically backstab Playmates original intentions by turning around and selling their specialty store exclusive to a regular family oriented toy store. Nice going guys!

product_title: Little People: Beeps the Bus
review_body: My second child is just as enamored with this toy as the first.  It's been knocked around a lot and is still a favorite at our house.  We've owned it for about four years, and our third child will probably love it too.  All of the Little People sets are a huge hit at our house.  We want to mount them somehow and build a village so that the pieces stay intact (but how do you change the batteries?)  If you're listening, Fisher-Price, please develop this!

product_title: Star Wars: Episode 2 Obi-Wan Kenobi (Coruscant Chase) Action Figure
review_body:
This toy is super sweet. I am a huge Star Wars fan, so I know what I'm talking about. The figure really captures the essence of Obi-Wan. He has the perfect Lightsaber stance, (With saber in left hand, right hand slightly behind his body) his facial features and hair is perfect, and even his height is correct. (compared to the other figures of course) And unlike all the other jedi figures, the lightsaber is not a problem. The assassin droid is could be better detailed, but it could be worse.
Both figures are a lot of fun and are could for collectors and just people who want to play with them alike! (I'm both)
P.S. Keep away from computers, there's a magnet is Obi-Wan's hand and in the assassin droid.

product_title: Banzai Falls Original Water Slide
review_body: well same story here first time i put the water on it did pop. We taped it with duct tape, holding up, the foot holes are ripping also. The kids are 5 and 7 years old, one weighs 43lbs. the other weighs 45lbs.It is a great invention but I agree with every body else, its not worth it no matter the price if it falls apart on day 1.And they too went down one at a time.

product_title: My Little Pony Playset Cotton Candy Cafe Hard to Find!
review_body: upon opening this toy i dont think its as cute as it looks in the box.  compare to the fisher price sweet street houses which have so much more detail for the same price.  there is not that much to it but if your child loves my little pony she will probably like this.

product_title: See & Learn Piano
review_body: This is one of my granddaughters favorite toys!  She has had it since she was 7 months old. It took her a couple of months but she learned to push the buttons to keep the music playing.  She has always loved it when it is in continuous mode.  She loves the mirror.  She can stand on it and it keeps playing!  It has been banged around alot but keeps going.

product_title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone Trivia Game Prefects Edition
review_body: A must for any Harry Potter fan!  My son and I have hours of fun playing the game over and over.  Test your knowledge of the first Harry Potter book.

product_title: Front Load Player CDG Hard Rock Academy
review_body: I needed a karaoke machine for my daughter's 16th birthday party and was in a hurry to buy a good deal.  I got this at my local Toys R Us store after work one day and it was 50% off the retail.  Definitely worth the bucks.  My daughter and I had fun with it the first 15 minutes we got it home.  Don't know how durable it will be when I pass it on to my 11 year old, but seems to me the challenge is finding karaoke CD's to play that have both the vocal versions as well as the karaoke versions.  We couldn't remember how some of the songs go on the CD I bought, but this one had a complimentary CD in the box with both vocal and karaoke versions of some popular 90's songs.  Looks and sounds like a lot of fun.

product_title: Rekonstructors Creature: Tempest (Dragonfly) by K'Nex
review_body: This toy is probably one of the best in the current zekorian line. All three modes look good. However, I've had trouble with the launching disks. While fun, the tail can sometimes come off while shooting so I suggest you hold the tail near the front if you are going to launch. If you get this toy, take my advice and go to the website! It will give you a much better idea on how a ten-foot dragonfly can grow legs and launch disks. There is even an on-line multiplayer game!

product_title: My First Swing Set
review_body: My first boy starting swinging on this when he was 6 months old. When he got a little older he would climb up the stairs and go down the slide. He absolutely loves the little steering wheel and the blocks that are on one of the poles. He started to outgrow it when he was about 2 1/2 (and he was a big boy 9 lbs 13 oz at birth, and was the size of a 4 year old at 2 1/2 years) Now my 2nd one is 11 months and has taken over the swingset, he loves swinging too and going down the slide. I keep it inside in their playroom so even after 3 1/2 years it still looks brand new, and it has been used a lot. It is a very good deal for only [$$$]!

product_title: Ocean Wonders Aquarium
review_body: I bought this for my 4month old son to keep with his aquarium theme and he loves it. He will stay in his crib and play with it for a while before falling asleep. He loves to turn it on and off.

product_title: Little Tikes Buzz About Mailbox
review_body:
I got this for my youngest son when he was 8 months old. Now he's 18 months old and he still plays with this all the time! At first he was just interested in chewing on the \\"mail\\" and spinning the bumblebee, but now he pretends to mail the letters. His 3 year old brother loves being a \\"mailman\\" also! I never would have bought it if I hadn't found it on sale because I never thought they would have enjoyed it so much! I'm so glad that I bought it.
I definitely wish that the bumblebee had an on/off switch. That buzzing gets really irritating. If it gets to a point where I can't stand it, I can just take the batteries out. It would just be nice to have the option to turn it off.

product_title: Melissa & Doug Alphabet Train Jumbo Jigsaw Floor Puzzle - Letters and Animals (28 pcs, 10 feet long)
review_body: I just got this puzzle and the animal barn puzzle today.  They are wonderful.  I bought them because of the nice reviews I read here.  When I got it, I am still surprised in their thickness and size.  My daughter is still too young for them, but I am sure she will love them when the time comes.

product_title: LeapFrog Leapster Educational Game Dora the Explorer
review_body:
I was a little worried that my 3 1/2 year old son would struggle with this software since the Leapster says it's for 4 and up. I was very pleased when he and I began playing the game - HE LOVES IT!!! He has never played video games before, but he did GREAT! And he was learning too! It teaches and reinforces so much! He had to do things like jumping on rocks to \\"find the number\\" (where there were two letters and one number\\", and \\"find the yellow circle\\", I was so pleased! When it asked about the opposites, I got a little concerned, but he did great with that also! It also has a nice \\"hint\\" button in case he gets stuck! I am so pleased that I decided to purchase this for him! His 2 1/2 year old brother is trying to play it as well! Won't be long!
I can't wait for the Pre-K software to come out!

product_title: Triumph 5 Comfort Touch Car Seat with LATCH - Rockefeller
review_body: I purchased this seat for a 1-year-old baby who grew out of his infant car seat.  The seat & padding is the quality of a Britax, which I also own for my older toddler.  I have a Dodge Durango & this seat will only fit on the sides of the back seat, not middle.  Keep in mind I have a Britax on the opposing side for his brother.  The car seats will not fit when side-by-side.  You may need a pool noodle or similiar in the rear-facing position to get the seat to recline to the proper position.  Easy in/out of the baby, the straps stay flat, so far.  The turn dial for loosening/tightning straps is slightly inconvenient, because it is hard to get to when the seat is so compressed (to get it tight), but it is better than the regular front types that are on most seats.  Hope this helps.  I will review my Britax as well-I can't say the Britax is worth the extra money.  This is a pretty nice seat.

product_title: Disney Magic Ride Wooden Talking Railroad With Rides, Winnie The Pooh & Friends, 25 Chunky Pieces
review_body: My kids love this toy.  I did not expect them to put it together(ages 1 1/2 and 3), however.  It does occasionally need some adult maintenance, but my 3 year old is capable of aligning the tracks and adjusting the rides. I am very surprised by the reviews suggesting that the train is not well made, I would strongly disagree.  I have had it on both carpet and stone and it needs less adjusting on stone, but works well on carpet.  We have had the train only about four months and two neighbors bought the toy as their sons would cry at leaving it and my son refuses to loan it.

product_title: Baby Discoveries Activity Atom
review_body: My daughter loves to hear the music and see the lights.  I only have two complaints about it.  One is that there is no turn off button and two it is really easy to get off of the holder which makes it hard for babies to spin it several times.  Very neat idea, but if these two things were changed, it would be much better!!!

product_title: Ocean Wonders Fishbowl
review_body: This was a belated baby shower gift that I had received when my son was about 2 months old. He used to stare at it when he wan't able to play. Then as soon as he was able to play with it he hasn't tired of it. I love how this game works on his eye hand coordination by taking the balls out and putting them back in. This toy is very durable as it has been now kicked by him, pushed by him, dropped into the toy box by my older girls, and the balls tossed in. My son is now 8-1/2 months old and he still plays with this toy. When my daughter was little she was sent a plain bowl and balls by a company that specializes in educational toys. This is much better and holds babies attention so much more. I love how you can turn the music to two different levels if you don't want to really hear it but, baby does. I love the aquarium theme line this year.

product_title: Amazon.com Bookology Trivia Game
review_body: I got this game thinking it would be a fun game for me and some of my friends to play (we're English graduate students), and a sort of study tool. But I was a little let down. Some of the questions had the most bizarre and useless clues. But some of them were fun and interesting. Playing the game was good for a laugh. It says that it is recommended for ages 12 and up, but I think most 12 year olds would have trouble with the bulk of this game. Selection question choosing could alleviate that problem. I'd have to say, its a risk to buy this game. You might like it, or you might not. I'd suggest taking the chance.

product_title: Corn Popper Playland
review_body: My son almost 1 years old just got this from his Aunt for christmas and he loves it! He love climbing in and out. They only real reccomendation I have is to buy extra balls. We got one pack of extra and we probably buy at least one more. They can get lost and also the kids like if the pit is a little fuller. I would buy this pit as a gift for another child!

product_title: Star Wars Lke Green
review_body: i dont have this sber but ive heard much about it. first of all, the pic is not accurate, the real saber has a huge copper section, look for your self at rebelscum.com, also and ive heard that bothe the light and sound are inferior to the vader saber. also it says that this is from \\"a new hope\\", but actually its from return of the jedi. hope this helps.

product_title: Apples to Apples Core Game
review_body:
This is a great party game. It seems best played with five or more people, since it allows for some interesting card submissions. However, this all depends on the people playing with you. My wife and I suggest you play with people that you know who you are compatible with in terms of wit and humor.
We have also noticed, when playing with the normal rules of not counting the last submission, the games become less fun... submissions are rushed and less thoughtful.

So, normally we play the variation which allows all submission to count, one per player which allows for slower, thought out entries.
Overall, it's a great game to have in one's game library.

product_title: BATMAN " PUPPETS OF CRIME" 5 FIGURE SET MIB by Batman
review_headline: Don't let the Sale Price Fool You
review_body: Sure, it sounds like a GREAT value with a sale price of less than $6.00 for this 4-pack, but don't be fool. TRU isn't really charging this low. What you may not notice until it's too late, is that the shipping is calculated so that this item has to be shipped by itself and not included with anything else bought, making you pay MORE for the shipping of the item than the cost of the item itself! Think if you buy multiple of this item that you will save on shipping? NO, you WON'T!  I suspect TRU does this on several other items as well. The snuck the extra shipping charges on me, and even shipped the item WITH the other items I purchased.

product_title: Fisher Price Twirlin' Whirlin Garden
review_body:
I bought this toy for my 7 month old daughter in hopes that it would strike her interest and enhance her motor skills, and it did just that.
She's figuring out cause and effect; she knows that if she press the big blue button that the blocks will go around and the lights will flash. It's such a joy to see her developing these skills. although the music is repetitious and it doesn't hold her interest for a whole hour, i'm pleased to say that it does its job for 45 mins,in that time I am abled to get a few things done. What would improve this item even more is if it had a volume button so one could play it high or low, and maybe extra buttons for a more of a variety of music. overall i highly recommend this item.

product_title: Hasbro Beyblade Tops Master Dragoon Attack Type / #A-31
review_body: this is a very good blade. You might want to change the weight ring and custimize it a little get a left spin gear and a deluxe launcher but it is good on its own. begginers shouldnt get this it is my first blade and it took me forever to get it to spin right, I even had to develop a new way to launch it. but experts should get this blade

product_title: Mighty Beanz Racetrack Set Super SBend Crazy Corner Action!
review_headline: Biggest piece of cr*p ever manufactured
review_body: After trying for half an hour to figure out how to make the beans go down the track without getting stuck at the turns, I finally decided that it was physically impossible.  The track is not tall enough, the beans won't go down.  Don't waste your time or money on this...this is going right back to the store as soon as I find the receipt.

product_title: 10' x 30" Easy Set Pool
review_headline: Great for anyone on a hot day
review_body: This is the greatest pool I have ever owned! Why?  Because it is shallow enough to get into without a ladder and once in, I can plop down and enjoy a good book, meditate, or I can float or sit in the pool with family and cool off.  We have our pool up for the third summer and all original parts are in great condition. Assembly is a snap and taking it down in the winter is just as easy.  If you want a great pool, that takes up little space, buy one of these and stay cool this summer.

product_title: Animal Alley 17" Jessie the Gold Labrador
review_headline: MY 2 YEAR OLD WON'T LEAVE HOME WITHOUT "DOG"
review_body: This is by far the best toy we have ever bought any of our children.  \\"Dog\\" goes everywhere and does everything with us.  When he gets dirty, he's machine washable.  My son uses him as a pillow when watching TV and of course he can't go to sleep without him. He is so silky soft, you can't help but cuddle with him. We have had \\"dog\\" for 8 months and he almost never leaves my son's side.  This is the best stuffed toy I have ever found that is resonably priced.

product_title: Hasbro Playskool Lullaby Gloworm
review_body: Ok, leave it to Playskool to ruin a perfectly good thing. I ordered two of these for my children because they both have 'issues' with the dark. When they arrived I expected to see a cuddly little stuffed thing that lit up when hugged. Well, it not only lights up... it BLARES the WORST electronic 'lullabies' you can imagine! And you can't turn them off!!!! Now why would they do that on something that is intending to be a nighttime comforter? Ugh!!! I promptly packed them up and returned them, and found the old (quiet) version elsewhere online.

product_title: Safety 1st Potty 'n Step Stool
review_body: This potty is no good!  My 20 month old boy has had more trouble with this potty!  The pee guard is useless, the hole is too small, if he lifts up the potty by the handles to carry it the top comes off of the base, the lid falls and hits him on the back as he is trying to sit down, etc.  Do not waste your money with this potty!  I recommend the Graco soft seat potty and step stool.

product_title: Fisher-Price Elmo's World Talking Cell Phone
review_body: I bought this phone for my daughters' 1st birthday because she loves Elmo so much.  I thought it was really cute and eye catching.  However,  once I got it home and took it out of the box you could not here what was being said hardly at all.  The eyes are cute and the elmo graphic is fun but as far as educational value, you can't hear anything enough for your child to learn anything.  My daughter plays with this for about 10 minutes and then she has had enough.  I think if the music was louder she would be more entertained.  I do not recommend this toy.

product_title: Electronic Interactive Whac-A-Mole Game
review_body: It's just okay!  I can't describe it any better.  I bought it for my 2-year-old and she is doing well with the hand-eye coordinating.  There is just one problem.  You really have to WACK the moles HARD for it to register as a hit.  Sometimes, my 2-year-old doesn't hit hard enough for the game to acknowledge her attempt, as a result she scores low, but I know she's playing very well.  I wish the game was a little more sensitive to touch.  However, it's still just an okay game.

product_title: Little People Ramps Around Garage
review_headline: A fun toy for infants to preschoolers
review_body:
I have 3 children ages 1, 3, and 5 who love this toy. Not only does it get used with the Little People but it also is used with other toys. My 1 year old loves the sounds and is able to put the people into the cars. It is so sturdy that it withstands his climbing all over it and it does not tip over on those occasions when he decides to stand up and hold onto it. My 3 year old daughter loves to play with the Little People that came with it and she loves the video that came with ours. My 5 year old likes to use it for staging battles with his green Army men and their planes and it occasionally becomes a hideout for the Superfriends action figures or Matchbox cars.
It has just enough electronic sounds to be fun but not to take away from the kids' imaginations. With such a wide appeal and so many ways to use it, this toy is a great value! Way to go Fisher-Price.

product_title: Yu-Gi-Oh Cards - Metal Raiders - Booster Pack
review_headline: Excellent game, bad place to start
review_body:
Yu-gi-oh is incredebly popular with all the children at school. It is a wonderful way to get your children and yourself socially active. Every time I go to a store and see a new set that has come out I have to always atleast buy a few. The game is as addicting as the show, and the excitment of pulling a secret rare card is.....well just something you have to expierence, if you have, you know what I mean.
If you are going to spend this much money on yu-gi-oh cards, I suggest buying either the legend of blue eyes white dragon or Metal raiders booster packs. First the new boosters have none of the monsters or spell cards that are seen on the show, so it doesn't seem right when you are opening a pack of cards and don't know how valuable the cards might be to your deck. Also the cards in the 2 early sets stated previously are just better for battleing and collecting. Yu-gi-oh is great, but is becoming another pokemon. The earlier sets may cost more,but it is well worth what you get.

product_title: LeapFrog Learning Table
review_headline: Wish we had known about it sooner
review_body:
My husband and I purchased the LeapStart Learning table for our little boy who is a 1yr. old for Christmas. He is so into this toy especially the ABC song. He actually Hmm's the tune and sings the songs; sometimes without playing with the table when he's doing other things around the house. When we first opened it on Christmas day, we were a little disappointed visually, because I thought we made a mistake since he'll be 2yrs. old in January. It seemed like a toy for a much younger infant/toddler. But once my husband setup the table and my son started playing with it; it took on a life of its own. Turns out he wasn't too old for this toy after all.
Very please with the outcome!!!!

product_title: Ligor Zero
review_body: IT was nice to build and very fast and all but the dang thing broke in two or three races on the table. Not a bad toy but you have to be careful or it goes splat!

product_title: Electronic Catch Phrase
review_body: This is the best game we own, by far! We love it. It's portable, it's hassle free, it's hysterical! The timer is both annoying AND the reason we laugh so hard - people are trying to get their teammates to guess what the word or phrase is and that timer is going crazy and the noise is increasing and the people are yelling... it's fun, fun, fun. I've read the reviews for this game and some people have mentioned you cannot clear the scores or start over... well they just didn't read the instructions - you CAN start the scoring over and reset the game by holding both score buttons down at the same time. The computer is easy to learn and easy to use, at any level of \\"computer literacy\\" and the rules are easy to follow. There are only 3! Of course the one thing we find starts a few heated discussions is how to interpret the rules and you'll find it necessary to have \\"house rules\\" to settle them as fairly as possible. product_title: Friends Trivia Game; In A Collectible Blue Tin
review_headline: Fun, but not for someone who just thinks the show is "Okay"
review_body:
My friends and I are obsessed with Friends - like, so obsessed that we've never missed an episode, can quote it at the drop of a hat, etc. Needless to say, we were really excited to try the game out!!
The game rules are simple, you go around the board trying to get \\"items\\" from the Friends apartments (ex: Phoebe's guitar, Ross' keyboard, etc.) by answering questions. For each question answered correctly you get an \\"item\\" - you have to get one from each Friend to win the game. There are also charades (which are pretty much impossible to do without props!) My only complaint about the game is: it seems to be very cheaply made. Some of the questions aren;t numbered, written upside down, and some of the answers are followed by question marks (ex: What's Phoebe's dorky boyfriend's name? Answer: David?) - so does that mean the people who made up the questions don't even know? And, the other thing, my friends and I are really obsessed, and found some wrong answers on the cards.
I know it sounds like I hate the game, and I haven't said one good thing about it. It is really fun, and pretty challenging. The most fun is the charades, because they're sooooooo difficult! As I said though, if you're not a huge fan of the show, don't play the game. Some of the questions are really hard (ex: What is the name of the record store across the street from Central Perk?), and others are really simple (ex:What is Chandler's middle name? & Which of the Friends mother killed herself?). I recommend the game for hardcore fans of the show. It's insanely fun!
Overal grade: A

Once they come up with a better way to attach the push handle to the trike I will give it 4 stars (not 5 because- once they outgrow the pushbar you have to cut the cables with wire cutters in order for your child to ride it without it- or take it all apart!). product_title: ANAKIN SKYWALKER * HANGAR DUEL * Star Wars Attack of the Clones 2002 Action Figure with Special Battle Feature & Accessories
review_body:
I went to Toys R Us and purchased this figure, along with 3 others, on April 23rd, the day the toys of Attack of the Clones were released. I knew I was lucky--I could tell this figure was rare from what I had heard, and also that it was the only Anakin Hangar Duel figure on the shelf. Feeling lucky, I nabbed it quickly. When I got home, I opened the package of the figure, his right arm, from the elbow and down, just popped off. I was surprised at first, and I thought to myself, \\"Jeez, what a cheap toy, it broke already.\\" Then I read the back of the package, and it said that the figure's arm comes off to \\"recreate battle wounds.\\" Fortunately, the arm can be reattached because of the magnet it has on it. But I think that Hasbro shouldn't have made his arm be detachable for these reasons:
1. It is a major spoiler for the events of the movie.
2. Little children playing with the toy might lose his arm.
The figure can keep its arm on while playing with it, most of the time, as long as you don't play with it too hard. Overall a pretty good figure, despite the arm thing. It has great detail, good sculpt, and two cool lightsabers. The battle action in the left arm is a little weird; it doesn't look realistic, but you'll probably make do, if you aren't really finicky. The figure stands up on its own most of the time. If it doesn't, just keep trying to position it in different ways until you do, it always works. It's a better figure than the Anakin Skywalker Outland Peasant Disguise for sure, because it's a taller figure, it has better detail, better weapons, and it just looks cooler. I don't recommend this toy to young children, because they might lose the detatchable right arm. Otherwise, it's a great collector's item, and a good play toy too.
Recommendations:
1. Obi-Wan Kenobi--Coruscant Chase
2. Jango Fett--Kamino Escape
3. Padme Amidala--Arena Escape
4. Kit Fisto--Jedi Master
5. Boba Fett--Kamino Escape
6. Clone Trooper
7. Super Battle Droid
8. C-3P0
