While it is easy to put together, it also takes up quite a bit a room. But if you have the room I highly reccommend this jumper. My son laughs and smiles so much when he's playing. My husband works from home at times when I'm at work and he is able to get his work and conference calls done because our son stays occupied in the jumper. Plus he is able to keep our son in his eye sight since this jumper doesn't need a doorway.

A plus is that you can detach the toy in the front and use the tray for other baby items/toys if desired. This jumper is also as pleasing to the eye as a jumper could be.

review_body: We live in an apartment that does not allow dogs, so my husband surprised me with this one. He's very cute and cuddly and never needs to go out for a walk!

review_headline: My Son Is In Love With His
review_body:
Well, Grandma gave my guys a gift certificate for Toys R Us for Christmas, so off to the store (you know how kids are)!!!

Long story short, he is hooked. The car is very well constructed. My son says the seat is comfortable and you can adjust the tension on the pedals to make starting easier, I fine tuned it for him. product_title: Mobile Suit Gundam: Zeonic Front
review_body:
This game is supurb. While other people will complain about it being to hard as with some weapons the ememy suits can kill you with one hit. But if you have ever watched any of the Mobile Suit Gundam shows you will know that there's no chance that any Zeon suit could withstand some of the firepower in this game. Such a shot to the cockpit or bosters with a beam rifle or the twin 120mm cannons mounted on the shoulders of a Guntank.
If you do find it to hard for you rework your attack route and battle codes, the ones the game gives you are rarely the best. Thats the whole point of being able to plan your own route.
As for graphics, I would have to say that while the eviroment looks O.K. the appearance of the suits, both Federation and Zeon is beyond great.
The game is divided into a variety of missions varying form recon to defense and escort. For each mission you can choose which teams will participate what equipment they will take with them, weapons, decoys, support fire, etc, and what route each team will take.
This game can however get a little fustrating well you go and make a magnificent attack pattern that you think couldn't possible go wrong, and then it does and you have to go and rework your plan. So don't expect to beat every mission on you first try. And when you do lose because you acidently put yourself in a position with your back to the emeny and got killed rework your plan so you come up behind them and they get ambushed.
In conclusion I would say that this is a great game to buy if your a moderate gundam fan or if you like squad based action.

I took the seat to our local police station to have it professionally installed, and the police officer that installed it was extremely impressed with it.  The seat did not budge once installed.  My 2 year old loves his new big boy seat, especially the shopulder strap covers so the straps don't irritate his shoulders with little summer tank tops starting to be worn.  The recline feature is probably not something I will use frequently, but we do take long car rides sometimes and was definitely a nice option when we did that the other day and he was able to peacefully take a 2 hour nap.  Overall I would reccomend this seat to anyone, and so would my son.

product_title: Thomas & Friends - Cranky At the Dock
review_headline: Fun but not compatible with wooden sets
review_body: This is a fun accessory for anyone who has the Tomy plastic Thomas trains.  We got this for our son for his forth birthday and he really likes playing with it.  There is a Y track that your child can use to direct the train onto two sets of tracks.  When a train runs over the inner track, the track automatically raises up a bit to stop the train.  Cranky then swings back and forth through about a quarter turn as if it is loading the train.  The train is then released to continue on its way.  Note that you can't move cargo up and down, only back and forth.  As such, you can't raise or lower any cargo.     The instructions to assemble this are a little weak.  You have to insert the top part of Cranky into the base.  You need to be careful to align the hex shaped shaft into the base or Cranky will not be able to turn.  It took me about three tries to get this right.        Note that the track is not compatible with the (Learning Curve) wooden sets.  The connectors are designed differently for the plastic set.If you are not familiar, there are two common types of Thomas sets.  The wooden sets are best known.  They are a lot of fun if your child likes to push trains along on the track.  Tomy makes a plastic Thomas set that uses battery operated trains that run on blue plastic track.  These sets are more fun if your child wants a battery operated set because they go faster than the wooden battery trains.  Both types are fun to play with, but the tracks are not interchangeable.

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Aquarium Cradle Swing
review_headline: The Rolls Royce of Baby swings
review_body: We love this swing. I had a regular Graco swing for my first daughter and it was okay.  But this FP swing is amazing because it can truly be used from birth.  When I saw my 3 week old son rocking peacefully back and forth with the cradle motion, he looked so cozy, I wanted one in an adult size.  Now, at 10 weeks old he loves looking at the mobile and lights.  He also naps in it frequently and at night it's how we get him to sleep before bputting him in his crib.  Also, the music is really nice - not annoying at all. And the \\"white noise\\" features are really cool too. I will now recommend this swing to everyone I know having a baby.  (The swing does move a little fast for a newborn - but hanging a blanket on it, as is recommended in the instrucion booklet, slows it down)

product_title: Rubbadubbers Bubbletime Bath Playset
review_body: I am so mad at myself for buying this!  The commercial is very misleading.  It makes you think the toy does and has a lot more with it than it does.  It is made with flimsy plastic and is not easy to get it to stay on the shower wall.  The paint on it was poor at best.  It took nearly an hour to get it out of the box because of the wires, tape, etc.  I only gave this item a 3 on the educational value because my daughter is autistic and has a terrible fear of bubbles and sitting down in the tub.  It has helped us there.  If it wasn't for that, this toy would be returned so fast!  For all you other parents, though, I strongly advise not buying this toy. (Unless it gets marked down to a dollar!)

product_title: Table-Top Cotton Candy Maker
review_body: My child was so looking forward to making cotton candy with this machine.  All I can say is that is smokes like crazy and makes what could best we described as a single lick of cotton candy.  It's a complete waste of $$$.

product_title: Thomas & Friends Wooden Railway - Rusty with Construction Cars
review_headline: Cool but I  only wanted the construction cars
review_body: What I meant by my title is that I already had Rusty and I just wanted the Construction Cars. The cars sway from side to side and they can survive a lot of damage. I was suprised at how durable these were. The sets are a lot of fun because you don't need any additional things to go with it for immediate fun. These toys are really good for a car trip to keep a child busy when they are bored. I would higly recommend getting this set but don't buy Rusty first.

product_title: Batman
review_body:
It is about time that someone comes out with an accurate depiction of Batman The Darkknight himself. This is not your fathers Batman!
This is the real Darkknight, and it shows just by looking at him.
This goes in line with any comic book fan, a good example of Frank Millers The Darkknight Returns, not as old of course, but never the less, this is the true depiction of what The Darkknight is all about! Here Here Mattel, I give a 4 1/2 star batarang rating on this one! (The utility pouches do not open as far as shown, and can be cracked, so be careful, don't force it). The batcape also doesn't spread out as shown,it's sewn to his costume above his shoulders, so it takes some creativity to get it to stay if you like the full batwing look.

product_title: LeapFrog Leapster Educational Game Dora the Explorer
review_body: I can't believe how much my 3 year old loves this toy.  She said this was her favorite Christmas present and did not open about half of her gifts this year.  My 6-year-old loves it too and we are going on a plane trip in April and plan on getting another Leapster for him.  I just ordered Dora for Bethie(3-year-old) so I'll let ya' know how she does.  But I have to say, I ordered this on 12-23 and express shipped it on 12-24, held off b/c of the price, but it is well worth it.  Do an a.m. show and will talk it up then too.  GREAT INVENTION.  We were looking for the \\"it\\" toy, I think this is \\"it\\"! S

product_title: Little Tikes Disc Swing
review_body: It's a definite challenge to balance, and will take younger kids a little time and a lot of patience before they can appreciate how much fun it really is!

product_title: Spider-Man LED Light Show
review_body: This wonderful item has been an absolute joy to my grandson of 8. He has entertained himself and several friends and adult family members. I highly recomend it for anyone who want hours of fun and relaxation. Even for children in hospitals and confined to bedrest.

product_title: Fisher-Price Sweet Dreams Monitor
review_body: This monitor has horrible range...I couldn't use the portable in the whole downstairs of my house without listening to static and buzzing.  It was only (mostly) clear upstairs where I didn't need it!  The light show is OK, but that's not the point, right?  Got the Sony 900mhz, and that's AWESOME in comparison.  Don't bother with this model.  The same price will get you something much better...

product_title: Tropical Island Activity Pool
review_body:
Bought the pool before reading the reviews. The nets were not included. The basketball had a hole in it. The basketball hoop had a hole in it. Found out about the holes after inflating the outside, which took a min. of an hour with the loudest pump ever.
Returned the pump and pool and bought a non-inflateable pool. The kids had a blast with the simple non-inflateable pool.

product_title: IQ Baby Busy Box
review_body: This toy is fabulous!  I bought this for my 9 month old son and he loves it! There are so many toys in one, it keeps his attention for a long time. The side with the musical buttons is the best and he loves to take the phone out of the holder. This toy will be great for travel also.

product_title: Justice League 10" Superman Large Figure
review_headline: Great, but only the guys?  Where are WW and HG?
review_body:
Great, kids will love this. It will be excellent for Xmas.
BUT WHERE ARE WONDER WOMAN AND HAWKGIRL?
Sheesh.

product_title: Tolo Toys Musical Jack in the Box
review_body: The music stopped playing the same day we got it in the mail.  Would have been very cute if it wasn't so cheaply made. Very disappointed.

product_title: Star Wars Luke Skywalker Lightsaber
review_body: I got my first saber two weeks ago and the sound did not work at all. I had to send it back and a week and a half later my second one arrived. The second one was much more impressive. The sound worked fine and the blade is beautiful. This is must for any Star Wars fan!

product_title: Fisher Price Smart Screen Intelli Table
review_headline: WASTE OF MONEY - WILL BREAK IN A FEW MONTHS
review_body: I HAVE ONE OF THESE AND IT BROKE AFTER 3 MONTHS - CALLED FISHER PRICE AND THEY MAKE YOU SHIP THE ITEM BACK TO THEM (AT YOUR COST) AND SEND A PAPER VOUCHER FOR ANOTHER ITEM.  THEY DO NOT STAND BEHIND THERE PRODUCTS! SAVE YOUR MONEY AND BUY THE LEAPFROG VERSION.

product_title: Imaginext: Rescue Center With Bonus Emergency Medical Station
review_body: I purchased this item at my local [store] and my 6 year old son could barely wait til we got home to play with it.  He already has the police station.  We are going on approximately 5 hours of play time and he is still not bored.  Young children will need help at first putting together but once they get the idea of how to do it just step back and let them go. Every once in awhile I hear my son  saying EMERGENCY, EMERGENCY!!!! With the massive heat wave we have had this week this has been an absolute lifesaver. Alot of thought went into all the little parts that go with this.  Is definitly worth the money and would definitly reccomend!!!!!  Also this is a great follow up to the rescue heroes!!!!

product_title: I/R T-Rex
review_body: I bought this toy for my son a four year old. this toy is cool when it works. it only works half of the time and it breaks very easy. The skin will begin to crack at the seems and can not be glued back. This toy sat most of the time drying from the glue then he actually got to play with it.

product_title: The Wiggles Sing-With-Me Microphone
review_body: My daughters love the Wiggles, and have many of their toys. They have all the dolls, the guitar, the cars, etc., etc. Unfortunately the microphone was a real dissappointment. It really didn't work well from the moment they received it as a gift. We changed the batteries several times, but that didn't help. The only way we could get it to work was to bang it on the floor really hard. That would allow us to play a few songs. My girls enjoyed the toy when it actually worked. They still use the microphone even thought music does not come out of it. Just thought I would give other Wiggles fans a heads up.

product_title: Pizza Hut Deluxe Play Delivery Set
review_body: My two-year-old received this pizza set, as well as several other food sets, as a gift. The Pizza Hut set was the worst by far. Poor quality: the paper money is glued to the box and tore immediately; the spaghetti is a hollow plastic shell; the drinks, shakers, bread sticks, etc., are all under three inches. The pizza and the cutter could be cute for play, but the set as a whole is not worth the money. Recommend instead: the food basket sets from Summit are sturdy, realistic, and high-quality alternatives.

product_title: Tomy Water Symphony
review_body: I bought this for my daughters (ages 18 mos & 7 mos at the time) for Christmas thinking they'd really enjoy a musical tub toy. Well, they're hardly "musical". If you tap on their heads, and the water has to be deep enough, they'll sort of play a note. Each fish has it's own note. They don't work at all in a bubble bath and my daughters never play with them to make music. They like filling them up with water and dumping the water out more than anything else. A couple of cups would have provided the same entertainment. I wouldn't spend the money again.

product_title: Care Bears Magical Care-a-lot Castle with Cheer Bear, Wish Bear, Funshine Bear & Grumpy Bear
review_body:
i bought the castle for my daughter and she absolutely loves it .
of all the other toys that teach children violence and hate ,i think 40 dollars is nothing when my child plays with carebears and teaches her the virtues of life. helping my child when she needs help is not a big issue.rather than give her another toy that she plays with quietly with no questions and find out later that something shes done wrong was learned by a toy. whether it be 40 dollars or 5 dollars (carebears are worth it)obviously others agree because no one has mentioned bring them back.....

product_title: Ocean Wonders Aquarium
review_body: My 5 week old daughter is having a terrible time with gas which is making her cranky and wrestless at night.  We bought this and she slept 6 hours the first night we tried it.  Plus when she woke up in the morning I turned it on and instead of screaming like usual she watched the aquarium while I changed her diaper.  This has been a god send for me.

product_title: Triumph 5 Comfort Touch Car Seat with LATCH - Rockefeller
review_headline: I think I LOVE this seat as much as my son does!
review_body:
At 4 months old, my son has already outgrown his infant carrier. At his 4 month check-up, he was 17.8 lbs, but 26 1/2 inches long. I looked online at reviews, and went to BRU to look at ALL the carseats in person.
I was very impressed with this seat. I LOVED the 5 positions, and everything else about it. I liked the Britax too, but didn't have the extra $... to spend on it. So I straped my son in differnt seats, and he seamed to look the most comfortable in this one.
I actually asked the sales clerk if I could try it out in my Explorer to see how it fit. My husband is 6'4\\" so I wanted to make sure that we didn't have to move the seats up to far. It fit PERFECT!!!! We didn't have to move either seat up at all.
WE have had the seat for 2 weeks now, and haven't found anything wrong with it. Our son seams very comfortable, and we don't have to worry if he's safe or not.

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Aquarium Cradle Swing
review_body: We bought this swing on the suggestion of a few friends, mainly because the radle position is great for a baby under 6 weeks old. She was about 4 weeks old when we first bought it.  The first swing when we turned it on made a horrible grinding noise and the mobile didn't work at all. We exchanged it and the same thing happened again.  I called Fisher-Price and they were no help at all.  We exchanged the swing again because she loved it and it put her to sleep.  The third swing finally worked!!!!!!!!!  She thinks it's the greatest thing.

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Aquarium Cradle Swing
review_body: This swing is the best baby item we've received. Even though that the baby outgrew his bassinet already, the swing will last him much longer because it is up to 24 lbs. When he gets fussy and/or sleepy  and cannot fall asleep and nothing helps to sooth him , not even cuddling,the swing's sidewave rocking (like a craddle) will do the job.  When he wakes up, he is back to his normal self.  Our baby loves spending time in it. I found it most helpful when the baby does not want to go back to sleep in the mornings (5AM). After a night of feeding every 2-3 hrs. I can surely use extra hour or two to nap next to my baby in the swing.  It is also a great help when I am getting ready to leave the house to sit him in it instead of having him wait in the car seat for extra time.  The different sounds are excellent, because the first month our son loved the ocean sound, which does not calm him down any more.  Now he prefers the music.  The different speeds are also excellent. He loves the high speed which I use at the beginning and then lower it when he falls  asleep. The good part is that the swing does not turn off after a certain period of time. I guess that is the only thing that could be improved on the sound effects.   I would highly recommend this swing, specially because of the sideway rocking.

product_title: Winning Moves Pass the Pigs Classic Party Game
review_body: I bought this game, or one very similar, over 15 years ago.  Our children didn't seem to like it much, but our adult friends love it!  It's great for when you have a few friends over for the evening and you're just sitting around, but be prepared to laugh alot!  It's not for serious discussion, but rather when you just want to be silly.  We love it!

product_title: Go Natural Portable Wipes Warmer
review_headline: This is a must have for every mother! Great for bottles!
review_body: I use the wipe warmer to keep bottles warm on trips to the store or when my husband and I go out to eat, etc.  There is nothing better, I tried the hot/cold packs and not only was it more work to heat, it didn't keep the bottle warm half as long.  Fits in a diaper bag, I also put it in my purse when I don't want to carry the diaper bag.  This is a must have for every mother!

product_title: Fisher-Price Sweet Dreams Monitor
review_body: My sister told me about this product before I even knew I was pregnant. She was telling me that if she could do it over again, she would love to have something like this. So, when I registered, after finding out I was pregnant with my daughter, I asked for this monitor. The light show is wonderful, and while the baby is little, the monitor will definitely occupy the baby if you have a hard time getting them to stay in one place while changing their diaper. It is also good because you can change from music to a light \\"outside\\" noise, which sounds like a frog chirping in the background. It is relaxing to listen to. My daughter feels very comfortable listening to it. Also, the receiver has a soothe button that you can push in the middle of the night, if your child is crying and you are trying to teach them to soothe themselves. The projector gives just enough light that she can find her binky and then go back to sleep. In the morning, it always gives us that extra 15 minutes of listening to her play and talk in her crib. The static only becomes a problem for me when we are using batteries and they are low. It will also make a ticking sound when they are low.....FP does need to work on that aspect. Everything else is great!!!

product_title: Schylling Jack In The Box
review_body: When I received this from amazon.com, I was anxiously anticipating the reaction of my then 15 month-old daughter.  I couldn't wait for her to start playing with it.  I didn't even get a chance to give it to her to play with since the jack-in-the box didn't work at all!  The top wouldn't stay fastened to the box.  Thus, it wasn't a Jack-in-the-Box.  The clown just stayed outside of the box and wouldn't stay back in no matter how much I tried.  Definitely not worth the money.  Not durable in the least!!!

product_title: Step2 Push Around Buggy Toddler Pushing Car - Durable and Safe Outdoor Wagon Cart for Kids - Red
review_headline: I wish it was just a little bit better....
review_body: Let me start by saying YES, I LOVE IT !  And so did my 1 year old daughter.  For several months, it was her favorite way to cruise the neighborhood.  And other toddlers love it too-everywhere we went, they wanted to hop on.  But, ever since she was 14M, she hasn't ridden it.  Now, she prefers the pedal power of her Little Tikes Cozy Coupe.  I just wished I could get more miles out of it if it somehow allowed her to pedal.  So, right now, it's in the basement, awaiting my second child.  I think in hindsight, I might have gotten something similar but which can be converted to pedal power like the one they sell at OnestepAhead.

product_title: Jazz Transformers Commemorative Series III Generation One Reissue Action Figure
review_body: Jazz is one of the coolest Transformers, he was 2nd in command in season one and he's also a Porsche!  If you really want educational value pick up the DVD boxed sets.  They have excellent educational value, I mean, how many 2nd graders REALLY understand what shooting stars, black holes, and equilibrium are- not to mention how hydro-electric power stations work.  Any of you who don't think these toys are durable check ebay, some these things are 19 years old and still completely undamaged!!!

product_title: Catch A Bubble Jumbo 5-Pack
review_body: Our Westie, Hunter, loves to catch bubbles.  These bubbles stick around a while so he can keep catching them.  This should be a dog or cat toy too!

product_title: Ocean Wonders Fishbowl
review_body: I bought this for my son when he was about 4 months old.  I wanted something that would encourage him to sit and play.  He was just learning to sit up unassisted.  At first he was afraid to put his hands inside.  But once he tried, he learned how to grab onto the flutter balls inside and pull them out.  The little plastic balls that come with this are the best part.  His dexterity has improved since playing with them.  He is now almost 10 months old and he still plays with this.  I roll the balls for him and he loves crawling after them.

product_title: Trivial Pursuit: The Lord of the Rings Movie Trilogy Collector's Edition
review_body:
I absolutely adore the Lord of the Rings movie trilogy. I have watched everything you could possibly watch on the special extended editions, so when I found out that this game existed, I had to get it!
I have played this game with just my housemate and there are times when one person could answer 10 questions in a row before you get another turn! It can get a little bit boring or frustrating but that's the price you pay for being a fan who knows too much! The questions that we usually get caught on are the ones in the \\"Making Movies\\" category. Despite having watched the extended versions ad nauseum, we sometimes get stumped on the names of people who worked on the more obscure technical aspects of the film.
I've also played this game with my housemate and another friend right before we decided to switch to playing Trivial Pursuit's 20th anniversary edition for a spell and boy did we hear the crickets. It was such an intellectual letdown after our triumphs at Lord of the Rings movie trivia. :)
I like the fact that you have the optional rule of, when anyone answers a question incorrectly, a Ringwraith going after the player who bears the ring. Another cool thing we've noticed is that there are some questions that are possibly in reference to the Return of the King extended edition.
Overall this is a trivia game for those who have an ardent love of the movies. The only drawback that I am experiencing, so far, is that we have played so often that we're having repeats of the questions. Perhaps, extra cards will be published in the future?

product_title: LeapFrog Learning Drum
review_body: My 13 month old got the Learning Drum for her birthday. She rarely plays with it and when she does, it's only for several minutes. We try to engage her in it, but she doesn't seem interested at all in it. While I love the features on it, it seems like wasted money for something that doesn't keep her attention at all.

product_title: Fisher-Price Learning Patterns Rocker
review_body:
I am a huge fan of Fisher Price's 'Learning Patterns' toys and gear. It has black and white for really little ones and brighter colors as your baby gets older.
When I got this, I thought that it was a really good price as compared to a bouncer because you can use it from infant to toddler. However, when your child starts to move and has the ability to sit up, this seat has to be put away until they have the ability to climb in and out of it on their own.
Also, other reviews mentioned that this thing had tipped over and hurt their child. It does say to use under adult supervision. And if your child is leaning forward in a ricking chair, it's going to tip.
I do like how easy this was to assemble, it took about 10 minutes and I have not assembly skills at all.
Great seat for 0 to 3/4 months.
Great rocker for 9/10 months to 3/4 years.

product_title: Ocean Wonders Aquarium
review_headline: We love love love this toy!
review_body: We have a five month old daughter and she goes to sleep with the ocean wonders aquarium almost every night.  In the middle of the night she stirs alot and flings her arms out to the side.  She turns on the aquarium and out she goes.  We like the bubble, swimming, music setting.  I would recommend this to anyone!

product_title: Hasbro Elefun
review_body: I purchased this game for my 3yr old and he loves it.  It is a pain to have to keep putting the buterflies back inside the elephant every 15 seconds or so, but he enjoys doing that as well.  I would recomend this for any toddler.

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Aquarium Cradle Swing
review_body:
Our son, Ben, LOVES this swing. We intially purchased the Fisher Price Rubber Ducky Cradle swing, but Ben always acted irritated in it. We exchanged it and he loved this swing immediately. The mobile and glowing globe keep his attention the entire time they are moving/lit. The music and nature sounds are wonderful and relaxing for Ben, as well as for my husband and me. It's much nicer to hear the swing sounds rather than the annoying sounds from some of the other baby products we have. This swing is very strong, too. Ben is now 17 pounds and the swing has shown no signs of slowing down. The batteries last a really long time. I can't even remember the last time I changed them. The only complaint about this swing is that the mobile/music/sounds turn off by themselves after about 7-8 minutes. It's not a huge deal to push the reset button, but if you are lucky enough to have fallen asleep on the couch while your little one is content in the swing, jumping up to reset it messes up your rest time!! :)
I recommend this swing to EVERYONE!!!!! Ben has been in this swing since 8 weeks of age and he has loved every second of it!

product_title: Baby Basics - Knit Crib Sheet - Blue
review_body: This sheet has a terrific texture--it's soft and comforting and doesn't get cold like regular cotton sheets. Also, because the knit is stretchy, it can accommodate some of the thicker mattresses that are out there today.  However, I noticed some considerable fading after a few washes.  The faded color was still beautiful, but there was definitely a difference in intensity: the formerly light blue sheet was now a very light sky blue.

product_title: Toy State Caterpillar Big Builder Backhoe Lands Shaking
review_body: My 2-yr old son loves backhoes, and he loves this toy.  For my part, it is flimsier than I expected.  The body is made out of plastic and is fairly lightweight.  Just taking it out of the package, I managed to separate the arms that support the shovel, and had to fit them back together.  I was expecting something heavier and sturdier, more like a Tonka toy.  Not matching my preconception doesn't make it a bad toy, but I do keep an eye on my son while he's playing with it, just in case.

product_title: Wiggles: Greg Doll
review_body:
On Playhouse Disney, I have Greg only as my best favorite Wiggle-even if there's enough love in my heart for Murray, Anthony and Jeff. Greg is a Yellow Wiggle and the Magician King of the Wiggles World, I love his kind smile, one of his magic tricks and of course my three words that describe him.
1. Hair, belt, pants, shoes black as night.
2. Eyes blue as a pool of water.
3. Shirt yellow as the lemons.

product_title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters Arena Playset
review_body: The idea is great but there's no instructions in how to play the game. The cards don't have any information about their defense or attack abilities. You have to figure our a way to play the game.

product_title: Animal Alley 11.5" Brown Labrador
review_body: I am a sucker for stuffed animals, especially dogs, since I have a dog, a chocolate lab named Abigail.  The toy is very soft and durable and has a spot of honor on my bed, along with the 17\\" black labrador that I got from Amazon.  It would have been nice to have a larger chocolate lab, but this one is fine.  I think a child who loves dogs would like it just as much as this 41 year old married woman.

product_title: Marvel Legends X-Men Legends Gift Pack Action Figure
review_body:
This would be a great starter set for anyone just beginning to collect Marvel Legends figures. For those whose collection precedes this set, it's sort of a ripoff to get Rogue for your collection.
The Wolverine figure is different because it is unmasked. I guess they did this to settle everyone who complains about chase variants. I for one hate them myself. Serious though, how many Logans do we need? There's the regular nineties Wolverine, the 80's brown and gold in series 6, and Weapon X forthcoming in series 7. I'd rather see more unique characters instead of more retreads of Logan and Iron Man. That's just me though, bub!
Gambit's virtually identical unless you like the matching pleather coat to go with Rogue.
Same for everyone's favorite oversized Smurf. The Beast is a retread except for his nifty labcoat and glasses. I'm gonna try painting him grey to be the Dark Beast. I'm such a loser.
Magneto--he's back, only more angry. Again, so what. Give me Mister Sinister, or even Toad. I think they learned their lesson with retreads. Look at the Sinister Six pack, mostly new characters. Bravo.
Rogue. Great, good sculpt, great look. Maybe a little too much lipstick, but...
Overall, grab it cheap to get Rogue, or if you're just starting. Otherwise, eh? Actually saw a box at WalMart where someone just took the Rogue figure out. Guess you could do that too.

product_title: Educational Insights Design & Drill Activity Center
review_body: This play set is wonderful!  It is easy to use and entertaining for preschool to early school age children.  While kids are having fun playing, they are improving their fine motor skills and patterning.  They can be creative with their own designs or learn to follow one of the included pattern cards.  The set includes 3 bits for use with the drill or screwdriver handle and 5 different colored large screws.  The drill has forward, off, and reverse settings and makes drill sounds at a reasonable volume.  Overall a great buy.

product_title: UNO Attack!
review_body: I bought this game for our family game nights.  It is our favorite game.  Even the little ones can play with some assistance (our 6 y/o uses a card holder).  We laugh so hard when it shoots a lot of cards out at once.  Highly recommend it for 5 and up.

product_title: 3-in-1 Sport Set
review_body: This toy is very cheaply made, not to mention that the balls don't go through the hoop.  You put the ball on the top of the hoop and then push it.  It then comes down a sprial slide, and out the bottom.  The balls that are attached are ridiculous. I think that a child will want to hit everything with the bat and the golf club, other than the attched balls. As soon as I put this item together, I took it apart and took it right back to the store.

product_title: 9 oz. Magic Cup - 6 Pack
review_body:
Contrary to popular belief, these cups DO NOT leak. Leakage comes from closing the tops too tightly! People can visit the Avent website for the FAQ on using these cups. Follow the instructions and they won't leak.
That being said, my 18 month old LOVES these cups. This cup is the only cup she will drink from.

product_title: Safety 1st neat! Diaper Disposal System
review_body: I have been using the neat diaper system since I came home from the hospital.  It is great at keeping odors sealed, except when you go to change the bag.  I have not had any problems with putting diapers into the pail. However, the top does not always stay up when you lift, this causes the top to sometimes hit your hand in the process.  The bags are easy to remove and to refill.  The only negative is that you waste a lot of the bag everytime you push a diaper through the slot the bag releases, so when you go to change it you have a mile of unused diaper bag, whic causes you to go through refills at a faster rate.  My husband attempted to re-wrap the unused bag back into the container, however it was difficult and the bag smelled from being in the bottom of the pail.  Overall it does what it is supposed to do which is keep the odor contained.  I would recommend it, just by a lot of refills.

product_title: Banzai Falls Original Water Slide
review_body: The slide was extremely fun for the grandchildren for about 45 minutes.  Then the place where the hose came in split.  It is horrible that a product with this price tag is still on the market when there are obvious defects in the workmanship.

product_title: Racko Card Game - 50th Anniversary
review_body: I unfortuneately had to spend last week in the hospital but they had this game and my mom and I would stay up til 12:00 in the morning playing it.  It is a great game that you can't play just once!

product_title: Irwin Toy SpectraColor Image Pad " A Touch of Magic!!
review_body: Good thing my spouse actually tried one of these before Christmas, otherwise my kids would have thought Santa was playig a cruel joke.  Sorry to say, but this product is an absolute zero. I could only imagine my kids frustration when they spent hours positioning each peg and then went insane when they bumped the board and had to start all over. Looks great until you try it. What was the manufacturer thinking!?!?

product_title: NASCAR Championship 4-Lane Speedway Set
review_body: My 7 year old son and I love this race set.  We put it together with the NASCAR set and really have a blast...the cars are very durable and take lot's of abuse when we crash them.  We are going to buy more LL race sets....enjoy!!!

product_title: Mighty Mind
review_body: My daughter absolutely loves this game. She can play with it for hours and stay mesmerized by it. I would heartily recommend it to any parent.

product_title: SwimWays Baby Spring Float
review_body: I bought this for my 1 yr old son and he loved every minute he spent in it. Very durable and guaranteed to be alot of fun for your child...well worth the money! All the other mothers with children my son's age all said they should have bought this one instead of the floats they had!

product_title: Fisher Price Kick & Crawl Aquarium
review_body: This is an excellent product.  I just bought it for my two month old daughter and she loves it.  It combines the upper and lower body stimulation, so you don't have to buy two seperate items.  She loves the colors and the little fishies.  Worth every penny, maybe even more.

product_title: Simple Fit Pressure Gate - 2 Pack
review_body: This gate is impossible to use and it doesn't come with any instructions.  It doesn't fit in our doorway, no matter which latch I set it on.  Don't buy this gate!  Spend the extra few dollars on something of a better quality.

product_title: Power Wheels Performance Series MX3 Mini Bike
review_body: I bought this bike for my 4 and 5 year old last year, and they love it. We purchased the fisher price training wheels and installed them for balance.(they were a little trouble to put on, but worth every minute!)My children love it, and so does everychild who visits. Now, even my 3 year old nephew has one with training wheels, and he hasn't had any problems either! I reccommend this mini bike for ages 4 and up (if training wheels are installed of course!) The bike automatically stops when the child lets go of the throttle, so they never need the hand brake. I have absolutely no complaints about this bike! I think this is a wonderful mini bike, and so do my kids. I have definitely gotten my money's worth out of it, and it is still going strong!!

product_title: MLB Series 6 Figure: Jim Thome with Gray Jersey
review_body: his hands don't go together so it looks like the bat is floating.  also, i can't get the nob end of the bat into his right hand.  this wouldn't be too bad if his back leg wasn't hanging over the end of the dirt.  i'm really sad.  i guess you're not supposed to take them out of the box.  on a good note he looks great detail wise.  and he is very sturdy and heavy, not cheaply made.

product_title: USA Talking Puzzle
review_body: I purchased this toy as a Christmas gift for my 7 yr old. He loves maps. I find my 2 1/2 yr and my 5 yr old playng with it all the time. My 5 yr old knows his states and capitals and my 2 1/2 yr old already knows approx. half the states and where they are located. This is and excellent toy . I highly recommend this to any parent for any child.As far as durability ... this this has been tugged and dropped, and is still perfect .

product_title: Giant Building Block 40-piece Set
review_body: These cardboard blocks are not as big as I would like. There is a set out there that has blocks that are about the size of half a shoe box.  These bigger ones are better for many projects.

product_title: LeapFrog Original LeapPad Learning System from 2004
review_headline: Have Fun and Learn with LeapPad!
review_body: I bought this last Christmas for a 4 year old and it has had continual use since that time. He is now 5, and can read just about anything. It has great learning value. The Map Game is fun, too!  See if you can beat your child by naming the states and capitals! This game has allowed the child to be able to name the states on a blank map!  The only problem I had was with the MindStation, that I spentan extra [$] for.  No where on the box did it say you needed an extra serial port on your computer. My computer uses the bus ports. I bought an adapter (cost me [$]), but the mindstation would not work then, either. The company apologized, and said they would have a mind station that worked with the bus port available in the fall and they would send me one. However, it is now December, and I have not heard from them.  Save your money, the Mind Station is not necessary to use the program.  Use Leap Pad and buy the extra books to go with it.

product_title: Ligor Zero
review_headline: this zoid is 1 u have to get
review_body:
i love this zoid it is soooooooooo cool
with all the parts u can buy to make it look even better
it is truely a must have sooo if u dont have 1
u better get it fast

product_title: Little Tikes 2-in-1 Snug & Secure Swing
review_body: I purchased this swing for my son when he was about 12 months old.  While the back is nice and high, and it seems secure to have the t-bar, the straps are nearly impossible to unhook - not just sometimes, all the time!!  It was so frustrating to fight with those clips to get my toddler out!!  As for stowing the t-bar under to convert to a toddler swing - it's been hard for my toddlers to not slip around so much when learning to stay on a \\"big kid\\" swing.  I would not recommend this swing to anyone and am in the process of buying an easier one to get my little kiddos in and out of - probaby the red Little Tikes one.

product_title: Ello Aquaria People Places & Things Set - 168 Pieces
review_headline: a cool toy for girls of all ages
review_body: it is a very cool toy the only bad thing is that thay are alittle hard to put together at first and I recomend ELLO to any smart girl how has money in her pocket and knows how to use it! I think it is the 1# toy for girls of all ages.

product_title: Megatech Ocean Explorer-1 Submarine with Radio, Battery and Charger
review_body: This toy is great for presents and gifts. I think (as an opinion) is a great toy. Children could play with it all they want. Its a great toy. Get yours while it lasts!

product_title: Barbie KELLY Amusement Park Kelly Kiddie Coaster Playset (2001)
review_body: I'm new to buying Barbie playsets since my daughter is only 4.  But, my sister, who has bought playsets for her daughter who is now 12, had warned me about the worksmanship of Barbie toys.  This coaster set is yet another cute but flismy toy in the Barbie lineup.  The handle that is used to crank the coaster and ride keeps falling off.  I've taken the whole thing apart twice now in vain to try to snap everything in place better, hoping the handle would stay on.  No such luck!  The directions advise that the base of the ride is to be held while the handle is being turned.  I've also noticed that you have to push the handle in while turning it to make it stay attached longer.  Adults can do this with no problems, but a child who is turning the handle and trying to see the Kelly dolls go around the ride, is not going to do this.  It was a very cute idea, and my daughter loves it, but from a parent standpoint, it could have been made better. After all, what fun is the toy if the handle that operates the main attractions of the toy (coaster and ferris wheel), keeps falling off?  Maybe I'll have better luck with a dab of super glue.

product_title: LeapFrog Hug & Learn Baby Tad Plush
review_body: My son has had this toy for a long time. He is now getting interested in it. When he was younger, he would not play with it.  Now at 2 1/2, he loves it.  I think 6mos is a little young for the age for this toy.  My son just wasn't interested in it.  Now he can push the buttons and understand what it is saying to him. I would recommend this toy, but for a older child.

product_title: My Little Baby: Totally Interactive Baby Sydney
review_headline: Cute fun at a small cost
review_body: My girls each received a My Little Baby from the Easter Bunny.  They love them!  They are 6 and 3.  The youngest just wants to \\"feed\\" hers but my 6 year old can get the doll to interact with her.  While the babies are a little loud for their size, they are by no means distracting or even annoying.  And the best part is that they can be shut off---unlike other electronic interactive toys.  Pretty cute toys for minimal cost!

product_title: Triumph 5 Comfort Touch Car Seat with LATCH - Rockefeller
review_body: We did a lot of research and decided to buy this car seat before our baby was born.  So glad we bought this seat and not an infant seat because our son is now nearly 20 pounds at four months!  It has been comfortable for him from when he was just born (9 pounds) and is comfortable now.  This is a great car seat, very safe, great reviews, good buy.

product_title: Harley Davidson Barbie Collectible Ken Doll #2
review_body: This Ken doll is one of the most handsome dolls created.  He is in leather!!! He has rooted hair!!!!Facial Hair!!!What more could Barbie ask for????Well maybe one developed in AA perhaps!!  A girl takes what she can get:}

product_title: Mighty Beanz Series 2 (6-Pack)
review_body: Mighty Beanz are great.  They are little collectible plastic beans that you can collect and put in a giant collectors box.  You can buy 3 packs and 6 packs and it comes with a guide about Mighty Beanz that will tell you about the secret club greeting, the Mighty Beanz points and the rare Mighty Moose bean.  I am 8 years old and I love them and so do my 5 year old sister and 3 year old brother.  They can be very fun but be careful not to lose them because they are pretty small.

product_title: Digital Blue: QX3 Microscope
review_headline: Well worth the money to spark interest in  a child!
review_body: I bought this for my 12 year old niece. She thought it was "cool". And it gave her something else to do with the family PC. I am hoping it sparks an interest in the world of science when she enters high school,"before you know it". I believe It is a more thoughful gift than more clothes, a cell phone, CD player, etc... Well worth the money. And it will still be around when her 8 year old sister assumes ownership. This is an upgraded version of the NA32 model that was a hot item at christmas. It is only a software update. I would recomend this for any family with pre-teens.

product_title: Stare! Junior Board Game - 2nd Edition
review_headline: Greatr for encouraging attention spans and memory
review_body: If you think you'll get ill playing yet another game of Chuts and Ladders, Monopoly or Candyland, here's a pleasant change of pace - a game ADULTS and CHILDREN can enjoy. I absolutely love this game and so does my son because it is challenging for both of us. If your child has a hard time playing this game solo, it can be played in teams and the questions are just hard enough to keep kids on the ball without being too hard. It is also fast-paced and doesn't drag like so many games can. Best of all, it is good for children from 6 to 12 (and even older) so it will last for some time before the interest wears out.

product_title: Imaginext Battle Castle With Enemy Dungeon, Medieval
review_headline: Skip the castle and buy the figures
review_body: I teach Kindergarten and bought all the sets to go with the Battle Castle.  The kids love the toy, but never play with anything except the figures.  The building itself is hard to put together and falls apart easily.  I was very disappointed.

product_title: Educational Insights Name That Country Game
review_headline: Game is not for 3 year olds!
review_body: The game is rated for 8 years and above.  It would be quite impossible for most 3-5 year olds to play, since reading is required. I believe there is an error on Amazon's age rating.  However, my 7 year old and I enjoy playing. And, after my daughter brought it to her 1st grade class, her school teacher asked where she could purchase the game, because it is fun and educational.

product_title: Barbie Happy Family Neighborhood - Midge & Baby (Aa)
review_body: It took awhile before I finally found this doll.   We had the accesories long before the this doll came out.   My daughter and I both love to play with not only this doll, but Ryan and Allan also.   I just wish we could have been able to find Nikki (1st Birthday) by herself.  Oh well.   We enjoy everything in this collection.   Hopefully they will come out with a complete dollhouse.

product_title: LeapFrog Learning Table
review_body: I always reccomend the leap frog table to peolpe I know.  My son especially loved it when he was first pulling up. He's walking now and still loves to stand and try all the buttons and levers. There are a number of different switches/instruments and they all trigger a sound or song.

product_title: Little Tikes Buzz About Mailbox
review_body:
My three year old will still play with this at times. My two year old girl has had a ball with this toy. They enjoy playing mailman and getting mail and sending mail. They enjoy all the pieces that click and move and so on.
If you are like me and appreciate toys that are fairly quiet, easy to play with, fun and durable, this is a good toy to buy.
It encourages both small and gross motor skills. It encourages creative play and imagination and exploration of the world.
I would consider this toy well worth the money.
Enjoy

product_title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Combat Lair
review_body:
This toy is really fun. first it comes with this ooze stuff that doesnt stain the carpet and doesnt ruin the figures or play set. It may be a little frustrating putting it togeather but the instructions were very deatailed. Heres a tip: dont lose the pieces or else will not be able to use it. put it togeather in a wide open space so you can always find the pieces.
I had no trouble with the pieces togeather (maybe the other review people had a deffective set lol)
Anyway i would reccommned this toy to your kids. it is defidently worth the money !
oh yeah and one more thing about the ooze stuff is that you should always keep in in the plastic barrel that it comes in and not on the floor. or else you will have alot of stuff sticking to it like i do.

product_title: Fisher-Price Sweet Dreams Monitor
review_body: Not only does this monitor hum loudly, but we couldn't get the cover off the back of the portable unit so that we could change the battery.  You need to have a really long and super skinny screwdriver in order to change the battery.  Thus this monitor was useless for us and we are returning it.  Thank goodness we kept the box.

product_title: LEGO Harry Potter: Hogwarts Castle Set (4709)
review_body: Very disappointed. Very cool but disappointed. For the price paid, it was not worth it. The main castle falls apart easily.  End up putting it together twice. I was also lacking a few pieces from the set. I was missing Harry's hair and a few little items but I got extra \\"potion\\" pieces. You can't play with this. You put it together and don't touch it or it will fall apart. IN addition, the stairs just wrap in circles to the touch. They don't stay firmly in place. Not worth what we paid for it.

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Aquarium Cradle Swing
review_body: I received this swing as a gift and now it is the only gift I would give to new moms. You should not have a baby and not have this swing.  My daughter loves the lights and the gentle action. The music is not annoying and the four different sounds are great for variety.  We have found that the ocean waves is much like the shushing sound I make to soothe her. She normally only sleeps for two hours in her cradle but will sleep up to four hours in the swing for a nap which is great for a much needed break for a new mom.  The only thing I wish is that it had a plug adaptor because we go through so many D batteries.

product_title: Fisher Price Twirlin' Whirlin Garden
review_body: My triplets received this toy for Christmas when they were 6 months old.  We didn't bring it out until they were 8 months old.  My daughter and son were very disturbed by the loud music and clanking blocks that continually were flying all over.  (My other son just stared at it.)  I couldn't believe it!  They are not fearful kids!  I put it away and brought it out 3 months later...as soon as they heard the music...they ran!  At this point I started to really look at the toy.  It has no educational value, the same song is played and it simply spins.  They enjoy toys that do more than "one" thing!  I do not recommend this toy.  It is so repetitive and meaningless.  I can't believe some of the reviewers actually like the music!  It has ONE song...how exciting is that to hear over and over and over?  Sorry Fisher Price, I usually LOVE your toys.  Not this one.

product_title: Radica Pocket Tetris Electronic Handheld Travel Game
review_headline: Thx to firstminster for noting most points of interest!
review_body:
Enjoy this game very much. It is a bit bulky; a slimmer version would be more helpful for carrying around. Navigation buttons are placed mainly for right-hand dominate players but I was able to adjust rather quickly - and agree with above, does tire the hand muscles with it's bulkiness and button placement. Screen could be improved - unless you have the light at the correct angle, screen is a little difficult to read. Even though it sounds like many negatives from above, I am very happy w/the game; it has many positives. Was able to keep my mind/reaction time/spatial judgement from idling/deteriorating while recovering from surgery which requires diff't sedating meds, etc. Plenty of levels and such to allow use at varying mental functioning abilities. Batteries last quite a while. I'm just waiting for a new version - less bulky and maybe with some added options that were on the floppy disks for PCs a looooonnngggg time ago (shoot, hope I'm not dating myself!). Also, again as mentioned by firstminster, if you have trouble with small print up close and don't have one of those magnifying sheets you can place on it, would suggest viewing product in person prior to purchase...
If you purchase, hope you enjoy it!

product_title: Deluxe Bouncer- Precious Moments
review_body: I love Precous Moments and got this as a shower gift.  Adorable - but my son HATED the music thing.  I think it scared him - and to tell you the truth I was not crazy about it, either.  It was loud and the lights were bright - with no way to adjust either.  So, I took that off - and he LOVED sitting in the vibrating chair....  until the vibrator broke when he was 3 months old.  We tried replacing the batteries - but the vibrator was shot!  Should we be blessed with more children - this is definitely NOT something that can be used for them!

product_title: Kick & Play Piano with Music, Sounds & Twinkling Lights
review_body: A little pricey for a babies toy. Offers about 15 minutes of attention each play time...get the picture parents.

product_title: Step2  Push Around Buggy (Pink)
review_headline: Not a good car by far!
review_body: First of all if you can get past the horrific noise from  pushing it on asphalt or concrete, it has to be almost deafing to the poor child thats in it.  The next down fall is the lack of sunshade and then that leaves, if you have a tall child with bigger feet, they won't fit in it for long,  My 11 month old's feet barely have room with shoes on.  So the buy this one early on if you want to get your money's worth.

product_title: Socker Boppers
review_body: these toys are so much fun, and the injuries are very minor.  i have a sock'em boppers tourey with my friends and we have only suffered 4 concussions from the fights in almost 5 weeks.  the best part is when they pop and instead of punching them with an air filled fist, you actually hit them very hard.  the next best part is when the seams break open and start hissing out air every time a blow is dealt.  along with the minor injuries come broken noses, open head wounds, and even fractured ribs.  so far, there has been 18 people who have gotten the wind knocked out of them.  although these injuries sound severe, they are all worth it when you beat the crap out of your best friends, and they wake up a week later with no memory of it.  i love them.

product_title: Personalitease
review_body: I originally bought this game to use the questions during therapy sessions.  However, I first played it with my family and we had a blast.  The questions allowed us to get to know interesting facts about each other while engaging in rather clever banter.  It was difficult to determine who responded when three of my sisters responded to the question in the same way.  We did need to sensor some of the cards due to young children being in the room (not to mention our parents!)  The game was timely and hillarious.  Buy it, you'll have fun.

product_title: Ocean Wonders Aquarium
review_body:
I bought the Ocean Wonders Aquarium because it looked very cute and I hoped it would be a bit better than the Peaceful Planet Aquarium. My son used the PP Aquarium for almost 2 years and loved it. The only reason we aren't using it now is the motor seems to be going and is getting loud.
If it weren't for the loud pump noise for the bubbles, I would keep this item. However, I'm also disappointed that the volume control doesn't go lower than it does and that the unit doesn't stay on longer. I've tried using it for my 7 month old but she has no interest in it and it's too loud to soothe her to sleep. This will be returned.

product_title: Boppy Pillow - Baby Bees
review_body: I am a new mom, who does not breastfeed, and just love the boppy! I don't know how many times in the past that I would feed a baby and end up with sore arms after holding them so long.  The boppy eliminates all that!  I even sometimes sit my son in the boppy on the couch next to me to feed him.  He loves it and his doctor was also happy I was using it.  The doctor told me it is useful because it elevates his head while he is eating to prevent him from getting so much gas. A MUST HAVE FOR ALL NEW MOMS....NOT JUST FOR THOSE THAT ARE BREASTFEEDING.

product_title: The Wiggles Activity Game by Univeristy Games
review_body: We love the Wiggles but this game's design is truly horrific. Before you can even play ten sets of cards have to be sorted into piles. The sorting is more educational than the game itself. The activities are almost too easy even for a pre-reader but you cannot play this game unless you are a reader or are playing with one. This game is way too easy for the recommended six to ten year olds. (eg: \\"Name something red\\") The instructions make no sense and the progress of the game is dreadfully slow. Just stay away from this game! Even the most ardent Wiggles fans will be bored. And parents - you will be haunted by the memory of being dragged into playing this game for a long time....

product_title: To Know You Is To Love You / I told You So
review_body: This ballpit keeps my 22 month old and her 3 boy cousins, 9, 7, and 3, occupied the entire time they visit. I blew it up by myself in short order. The big nose end of the whale took the longest, all the other chambers are small and didn't take too long to blow up. It stands up really well when the nose is tucked in and closed, but it tends to lean to one side when the nose is open. We think it needs more balls to make it really fun. We took it outside for the Fourth of July and put it by the blowup pools and the boys filled up the bottom with water and had a lot of fun playing in it. Great toy for the price!

product_title: Spy Gear Spy Listener
review_headline: i think this toy is good
review_body: I think the spy listener from wild planet is a great toy the only thing is i could not here the best but asides from that its really cool also the way it fits on you head is odd but overall its a good toy

product_title: Training Rewards Soft Seat Potty & Stepstool
review_body: This is the second potty I bought my son.  The first one he didn't like at all and I thought he would never be potty trained.  Then I found this potty. It is comfortable and sturdy.  Also the bowl is big enough so there is little if any messes on the floor.  Right before my son's third birthday he was potty trained!  I owe it all to this great potty!! I would recommend highly.

product_title: 7 oz. Magic Cup Trainer - 6 Pack
review_body: I have to admit these cups were excellent against spilling.  However when it came down to cleaning the plastic pieces it was a pain in the neck.  Eventually I broke off the hard plastic peice do to the difficulty of cleaning.

product_title: LeapFrog Learning Drum
review_body:
With this toy, your child is more likely to get ADD than a PhD. (ADD = attention deficit disorder)
I see Vegas, not Harvard, as the more likely future for children who play with this obnoxious toy.
The toy is bosy and shallow.
Sure, it has lights and noise, but only at times with purpose.
It's the educational equivalent of cotton candy.
Any toy that has to repetitively tell you how fun it is to play with probably isn't. ("Hit the drum, it's FUN!")
I had high hopes for this toy based on the other reviews. Unfortunately, I dislike it so much (my daughter isn't interested in it, either - even the box it came in was more interesting) I'm going through the hassle of sending it back.
Spend your money on something else.

product_title: Yugioh Starter Deck - Yugi
review_headline: These cards are great for kids
review_body: I think these are great toys for young kids. They can trade for new cards so they dont always have the same cards, and the kids love them.

product_title: Kim Possible KIMMUNICATOR WALKIE TALKIES
review_body: You can play Kim Possible with this Toy!(...)It is so cute! It has flashing pictures of Kim and Wade and Ron.too!Any Fan of Kim Possible should get this toy!

product_title: Ocean Wonders Aquarium
review_body: I received this for my twins for Christmas. They were 2 months old and they absolutely love it.  When they are cranky I can turn on the aguarium and the love looking at it.  You can adjust the music volume, turn on or off the lights and motion.  The only thing I didn't like about it is that it does not stay on for a long enough period of time for my girls. I'm thinking of buying a second one so both cribs have one.

product_title: Ocean Wonders Aquarium
review_headline: "they don't make 'em like they used to"
review_body: We had the Peaceful Planet aquarium for our first son and we ALL loved it. In fact, until it finally gave out (after 2 1/2 years of constant use) our son used it as entertainment and to help him sleep every afternnon/night. We bought this version when it first came out because it looked so much cooler than the first and we needed a new one for our second son. We spent a lot of time trying to find it because it was widely advertised long before its availability. What a disappointment!! We wish we wouldn't have wasted so much time trying to find it. It's not as sturdy, the lights do not shine on the ceiling, the motor is too loud and drowns out the music and you can barely see the fish unless it is PITCH black in the room. Even the colors are not the same on the toy as what is on the package-not that it matters-just another point. We ended up returning it and purchasing another Peaceful Planet with which we have been very happy. So the old saying goes...newer isn't necessarily better.

product_title: Fisher-Price Musical Tea Set
review_headline: Wish I had this tea set when I was a kid!
review_body: My girls love it.  They are always playing TEA.  My girls are 2 and the size is perfect for their little hands.  The plastic seems durable and I think this toy will last for some time with normal use.  The \\"pouring\\" sound the tea pot makes can be annoying to parents, but the kids seem to love it.  The tea pot also plays \\"I'm a little tea pot\\" which is cute and my girls love it when I sing the song.

product_title: Ello Aquaria People Places & Things Set - 168 Pieces
review_body: My daughter, age 5, begged me for Ello because her friend got it for a birthday gift.  I was skeptical because she doesn't usually like lego type toys.  Now that we have it, we love it.  Since she's so young she requires assistance, but its fun for me too.  We both create characters and rooms for them to play in.  There's lots that she can do without me too - stickers and fantasy play once some pieces are put together.  We both like the colors and the wierd shapes.  Interestingly, what I like about it my husband doesn't:  the shapes and colors.

product_title: LeapFrog Learning Table
review_body: This activity table definitily outranks all other activity tables. My 13 month old has been playing with this since he was 9 months. There are so many aspects to learning for him to continue to discover that we'll be playing with this for a long time to come.

product_title: Fisher-Price Deluxe Jumperoo
review_body: Our son is 6 months old and loves to stand and jump.  I saw this product in a Fisher Price product flier around Christmas time but couldn't find it on the shelves anywhere. At the time my son was only a month old so I just kept checking around.  Finally in February, there it was.  I brought it home and put it together in just a couple of minutes.  Wow!  Assembly couldn't be any easier and no tools were required!  My son has been playing in this for the past three months and NEVER gets tired of it.  He loves the toys on the front and just screams with delight and starts jumping away as soon as he is put in it.  I really love this product and am recommending it to all of my friends who are expecting or have infants.  This was definately good money spent!

product_title: I Play My First Mobile Phone
review_body: My 11-month old daughter loves her father's cell phone, so we bought this mobile phone for her for Christmas.  At 11 months nothing really holds her attention for very long, but she really liked pushing the buttons, making the wheel spin by sliding the ladybug, and she really loves opening and closing it.  She likes hearing the short recorded messages we make.  I've read reviews of other toy phones that said the sound effects were too quiet to hear, which is not a problem with this phone.  The sounds are clear and loud enough to hear without being too loud.  Overall my daughter likes this toy and it keeps her away from her Daddy's cell phone.

product_title: Melissa & Doug
review_body: My son couldn't get enough of the Food Box from the same company, so I bought him this and now he loves them both!  These are great complimentary toys that play well together and give my son hours of entertainment away from the TV.  At this price, I recommend buying this for any 3-5 year olds that you are shopping for (even for birthday party presents!)

product_title: Sunshine Symphony
review_body: This is a toy that YOU, the parent, will actually enjoy listening to.  Many musical toys tend to grate on my nerves after a while, but I could listen to this one for a long time!  The toy has one setting for continuously playing music and another that plays an 8-count (if memory serves me correctly) every time your child bumps it.  The sensor is very sensitive, so you child doesn't need to bang on it to get the musical reward.  I take this toy along for stroller rides, and the music plays constantly from the bumps--and my 11 month old daughter and I BOTH enjoy listening to it!  She also likes to touch it and feel the extra features, but it is the musical quality with great classical tunes that make this toy a real winner!  My only complaint is that there should be more songs to listen to!

product_title: Neopets Deluxe Portable Pocket Player MERIDELL
review_body: This game is so much fun! It has six games, three shops, a bank account and more! Plus it comes with three characters to play with. You learn about saving money when you spend and earn Neopoints. 5 stars!

product_title: Fisher Price Noah's Ark
review_headline: Another great addition to your Little People collection
review_body:
My 3 year old daughter received this for her birthday. We have many different sets of Little People but this one is definately her favourite because of the animals. She likes to line them all up, march them in the ark, march them out, put them in, put them out. It keeps her happy for hours as she role plays. The Little People range really keeps our 3 children busy and they have excellent fun with role play. They group animals and people together or all the blond hair and all the dark hair people. There are so many great educational things with this toy.
As with all Fisher Price we are finding this Noah's Ark extremely durable and easy to wash if you have to clean it.
And it's also a great addition to your Little People collection.

Although I am not a Spanish speaker myself, my sister-in-law did notice that the bus sometimes speaks very quickly, which may be a bit difficult for a child trying to learn Spanish.

product_title: Battle Cry (Older 2000 Version)
review_body:
I picked up this game on a whim, hoping to get some of my family and friends interested in wargaming. I've been playing serious hex-grid and die-cut cardboard pieces wargames for 15 years, and I had some misgivings about playing a game with toy soldiers.
The pieces in the game are made of a flexible plastic that has proved very resilient. The terrain tiles are printed on a nice heavy cardboard. The cards, with proper care, show little wear.
Battle Cry uses a unique system of activiation. The battlefield is divided into thirds, with players issuing orders through their deck of cards. Orders vary from moving one or more units in one sector of the field, to more powerful cards that allow for more balanced movement. Only the player whose turn it is conducts fire, and only those units which have been activated by cards may fire.
After reviewing the rules for 10 minutes my father and I played our first game. I was immediately struck by the fluidity of the battle. Fortune ebbed and flowed as each player's deck of command cards changed. Spent units rallied, reinforcements appeared at critical points of the field. Attacks bogged down as command control waned with the depleted decks. At the end of my first game I was struck by how much our contest had resembled a real Civil War battle. Over a year later I'm still hooked! This is not only the best beginner-level wargame I've played, it is one of the best PERIOD.

product_title: Furreal Friends Cat
review_body: I'm allergic to cats and my daughter has wanted one for  so long.  So when she saw these she wanted one DESPERATLEY  for Christmas, I finally found one by happy accident at a retail store the Friday before Christmas.  It was just what she wanted.  She couldn't be more thrilled.  I personally couldn't understand what all the fuss was about.  It is very noisy and just like real cats--it sheds!

My daughter gets quite frustrated because we keep having to shake the elephant's trunk and \\"reload\\" the butterflies.
