I like how it has a bigger display area and toy's so baby can play but I miss how the other one was shaped like a little fish bowl and it did a kind of picture show on the cieling.  This is still a great product just I don't see how it's been upgraded much.  In fact, it seems to have been downgraded.

product_title: Fisher-Price Peek-a-Blocks Tumblin' Sounds Giraffe
review_body: I have 6 month old twins who enjoy the peek-a-boo blocks.  Just looking at them holds their attention and inspires them to learn to \\"rake\\" the toys towards them to get a closer look.  My 3 year old enjoys showing his brothers how the blocks go down the giraffe, and they all like the little jingle it plays.  I've read the negative reviews on this toy and I think people are over anaylzing a simple toy.

product_title: LeapFrog Fridge Phonics Magnetic Alphabet Set - Styles May Vary
review_body: My son received this at his 3rd birthday party and he hasn't stopped playing with it since!  He already recognizes his letters, but he is fascinated to know those letters make sounds.  He'll sit for 30 minutes to an hour in front of the refridgerator placing the different letters in the base to hear what they say.  Later on, I'll hear him in his room singing what he just learned, \\"B says Buh...B says Buh.  Every letter makes a sound.  B says Buh.\\"  This toy develops language development, creativity, and motor skills.  Bonus:  It keeps the kids in sight while you're trying to cook!

product_title: Triumph 5 Comfort Touch Car Seat with LATCH - Rockefeller
review_headline: Very Lucky to have this Car Seat
review_body: I am giving this car seat 5 stars because I was just involved in a very serious, 6 car pile up.  My 2 1/2 yr. old son was with me.  This seat didn't budge.  He didn't have one bump or scratch on him.  Since we can't use the seat after it's involved in an accident, I have to buy a new one.  I am DEFINITELY going to buy the same seat.  Car seats aren't just about our convenience, it's about safety, and I recommend this one 100%!!

product_title: Monopoly
review_body: How can you not love Monopoly? Okay, a well-played game can take hours, but that was how my brother and I always managed to con babysitters into letting us stay up late when we were kids. We HAD to finish the game, after all! : ) You can even turn it in to an an educational game, learning about strategy and planning and saving money. But mostly it's just a fun American classic board game.

product_title: 1 X Crayola Sand Picture Art
review_headline: Everything is wrong with this toy
review_body:
Concept of using sand to color is great, but this toy isn't the answer. The sand jams the release so that sand pours out of the exit at any time (onto the floor), the hole to return sand back into the bottles through the funnel is too small (onto the floor), the door comes off the hinges easily, the stickers give you papercuts, the instructions are unclear as to how you should go about approaching the design of your art, the supply of sand and pictures is extremely limited (how much could a little more sand cost?).
Most kids would not be able to do this without an adult to not only supervise, but do it for them. We had sand all over our kitchen floor. My daughter thought the sand was cool, but it made me furious.
If you're thinking \\"hey, this is an inexpensive toy, it's not that big of an investment if it doesn't work out\\": you'll be eating your words with sand in your mouth and papercuts under your fingernails... Move on if you're thinking of this toy. Crayola really made a bomb here.

product_title: Fisher-Price Rescue Heroes Command Center
review_body: WE OWN ALMOST EVERY RESCUE HERO ITEM AVAILABLE, AND WATCH FOR THE NEW ONES TO COME OUT!! MY SON IS 6 HE IS ADDICTED TO THEM THEY ARE THE BEST! HE CAN PLAY ANY CHARACTER, WHEN HE WATCHES ONE OF THE MOVIES HE GETS OUT EACH HERO AND ACTS IT OUT WITH THE MOVIE. THESE ARE A LIKE BARBIES, YOU CAN NEVER HAVE TOO MANY, AND IT DOESN'T MATTER IF YOU HAVE DOUBLES, BECAUSE THEN YOUR FRIENDS GET TO PLAY TOO!!!

product_title: Sharon Osbourne
review_headline: The Wicked Witch of the West has nothing on Sharon Osbourne
review_body:
...or so she says, in one of the three pre-recorded messages played through the colorful plastic base that comes with her action figure.
Little Sharon has six points of articulation (neck, shoulders, wrists and waist), including a ball joint that makes head movement more versatile. The lack of elbow articulation means her bent elbows stay bent (just like the Kelly figure), limiting her mobility. The face sculpt is dead on, and the expression is perfect. Like the other Osbourne figures, this one has slightly oversized feet, which help to stabilize the figure when you're not using the base that's included.
Sharon probably has the best accessories of the bunch: a shopping bag, a ham (for tossing over the fence at loud neighbors), and a squeezeable pooping dog. (Don't squeeze TOO hard or the pooper will pop!) This item isn't really intended for kids, but is a gem for action figure and/or Pop Culture collectors. If you'd like to keep some kind of memento of the MTV series, the whole set of Osbourne figures gets my top recommendation, after the uncut DVD collection.

product_title: Grandmaster Chess Set
review_body: This is probably the nicest of the cheap toy store sets out there. At least the squares are not red and black. The pieces are nice and durable plastic.  You can get a true regulation chess set for the same or little more money. Unless you think you may be playing tournament chess though this set will do nicely. I am a tournament chess player and ordered ten of these sets for a local middle school chess club. They fit on the desk tops better than a regulation set and didn't set the school back too much. I would recommend this for someone who wants to give chess a try.

product_title: Musical Activity Walker
review_headline: Momma to the Bean and the Bear
review_body: I was very disappointed in this toy - it really doesn't do very much - the only activity that seems to interest my 7 month old is the smily face in the center.  The sounds do not play very often in response to his playing.  It is sturdy - he uses it to pull himself up and it hasn't teetered once.  When our son is given the choice of this toy or one of his others, he always chooses the other.  Next time I would spend the extra 5 or 10 dollars for a more exciting toy.

product_title: Lamaze Play & Grow: Celeste
review_body:
I placed this toy on our registry and it was one of the best things we could have asked for. My three month old son loves it! I introduced it to him when he was a month old. His eyes lit up and he couldn't stop staring at it. As he became more coordinated he started reaching for it and laughing at the squeeky ladybug. Now he grabs each of the stretchy arms and puts them in his mouth! The star and orange triangle seem to be pretty tasty.
He used to really focus just on the beautiful sun, but now he's noticed the moon on the other side. He has great fun turning the toy around and looking at both sides.
We've hung other toys from his play arch, and he's ignored almost all of them -- for this one! He plays with it everyday. We can't leave without attaching his Sunshine Friend to his stroller or car seat.

product_title: Lord of the Rings - Fellowship of the Ring - Sauron W/electronic Lights and Sounds
review_body: I felt let down when I first saw Sauron in the movie because you never \\"see\\" Sauron in the book.  However, I thought he is an absolute 'must have' for the collection.  When I recieved this action figure I was completely blown away by the detail and how much movement he has.  The sound and light-up eyes are great too.  For anyone that enjoys a very well made and awesome looking figure this one is definitely worth buying.

product_title: Fisher Price Disney Princess - SPIN 'N SURPRISE CASTLE - My First Princess
review_body: I did not have big expectations when I bought this but both 2 and 4 year olds love it!  It is simple enough for a 2 year old to easily manipulate but the variety of dolls and the palace hold the interest of a 4 year old.  And it is different enough from other doll houses to be fun.  Having several princesses also helps minimize problems with sharing and fighting (not elminate, minimize!).  Well designed, fun and easy to operate.

product_title: VTech - V.Smile Pull n' Play Phone
review_headline: Annoying in more ways than one
review_body: My daughter got this for her first birthday. She adores phones, but this one goes to the bottom of the toy pile. The cord is way too short. When she tries to put it next to her ears, the phone comes off the ground and hits her. The noise the phone makes is also very annoying. If I forget to turn off the sound, it will continue talking from the bottom of the toy box long after my daughter has discarded it. Most of the toys that she doesn't use anymore go into the charity pile, but I won't torture another mother or child with this one.

product_title: Fisher Price Sparkling Symphony Xylophone
review_headline: Twin girls and 3 year old boy  LOVE this toy!
review_body: A dear friend gave this toy to my 10 month old girls for Christmas and they just adore it.Emily has always liked to bang on things so the attatched "wand" is right up her alley and Julia loves the action/reaction of pressing something and having it light up. The whole thing is magical to them and you can see it in their eyes as the lights and music race up and down with each other. Even my 3 year old likes to get in on the action and claims that it was his Christmas present;) So far it's been dropped from the high chair to the wood floor several times with no problems.  We love this toy!

product_title: Mattel Classic Football Handheld Game
review_headline: Mattel Football - BLAST from the PAST
review_body: When I first saw this toy it brought back a flood of great memories. I had the original version when I was a child in the 70's. My 9 year old son plays Nintendo Gameboy and he was suprised to find out that I played handheld games when I was a child. It looks and plays like the original and is a lot of fun. I keep it on my desk at work and you would be suprised the amount of people that pass by, notice it and say \\" Hey, I had one of those when I was a kid. \\"

product_title: The Wiggles Sing-With-Me Microphone
review_body:
My son, 2, picked out the microphone at the store the other day. He hasn't stopped playing with it since. It is a very cool toy. He has the guitar and I like that most of the songs on the microphone are different than the guitar (2 are the same but those are 2 of his favorites). The microphone feature is pretty cool as well. My son has occasionally has to tell me it is his turn because I will end up singing to the songs as well.
The only bad thing about this toy is that the on off switch is a big button that is right where little hands are. I told my son that is the off button and only to press the people-he understands but for someone younger it may be difficult.

product_title: The Wiggles Big Red Car
review_body: We got this for our 20 month old son for Christmas and he absolutely loves it.  He carries it around and sings the \\"Toot Toot Chugga Chugga Big Red Car\\" all the time.  It's been durable so far, so if your kids like the Wiggles, it is a definite must have.

product_title: Lamaze - Tug & Play Knot Block
review_body: IT IS SIX TOYS IN ONE!!!  This is the first toy that held our son's interest for any length of time.  He loves the sounds shapes and taste of the parts.  As an added bonus, if he drops it from the stroller you can hear it hit the ground so it doesn't get lost.  A great gift for a new mom.

product_title: Stroller Arch Tropical by Tiny Love
review_headline: Doesn't stay on the car seat
review_body: I bought this for my son last weekand put it on his car seat yesterday. He was screaming in the backseat yesterday and I turned to find the silly thing laying on his face. The clips on the sides are not strong enough.

product_title: Colorado Backpack
review_body: Wow!! I agree with the reviews that were alreay written, but had to write one myself.  I have two boys, ages 2 and 3 months.  I was carrying two bags until I thought this was crazy.  I had to give up my old Land's End bag and get a bigger one.  I opted for a backpack because my husband and I are avid hikers and also with two kids, you must have two hands free.  This bags hold EVERYTHING for my kids and still leaves room for me.  Thank you Babies 'R Us and the help I received in picking out this bag.  The girl told me that this was the bag I was looking for and she was absolutely right.

product_title: Fisher-Price Dora We Did It! Dancing Dora
review_body: My little brother has this doll and loves it! He thinks it's great because he loves Dora, he sings the song, ...

product_title: LeapFrog: Turbo Twist Spelling-colors may var
review_headline: Turbo Twist Spelling - Kids love to learn
review_body: My son is 7 years old and he has played with the TurboTwist Spelling game non-stop since we saw it in the store. The best thing about this toy is that the child can sign in and the game remembers the progress they have made. Also, it is upgradeable, that is once they've learned a certain number of words you can buy a cartridge or download from the Internet and begin with more difficult words. Versatile and super fun to use, Leapfrog has outdone themselves with this toy. Highly Recommended.

product_title: Barbie CD Boom Box with Tape Recorder and Microphone
review_body: I just got this for my daughter's 5yr old birthday and she loves it!  The only disappointment was the microphone doesn't pickup unless your mouth is touching it and there is no on/off button for the mic that can be switched on and off.  Rather there is a button that the child must keep pressed down w/ her finger while singing.

product_title: Shrek 2 Deluxe Ogre Micro Playset - Far Far Away Castle
review_body: We were excited to assemble this playset only to quickly realize that it's a very poorly constructed toy.  From the get-go, removable pieces couldn't even stay in place and pieces were either falling off or tipping over.  Definitely a frustrating thing for a young child.  For the price that was paid, it should have been more durable.  The only impressive thing about it is the detail they put into how the castle looks.  Unfortunatly, I consider only one (out of two) main pieces of the castle to be functional (and somewhat entertaining) with its trap doors and levers.  The second part is useless and is already stuffed in a bag with all its pieces fallen off--and we just bought it an hour ago!  I'd invest in the action figures, which are better constructed, not these playsets.  Truly a disappointment.

review_headline: Great set but something seems wrong...
review_body: I am a huge fan of Aliens and Predator, I even have some card from the set of Aliens vs. Predator movie. This set was a must have but the thing is flimsy, the Alien isn't painted that well and the Predator should have his mask as an acessory. But that didn't stop me from buying it. I kept it in the box, never opened along with my over McFarlane Delux Sets on my dresser. If you are looking for a durable toy THIS ISN'T THE AWNSER, they fall off the pegs Very easily. But if your a collector like me, keep it in the box (It looks A little better anyways.)

review_body: This is the best diaper disposal system out there! I wouldn't even try any other! You definetley can not smell anything until you take the bag out but hey with 40 or so stinky diapers, how can you now smell something???

review_body: I have a 1 year old and a 3 year old. Both were bored with it after about 3  minutes. it is in the play room and they never have played with it since the time we put it together. that was a year ago. ...

product_title: Boppy Pillow - Baby Bees
review_body: I too found the boppy to be a little snug to use when I breastfed.  I recieved mine as a gift from the birthing center when I had my daughter.  My husband likes it to help feed her when I give her a bottle.  I also use it to help her sit up on the floor and at the computer while I work (she likes the colorful pictures).  It's not recommened to let your child to on the pillow, they have one specially designed to use for sleeping.

review_body:
The draciel is a good beyblade but i can beat it with my bearing stinger and my master draciel and my driger f and my customised beyblade.
p.s. Dont get a spark knight because i shattered one the other day with my bearing stinger.

product_title: LeapFrog Fridge Phonics Magnetic Alphabet Set - Styles May Vary
review_headline: My 3 year old twin boys love this
review_body: My 3 year old twin boys received this for Christmas and has played with it everyday since. Less then a month after Christmas they know the letters and their sounds. It amazing how quickly they have taken to the toy. Out of all the toys they have received they have learn the most from Fridge Phonics and have kept the most interested in. (...) this is the best toy bought.

product_title: Koala Baby - Satin Edge Fleece - Pink
review_headline: Sooooo soft!  I want one for my bed!
review_body: I envy my little baby girl who'll be wrapped up in this when we deliver in a few weeks!  I wanted a blankie for her with the satin edge (big hit with my first daughter who's now 8) and the soft fleece makes this one the perfect snuggler!  I like that it's bigger than most baby blankets, so she'll get some use out of it as a toddler too.  Even my 8 year old wants one now so it looks like we'll by buying another one!

product_title: PEEK-a-Blocks 2-in-1 Activity Wagon
review_body: I purchased the activity wagon for my 12 month old son. He thoroughly enjoys playing with it.  He is delighted by the lights and I find it to be his favorite toy.  He did once get his finger pinched by the wheels and my only complaint is that they should have put some sort of lock on them.  Over all, I find it to be a good deal for my money.

product_title: Easy Store Sand and Water
review_body: The concept is great and it looks like a ton of fun, and it is for the kids.  But for the parents, we found it very difficult to secure it open.  We are returning this because of that feature.  It just doesn't feel like it is completely locked in place when open and since the water side only has two legs, I can just see it collapsing in the middle sending my two kids and a rush of water all over the patio.  This is just a heads up for parents, and if you are reading this and the other reviews, then you are already ahead of the game when is comes to selecting the most safe toys for your kids.

product_title: Plush Comfy Cozy Puppy 24"
review_body:
We received this blue puppy blanket as a gift for our newly adopted daughter when she was eight months old. She showed a preference for it immediately over her other blankets or toys. She sleeps with this puppy every night, and at 15 months has now taken to dragging him everywhere.
We have washed the puppy numerous times and he looks like brand new. This toy is sooo soft. It is great for a tiny baby up to an older toddler. We will soon be buying another one to put in reserve in case bad luck should befall the original!

product_title: McFarlane - Movie Maniacs - Series 4 (MM4) - Jaws Deluxe Box Set w/Shark (Jaws), Boat and other custom figures and accessories
review_body: If you're a horror or just plain film fan you have to own this awesome piece of memorabilia.  Not so much a "toy" as a model it captures the thrilling ending of the classic, JAWS perfectly even coming with a little "Quint" that you can fit into JAW's gaping maw.  (How cute, he even comes apart at the waist revealing bloody innards, awwww!) The only gripe I have (call me crusty like good 'ol Quint I suppose) is that this is so much a sculpture and not a toy.  I would've liked to be able to close JAW's mouth or be able to remove him from the playset like their King Kong is able to.  These are minor gripes though it is still cool as all hell.  Suggestion: Make a JAWS 2 figure with a removeable JAWS shark or better yet make an 18" JAWS with a mini-Roy Schieder! Bottom line: Own this great Mcfarlane, you movie maniacs!!

product_title: Secret World Ocean Creatures Jigsaw Puzzle 100pc
review_body: I bought this puzzle for my two daughters.  It was more fun than I could have imagined! We put the puzzle together and then afterwards, had a blast searching for the tiny hidden images with the little magnifying glass included.  It was so fun, they took it apart and did it over again.  What a great idea for a puzzle.  Usually, we put it together and that's it.  This is like 2 activities for the price of one!

product_title: Hasbro Beyblade Tops Hidden Spirits Tops - Salamalyon / #A-34
review_body: This beyblade is awesome. It is a real powerhouse. With Salamalyon I beat 3 beyblade under 20 seconds. A must-have for any beyblader. It is my forth best beyblade out of Trygle, Driger S, Driger F, Dranzer F, Dragoon Fighter, and Burning Kerberous. It one of the best. Have fun and LET IT RIP!!!

product_title: Pacific Play Tents Teepee Play House Tent
review_body: My two sons recieved this as a gift for Christmas. I was discouraged with how easily it comes apart.  My 5-year old plays well with things, and isn't real rough.  He got very frustrated that the poles kept coming out and moving around. My 3-year old loves to watch movies in the tent though. He hides in it all of the time. It is a good item for the price. I wouldn't pay anymore for it though.

product_title: Disney Charades
review_body: Well my disney fanatic friend bought this game recently. It's charades with a difference. At first it's pretty fun but you keep having to recycle the cards and funnily enough, unless you're a disney fanatic you'll find it hard going.

product_title: Beyblade American Hasbro Driger-F Combination TypeA-24

review_body:
This beyblade is the best.I was battling with a master driger and i split its attack ring in half.It is really fast so i don't recomend this blade for begginers.You have to practice with it alot to be able to control it.If you want a blade that is strong i recomend this blade and to make a little bit stronger add a two weight disk.After adding this to my blade i had a battle with my neighbor.(he insisted on useing driger so i let him,i was useing a knight dranzer.)The battle was over befor the blades hit the stadium. product_title: Elite Force 21184 - US Army Black Hawk Helicopter
review_headline: I can't believe it is a toy
review_body: When I first saw this toy, it was a t work.One of the pilots had one in his office,when I saw it I was like a little kid and had to know where I could get one.I am in the Army and this is one of the aircraft I work on.The overall detail is amazing,in addition the scale is just wow.There are a couple tiny things that are wrong as for the actually systems on the aircraft ,for example the slime lights on the stabilator are on the bottom on the toy where as on the real aircraft they are located on the top.But with a little time and superglu it can be made right,other than that I think any child and adult alike will get many hours of joy out of it,in fact I have been thinking about purchasing a second one.

product_title: Fisher Price - Learn Thru Music System With Cartridge
review_headline: a little loud and good for two and up
review_body: My daughter rec'd this toy when she was just over one years old.  she has issues with using the mic,  you must hold the button down to make the mic work.  i also wished that the volume was able to be adjusted.

product_title: Gundam Perfect Grade Model
review_body:
This model kit is Japanese version, not American version.
All manuals are written by Japanese, however you can build completely.
Original price of this kit is 1500 Yen.
This is not a toy, this kit is fragile.
You must be careful when you fabricate the parts.

product_title: Fisher-Price Baby Playzone Kick and Whirl Carnival
review_body:
I nanny for a 6 month old child. We purchased this for him when he was 3 months old and he could not take more than a minute or two of the lights and music, it was totally overwhelming to him. He would kick the bottom and it wouldn't move, but if he kicked the floor in front of it the lights and music would start. I found that he got bored during the 5 minutes of music, and that doesn't teach cause and effect very well at all. I have always turned it on to the second setting (a short set of music) and it works the same. Since he was not impressed with this toy we borrowed a playskool's product (kick start gym) and he loves it. It responds only when he kicks in the button (which is big and easy to push). He loves to watch the wheels spin and listen to the noises it plays.

Now that he is old enough I have moved it to the second position and sit him in my lap and use the toy myself. He can watch it for hours and I think he will enjoy it when he is old enough to use it himself...

If I had to do it again I would not purchase the same product.

product_title: Risk: The Game of Global Domination (2003)
review_body: A great game my husband got me into.  I would suggest playing with at least 3 players, because if only two play (certainly in our house,) whoever gets to go first usually wins.  If you don't want a game where you have to think, don't get it.  Also watch the pieces if you've got small children, and low VCR's!

product_title: UNO Attack!
review_body:
This game is a blast! We got it for the holidays to play with family and friends, and there seems to be no end to the laughter when playing this addictive game. It's for 2-10 players, and you could play with just two, but the more the merrier. People really seem to enjoy watching another player get loaded up with cards when they have to "hit." Also, the addition of some new cards, such as "Trade Hands", has really spiced up the game.
My seven year old twins love to play games, and finally we have a game that they can play right along with the adults and everyone has fun.

product_title: LEGO Spider-Man 2: Doc Ock's Fusion Lab
review_body: My son love all lego. He's no a fan of spiderman, but love this toy. Only thing to watch out.Don't lose the very small crank.

product_title: Hot Wheels Cyborg City Playset with Electronic Lights & Sounds and Motorized Power Charger Booster
review_body: I vowed I would never buy Hot Wheels again because, aside from the cars, I've never had one of their products pass the durability test ... that it does what its supposed to without falling apart. I broke down and bought this for my son after much bantering.  Result?  Back to the store it went for a refund, with my son asking 'Mom, why doesnt it work like it did on TV?'  Hmmm,  good question..........

product_title: LEGO Sports: NHL Slammer Stadium
review_body:
My son (11 yo) loves Legos... he also loves hockey. I didn't think Legos could make a good game of hockey, but I was wrong. This set happens to be the game that beat out the Xbox on Christmas morning.
We had a great time setting everything up, and then the fun REALLY started as we played two-on-two hockey with some blocky looking robot-like players.
Nevermind that it's not really like skating, and that they can't really shoot hard when pushing down their heads... the fun came from developing our own set of \\"rules\\" as to how to play the game (don't be surprised if you start playing with the players like the old rod hockey games... spinning them by the head).
Great creative toy... my son's now working on making his Bionicles play hockey.
A side note. While most of the players don't hit a very solid shot, the Slap Shot player -- just like his namesake -- fires a BLISTERING shot. We may be drafting a couple of those to see how our game evolves...

product_title: BladeZ Moby Extreme 35cc Gas Power Scooter
review_headline: I would get the Go-Ped brand scooter
review_body:
I wanted to ride with all my other buddies because thay all have Go-Peds. Ended up getting one of the Bladez and now wish I spent my money on a Go-Ped brand scooter. Go-Peds are truly the one to get. Hard to service the Bladez and it seems like I always need to replace or repair something on it so it sits around more then I spend time riding.
Best advice I can give you is... Remember this one thing when you are looking for a scooter. Where are you going to get the parts and service when you need it. So do yourself a favor and find an authorized store that can handle repairs and service near you! The goped site is a good place to start since I now know that goped has a dealer finder tool on their site to help you find an autorized dealer near you.
Its never any fun when you spend now more money getting something you should have got in the first place.
Happy scooting.

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Aquarium Cradle Swing
review_body: This is such a life saver!!  We have placed my daughter in it since she was 2 weeks old.  I love how it is so adjustable.  The motor is a little loud, but you get used to it and the babies love it.  It also seems fast at first, but you quickly realize that as they get heavier you need those faster settings!  My daughter is 4 months old now and still enjoys the light and mobile.  When she had the sniffles, I felt comfortable letting her sleep at night in it so she could breathe better.  She gets to swing while my husband and I eat dinner, and she loves to swing while I do work on the computer.  I could not have survived the first few weeks of motherhood without this toy.  I thought that she needed to be held all of the time, and the swing actually let me get things done (like take a shower and get dressed!).  I think that all babies should have this swing.  I have heard that they are making a travel one...I will definitely get that one too!

product_title: Easy Bake Bundle - Oven and Mixes
review_body:
Ok I love Easy Bake too! My daughter and I are having a blast making little cakes and what a flash back to a Christmas long ago...
My daughter is 5 so she isn't using this on her own but it has been a fun project to do together. And for some reason it is just completely different than helping mom with the \\"real\\" cooking.
BRING ON THE EASY BAKE!

product_title: Globonz
review_body: Anything that will keep 3 boys busy is an A+ in my book. The best toy purchase I've ever made.

product_title: Mobile Suit Gundam: Zeonic Front
review_headline: Good Game But SO SO HARD!
review_body: This game is fantastic yet the missions get progresively harder and if you watch the anime special movie, or the basic Gundam series, you find out that the Principality of Zeon ultimately loses which doesn't do much for your morale fighting for the losing team.  Still great game, the controls are somewhat complicated and the strategy element is there but you really have to play it to get it.

product_title: Radio Control Mercedes-Benz CLK DTM 1000 1/12 Scale (27 MHz)
review_body: I have recently bought this car it, is the best rc I,ve ever owned.Me and my friends have been racing and this is really fast.I Was just fooling around and hit some curbs, jumped off them and nothinh happend to the car. I recomend this to anyone looking for racing action!

product_title: McFarlane's SportsPicks NHL Hockey Series #7: #11 Owen Nolan in White Toronto Maple Leafs Uniform
review_headline: Toys R Us Ship this Toy to Canada, Please!
review_body: This toy is awesome, Toys R Us could u please ship it to Canada? Email me if u can.

product_title: Fisher-Price Deluxe Jumperoo
review_headline: Mom Loves it Baby Loves it too..
review_body: I bought this when my son was only 5 months old and he love it.  He is now 7 months old and he is always excited everytime I put him into it.  He loves the music and the sound it makes when he jumps.  Thanks Fisher Price for another great product.

product_title: Scrabble Junior
review_body: For the 4-6 year old still learning letters and basic spelling, this game is OK.  For the older child, it gets boring fast.  I try to get the older child (7) to work at strategy for playing pieces, to set himself up to finish a word & to prevent someone else from getting a word.  The easy side of the board is very decorated, & it's hard to see some of the letters, so it takes careful attention to know where letters can be put.  Also, there are only enough letters provided with the game to play the easy side, no extras, so if you lose any, you can't play the game.  And it means that when there are no more letters in the pile, you can figure out at that point who is going to win, without finishing, because all the letters have a spot on the board. It also limits your options for the advanced side -- for example, there's only 1 'q' tile.  I raided a regular scrabble game for pieces, & found those pieces easier for the kids to handle, too.  Using easy, finished, crossword puzzles to map out a game on the advanced side gives the kids some easy games other than the one on the easy side of the board -- but it does require additional tiles & a good bit of work on my part!

product_title: Transformers *ENERGON IRONHIDE* Deluxe 4x4 Vehicle
review_body: From the new Transformers: Energon toyline comes the heroic Ironhide! Featuring electronic sounds and projectile launching accessories, Ironhide transforms from a blue SUV to mighty robot and back! In addition to these features, Ironhide can combine with the Autobot Jetfire (or other Transformers in the same size class) to form a larger, more powerful robot: Powerlinx Ironhide! Large, well-articulated, and bristling with accessories, Ironhide's playability is undeniable. A great toy, and a definite must-buy for children and collectors alike!

product_title: Slushee Maker
review_body: This just did not work for us at all.  We had 4 boys sitting around it very excited to get an icee - but it didn't work after cranking it for more than 15 minutes.  Don't waste your money.  We took it back the next day.

product_title: Triumph 5 Comfort Touch Car Seat with LATCH - Rockefeller
review_body: Our son is 7 months old and we bought this car seat shortly after he turned 6 months. He simply loves it and we love it too. Initially we bought Graco's Comfort Sport with latch and hated the most, i returned it the next day. We found that seat to be very unsafe, it moved all around and our child was not at all comfortable in it. It had only one recline position. This car seat has several recline positions and very heavy that it barely moves once installed. Overall we are very satisfied. I highly recommend this car seat.

product_title: Elimination Chamber Playset
review_body: This is amazing and I give it 5 stars for FUN and I think that the only wthing that should be changed is the height, and it should be a bit wider on the floors that way they could have 4 chambers... Other that that... I LOVE IT... they just need a hell in a cell now

product_title: Harley Davidson 8 R/C Motorcycle and Rider
review_body: I bought this for my 5 year old nephews birthday and he just loves it. So far no problems. I have a hard time buying toys for him because he is so rough on his toys he usually ends up breaking most things in a matter of days (if not hours), but so far this has held up to his abuse really well.      One thing they don't mention in the description is that this is acutally a gift set. In addition to the motorcycle and controler you also get a pair of sunglasses, a doo-rag and a pair of motorcycle gloves.

product_title: Barbie & Krissy Stroll 'n Play! 3-in-1 Fun
review_body: She loves the fact that the babies come included! It's great fun for her, she has played with this toy for hours! the only thing I recommend is throwing away the smaller parts for smaller children, which I have done (it comes with small baby bottle that a child can choke on), but without the bottle, my daughter walks the babies in the stroller, and puts the babies down for a nap and even pretends to use the little baby carraiges as baby car seats. Great fun, I even have sat down and played with this toy with her. Definitely a fun toy!

product_title: LEGO Bionicle Set #8595 Takua Pewku
review_headline: Takua and Pewku - Get it while you can!!
review_body: This set is awsome!  It takes a little work to get the legs set up correctly, but it is worth it.  I can't wait to get Jaller and the Gukko bird to make the combiner.  THIS SET ROCKS!!

product_title: Thomas & Friends Wooden Railway - Trevor
review_body: To say we have a substantial Thomas collection is an understatement, but I must admit that this is one of my personal favorites.  What makes Trevor stand out from the other characters is that his \\"traction\\" wheels actually turn when he moves.  Cool to watch, fun to play with, and somewhat educational, too. product_title: Carter''s - Receiving Blankets 4-Pack - Yellow Check/White with Yellow Print
review_headline: great size, good to swaddle at first
review_body: These are great blankets.  They are bigger than most others, versatile, and wash very well.  We swaddled our daughter in them until she was a week old and could wrestle out of anything - except a stretchier, waffle-weave blanket.

product_title: Magic Ruler 36 Pack Booster Box
review_body: Out of the four yu-gi-oh stes that have come out, magic ruler is by far the best! If you by this box, you can get extremely powerful and rare cards such as relinquished, toon world, toon blue eyes white dragon, the dark illusion ritual, serpant night dragon, etc,! I got one of each! Plus you can add a little twist to your game with the new ritual cards. This is a must buy!

product_title: LeapFrog Learning Table
review_body: My daughter got this table for her 1st birthday and 4 months later, she still enjoys it as much as she did the first day she got it.  She loves the music and dances with it all the time.  The page that plays the alphabet and colors is great, she is repeating the colors it says to her and I am sure in time she will learn them with this wonderful toy.  IF your child enjoys music and to use those little fingers this is a perfect toy.

product_title: LeapFrog Learning Table
review_headline: This toy is worth every penny!
review_body: We received this toy as a christmas gift for our then 7-1/2 mos. old daughter and she still LOVES IT. It is sturdier than most other table type toys, has no loose parts to have to find and is entertaining. Even the sounds the toy makes are pleasant (and as a parent that's important because you will hear them over and over and over...). Leap Frog makes great, quality toys and this is no exception. All children's toys should be made with this quality and attention to detail. worth every penny.

product_title: LAMAZE Buzz the Bug (birth +) - RETIRED
review_body: I bought this for my son when he was four and a half months old and he loved Buzz right off the bat. The colors really catch his attention and he loves the squeaky heart. Buzz is so easy to take with us, we just strap his little sqare onto the diaper bag and go. We never leave home without him. He's very durable. My son, now 6 months old, tosses him all over the room, spits up on him, and even drools on him. After multiple washes, he's still the same old Buzz. I would suggest Buzz to any mother. You'll never regret the purchase of a lifetime... trust me.

product_title: Fisher-Price Peek-a-Blocks Tumblin' Sounds Giraffe
review_body: My son (who is 11 months old) received this toy as a gift and he really liked it for awhile.  However, the music and repetitivness of dropping the blocks down the chute quickly become boring for him.  He quit playing with the actual Giraffe fairly soon after he received the toy.  However, he continues to play with the blocks and we've had the toy for over 6 months now.

product_title: Graco: Travel Lite Folding Bouncer
review_headline: Good idea but needs major improvements
review_body:
We bought this bouncer for the purposes of travel and having a second seat upstairs. And after owning it for a few weeks, I wish I could return it but have thrown away the box. My 12 week old son slides to the side of the seat each time he's in it, while one of his arms slides out the side. He's literally leaning on the side of the seat!

This seat is also, quite frankly, very boring compared to the Kick and Play bouncer. The two speeds are nice, but the two music options are unstimulating.

Although this seat folds up quickly and neatly, which is perfect for travel, I won't be using it for that purpose. I feel its not safe for my son, especially when he's nearly falling out of the side of the seat.

product_title: Lord of the Rings Armies of Middle Earth Deluxe Figure: Gondorian Horseman
review_headline: Ouch...a LotR figure that isn't so good
review_body:
In the battle for the last stronghold of Men in Middle-Earth, the might of Sauron's massive armies was turned loose on Gondor. Only through the courage of the soldiers, and the skill of the White Wizard, could victory hope to be accomplished.
As you might be able to see by my nickname, of all the lands in Middle-Earth, I am most enamored by Gondor, the city of Men. The 6-inch figures are my favorites to collect, but when I saw this first toy representation of Gondorian soldiers, I impulsively reached out and grabbed it off the shelf. It took me approximately one day before the little stand that holds him up in a horse-rearing pose to break, which renders the entire figure pretty non-functional -- not that it had much function before. Its only purpose was for display, and if you aren't careful, you can render that non-fuctional too.
Otherwise, besides being only three inches tall, it's kind of a cool figure. The Gondorian soldier is mounted on his horse, with a shield in one hand, and a lance, or spear, in the other. The horse is kind of rearing up, held, like I said, by a small plastic stick. (WHICH, I may point out, is easily breakable) There's a small platform of terrain beneath him, so standing on his own isn't an issue.
I'd really suggest you wait for the six-inch Gondorian soldier. This one just doesn't cut it.

product_title: LeapFrog Hug & Learn Baby Tad Plush
review_body: My daughter just loves this toy.  She'll play with it for what seems like hours.  This is a great toy to travel in the car with, or just to have around the house as it's a great distraction.  She loves the songs it plays.  It also has a lullaby feature to get her into sleep mode at night.  Overall this toy has been a great addition to her toy chest and I would recommend this toy to anyone.

product_title: Dibs a New Take on Trivia
review_body: I bought this game recently and have played it 4 times already.  The questions are really funny and the best part of the game is it doesn't take forever to play.  You can play in about 45 minutes so it doesn't drag on and on.  Everyone I have played this game with has loved it so I have to recommend it highly.

product_title: Triumph 5 Comfort Touch Car Seat with LATCH - Rockefeller
review_body:
I echo the positive reviews of this car seat. This is a wonderful car seat and my son loves it. It has 5 recline positions so it's good for a small child who's not ready to sit up straight as well as a toddler who just wants to take a nap or to play with his toys.
I too was in a car accident recently (6/15/03) on Father's Day and the only person not affected was my 15 month old son. We were hit on the rear passenger door from the side. He was scared, but not hurt.
Do your research and let your child sit in different seats. Talk to parents who have used different brands. Parents are the best references!!
My husband and I have been very happy with Evenflo car seats. We used an Evenflo infant car seat and stroller.

product_title: Power Swimr System - Medium by Swimways- Colors / Styles May Vary
review_body: My son swims like a fish with this device.  He had one last year and used it so much I needed a new one this year.  He was only 2 when we got the first one and he gained so much confidence in the water that we got him another one.  We are gradually removing the pads, and teaching him to use his arms and legs better.  I hope that by next year, he wont need it at all.  I have friends who have borrowed it and then went out to buy their own.  It works better than water wings because my son can use his arms more easily.  I totally recommend this toy for anyone who has small children and a pool.

product_title: Bop It Extreme
review_headline: Great toy but not great for education.
review_body: The only thing this game teaches is how to be under alot of pressure and scream as loud as humanly possible when you mess up! It is great fun though! Very durable! Fun for all ages from 7-3,000! Lots of fun for adults not just kids!! If you buy it be prepared to "Bop it!"

product_title: Cranium
review_headline: For those of you who hate trivial pursuit...
review_body: this game is for you.  We love to play games at our house, but the trouble was that a lot of the games for grown ups involve only memorization and/or "book" smarts.  Since not everyone is "book" smart this  game allows those of us who hate the trivial pursuit type game to shine and   even WIN! This game is definately not your average brain game and more  often than not, it is hysterical.  (The only reason that I did not give  durability a 5 star rating is because there is some clay involved.)

product_title: Fleece Blanket - Garden Bunny
review_body: So soft and very cuddly feeling. Great product for the price! Love the bedding set that matches it too..WOnderful!

product_title: Pokemon Starter Gift Box
review_headline: Older kids will enjoy Magic more
review_body: Pokemon is a hit. And chances are your kid aged 8 to 13 will love this game. But, if your child is older, say 14-18, do them a favor and get Wizards of the Coast's other hit game Magic: The Gathering. It's far more  interesting and stratigic.  If Magic is Risk, then Pokemon would be  Tic-Tac-Toe.

product_title: Fisher Price Twirlin' Whirlin Garden
review_body: I have to say, my son got this at 9 mos, and to this day (13 mos) he's totally uninterested.  When he even barely touches the toys, they fall over, and cause the twirlin to be all clunky (stuff kind of falls into the turning parts and makes TONS of noise)  He couldn't care less about this toy.  I think it has too much going on, and the stuff that's going on isn't educational.

product_title: Ravensburger Enchanted Forest - Family Game
review_headline: A flexible, imaginative, and beautifully made game.
review_body: I am a child psychologist, and this game has been a fixture in my office for 15 years.  It promotes concentration and working memory, imagination, and a fun competitiveness devoid of aggression.  What I find helpful is  that the rules of the game are easily adapted to suit different age groups.  An outstanding game.

product_title: Cranium
review_headline: Great entertainment for a party of adults
review_body: This game came into our family last Christmas, and ever since then, it's the game we play at family gatherings (at least once a month).  It's different, it's interactive, and it lets everyone's strengths shine.  From sculpting to drawing to charades and factoids, this game has something for everyone.  We've discovered that teams of 2 or 3 are the best for a longer game, but even teams of 4 or 5 are lots of fun, it just makes the game go faster.  I highly recommend this game for adult families or as a party game.  Children much younger than 14 or so will not enjoy it as much, simply because the questions are geared towards a more experienced audience.

product_title: Fisher-Price Grow-to-Pro Golf Set
review_body: Fantastic toy that provides hours and hours of great entertainment for your little toddler.  It is fabulous and unique because it helps develop balance and equilibrium when setting up the tee.

product_title: Dirt Devil Junior Lights Sounds Upright Toy Vacuum Cleaner
review_headline: Need more than one if multiple children!
review_body: With 4 nephews 5 and under, this is the most sought after toy in my house!  Forget the dumptrucks and building blocks, they would all rather have the vacuum and "clean house" for me!

product_title: X-Men Trading Card Game Starter Set
review_headline: X-men Card Game is da bomb
review_body: At first,being a Magic the Gathering player, I was skeptical about how the game would work and feel. I was afraid it was going to be a rip-off with  X-men characters. I was completely wrong. It is so different from Magic,  yet it still captures the feeling of a great card game. The dice feature is  a welcome addition to card games that I have played. it is also simple to  learn, but the more advanced you are makes it more fun. The cards are  beautifull and well desinged. I think it is a great game with lots of  inovation.

product_title: 1999 Barbie Shop With Me Cash Register
review_headline: Barbie Cash Register...A Toy For Any Age?
review_body: My 4-year-old daughter received the Barbie Cash Register and she loved it. It is a bit technical for her, but she doesn't seem to get frustrated with the complexity of the toy. I think the age recommendation  of 3 years and up is stretching it a bit if you intend to get the full  appreciation for the toy. Even though it would probably be better suited  for and understood by a 5-6 year old, a 3-4 year old can easily sit and  push buttons at random and have a ball! The working microphone and  "talking" Barbie features absolutely delighted my daughter. My  10-year-old played with it about as much as my as my 4-year-old. As a  matter of fact, they had a great time playing with it together. They loved  the pretend scannable item cards and credit cards, not to mention the  pretend coins and paper money. The catalog that came with it was a nice  touch. The catalog has additional items with numbers you can enter to  purchase those items. It is a toy that not only provides hours of play  time, but teaches math skills as well. No wonder it was one of the hottest  selling toys... I highly recommend this toy.

product_title: Polly Pocket Fashion Polly Super Stylin' Bedroom
review_body: I bought this for my 2 yr old daughter thinking what a great toy for places where you have to "wait". Well, she had it 24 hours when in the midst of my putting her pants on, the doll fell apart. My daughter was very upset about it. I know she is a bit young for the doll, but she is careful with her things and most particular about keeping pieces together. Would have been an excelent purchase if it were more durable.

product_title: Jammin Draw - Now you can draw Music!
review_body: I just bought this toy for my son's 5th birthday, and for the price I paid I expected more.  The only fun part is the beat that you can choose to play while you color.  The music that you supposedly "create" by drawing is just different notes that play at random while the marker is pressing on the paper.  There is no specific melody.  It only comes with three markers and they start wearing out as the picture is filled in. You could probably ue crayons but I'm unsure as to whether any sound is made if using anything other than a marker.  Think twice before buying this one...I wish I had just bought him a new magna doodle instead.

product_title: Jean Grey - X-Men
review_body: This figure is one of the closest resembulances in the entire line. It looks very much like Famke Jansen. With 10 points of articulation, this  figure looks great. The picture is somewhat misleading. The figure's hair  is pulled back, and makes her look much better than the picture actually  shows. The mutated Senator Kelly...thing, is very cool...and disguisting.  ;-) Overall, a must buy for any fan.

product_title: Crayola Playstation Light up Tracing Desk
review_headline: Keeping my kids entertained for hours.
review_body:
Having the opportunity to test over 900 products means I spend a lot of time using and playing with the products themselves, sometimes I need a little help and having small kids and working with Crayola the two together is the perfect fit.

Testing both the Metallic Blue Vehicle kit for boys and the metallic pink Fashion design for girls I found that the kit were well built and very durable. The unit I tested came with 3 "D" cell batteries, but the actual kits don't have this. Once the batteries were installed everything worked without fail.

The small bulb inside the desk was designed to makes sure no one run the risk of a burn. The bulb is a low-temperature bulb with a cover that requires a screwdriver in order to remove, which in turn minimizes the risk of burns. The units I recieved had tracing paper, 8 pencils, 2 of which were metallic in color and a tracing pencil; which is standard for every kit..

The kit is rated for 6 years or older and I found that with a little help from mom and dad 4 and 5 year old kids can have a great deal of fun. Instructions are included and taped to the top of the desk.

With older kids this unit can travel in the car and for the price this product does make a great gift for all occasions and fits well into any family budget. Looking at the quality of the product it is very apparent the Crayola is making every effort to give the consumer more than they ask for. Overall - excellent.

product_title: FREECELL HANDHELD, Over 1000 games to play, Extra Large Playing Buttons, The ultimate Full Color Card Game
review_headline: Enjoyed for the First 24 Hours - then it Broke!!!

product_title: Barbie KELLY Amusement Park Kelly Kiddie Coaster Playset (2001)

product_title: gator golf
review_body: This is one of those toys that is lots of fun for a couple of days, but the kids soon lose interest.  Well made.

product_title: Pokemon Battle Figures #94 Gengar & #52 Meowth with Poke Ball and Battle Disks
review_headline: A must-have for your Pokemon collection!

Pokemon figures are as educational as your  creativity makes them. My 3- and 5-year-old daughters and I could play with  these guys all day long!

product_title: MEGA BLOKS PROBUILDER USS KITTYHAWK
review_body: I have got this present for my son's birthday in July and was extremely satisfied with the product, He has built, rebuilt, and modified the original designs numurous times. Truly a great set.

product_title: Apples to Apples Kids
review_body: This is a fast-paced game that you will want to play over and over again.  The only problem with it is that you need at least 4 people to play, but that does make it good for family gatherings.  It is fun, and funny, and appealing to all ages.

product_title: Sesame Street Super Boom Box
review_body: This has to be one of my son's favorite toys.  He is just mesmerized by the lights and the music.  Whenever we pull it out he gets a big smile on his face.  The only downside to the toy is that it can be a little loud but that will not matter when your child is having lots of fun.

product_title: Uncle Milton Ant Farm Live Ant Habitat, 60th Ant-iversary Edition, Ant-es Mountains
review_body:
Bought the ant farm (the "Bug's Life" version)for my sons (7 and 10 y.o.) There was the initial dissappointment of having to wait for the ants to arrive.
Part of the farm was a section covered by a removeable (intentional?) umbrella-shaped cover. Maybe this was my mistake, but I glued the cover on. Maybe the glue wasn't good for the ants.
We followed the instructions closely, but about 80% of the ants died within about a week. The other 20% weren't too far behind.
What *was* kind of fun was collecting our own ants...
Georgia Fire Ants!
They were big and very aggressive. They died soon too.
I threw away the farm a few weeks ago.

product_title: Easy Set Pool Set (12' x 30")
review_body: This pool is the perfect size for a family with several young kids.  Unfortunately, the pool requires perfectly flat ground to be set up on.  To our untrained eye, our yard looks pretty level.  We purchased this pool and attempted to set it up in various locations around the yard but nowhere was it quite level enough to meet the standards set out in the directions.  We set it up anyway in the best spot we could find.  Upon filling the pool began to loose shape, with the side bulging out and the rim beginning to sag.  The kids loved the size and the depth was perfect for our 5 and 2 year olds to have lot of fun in.  Unforntately, we are going to end up returning it to find a different pool that will work in our yard.  We don't want a permenantly installed pool or have to do extensive site modifications to our yard but also want a pool that is a little larger and definately more durable than the typical inflatable ones.

product_title: ROADMAX Dump Truck
review_body:
When I first looked at the Bruder toys two years ago, the cost seemed too high. But after looking at what else was available, I decided to try the dump truck for my two boys. We have been very happy with the quality and durablity. The truck has been taken to the park sandbox several times a week for two summers now and after the dirt is sprayed off it still looks like new. I really am amazed at how well it has held up. The wheels, the dumper, and the cab opening work as beautifully as they did when it was new.
The truck is about 13 inches long 8 inches high and 7 inches wide. The dumper not only dumps but also swivels from one side to the other. The cab opens up from the top (the red and black part) to show seats inside.
My boys love this toy, they are 3 and 6. Several of our girl -friends that come over to play love this dump truck as well.

product_title: Barbie Airplane
review_body: I am surprised to see such positive reviews of this toy. This is not an inexpensive product and it constantly requires reassemly due to the wings falling off or the doors of the inner compartment cabinets breaking. A six year old gets tired of this rather quickly and there you have a large plastic toy that is too frustrating to play with and very difficult to store.  I bought this product last Christmas when it was the toy all six year olds just had to have!  I thought I just got a lemon, but when I checked with the other mothers at school, they too were very disappointed with the plane. Many quietly disposed of the plane by spring.  My daughter asked if she could give hers away to someone who might like it.  I couldn't think of anyone.

product_title: Electronic Battleship Advanced Mission
review_headline: Hasbro "Missed The Boat" on this one!
review_body:
I sure expected a lot more out of this game based on its price. Essentially the only thing electronic about this is the preprogrammed games and the cheesy, repetitive sound effects. Okay, a little red light flashes if you hit a boat, but so what? For the money, Hasbro should have: 1) At the very least printed out the punched in letter/number combo on the light grid. Ever play this with a kid who forgets to call out the coordinates then forgets what they were altogether! Frustrating! Putting this on the display probably would have cost pennies. 2) Had LEDs in the grid. Want those plastic pegs? Get the much cheaper and essentially the same, old fashioned "manual version". This doesn't do much more. I was at least expecting LEDs to light up in the grid after the coordinates were put in. Okay, nickels this time, not pennies. But nope. 3) Keep track of what's sunk. Hey, they have a little key with the boats on it - how tough could it be to put a little lit up LED next to each when it's sunk? They don't even have the peg holes up top anymore to mark your sinkings! How lame is THAT?
In this day and age of high tech computer wizardry, this game MISSES THE BOAT! It should be quick and inexpensive to put in what is really missing, especially for the price. Instead, Hasbro gives you something not much better than the classic....at 3X the $$.
If this weren't a kid's gift I would have returned the one I bought. Save your money and stick with the classic. Don't say you weren't warned!

product_title: Lillys Purple Plastic Purse Game Based on Book By Kevin Henkes
review_body: My almost 4 year old daughter loooves Lilly.  This game was a little over her head, but she still has really enjoyed playing with the purse and the mask.  She may grow into the cards, but it is really more appropriate for  an older kid (5ish).  Still she has really enjoyed the pretend aspect of  the props.

product_title: Scrabble Crossword Game, Deluxe Travel Edition
review_headline: The classic game with only one important complaint...
review_body: the tiles are annoyingly small.  If you've got big fingers, don't even try to play this game.  And although it's been good so far, the plastic feels a  little brittle - I can foresee it breaking if one is not too careful.

product_title: I/R T-Rex
review_body: We purchased this toy for our son's 5th birthday because he loves dinosaurs.  We were impressed with the realistic look, touch, movements and sounds of the toy and felt that it was a good first-time remote control toy for him since it was cordless.  The toy initially worked, however after a short while it seemed to have problems walking straight ahead (it would always turn).  After 2 weeks it quit working all together.  We are having problems locating a replacement, the toy is out of stock at our local store as well as at other surrounding locations.  Needless to say our son loved this toy and has his heart set on a replacement T-Rex.  We are willing to give this toy another chance if only we could find one.  Yesterday we left a message with Wow Wee's affiliate here in Canada in the hope of receiving a replacement toy and we are waiting to hear from them.

product_title: ThinkFun Brick by Brick
review_headline: This is a very good toy for gifted kids.
review_body: This is one you want to add to your cart. If you have a gifted child, he/she would love it! Basic details follow these lines: You have a card with a brick pattern on it. You have 5 brick pieces. You have to match the  pattern on the card with the plastic bricks. Easy enough? Sure! I have it  in my classroom and you should too!

product_title: Chicco Flip 'n Play Table
review_body: We didn't purchase this table for our daughter until she was 15 months old, steady on her legs and ready for something her own height.  She loved it immediately.  My only reservation is that additional blocks are hard to find--only the Chicco brand fit.  (I thought Duplo might--they don't).  Otherwise, its been a lot of fun--I'd buy it as a gift.

product_title: Fisher-Price Brilliant Basics Corn Popper
review_headline: I'm so glad they still make these!
review_body: Like other reviewers, I remember having one of these when I was a child. My only complaint with the current version is that it is made of plastic. I think mine was made of wood. However, I enjoyed giving the corn popper to  my daughter on her first birthday, and she is having as much fun with it as  I remember having.

product_title: Little Tikes Cozy Coupe
review_body: My 19 month old daughter won't stay away from this car.  She loves it.  Little Tykes makes good quality toys.  We are very happy with this purchase.

product_title: Ravensburger Enchanted Forest - Family Game
review_body: My daughter has loved this game since she was six years old. The craftsmanship of the game itself is beautiful. The game-pieces and the little trees are wooden, and the illustrations are of the old-fashioned  fairytale variety, very intricate and colourful. The cards are good,thick  cardboard and will stand up to years of use. It looks like a very old game  that one would find in an attic trunk. Winning depends on such a variety of  strategy, memory, and just plain luck that a combination of ages can play  concurrently and feel equally challenged. I recommend The Enchanged Forest  highly. It is a feast of colours, a delight to behold and touch, and it  provides good mental exercise.What more could you ask?

product_title: Easy-Bake Oven and Snack Center
review_body: My daughter has had the easy bake for two years and she loves it. It does make quite a mess which needs cleaning up afterwards so make sure you have extra time. I also would not leave the chefs unattended. We only wish the baked foods were a a little larger for sharing with her brothers. Happy eating.

product_title: Easy-Bake Oven and Snack Center
review_headline: Good idea in theory, but there's trouble in the execution
review_body: The idea of a little kid having their own oven to bake in is a good one; they get to be just like Mommy, they can share their creations, and even the pickiest eaters will eat what they cook.  However, I was disappointed to see that the oven didn't come with the light bulb; make sure you pick  one up before Christmas.

product_title: Mouse Trap Game (Amazon Exclusive)
review_body: That should be what it is called!It looks like a really cute,fun game but...at least the versions here in Australia--are so hard to use because the Mouse Trap keeps falling apart.It needs to be made better.

product_title: Jenga Game
review_body:
Not only is this toy extremely durable (how can you really break those small blocks of wood?), it's incredibly flexible as a toy. My brother at twelve (and I at 21) played this game for hours. When I went back to my computer/book/sleep, he'd stay occupied with the game -- playing it alone, stacking and re-stacking the blocks, creating houses and encampments as if the pieces were designed as building blocks.
As an adult, I don't enjoy card games or board games much, but I still appreciate having this game around the house. It's a game you can play with just about anyone, and although it does take some concentration when you're the one pulling out that precarious block, you can still converse and cavort while playing (as long as you've got the game on a stable surface!).
Jenga also helps teach hand-eye coordination, precision, patience, forethought ("what will happen if I pull out this block?"), and just a bit of physics -- some of the blocks are rougher, some are smoother, so friction comes into play.
I highly recommend this game to everyone, regardless of age!

product_title: Little Tikes Cookin' Sounds Gourmet Kitchen Cuisine
review_headline: Mom of 2 year old who loves Emeril!
review_body: My daughter loves this toy.  It is very sturdy and the cute sounds are an added bonus.  She cooks along-side Emeril when we watch his cooking show.  We bought it for her when she was 18 months and I am sure it will be one of her most used toys.  All of the other kitchens we looked at didn't seem sturdy enough to withstand the abuse of a toddler, but this one has been great!  It took almost 30 minutes to put together (by an Architect and an Engineer) but we had to contend with our daughter trying to "help" the whole time!  This is a great toy, you won't regret the purchase.  It doesn't have a fridge, but my daughter pretends the oven is a fridge and the microwave is the oven.  We live in an apartment, so space was a consideration for us.

product_title: Original 20" Sock Monkey
review_body: I love sock monkeys -- not just because they're cute and I had one as a child, but because it's so much fun to say "sock monkey." (Try it!) I purchased this particular ape for my 8-month-old nephew for  Christmas -- continuing a tradition I started with other nieces and  nephews. The toy is well-made, with no small pieces to fall off and cause  problems. I'm sure my nephew will slobber on it, throw it around, and love  it as much as his brother and cousins love theirs!

product_title: BLUE'S CLUES-Handy Dandy Notebook
review_headline: poor writing surface, save the money
review_body: My three year old often carries the note book around now only having to pretend to use it. The writing surface works poorly after only a few hours of play.   Try magna doodle or paper instead.

product_title: Sequence Game
review_body: I love this Game...we have been playing it for years...two players.....4 players or in 2 teams.....its always fun. A keen eye and plan ahead...and dont forget to draw your CARD.....lol.....I highly recommend this game and  have given it as gifts many times.

product_title: Bob The Builder Scoop
review_body: My 3 year old son just received this as a birthday present.  He is a huge Bob the Builder fan.  He watches it every Monday thru Friday at 9:00AM.  He has not put this toy down since receiving it.  As with some of the other little fans, he takes is everywhere he goes, including to bed, naps and bathroom.  I was surprised at how clear the voice is, just like the tv program.  I would definately recommend this to all fans out there.

product_title: Fisher Price Mirror
review_headline: If you can only buy one toy, buy this one!
review_body: My 5-month old baby used to be quiet when she woke up, and would then cry for me. Now she wakes up every morning and plays with this toy, and I know she's awake. She greets me every morning with smiles instead of tears.  Also, we took a 6-hour car trip last week and placed this toy at the foot  of her car seat. She used her feet to play the music, and she slept and  played with the mirror the whole trip!

product_title: Doodle
review_body: I just purchased this toy for my almost 2 year old.  He LOVES it!  He immediately understood how to use the toy and does not get frustrated with it when playing alone.  It is very easy to use the slide eraser, the pen doesn't get lost, the stamps make it easy for him to "draw" pictures - it's a terrific toy.  And, of course it allows the child to draw unsupervised...

product_title: Slamwich
review_body: I bought this game for my seven year old son last year.  Not only does he enjoy playing it but my husband and I will occasionally play it after our son has gone to bed.  The rules are pretty simple and the game only requires memory and speed so our son actually has a pretty fair chance of winning.  My son especially likes the thief cards.  What I like about this game is that it isn't boring for adults to play and isn't something my son will quickly outgrow.  We've had the game for a year and it's still a favorite with my son.

product_title: Wizard of Oz Game Yellow Brick Road
review_headline: My 3 yr old loves this game!
review_body: This "chutes and ladders" type game is just the thing for my Wizard of Oz crazy 3 year old. It's great counting practice and great for learning basic board game rules. She's not quite patient enough yet to finish but it's fun watching her go farther every game.

product_title: Home Depot Deluxe Power Tool Set with Goggles
review_headline: Kids loved it, but items broke too easily!
review_body: My 7, 6, and 4 y/o sons love these tools! Finally found something that they have an interest in and don't seem to abandon after a few seconds. However, all but the drill are broken, and after only 1 day!! The handle on the sander broke off, and the battery covers on the others broke. Maybe the manufacturer needs to go back to the drawing board and figure out how to make tools sturdier?

product_title: Disney Monsters Inc One-eyed Mike Talking Doll
review_body: This toy is soft and cuddly.  Its a great way to remember my favorite character from the movie.

product_title: Cranium
review_body: This is a wonderful game fo all ages; the first time my family and I played we were cracking up with laughter, the difficulty of the questions may vary and some younger children may need help with a few questions ( such as the cameos and songs ) but overall I LOVE this game. To this day we  are laughing about some of the things that went on when we last played it.  ( ps, in my opinion the creative cat and star performer catagories are the  most interesting... )

product_title: Block N Roll 100 piece Set
review_headline: Love how this toy ties in with Duplos
review_body: Finally, someone figured out that we don't want to spend money on expensive specialized parts to build the supporting towers for a marble run  game! This game fits together with ordinary Duplos (or Megablocks) to give  the run some height. My children and I love it!  But it could be even  better if they included more "corner" pieces. I would also like  to have some fancier pieces to create more options for the marble paths,  such as a single piece that turns the corner or goes straight, or some kind  of "Y". And it is difficult to align the "drop-through"  over another run, because of how the Duplo-like pieces fit together.

product_title: Fisher Price Seasame Street Big Bird Toy 0-24mc
review_headline: My two-month old son really reacts to this toy.
review_body: This is the first stuffed animal that my two-month old son really reacts to.  He smiles at and bats his arms at Big Bird.  He even "talks" to it in his crib.  I think it is the bright colors that  he loves.

product_title: Step 2 Up & Down Roller Coaster
review_body: My 2 1/2 year old and his friend love this roller coaster. They can hardly wait for their turn. It is extremely durable. I know that this toy will still be great when my baby is big enough to play on it.

product_title: Melissa & Doug Alphabet Art Wooden Jigsaw Puzzle
review_body: this puzzel is great!.My son has been playing w/ this since christmas. Very educational w/ alphabet,animals,problem solving skills and fine motor. Every child should have one.

product_title: Set: The Family Game of Visual Perception
review_headline: Addictive, in a twisted mathematician's sort of way.
review_body:
It seems simple enough. You have a deck of 81 (3^4) cards. Each card has either one, two, or three shapes on it. The shapes are either solid, striped, or empty; red, green, or purple; diamonds, ovals, or squiggles. Find sets of three cards such that in each of these four dimensions, either all three cards are the same or all three are different. (Three red cards, or one red, one green, and one purple, but NOT two red and one purple.)
You'd think that you would get tired of this game. But you don't. It's strangely addictive. What usually ends up happening - at least when I play - is that you find two cards, then start looking for the third card (there's always exactly one) that will complete the SET. Sometimes it's there - but most of the time, you can't find it. You start to get mad at the cards - if this one was only green instead of purple, or had two shapes instead of three - but there's nothing you can do.
Then someone finds a SET. It's always obvious once someone finds it - how could you not have seen it? That's why this game is so addictive - it seems so simple, but it's not.
There's one problem with this game, though. Once you get good at it, everyone else starts to resent you for it and not want to play any more. I've been there. Be careful.

product_title: 100 pc. 2002 Mega Blok in Tote
review_headline: Perfect for boys and girls alike!
review_body: These keep my 4 yr old occupied forever.   It's the best purchase of many many many!  He doesn't realize he's learning and figuring things out..but I see it clearly.

product_title: Easy Set Pool Set (12' x 30")
review_body: We just purchased the 12ftx30in pool for my daughter,I'm sure she'll get a lot of fun out of it ! Ijust hope we get a couple of years out of it.That on thing I'm a little disappointed about is,I thought it came with a groung cover? The other thing is it doesn't tell you how or what type of ladder you can use with the pool.

product_title: Mystify Word Scramble Board Game
review_headline: If you enjoy word games -- you'll really like this one.
review_body: Your ability to quickly unscramble words is combined into the fun of a board game.

product_title: Lego Star Wars #7146 Tie Fighter
review_body:
My son (4 yrs) was disappointed in this tie fighter because the wings wobble. I am baffled as to why LEGO settled for such an unstable design. It would have been easy to eliminate the wing-wobble using parts they include with other sets. You can customize with other pieces to eliminate the wobble, but the fighter will look different. The cockpit is also a little unstable. On the positive side, my son and I have used the pieces of this set to build several different ships of our own design.
