P.S. I highly recommend the Model 7140 Tie Fighter! Great design and stable enough for kids to play with.

product_title: Barbie Kitty Fun
review_headline: A must buy before your child gets a real pet
review_body: My daughter wanted a pet so we bought this Barbie with the cat and after taking care of Barbie's kitty my daughter soon learned the responsiblity that goes along with a pet.  We are sticking to barbie because she realized it wouldn't be that much fun if she had to clean a real litter box.

product_title: Fisher-Price Blocks
review_headline: A classic toy at five times the price.
review_body: The price is terrific for this stacking toy that has been around for ages.  When your baby or toddler begins to develop hand-eye coordination, this is the toy to stimulate him or her.  Obviously, you should be near your baby  to make sure she does eat the rings for breakfast.  A little teething is  OK.  You can wash this toy in the dishwasher to get is almost sterilize  clean.  My son who is 3 liked this toy a lot.  He did not love it, probably  because it was not a car or truck, but we certainly got our moneys worth,  time and again.  Highly, highly recommended.

product_title: Elmo's Rock & Roll Guitar
review_body: My youngest son got this one as a Christmas present LAST YEAR and he and his brother still pull it out of the toybox almost every day to play!  We all know how amazing that is, but the best thing about this toy is that although it's a sound and lights type toy it is not annoying.  The sounds it produces are not grating or out of key no matter what key combination is pressed and even if I have to hear "Splish Splash" 27 times in a row I only find myself tapping my foot to the beat or humming along.  The volume control is a great plus for the car and is actually how my kids learned what the plea 'Turn it down!' meant.

product_title: Top it
review_headline: Quick--Flop It! Flip It! Top It!
review_body:
One of my feisty nephews has this fun-tastic toy, um, I mean adult thrill-seeking, skill-seeking, reflex & coordination improvement object. Either way you look at it, it's an addictive physical game with a whole lotta laughing involved.
During outdoor get-togethers, we have played individually and as teams, (chiming in with the 'lil quirky voice, which if you take too long or make a wrong move, taunts you unmercifully). Note: the automatic shut-off feature does save on battery life, but you're going to love this so much, stock up on triple AAA's.
This makes a great gift for kids and fun loving adults. You may want to buy more than one. 'Cuz once you play, I can bet ya, you're not going to want to give it away!

product_title: Planet of the Apes Major Leo Davidson Figure the Movie
review_body: This toy is made great.I love it because it looks cool and does not break.Most toys that look real snap when you drop them. This toy along with Attar and the entire set are made perfect.If you like the movie get these toys because they are the best toys i own.

product_title: Monopoly
review_body:
Monopoly is a true classic - if you don't know what Monopoly is I'm not going to tell you because you obviously live in a cave and don't have internet access anyway. But what I do want to say is that if you don't have a copy of Monopoly you should get one - it's a truly great game that can be tons of fun for people of all ages. There's a reason why this game has sold hundreds of millions of copies in almost every language known to man and has so many versions.
Still, monopoly can get old fast if you just march around the board collecting and paying rent and waiting till someone gets a monopoly and wins. You have to spice things up a little, which means bending the rules a little. Before each game I suggest making up some interesting "house rules" to make things a little different each time you play - the classic example is putting all the money people pay from luxury tax or chance and community chest cards into a pot that is won by the next person who lands on "free parking". Also, it is a lot more fun when there is more wheeling and dealing. Me and my friends have a standing rule that two players can make any deal as long as they both agree and the deal only affects their own assets. In one game this one player "owned" another player for a while because the other player was going to have to sell all his houses off to pay a rent but instead agreed to temporarily sell himself into "slavery" until he could pay off the debt. This is obviously technically against the "real" rules but we allowed it and it led to some hilarious hijinks. Anyway, the point is that monopoly is fun as is but a lot more fun when you get creative.

product_title: Holey Moley (DAMAGE BLISTER PACK)
review_headline: So Simple but SO MUCH FUN!
review_body: This game may not have cool graphics or be very challengling, but my kids LOVE IT! The sound effects are funny & not irritating(and they can be turned off!) Great game for road trips, since it's small. SUPER VALUE at (dollar amount)!

product_title: Mobiel Suit Wing Gundam Action Figure Model Kit
review_body: this guy  took me one hour. it is easier than i thought. this is my 2nd gundam model. i am going to buy more because it is fun and easy to build.

product_title: Five Crowns
review_headline: Always a Winner at Game Night
review_body: I introduced this game to Game Night a few months ago.  Although it is a little difficult to explain the rules, once we do a practice hand, everyone is pretty much on board (even though someone inevitably discards a wild card). The game is always a hit - at least one game is played every time a group gets together. Previous players want to get in on a game and are eager to explain the rules to newer players.  The best thing is that you can get a large number of players involved and it doesn't take a lot of time to set up.

product_title: LIttle Tikes Easy Store Jr. Play Table
review_body: This is probably one of the best purchases made for my one year old daughter.  She has snacks, colors, and plays with small toys on this table.  The best thing about this table is that the benches are attached.  This prevents her from tumbling over in a chair.  This table is a good height for young children.  My daughter has survived many falls from the benches as well as the top of this table, many without a tear shed.  This is the sturdiest table around it has stood up to my daughters newest hobby of climbing and bouncing on everything.  The color of this table is good too, it matches my new "Little Tikes" decor.

product_title: Step2 Push Around Buggy Toddler Pushing Car - Durable and Safe Outdoor Wagon Cart for Kids - Red
review_body: This is a wonderful toy.  My son who is 7 months and just learned to sit  up by himself can sit in the seat belt and be pushed around in the little  car.  He loves to hold onto the stearing wheel and be pushed around.  It is  very easy to push and provides many hours of enjoyment for all of us.

product_title: Hasbro Twister
review_body: I have personally been playing this game ever since I learned how to walk.  It is goofy, embarrasing, funny, tiring, and unique in its on way.  You can introduce this to kids at birthday partys or at college orientation.   No matter what the age or where you are at, you can play twister and not be  disappointed.  And it is a great ice breaker at any business party.

product_title: Hasbro Twister
review_body:
I am a college student, and we play this game very often. For one thing it is absolutly hysterical to see two really tall basketball players all tied up, it is fun to play indoors or out, and it challenges your brain. You're probably thinking "What? How does Twister, a physical game, challenge my brain?" Even if you were just thinking "I'm hungry, I think I'll have a Tuna Fish Sandwich," or "Where did I put my Detroit Tigers Baseball cap?" I'll tell you how it challenges your brain. (Did I mention that I am studying to be a teacher?) Okay, Raise your left hand if you know the difference between left and right . . .no your other left hand - good job! One way Twister challenges your brain is that you need to know your left from your right. (Wow amazing!) Now I want you to cross your legs,bend over, put your left hand on the ground through your legs and your right hand on the ground in front of you - now stay that way until I tell yu to move your right arm again - guess what this involves? That's right Balance and coordination! (You get a gold star!) Okay so far we have balance, coordination, and knowing your left from your right. This game also teaches about colors - do you know the difference between red, green, blue,and yellow? Even if you are color blind you can play because they are in rows and if you really want you can label the circles. Did you know that physical activity is good for your brain and it helps you learn better? It really does - there is well proven research on that - go look it up if you don't believe me. Oh yeah - can you show me the difference between your feet and your hands? That is a very important life lesson - if you aren't sure about those I'd like to have a word with your parents please!
One small warning - take off your shoes first - when the mat gets ripped the game isn't fun anymore - you might want to put an oder eater ball in the box if you just played with college boys :o)!

product_title: Fisher-Price Bright Beginnings Ready Steady Trike
review_body: AFTER I PURCHASED THIS TOY I FOUND OUT THAT IT REALLY ISN'T AS STABLE AS THEY ADVERTISE.  MY CHILD EVEN FELL OFF OF IT WHILE TRYING TO GET ON IT. THE HANDLE BARS HARDLY EVEN TURN.  I WAS TOTALLY UNSATISFIED.

product_title: Bop It Extreme
review_body: It's a really fun game (like a musical "simon")on it's own, but it's even great as a substitute for "quarters" (for those of us over 21) with a bunch of friends.

product_title: Test Big Data 14542
review_body: I was very hopeful that the children I watch everyday would love this table and that it would keep them busy.  However, they quickly lost their interest and the table is usually just carried around the house, or used as a step to get to something higher.  The blocks are either chewed on, or thrown about the room.  I wish it was more challenging and could hold a toddlers attention longer.  I was very disappointed in this toy.

product_title: Scrabble
review_headline: Scrabble is the board game that help the entire family
review_body: As a child, we played Scrabble at least 2 to 3 times a week.  My parents had an added bonus for us... any time we could place one of our school vocabulary words on the board, the score for that word was automatically  doubled.  This had phenomenal value for each of us.  Since my parents never  dummied down their own words or scores, it gave us a chance to stay  competetive with adults, without being condescending.  It also gave my  parents a way of staying in touch with our school work (and we all know how  important parental involvement is!)  As a parent myself, I still believe in  the value of games such as Scrabble.  Try this method with your own  children!

product_title: The Simpsons Radio Control Skateboarding Bart Simpson
review_body: Let me start off by saying, "WOW, that was really quick."  Talk about FAST service.  I received the toy in just a couple of days.  I asked my son what he wanted to say about the toy and his reply was, "I LOVE IT!!!  It's soooo coool, mom,...thank you, thank you, etc.  So I guess that pretty much sums it up.  As for me, it shouldn't really matter what I think unless of course it was damaged or defective, but it wasn't & besdides that, I'm not the one playing with it.  My son is happy and loving it and that's what really matters.  Although, I did get a real good laugh watching my son spin Bart around and giggle.  Now that's priceless!

product_title: Dolphin Ride-On
review_body: A TON of fun but it's not easy to stay on.

product_title: Apples to Apples Core Game
review_body: I just returned from our family reunion. We shared Apples to Apples with everyone from ages 10 to 70 years of age. It was a big hit! We were laughing so hard, we had to rotate players so that we could catch our  breath! I highly recommend this game if you are looking for a fun family  game or a game to play at your next group function.

product_title: Proverbial Wisdom (The Exciting Game of Proverbial Fun)
review_headline: This Game Is More Fun Than A Barrel Of Monkeys!
review_body: I played this game with a few friends and their children.  I think the children had more fun than anyone else.  The sketch cards were the most  fun, but the fact that everyone could get involed was the nicest aspect of  this game.

product_title: Rush Hour Logic Game
review_body: My 10-year old nephew brought this to the beach with him and had to fight  to get it away from the adults! We all got hooked on it! It's a great game  and addictive! You just don't want to put it down.  END

product_title: Rubik's Cube
review_body: The Rubik's cube is a great puzzle.  Fits neatly in a backpackor your hand to take practically everywhere.  Although the bookletdoesn't tell you exactly how to solve it, it has great tips.  However, it takes so many turns to figure the cube out, that by the time you've mastered it, it may be hard to determine which color is which because the stickers fade and peel.

product_title: LeapFrog Original LeapPad Learning System from 2004
review_body: I bought the LeapPad for my Grandson last year when he was 3. He knows the states from the map, the bones on the skeleton, and he is now 4 and learning to read. I recommend this book for all children. It is a fun way to learn and kids seem to love it.

product_title: Little Tikes Cozy Coupe
review_body: My 20 month old son just received this as a gift. After playing with everyone else's for months, he now has one of his own. What a brilliant car!! I would recommend everyone get one for their child, boy or girl. Very sturdy and very well made. That's Little tikes for you though. Well done!!!

product_title: Nerf Action: Wild Fire
review_headline: An Excellent Choice For Either Offense Or Defense
review_body: I am the sniper on our nerf team.  Although I generally like long-range weapons like the Crossbow or Ultimator, The Wildfire is a great sidearm.  Once, in the middle of a Nerf battle, i was attacked at point blank by an  opponent.  Because the Wildfire's strap allowed me to hang it on my back  within easy reach, I was able to bring him down before he could do the same  to me.

product_title: What Makes a Rainbow?: A Magic Ribbon Book
review_body: This book has been a favorite for my three month old son.  He loves the colorful pages and the pop up sun at the end of the book.   We read this book almost daily to him.  It will be a great start for him to learn his colors.   Each page is filled with vibrant colors of the rainbow and is written simple enough for young children to understand.   A must for every child.

product_title: K'Nex International Space Station
review_body:
How I wish these toys had been around when I was a kid! My 10-year-old son spent several after-school hours putting this item together. It motivated him to research the REAL international space station, and to educate the family, his friends, his teachers and classmates, and anyone who would stay still long enough, about the details of its purpose and construction.
Regarding durability: He took his construction to his science teacher's classroom, where it was handled by hundreds of kids every day for months. He brought it home -- perfectly intact -- and it now sits as a piece of scientific/kinetic art in our living room (along with several other brilliant constructions).
As a parent, and as a grown-up kid who loves to play and think, I love k'nex.

product_title: Steve Yzerman Series 1 Action Figure by McFarlane's Sportspicks
review_headline: starting lineup collector who is changing his mind
review_body: This product has so much detail it is unbelievable.  Look at Stevie Y's eye you can even see his scar.  Scuff marks on the skates very real and I believe that the collecting world will be set on fire by this product.  I cannot wait for the baseball!  Anyone who has ever collected sports figures need to check out this new line.

product_title: Honor of the Samurai by Gamewright
review_headline: This is a great family game!
review_body: Our family plays this game every night.  My 10-year old son and 12-year old daughter never tire of it.  Actually, my husband and I enjoy it too!  It's a great way to learn strategy, negotiating and some history, too.

product_title: Jenga Game
review_headline: Finally, a game elders can play, too.
review_body:
I'd never played Jenga until we got it out at the adult daycare center where I work... and then I didn't want to quit. (Neither did the elderly woman I was playing: It turned into a real battle of wits.)
Many of the elders at the center have dementia; most are frail and have lost muscle tone. Jenga is simple in strategy, great for hand-eye coordination, and just plain fun.
Just watching my opponent concentrate -- and whoop at her successes -- made me a die-hard fan. (And she was a lot more skilled at playing than I was...)

product_title: Clue
review_body:
I loved this game as a child, I love it as an Adult!
This is a board game that parents and children can play together...and both have fun.
What's in the game? The game board is filled with different rooms (kitchen, library, billard room etc) and spaces that lead you to the rooms..there are also two seceret passages. You have game pieces (all different colours) which represent the people ...who are all suspected of killing Mr. Boddy...was it Colonel Musterd? Mrs. Scarlett? or perhaps Mr. Green. To add, you have different weapons that could have led to Mr. Boddy's demise...the rope, revolver, candlestic etc.
All game players are given equil amounts of cards...each card has a person, weapon or a room on it. 3 cards (one room one weapon one person) are hidden in an envelope that cannot be opened until a player has decided he/she knows the answer. The player then looks at their cards and crosses off that person, room or weapon on his recording sheet...the player then can wonder about the other rooms etc
The players start rolling the dice, going into rooms and making accusations....
If you like detective work, try to find Mr. Boddy's killer!
You'll have fun!

product_title: Creations by You Plateworks Design Your Own Plate
review_body:
My daughter and I bought this kit for our 5 year old to make as a gift.
It comes with everything that you need to make a plate mug or cup. You draw your picture on the paper, send it back in and they make a plate out of your art work!
Great for boys or girls!!

product_title: Coodju
review_body: This game sparks massive fun competition in everyone who plays.  I've played with large and small groups and we always have a great time spelling backwards, forwards, from the outside in--you have to try it!  The scoring system is inventive and exciting.   I highly recommend it for families, friends, classroom teachers and college students. There's no other game like it.

product_title: GeoSafari Talking Globe Assortment
review_headline: A fun way to learn so much geography!
review_body: I have this in my classroom, and it's one of the most popular free-time choices.  When students visit from other rooms, this is usually the first place they go.  I am amazed how absorbed children get playing with the  globe. My own children have spent hours playing the games and just  listening to the music when they have to go to work with Mom.  I think the  voice is espescially clear and easy to listen to.  It's a fun and painless  way to learn world geography.
